rgyud 'bum/ tshomi (86)rjerdo:ji tshar 11 3bye :re /) 11byange 110515 dpal snyang rgyan sa dra/ ba rgyud rgyal na / 3dkyil 'khor chen po/ daphyag rgya'i rim par phye ba/ 55dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 66chu lha'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 70me lha zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po/ 71rlung lha'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 72bzlas pa'i de kho na nyid kyi le'u/ 73de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bstod pa'i rgyal po/ 75de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku'i sgrub pa'i thabs 77de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdzas kyi bya ba sgrub pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs kyi le'u/ 81rdo rje ka kṣa'i sbyor ba mdor bsdus te bstan pa/ 881

ngag gi sgrub pa'i thabs 95de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor gyi sgrub thabs kyi cho ga rgyas pa'i rim par phye ba/ 98sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sgrub pa'i thabs 105khro bo'i dkyil 'khor/ 117sngags kyi de kho na nyid/ 122dam tshig chen po'i de kho na nyid gsang ba zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor chen bo/ 134shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i dkyil 'khor 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i rtog pa rgyas pa/ 146yang dag par spong ba rjod pa zhes bya ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo la sogs pa bstan pa/ 162chos rje sa skya pa'i bsgyur 'phro lags/bu ston gyis rgya dpe la gtugs shing slob dpon rab zhi bshes gnyen gyi 'grel pa dang ba na nas zhus dag byas/mnyam pa nyid ces bya ba'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sogs bstan pa/ 176dpal ldan blo gros brtan pas bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(191) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(232)0516 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo nyi shu rtsa lnga pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ na dbasdur mchan/(236) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(237)2

0517 de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba rgyan gyi bkod pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 238de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje ye shes yum chen mo rnams kyi phyag rgya ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor/ 238de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yum gyi phyag rgya'i ye shes mchog gi dkyil 'khor/ 251gsang ba rgyan gyi bkod pa zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal po/ 308de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchod pa dang mchod pa'i lan la sogs pa/ 315rgya gar gyi mkhan po brda sprod pa chen po bde bar gshegs pa'i dpal zhes bya ba dang / sgyur byed kyi mkhas pa sgra'i gzhung lugs la blo gros dkar ba kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis dpal sa skya'i dben gnas dam par bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(324) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(341)0518 'phags pa gsang ba nor bu thig le zhes bya ba'i mdo/ 342sems so sor rig pa la sogs pa rgyas pa/ 342lha mo'i rgyud kyi cho ga rgyas pa/ 358gsang ba'i de kho na nyid sbas pa mtha' dag gi cho ga rgyas pa/ 379bcud len gyi cho ga rgyas pa/ 413gsang ba'i 'byung gnas/ 415mkhas pa bde bar gshegs pa'i dpal dang /kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur/3

bsdur mchan/(421) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(435)0519 rnam par snang mdzad chen po mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa rnam par sprul pa byin gyis rlob pa shin tu rgyas pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs/ 436sems kyi khyad par rim par phye ba/ 436bgegs zhi bar bya ba'i rim par phye ba rgyas pa/ 456spyi'i gsang sngags kyi mdzod rim par phye ba rgyas pa/ 496'jig rten pa'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i rim par phye ba/ 504dngos grub bsgrub pa'i de kho na nyid rim par phye ba rgyas pa/ 506lha'i ting nge 'dzin gtan la dbab pa rim par phye ba/ 526mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin rim par phye ba/ 528'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bzlas brjod kyi de kho na nyid rim par phye ba/ 529yi ge'i 'khor lo rim par phye ba rgyas pa/ 530rnam pa thams cad du 'jug pa'i sgo chos kyi yi ge'i tshul rim par phye ba/ 540gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor rim par phye ba/ 559gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa rim par phye ba/ 561gsang ba'i phyag rgya brgyad rim par phye ba/ 583gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du gzud pa la 'jug pa'i rim par phye ba rgyas pa/ 586rig sngags kyi brtul zhugs rim par phye ba rgyas pa/ 589slob dpon gyi de kho na nyid shes pa rim par phye ba/ 592

yi ge bkod pa rim par phye ba/ 694byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa thabs dang ldan pa rim par phye ba/ 695yi ge brgya 'byung ba bstan pa rim par phye ba/ 602'bras bu'i sbyor ba bstan pa rim par phye ba/ 608yi ge brgya pa rnam par dgod pa sgrub pa rim par phye ba/ 605bdag nyid sgrub pa'i rim par phye ba/ 608yi ge brgya pa'i sngags kyi cho ga rim par phye ba/ 612rdzogs par byang chub pa'i ngo bo nyid bstan pa'i rim par phye ba/ 613dam tshig gsum spyad pa rim par phye ba/ 614de bzhin gshegs pa bstan pa rim par phye ba/ 616gsang sngags kyi sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i cho ga ji snyed pa rim par phye ba nyi shu rtsa lnga pa 617zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga rim par phye ba/ 622rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gi las kyi cho ga rim par phye ba/ 633dbang du bya ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga rim par phye ba/ 639drag shul spyad pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga rim par phye ba/ 642bsgom pa'i yi ge dgod pa dang dbang bskur ba rnam par phye ba/ 646bzlas brjod kyi cho ga rim par phye ba/ 650de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po byin gyis rlob pa/ 653rgya gar gyi mkhan po 'i len dra bo snyi dang /zhu chen gyi lotstsha ba bad de dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(694) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(756)0520 de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi khro bo'i rgyal po 'phags 5

pa mi g.yo ba de'i stobs dpag tu med pa brtul phod pa 'dul bar gsungs pa zhes bya ba'i rtog pa/ 757rgya gar gyi mkhan po u la sha ma rakṣi ta'i zhal snga nas lotstsha ba glan dge slong dar ma blo gros kyis bsgyur cing zhus/phyis su lo tsā ba dge slong chos skyong bzang pos rgya dpe la legs par gtugs te gtan la phab/spar yang dge slong ā nanda maṅga yaṃ gyis bi kra ma la shrī la'i gtsug lag gi rgya dpe la gtugs nas/ mi 'chos su mi rung ba rnams legs par bcos te dag par bgyis/bsdur mchan/(902) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(935)smo dkar chag gi zur ma na/ chos tshan (0519)pa'i mtshan byang rgyas drags pas thod yig tu bsdus te bkod yod/6

nga spyang ri ri ju ga ra /rngo/ri/ /ske zhe 47) ri nga'i nye pho mome dzwa tsho ———ma2 4 bye ji tsho dā rmi tsho〉 mo dzā /stordo /༷ 3 ༷ ༷ ji ste rwa byung gardo nga mji / —— ri —— — — —ci / pari / — — —tshang ci rmi chosalagaX mi cas pa'i ci ri ci ci na pa ge —— — —44 ru ci chos ci ————— mdzo ru ne stsa ༄ /gzhi snying me tog gis brgyan pa'i/ /zhing sga 'dren pa rnam snang mdzad/ /

༄ga /dpal rdo rje snying po rgyan ces bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po/nya))tshogi /rgya gar skad du/ shrī badzra maṇḍa ②a lo ka ra nā ma ma hā tan tra rā dzā / bod skad du/ dpal rdo rje snying po rgyan ces bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen pobya/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhabs kyi padma la spyi bos gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje dang / nor bu dang / rin po che dang / padma dang / las kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i dam tshig gi ye shes rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i 9shekhyad par yidang ldan pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rin po che'i cod pan khams gsum pa'i chos kyi rgyal por dbang bskur bar 7dbarnyes pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje dam tshig gi ye shes rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi phyag rgya brnyes pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya thams cad 58dmanyam pa 86—3

nyid ①thugs su chud cing las sna tshogs mdzad pa ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i sems can gyi khams thams cad kyi re ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i rdo rje'i las mdzad pa/ thugs rje chen po rnam par snang mdzad chen po rtag pa dus gsum ri du gnas pa'i sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bsten gcing bsngags pa'i nor bu rin po che chen po dang ldan pa/ kha dog rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i dril bu btags pa/ rlung gis bskyod pa'i dar gyi ba dan medang / me tog gi chun po dang / dra ba dang dra ba phyed pas bklubs tsho shing nye bar mdzes pa/ chos kyi dbyings thams cad legs par yongs su dag pa/ chos kyi dbyings kyi khang bzangs yi'od mtha' yas pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gtsug (gelag khang 2me tog gi 'khri shing mchog gi snying po'i rgyan gyis bkod pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud rgya mtsho rab tu bkram pa'i sprin nam mkha'i khams yongs su khyab pa/ de bzhin gshegs pas byin gyis brlabs pa/ mtha' las 'das pa'i sangs rgyas 'khrungs pa'i 9dbus/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi snying po 'od gsal ba'i gzhal med khang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas/ rdo rje snying po'i rgyan/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje/ de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrung 7mi 'gog 'gog par mi 'gyur ba'i yan lag gi spyod yul yang dag pa'i mtha' gsal 1lhab/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi nyi thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi yul/ chos kyi dbyings kyi snying po'i khang bzangs/ste de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi sku/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byang chub kyi snying po sa chen po'i dam pa bol bzhugs so/ /de la sangs rgyas 86—4

kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul phra rab kyi ①rdul dang mnyam pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis yongs su bskor zhing mdun du bdar te chos ston par mdzad do/ /thog shu mar dge ba bar du dge ba tha mar dge ba/ don bzang po/ tshig 'bru bzang po ma 'dres ②pa yongs su rdzogs pa yongs su dag pa yongs su dkar ba chos thams cad kyi tshul rnam par ④dag pa'i sgo ston par mdzad do/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes sems dpa'/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi nyi ma/ rnam par rgyal ba'i dam tshig 'byung gnas rdo rje snying po/ chos thams cad ngo bo nyid kyis rnam par dag pa'i ye shes mnyam pa nyid brnyes ⑤pa/ rgya mtsho ltar zab pa/ las sna tshogs pa'i phyag rgya'i ye shes thob pa yisku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje nam mkha' ( ralta bu/ sku chen po rdo rje'i skul/ mtha' las 'das pa'i sku/ sku rin po che chos kyi sku/ sprul pa'i sku/las (kyemanyam pa nyid kyi sku/ byang chub kyi sems don yod pa/ yongs su bsdus pa / dge ba 'phel ba/ rgyal po chen po snang ba (9)tog /bzhad ribeb pori nye/chos dang ldan pa/ shes rab 8'khor lo/ skad thams cad pa/ sna tshogs pa can/ srung rtsonab po/ gnod sbyin can/ mtshams sbyor ba/ lagatsug tor 15du gyur pa/ mchog ldan/ rdo rje can/ 'khor lo can/ ye shes can/ khyab bdag tshichen po/ sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad mdu legs par bzhugs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yang dag par 'du bar byed /8pa/ rdo rje'i dbyings thams cad khong du chud pa'i ye shes 86—5

sems dpa' nam mkha'i khams thams cad kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul dang mnyam pa'i ①rdo rje'i byin rlabs ②kyi ye shes snying po/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bla na med pa'i rdo rje ③rin po che'i dbang bskur ba chen po'i dam tshig nam mkha'i khams thams cad du spros pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i mngon par shes pa mngon par byang chub par gyur pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid kyi ngo bo rnam par dag pa de yis ④chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis dag pa nam mkha' thams cad 'a)la khyab pa po/ gzugs thams cad yongs su mthong ba'i ye shes kyis ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i sems can 'dul ba'i spyod pa mchog dang ldan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad don yod pa'i bka' lung mdzad pas sems can thams cad mnyam pa nyid bla na med pa'i las sna tshogs pa can / rnam snang mi 'gyur mi bskyod pa/ /rin chen tog ste kye'od byed pa/ /'od dpag med pa rgyal ba'i mgon/ /don yod pa ni las kun byed/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid kyi (7noye shes la rab tu gnas pa/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi so sor rtog 98)pa'i ye shes gnyis su med pa brnyes pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bya ba grub 99)pa'i ye shes yang dag par rjes su thob pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi spyod yul/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gnyis su med cing mnyam pa nyid dmigs pa'i ye shes yongs su dag pa mthar phyin patsha/ stong pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid nyi dang —/ yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / mtshan ma med pa dang 12/ smon pa med pa 86—6

dang ske/ tshangs pa'i gnas pa 6)bzhi po dag gis sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi yul du gyur pa/ sangs rgyas kyi yul mnyam pa nyid la dmigs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po ②nyid la byin gyis brlabs nas / phyogs dang mtshams rnams su kun tu chaganas so/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das ④rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug gis/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal khyod kyis sangs rgyas thams cad dang rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams spyan drongs shig /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / 'jam dpal gzhon nu 'khor los sgyur (kheb chen po rab tu dgyes pa'i zhal ras kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams spyan drang ba'i don du rdo rje se gol brdabs te de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bsdu ba'i 56)snying po chen po du ra'adi ched du brjod pa/ bud dha sa mā dzaḥsera.āḥhāḥ.i hūṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ de nas de skad ces brjod nyu)pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams kyis 'jig rten gyi khams me tog gi gzhi'i ri )snying po'i rgyan bkod pa'i rgyud rab 'byam nyunyergya mtsho'i sprin yang dag /napar mthong ngo / /de nas yang 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad la nyu de bzhin gshegs pa rnams nyu )thams cad kyis nyugelhan cig yang dag par sbyar tshanas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje blo'i nyu ye shes yongs su bskyed de gnas thams cad du rnam par gnas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i rang bzhin rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug gis /shede bzhin gshegs pa thams cad nyid du 36bdag nyid byin gyis brlabs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams dang 86—7

rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams la bka' stsal pa/ kye de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad thams cad ri3)mkhyen pa'i ye shes ②'khor los sgyur ③ba chen po'i snying po bdag la yod pa 97de ngas bshad par bya'o⑤/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis ⑥byin gyis rlobs shig /rgyuX/ de nas/ mi bskyod nide bzhin gshegs pa dang //rin chen 'byung gnas de bzhin gshegs/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med / /don yod grub pa de bzhin gshegs/ /gzhan yang de bzhin spugashegs pa rnams dang lhan cig de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ⑩dpal gyi be'u la rab tu zhugs so|sto/ /zhugs pa tsam gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'khor lo la rtortabade ba 'ostethams cad yang dag par ston rnam/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad zhal bzhir gyur te/ zhal bzhi po rnams kyis 8chos kyi dbyings dang nam mkha'i khams mtha' med pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yul chos kyi tshul mngon par brtags pa 'di nyid 7dbyangs kyis tsoched du brjod lha pa 'di lta ste/ rab tu dga' ba rnam par dag pa'i gnas gang yin pa de ni 'di lta ste1rto/ byang chub sems dpa'i gnas so/ /lta ba rnam ( — )par dag pa'i gnas gang yin pa de ni 'di lta ste byang chub sems dpa'i gnas so/ /dga' ba rnam par dag pa'i gnas gang yin pa de ni 'di lta ste byang chub sems dpa'i 2nyaganas sol/ /sred pa rnam par dag pa'i gnas gang yin pa de ni 'di lta ste byang chub sems dpa'i gnas so/ /'dod chags rnam par dag pa'i gnas gang yin pa de ni 'di lta ste byang chub sems dpa'i gnas so/ /zhe snang rnam par dag pa'i gnas gang yin pa de ni 'di lta ste byang chub sems dpa'i gnas so/ /gti mug rnam par dag pa'i gnas gang yin pa de ni 'di lta ste byang chub sems dpa'i (96—8

gnas so/ /nga rgyal rnam par dag pa'i gnas gang yin pa de ni 'di lta ste byang chub sems dpa'i gnas so/ /mi khom pa rnam par dag pa'i gnas gang yin pa de ni 'di lta ste byang chub sems dpa'i gnas so/ /yid sim pa rnam par dag pa'i gnas gang yin pa de ni 'di lta ste byang chub sems dpa'i gnas so/ /snang ba rnam par dag pa'i gnas gang yin pa de ni 'di lta ste byang chub sems dpa'i gnas so/ /lus rnam par dag pa'i gnas gang yin pa de ni 'di lta ste byang chub sems dpa'i gnas so/ /ngag rnam par dag pa'i gnas gang yin pa de ni 'di lta ste byang chub sems dpa'i gnas so/ /yid rnam par dag pa'i gnas gang yin pa de ni 'di lta ste byang chub sems dpa'i gnas so/ /gzugs rnam par dag pa'i gnas gang yin pa de ni 'di lta ste byang chub sems dpa'i gnas so/ /sgra rnam par dag pa'i gnas gang yin pa de ni 'di lta ste byang chub sems dpa'i gnas so/ /dri rnam par dag pa'i gnas gang yin pa de ni 'di lta ste byang chub sems dpa'i gnas so/ /ro rnam par dag pa'i gnas gang yin pa de ni 'di lta ste byang chub sems dpa'i gnas so/ /reg rnam par dag pa'i gnas gang yin pa de ni 'di lta ste byang chub sems dpa'i gnas so/ /dngos po thams cad rnam par dag pa'i gnas gang yin pa de ni 'di lta ste byang chub sems dpa'i gnas so/ / de'i rgyu hudaci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa ste/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas gsang sngags ri thams cad kyi dbang phyug gsang sngags thams cad kyi 'dren pa po/ sngags thams cad kyi bla mar gyur pa/ thams cad 86—9

gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ①ba/ bstan pa la brdzi ②ba med pa/ 'khor los sgyur buba'i snying po bka' stsal pa/ :bya/ 'jam dpal gang la las chos thams cad ⑤bsdus pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po 'di lan cig 0tsam yang thos na de'i byang chub kyi snying po la thug pa'i bar du sgrib pa thams cad dang ④chod pa dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang / chos kyi sgrib pa dang las kyi sgrib pa chen po ༄༄nye bar bsags kyang nam yang ⑨dmyal ba la sogs pa'i ⑩ngan song rnams su ltung kyi/bar mi 'gyur ro/ /0sdig pa rnams byas pa tsam (sten yang sdug bsngal med cing zad par 'gyur ro/ /gang gis 'di 'chang ba dang / nyi ma re re 'don ④pa dang / klog 7pa dang rgyun ma 9nyu9chad par tshul bzhin na yid la byed pa de ni skye ba 'di nyid la chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin so sor thob nas chos thams cad kyi dbang phyug tu 'gyur ro/ /chos thams cad la dga' zhing mgu la rab tu dga' ba myong bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' chen po skye ba bcu drug na/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid dam rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid thob par 'gyur ro/ /rghaṃ/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyis slar yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhi ba'i chos nyid mngon par byang chub pa zhunyamangon par bsgrub 46pa 'di ston par mdzad do/ / rdo rje brtan pa nyid kyi ne gyerdo rje mnyam pa nyid mngon par rdzogs par 7byang chub pa'i byang chub chen po 22dang / don gcig pa nyid kyis don mnyam pa nyid mngon par byang chub pa'i byang chub ( nyachen po dang /rang bzhin rnam par dag pas chos nyid ri 7mnyam pa nyid mngon par byang chub pa'i byang chub chen po dang / rnam par rtog pa dang rnam par mi rtog pa nyid kyis las 86—10

thams cad mnyam pa nyid mngon par byang chub pa'i ①byang chub chen po ste/(kye'ajam dpal gang la las chos kyi gnas bzhi po 'di nyan par byed ③pa dang /'dzin pa dang / 'don pa dang / sgom par byed na ji srid byang chub snying po la gnas kyi ④bar du sdig pa thams cad la kun tu spyod pa thams cad kyang (nyesdig pa thams cad las 'das par ⑥'gyur zhing myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par byang chub par 'gyur ro/ //⑦/ de nas yang bcom ldan 'das gdug pa thams cad 'dul ba de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal bas bsdus pa zhes bya ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mngon (8)par sgrub ⑨pa bka' stsal pa/ 'dod chags kyi tsospros pa med pa'i phyir 'dod chags hu༄spros pa med pa'o/ /zhe sdang gi spros pa ri gemed pa'i phyir zhe sdang tho spros pa med pa'o/ /gti mug gi spros pa med pa'i phyir gti mug 0spros pa med pa'o/ /chos thams cad spros pa med pa'i phyir chos thams cad spros pa med pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa spros pa med pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa spros pa med par rig 57par bya'o/ /'jam dpal gang la la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul 'di nyan pa dang 8'dzin cing 'don la klog par byed na de nyu 'dul ba'i dbang nye bar bzung /nyenas khams gsum du skyes pa'i sems can rnams bsad /shepar gyur kyang ngan song du 'gro bar mi 'gyur zhing myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i tsho )byang chub par 'gyur ro/ /hūm̐/ de nas bcom ldan 'das rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i chos nyid brnyes 1pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa ri 4slar yang chos thams cad spyan ras gzigs sridabang phyug ye shes kyi phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin 86—11

pa'i tshul 'di bka' stsal pa/ ①'dod chags thams cad rnam par dag pa'i phyir 'jig rten na ②yul thams cad rnam par dag pa nyid du 'jug par 'gyur ro⑤ / /zhe sdang thams cad rnam par dag pa'i phyir 'jig rten na④sdig pa thams cad rnam par dag pa nyid du 'jug par 'gyur ro⑤/ /chos thams cad rnam par dag pa'i phyir 'jig rten na ⑤chos thams cad rnam par dag pa nyid du 'jug par 'gyur rol/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes rnam par dag pa'i phyir 'jig rten na ②thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes rnam par dag pa nyid du 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /khyashes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rnam par dag pa'i phyir 'jig rten na 7shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rnam par dag pa nyid du 'jug par 'gyur ronanya/ /'jam dpal gang la las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul 'di 8nyan par byed 'a'adzin cing 'don la sgom par byed na de 'dod pa thams cad kyi nang na gnas kyang padma lta bur 'dod chags kyi skyon 0blo 0bur ba'i dri mas tshagos par mi 'gyur zhing myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par byang chub par 'gyur ro/ /hrīḥ/ de nas bcom ldan 'das khams gsum pa bothams cad kyi mi bdag po de bzhin gshegs pas slar yang 17de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dbang bskur ba'i 'byung gnas ye shes snying po zhes bya ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul bka' stsal pa/dbang bskur byin pas khams tshogasum po thams cad kyi rgyal srid gisteyongs su thob par 'gyur ro/ /don gyi sbyin pas thams cad kyi bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /chos kyi sbyin pas chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid thob par 'gyur ro//zang zing gi sbyin pas thams cad kyi lus dang ngag dang yid bde ba thob par 86—12

'gyur ro/ /4①/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi phyag rgya brnyes ②pa thams cad kyi khu tshur 'chang ba de bzhin gshegs pa rtag pas slar yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes phyag rgya ②byin gyis brlabs pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul bka' stsal pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku'i phyag rgya yongs su gzung bas ④de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad nyid du 'gyur ba dang / gsung gi phyag rgya yongs su gzung ⑤bas chos thams cad thob pa'i don du 'gyur ba dang / thugs kyi phyag rgya yongs su gzung ⑥bas ting nge 'dzin thams cad thob pa'i don du 'gyur ba dang / rdo rje'i phyag rgya yongs su gzung 9)bas sku dang gsung dang thugs thams cad rdo rje mchog tu 'grub ⑧pa'i don du 'gyur te/ 'jam dpal gang la las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul 'di nyan par byed yonye'adzin cing 'don la 'chad cing sgom par byed na/ de chadangos grub thams cad dang phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang / ye shes thams cad dang / las thams cad hu) sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje sems dpa' /gemachog gi dngos grub thams cad so sor tsothob par 'gyur zhing myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par byang chub par 'gyur ro/ /aḥ8/ de nas bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad spros pa med pa'i de bzhin gshegs pas slar yang rdo rje'i yi ge'i 'khor lo bskor tsob zhes bya ba'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul bka' stsal pa/ rang bzhin med pa'i tshul gyis 57chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang chos thams cad mtshan ma med pa humanye bar gzung nyusheba'i phyir chos thams cad mtshan mas dben pa dang / smon pa las nye bar grol ba'i phyir chos thams 86—13

cad smon pa med pa ①dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa'i phyir chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'o/ /il/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor lo'i nang du gnas pa'i ②de bzhin gshegs pas slar yang 'khor lo ༅chen por 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul bka' stsal pa/ rdo rje mnyam pa nyid la zhugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor lor ⑤'jug par 'gyur ba dang /don mnyam pa nyid la zhugs nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i 'khor lor 'jug ⑥par 'gyur ba dang / chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid la zhugs nas dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lor ⑦'jug par 'gyur ba dang / las mnyam pa nyid la zhugs nas 'khor lo 985tshothams cad du 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /rghaṃ/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas pa'i snod de bzhin gshegs pas slar yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchod pa dam pa zhes bya ba'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul bka' stsal pa/ byang chub kyi sems bskyed pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas pa dang / sems can gyi khams thams cad yongs su skyob pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su gzung 9bas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'dri bob dang / 'drir 31'jug pa dang /'dzin pa dang / 'don pa dang / rjod 12pa dang sgom pa sngon 12du 'gro ba'i las kyi 'de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas pa'o/ /oṃ/ de nas bcom ldan 'das gdug pa thams cad 'dul ba'i skanus pa'i 7de bzhin 86—14

gshegs pas slar yang sems can thams cad 'dul ba'i ye shes snying po zhes bya ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul 'di bka' stsal pa/ sems can ①thams cad mnyam pa nyid pas khro ba mnyam pa nyid dang / sems can thams cad ②'dul ba nyid pas khro ba 'dul ba nyid dang / sems can thams cad chos nyid nyid pas khro ba chos nyid nyid dang / sems can thams cad rdo rje nyid pas khro ba rdo rje nyid de de rgyu ①ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar sems can thams cad 'dul ba'i byang chub ste/ haḥbya/ de nas bcom ldan 'das thams cad mnyam pa nyid la rab tu gnas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pas slar yang chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi mchog ces bya ba'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul 'di bka' stsal pa/ thams cad mnyam pa nyid pas (sheshes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam pa nyid dang / thams cad kyi don nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don nyid dang chos ⑥thams cad mnyam pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos mnyam pa nyid dang / thams cad las gnyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las (8༄nyid du rig par bya'o/ /hrīḥ/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis slar yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad byin gyis rlob pa zhes bya ba'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul 'di bka' stsal pa/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po bdag nyid thams cad pas sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i 57snying po dang / rdo rje'i snying pos hu )dbang bskur bas sems can thams cad rdo rje'i snying po dang / rin po che thams cad kyis (chedabang bskur bas sems can thams cad rin po che'i snying po dang / ngag thams cad la rab tu 'jug pas sems can thams cad chos kyi 86—15

snying po dang / las thams cad byed pa'i sbyor bas sems can thams cad las kyi snying po'o/ /hrīḥ/ de nas bcom ldan 'das mtha' las 'das shing mu med pa'i mthar phyin pa'i ①de bzhin gshegs pas slar yang mu med cing mthar phyin pa'i chos dang / slar yang 'di'i rtog pa dang yongs su mthar thug pa byin gyis brlab pa'i don du ②chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid ③yongs su mthar thug dupas byin gyis brlabs pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul 'di bka' stsal pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mtha' med pa'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mtha' med pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mu med pa'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mu med pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gcig pa nyid kyi phyir chos thams cad gcig pa nyid dang /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su mthar thug (gepa'i phyir chos thams cad yongs su mthar thug (6)par 'gyur ba ste/ 'jam dpal gang la ⑦las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul 'di (8)nyan par byed 'dzin cing 'don la sgom par byed na de ni dag cing mthar phyin 97pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mthar phyin pa la gnas pa nyid kyis 71sgrib pa thams cad las rnam par grol bas de bzhin gshegs pa nyid dam rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid myur du thob par 'gyur ro/ /bhyoḥ/nyam/ de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad de bzhin gshegs pa de bzhin gshegs pa 12thams cad kyi gsang ba'i chos nyid brnyes pa/ chos thams cad spros pa med pas nyi slar yang bde ba chen po rdo rje don yod pa'i sadam tshig ces bya ba rdo rje chos mnyam pa nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo dam pa thog ma dang tha ma dang dbus las grol ba'i mchog 'di bka' stsal pa/ byang chub 86—16

sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi 'dod chags chen po mchog tu grub pas bde ba chen po mchog tu grub par 'gyur ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' chen ①po rnams kyi ②bde ba chen po mchog tu grub pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byang chub ①chen po mchog tu grub par 'gyur ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byang chub mchog tu grub pas bdud sde chen po rab tu 'joms pa mchog tu grub par 'gyur ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi bdud sde chen po rab tu 'joms pa mchog tu grub pas khams dugasum po mtha' dag gi ⑤dbang phyug mchog tu grub ⑥par 'gyur ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi 'jig rten gsum po mtha' dag gi dbang phyug mchog tu grub pas ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i sems can gyi khams yongs su skyob pa'i sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i mchog shin tu bde ba chen po mchog tu grub par 'gyur rol/ /sī/ de rgyu ci yi rin phyir zhe na/ ji srid 'khor ba'i gnas su ni/ /mkhas pa mchog rnams gnas gyur pa/ /de srid mnyam med sems can don/ /mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus / /shes rab 6)pha rol nyu )phyin pa'i thabs/ /ye shes byin gyis brlabs kyis 'grub / /las ni thams cad rnam dag pasayi/ /srid pa dag par 'gyur phyir ro/ /chags sogs kyis 'dul 8'jig rten ni/ /kun nas srid par rtag ri'asdig byed8/ /de dag rnam par sbyang don du/ / srid pa'i bar du rang 'dul byedam/ /ji ltar padma legs dmar ba/ / tshon gyi 44skyon gyis ma gos ltar/ /bag chags skyon gyi srid pa ru/ /rtag tu 'gro phan gos mi 'gyur/ /'dod chags chen po rnam dag pa/ /bde ba chen po nor chen po/ /khams gsum 86—17

dbang phyug thob nas su/ /de dag don ni brtan par byed/ /haḥ 'jam dpal gang la las ①shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul gyi sgo'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ②nyin 0re bzhin du nang par langs te/ gang 'don pa dang nyan pa dang 'dzin pa dang / rjod smyogepar byed na/ des bde ba dang / yid ⑤bde ba thams cad thob par 'gyur zhing bde ba chen po rdo rje don yod pa'i dam tshig gi dngos grub mchog tu gyur pa skye ba 'di nyid la thob par 'gyur ro/ /hūṃ/ de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑥'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la bka' stsal pa / 'jam dpal nyi shu rtsa lnga po 'di dag ni nges par shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul gyi sgo ste 'di ltar/ oṃ na maḥsarba ⑦bud dha bo dhi satā durna/ oṃ bo dhi tsitta badzre/ oṃ sa manta bha dra tsābye dhi(7/ oṃ tsihā ma ṇi/ oṃ a ni ro dhe( )/oṃ dzā ti bi bsto11/ oṃ dzā ti pa ri wa ra te/ oṃ (/nyam hā rā ga dharma tetunya/ oṃ bīrya ka ba botse/ oṃ sarba gā mi ni/ oṃ badzra dṛ nye lika ba (9tsi te (nyes phaṭa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga te1 / oṃ swa bhā ba nya shud dhe/ oṃ pradzñā pā ra mi tā ḍa )tshwa na bi shud dhe/ oṃ kurma 21bi sho dha 9 2ni rmo ste// oṃ ni sum̐ bha badzi ṇi 3ste/ phaṭa/ oṃ kurma rā ( )ge/oṃ badzra rtsu badzre kyi/ oṃ rghaṃ 2 tshosarba gā snyem ṇi tsho nyam hrīḥ/ oṃ a ci )kā ro danamu khe oṃ pralha pā dger mi te/ oṃ a sba dzo rgyu/ oṃ rmā mi/ gi tsha sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya a gre/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ bāka bi sho dha de dzī/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsitta badzre aḥ rte/oṃ sbo ṭa ya sarba a pā ya brnya nā gi ni pra mo kṣa ya sarba a pā ya shusteg ti bhyaḥsabra sa ma ya badzra hūṃ phaṭa rmā/ sdig pa 2dral nyaba'i phyag rgya dang sngags so/ /de brjod 69pa tsam gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba mchog gi dngos grub rdo rje 'dzin pa chen 45po'am de de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal 86—18

'di ni dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bskrun ①pa'i sems can rnams kyi rna lam ②du grag ②par mi 'gyur zhing dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bskrun 0pa'i sems can gyis bri ba dang bklag ⑤pa dang brjod dupa dang rim gror ④bya ba dang bla mar bya ba dang / rjed ⑧par bya ba dang mchod par ⑨bya bar yang nus pa ma yin no/ /gzhan du na gang gis ⑩shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul gyi sgo'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di tha 0na yi ge gcig tsam ⑩yang thos nas sems can de sangs rgyas mang po la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun par rig par bya na slar yang mtha' dag ma lus pa 8rdzogs pa lta ci smos/'jam dpal sems can gang la la gang gā'i 0klung gi bye ma brgyad cu asnyed kyi sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig la phyag byas bla mar byas rjed par byas mchod par byas yin/ des shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul 'di nyan par nus so/ / gang du na shwe/chos kyi rnam grangs 'di rab tu tunyespyod par 'gyur ba'i sa'i phyogs /shede mchod rten du gyur par 'gyur te gang zag de yang dzña )phyag bya ba'i 'os su 'gyur ro0/ /gang chos kyi ( ༄rnam grangs 'di yid la gzung du nyeb 'am/ glegs bam du bris par gyur na de bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mang por skye ba dran par 'gyur ro/ /de la bdud sdig to can gyis bar du mi gcod do/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi po rnams dang / gzhan yang lha rnams kyis ( stephyi bzhin rjes su 'brangs te/ de gesung ri cistob dang skyob pa dang / sbed pa zhu byed par 'gyur zhing tshul ma yin pas dus byed par mi 'gyur la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis dgongs 2shepar 'gyur ro/ /mdor yin sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang dang gang yid la 'dod pa de dang der skye bar 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal 'di lta bu'i phan zhu noyon mang po 'di ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 86wa 19

ni ①shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul gyi sgo'i chos kyi rnam ⑤grangs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen pos rdo rje'i ②snying po thams cad kyi rgyan theg pa chen po mngon par rtogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba chen po ④gsang ba'i dam tshig rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug dam pa chen po ⑤'khor los sgyur ⑥ba chen po bzhis yongs su bskor ba rdo rje snying po rgyan ces bya ba'i snying po 'di phyung ngo / /mtshan nyidaphyagacig pa'i phyir chos thams cad gdod (8)nas ma skyes pa'o⑨/ /nam mkha' dang ⑩mnyam pa'i phyir chos thams cad stong pa nyid do/ /spros pa thams cad spangs ⑩pa'i phyir chos thams cad gdod ma nas yongs su (snyedag pa'o/ /thams cad kyi sems gsal ba'i mtshan nyid kyi phyir chos thams cad chos kyi dbyings yongs su rgyas pa'o / /aḥrgyu bla tsā hrīḥ7rgyu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje yi ge'i tshig 'di brjod pa tsam gyis chos kyi dbyings kyi mthas klas pa 8sangs rgyas kyi yul thams cad de snyed nyid du 7shin tu gsal ba rgya chen pos 0snang bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 3nyade bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis ()slar yang bsdu bas byon nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nu 7te/ 'jam dpal gzhon stonar gyur pa la bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje snying po rgyan zhes bya ba'i 6nya dkyil 'khor chen po sa bshad par bya yis gi nyon cig de legs par gi nyon la rab tu 69yid la gyis ( chushig dang ( snyebashad par bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen pos 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal khyod kyang de 86—20

bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi shes rab ye shes la zhugs la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i ①snying po chen po la ②byin gyis brlab par ⑤byos shig /de nas yang 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis gsol ba btab pa'i tshig thos nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kur 0zhugs te/ byin gyis ⑤brlabs nas de las 'thon ②te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi spyan sngar rnam par gnas sol/ /de nas bcom ldan ⑦'das kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig 'byung gnas/ rdo rje snying po'i rgyan byin gyis rlob pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas chos kyi dudabyings kyi rdo rje chen po snying po'i rgyan de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor bkod pa 0chen po bka' stsal pa/ de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /dkyil 'khor chen po mchog gyur pa/ /rdo rje snying po gsang chen po/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun ldan dge/ /rdo rje snying po dang mtshungs pa/ /khams rnams thams cad rnam par sprul/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdud rtsi dang / /gzhan yang bcud len dang mtshungs pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gsang / /rdo rje kun gyi rang bzhin grong / /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhi ⑩ni rnam par mdzes/ /thig bzhi dang ni yang dag ldan/ /dar dang me tog chun pos spras/ /grwa nyunyeyi cha rnams mthams cad dang / /sgo khyud kyi sgyu ni mtshams rnams su/ /rdo rje rin chen rnams kyis spras / / rdo rje'i thig rnams kyis spras pa'i/ /phyi rol chadakyil 'khor thig gdab byam/ /de yi'ang tsophyi rol du bya ba/ /dkyil 'khor bdud rtsi yi ni 'ong //khyad par ji lta ba bzhin du/ /sngags pas kun nas yongs bskor bya/ /de ltar 86—21

rnam bzhi'i rnam pa dang / /ji srid grong ni rnam pa bdun/ /sbyor ba bdun dang yang dag ldan/ /dar dang me tog phreng bas brgyan/ /sgo dang sgo khyud rin chen ni / /yang dag mtho ba legs par gnas/ /de yi grong gi nang du ni/ /rab zhugs 'khor lo 'dra ba ru/ /rdo rje thig gis yongs su bskor/ /ka ba brgyad kyis nye bar mdzes/ /rdo rje ka mdun gnas rnams su/ /dkyil 'khor lnga yis brgyan pa'o/ /de ltar 'khor lo rnam pa gnyis/ /nang gi dkyil 'khor dang mtshungs pa/ /tshad mdzes pa yi snying po che/ /rdo rje 'khor los rnam par brgyan07 / /gru bzhi pa dang zlum po nyid9gyi/ /gru gsum rnam par yang dag byung / /zla phyed rnam pa dang mtshungs pa/ /dkyil 'khor rnam pa bzhi slar yang / /slob dpon rdo rje yang dag 'byung / /shes rab chen pos rab brtag bya/ /dbus kyi dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /padma chen po 'dab brgyad pa/ /padma rā ga'i 'od mtshungs la/ /sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan gzhag par bya/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni dbus nyid du/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bsdus pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni ngos kun tu/ /shes rab can gyis gzhag bya ba/ /dam tshig mchog bzhi rnam bzhi ni//go rims bzhin du yang dag bri/ /rdo rje chen po seng ge'i khrir/ /'khor lo can gyi khyab bdag gzhag /gdugs dkar rgyal ba'i gtsug tor dang / /gzi brjid phung po skal ba che/ /rnam par 'phro byed rnam rgyal nyid/ /de bzhin gtsug tor lnga po ni/ /sangs rgyas skyob pa thams cad la/ /yongs su bskor nas snam bu la/ /dkyil 'khor kun tu bri bar bya 5)/ /rdo rje shugs kyis song na cikyini / /dkyil 'khor dag ni bzhi po ru/ /mi bskyod la sogs rnam pa bzhi/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor dbang phyug bri/ /mi bskyod pa yi dkyil 'khor ni/ /zla 'od lta 86—22

bu'i mdog tu bya①/ /②rdo rje sems dpa' dusogs rgyal poli/ /kun mchog sa yi ⑤dbang phyug rnams/ /rdo rje slob dpon stobs po che/ /shes rab chen pos dgod par bya/ /⑥rin chen 'byung gnas dkyil 'khor dug/ / rdo rje rin chen sogs kyis dgang / /nirdo rje chos sogs gsang ba yi/ /dkyil 'khor tshe dpag med pa'o⑨/ /rdo rje las la sogs ldan pa/ /don yod grub pa'i dkyil 'khor rol/ / gnyis pa 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor du/ /7rdo rje shugs kyis song nas ni//7rnam gzigs la sogs sangs rgyas rnams/ /dkyil 'khor kun tu 8der ni briX la/ /rdo rje snying po rgyal po che/ /khyab bdag gsang ba'i chos chadabang phyugatso /'dod pa'i don kun grub pa'i phyir/ /'bad pa yis ni bri bar ⑩bya/ /blo gros rgya mtsho mi zad blo/ /byams pa bdag nyid chen po dang / /nam mkha'i snying po grags chen po/ /kun tu bzang po nyid dag dang / /phyag na rdo rje bdag nyid che / /kun nas 'bar bas 'khrug pho pa'i 'od/ /'jam dpal hunyedabyangs ni rigs kyi mchog /sangs rgyas sras bzang dri ma med/ /sgrib pa thams cad nges par sel/ /de nas /khes yi snying po mchog /nam mkha'i mdzod ni mdzod dam pa / /lag na rin chen bla na med/ / ngan song kun ni ri sta'ajoms pa ni/ /dra ba can gyi 'od ces bya/ /dpa' bo 'di dag gsang ba che/ /dkyil 'khor 'di dag bri bar bya/ /'khor lo de ni dor nas ni/ /blo gros ( rjeldan pas phyir song ste / /shar du sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /phyag rgya go rims sa bzhin du dgod/ /'khor lo mdzes pa'i dge legs can ge/ /rdo rje dpal be'u pad ces bya/ /gtsug tor rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /rdo rje pad mas rnam par brgyan mu/ /lhung bzed dang ni 'khar gsil gedang / /chos gos kyang ni khyad par du/ /20shākya 86—23

seng ge ji srid par①/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rab tu gsungs/ /gang zhig dngos grub mchog 'dod pa(kye/ /de rnams blo ldan brtan pas ③bri/ /byang du 'jig rten dbang phyug gi/ /phyag rgya'i tshogs mchog de bzhin te/ /padma ud pal nyid ④dang ni/ /spyi blugs pags ⑤pa'i g.yang ⑥gzhi dang / /dbyug gu'i shing ni mkhas pa yis/ /ma myos pa ru bri stibar bya/ /slar yang lho ru song nas ni / /phyag na rdo rje bdag nyid che/ /slob dpon bdag nyid chen po yisal/ /phyag rgya 'bad pas bri bar ⑨bya/ /rdo rje pas ⑩sha dang ni⑩/ /dril bu rab tu mdzes pa dang / /dbyug gu dang ni tho ba dang ti/ /dbyug pa rdo rjes mtshon 0pa dang ske/ /lcags sgrog dang ni rtse cigasum yang / /'di dag dpa' 8bo'i phyag rgya'o⑩/ /dkyil 'khor nub tu song nas ni/ /'jam pa'i ⑩/dbyangs ni blo dang ldanam / /gsang ba'i chos ni dam pa'i mchog /brtson 'grus chen po'i phyag rgya bri / /ud pal 'khor lo rdo rje dang / /ral gri yang ni khyad par du/ /thod pa dang ni 1)dgra sta nyid(3/ /rma bya dang ni seng ge nyid/ /phyag rgya 'di ni 0brtson 'grus che/ /mkhas pa yis snye ni dgod par bya/ /'khor lo'i grwa ni legs gnas par/ /rdo rje sgeg mo la sogs bri/ /phyi yi 'khor lo'i grwa ru ni/ /rdo rje bdug pa zhes bya sogs/ /bdag nyid chen hūṃ snyepo 'bad pa yis/ /mchod pa 'di dag bri bar bya/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor grwa rnams su/ /gzugs kyi rdo rje la 'ogesogs min snye / /gzugs sgra de bzhin dri dang ni/ /khyad par du ni ro nyid dang 9 lha/ /reg dang chos kyi dbyings dang ni/ /mkhas pa yis ni dgod par bya/ /sgo yi nang ni thams cad du/ /sgo skyong ba 8 7ni dgod par bya/ /de bzhin dkyil 'khor gnyis tsho snyepa ru/ /rdo rje shugs kyis rka )song nas ni/ /go rims 8gyebazhin du 86—24

sangs rgyas kyi/ /yum rnams 'bad pas bri bar bya/ /nam mkha'i spyan zhes bya ba ni/ /sangs rgyas spyan zhes bya ba dang / /shes rab pha rol phyin ma yang ①/ /phyag rgya kun dang yang dag ldan/ /ji srid de bzhin gshegs rig ma/ /thams cad shar du dgod par bya/ /de nas blo gros ldan pa yis②/ /byang gi phyogs su song nas ni/ /gos dkar ma dang dusgrol ma che/ /khro gnyer can dang grags 'dzin ma/ /khyad par du ni dpal bdun ④dang / /mda' bdun dang ni dbyangs can ma/ /de la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams/ /bran dang bran mor yang dag ldan/ /de bzhin pho nya pho nya mo/ /gsang ba'i phyag rgya lhan cig bri/ /rdo rje shugs kyis song nas ⑤ni/ /lho yi phyogs su rab phyin la/ /mā ma tī dang lcags sgrog dang / /khab rtse rdo rje'i ⑥mtshan ma ⑦mchogadu /de ltar bris nas blo ldan gyis/ /nub kyi phyogs su song nas ni/ /der ni phyin nas shes ldan gyis/ / skra can ⑨stobs chen bri bar bya/ /de bzhin 'dam bu mda' rgyu 'o)dang / /lha mo zla mdzes hunye'od zer 'dra/ / dkyil 'khor kun gyi mtshams rnams su/ /8 de bzhin (stenye ba'i skra can ma/ /'bad pa yis ni bri bar bya/ /rab bkra nor gyi blo gros dang / /'gugs 'byed pho nya lnga dang ldan/ /grwa 8yi cha ru bri bya ba/ /rdo rje mdung rtse zhes bya sogs/ /sgo yi nang ni tsothams cad duli/ /sgo skyong ba ni rnam par bri/ /gzhan gyis tshimi thub lha mo che/ /de bzhin ral pa gcig ma mchog /rdo rje dregs mo (/—6lha mo che/ /rdo rje kum bhi yang dag bri/ /de nas blo ldan dkyil 'khor ni/ /thams cad las 'i zhini 'thon 5 chenas su/ /shar gyi cha ni thams cad du/ /sngags pa mnyam par gzhag sa pa yis/ /khro chen gzhan gyis shurnyemi thub ri stepa/ /de bzhin mi g.yo zhes bya dang / /khams gsum rnam rgyal snying po 86—25

ni / /mnga' bdag brgya phrag lnga yis bskor/ / shar du ①byis nas sngags pa yis / /de nas byang gi char song ste/ /rta mgrin khro bo chen po dang / /skar ma'i spyan ni khyad par du'o/ /khro gnyer rim pa rnam bsgyings pa/ /khro bo blo ldan brtson 'grus che/ /pho nya bran rnams thams cad dang / /ma mo stong gis yongs bskor ge bar/ /'jig rten mgon gyis bka' stsal to/ /de nas blo gros ldan pa yis / /lho yi phyogs su song nas su / /der ni phyin te brtson chen po/ /khro bo chen po stobs po che/ /rdo rje mtshan pas legs mtshan pa/ /shes rab chen pos dgod par bya/ /khro bo zla ba'i thig le dang / /de bzhin khro chen rdo rje 'chang / / khro bo gzegs ma stobs snyipo che/ /khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang ⑤/ /rdo rje sa 'og sa 'og dang / /de bzhin 'jigs pa'i mig can dang / /rkang pas bsnun pa'i (67rdo rje mchog /gsang dang rab gsang rjes 'gro dang / /bran dang pho nya rjes 'gro ba/ /rjes 'gro can blo tsho khro bo ni/ /stong phrag gsum dang phyed kyis bskor / /de ltar bris nas blo ldan gyis/ /nub kyi phyogs su phyin nas ni/ /der ni song ste brtson chen po/ /gshin rje mthar byed ces bya ba/ /gdong drug pa la lag drug pa/ /khro bo yi ge bdun zhes bya(8/ /khro bo'i gtso bo stong phrag ni/ /bdun dag gis ni yongs bskor ba'o/ /dkyil 'khor cha ni thams cad du/ /khro bo gtum po thams cad bri/ /de nas blo ldan 'ongs nas su/ /rang rgyal rgyal ba thams cad ni9/ /dkyil 'khor kun tu bri bar 7bya/ /de nas sngags pa 'ongs nas ni/ /rgyal ba nyan thos bri bar bya/ / de nas thams cad bris nas sum/ /11de rnams 1 tshangs sogs lha de dganyan /dkyil 'khor kun tu rnam par bri / /dbang phyug che dang khyab 'jug sadang / /zla ba nyi ma zhes bya dang / /86—26

gza' brgyad dang ni 'jig rten skyong / /rgyal chen rigs ni bzhi po dang / /de bzhin sum cu ①ma gsum nyid②/ /'thab ①bral rnams dang dga' ldan rnams④//'phrul dga' gzhan 'phrul dbang byed rnams⑤/ /dutshangs chen rnams dang /'od chung rnams dang / tshad med 'od rnams dang / 'od gsal rnams dang /dge chung rnams dang / tshad med dge rnams dang / dge rgyas rnams dang /sprin med rnams dang / bsod nams skyes ⑦rnams dang / 'bras bu che ba rnams dang / mi che ba rnams dang / mi gdung ba rnams dang / gya rnam snang ba rnams dang / shin tu mthong ba rnams dang / 'og min rnams dang / dag pa'i gnas pa ④rnams dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi mtshams su dgod par bya'o/ /de nas dbang ldan du dbang ldan dang / dbang por dbang po dang / mer me spulha dang / gshin 7rjer gshin rje dang / bden bral du bden bral dang /chur chu lha dang / rlung du rlung lha dang / lus ngan du lus ngan rnams dang / phyi rol du khor yug chen po'i ri'i rgyal po bri bar bya'o/ /rab dga'i nang du rgya mtsho chen po bdun dgod par bya'o/ /hu)phyi rol gyi 'ishar phyogs su hu)khro bo gzhan gyis mi thub pa zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya chen po dgod par bya'o'i/ /lhor rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi spyan gyi chogephyag rgya chen po dgod par bya'o/ /nub tu khro bo'i rgyal po chen po gshin rje gshed kyi phyag rgya tsochen po dgod par bya'o/ /byang du rta mgrin gyi phyag rgya chen po rnam par dgod par bya'o/ /hu tshode lta bu'i gru bzhi pa/sgo bzhi pa'i nyushedakyil 'khor chen po dar dang me tog gi chun po dang / sgo khyud dang //smu gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan bsgreng ku stab/ dra ba dang dra ba phyed pas bklubs —)pa/ de lta bu'i dkyil 'khor chen po bris la bsgom 86—27

par bya'o/ / de'i phyi rol du 'gro ba lnga po gzhag par bya'o/ /①de bzhin du dbus su ri'i rgyal po lhun po'i tshad ②dpag tshad brgya stong phrag du ma rnam par bsams nas②/ de'i steng du rdo rje seng ge'i khri la bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gzhag par bya'o/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor rim gyis bkod ④nas nye bar spyod pa thams cad kyi 2tshogs mchod nas ⑥ nye bar zhugs te/dgug pa dang gzhug pa dang dam tshig gis bcings nas ⑦mnyes par byas te/mchod pa dang 2dbang bskur ba dang byin gyis brlab ⑨ pa dang spro ba (nyedang /bsdu ba la sogs pa byas nas ⑩de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya chen po bsgom par bya'o⑩/ /de bzhin du bsgom pa las blang ste 8de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rdo rje sems dpa'i bdag nyid ni ④rnam 8par snang mdzad nga'o zhes 8bsgom par bya'o/ /de lta bu las langs 0nas de'i snyems pa 'chang zhing ⑫ snying rje dang byams pa'i 'dren byed dang ⑩mig gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' las 'das pa rab 'byam nga )rgya mtsho'i sprin thams cad du (nyede bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku'i sprin gyis kun nas bkang ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rab tu 'bab pas gro rdo rje sems dpa' hūṃ mdzad kyi bla phyag rgya rang gi lus la zhugs nas/ phyogs thams cad rghaṃ gi yi ge'i sgras rab tu bsgrag par bya'o( ste/ /bsnun pa bzhis rol pa dang bcas pas phyag rgya ( nyal bzlas pa bya ste( ste/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya 8 tshobacings la/ cho ga bzhin du rdo rje slob dpon gyis bkug nas bcug ste bcings la dam tshig la gzhag par rdo stebyas nas rdo rje 7se gol gyi sbyor ba dang kun nas 'bebs pa'i phyag rgyas bdag nyid la dbab ste/ snying po 'di bzhis gi tshode bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang bdag mtshungs so snyam du bsam 86—28

par bya'o/ /de la 'di ni thams cad 'bebs pa'i ①snying po bzhi por 'gyur ro②/ /a ā i aḥbadag byin gyis brlab pa la sogs pa byas nas slob dpon gyis ①de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang bdag mtshungs pa yin no zhes nga rgyal bskyed par byas nasadu/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje lcags kyu'i se gol gtogs nas ⑤sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drang bar bya'o/ /de la snying po ni 'di yin te/ yibadzra sa mā dzaḥl/ ā gatstsha ā gatstshasal/ sarba ta thā ga tadhi/sab bo dhi satwa pa ri bṛ tāḥ prarkye kārta ha te swā hā zhes so0/ /oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ7ske/ ā gatstsha/ ā gatstsha/ sarba ta thā ga tā 8badzra yo gī shwa ra8/ sa tpa na yiḥl/ swa hā a hāḥ8/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang bcas pa dkyil 'khor thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs dang rgyud dang gzugs 7rnams dang lhan cig dkyil 'khor du 'dus nas byon par 'gyur ro/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 0phyag rgya chen po bdag nyid rnam par bsgoms nas ming brgya rtsa brgyad pa bton la cho ga ji lta ba bzhin du mchod pa byas nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad brtan par byas nas sgo bzhi po rnams su rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pas las byas te/ las chen po dam pa'i phyag rgyas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gzhug the tshopar bya'ogyu/ /oṃ sab ta thā ga ta/ su ra ta badzra badzra satwa yidzaḥs baṃ hoḥ.a dhi tiṣṭhacas )/ sabra ta thā ga ta 6nyem hā maṇḍa lo zhes so(nye//de nas gsang ba'i mchod pa la sogs pa rnams kyis mchod pa byas rdzu nyenas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la bdag gsol ba 'debs lags kyis sangs 86—29

rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' ①thams cad kyis bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol / sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad du gsol/ bdag la dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ ji ltar bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchod pa rab 'byam ②rgya mtsho'i sprin rnams kyi ②chos kyi dbyings kyi mthas klas pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yul kun nas bkang ste byin gyis ④brlab par bgyi'ol/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rgyabaka' yongs su rdzogs par bgyi'o / /de nas 'dir rdo rje snying po'i rgyan chos kyi dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma gzhug ⑥pa'i cho ga rgyas par 'gyur ba ni de nas gos dmar po phrag par gzar te de bzhin de bzhin 4)gshegs pa thams cad la ⑤phyag 'tshal ba'i thal mo sbyar nas/ sngags 'dis snyan gsan dbab par bya ste/ sa ma ya hoḥhuste/ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ sa ma ya badzra a dhiṣṭha ⑩rna ku ru rmā // sab ta thā ga ta sa ma le'i me a ⑫dhi tiṣṭhantu sarba budha māṃ lho pra be sha yantu/ pra ti pā la yas/ pu dzā ñtsa me pra yatstshantu/pra bisgosmibi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra maṇḍa'i/ a lo kā re ma hā badzra maṇḍa ⑩le pra ti ba la yan tu māṃ stu dzañtsa 7me pra yatstshas1snye/ de nas slob dpon gyis de'i thal mor me tog dkar po'i phreng ba sngags 'dis btags nas nang du me tog bzhi dang sor mo'i rtse mor me tog re re bcug la de nas sngags 'di brjod cing gzhug nyu0par bya'o/ /rghaṃ tt+waṃ trī sum̐ 9 34 rdzu baḥkaḥ pre kho shrīrgya ṭwāṃ /ri rinya/ a dhi tiṣṭha mā( nya/sarba ta thā ga ta sa ma ya satwa tsho dpra bi shā mi/ de nas slob dpon gyis de'i gdong g.yogs bcings la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mya ngan las 'das pa'i grong khyer chos kyi dbyings nam mkha'i khams rab tu khyab pa'i sbyor bas de bcug la sngags 'dis me tog gtor bar bya'o/ /sngags ni sa ma yo haṃ sa ma ya st+waṃ sa ma 86—30

ya rgyu/ gang la me tog rnams lhung ba de nyid de'i lhar byin ①par bya'o/ /de nas cho ga bzhin du sngags 'dis dbab par bya'o/ /②na maḥsarba ta thā ga te ②bhyaḥX / ta ṭa ta ṭa/ dha ma dha ma/ badzra hūṃ bi kṛ duta bibyu sgyu hā durtan ta rjod ma ka /ha si ta lo bo da ra/ ka ha ka ha/ tsu lu tsu lu/ muñtsa muñtsa/ astob hā rgyas/ da ra bi da ra/ badzra brjosgo tag/ badzra ne latra/ badzra sho tra/ badzra kyā 7ṇa/ badzra de'i kyi: spyirā ya si pra bi ⑩sha /badzra pā ṇi hre phyed ya mā bi sha / mā bi shaklu / byusgyu byusgyu/ puṇḍi guṇḍi/ kuṇḍa pa ya/ byusgyu ⑩pa ya/ bhā ma ya bhā byam ya/ pā ta 8ya mo ṭa ⑩ya/ a be sha ya/ dzalpa dzalpa/ dzalha pa ya dzasgyu pa zhu ya/ la lhu la ghu/ sarba ta thā ga tā tsā 0ka ra pra ba ra/ dharma la bhartsa/bi dza ya/ ho ho badzra lha du kā ra tso kṛ steta zhwa hā/ dbab pa'i dam tshig go/ /de ltar phab yinas kye khyod kyis gang dge ba 'am mi dge ba mthong ngam zhes dri'o/ /da chanas de de slobazhin gshegs pa'am/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'am dge ba'am mi dge ba bdag gis 0'di lta bu mthong ngo zhes rdu )smra bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas slob dpon gyis de ri nyethams cad de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ri ri rdo rje'i rang bzhin du yongs su gzhag sosnyel mig bcings pa bkrol la dbang bskur ba'i don du dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa byas tsol de'i dbus su kha dog thams cad kyis padma chen po 'dab nusnyem brgyad pa yid du 'ong ba 'am/ seng ge'i khri rang nyid kyis bris te de nas de la dar gyi bgo ba dang / me tog solhabadug pa la sogs pa rnams kyis ru sgyumachod la khyad par du gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro dang reg bya du dang gdugs dang ske/ rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan la sogs pa nye bar mkho ba du/dang / dung dang / rdza rnga dang / rnga bo che dang / dung la sogs pa dang gar dang / glu 86—31

rnams kyis legs par mchod nas cod ①pan lnga'i dbang bskur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje slob dpon gyi ②go 'phang la sngags 'dis rab tu gzhag par bya'o③/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzo snri ṣa a gi ṣiñtsa oṃ badzra satwa a gyi ṣiñtsa oṃ badzra ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa/ oṃ badzra padma a bhi ṣiñtsa/du ma badzra badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa spyi bo dang / dpral ba dang / mgrin pa dang / snying ga ⑤dang / lte ba dang /rked pa nas rje ngar gyi ⑥bar du yi ge'i phyag rgya stibakod la rang gi lha'i gzugs kyi ni sbyor bas blta bar bya'o/ /de de ltar dbang bskur nas rigs dang mthun pa'i ming byas ⑨nas rdo rje'i cho ga 1 )rnams bslab par bya'o⑩/ /de la rdo rje'i gnas tshig ⑩rnams ni 'di dag ste/ rang bzhin gyis dbyer med pa'i phyir rang gi lus rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas te/ rdo rje'i gnas 'dis lta ba'i thibs po thams cad nges par 'joms par 'gyur ro/ / rig pa la 'jug pa'i phyir ma rig pa rdo rje'i gnas te④/ rdo rje'i gnas 'dis dmigs pa'i dngos po yongs su shes pa la 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /hūṃ/ mngon par 'du byed pa'i phyir mtshams med pa'i mtha' rdo rje'i gnas tebi/ rdo rje'i gnas 'dis blta bar gyur pa 7thams cad 8nges par rig 7par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ/ 8'dod chags dang bral ba'i mtha' mnyam pa nyid kyi phyir/ 'dod chags kyi mtha' rdo rje'i gnas te/ rdo rje'i gnas 'di 'dod chags dang bral ba'i ched du 'jug go/ /ha/ byams pa'i mtha' mnyam pa nyid kyi phyir zhe snang gi mtha' rdo rje'i gnas te/ rdo rje'i gnas 'di nyes pa thams cad gcod pa'i ched du 'jug go/ /meḥ/ shes rab sgron ma mnyam pa nyid kyi phyir gti mug gi mtha'i rdo rje'i gnas te/ rdo rje'i gnas nya6'dis mun pa bsal bar byed par 'gyur no/ /raṃ/ sems can 86—32

thams cad sems can gcig pa ste/ rdo rje'i gnas 'dis sems can mnyam pa nyid la 'jug pa'i don dang sems can gyi rang bzhin rtogs pa'i don du 'gyur ro/ /'i①/ sems can ②thams cad sems chagacig pa ste/ rdo rje'i gnas 'dis sems dunges pa la 'jug pa'i don dang sems rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba mngon par rtogs pa'i don du 'gyur ro/ /a/ sangs rgyas thams cad sangs rgyas gcig pa ste/ rdo rje'i gnas 'dis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rjes su 'jug pa'i don dang mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes rjes su rtogs pa'i don du 'gyur ro/ /ma⑤/ chos thams cad sangs rgyas kyi chos teyi/ rdo rje'i gnas 'dis thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes rjes su rtogs ⑦par 'jug pa'i don dang /rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin rjes su rtogs ⑧pa'i don du 'gyur ro/ /ṇḍaskyu/bdud kyi las thams cad sangs rgyas kyi las 0te/ rdo rje'i gnas 'di 0las thams cad rjes su rtogs pa la 'jug pa'i don dang / las thams cad las yongs su 'das pa'i don du 'gyur ro/ /rgyu/ ngag thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung ste'i/ rdo rje'i gnas 'di 0sgra ji bzhin pa thams cad rjes su rtogs pa la 'jug pa'i don dang / brjod pa las 'das ④pa'i chos rjes su rtogs pa'i don du 'gyur ro/ //hunye/ chos thams cad ma skyes pa ste/ rdo rje'i gnas 'di ⑩'chi 'pho med pa la 'jug pa'i don dang / skye ba dang / rga ba dang ⑩'chi ba'i las 'da' ba'i tunyedon du 'gyur ro/ /mi/ chos thams cad ma byung ba ste/ rdo rje'i gnas 'di hu)'gog pa med pa la 'jug ku )pa'i don dang /chos thams cad 'gog pa med pa'i don du 'gyur ro/ /khaṃ/ 'di la rnam gnas rnal 'byor pa/ /bdag gis 5nyede nyid rab rtogs te/ /bdag gis du rnyede 86—33

nyid rab brtags ①nas/ /sangs rgyas kun mtshungs mnyam med 'gyur/ /de la sogs pa'i dngos grub thams cad dang / phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang ske/ gter thams cad dang / 'khor lo thams cad dang / rdo rje ②thams cad dang / ral gri dang / yid bzhin gyi ninor bu dang / dngul chu dang /bcud len rnams dang / gyen du 'gro ba dang / rkang 'og dang mi snang ba dang /rig pa 'dzin pa dang / 'khor los sgyur ④ba nyid dang / brgya 0byin ⑥dang / tshangs pa dang /ga khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po nyid nidang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa rnams des myur du 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /rtsu/ yid ni rtse gcig gyur pa yis(she)/ /sangs rgyas rjes dran bsgoms nas ni/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /sangs rgyas sku gzugs bsgom 0par bya/ /sbyor ba de yi bka' drin gyis/ /sangs rgyas kun mtshungs mnyam med 'gyur/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor rab gsal ba'i//kun tu bzang po phyag rgya che/ /legs par mnyam par gzhag 'o)pas bsgom/ /lo 7ni phyed kyi sbyor ba yis/ /kun tu bzang po 'dra bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje rin chen phyag rgya che/ /legs par mnyam par gzhag pas bsgomayi / /rgyal po'i dbang bskur nyid dam ni/ /yang na dbang phyug thob par 'gyur/ /rdo rje chos cikyi phyag rgya che/ /de ni rang gis brtan por bsgoms/ /'jig rten kun gyi ⑫dbang phyug kyang / /thob na dngos grub gzhan ci smos/ /rdo rje las kyi phyag rgya gang ske/ /de bzhin nyid kyi 'od gsal ba/ /rdo rje'i sbyor bas de bsgoms pas/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor brtan por 'gyur/ /de lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems kyi mchog bsgom tshapa phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes nyid yin rna3 rme/ /'khor los sgyur mi ba'i phyag 86—34

rgya che/ /legs par mnyam par gzhag ①pas bsgomal/ /phyag rgya kun gyi bdag nyid kyil/ /dam pa'i don nyid thob par 'gyur/ /gzi brjid phung po'i 0phyag rgya che/ /dam pa'i don du bsgom ⑤par bya/ /gsang ba'i rgyal srid 0thob 'gyur na / /dngos grub gzhan lta ci zhig smos/ /gdugs dkar gtsug tor chen po ni / /dam pa'i don du bsgom par bya/ /gtsug tor ye shes thob 'gyur na/ /dngos grub gzhan lta ci zhig smos/ /rgyal ba'i gtsug tor phyag rgya che/ /de ni yang dang yang du bsgomacha/ /chos kyi rgyal srid nirnam rgyal nyid/ /mdor bsdus pas ④ni thob par 'gyur⑩/ /rnam rgyal gtsug tor phyag rgya yi/ /dam pa'i yi ge bsgom par bya/ /legs par rab gnas 'od zer can/ /dngos grub ye shes thob par 'gyur/ /de la sogs pa mtha' yas mchog /chos dbyings mnyam dang mi mnyam pa/ /gtsug tor rnams kyis ⑩legs bshad pa/ /phyag rgya de rnams bdag nyid mchog /de ltar rnal 'byor pas bsgoms na/ /lhag pa'i lha ni gcig pu nyid/ /thog ma tha ma med zhi ba/ /rang 'byung 8mchog tu mi 'gyur ba / /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam sbyor ba/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug go 'phang mchog /sangs rgyas ye shes dri ma med/ /bdag nyid chen po thob par 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor gyi dam tshig ye shes kyi phyag rgya rnams so/ /da kṣ-i/nyeni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi yi ge'i rang bzhin gyi ye shes de la bslab par bya'o zhes bya ba ni rnam par dpyod skopa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo ste rnam par 'byed pa'i don du 7shes par bya'o/ / oṃ bam̐/ci.a zhes bya ba ni chos thams cad ma skyes pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgor bshad do3 / /oṃ a ā i kyi aḥ/ ba zhes bya ba ni chos thams cad kyi sgo ste don dam 86—35

par chos thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par blta bar bya'o/ /oṃ paṃ/ na zhes bya ba ni chos thams cad kyi ming dang gzugs dang shes rab dang chos dang bcas pa la dbang bsgyur ①ba'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgor bshad do/ /oṃ rna/ da zhes bya ba ni 'dul ba dang zhi ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgor brjod do/ /oṃ rda/sa zhes bya ba ni thogs pa med pa las yang dag par 'das shing / yongs su nyon mongs pa dang rnam par spong ba dang zag pa dang bcas pa dang zag pa med pa'i sgo nas phung po dang / khams dang skye mched la sogs pa don dam pa'i bden pa la nye bar len pa②/ mi dmigs pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgor rnam par gzhag go/ /oṃ sum̐/ ta zhes bya ba ni de bzhin nyid kyi rjes su 'gro ba'i chos kyi dbyings la 'jug pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgor rnam par blta'o①/ /oṃ rta/ka zhes bya ba ni las kyi rnam par smin pa dang bral ba'i ④phyir chos thams cad kyi sgor gsal bar bya'o/ /oṃ kai/ ma zhes bya ba ni sgyu ma lta bu nyid dang dran pa med cing snying rje che ba dang shes rab rno ba las byung ba'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgor gsal bar bshad do/ /oṃ mi/ ga zhes bya ba ni zab mo gting dpag dka' ba'i ⑤phyir chos thams cad kyi sgor blta bar bya'o/ /oṃ gi/ dza zhes bya ba ni skye ba dang rga ba dang gyo'achi ba las yongs su rgal ⑦ba'i rang bzhin mi phyed pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgor blta bar bya'o/ /oṃ rdza/ dha zhes bya ba ni chos kyi dbyings yongs su mi phyed pa'i rdo rje yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir ⑤chos thams cad kyi sgor blta bar bya'o/ /oṃ dhe(9rwa/ sha zhes bya ba ni zhi gnas dang lhag mthong yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgor blta bar bya'o/ /oṃ sho/86—36

kha ①zhes bya ba ni gang zag dang chos kyi bdag med pa nam mkha' ltar gsal zhing chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ②'od gsal ba'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgor rnam par gzhag go/ /oṃ khaṃ/ kṣa zhes bya ba ni g.yo ba skye ba ①med pas mi zad 0pa'i ye shes so sor ⑤dmigs te/ chos thams cad yongs su dag pa'i phyir dhichos thams cad kyi sgor blta bar bya'o/ /oṃ gho/ nga zhes bya ba ni ②thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes thogs pa med ⑧pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgor blta bar bya'o / /oṃ nge ⑨/ tha zhes bya ba ni gnas dang gnas ma yin pa la mkhas pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su sbyong ba'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgor blta bar bya'o//oṃ the/ rto zhes bya ba ni mthar phyin pa dang mur thug pa med pa dang ⑩/ sgrib pa thams cad rab tu spangs pas zad pa dang mi skye ba'i ⑩le shes thob pa'i mchog tu byed pa'i 8phyir chos thams cad kyi sgor bshad do/ /oṃ ḍho/ dzha /3zhes bya ba ni dri ma'i rnam par 8dmigs pa med pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgor blta bar bya'o/ /oṃ rghaṃ/ tsolus rnam par 'byed pa ni tso'adod chags dang bral ba'i mtha' ⑩nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te rdo rje snying po'i lus so sor thob pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi hu)sgor blta bar bya'o/ /oṃ 48/ sems rnam par 'byed pa ni du )nyes pa dang rmongs pa dang bag la nyal ba rab tu spangs nas byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa rang bzhin gyis ji nye'od gsal ba'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgor blta bar bya'o/ /oṃ i/ ( snyengag rnam par 'byed pa ni shu sgongag gi spros pa chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgor blta bar bya'o/ /oṃ 'cha/ tsha zhes bya ba ni grib ma ma dunadamigs shing rang bzhin gyis dang ba'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgor blta bar bya'o/ /oṃ chi/ gha zhes bya ba ni gcig tu 86—37

'dres ①pa ma dmigs pa'i don dam par gnyis su med ②pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgor blta bar bya'o/ /oṃ lha①/ ṭa zhes bya ba ni ca co dang bral ba dang durdo rje snyems pa ⑤'dzin pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgor bshad do/ /oṃ (du/pha zhes bya ba ni chos thams cad dbu ba rdos (pepa lta bu'i tshul gyis gsang ba'i ye shes gsal ba'i 0phyir chos ④kyi sgor bshad do/ /oṃ pho/ ḍa zhes bya ba ni 'tshe ba las ⑨ grol ba'i nam phonyemakha' la 8'gro ba grub pas so sor thob pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgor blta bar bya'o/ /oṃ ḍi/ ṣa zhes bya ba ni tsha sgo ma 8dmigs pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgor blta bar bya'o/ /oṃ ṣiñtsa/ chos thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i phyir nye bar zhi ba ni 8chos thams cad kyi sgor rnam par gzhag go/ /oṃ zhi / tshul bzhin ni 7nges par 'byung ba'i don du 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad la 'jug lho tshopa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgor blta bar bya'o/ /oṃ yam̐/8de kho na nyid ni 7spros pa thams cad rnam par spang ba'i so )phyir chos thams cad kyi sgor rnam par gzhag 21go/ /oṃ rta/ 32ma skyes pa'i chos rnam par grol ba'i mtshan nyid kyi don buyin pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgor bshad do/ /oṃ hūṃ/ tsho steyongs su gzung dgeb med pa ni 32'thab pa dang ( nyertsod pa spangs pa'i chos nyid yin pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgor blta bar bya'o/ /oṃ 〉( 3/ kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa ni mtshan nyid rnam par dag pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgor blta bar bya'o/ /oṃ ka kha ga gha nga / rang bzhin gyis ༷ she'od gsal ba'i mtshan nyid gzung gi ciba'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgor gnas so/ /oṃ tsa 3 dza dzha nunyenya/ snang ba ni gsal zhing 'bar ba'i phyir chos thams cad 8nyekyi sgo'o/ /oṃ ṭa ṭha ḍa nye ṇa/ bsgom snyepa ni chos thams cad kun tu sbyor ba dang bral ba yang dag 86—38

par sdud ①pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /oṃ ta tha da dha na/ gzhi med pa ni chos thams cad ma 'dres pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi lasgor rnam par gzhag gol/ /oṃ pa pha ba bha ma/ byang chub ni chos thams cad dri ma med pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgor blta bar bya'o/ /oṃ ya ra la wa/ mya ngan las 'das pa ①ni blo ④bur ba thams cad nges par dor ba'i mtshan nyid dang chos kyi dbyings so sor thob cing mngon par shes pa lnga dang ye shes mkhyen pas sangs rgyas kyi sa yongs su thob pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgor blta bar bya'o/ /oṃ sha ṣa sa ha/rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes rnam par dag pa rnam par 'byed par byed pa'o zhes so(snye/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi sgo rnam par nges pa'o/ /de nas rigs thams cad kyi gsang ba'i cho ga rgyas par gyur pa ni/ sngon bzhin nges par byas nas ni/ /phyogs kun mnyam pa nyid bsgoms (nyanas/ /ri rab chen po gru bzhi pa/ /rin chen kun gyis rnam par brgyan(7/ /de yi steng du rdo rje che/ /de yi steng du padma gzhag(kye /'dab 99dam brgyad pa ches bebakra ba/ /rnal 'byor gnas yinyezhes rnam par bshad/ / dbang po gnyis ni snyoms 'jug pa/ /yongs su rdzogs par bdag nyid kyis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad nyid bsgoms na/ /de nas bskal pa'i mthar thug gnasal/ /tsosangs rgyas kun gyi 57phyag rgya che/ /'od zer gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor can/ /brnal 'byor thams cad bsgom par bya/ /mnyam med sangs rgyas kun dang mtshungs/ /nyugebha ga chen po rnal 'byor che/ /rnal 'byor pa gnas mi zad rtsapa/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag bsgoms nyu tshonas ni/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mtshungs par 'gyur/ /khams gsum pa yi rgyal srid che/ /sems can kun 86—39

la thams cad du/ /gang tshe rnal 'byor pas bsgoms na①/ /de tshe dngos grub lag na gnas/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal chos/ /gdod nas dag cing ma 'dres pa/ /gang tshe ye shes mthong ba ni/ /de yi tshe na dag par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas thams med mdor bsdus ②pa/ /sna tshogs las kyi sbyor ba yis /gang tshe rnal 'byor pas ②bsgoms na/ /sna tshogs las ni byed par 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes so// //'khor los sgyur ④ba rgyal po che/ /kun mchog sa yi dbang phyug ni/ /rdo rje sbyor bas bsgoms na ⑤ni/ /mnyam med 'khor los sgyur ⑥ba mtshungs/ /gzi brjid phung po ༅phyag rgya che/ /legs ⑧par mnyam par gzhag ⑨pa bsgomatso/ /'bar ba'i phreng 'onyabs 'khrugs shing mdzes/ /padma rā ga mtshungs pa'i 'od/ /rdo rje'i sbyor bas bsgoms nas ni/ /rang nyid ⑩gzi brjid phung por 8'gyur/ /gdugs dkar rgyal ba'i gtsug tor gyi0/ /phyag rgya chen po bsgoms na ni/ /'od zer gsal ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /sems can dag pa nyid du 'gyur/ /rnam par gsal ba'i gtsug tor rgya/ /ral gri 'bar ba'i 'od kyis 'khrugs/ /zag pa med pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /mnyam med gsal ba'i gtsug tor mtshungs/ /rgyal ba'i gtsug 7tor phyag rgya che/ /legs par mnyam par gzhag ⑩pas bsgomacha/ /rgyal ba'i gtsug tor sbyor ba yis/ /de yi rnam pa'i spyod yul 'gyur/ /rdo rje dam tshig ye shes che/ /legs par mnyam par gzhag lho)pas bsgom(/ste/ /kun tu bzang po sogs tsho nyagazugs kyis2spe/ /mnyam med rdo rje sems dpa' mtshungs nye/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas padzo te/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /byang chub sems dang 3stematshungs pa'i 'od/ /gtsug tor lnga ldan stobs po che/ /86—40

rdo rje'i sbyor bas①bsgoms ②pa yis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'dra bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje rgyal po'i phyag rgya che/ / don dam par ni bsgoms na ①ni/ /'gro ba thams cad 'gugs byed na/ /skye bo gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ /rdo rje chags pa'i phyag rgya che/ /legs par mnyam par gzhag pa ④bsgom⑤/ /skye dgu duthams cad chags 'gyur na/ /bud med gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ /rdo rje legs pa'i gaphyag rgya che/ /dam pa'i don du bsgom ⑧par bya/ /legs so ba ni rab ⑨gsol bas/ /bud med thams cad tshim par byed/ /byang chub kyi ⑩sems kyi phyag rgya'i ye shes so// //rdo rje rin chen phyag rgya che/ /'bar ba'i phreng bas 'khrugs 0pa'i 'od/ /dpral ba'i phyogs su gnas pa bsgom/ /de yis tsodar thod dbang bskur 8thob//rdo rje gzi brjid phyag rgya che/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mtshungs pa'i 'od/ /snying gar ④gnas pa bsgom par bya/ /kun mkhyen ye shes ster bar byed/ /rin chen tog 8gi phyag rgya che/ /legs par mnyam par gzhag ⑩pas bsgomatso/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin pa mchog /sgrub po dam pas rdzogs par byed/ /rdo rje bzhad pa (3phyag rgya che/ /legs par mnyam par gzhag ⑥pas bsgom(nye / /rdo rje bzhad du pa ltar gyur te/ /de ni skye dgu tsodaga' byed 'gyur/ /dbang bskur ba'i duphyag rgya'i ye shes so// //padma bde chen padma la ༄ste/ /dag pa'i chos ni mnyam gzhag so pas/ /dam pa'i don du bsgom par bya/ /mnyam med rdo rje chos dang mtshungasali/ /shes rab ye shes rdo rje rno/ /bsgoms pas de ni rdo rje 'chang / /shes rab pha rol 0phyin dag pa/ /stong nyid sbyor bas bsgoms na sa ni/ /dam pa'i don du bsgom bya 86—41

de① / /mnyam med 'jam dbyangs dang ni mtshungs②/ /rdo rje rgyu yi phyag rgya che/ /legs par mnyam par gzhag bsgoms dunas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo kun mchog rtse//mdor bsdus nas ni de yis dubaskor/ /rdo rje smra ba'i 0phyag rgya che/ /dam pa'i don du bsgoms nas ni/ /rdo rje bzlas pa'i nus pa yis/ /ldem po'i ngag ni de yis 'chad/ /chos kyi phyag rgya'i ye shes so// //rdo rje las kyi phyag rgya che/ /dam pa'i don du bsgoms na ni/ /kun nas kun nas rang nyid kyis/ /rdo rje las ni byed par 'gyur/ /rdo rje bsrung ⑥ba byams pa che/ /rdo rje chos zhes grags ⑦pa ste/ /chos kyi sbyor bas bsgoms na ni//rdo rje bsrung (nyeb dang mtshungs ⑨'gyur/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin brtson 'grus che/ /khro bo chen po stobs po che/ /dam pa'i don gyis ⑩bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin dang mtshungs 'gyur/ /rdo rje khu tshur phyag rgya che/ /lus ngag yid kyis ⑩de bzhin du/ /rdo rje'i sbyor bas bsgoms na ni/ /rdo rje khu tshur 'dzin par 'gyur//las kyi phyag rgya'i ye shes so// //sgeg /rtemos mngon par dga' ba hunyester/ /phreng ba 8yang ni dbang bskur ⑫ba / /glu mas mdzes pa'i sgra dbyangs byed/ /gar mas rdzu 'phrul thob par 'gyur / /dri mas bzang po'i dri yin te/ /me tog byang chub yan lag nyid/ /sgron mas mtha' dag gsal ba'o/ /bdug pas chabadug pa dag la brtson/ /lcags kyus dbang phyug 'gugs byed na/ /skye bo gzhan lta smos ci dgos9/ tsho/ /zhags pas dbang ponya 'ching 'gyur na/ /gdug pa'i sems can smos ci dgos/ /lcags sgrog gis ni 'phrog byed dang / /tshangs sogs dbang phyug chen po'ang 'ching ske/ /'bebs pas thams cad 'bebs 'gyur na/ /dman pa'i mi dag 86—42

smos ci dgos/ /'di nyid kyi ①ni sbyor ba yis②/ /chos kyi yi ge mchog gi nini / /phyag rgya'i ye shes rab sbyor bas/ /sbyar te 0myur du bsgrub par bya⑤/ /'di yi sbyor ba shes par bya0/ /phyag rgya'i 'khor lo khyad par dusti/ /spyi gtsug snying ga durkang pa'i bar/ /yi ge yis ni yongs gang bar/ /gzugs brnyan gcig gi stigo 'phang gyur/ /sems 0rtse gcig 'gyur bsam gtan gyis7/ /sa la rab gnas padma ni/ /dbang chen gyi ni gnas zhes bshad/ /dbang po gnyis ni mtshungs sbyor bas/ /dbang phyug kyang ni bsgrub par bya/ /dbang chen dag ni gru bzhi pa/ /dbang chen gyi ni las su 8bshad/ /chu ni zlum paratsoshes par bya/ /padma'i mtshan chams rnam par mtshan/ /zhi bar byed pa'i las dang ldan / /zhi ba'i don du de 8bshad do8/ /me ni gru gsum shes par bya/ /sum rngumado yi ni gnas su gnasarmeshe/ /dbang du bya ba bsgrub yidon du/ /padma rā ga 'dra ba'i 'od/ /mngon spyod la ni brtson 'grus che/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor brjod bya 2 )ste/ /ral gri yi ni phyag rgya'i dbyibs/ /dbyar gyi sprin dang mtshungs pa'i 'od/ /ser dang dkar dang de bzhin dmar/ /nag po yang ni khyad par du/ /dang po'i dkyil 'khor tshul gyis ni spe/ /tha ma'i bar du rab tu brtag /dang po rdo cirje rab tu gzhag( du /de yi rjes su rin chen te/ /padma dang ni las rnal sa 'byor/ /grub pa'i go 'phang rim par bshad/ /phyag rgya thams cad kyi ye shes so// // de nas bcom ldan 'das rtag thupas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya'i ye shes bka' stsal pa/ gnyis dang gnyis su medas pas yongs su dag pas chos thams cad rnam par grol ba'i phyag rgyas rgyas sacabatab pa'o/ /rtag pa ci 86—43

yongs su dag pas chos thams cad zhi ba dang mtha' dang ①mtha' med pa'i phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /zad pa'i sgo dang zad pa'i mtha' dang zad pa'i mur thug pa dang ldan pas chos thams cad zad pa dang / 'dod chags ②dang bral ba'i phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /mnyam ③pa nyid kyi mtha' rnam par dag pas chos thams cad la skur pa mi 'debs pa'i phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /mig lnga la 'ayang dag par 'das pas chos thams cad nam mkha'i phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o / /sems can thams cad nam mkha'i dbyings nyid kyi ⑤phyir chos thams cad nam mkha'i rang bzhin gyi ༅phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /chos kyi dbyings su yang dag par 'du ba nyid kyi phyiral/ chos thams cad dbyer mi phyed pa'i phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /⑧byang chub kyi sems dang tha mi dad pas chos thams cad byang chub kyi sems kyi phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /chos kyi dbyings mi phyed pa'i mtshan nyid yin pas chos thams cad 0chos kyi dbyings kyi ⑩phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /ngo bo nyid med pas chos rtso〉thams cad stong pa nyid kyi phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /'tshe 7ba med pas chos thams cad bdag med pa'i phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /skad cig ma nyid pas chos mthams cad mi rtag pa'i phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /skye ba dang rga ba dang 'chi ba'i mtha' dang ldan pas chos thams cad sdug bsngal gyi phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /sngon gyi mtha' dang phyi ma'i mtha' de bzhin nyid pas chos thams cad de bzhin nyid kyi phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /gdod ma minas yongs su dag pas chos thams cad yang dag pa'i mtha'i phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas mnyam pa nyid pas chos thams cad chen po postong pa nyid kyi phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /spros 86—44

pa'i dmigs pa rnam par bral ①bas chos thams cad mtshan ma med pa'i phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /re ba thams cad las rnam par grol bas chos thams cad smon pa med pa'i phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan nyid kyis na ⑤chos thams cad mi rtag pa'i phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /phung po lnga yongs su 'dus pa'i mtshan nyid kyis na chos thams cad sdug bsngal gyi phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /rang bzhin gyis ④bdag med pas chos thams cad bdag med pa'i phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /shin tu mi g.yo ba'i phyir chos thams cad zhi ba'i phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /don dam pa'i bden pa yang dag par 'du ba'i ⑤phyir chos thams cad bden pa'i phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /'tsho ba rnam par mi gnas pa'i phyir chos thams cad dri ma med pa'i phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ / mchog tu mthar phyin ⑥pa'i phyir chos thams cad 'khrug pa med pa'i phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /sngon gyi stimatha' dang phyi ma'i ⑧mtha' bcad pa'i phyir chos thams cad ji lta ba bzhin gyi 0phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ / 'jal ba'i dbang du byed pa dang dbang du bya ba 7med pa'i phyir chos thams cad sgro 'dogs pa med pa'i phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /byed pa pos byas pa'i phyir chos thams cad 'jig pa'i phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /rang bzhin gyis ma byung ba'i phyir chos thams cad 'byung ba med pa'i phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /rang bzhin gyis ma skyes pa'i phyir chos thams cad 'gog pa med pa'i phyag rgyas rgyas btab hunyepa'o/ /'gag pa med pa'i phyir chos thams cad gdod ma nas skye ba med pa'i phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ / rtog ge 7kun tu spyod pa thams cad dang bral ba'i phyir chos thams cad spros pa med pa'i phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /86—45

gzugs rnam par lta ba med pa'i phyir chos thams cad mtshan nyid med pa'i phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /gnas yongs su bcad pa'i phyir chos thams cad nye bar sbyor ba ①med pa'i phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /mi mthun pa'i phyogs nye bar mi dmigs (kyepa'i phyir chos thams cad la rjes su sbyor ba med ②pa'i phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /mngon par 'du byed pa thams cad med pa'i phyir chos thams cad las kyi rnam par smin (4)pa med pa'i phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /skye ba dang gnas pa las rnam par grol ba'i phyir chos thams cad 'dus ma byas pa'i phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /nam mkha' dang khyad par med pa'i phyir chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /mtshan nyid gcig pa'i phyir chos thams cad gzugs dang / tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang /(5) 'du byed dang la/ rnam par shes pa'i phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /snying po med pa'i phyir chos thams cad phung po'i phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /snying po dang bcas pa med pa'i phyir chos thams cad khams dang skye mched kyi phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku dang mnyam pa nyid thob pas chos thams cad khams dang skye mched kyi phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /mtha' gcig tu 'jig rten gyi lam rnam par dag pa'i phyir chos thams cad 'phags pa'i bden pa (6)bzhi'i phyag ci rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /lha 977rjes su byed pa'i phyir chos thams cad phyag rgya chen (5)po'i phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /mtha' gcig tu chos la phan 'dogs pa'i phyir chos thams cad chos kyi phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /thams cad kyi las sna tshogs byed pa'i phyir chos thams cad las kyi phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /thams cad dam tshig thams cad rjes su bsgrub 9pa'i phyir chos thams cad dam tshig gi 86—46

phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad rab tu mi gnas pa'i phyir chos thams cad sangs rgyas kyi phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /chos thams cad 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phyir ①lam gyi phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa dang ②/theg pa chen po'i phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa dang / gsang sngags kyi phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa dang / phyag rgya'i phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa dang / dkyil 'khor gyi phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa dang / mnyam pa nyid kyi phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa dang /rdo rje ①ye shes kyi phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa dang / ye shes thams cad kyi phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa dang / me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa dang / mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa dang / so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa dang / bya ba grub ④pa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa dang ske/ chos thams cad (gechos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi phyag rgya'o//muḥ(ye / 'jam dpal phyag rgya'i tshig 'di dag ni mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i ye shes kyi tshig de bzhin gshegs pa (gethams cad kyis (8)byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshig thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yongs su rdzogs par byed pa theg pa chen po'i tshig ste / 59)'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas 57bcom ldan 'das rnams dang / byang chub kyi phyag rgya nyid kyi phyag rgya'i tshig gang gis/phyag rgya'i tshig 'di rnams kyis kyang / chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong skyed par byed do/ /sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi rgyud la phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ // a i yi aḥmurnya/ sngags pas phyag rgya 'di lta bus 'irgyas btab na de 86—47
