bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya yang dag par 'du'o/ /hūṃ/ myur du ma skyes pa'i chos rnams la bzod pa thob par 'gyur ro①/ /khol/ de nas da ③ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sbyor ba thams cad kyi gsang ba chen po'i phyag rgya'i ye shes su gyur pa ni④/ snying gi dbus su rtag bsgom bya⑤/ /padma chen po 'dab ⑥brgyad pa/ /'bar ba'i phreng bas ⑦'khrigs pa'i 'od/ / zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus son par/ /⑧de yi steng du rtag bsgom ⑨pa/ /yi ge yi ni gtso bo mchog /thog ma tha ma med zhi ba/ /kha ba ba mo'i 'od 'dra 'od/ /dpa' bo kunda zla ltar dkar/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ltar 'od gsal/ /zhi ba'i chos kyi rang bzhin sku/ /kun mkhyen ye shes kyis ⑩gang ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi 3lhagasang / /ra sā 7ya na dang mtshungs mchog /kha yig mkha' 'drar (steshes par bya/ /thig le nā das rnam par spras/ /gsang ba chen po mchog tu mdzes/ /thog ma tha 8ma med pa'i bdag / de yi 8stong du 'od zer mche/ /bo'abar ba'i phreng ba 'khrugs (/nyapa'i 'od/ / rdo rje rdo rje lta bur gnas / /spyi bor rtse mo lnga dang ldan/ /3)de yi steng du rtag bsams pa yi ge mchog gi go 'phang ngo / /man ngag mchog las shes bya ste/ /gzhan du na ni nga mi smra/ /sangs rgyas mkhas pa thams cad kyis —9/ /mdor bsdus nas ni 'di gsungs so/ /rnam par grol ba gsum thob nas(nya/ /thob 'gyur 'di ni gzhan du min/ /lce ni rkan la dzo 2sbyar bar ( stebya/ /sna yi rtse mor yi ge rghaṃ/ /dbang po gnyis ni snyoms 'jug pas/ /phyag rgya'i go 'phang tshig gis ni/ /shes rab ldan pas rang sems bsgom ci/ /snang ba med cing spros med pa/ /shin tu mchog tu phrar shes bya/ /khyab bdag bsod nams ye shes dngos/ /bsam bya bsam 86—48

gtan brtson byas te①/ /mig dang sgron ma'i 'od bzhin du/ / ra yig ②'bar ba dang ldan pa/ /mgrin pa 'bad pas gcum dunas ni/ /dkar po ser po sngon po'i du'od/ /dmar po yang ni bdag gis spro①/ /'bar ba 'di dag 'bad pa yis/ / 'di dag yang dag nyer mtshon dubya/ /snying gar ⑦gsal bar byas nas su/ /de bzhin thams cad spyi bor song / /gnas de las ⑧ni 'thon ⑨nas kyang / /dbang po thams cad dgang bar byasakyi/ /de las 'thon yinas 'jig rten ni/ /mtshungs par kun nas thams cad du/ /slar yang de ru 'ongs nas ni/ /de ni 'jug par cirab tu bsam/ /yid kyis de ltar bsgoms na ni/ /rang nyid 'khor los sgyur lta bur0/ /dbang po gnyis ni rab sbyor bas/ /legs par mnyam par gzhag ④pas bsgomatshu/ /dbang po lngas ni dmigs nas yang / /mi rnams lus ni dag par 'gyur/ /ji snyed bud med yon tan dang / /ldan pa kun du gnas pa ni/ /bkug nas bcug ste bcings nas su/ /dbang du bya ste bsgrub par bya/ /de rnams lhan cig yongs brten ⑩nas/ /sngags pa mchog gi dngos grub thob/ /gsang ba mchog tu dgyes pa na/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa ste / /zhi ba'i chos kyi rim pa mchogatso /shin tu mnyam par gzhag pas bsgomayi/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i dngos grub gang rdu nye/ /de 'grub gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ /mchog ni rtag par shes par bya /bar mas phun sum tshogs pa ste/ /stong pa nyid dang mtshan med mchog /smon pa med pa zhes su grags/ /chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /kun mkhyen ye shes rdzogs par byed/ /sa bcu yi ni stobs dag gis/ /pha rol phyin pa thams cad thob/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mchog bsgoms nas(sto/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'dra bar 'gyur//86—49

de nyid 'di ni bcud kyis ①len/ /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mchog /theg chen mchog tu yid 'ong ba/ /stong nyid bsgom ②pa'i bdag nyid can/ /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mchog /gang gis rtag tu sgom byed na/ /de yang rdo rje 'dzin rgyal po/ /yon tan mchog las skyes par ②'gyur/ /brgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyanan)/ / bud med lus ngag yid sbyor bas(7 yongs reg ā dzi 97ga tsusbas/ /mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /bud med kha dog ljang gu 2gang / /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan⑨/ /de tshe de ni sngags pas bsten/ /mnyam med gsang ba'i ye shes mtshungs/ /bud med gang zhig kha dog dkar/ /padma'i 'dab tshem 'dra ba'i 'od/ /de dang lhan cig sngags pas bsdad / /dam pa'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ / bu mo tshigang zhig kha dog dmar / /utpa la yi rgyan 'chang ma/ /sngags pas de dang lhan cig gnas/ /shes rab pha rol phyin mtshungs 'gyur/ /bud med yin dra 75 la mtshungs/ /gsang ba rdo rje rjes su sbyor1rta/ /rig 'dzin rnams kyi rgyal po nithu/ /stobs chen grub par de 15'gyur rotsha/ /gsang chen ma ra ka ta mtshungs/ /gang gis rtag tu bsten pa ni/ /de yang 1 rdo rje 'dzin rgyal po/ /myur du gsang ba'i dam par 'gyur/ /bud med padma rā ga 'dra/ /rgyan rnams 3stekun gyis rnam par brgyan / /dbang po gnyis ni snyoms 'jug pas/ /rdo rje 'dzin ma lta bur bsgrubanyi ske/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam sbyor ba/ /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mchog / bsam pas 1rtag tu bsgom 1pa ni/ /mnyam med sangs rgyas kun dang mtshungs/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi/ /mchog gis ( sheganas kyis bsgoms na snyeni/ /rnal 'byor mchog gis 2 mi ring bar/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa lta 86—50

bur 'gyur/ /yang dag spong ba rnam pa bzhi/ /legs par mnyam par gzhag pa bsgomacha/ /dbang po gnyis ni snyoms 'jug pas/ /mnyam med 'jig rten dbang phyug mtshungs/ /so so ②yang dag rig pa bzhi/ /shin tu mnyam gzhag bsgoms ①na ni/ /④rdo rje sangs rgyas ting 'dzin mchog⑤ /mnyam med 'jam pa'i mchog dang 'dra/ /mi 'jigs pa ni rnam pa bzhi/ /rdo rje'i sbyor bas bsgom par bya/ /dbang po gnyis ni snyoms 'jug pas/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa lta bu ste / /rdzu 'phrul gyi ni rkang pa bzhi/ /shin tu mnyam gzhag bsgoms yin ni/ /dbang po gnyis ni mnyam sbyor bas/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan pa'i mchog tu 'gyur/ /tshangs pa yi ni gnas bzhi po/ /tshad med pa yi sems kyis ni/ /rdo rje sbyar tsobar bdag bsgoms na/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa lta bur 'grub/ /sbyor ba'i bdag nyid dbang po lnga/ /dam pa'i don gyis bsgoms na ni/ /dbang po gnyis ni snyoms 'jug pas/ /mnyam med rdo rje sangs rgyas mtshungs/ /yid kyi stobs ni rnam pa lnga/ /shin tu mnyam gzhag (kyebasgoms na ni/ /'khor los sgyur yidab brtson 'grus che/ /stobs 'dzin lta bu nyid du 'gyur/ /byang chub yan lag rin chen bdun/ /gsang sngags sgom ⑩pas bsgoms /man ni/ /rtog pa'i ye shes sbyor ba yis/ khyab bdag chos kun 'dzin par 'gyur/ /'phags pa'i yan lag brgyad kyi lam/ /kun mkhyen ye shes rdzogs byed pa/ /de ni bsgoms pa tsam gyis ni/ /'jig rten shes rab tsorab tu 'da'/ /rjes su dran pa rnam pa drug /bdag nyid rtse gcig gis bsgoms na/ /sngags pa rdo rje 'dzin pa ru/ /sngags pa dus mi ring bar 'gyur/ /stobs bcu po ni yang dag bsgoms/ /bsgom the pa'i rnal 'byor de nyid kyis/ /bsod nams ye shes yongs rdzogs te/ /86—51

rtag tu stobs bcu'i dam par 'gyur/ /pha rol phyin bcu yongs su rdzogs/ /stobs rnams dang ni ①dbang rnams dang / /sa rnams kun ni des bskyed nas/ /myur du mtshan ma dag par 'gyur/ / rnam grol gos kyis bsgribs nas su/ /② de yi ⑤nu ma shin tu bsnun/ /rje dungar gyis kyang ⑤de bzhin du/ /mchu yis mchu ni yongs su gzung ⑥/ /'bad pas dam du ā tshuling ga /⑧byang chub sems ni bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje ye shes brtson 'grus che/ /rdo rje dbyings su bdag brtan ⑨pas/ /rnam pa sna tshogs ka ra ṇa0/ /rnal 'byor shes pa de bsten bya/ /7bud med rnams kyi dam tshig 'grubatso/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mtshungs par 'gyur/ /bud med rnams kyi bha gar 8bsnun/ /ling ga myur du gang bar 'gyur/ /sbyor ba 'di ni mkhyen pa yis/ /stobs chen sangs rgyas rab tu grub/ /gsang ba 'di ni dam pa ste/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi skyob pa'o/ /gsang ba 'di yi sbyor ba yis/ /yi ge'i chadam pa 'grub par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi tshim 'dres pa'i/ /chos su grags pa gang yin pa/ /de rnams sgom byed gtso bo ni/ /dngos grub thams cad rab tshogs pa'o⑩/ /ma 'dres pa yi chos bcwa thabargyad/ /sangs rgyas chos su grags pa ste/ /de rnams bsgom tsopa dang ldan pas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab ster byed/ /bsam gtan bzhi po thob nas ni/ /gzugs med pa yi rtag par yang / /'gog pa'i snyoms ⑩par 'jug ldan pas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sgrub ༷ rtepa po/ /byang chub phyogs ni sum cu 51bdun/ /chos ni mchog tu rmad byung ba/ /de rnams bsgom 6)pa dang ldan pas/ /byang chub sems dpa'i skyob pa'o/ /sngags rnams thams cad rab 'grub cing / / sbyor ba na thams cad thams cad du'o/ / des na rdzi'abad pa 86—52

thams cad kyis/ /sangs rgyas chos nyid bsgom par bya/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i lam/ /ye shes rin chen rab rnyed dka'acha/ /mchod dang dbang bskur byin brlabs ②pas/ /rnyed 'gyur gzhan du ma yin no/ / bshags dang ①gsol ba gdab 0pa dang / /bdag nyid dbul ba de bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas sogs la yi rang zhing ⑤/ /de bzhin yongs su bsngo ba dang / /byang chub sems ni yang dag bskyed/ /khyad par du ni dus kun du'o/ /thog ma bar dang phyem red 0du/ /ji lta bzhin du rjes bsgoms pas/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bsgrub bya ste/ /'di la the tshom yod ma yin/ /'gro ba sems kyis spro ba ni/ /brtan pa'i snying por ④legs par bshad/ /stong nyid de bzhin nyid las byung / /rdo rje sems dpar de bshad do/ /'gro ba thams cad bkug phyenas su/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sbyar bar bya/ /don yod ye shes dag pa de'o/ /rdo rje rgyal po mchog ces bshad/ /rdo rje chags pas chags gyur nas/ /rang bzhin gyis ni brtan par 'gyur/ /'gro ba ma lus lus med pa/ /de yi sems ni chags ⑩par bshad/ /chos rnams kun ni rang bzhin gyis/ /rnam par dben zhing gnyis su med/ /gang tshe dag pa'i bdag nyid mthong / /de tshe rdo rje legs par bshad/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bzhi po yis/ /ming dang brda ni sbyar ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam sbyor ba/ /sdom pa mchog tu dam pa'o/ /khams gsum pa yi rgyal srid che/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs par byas pa ste/ /sa dang pha rol phyin mchog gtso/ /rdo rje dbang bskur las byung ba/ /de bzhin gshegs kun ye shes te/ /rnyog pa med cing yi ge med/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor gzi brjid mchog /brtan pa rtag pa nyid du 'gyur5nya/ /nam mkha'i mdzod ni 86—53

mdzod chen po/ /chos rnams thams cad dbang sgyur bsti/ /yid bzhin nor bu rdo rje che/ /rdo rje tog ni bla na med/ /ye shes snang ba rin chen che/ / rmad du byung ba nges par mthong (mi/ /de bzhin gshegs kun gsang ba ni/ /rdo rje bzhad pa zhes su gragasaXkye/ /chos kyi bdag med las byung ba/ /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mchog /chos nyid dam pa bsam du med/ /rdo rje chos zhes bya bar dran④ / /rdo rje blo gros snang ba che/ /shes rab ye shes dri med mchog /zag med shes rab chen po pa/ /de ni rdo rje rnon por bshad/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos 'khor lo/ /gnyis su med las byung bar mtshon/ /yan lag bcu gnyis rten 'brel ming ⑤/ /rdo rje rgyu zhes nges par bshad/ /dgongs pa'i skad ni spros pa'i mchog /yul rnams kyis ni bshad pa ste / /sangs rgyas kun gyis ⑦bzlas pa che/ /de ni rdo rje smra bar bshad/ /sems can kun gyi don la sbyar/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mchod pa che/ /gdod nas dag pa'i rnal 'byor che/ /de ni rdo rje las ( su bshad/ /bla na med pa'i byams pa che/ /bsrung ba'i bya ba gong na (9)med / / dag pa'i 7chos ni brtson chen po/ /rdo rje bsrung 4stob zhes su grags/ /shes rab thabs kyi khro bo che/ /sangs rgyas kun dang rjes mthun 1nyapa/ /nyon mongs thams cad za ba che/ /de ni rdo rje nya gnod sbyin chabarjod/ /lus ngag yid ni yang dag sbyor/ /sgrib pa med cing yi ge bral/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi 1lhagasang / /de ni rdo rje mtshams sbyor bshad/ /rdo rje yin (1 ge shes rnal 'byor che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi stobs po che/ /thog ma tha lhonyam med zhi ba/ /rig pa mchog ces bya bar bshad/ /de nas yang 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i glus de bzhin gshegs pa thams 86wa 54

cad legs par mchod nas glur blangs pa/ oṃ sarba bud dha pa ra me shwa ra burgya shurgya ①la li hoḥl/ su bha gaḥ0/ su ra dutaḥkhru/ ma hā ma hā ā di ⑥ma hā bo snyi buddha ⑦bu ni/ ya gā dhishwa ra ta thā tā bhā bi tādma 0ka ta thā ga ta/ byang chub sems bskyed las 'khrungs pa/ /sangs rgyas kun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog gi dbang phyug dam pa'i chos/ /gdod nas zhi ba la phyag 'tshal/ /byang chub sems dpa' skyob pa po/ /rdo rje can kun la phyag 'tshal/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje che/ /sangs rgyas byang chub la phyag 'tshal/ /mi dmigs go 'phang la gnas pa/ /mtha' las 'das pa la phyag 'tshal/ /'dren pa rnams kyi stobs po che/ /rghaṃ gi yi ge ma lus pa/ /thams cad mkhyen pa mtha' dag dang ske/ /shin tu yongs su mya ngan 'da'/ /'jig rten dbang phyug mgon bzang po/ /rdo rje ye shes dri ma med/ /rnam par dag pa rdo rje mchog /dngos grub thams cad rab gsol byed/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams kyi mgonasko/ /dus gsum bsam pa dbang sgyur ba/ ri/ /sems can rnams la phan don du/ / 'byung ba kyi khyod la phyag 'tshal 'dudamu/ /rdo rje snying po rgyan las dkyil 'khor chen po yongs su rdzogs sto'i// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnams slar yang 'dus par gyur nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kur (7zhugs te/ bcom ldan 'das rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po rdo rje snying po 51 rgyan gyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i phyag rgya'i don ched du brjod /shepa/ de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /dkyil 'khor chen po dam pa ste/ /rdo rje snying po zhes grags pa/ /sangs rgyas 86—55

kun gyi skyob pa'o/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis ①ni rnam par mdzes / /sgo khyud rdo rje'i gzugs brnyan dang / /phyag rgya dang ldan ②rab tu mdzes / /dkyil 'khor de yi dbus su ni/ /'khor lo gnyis ni rab tu gnas/ /rtsibs ③brgyad pa dang bcu drug rtsibs/ /rnam par dbye ba legs par brtag /dbus kyi dkyil 'khor nang gi ni/ /lte ba'i gnas su legs brtags paX/ /padma chen po 'dab brgyad ⑤pa/ /ge sar gtams ①pas rab tu mdzesal/ /de yi lte ba'i dbus su ni/ /khyab bdag rnal 'byor dbang phyug che/ /rnam par snang mdzad brtson chen po/ /sems can kun dul rjes brtse bas/ /de yi nye 'khor kun du ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa brgyad rnams dgod/ /shar du dgod bya 'khor lo can/ /gtsug tor dkar po nub tu gnasakhya/ /gzi brjid phung po lho ru'o/ /rnam par rgyal ba byang du gnas/ /dbang ldan rnam par gsal bar bri / /mer ni steng 'gro 7dgod par bya/ /steng 'gro chen po bden bral du/ /rlung du rgyal ba chen po gnas/ /sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan 'dzin pa'i mchog⑩/rnal 'byor ldan pas 7'di dag bri/ /mi bskyod pa ni shar du dgod/ /lho ru rin chen 'byung ldan no/ /nub tu 'od dpag med par 'gyur/ /byang du don yod grub pa'i ming / /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la brten 8pa'o/ /dbang ldan phyogs nas brtsams nas ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs bri/ /thams cad zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnas0/ /'khor rnams zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la'o/ /phreng ba rnam par dgod bya ba/ /rang gi phyag rgya 'od zer 'bar/ /rdo rje sgeg mo la sogs pa'ibo/ /lha mo 'bad pas dgod par bya/ /rdo rje bdug ⑩pa la sogs bri/ /de bzhin gzugs kyi rdo rje sogs/ /rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pa/ /86—56

sgo srung ①'bad pas bri bar bya/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor la gnas par②/ /kun du bzang sogs rim bzhin bri/ /rang gi phyag rgya'i 'khor rnams dang / /pho nya yi ni 'khor dag dang / /khro bo rnams dang mngag pa dang / /de bzhin pho nya pho nya mdu/ /rgya mtsho yi ni dkyil 'khor ni/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor gsal ba'o/ /phyi ru phyi rol rdo rje'i duming / /dkyil 'khor la ni 'bad pas bri/ /dbang ldan phyogs nas brtsams nas su/ /'jig rten skyong ba brgyad po bri/ /tshangs pa ⑤khyab 'jug dbang chen ming / /dbang po la sogs lha thams cad/ /ma mo kun dang sring mo rnams/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi dang kludu/ /de bzhin lha rnams thams cad dang / /brtson 'grus chen po nam mkha' lding / /'bad pa yis ni bri bar bya/ /de lta'i dkyil 'khor bris nas su/ /khyad par du ni mchod par bya/ /me tog bdug spos rol mo sogasaX/ /de bzhin bza' dang ston mo sogs/ /phreng ba'i rgyan ni sna tshogs kyis/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams mchod par bya/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi cho ga yis/ /mchod pa kun gyis thams cad nas / /'khor lo kun gyi cho ga yis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya/ /de nas slob ma thams cad gzhug⑧ /yongs su dag pa khyad par du/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed nas su/ /byang chub bslab pa rjes spyod pa/ /cho ga shes pa'i sngags pas gzhug /'dren pa rnams la mchod du 99༄gzhug /rdo rje'i dbang bskur sbyor ba yis/ /dbang bskur ba ni de nas sbyin/ /seng ge'i khri yi steng du ni/ /dar dang me tog chun pos spras/ /dkar po'i gdugs dang rin chen che/ /bla re 0rgya che 'bar ba dang / /de yi g.yas kyi drung du ni/ /mkhas pa yis ni gzhag 0par bya/ /ba dan rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /sna tshogs ras kyis rab 86—57

mchod pa 2)/ /g.yon gyi drung du thams cad nas/ /'bad pa yis ni gzhag ②par bya/ /rin chen sman kun gyis gang ba'i/ /bum pa legs par gzhag ①byas te / /rdo rje ming gi ④dbang bskur gyis/ /de la rang gis ⑤dbang bskur bya/ /rdo rje ming gis dbang bskur ba(ye/ /mkhas pa yis ni slar (peyang bya/ /kun gyi cod pan dbang bskur gyis/ /yang dang yang du dbang bskur bya/ /chos kyi cod pan dbang bskur dang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi skyob pa (0ni/ /sna tshogs las kyi dbang bskur sbyin/ /chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam mtshungs pa'o/ /chos kyi sku yi dbang bskur ba/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sgron ma ①sbyin/ /de ltar slob ma dbang bskur ba/ /6khyad par du ni sngags pas bya/ /de la dam tshig cho ga yis//sngags dang phyag rgyas sbyar bar 37bya/ /slob dpon brnyas par mi bya zhing / /sgrub po kun la smad mi bya/ /sngags kyi spyod pa thams cad las/ /'da' bar mi bya smad mi bya/ /'jig rten pa yi lha rnams dang / /grub mtha'i rigs pa thams cad la/ /smad par mi bya blang mi bya/ /de la mngon par dga' ba spangs/spyo/ /sdig pa thams cad rnam spang zhing / /de bzhin bsod nams thams cad bsdu/ /bza' dang ston mo du ma la/ /bza' bar mi bya smad mi bya/ /'dod pas bcom ldan sems pa nya 7ste/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sras bdag skyes/ /thog ma tha ma med zhi ba/ /nam yang dor bar mi bya'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad chags las 'khrungasal/ /de bzhin zhe sdang rmongs las 'khrungs/ /mnyam dang mi mnyam chos kun 15dang / /dbu ma'i gnas la gnas nas su/ /de nyid dam tshig shes nas sum/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yong 15mi spong / /lus can kun la 'tshe mi bya/ /khyod kyis ser sna mi bya ste/ /phrag dog bya bar mi byazho/ /dam pa'i chos ni spang 86—58

mi bya/ /byang chub sems ni mchog tu bde/ /chang gi btung ba spang bya ste/ /pha rol bud med rnam par spang / /thams cad mkhyen pa yongs mi dor/ /rtag tu srog chags gsad ①mi bya/ /sems can kun ②la snying rje dang ①/ /byams pa yang ni rnam par bsgomadu/ /sems can rnams la phan pa ni/ /yang dang yang du yongs bsdu ⑤bya/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rjes skyob pa/ /dam tshig de ⑤nyid 'di dag ni/ /slob ma rnams la rjes brtse bas/ /mkhas pa yis ni bstan par bya/ /de nas phyag rgya rjes bcing ba⑦/ /go rims (bebazhin du bstan par bya/ /phyag rgya 'di dag khyad par gyi/ /mtshan nyid yang dag rab bshad bya/ / thal mo brtan par bsdam par bya/ /⑨me tog zum pa'i tshul du mdzesam/ /sangs rgyas dpa' bo thams cad kyis7/ /padma'i thal mo zhes su bsgrags/ /rtse mo thams cad 8legs brkyang ba/ /padma'i phyag rgya zhes su brjod/ /re re'i mtshams su nges bcings pa/ /de ni rdo rje thal mor brtags/ste/ /sor mo thams cad nges bsdams pa/ /rdo rje bsdams pas legs bcings pa/ /sor mo brkyang ste steng du bstan/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab gsol byed/ /khu tshur nang du byas nas ni / /gnyis ④ka sbyar bas yongs su brtag /'khor los sgyur skosogs phyag rgya'o / /dam pa sbyin pa yin par bshad/ /sangs rgyas dpa' bo thams cad kyi/ /dam tshig phyag rgya 'di yin no/ /ming med nang bcug khu tshur gyis/ /kun gyi rtse tsomor yongs su brtag /rdo rje'i rnam pa nyu legs par sbyar/ /rdo rje chen po zhes su bsgrags/ /mthe the chung srin lag khu tshur las/ /gung mo legs par brkyang ༅nas su/ /mdzub mos mthe bong yongs su sbyar/ /'khor los sgyur ri rab nyid gsol byed/ /brkyang pa'i rtse mo sbyar ba ni/ /gdugs dkar zhes ni rab tu 86—59

gragasal/ /srin lag dang ni mthe bong sbyar/ /gung mo gnyis ni brtag ①par bya/ /gzi brjid phung po'i ②phyag rgya che/ /gzi brjid phung po ⑤nyid gsol byed/ /de nyid ral gri lta bur sbyar/ /rnam par rgyal ba zhes su grags/ /de nyid rgyal ba zhes bya ba/ /rdo rje ldan pa de bzhin gshegs/ /khu tshur snying po ldan byas pas / /gtsug tor rnam pa'i 'byung gnas te/ /thub dka' sangs rgyas thams cad kyis④/ /steng du 'gro ba zhes su bshad/ /rdo rje bsdams pa yongs su sbyar/ /dam tshig kun gyi 'byung gnas te/ /gung mo'i rtse mo mchog tu sbyar⑤/ /mthe'u rjochung dang ni mthe bong brkyang / /lcags kyu mda' yi sbyor ba yis/ /legs so ba ni sbyar bar bya/ /gung mo rdo rje rin chen rtse/ /bye ⑦ba gzi brjid mchog gi mchog /rgyal mtshan gnas su nges par sbyar/ /bzhad pa'i gnas su sbyar bar bya / /rdo rje chos kyi phyag rgya che/ /dbu ma padma lta bur (kyebaskum/ /ral gri 'dzin pa ⑨'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /'khor lo sbyar ⑩ba'i 'khor los sgyur⑩/ /kha ru phye ba'i 'phyag rgya che/ /rdo rje smra ba nyid du 'gyur/ /las kyi rdo rje'i phyag rgya che7/ /gar mtshungs rdo rje sna tshogs can/ /chos yongs sdud ༷pa'i sbyor ba yis rdo rje bsrung 7bar brtag par bya/ /mche ba gnyis ni rnam par gtsigs/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin zhes su bshad/ /khu tshur bcangs yipa khu tshur gyi0/ /rdo rje thal mo snying gar gzhag1nya /rdo rje sgeg mo zhes su grags/ /yongs su sbyar ba spyi bor gzhag37 /rdo rje phreng ba zhes su brjod/ /thal mo sbyar ba gdong du dgrolasgonya/ /rdo rje glu mar rjes su bsgrags/ /'gyed cing 'dud pa'i sbyor ba yis me/ /de ni rdo rje gar mar bshad/ /padma'i thal mo gdong du dbye/ /spyi bor yongs su sbyar la gzhag snye /snying gar 3stemathe bo bsnyams pa dang / /rab tu brkyang ba byug 86—60

pa'o①/ /lag pa steng du yongs brkyang ba/ /gzugs kyi phyag rgya nyid du 'gyur/ /lag gnyis rna ba'i lam du gzhag② /sgra yi phyag rgya nyid du bshad/ /dri ni byug pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /dri yi phyag rgya zhes su brjod/ /gdong du snyim pa phye ③ba ni/ /ro yi phyag rgya zhes su bsgrags/ /mkha' la myur ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /reg pa reg pa zhes su bshad/ /mthe'u lichung gnyis ni duyongs su sbyar/ /mdzub mo lcags kyu'i sbyor ba las/ /de nyid zhags ⑥pa'i dbyibs dang ni/ /lu gu rgyud kyi rnam par brtag /bzhi pa rdo rje dril bu zhes/ /rdo rje 'bebs par rnam par brtag /phyag rgya kun dang nye ba'i rgya/ /blo gros ldan pa rang gis ⑦brtag /thal mo yongs su sbyar la bsdam/ /mdzub mo gnyis po bskum ninas ni/ /rin po che yi rnam par bcing / /kun du bzang po blo ldan gyis/ /de las rtse mo rtse mo bskum/ /sems kyis ⑨byams pa bsgoms nas soX/ /mdzub 7mo sbyar la bcug nas ni/ /ral gri'i rnam par brtag pa ste/ /'di ni nam mkha'i snying po yi/ /phyag rgyar sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags/ /de nas ral gri'i mtshon cha yi/ /rnam pa ru ni nyer gnas pa/ /phyag rgya 'di ni rnam 'gog par/ /thams cad kyis ni yongs su brjod/ /gar ni sdud pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje thal mo rab tu brkyang / /padma'i lta bur rnam par brtag /padma'i lag pa blo ldan gyis/ /de nyid me tog zum 8tshul dang / /utpal rnam par 8ltar mdzes pa/ /'di ni padma sgrol ba'i rgya/ /padma'i mgon po zhes su grags/ /mche ba gtsigs pa dang ldan pa'i/ /kha dang 'dra bar legs par brtagatso /'di ni rta mgrin phyag rgya ste/ /kha yi phyogs su rab tu brtag /padma'i thal mo dpral ba yi/ /khro 8gnyer du ni nye bar sbyar/ /rdo rje thal mo 'bebs pa che/ /dpal gyi snying po rin chen ldan/ /86—61

yid bzhin nor bu'i rnam ①pa bzung (gyi/ /thal mo legs par rab tu brkyang / /mi zad ①blo gros phyag rgya che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rab tu brtagasadu/ /gar ni sdud pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /rin chen rdo rje snying gar gzhag⑤ /nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya ste/ /nam mkha'i mdzod nyid ster bar byed/ /rdo rje chen po legs par brkyang / /mthe chung mthe bong nges par bcing / /lag pa gnyis ni nges par brtag /blo gros rgya mtsho'i phyag rgyar 'gyur/ /rdo rje thal mo steng du bsgreng 94)/ /mdzub mo gnyis po sbyar bar bya/ /'di ni rdo rje snying po'i rgya/ /rdo rje snying pos bka' stsal to/ /khu tshur nang du byas nas su/ /mdzub mo gnyis po rtse mo bya(pe/ /'di ni 'jam dpal phyag rgya ste/ /rdo rje ral gri zhes su brtag /de nyid shag ti'i shernam pa ni/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs ni blo ldan gyi'o/ /gshin rje mthar byed mdung rtser 'gyur/ /mdung rtse chen por rab tu brtag /mdzub mo bskum par byas nas ni/ /gung mo'i steng du yongs su gzhag0 /zhags pa'i rnam pa rab ldan pas/ /gshin rje yang ni 'jigs par byed/ /de nyid ral grir byas pa ni/ /skra can ma ru khorab tu bshad/ /khu tshur thams cad nges bcings te/ /mdzub mo gcig ni bskum par bya/ /'di ni nye ba'i skra can 7rgyar / /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis bka' stsal to/ /rdo rje bsdams pa steng bcings te/ /dbu ma gnyis ni rnam par spang / /mdzub mo rdo rje'i rnam par bya / /mthe'u tshachung dang ni mthe bong brkyang / /'di ni rdo rje 'dzin chen po'i/ /phyag rgya don kun sgrub byed yin/ /mdzub mo mthe bos sa bsdams pa ni/ /mā ma khrir ni yongs su bshad/ /mdzub mor 〉lcags sgrog 7rnam pa las/ /gung mo'i dbu ma rdo rjer bya/ /'di ni rdo rje lcags sgrog rgya/ /rdo rje lta bur yongs su 86—62

bshad / /rdo rje chen po gyertse lnga pa/ /khro bo gzegs mar rnam par bshad/ /mchog gi rtse mo rtse gcig bya/ /rdo rje rtse mo nyid kyir ②bshad/ /lag na rin chen phyag rgya ni/ /lag gnyis legs par brkyang bar bya/ /sor mo padma'i dbyings su bya/ /skul ③byed lha mor yongs su bshad/ /thal mo yongs su sbyar ba las/ /mdzub mo dang ni mthe bong dag /mig gi tshul du sbyar bar bya/ /sangs rgyas spyan gyi ④rnam par bshad/ /bkra shis kyi ni skyil krung dubaca'/ /rnal 'byor rig pas lus bsrang ⑥ste/ /lag gnyis lhung bzed 'dzin 'dra ba/ /bsam gtan phyag rgyar rab tu bshad/ /'di ni rnam par snang mdzad rgya/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi don mdzad pa'og/ /mi bskyod ⑧pa yi sa la reg /rin chen tog gi mchog sbyin bshad/ /bsam gtan phyag rgya 'od dpag med/ /ngo bo nyid kyi don rtogs byed/ /don yod gzigs pa'i phyag rgya ni/ /mi 'jigs 'jigs pa (94rimed pa sbyin/ /blo ldan rnal 'byor skyil krung ⑩gnas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin bdag /mnyam par bzhag phonyapa 8phyag rgya kun/ /'ching 8ba 'am ni 'ching tsodu gzhug /'jig rten pa yi phyag rgya la/ /lag pa gcig ni rab brkyang ste/ /dbang ldan gyi ni rtse gsum pa/ /mthe bos mthe'u 8chung mnan par bya/ /lha yi dbang po'i rdo rjer 'gyuratso/ /lag pa g.yas pas brtag she 7par bya/ // me yi oṃ yig lag pa dag /mthe bo /)gung mo nyid la gzhags dī /gshin rje'i rdo rje dbyug pa ste/ /mdzub mo dang ni mthe bong sbyar/ /de nyid khyab 'jug rina'akhor lo ste/ /'khor lo'i yi ge dgod par bya/ /lag pa gcig gis thod pa ni/ /ma mo rnams kyir sa yang dag bshad/ /sor mo gnyis bsgreng gyeral gri ni/ /srin po ( 4thubadag nyid chen po'i'o/ /mdzub mo mthe bong sbyar ba ni/ /chu lha'i zhags pa 86—63

nyid du bshad/ /mdzub mo dang ni gung mo dag /rgyal mtshan lta bur legs par brkyang / /rlung lha rgyal mtshan phyag rgya ni/ /lag pa gnyis kyis rab tu brtag /dbu ma gcig pu legs brkyang ①ba/ /dbyug to'i ②phyag rgyar ①rab tu bshad / /gnod sbyin kun gyi dbang phyug ni/ /lus ngan bdag nyid chen po'o/ /mchod phyir thogs kyi phyag rgya ni/ /tshangs pa yi ru ༷legs par bshad/ /drag po'i gsal shing shes bya ste/ /lha mo'i ba ṭi sa ⑤ru brjod/ /tshogs bdag gi ni sna ru bshad/ /zla ba'i bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor royi/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer stong phrag ni/ /lag pa gnyis kyis bstan par bya/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor sbyor ba yis / /dbang po'i rdo rje mtshon cha ltaral/ /'di ni lha rnams kun gyi rgya/ / dpa' bo tshonyekun gyis 6)rab tu gnang 0/ /dri za rnams kyi phyag rgya ni/ /glu len lta bur rab catu bsgrags/ /dga' byed dbang phyug phyag rgya che/ /rdza rnga'i sgra dbyangs rab tu 'bar/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rab mchod phyir/ /lha (7chen pos ni rab tu brtags)snye/ /ting ting shag (nye'adzin sbyor ba yis/ / mi 'am ci rnams kyir brjod byathu/ /pi wang bsgreng ⑫ ba'i sbyor 0ba yis/ /dbyangs can gyir ⑩ni rnam par bshad/ /rtag 1 tu dun du rnyi sgrog pa/ /rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyir brjod/ /lag gnyis gdengs ma'i tshul byas pa/ /klu rnams kyir ()ni legs par bshad/ /gar ni sdud pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /'gyed dang 'du ba'idude bzhin no/ /lag pa'i zhags pa sko stenges bcings pas / /de ni phyag rgyar rab tu bshad/ /'di rnams dam tshig phyag rgya ru/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams legs par gsungs9 —snye/ /las kyi sbyor ba 'bad pa yis/ /'di rnams kyang ni phyag rgyar bshad / /phyag rgya dor nas sems kyi ḍo mini/ /rin chen yang dang yang du bsam/ /86—64

rnam par rtog med gdod nas zhi/ /chos dbyings mnyam zhing mi mnyam pa/ /stong pa mkha' 'drar shes nas su/ /mkhas pa yis ni bsgom par bya/ 'di dag thams cad ma skyes shing / /mi lam lta bur rab tu gnas/ /dri za'i grong khyer lta bur snang / /'tsho ba'i 'jig rten yang dang yang / /mig 'phrul lta bur shin tu ni/ /'gro ba thams cad rab tu gsal/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal stong pa ru/ /srid pa thams cad mdor bsdus pa/ /bdag med pa zhes mthong nas ni/ /sangs rgyas kun dang dpa' bo yis①/ /sgyu ma smig rgyu brag ca ②dang / /lbu ②ba chu yi chu bur dang / /gzugs brnyan lta bur 'jig rten ni/ /de ltar sangs rgyas rnams kyis dgongs/ /thams cad mgal me'i 'khor lo ltar/ /zo chun khyud mo ji bzhin du/ /gar gyi gnas kyi tshul 'dra bdu/ /zla ba gnyis dang mtshungs par blta/ /rtag tu glog gi phreng ba 'dra/ /sbrang bu'i sgra dang mtshungs par gnas⑤/ /'khor ba shin tu bslang ba ⑥ste/ /rgod ma'i kha dang 'dra bar gnas/ /'di ltar shes shing rtogs nas ni/ /bsgom ⑦pa'i stobs kyis rang nyid kyisani/ /sems ni legs bsgrub ⑨rnal 'byor pa/ /de la phyag rgya rab tu bshad / /stong pa mtshan ma med pa dang / /smon pa med pa'i rang bzhin las0/ /lus dang ngag dang yid kyis ni/ /dam tshig gsum ni brtags pa'o/ /phyag rgya sngags dang lha nyid dang / /de nyid (legasum ni rab tu gnas/ /bdag nyid sbyor ba'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /mtshan nyid gcig tu rnam par gnas/ /de 'di dam pa'i phyag rgya ru/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis bka' stsal to/ /phyag rgya yi ge bral ba ste/ /rnam pa 8med cing snang ba med9/nye/ /dngos po med pa'i chos rnams la/ /dngos po'i de nyid nyid du bshad/ /dngos med dngos po'i rang bzhin 86—65

yin / /dngos med nyid kyang dngos po yin/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam par grol / /rnal 'byor ye shes mchog tu bde/ /rtog ge med cing snang ba med/ /'khrul pa med cing yi ge med/ /stong pa nam mkha' mtshungs pa'i sems/ /gang tshe de ltar nyid gyur pa①/ /de tshe phyag rgya rnams dang sngags/ /lha nyid du yang rab tu brtag /sngags las phyag rgya ma mthong zhing ②/ /phyag rgya las kyang sngags min las/ /rang nyid lha yi rnal 'byor ni/ /gnyis med sngags dang phyag rgyar brtags na/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje snying po rgyan ces bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las phyag rgya'i rim par phye ba'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad slar yang 'dus par gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor los sgyur (mib chen po rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po la gsol ba btab pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyi rigs bskyed par mdzad du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa de dag gis gsol ba btab pa'i tshig nye bar gsan nas 'og min gyi gnas nas byon te/ dga' ldan gyi gnas su bzhugs nas dga' ldan gyi ris kyi lha'i bu rnams la chos bstan 97)nas zas gtsang gi rigs la mngon par gzigs te/ mngon par byung bar mdzad nas byang chub kyi snying po dag la nye bar mnan 8tshonas nye bar 'khod de/ bdud bzhi las rnam par rgyal bar bstan nas byang chub kyi snying po la bzhugs par gyur te/ bzhugs nas kyang kun nas 'phro ba'i ting nge 'dzin sngon du 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin bye ba brgya stong phrag brgyad cu 9rtsa bzhi la snyoms par zhugs te/ snyoms par zhugs nas kyang de 86—66

bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje se gol gyi sgras de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan 'dren cing gsang sngags 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ sasba ta thā ga ta badzra sa mā dzaḥ.ā ①karṣa ya sab ta thā ga tā na hūṃ/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'khor dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po rnams legs par byon te/chos kyi dbyings su spros nas phyogs bcu mu med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rab 'byam ②rgya mtsho'i sprin rnams khyab ①ste/ nam mkha'i khams na gnas pa thams cad til gyi gang bu ltar 'dzam bu'i gling du 'khod par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug gis bkug cing bcug ste/bcings nas dbang du mdzad de/ de nyid kyi thugs kur durab tu gzhag ⑤par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen pos gnyis su med pa'i sbyor bas byin gyis brlabs gyete/ sngags 'dis rang gi sems so sor rtogs pa ⑦mdzad do/ /oṃ tsitta pra ti be dhe ka ⑧ro mi/ de'i rjes thogs nyid la sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs kur nyu)longs spyod rdzogs pa dang / sprul pa'i sku las chos kyi 0sku rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba sems rin po che nges par byung tunyeste/ spros par mdzad do/ /de nyid sems 'od gsal ba/ thugs 7rje chen pos khyab pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i rnyog pa spangs pa nam mkha' ltar gdod nas zhi ba/ de las thugs rje 8chen po la mngon par phyogs par byas nas sems can gyi khams thams cad la rnam par gzigs te/ mi shes pas rga ba dang / 'chi bas rnam par khyab pa'i 'jig rten la gzigs nas slar yang sngags 'dis byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa nye bar spu86—67

bstan pa/ oṃ bo ①snyi tsi tta uṅgā da yā mi/ byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa'i rjes thogs nyid la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kur ②sems 'od gsal ba de yongs su rdzogs pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ltar byin gyis brlabs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kur (kyernam par gzhag dugo/ /legs par rnam par dag pa'i nam mkha' ltar dri ma med pa/ spros pa thams cad spangs pa me long lta bur brtan par byas nas gnas te/ byang chub kyi sems chen po la sngags 'di brjod do/ /oṃ dzñā na rasmi bi sri dza rgyu/ de ni ⑤rjes thogs nyid la 'od zer rnam pa sna tshogs pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor las rnam par phyung ༅ngo / /de phyung nas kyang chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang du zhugs te/ shes bya'i dkyil 'khor thams cad gsal bar byas nas/ sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi ri bo'i rtse ⑦bsnyil te rab tu rtogs par byas nas gcig tu 'dres gte/rdo rje'i sku chen po rnams bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kur 0rjes su zhugs nas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rab tu gnas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen pos sngags 'dis ⑩byin gyis brlabs so/ /oṃ tiṣṭha badzra 7slar yang sngags 'dis spros 7pa/ oṃ sga ra badzra slar yang sngags 'dis bsdus so/ /oṃ sang ha ra badzra/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis ye shes rdo rje'i snying po 'di ched du brjod pa/ oṃ dzñā na badzra/ de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug 9/nyechen pos sngags 'dis byin gyis brlabs pa/ oṃ sab ta thā ga ta tshwa na badzra hūṃ/ de nas yide bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang thugs mnyam pa nyid brnyes tsopas sngags 'dis byin gyis brlabs pa/ oṃ badzra ādma cako3lha / de nas de 86—68

bzhin gshegs pa thams cad brtan pa nyid du nye bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis ①de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang / thugs gzigs nas sngags 'dis byin gyis brlab par mdzad do//oṃ ya thā sab ta thā ga ta sta thā a rtal/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad pa'i rgyu sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku bdag nyid sems can gyi khams thams cad du nges par bstan to/ /de nas brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyis mthong nas lha dang mi rnams kyis mngon par byang chub pas bcom ldan 'das mngon par byang chub pa zhes sgra bsgrags so/ /de nas tshangs pas gsol ba btab stel/ chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor nas de dang des 'dul ba'i skye bo btul te gang gis slar ldog pa med pa nyid du gyur to/ /'di rnams ni sangs rgyas kyi byang chub bsgom 0pa'i rim pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs nas sangs rgyas kyi byang chub bstan te sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad pa nye bar bsgrubs nas de'i thugs ka ⑤las rdo rje phyung ste/ nyid kyi phyag tu gzhag ⑥par gyur te⑦/ de nas 'od zer rnam par phyung ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad snang bar mdzad nas slar log ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi (gyethugs kur tsozhugs nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po kun du bzang po'i skur byin gyis brlabs te mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dar dang phreng bas dbang bskur ba/ zla ba'i kha dog lta bu'i 'od zer can du byin gyis brlabs te rnam par gnas so/ /de nas thugs ka ⑩nas phyung ba'i /7zla ba'i 86—69

dkyil 'khor la brten ①te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi spyan snga dang /rgyab dang drung du rdo rje sems dpa' dang / rdo rje chos dang / rdo rje rin chen dang ske/ rdo rje las la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i phreng bar ②rnam par gnas so/ /de bzhin du sgeg mo la sogs pa rnams dang bdug pa la sogs pa'i lha zhukhyad par du nges par bskyed cing gzugs la sogs pa rnams dang lcags kyu la sogs pa'i lha rnams bskyed de 'di dag gi dkyil 'khor bka' stsal pa / de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /dkyil 'khor chen po mchog gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas dpa' bo thams cad kyis/ /rdo rje snying po zhes su gsungs/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /dar dang me tog phreng bas brgyan/ /sgo khyud ④dang ni kha khyer 95)dang / /rta babs kyis ni so sor sprasayi/ /de yi dbus su khri chen po/ /kun (penas yongs su gru bzhi pa/ /de yi steng du pad chen po/ /ge sar ldan zhing rab mdzes pa/ /de yi lte ba'i dbus su ni/ /sangs rgyas sku gzugs dgod par bya/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni drung kun du/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dgod par bya / /sangs rgyas kun gyi nye 'khor du/ /'khor los sgyur (kyeb la sogs bri/ /phyi yi gnas ni thams cad du/ /sangs rgyas sras po rnam par dgod/ /kha dog ser po gzi brjid che/ /dbang chen dkyil 'khor rab 'bar ba thams cad rnam pa sna tshogs rgyan99/ /brgyan pa de dag dgod par bya/ /rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud chen po las dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis 7slar yang chu'i lha'i dkyil 'khor chen po bka' stsal pa/ de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /dkyil 86—70

'khor chen po mchog gyur pa/ /chos kyi 'khor lo 'dra bas na/ /chos kyi 'khor lo zhes su brjod/ /de yi phyi rol gnyis pa la/ /zlum po ru ni rtogs par bya /ri mo mang po ①sna tshogs pas/ /sgo dang sgo khyud ②brtag par bya/ /rta babs rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /dar dang me tog phreng bas brgyan①/ /de yi dbus su pad chen poX/ /ge sar ldan zhing rab mdzes pa/ /'dab (gem brgyad kyi ka ba'i mdun⑥/ /dkyil 'khor brgyan ⑦kyis brgyan pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor de yi dbus su ni/ /rgyal ba thams cad dkar por semachog /kha ba ba zho ltar dkar gsal / /shel dang zla ba lta bu'i 'od/ /kunda zla ba ltar dkar brtan⑨/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus son par/ /de yi nye 'khor thams cad du/ /sangs rgyas sras po rnam par dgod/ /thams cad zla ba ltar dkar zhing ⑩/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs zla ba 'dra/ /zla ba 'bar mtshungs mnyam med pa/ /chu yi ming zhes bya ba yi/ /hunyerdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud chen po las chu lha'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen pos me lha zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po bka' stsal pa/ de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /dkyil 'khor chen po mchog gyur pa/ /rdo rje ye shes gzi brjid mtshungs/ /rdo rje /nyagazi brjid ces su brjod/ /gru gsum rnam pa nyid du bya/ / sum mdo ris kyi rnam pa mtshungs/ste/ /'bar ba'i phreng 'khrugs 'jigs pa'o/ /kha dog dmar po stobs po che/ /'jig pa'i dus kyi me 'dra ba/ /rtag tu padma rā ga mtshungs/ /de yi dbus su gzi brjid che/ /nyi ma'i kha dog stobs po che rdo 86—71

rje rtsa gsum sna tshogs pa/ / sum mdo'i ①snying gar ②gzhag ②par bya/ /bal po se'u'i me tog mtshungs/ /ya ba'i me tog dag dang 'dra/ /padma padma rā ga mtshungs / /sangs rgyas dpa' bo yang dag par④/ /bzang po mtshal ⑤dang mtshungs 'dra ba/ /rgya skyegs bcud dang 'dra bar gnas/ /de yi nye 'khor thams cad du/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas sangs rgyas sras/ /khro bo dang ni mngag pa dag /mkhas pa yis ni dgod par bya/ /de dag thams cad kha dog dmar/ /gzi brjid khams la 'od ldan pa/ /'od zer dmar po rab 'phro ba/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus son par/ /thams cad dmar po'i mtshon cha can/ /dmar po'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /dmar po'i gos kyis bkab pa'i lus/ /phreng ba dmar po mchog 'dzin pa/ /'di ni gzi brjid gter zhes bya/ /dkyil 'khor mchog tu 'bar ba'o/ /rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud chen po las me lha ⑥zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po rdzogs stol// // de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen pos laslar yang rlung lha'i dkyil 'khor bka' stsal pa/ de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /dkyil 'khor chen po mchog gyur pa/ /rlung gi khams dang 'dra bas na/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor zhes su bshad/ /zla ba phyed pa'i rnam pa 'dra/ /dbyar gyi sprin gyi 'od dang mtshungs/ /a ta sī ⑨yi me tog 'dra/ /yin dra nī la'i 0'od dang mtshungs / /de yi namedabus su pad chen po/ /bai ḍūrya yi 8'od dang 'dra/ /shin tu gnag na pa'i mig sman mtshungs/ /sngon 8dmar gyi ni rnam par gnas/ /de yi lte ba'i dbus su ni/ /sangs rgyas dpa' bo rab 'bar ba/ /rgyal po 'khyil 86—72

pa 'bar ba'i gzi/ /mtshan ①mo nag mo lta bur gnas/ /utpal sngon po 'dab ②ma'i tshul/ /stong pa nam mkha' ①lta bur gnas/ /de yi nye 'khor thams cad du/ /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras rnams bri/ /khro bo rnams dang mngag pa dang / /de bzhin pho nya pho nya mo/ /thams cad sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan/ /de bzhin nag po'i gos gyon pa/ / kha dog nag po thams cad du/ /④ba dan rnam pa sna tshogs bsnams⑤/ /⑥gdugs ni rnam pa du ma'i dbyibs/ /kha dog sna tshogs legs 'bar ba/ /bla re rgyas pa mnyam pa ni⑦/ /kha dog nag po sna tshogs pa/ /dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin gyisal/ /mdor bsdus nas ni bsgom par bya/ /dkyil 'khor chen po 'di lta bu/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis ④rjes skyob pa/ /bris nas shes rab can gyis bsgom0/ /gal te dngos grub rang ⑫'dod na'o⑩/ /rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud chen po las rlung lha'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'o// // de nas bcom ldan 'das rnams de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 0kyis slar yang bsdu bas byon pa'i ④ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te⑩/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po la gsol ba btab patshu/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ⑩de kho na nyid kyi sgrub pa'i thabs bskyed 8du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po de rnams kyis gsol ba btab pa'i tshig nye bar gsan nas/ sgrub pa'i thabs kyi ⑩/cho ga mchog tu gsang ba chen po bka' stsal pa/ sgeg mo sogs pas mchod pa kun/ /yang dag mdor bsdus byas nas ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sku 86—73

chen por/ /bdag gis ①rtag tu bsgom par bya/ /sngags kyi yi ge yang dag ldan / /'dod pa ster ba'i sku ru bya/ /sgra dang gzugs dang de bzhin sbyor/ /yi ge'i ⑤phreng ba de bzhin te/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /sngags pas thams cad rnam par bsam/ /rtsu/ sngags pas snying gar ①son pa bsgom④/ /gsang sngags dge ba brjod nas su/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs dag pa/ /dung gi sgra ru rab tu brjod/ /dril bu'i sgra ni rab gsal ba/ /pad mo rnal 'byor dbang phyug go/ /dus min sprin gyi rdu gi sgra/ /tsa ṭa tsa ṭa'i sgra 'phro ba/ /rdo rje rin chen dbang phyug gi⑤/ /sgra ru de bzhin gshegs rnams gsung ⑥/ /nor bu las kyi rigs kyi yang / /rnga chen sgra ru rab tu bshad/ /pi wang gling bu de bzhin glu/ /gar gyi rgyan gyi sgra dang ni/ /rdza rnga'i ngar sgra rgyu gi sgral/ /spyi yi nyid du rab tu bshad/ /rtog pa kun la ⑦rnam par sbyar/ /sgrub pa'i thabs kyi las rnams dang / /de nas gzugs kyi bzlas pa lamachog /go rims 1 ji bzhin rab tu bshad/ /dgug dang gzhug dang bcing ba dang / /lha rnams dbang du bya ba ste/ /de la rang gi tshul rab sbyar/ /sngags dang phyag rgya rab tu sbyar/ /de rjes rnam pa kun gyi mchog /rtag tu lus chen ⑩bsam bya bsam / /lha yi sku gzugs bsgom par bya/ /lag pa'i phyag rgya rab nges pa'i/ /phyag rgya'ang snying gar 37son zhes 12bya/ /rang gi rigs rim cho ga yis/ /de yi lus ni 'od gsal zhing / /sgron ma'i 'od ltar gsal ba'i khyim/ /de ltar kun nas thams cad du/ /kun nas ba spu'i rtse dag nas/ /'od zer 'bar ba'i phreng dge bas3ste/ /gzugs kyi bzlas pa zhes su bshad/ de nas sbyor ba'i bzlas pa nithu/ /gsang sngags sgrub pos lho brtsam par bya/ /mchod dang byin 86—74

brlabs ①dbang bskur mchog / spro la sogs ②rim thams cad du/ /sbyor ba'i bzlas pa gtso bo 'di/ /'bad pa yis ①ni rab tu bshad/ /snying ga dhimagrin pa mchu lce min/ /rkan dang spyi bo nyid ma yin/ /nang min phyi dang gnyis par min/ /chos ni 'ba' zhig dukho na la/ /bzlas pa'i sgra yang 'byung ma yin/ /'di ni bcom ldan rnal 'byor che/ /shes rab pha rol phyin gsal ba/ / bsgom pa'i bsngags ⑥pa de nyid ⑦ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yi gnas su bshad/ /de nas steng du nimador bsdus te/ /snying ga'i khyadakyil 'khor rab skum pa/ /zla ba gang ba ltar bsam bya/ /dri ma med cing legs par gnas/ /de la yi ge rnam par dgod/ /tshig gi phreng ba ma chad pa7/ /mu tig phreng ba ltar brgyus yipa/ /char sprin gyi ni me 'dra'i 'od/ /de tshe thams cad gsal bar byed/ /lha yi lus ni snang byed cing / /ji lta ji ltar 8yi ge'i phreng / /mchog gi lus la rab 'jug pa/ /de lta de ltar sngags kyi lus/ /lha yi bdag nyid nyid du 'gyur/ /mthu stobs lha dbang thams cad ni/ /tshangs pa khyab 'jug las cher 8lhag /bzlas pa 8de nyid mchog 'di ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis tsobasngags pa'o/ /ji ltar ⑩sems ni bsgom pa yisam/ /de ltar 8dngos grub mchog tu 'gyur/ /rdo rje yisnying po rgyan gyi rgyud chen po las bzlas pa'i de kho na nyid kyi le'u'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen pos de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bstod pa rin po che bka' stsal pa/ mnyam med mi g.yo du )mnyam med mchog gi chos nyid can/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel bar mdzad/ /yon tan mtha' yas dngos grub thams cad sbyin 86—75

mdzad pa/ /dri med mi g.yo mnyam med dam pa'i mchog chos can/ /yon tan shin tu phra ba'i cha la'ang tshad med de/ /dpe ni nam mkha' dang yang bsgrun ①du yod ma yin/ /dngos grub mtha' yas mnyam med dpe dang bral ba rnams/ /sems can khams la dngos grub mchog rnams nges par stsol/ /rtag tu dri ma ②med pa ②thugs rje'i shugs las byung / /smon lam grub pa 'gog pa med pa'i chos nyid can④/ /'gro ba'i don sgrub (nyerab tu brtson pa mtha' yas pa/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid rtag tu rnam par snang / /tshad med tshad dang bral ba yishin tu rdzogs pa yi/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i lago 'phang dam pa brnyes gyur kyang ske/ /khams gsum rnams la dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad pa yi/ /thugs rje'i spyod pa mi g.yo 'gag (8)par yong mi 'gyur/ /e ma'o shin tu bzang po'i chos nyid mchog dang ldan/ /mchog sbyin rnams kyi nang na go 'phang mchog brnyes pa / /khams gsum kun la rtag tu dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad/ /mgon po dus gsum sgrib 997pa med pa borab mkhyen pas/ /dam tshig mchog gsum dngos grub dam pa bdag la stsol/tshon/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /yang dag yon tan rgyas pa ste/ /lan cig betsam zhig brjod pas kyang / /gsang sngags thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /bstod pa'i rgyal po 'di yis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs de kun bstod natsho/snye/ /rab yangs dngos grub stsol 'gyur nya te/ /bskal par gnas shing bsgal bar bobaskul/ /lus ni g.yo ba med pa ru/ /bdag nyid brtan par byas pa yis/ /mgon po chen po rnam snang mdzad/ /mi bskyod yirin chen 'byung gnas dang / /rgyal ba dag pa 'od dpag med/ /don grub rgyal po tshathams cad du/ /dngul chu bcud len de nyid dang / /mchog kyang 86—76

rab tu stsol ①bar byed/ /dngos grub yid 'ong ②ma lus pa③/ /rgyas pa'i don dang liphun sum tshogs/ /re ba thams cad yongs rdzogs pa/ /yid la 'dod pa ster bar byed/ /ye shes tshe dang stobs dang shugs/ /mchog tu dge ba stsol ⑤bar mdzad/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bstod pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba :rdob/bsu 1storjo// //de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen pos de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyi cho ga rgyas pa bka' stsal pa/ tshes grangs med cing rgyu skar med/ smyung bar gnas pa'i cho ga med/ ji ltar bshad pa cho gas bslab pa'i gnas nye bar gnas ⑦bzung ste gang yang rung ba'i yid dga' bar ji ltar rung ba'i dkyil 'khor byas tel/ me tog sil ma bkram la bdug spos kyis bdugs tethod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la ji ltar nus pa'i me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa rnams kyis mchod par ⑩byas te/ sngags 'dis yid kyis kyang sdig pa bshags te/ oṃ sab pā pā 7ta kā yi ka bā tsi 8ka ma na sod bhū tān marā ga de ṣa mo ha ma da ñtsamā na adhiṣṭha ⑩na yang kṛ rta 'o tan tre kā 5geli kai hūṃ hūṃ rgyu phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa sabra pā rpā pho)sbo ṭa yā mi gā hā/ oṃ sarba pā rpā pra ri — )ti de sha yā mi swā hā/ de'i rjes thogs la bdag nyid kyi ( dronyedangos po dbul bar bya ste/oṃ sab ta thā ga tā du gyenān ādma dzo sabhā tsunab ni ra yā ta yā 4 nami/ sasba ta thā ga taḥrurupra ti groṇḍa tu māṃ du swā hā/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bsod nams la rjes su yi rang ba ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu rgya tshwa na si bhā rān ( shes nu mo da yā mi swā hā/ yang dang yang du byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa rang bzhin gyis 86—77

grub pa'i sngags kyis bya ste/ oṃ sabra ta thā ga ta sa manta bha dra ma hā badzra sa ma yaṃ ma hā bo dhi tsista u'i ①da yā mi ṭwā hā/② de nas byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa'i rjes thogs la zla ba'i kha dog can zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa'i bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs pa sa bcu'i dbang phyug nor bu rin po che chen po'i pad ma'i snying po seng ge'i khri'i steng du bdag nyid bsam par bya'o / /oṃ bud dho rta / sngags 'dis bdag yongs su dag par byas ④te/oṃ swa bhā ba shursāḥlasarba ta thā ga tāḥ swa bhā ba shurnyo3lha0/ sngags 'dis bdag nyid chos kyi dbyings yangs pa 'od gsal ba'i snang bar shin tu gnas par bya ste/oṃ dharma medma tu swa bhā ba ②uttha ②ko3rta0/ de nas skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu ⑪rtsa gnyis kyis brgyan par bdag nyid byin gyis brlabs te'u/ 'jig rten thams cad las shin tu 'das pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi skur bdag nyid sngags 'dis gnas par bya ste/ oṃ pra bho shwa ro rtati/ de bzhin du rim pa 'dis chos kyi dbyings rgya chen por spros nas bdag nyid sangs rgyas nyid do/ /zhes nga rgyal bskyed la bdag skye dgu tsom lus pa'i dpung gnyen du byas la/ chos kyi dbyings yangs pa cha'od gsal bar lhag par tshuganas par bya ste / nye bar rgyas par thun mtshams bzhir bzlas pa brtsam 8par bya ste/ thun mtshams gsum du dus ji lta bar 47yi ge la rjes su gzhol ba'i yid kyis 'bum phrag nyi shu bzlas par ‘ nyabya zhing nyi ma re rer stong phrag brgyad dam 0stong phrag re bzlas te ji srid mtshan ma thob pa de srid du'o/ /tsandan dang ga pur dang ske/ gur kum hūṃ nyal sogs pa rnams kyis dkyil 'khor byas te/ nye bar mkho ba thams cad kyis mchod pa byas nas ni cho 'phrul gyi zla ba'am sa ga'i nya gang ba 86—78

la ①mar gyi mar me stong phrag brgyad sbar la rdo rje skyil krung gis ②gnas te sna ①ma'i me tog gam dume tog padmas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / mchod rten la ⑤mchod de ji srid 'brug gi 0sgra sgrogs ⑦pa ma thos pa de srid du bzlas par ⑧bya'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku bdag la ⑨gsal bar 'gyur bar shes par ⑩bya'o/ /de nas sreg 0blugs 'bum phrag gcig 8dgang bar byas pas mtshan tsom thams cad gsal bar 'gyur ro/ /bye ba phrag bzhi bzlas pas dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro/ /de nas sgrub pa chen po byed par 'dod pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtho gang ba'i tshad kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten ④byas la mchod rten re re'i mdun du 8stong phrag re re bzlas pa'am/ yang na dri'i mchod rten gyi drung du 'bum lhag pa'i bye ba phrag bdun bzlas sotso/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i mtho gang pa'i tshad kyi ⑩mchod rten nyi tsom re re la re re ji srid bye ba phrag bdun bzlas pa rdzogs pa de srid du bya'o/ /tha ma yang lho mchod rten 'bar ba'i 'od des sgrub pa'i lus la zhugs pas brgya 0byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba la sogs nas ji srid dag pa'i gnas kyi shurnyedabang phyug chen po la sogs pa'i lha rnams me tog gi char 'bebs par 'ong bar ( nye'agyur ro/ /lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci la sogs pa 'ongs nas kyang stod ri nyepar byed cing ji srid a bī butsi mnar med pa'i bar gyi sems can dmyal ba thams cad bsil bar 'gyur ro/ /yi dgas tsornams kyang yi dgas ri nyekyi sdug bsngal las rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro/ /sdug bsngal ba rnams kyis sems can rnams la gdung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas de 86—79

bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mngon par gzigs par 'gyur ro/ /de'i rjes la lus dang ba gser gyi mdog lta bu dang / lo brgyad gnyis kyi rnam pa can dang ske/ ting nge 'dzin dang / ye shes thob pa dang / kha dog dang / tshe dang /stobs dang / shugs dang / dbang phyug la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa dang ske/ 'jig rten gyi khams su rgyu ba dang / 'khor los sgyur ①ba ltar che ba dang ske/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis mngon par bstod cing steng du 'gro ba dang /rig pa 'dzin pa'i rgyal por 'gyur ba dang / stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rig pa 'dzin pa'i rgyal po rig pa ②'dzin pa bye ba phrag ③brgya stong ④du mas yongs su bskor ba dang / lha'i bu mo bye ba phrag du mas yongs su bskor ba dang /tshan phyogs bcu mtha' yas pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams su ⑥rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod pa chen po'i sprin gyis 0legs par mchod cing grub pa thams cad 'od kyis cing ⑧bar 'gyur ro/ /brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba'i stan phyed ster bar 'gyur ro/ /gzi brjid dang gzugs dang dpa' bas ⑨rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad zil gyis gnon par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa yang so sor thob par 'gyur ro/ /sems can thams cad 'dul ba la mkhas par 'gyur ro/ /phyi ma'i mthar tshe byin gyis brlabs te⑩/ sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa lho mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bya ba nges par ston par 'gyur ro/ /mchod pa'i sprin thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur ro / /byang chub sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po dang / byams pa dang /'jam dpal dang mtshungs par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 86—80

sku'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba ste dang po'o// //sgrub pa'i thabs gnyis pa ni ①de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mchod par bya ste/ gi duwang ngam ldong ros padma'i snod ③du gzhag dul ji srid dngos grub rnam pa gsum byung ba de srid du bzlas par ⑤bya'o/ /sems can thams cad dbang du 'gyur ba dang / mi snang ba dang / rig pa thams cad 'dzin par 'gyur ba yinyid do/ /rig pa 'dzin par gyur nas nyi ma stong shar ba'i kha dog dang ske/ lo brgyad gnyis kyi rnam par spa li zhing 'khyil ba dang / gdu bu ⑦dang ldan zhing lha'i bu mo bye ba phrag du mas yongs su bskor cing rig pa 'dzin pa'i grub pa thams cad kyis yongs su bskor ba dang / bskal pa chen po'i mthar gnas pa dang / rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyi dbang phyug tu 'gyur ro/ /rim pa 'dis rtse gsum bsgrubs na dbang phyug chen por 'gyur ro/ /mchod phyir thogs bsgrubs na tshangs par 'gyur ro/ /'khor los khyab 'jug tu 'gyur ro/ /grog mkhar gyi rtse mo'i sa bzung ⑧ste sa srungs kyi labu byas la de la zhon te bzlas na dbang por 'gyur ro/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor byas te de'i steng du bsdad na nyi yidang mtshungs par 'gyur ro/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi zla ba'i ste ⑩'di nyid kyis lha'i bye brag gang gi hunyamatshan ma 8bzung ste/ des de'i longs spyod la spyod par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du rim pa 'dis dngul chu'am bcud len gang bsgrubs pa de 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /gal te ma grub na de'i tshe sgrub pa lan bdun bya'o/ /bdun byas pas ci nas kyang 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /zhes de bzhin gshegs pa / thams cad kyi 'khor los sgyur 0zhebs bka' stsal pa/86—81

'bum phrag gsum bzlas pas ri ①lhun po'i tshad tsam gyi ri bo yang hūṃ zhes brjod pas ltung ②ba dang / rgya mtsho skems ①pa dang / ljon pa drungs dunas 'byin pa dang ske/ bum pa nam mkha' la 'phen pa dang / glang po che rengs par byed pa dang ske/ pha rol gyi sde mngon par 'joms par byed pa dang / bar snang na gnas pa thams cad ltung bar byed do⑤/ /sems can thams cad 'bebs par byed do/ /sgrub pa po las gang dang gang sgrub ⑥par 'dod pa de dang de thams cad byed do/ /yang ༅zla ba gcig tsam mi smra bar de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi skur bdag nyid bsgoms na sangs rgyas thams cad mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba thams cad ston par 'gyur ro/ /nam mkha' la gnas shing 'chag par byed do/ /me 'bar ba dang / glog 'gyu ba nil sogs pa ston par byed do/ /gcig tu gyur nas mang por 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten gyi khams stong phrag kyang g.yo bar byed do/ /sgrub pa pos bye ba shibadun bzlas nas 'di dag thams cad bsgrub par bya'o/ /rim pa 'dis lhung bzed dang / chos gos dang ske/ snam sbyar tshadang / 'khar gsil snyi/las gang yang rung ba bzung nas ji srid rig pa 'dzin par gyur pa de srid du bzlas par tsha/nyebya'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du 'gro ba dang / sprul pa du ma byed pa dang / 'dod na 'chi ba dang / skad cig tsam gyis 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du 'gro zhing de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis (nyanye bar gnas par byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi gzugs kyis sangs rgyas kyi bya ba thams cad kyang byed do/ /sgrub pa'i thabs gzhan yang bde bar gshegs pa'i mtho'i tshad kyi mchod rten 'bum phrag gcig byas te rma med pa'i ral gri blangs la/ cho 'phrul gyi zla ba phyed la nye bar spyod pa 86—82

thams cad kyis mchod de brgyad pa'am bcu bzhi pa'am nya gang ba la skyil krung ①bcas te ji srid du ral gri 'bar ba de srid du bzla bar bya'o/ /de'i rjes thogs nyid la rnga bo che rnams kyi sgra grag go/ /steng nas me tog gi char 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /lhan cig ②pa ji snyed pa dang bcas pa steng du 'gro'o/ /rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyis mchod par 'gyur ro/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i rgyal po chen por 'gyur ro/ /ral gri'i rig pa 'dzin pa chen po'i 'khor los sgyur ③ba rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i cha lugs ④dang rgyan 'chang ba 'dod dgu ⑤rgyu ba dang ⑥/skad cig tsam gyis 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du rnam par spyod pa medang /rga shi med pa dang / nyi ma re re zhing sangs rgyas kyi bdag nyid che ba mthong ba dang ske/ mchod pa'i sprin thams cad kyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du mchod pa'i char 'bebs pa dang / bskal pa chen po stong phrag tu 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas sgrub pa'i thabs gzhan yang 'khor lo'am pa ṭi sa blangs te 'bum phrag nyi shu bzlas pa yongs su rdzogs pa dang dpal gyi sgor song ste/ nim pa'i lo ma tsha ba'i mar khu la btags ⑧pa 'bum phrag gcig sreg 0blugs bya'o/ /lha ma yin gyi 'khrul 'khor thams cad 'byed par 'gyur ro/ /lha ma yin gyi bu mo thams cad 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te ma grub na 'bum phrag gnyis sam gsum du sreg ⑩blugs bya'o/ /lha ma yin gyi bu mo thams cad bsregs bzhin du 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /'ongs nas kyang sgrub pa po la zhu bar byed de/ kye skyes bu dpa' bo 'jug tu gsol zhes smra'o/ /de nas grogs dang bcas pa 0'jug par bya'o/ /ral gri'am 'khor lo de bzung dhinas lha ma yin gyi rig pa 'dzin pa'i rgyal por 'gyur ro'i/ /sa 'og gi rdzas rnams kyi mnga' bdag lha ma yin gyi bu mo thams cad kyi 86—83

bdag po/ gsang sngags grub pa gzhan thams cad dang / lha ma yin gyi rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyi dbang phyug sa 'og thams cad kyi bdag po lha ma yin chen po'i sprul pa byed pa po bskal pa chen por gnas pa/ khyab 'jug gi 'khor lo hūṃ zhes bya ba ①brjod pa tsam gyis rlag ②par byed pa/ khyab 'jug kyang rtsu zhes brjod ④pa tsam gyis rlag ④par byed na gzhan lta smos ④kyang ci ⑥dgos/ sgrub pa'i thabs gzhan yang bde bar gshegs pa'i mchod rten 'bum phrag sum cu ⑦byas te mchod rten re re'i mdun du stong phrag brgyad brgyad bzla bar bya'o/ /thams cad la nye bar spyod pa thams cad kyis mchod la tha mar me tog can gyi lcags las byung ba'i la'akhor lo rtsibs drug pa mtho gang tsam pa bzung nas 0cho 'phrul gyi zla ba phyed pa la tshe skyil mo krung bcings 7te/ ji srid 'bar ba 8de srid du bzlas par lte bya'o/ /de blangs ④pas rig pa 'dzin pa'i 'khor los sgyur ⑫bar 'gyur ro/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i rgyal po thams cad kyi mnga' bdag dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa'i lha thams cad 'dul bar byed pa/ bskal pa bye ba brgya stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgur 'tsho ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams stong rdzu 'phrul gyis gnon pa dang / mchod pa'i sprin brgya stong phrag gis mchod par byed pa dang / sangs rgyas stong phrag mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de rnams la nyi ma re re zhing mchod pa chen po'i sprin gyis mchod par byed do/ /sgrub pa'i thabs rgyas pa gzhan yang mchod rten 'bum phrag drug cu 7byas te/ sngon du bsnyen pa byas la bye ba bzlas cipa'otshe/ /de nas mtshan nyid thams cad 'dang ldan pa'i ro blangs 17la khrus byas nas nye bar mkho ba thams cad kyis mchod de ji srid lku )ma langs pa de srid du bzla bar 21bya'o/ /langs nas dngul chu dang bcud len dang mi snang ba 86—84

la sogs pa thams cad de la ①ster bar byed do/ /gal te mi ster na ji srid kha las lce ma byung ba de srid du bzla bar bya'o/ /de nas mtshon rnon pos de gcad ②par bya'o/ /de gzung ③bas nyi ma stong gi gzi brjid ④can rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyi rgyal po rig pa 'dzin pa bye ba stong phrag drug cu'i ⑤'khor can/tshe bskal pa bye ba brgya stong phrag drug cu du'atsho ba/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba dang / ri bo lhun po bye ba phrag stong sgul ba dang /gling stong phrag 'phen pa dang / rgya mtsho stong phrag skems ⑦pa dang / lha'i 'jig rten brgya stong phrag bsdigs pa dang / tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang /dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa rnams lhung ba dang / spa li zhing 'khyil pa dang /lo brgyad gnyis ⑧pa'i rnam pa dang / rgyan thams cad kyis ⑨rnam par brgyan pa ste / sreg hu )pa'i bskal pa na 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan du 'gro zhing rga ba dang / 'chi ba 7med par 'gyur zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen pos de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de bzhin du yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang /dpag bsam gyi shing dang / bum pa bzang po dang / nor gyi char pa dang /nam mkha'i chamadzod kyi ting nge 8'dzin chen po dang / rin po che chen po'i lag pa dang / nor rgyun gyi rtog pa chen po dang / sems can gyi re ba thams cad rjes su 'gengs pa dang / 'khor los sgyur ④ba'i rgyal srid tsodang / rin po che thams cad kyang bsgrub ⑩par bya'o/ /de la 'di lta ste/ 'khor lo rin po che dang ske/ glang po rin po che dang / rta rin po che dang /4) nor bu rin po che dang ske/ bud med rin po che dang / khyim bdag rin po che dang /tso bsnyen bkur ba rin po che'o/ /de nas sgrub pa'i thabs gzhan yang tsandan tsodakar po 86—85

las padma sor drug pa'i tshad byas la ①padma de lag par rbezung ②nas zla ba drug tu skyil krung bcings ①te nye bar spyod pa thams cad kyis mchod nas thun mtshams gsum mam 0bzhir grangs mi gzung ⑤bar bzlas par ⑥bya'o/ /zla ba drug yongs su rdzogs pa dang padma 'bum phrag bdun sreg ②blugs bya'o/ /zla ba nya nas bsgrub ⑧pa brtsam par bya ste/ nye bar spyod pa thams cad kyis mchod la skyil krung ⑨bcas nas mtshan thog thag bzlas par ⑩bya'o/ /tho rangs kyi tshe rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /skra li zhing 'khyil ba dang / lo brgyad gnyis kyi rnam par rgyan gyi tshogs thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ nyi ma stong phrag shar ba'i 'od dang mtshungs pa/ rig pa 'dzin pa bye ba phrag du ma'i 'khor can/ lha'i bu mo bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mas yongs su bskor ba/ tshangs pa la sogs pa'i lha rnams mngag gzhug par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du skad cig tsam gyis rnam par rgyu ba dang / mchod pa'i sprin du mas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams rnam par 3stomachod par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du utpa la'i sgrub pa dang /tsandan dmar po'i mapadma'i sgrub pa yang ngo / /sgrub pa gzhan yang 'byung ste/⑫shel dang / padma rā ga'amaci/ mu tig gi 'bras bu'am/ rin po che yongs su rtog 8par byed pa pos yongs su brtags pa la ⑩bde bar gshegs pa'i mtho'i tshad tsam pa'i mchod rten 'bum tsam byas te/ gang yang rung bar 6)grangs mi gzung 32bar ji srid bdag yongs su dag par mthong ba de srid du bzlas par ()bya'o/ /de'i rjes su mngar gsum gyis sbags pa'i padma 'bum dang / sna ma'i me tog 'bum phrag gsum dang / a ga dzo nyaru'i yam shing 'bum dang / tsandan gyi yam shing 'bum phrag gsum dang / til dang 'bras 'bum phrag bzhi dang / zho 86—86

zan 'bum dang / mar gyi sreg blugs ②stong phrag gsum dang / sman thams cad pa'i sreg blugs ②'bum phrag gcig byas la sbyin sreg ②yongs su rdzogs 0pa dang / dkar po'i tshes bcwa ⑤lnga la bsgrub par bya'o/ / skyil mo krung ⑥bcas te gnye bar spyod pa thams cad kyis mchod la ji srid nor bu rin po che 'bar ba de srid du bzlas par ⑧bya'o/ /'bar nas kyang rig pa 'dzin pa gzhon nu gdong 0du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /skra li zhing 'khyil pa dang / lo brgyad gnyis kyi rnam pa ⑩rgyan thams cad ⑩kyis brgyan pa phyogs bcu mu med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgyas par gsal bar byed pa rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyi slar tunye'akhor los sgyur 0ba chen por 'gyur ro/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i dngos grub byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i rig pa 'dzin pa zhes brjod do/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod cing bsnyen bkur ④bar byed do/ /skad cig tsam la 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi sems can bskor nas slar de nyid du 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te 'dod na byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs mngon par rdzogs par byas te lus de nyid kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i tsobyang chub par mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du sgrub thabs kyi le'u la bris sku dang / shing lham dang / mu tig gi phreng ba yang yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i cho gas bsgrub par bya'o/ /thams cad du 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /sgrub pa'i thabs gzhan yang mchod rten bye ba phrag stong byas te 'bum phrag bdun bzla bar bya'o/ /yongs su rdzogs pa dang me tog can gyi lcags sam/ lcags lnga'i rang 7bzhin gyi rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa sor bcu'i tshad dam/ bde bar gshegs pa'i mtho'i tshad tsam 4)cho 'phrul gyi zla ba phyed la mtshan thog yinathag lag pas rdo rje de bzung 86—87

nas mdun du 0khri'i steng du lag pa bkab la ji srid 'bar ②bar gyur pa de srid du bzla bar bya'o/ /de bzung zhunas rdo rje'i rig pa 'dzin pa 'khor los sgyur rjob chen po nyi ma bye ba brgya phrag dang rjes su 'tsham pa rdo rje 'chang ba ltar gzi brjid dang ldan zhing 'od gsal bar 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du rnam par rgyu zhing dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa'i lha rnams la ci bsgo ba nyan par 'gyur / lha ma yin rnams skrag pa dang / srin po rnams 'joms pa dang /sems can thams cad de'i ci bsgo ba byed par 'gyur bar bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ⑤'khor los sgyur ⑥ba chen pos ⑦de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud chen po las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdzas kyi bya ba sgrub (nyepa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs kyi khyale'u yongs su rdzogs sto'i// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnams thams cad 7slar yang ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag bla ste/ bcom ldan 'das thog ma dang tha ma med pa rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po la gsol ba btab pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang tunyeb chen po ka kṣa sbyar ba ste/mtha' yas pa kha sbyar ba zhes bya ba bka' stsal du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba chen po gsang sngags kyi ④ka kṣa pu ṭa bka' stsal pa/ de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi zhunyerjes su skyob/ /gsang sngags ka kṣa sbyar zhes bya/ /gsang chen mchog tu rmad du byung ske/ /gru bzhi pa la tshad mdzes pa/ /kun nas yongs su bzang zhing dag /86—88

re mig bzhi bcu zhe dgu pa/ /mdor ①bsdus nas ni sngags pas bya/ /dang po'i phreng bzang gnyis la ni/ /a sogs blo gros ldan pas dgod/ /ka sogs lhag ma'i re'u ②mig la/ /sngags pas mdo ru bsdus te bri/ /sbyor ba ji bzhin yi ge kun/ /go rims ①bzhin du dgod par bya/ /re'u 0mig stong pa dag la ni / /kṣa yig dang ni rdo rje bri/ /rim pa 'di rjodag bkod nas ni/ /rang sde'i 'og tu 'bar ⑥ba mchog /dang po dbyangs la de'i rjes su/ /yi ge phyag rgya mdor bsdus pa/ /ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya shasti /dag cing chu yi dkyil 'khor ldan/ /'di rnams myur du 'grub par byed/ /padma'i rigs kyi lha ⑧nyid do/ /don kun grub par yang dag ldan/ /me yi dkyil 'khor zhes su bshad/ /'bar ba'i me dang ⑨mtshungs pa'i 'od/ /kha tsha ṭha tha pha ra ṣa0/ /dbang chen gyi ni dkyil 'khor ldan/ /ga dza ḍa nyunyed ba la sa(/3/ /dngos grub kun byed rlung gzugs ldan/ /dbyar gyi sprin ltar shin tu 'jigs/ /gha dzha nye dha bha wa ha7/ /steng 'gros dngos grub byed por 8brjod/ /slar yang nga nya ṇa na ma/ /chos kun dbang du byed pa skemachog /thog ma'i dbyangs yig gang yin pa/ /de ni ⑩de bzhin gshegs stobs bcu/ /khyad par yan lag bcu gnyis bshad/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa ⑩bcu gnyis/ /ma ning yi ge bzhi po spong / / ṛ rī lo lī 8zhes bya ba/ /dbyangs dang sa bon de bzhin sngags/ /de dag yi ge ru yang bshad/ /dbang du byed pa'i sde tshan kun/ /thig le sgra gtsug zla phyed ces/ / rjes dbyangs kyi 47ni phreng zhes bshad/ /sangs rgyas de bzhin byang sems kyiku )/ /yi ger brjod pa de bzhin zhing / /gsal byed ces kyis gsal ba'o/ /de bzhin ya ra la wa ( —1rlung / /me dang dbang chen chu dag ( naste/ /'byung ba chen po ( no86—89

khams rnams so/ /rlung me bdud rtsi'i bcud ces bshad/ /mnyam dang mi mnyam cha dbye bas/ /thams cad nyid kyi lam shes ①bya/ /phyag rgya dang ni dkyil 'khor sngags/ /ting 'dzin mdor bsdus bshad pa'o/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal stong bdag med/ /chos rnams kun gyi sdom du brjodal/ /stong pa mtshan med smon med pa/ /rnam par thar pa gsum du bshad/ /phung po khams dang skye mched rnams/ /mkhas pa yis ni shes par bya/ /da ①ni sngags kyi ka kṣa'i sbyor ba la④/ rab tu btus pa sbyar ba dang phral ⑤ba bshad par bya'o/ /yi ge rnams kyis byang chub spyod6)/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyang mya ngan 'das/ /lhan cig nyid du sbyar bar bya/ /dbyangs rnams yig rnams bsdus par ⑦bshad/ /mtshan nyid kyang ni rab bshad bya/ /dbyangs ni byang chub gzugs nyid de/ /gzhan dang lhan cig sbyar bar bya/ /de la nges par sangs rgyas nyid/ /ster ba nyid du legs par bshad/ /thog mar sangs rgyas thams cad kyil/ /gsang sngags dri ma med pa 'byung / /thog mar dbyangs ni thig le 7ldan/ /rdo rje'i steng du yang dag gnas/ /'bar ba'i phreng can rab zhi ba/ /rnam par 'phro ba nyid du gnas / /zla ba'i dbus su bsgom bya ba/ /kun gyi ye shes 'od chen pokyi/ /kun du 'gro ba rab tu thob/ /thams cad du yang rnyed par dka'4te/ /de nyid bral ba lhonyartag pa ste1ste/ /yi ge med cing dbyer med pa/ /byang chub sems zhes rab tu bshad/ /dung dang kunda zla ltar dag /gnyis pa'i sgra dang yang dag ldan / /de ni shin tu ring por shes/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi spyod pa ste/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa rnams/ / dro ba'i bzhi pa sbyar ba mini/ /mya ngan 'das pa zhes su bsgrags/ /dbyangs dang yi ge khyad par 7can/ byu/mtshan nyid rab tu sbyar 86—90

bar bya/ /rang gi phyag rgya sogs ldan pas①/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab stsol ②byed / /da ③ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sngags kyi de nyid 'dir bshad bya/ /thog mar spyod pa dubyas nas ni/ /gnyis pa smra ba po ru bshad/ / bzhi pa'i ⑤dbyangs kyis kun nas mnan/ /gsum pa me yi duming can no⑦/ /rgyud ⑧med pas te cung zad pa/ /bzhi pa yis ni gsal bar byas/ /drug pa'i sgra dang tha dad min⑨/ /de yi steng du thig le gnas/ /chos kun nam mkha' dang mtshungs par/ /yang dang yang du bshad pa yin/ /de ni lnga par shes par bya/ /yi ge lnga pa stobs po che/ /yi ge lnga yi 0stobs lnga'i bdag nyid las skyes gtso/ /mthu stobs chen po khyab bdag srid pa'i bdag nyid skyes/ /mthu stobs chen po srid gsum las rab grol byed payi/ /yi ge lnga ni 'gro ba drug las grol ba'i bdag /mngon shes drug kyang rab tu ster byed dri ma 8med/ /de nyid bcom ldan spyod pa ste/ /mi bskyod pa zhes rab tu grags/ /byang sems rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ /bstan 0pa'i sems dpa' tsorang 8byung ba/ /chos kun gyi ni de bzhin nyid/ /gang bsgrags de nyid 8thams cad du/ / 'bar ba 7me yi sa bon tsoldan // /spyod ⑥pa yi ni steng du gnas/ /de nyid bcom ldan rnal 'byor ni/ /rin chen 'byung ldan zhes su ba shad/ /chos rnams kun gyi (nyebyed pa ni/ /med pa nyid du'ang bshad pa'o/ /me yi sa bon yang dag ldan/ /bzhi pa'i dbyangs kyis tsospyi bo ru/ /mnan pa rgyal ba 'od dpag med/ /de nyid bcom ldan rnal 'byor ni//sna tshogs de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /drug pa'i dbyangs dang yang dag ldan/ /don yod pa yi snying por gragasanige/ /sde lnga pa yi bzhi ④pa ni/ /dngos dang dngos med rab rtogs byed/ / 'bar ba me yi sa bon gyisari snye/ /'khor lo'i 86—91

dbus su rab tu gnas/ /drug pa'i dbyangs dang yang dag ldan/ /thig le sgra yis rnam ①par spras/ /'khor los sgyur ②ba ye shes che/ /rnam par rgyas pa'i ③nor ster byed/ /gang zhig sde lnga pa yi mtha'/ /sgyu ma'i chos la rab tu gnas/ /de nyid bcom ldan rnal 'byor ni/ /gdugs dkar zhes su bshad pa'o/ /brgyad pa'i dbyangs dang yang dag ldan/ /byams pa zhes ni grags pa ste/ /de nyid bcom ldan rnal 'byor ni/ /spyi bor thig le ④mnan pa'o/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs dang ye shes che/ /mā ma tī ⑤ru de bsgrags so/ /lnga pa'i yidabyangs dang yang dag ldan/ /'jam pa'i dpal (7zhes rab tu grags/ /spyod pa'i gar mkhan rab rtogs ming / /sdig pa thams cad rengs byed de/ / sdig kun rnam par sbyong byed pa/ /rnam par sel ba rnam shes bya2/ /sde tshan lnga pa'i gsum pa ni / /phyag na rdo rje stobs chen dang / /gshin rje mthar byed khro bo che/ /yi ge gsum ni stobs chen po/ /thog mar dgu pa yi ni dbyangs/ /de yi dbus su spyod pa gzhag1) /tha mar sna tshogs zhes bya sbyar/ /sku gsum du ni rnam par bsgoma'i / /tha ma'i sde tshan gsum pa ni/ /gang yin kun tu bzang por bshad/ /sde tshan dang po'i gsum pa ni/ /sangs rgyas spyan zhes bya ba'o'onya/ /de nyid ⑫bcom ldan mgon po ni/ /nam mkha'i mdzod ces rab tu grags/ /rdo rje khro bo stobs po che/ /de nyid rab tu grags pa'o/ /'di kun thams cad stong pa ste/ /rgyu ni rab tu spangs pa'o/ /dbyangs lnga dang ni yang dag ldan/ /rdo rje hūṃ mdzad rtsu mdzad do/ /gang zhig bzhi pa'i sde dang polho / /me yis charab tu gsal bar byasaska / /bzhi pa'i dbyangs dang yang dag ldan/ /gzi brjid phung po stobs po che / /de nyid gang dang ma sbyar ba/ /sgrol ma zhes su rab tu grags/ /bzhi pa 86—92

yi ni gnyis pa gang / /shes rab pha rol phyin par nges/ /thig le lhan cig yang dag ldan/ /sgra dang ldan pa'i mchog tu gyur/ /sde tshan gnyis pa'i gsum pa gang / /me nyid dang ni yang dag ldan/ /bzhi pa'i dbyangs kyis ①yang dag mnan / /khams gsum rnam par rgyal pa'i mchog /de nyid bcom ldan shes bya ba②ske/ /spyod pa'i gar mkhan zhes bya'i mtshan/ /de yi rjes nyid la ni me/ /dgu pa'i dbyangs dang yang dag ldan/ / me dang dbang chen du brjod bya/ /③gsum pa'i dbyangs kyis mnan pa yi/ /sde tshan dang po'i dang po'i yig④ /de nyid bcom ldan mgon po ni/ /'jig rten mgon po thub pa che/ /ye shes rgya che bsgrub par bya/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab gsol (gebyed/ /sde tshan 0lnga pa ⑦rin chen mchog /bzhi pa'i sa bon dam pa dedu/ /'og tu me yi yan lag 'bar⑨ske/ /khro gnyer can zhes rab tu grags0/ /dbang chen yi ge dag pa la/ /thig le sgra yis hunyernam par brgyanas/ /sangs rgyas spyan zhes rnam grags pa/ /sdig pa thams cad 'phrog par byed/ /sde tshan dang po'i gsum pa ni/ /nam mkha'i spyan zhes brjod pa'o/ /sgyu ma'i chos la rab gnas nas/ /gsod 4)pa'i don du rab gsol byed8/ /mā ma khri zhes bya ba'i ming / /rig pa mchog tu gsang ba ste/ /rgyu mi dmigs pa'i chos rnams kyis/ /dri ma med pa stsol bar tsobyed / /gnyis pa'i dbyangs dang yang dag ldan/ /'phags pa mi g.yo ba zhes bya / /dbang chen sa bon yang dag ldan/ /'gro ba'i rdo rje rengs byed na/ /gdug sems yigazhan kun lta ci /nyesmos/17 /rlung gi dkyil 'khor sbyar byas pa/ /rang gi sa bon gnas shing 'phro/ /'gro ba thams cad skyod byed na/ /gdug sems can gzhan si )smos ci dgos/ /de nyid me dang ldan pas nisan/ /dbang 86—93

dang dgug ①pa'i las rnams dang / /bgegs dang dgra rnams zhi ba ni/ /khyad par mi g.yo ba yis byed/ /don dam bden pa'i byin gyis brlabs/ /rnam ②snang mdzad bya ②gnas las 'byung ④/ /gzhan gyi dmag dpung 'joms pa ni/ / rgyu ni me yis gsal byas pa⑤/ /drug pa'i dbyangs dang yang dag ldan/ /thig le sgra yis rnam par brgyan⑥/ / 'gro ba thams cad 'gugs par byed/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyis drangs pasal/ /ti se man dā dur la sogs/ /de yi 0phye mar rlog ⑩par nges/ /rdo rje la gnas 'khor lo yi/ /dbus gnas ⑩'gro kun rengs par byed/ /gnas nas bskyod par byed 8pa yis/ /'byung po rnams ni dbang du byed/ /rtag pa'i gzugs su gnas nas ni/ /mi g.yo ba yi snying gar ⑫son / /chos kyi dbyings mtshungs thob nas ni/ /bdag gi bdag nyid bsgom par bya/ /rlung gi sa bon rin po che/ /spyod pa'i steng du yang dag ldan/ /me las byung ba med ④la gnas/ /'gro ba thams cad 'bebs par byed/ /sde tshan dang po'i dang po gang / /sa yi yi ge steng du gnas8/ /sde tshan lnga pa'i tha ma ni//drug pa'i sgra yi steng du gnas/ /'og tu me yi sa bon ldan/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ste / /sa gsum thams cad 'bar bar byed/ /me yi phyogs su gnas nas ni/ /phyag rgya'i bdag nyid thams cad bsgom0/ /rlung lha me lha yang dag sbyor/ /rgyu ni byed pa mtshungs pa'o/ /rnam par snang mdzad ye shes che/ /de nyid kho na bsgrub par bya/ /dbang chen me ni sbyor ba las/ /'khor los sgyur lhonyeba'i go 'phang gnas/ /ye shes rgya chen bsgrub par bya/ /yang na phun sum tshogs pa'i don/ /rig pa 'dzin dang sangs rgyas nyid/ /rnal 'byor ye shes phun sum tshogs/ /skye ba 'di la 17'grub 'gyur te/ /'di la the tsom 6)mi bya'o/ /86wa 94

dbyangs dang yi ge thams cad la/ /sbyor ba'i dbye bas ①rnam par dbyel/ /tshig dang ngag gi ②tshad rnams dang / /ting nge 'dzin dang sngags 'byung bdu/ /slob dpon man ngag las ⑤shes byarjo/ /gzhan du bya ba ma yin no/ /rdo rje snying po'i ⑦rgyan ces bya ba'i rgyud chen po las rdo rje ka kṣa'i sbyor ba mdor bsdus te bstan pa ste rgyas par slob dpon gyis mngon par spyad ⑧par bya'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das rnams slar yang 'dus par gyur pas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po ⑨la gsung 0gi dkyil 'khor gsol ba btab bo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis yigasol ba btab pa'i tshig gi rjes nyid la/ 'brug gi sgra mtha' yas pa'i legs par bsgrags pa/ nam mkha'i mdzod kun nas rdo rje rgya che ba tshangs pa chen po'i sgra yongs su rdzogs pa'i don dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung gi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor so sor yongs su rtogs pa'i don du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung grub pa zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po bka' stsal pa/de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /gsung gi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor che/ /skum po kun nas bzang po ste/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor lta bur gnas/ /de yi steng du pad chen po/ /'dab tsom brgyad la ge sar can/ /de yi lte ba'i dbus su ni/ /yi ge mchog gi go 'phang nyid/ /bdag gi dngos grub bsgom par bya/ /ngag gi dbang phyug 'od chen po/ /snying gar ⑩zla ba der 8padma/ /de yi steng du dung brtag bya/ /dung gi dbus su lce yin te/ /rdo rje'i rang bzhin dge ba'o/ /de yi steng du rin chen pad/ /yang na sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan yang tso/ /'bar 86—95

zhing rkan gyi mthar khyab pa/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun ni rab 'bab pa ba yi ①yi ge spyi tshugs pa/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni steng du gnas/ /bdud rtsi'i thigs ②pa 'dzag pa ni/ /go rims ①bzhin du bsam par bya/ /zla ba phyed dang zla ba gsum④ / /zla ba bzhi'am zla ba nyidal/ /zla ba brgyad du rab mchog bsgoms⑥/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po bsgrub par bya/ / skyil krung gis ⑦ni nyer gnas te/ /dang po'i sbyor ba'i dbang phyug skyes/ /chos kyi dbyings ni mtha' dag tu/ /thams cad du ni yongs su gang / /sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan bsgom par bya/ /chos dbyings mnyam dang mi mnyam pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rjes skyob pa'i/ /ji snyed rig pa thams cad ni/ /lus dang ngag dang yid rnams kyil/ /phyag rgya de rnams bdag nyid mchog /de rnams thams cad bdag nyid kyil/ /lus kyi dkyil 'khor 7la 'jug bsam/ /dung gi sgra ni gsal ba bsam/ /padma'i khams la yang dag rten7/ /padma'i ge sar thig le las/ /sgra yi rang bzhin rdul phran rnams/ /mgrin par son nas sgra gyur te/ /sgra ni dbyangs nyid lhag pa'osal/ /slar yang lce ru son pa dang / /yi ge mchog tu dge ba'o/ /lce yi yi ge cher 'bar ba/ /gcig nas gcig zhu tu rdo rje'i tshul/ /kun nas rab tu 'od gsal ba/ /rdo rje'i ngag ni dam pa'i don/ /sgra yis nam mkha' 8kun gang b.rasnyi/ /sgrub pos mdo ru bsdus te bzla/ /de bzhin du ni snying gar sgra'amatsha / /lce la 'od zer nges 'phros nas/ /mchu'am so las rab bkra ba'i/ /gal te 'od zer mthong na ni/ /de tshe grub par rnam par shes/ /grub pa'i ngag ni dam pa'i don/ /yang na lha ni gzhan pa yin / /ngag gi sgrub thabs chen po mchog /rang lce rdo rje'i rang bzhin bsam/ /bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa' 86—96

yang ①/ /'bar ba'i sgron ma dang mtshungs pa/ /rang gi snying gi dbus kyi cha/ /yi ge mchog tu phra ba yig/ /a yi yi ge mnga' bdag mchog /rnam par bkra ba nyi ma bzhin/ /rang gi sde pa'i mthar thug mtshungs/ /yi ge yi ger yongs su gzho'/—/ /phra mo mnyam pa'i mthar thug ni/ /'bar zhing thig le dang mtshungs shing / /snying gi dkyil 'khor gsal byed pa/ /de yi 'bar ba rab phra ba/ /ji srid rkan gyi bar du son/ /slar yang yi ge thams cad ni/ /yang dang yang du gsal byed cing / / lce la rdo rje 'bar ba ni/ /rdul phran lta bur byed bzhin pa'i/ /②rdo rje 'bar ba stong phrag dgadu /yang dang yang du rnam par 'don/ /'jig rten kun du de song ste/ /chos dbyings mnyam dang mi mnyam pa/ /yi ge'i rang bzhin rnam rgyabakra ba/ /rang gis 'gro ba snang ⑥byas te/ /slar yang 'ongs nas rang gnas su/ /'jug pa ru ni yongs su brtag / ji srid phyogs kun song ba yi/ /yi ge kha ru rab tu 'jug /lus la lus can gyi gzugs brnyan / /sems kyi phyag rgya legs par bsamatshu/ /de nas sgra dang yi ge ni/ /lte bar song ste yongs su gnas/ /lte ba ru ni padma mchog /padmar rdo rje dri med mdzes/ /de yi steng du dung chen po/ /rab tu 'phro ba nyid du gnas/ /de las 'bar ba'i rnam pa'i sgra/ /brang gi gnas nas yongs su byung / /slar yang mgrin par son (kyenas su/ /rdo rje lce la yang dag reg /'gram pa sbyar ba'i dbus su ni/ /sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan dri ma med/ /kha ba ba zho ltar dkar 'od/ /bcud len bdud rtsi'i thigs pa 'dra/ /rdo rje lce ni mtha' dag rnams/ /yang dang yang du gsal bar byed/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi rtser 5)son te/ /slar yang snying ga 7nyid du song / /thig le las ni gug skyed gyur/ /gug rtsonaskyed ri mo 86—97
