ring po can/ /cha shas rnam bzhi 'dus pa las/ /de ni yi ger rnam par shes/ /yi ge las ni sgra skye zhing / /sgra las nā da de ①las dbyangs/ /dbyangs las ngag tu rnam par 'gyur/ /yi ge las ni cha shas tshogs/ /tshig rkang dang ni ngag tu 'gyur/ /tshig rkang las ni tshigs bcad dang / /de bzhin du ni gā ②nā dang / /phreng 'dzin rgyun chags de bzhin te/ /'di ltar sngags dang rig sngags dang / /rang gi snying por rab 'jug ②'gyur/ /de nas bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor che/ /blo gros ldan pas brtan byas te/ /dgug dang gzhug dang bcing ba dang / /dbang du byas te bsgrub par bya/ /bzlas pa 'di yi 0sbyor ba yis⑤ thams cad du ni brtan par bya/ /yid bzhin gyi ni ngag 'grub bo/ /rmad byung mchog tu rnyed dka' ⑥ba'i/ /yang na ⑦lha ni gzhan pa yi/ /ngag 'grub thams cad skyob rnams kyi/ /yi ge gcig pa gsang chen po/ /ngag gi sgrub thabs mchog tu dge / /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid ni/ /legs par mnyam par bzhag ⑧pas bsgomasti/ /rang snying za 7bar rdo rje che/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrugs pa'i 'od/ /de las bstan bcos thams cad ni/ /nges pa gdon rka/nyapa nyid du bya/ /ngag grub 8pa yi (steye shes 'dis/ /thams cad mkhyen pa thob par byed/ /bstan bcos thams cad rab 'don cing ④/ /de nyid kyang ni 'chad par byed/ /sems can kun gyis thams cad du/ /dngos po cung zad gang bsams pa/ /de dag thams cad rnam shes te/ /skad cig tsam la smra bar byed/ /rdo rje snying po rgyan ces bya ba las ngag gi sgrub pa'i thabs rdzogs stobi// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 0rnams thams cad 6)slar 86—98

yang 'dus nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs chen po ①mchog gi dbang phyug la gsol ba btab pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang sngags kyi mdzod kyi cho ga rgyas pa'i zhusgrub pa'i thabs ③bka' stsal du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad kyi dbang phyug gis dugasol ba btab pa'i tshig ⑤ste bar gsan nas de de bzhin no zhes bka' stsal nas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kun nas 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gi rgyal po chen pos ⑥de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang sngags kyi mdzod kyi sgrub pa'i thabs kyi rim ⑦par phye ba'i cho ga rgyas pa bka' stsal pa/de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /'khor los sgyur ⑧ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ /'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'am yang na/ /rtsibs bcu drug par rnam par 'bri/ /lte bar de bzhin gshegs pa dgod/ /'khor lo'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan⑩/ /mtha' ru rin chen rnam pa bdun/ /mkhas pa yis ni spel bar bya/ /de yi lte bar bdag 7nyid ni/ /'khor los sgyur 8ba stobs po che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sku chen po/ /chos kyi dbyings dang mtshungs pa'i mchog /de yi phyag rgya bgrang las 8'das/ /skad cig ma ni nyid la 'thon8/ /'gro ba thams cad snang byas nas/ /sngags kyi dbang phyug nyid la gzhug /'khor lo'i dngos grub gzi brjid che/ /'khor los sgyur 8bar bdag nyid 'gyur/ /chung dang che dang dbang phyug dang / /rang dbang 'dod dgur 8spyod pa dang / /kun du 'gro ba nyid dang ni/ /kun gyi dbang phyug phun tshogs 'bras/ /rga dang 'chi ba med thob cing / /nges par 'khor los sgyur ⑩dang mtshungs/ /gser gyi 'khor lo rin po che/ /de bzhin dngul dang shel nyid dang / /me tog can gyi ji nyelcags 86—99

kyang rung / /rang gi lag gis bzung ①nas su/ /dbang chen dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bsgom par bya/ /'khor los sgyur ②ba gzi brjid che/ /mtshan rnams kyis ni rnam par brgyan/ /de ltar bdag nyid bsgoms na ②ni/ /'khor los sgyur ④ba nyid du 'gyur/ /de la de'i sngags kyi tshig tu gyur pa ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga to: ṣa a ba lo ki ti/ musbyi ⑤tsakra warti dzwa la dzwa ⑥la dhu na bi dhu na tā sa ya mā ra ya/ utsā ṭa ⑦lta ha na bhañdza phroṃ khri ⑧ni kuṇḍa ⑨li ni/ a pa rā dzi tā st+ra dhā 7ri ṇi rtsu hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ 0rtsa ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ oṃ a pa rā dzi tā dhi 8ka ṭwā hā/ snying po'o/ /na maḥ sa manta bud dhā titsā a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā ṭwāṃ ④a pa rā dzi tā ༷dhi ka swā hā/ cho ga'i 0snying po'o/ /'khor los sgyur ba ḍo/rte rang grub ste7/ /sangs rgyas nyid kun yo thob nas ni/ /ye shes tshe dang stobs dang shugs/ /yang na dbang phyug dam pa kun/ /dpa' bo thams cad ster byed na/ /dngos grub gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ /'khor los sgyur rka )ba'i sgrub ḍa nyathabs so/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /nam mkha' la ni yongs su bsgom snye/ /gzi brjid phung po ye shes che/ /sangs rgyas thams cad thob par 'gyur/ /gnyis su med 'byung sems kyi mchog /dkyil 'khor mchog tu rmad 'byung tsho — ba/ /de ni me yir shes par bya/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab sgrub byed/ /de yang 'khor lo 'dzin rgyal po/ /'khor los sgyur ( — )ba legs 'bar ba/ /de la de bzhin rin chen bdun/ /'khor lo'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan mi/ /'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /nyi ma re rer tsho —9bkra shis bsgom / /gzi brjid phung po sku chen po/ /sum cu rdo shertsa gnyis mtshan 'chang ba/ /'bar ba'i phreng 'khrugs dpa' bo ni/ /snang ba shar ba lta 86—100

bur gnas/ /de yi phyag rgya rtag tu bsam/ /nam mkha'i rnam par legs par gnas / /chos kyi dbyings kyi mthas ①thas pa/ /'od zer phreng bas rnam par khyab/ /de dang bdag nyid rdo rjer bsgomal/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab sgrub byed/ /kun du kun nas thams cad du/ /dngos po kun las 'byung bar 'gyur / /ye shes tshe dang stobs dang shugs/ /kun du 'gro ba nyid dang ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad nyid dag dang / /rdo rje can kun nyid dang ni/ / gzi brjid mchog kun thob gyur nas/ /dugazi brjid phung po 'dra bar 'gyur/ /de la sngags kyi tshig tu gyur pa ni/ oṃ ta thā ga to: duṣa a ⑤ba lo ki te myunti te yite dzo rā shi dzā la dzā ⑦la/ dha ka dha ka / da ra da nir/ bi dha bi dha ⑨ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ rtsa ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ te dzo rā shi 0swā hā/ snying po'o/ /oṃ dzā (lhal te dzo rā shi tso/ phaṭa swā hā/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /dag pa'i sngags tshig tso'adi rnams kyis/ /nyi ma'i ye shes rab tu gsal/ /kun du 'gro ba bsgrub ④par bya/ /rig pa 'dzin pa nyid thob 'gyur/ /gzi brjid phung po'i tsogasang sngags kyi sgrub pa'i thabs so// //kun nas snang ba zhes bya mchog /yi ge gsum pa stobs po che/ /gser gyi kha dog legs 'bar zhing / /gtsug tor steng son tso'od gsal ba/ /sngags pa rang bdag gis bsgom bya/ /kun nas snang ba lta bur 'gyur/ /oṃ āḥrgyu/gsang sngags rtse mo dam pa 'di/ /bsgoms tunyepa tsam gyis thams cad du/ /brtan pa dang ni g.yo ba yi/ /'gro kun kun nas snang bar 'gyur/ /kun nas snang ba'i gtsug tor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs so// //chos kyi 'khor lo phyag rgya che/ /legs par mnyam par bzhag / pas bsgomacho ce//86—101

sangs rgyas kun nyid kun gyi mchog /chos kyi 'khor lo rab skor ①byed/ /'khor lo 'di ni rtsibs bcu gnyis/ /rtsibs ②bcu gnyis pa ②yongs su gnas//rnam gsum gsum ni yongs bskor ba/ /bya ba'i don du dag pa steradu/ /sangs rgyas rang bzhin sku chen po/ /nam mkha'i khrugs dun gnas pa ste/ /chos kyi dbyings ni khyab pa ni/ /legs par mnyam par bzhag pas bsgomadu/ /'gro ba brtan dang g.yo ba ni/ /'di kun rten cing 'brel 'byung ba⑦/ /'di ni chos kyi ①phyag rgya che/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab sgrub byed/ /de yi sngags su gyur pa ni/ /oṃ dhu na pā ta ⑨ya sbyin 0tsakre ṇa badzi 'aṇi rghaṃ/ gsang sngags 'di ni dpal ldan mchog /chos kyi 'khor lo gnyis med 'char/ /skad cig tsam gyis thams cad du/ /dam pa'i chos ni rab skor 8byed/ /chos kyi 'khor lo sgrub pa'i thabs so// // padma rā ga'i 0rnam pa 'dra/ /sangs rgyas sku gzugs legs 'bar ba/ /rnal 'byor sbyor ba'i mchog bsgrubs na/ /nyon mongs rdo rje 'dra bar 'gyur/ /snying gnas 8rdo rje gzugs brnyan 'dra/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrugs pa'i 'od//de yi snying la rdo rje me/ /dri ma med pa skye bar 8'gyur/ /nyon mongs rtag tu ⑩yongs zad cing ⑪/ /dgra rnams kun las rgyal bar byed/ /bden pa bzhi ni rtogs pas na/ /bden pa'i ye shes thob par 'gyur/ /sngags ni/ oṃ kle sha a sha lhonyani hūṃ phaṭa/ 'di ni nyon mongs rdo rje'i sngags/ /drag cing drag po'i gzhan gnon pa'o/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyang ster byed na/ /dngos grub gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ /nyon mongs rdo rje sgrub pa'i thabs soyi// //dbang chen dkyil 'khor la rdzu lhaganas pa'i/ /sangs rgyas rang bzhin stobs 86—102

po che/ /bdud bzhi las ni rnam rgyal ba/ /legs par mnyam par bzhag ①pas bsgomal/ /bden pa bzhi yi khu tshur che/ /lus dang ngag dang de bzhin yid/ /khu tshur sangs rgyas thams cad kyil/ /gnyis med skye ba'i mtshan nyid de0/ /rdo rje'i dbus su bsgom par bya/ /rang nyid sangs rgyas yin no zhes/ /brtan dang g.yo ba'i 'gro ba ni/ /'di dag thams cad ma skyes par/ /rdo rje khu tshur bsgoms na ⑤ni/ /rdo rje khu tshur 'dra bar 'gyuradu/ /de la sngags su gyur pa ni/ /oṃ bi dza ye haḥl/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i khu tshur che/ /shes rab pha rol phyin gsal ba/ /sngags pas rtag tu bsgoms na ni/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa 'thob//de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi khu tshur gyi sgrub pa'i thabs so/ //dngos po thams cad gyen 'phags pani/ /gdod nas zhi zhing mtshan nyid med/ /sangs rgyas rang bzhin sku chen po/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus su'o/ /rdo rje dhirdo rje'i bdag nyid bsgomatshu/ /'bar ba lta bu'i gzi brjid kyis/ /'di yis 'jig rten thams cad kyi/ /'khor los sgyur ⑩ba nyid du ni/ /'jig rten kun gyi thams cad du/ /kun nas phun sum tshogs pa kun/ /bkug nas gus pas sbyin par bya/ /sngags ni/ oṃ dzwa la dzwa la dri tipya dri pya uṅga togyi ṣa yis na dhu na hūṃ/ steng 8'gro'i gtsug tor zhes bya bar/ /sangs rgyas dpa' bo kun gyis 8gsungs/ /'di ni bsgrubs pa tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyang rnyed dka' 8min/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs so// //sangs rgyas rang bzhin phyag rgya che/ /legs par mnyam par bzhag 4pas bsgomathonye/ /tshad skyob gdugs dkar chen po ni/ /chos dbyings mnyam dang mi 86—103

mnyam pa/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /zla ba'i kha dog cher 'bar zhing / /chu yi dkyil 'khor rnam ①dag pa/ /dri med puṇḍa rī ②kar gnas / /ri mo bdun gyis yongs su gang / /bcud kyis ①len gyi mchog 0lta bur / / sangs rgyas kun bdag ⑤bsgom par bya/ /dngos grub 'di yi sbyor ba yis / /sems can rnams la thams cad du/ /re ba thams cad yongs rdzogs pa / /'di ni gtsug tor gdugs rjodakar che/ /sngags ni/ oṃ ma ma ma ma rghaṃ ni⑦ / 'di ni bsgrubs pa tsam gyis ni/ /ye shes che dudang stobs mgyogs 'gro//dpa' bo thams cad thob ⑨'gyur zhing / /sangs rgyas nyid kyang rnyed dka' min / /gdugs dkar po'i yi sgrub pa'i thabs so// //zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni(1/ /'bar ba'i phreng 'khrugs ral gri ni/ /sngags pas snying gar 8bsgom par bya/ /rang gi bdag nyid sangs rgyas zhes/ /sangs rgyas rang bzhin sprin chen pos/ /nam mkha'i mthongs rnams yongs gang brka/ /bdag nyid gnyis med ngo bo yis/ /rnal 'byor gcig tu bsgom tunyepar bya / /sngags kyi yi ge 'khor lo che/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrugs pa'i 'od/ /sngags pas snying gar ④bsgom par bya/ /rgyal ba dam pa nyid du 'gyur/ /sngags ni / oṃ dzwa 7la dzwa lo smi ⑩ga 'onang la dzwa la brnya brnya da ma da ma dru ma dru ma da ha da ha na hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i gtsug tor ral gri che/ /shes rab ye shes dri ma med/ /sngags pas kun nas bsgoms nas hunyeni/ /rgyal ba'i gtsug tor 'dra bar 'gyur//rgyal ba'i gtsug tor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs so// //sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /'bar ba'i phreng bas ()'khrugs pa'i 'od/ /seng ge'i khri yi steng du bsam/ ci /yang na rdzu )rdo rje'i gdan la gnas/ /86—104

kun du gtsug tor che ①'bar ba/ /snying gar ②yongs su bsgom par bya/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid ni/ /yi ge dam pa yi ni gnas/ /thog ma tha ma med zhi ba/ /chos kyi sku ni mchog tu che/ /'di ni bsgrubs ①pa tsam gyis ni/ /kun du gtsug tor stobs po che/ /skad cig de la 'grub 'gyur te/ /rdo rje sangs rgyas kun gyi bka' bzhin no/ /sngags ni/ oṃ badzra ban dha rghaṃ/ gsang sngags 'di ni dam pa gtsoX/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dbang bskur byed/ /rtag tu rnal 'byor pas bsgoms phyen/ /de ni kun gyis (7dbang bskur ro/ / kun gyi gtsug tor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs sol// //rdo rje snying po rgyan ces bya ba'i rgyud chen po las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor gyi sgrub thabs kyi ⑤cho ga rgyas pa'i rim par phye ba yongs su rdzogs sortsi)// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnams thams cad 0slar yang 'dus par gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug la gsol ba btab pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' rnams thams cad nyunyekyi gsang sngags kyi sgrub pa'i cho ga ⑩rgyas pa bka' stsal du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen pos de dag gis gsol ba btab pa'i tshig gsan nas de ma thag pa kho nar the de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad du bdag nyid byin gyis brlabs nas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi gsang sngags kyi rim par phye ba bka' stsal pa/ shes rab ye shes rdo rje che/ /snying gar ñtsayongs su bsgoms nas su/ /ral gri 8sngon po phyag na bsnams/ /dbang chen 86—105

dang ni me las 'khrungs/ /ye shes chen po gzi brjid che/ /'khrul ba med cing yi ge bral/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag shes rab mchog /nyon mongs thams cad zad par byed/ /rdo rje kun bdag bkod pa po/ /kun du 'gro ba'i dam pa'i don/ /dbyer med mchog tu gsang ba po/ /rig pa mchog gi bdag nyid 'di/ /zhal drug pa la phyag drug mchog /mngon shes drug ldan yi ge drug /rjes dran drug gi sbyor ba yis/ /phyag drug ①dam pa stobs po che/ /gzi brjid yang na stobs kyis kyang / /kun nas yongs su gsal ba po/ /gzugs che lus kyang che ba ste/ /nam mkha'i khams ②na rnam par gnas/ /yang na phyag gnyis shes par bya/ /ting nge 'dzin gnas sdig pa bcom/ /dpa' bo padma la gnas pa/ /zla ba'i mdog can 'od po che/ /rnal 'byor pa yi ye shes phra/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa 'bar/ /gdod nas ma skyes pa zhes bsam/ / sangs rgyas ye shes rab stsol byed/ /zhusangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes mchog /'jam pa'i dbyangs zhes rab tu grags/ /de'i sngags ni/ skabā kye rda na maḥrjo/ gsang sngags 'di ni mchog tu gsang / /gsang chen gyi ni dam par bzhed⑤/ /rnam thar gsum gyi sgo la ⑥gnas/ /pha rol phyin drug rab tu gsal/ /rang nyid shes rab yin no zhesaphya/ /sngags pas rtag tu bsgom par bya/ /dbang po drug ni rab bsgyur ⑤te//sangs rgyas nyid ni rnal 'byor las/ /padma rā ga lta bu'i mdog /ston zla lta bur cher po)gsal ba/ /sems dpa' chen po gser gyi mdog /stobs po che ni bsgom par bya/ /'di ni bsgrubs pa tsam gyis ni/ /shes rab dri ma med par 'gyur / /bstan bcos thams cad rab smra zhing / /dbang phyug thams cad mdun na gnas/ / kun gyi rgyal po sngags pa nyid/ /rang nyid kun gyi rgyal po 86—106

mtshungs / /①rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad dang / /byang chub kun gyi pha rol son/ /dbang phyug kun dang bde ba che/ /chos rnams kun gyi yon tan mchog /rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad dang / /yang na sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /kun du 'gro ba thob 'gyur ②na/ /dngos grub gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ /dngul chu bcud len de nyid dang / /rkang pas spyod pa dri med ①mchog /ril bu dang ni mi snang ba/ /thams cad du ni ster bar 'gyur/ /dpal ldan 'jam pa'i mchog 'di ni/ /chos kyi gsung gi mchog las 'khrungs/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs zhes rab tu grags/ /'di ni bsgrubs ①pa tsam gyis ni/ /bsams pa'i phun sum tshogs kun gyi②/ /sangs rgyas kun du brtan 'gro na/ /gzhan pa'i lha lta smos ci dgos/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sgrub ⑥pa'i thabs so /snying gar ⑦padma chen po la/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs su gnas/ /'jig rten dbang phyug dpa' bo che/ /thugs rje chen po'i thugs ldan pa/ /phyag bzhi pa la zhal bzhi pa/ /dung dang kunda nizla ltar dag /chos kyi dbyings las yang dag byung / /chu yi dkyil 'khor chen po la/ /bdag nyid 'jig rten dbang phyug chesal/ /de la gnas pa dge ba bsgom7/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'di kun dag /gdod nas ma skyes ma byung ba/ /gsang sngags chen po 'di yi ⑩ni/ /snying gar 7yongs su hunyebasgom par bya/ /'jig rten dbang phyug 'khor lo che/ /kun du rnam par 'phros pa ④yi/ /'bar ba'i phreng bas 'khrigs shing zhi/ /ral pa'i thor tshugs 'dzin pa po/ /ral pa'i dbus su dpa' bo che/ /'od dpag med pa ldan pa'i bdag /ston ku'i zla ba lta bur gsal/ /kun du nam 86—107

mkha' yongs gang ba/ /gsang sngags sbyor bdag bsgom par bya/ /rang nyid 'jig rten gsum rnam rgyal/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi mthas klas pa/ /padma'i lus kyis ①yang dag gang / /kun du padma rnams la ni/ / zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yang dag gnas/ /②khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i sku/ /khyad par du bdag ①dgang bar bya/ /'gro ba brtan ④dang g.yo ba kun/ /snang dang mi snang dngos po ni/ /yang dang yang du blta bar bya/ /gdul bya ma lus sems la ni/ /stobs po ches ni dgang bar bya/ / kha dog ⑤dbyibs ni 'di bzhin du/ /sna tshogs gzugs la cher 'bar ba/ /kun nas yongs su bsdus nas ni/ /sngags pa'i mdun du gzhag ⑥par bya/ /de nas sngags pas de ma thag /slar ④yang rtse gcig sems kyis ni/ /dgug ⑧dang gzhug dang bcing ba dang / /dbang du bya ba bsgrub par bya/ /'jig rten dbang phyug thub chen po/ /bcom ldan rnal 'byor can grub na/ /dpa' bo thams cad stsol 'gyur zhing / /rang gi dngos grub mchog rnams dang / /rnal 'byor thams cad 'dzin nyid dang / /rnam par rgyas pa'i nor ster 'gyur/ /rig pa 'dzin dang 'khor lo can/ /sa dang pha rol phyin sogs dang / /sangs rgyas rnams kyang stsol 'gyur na/ /dngos grub gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ /de'i sngags ni/ oṃ ā ro lika /gsang sngags dpal ldan mchog 'di ni/ /rang nyid khams gsum rnam par rgyal/ /longs spyod thams cad bkug nas ni/ /skad cig tsam gyis rnam par ster/ /padma'i sgrub (9pa'i sbyor ba yisabi/ /bdag nyid 'jig rten dbang phyug bsgrubatunya/ /'jig rten gsum gyi rgyal srid lho ni/ /srid par (nyabakug nas rnam par ster/ /'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub 7pa'i thabs so// //86—108

thams cad rdo rje'i rang bzhin gzugs/ / me yi ①dkyil 'khor dge ba ste//de yi dbus su bya ba ni/ /dkyil 'khor rlung dang rab mtshungs pa/ /de yi dbus su de 'dra bsam/ /nyi ma yi ni dkyil 'khor ro/ /de yi dbus su gzi brjid che/ /'bar ba lta bu'i gzi brjid can/ /rdo rje'i lag pa gzi brjid che//rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /tshangs pa'i yul sa thams cad du/ /kun nas yongs su gsal bar byed/ /hūm̐ gi yi ge sgra zab mo/ /dbyar gyi sprin dang mtshungs pa'i 'od/ /rgyal po 'khyil pa dang mtshungs pa/ /zar ma yi ni me tog 'dra/ /'bar ba dmar pos 'khrigs shing 'jigs/ /bskal pa'i me dang 'dra bar gnas/ /zhal bzhi pa la ②mche ba bzhi/ /'jig ③pa'i dus kyi thal ba 'dra/ / sprin gyi sgra dang mtshungs pa yi/ /④rgyu gi yi ge bzhi dang ldan/ /⑤do rje rtsu mdzad ces bya ba/ /rnal 'byor pas ni rtag tu bsgomanya/ /sngags kyi tshig ni/oṃ sum bha ni sum bha ⑦ / griṇḍa groṇḍa ni// grosna pa ⑨ya gro: 0pa ya hūṃ/ ā na ya 0ho bha ga wān/ bibyā rā dzā 8rgyu phaṭa/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal po 'di/ /kun mchog srid pa'i dbang phyug gis/ /'jig rten gsum yang 'gugs byed na//bud med gzhan dag 7smos ci dgos/ /tshangs pa khyab 'jug dbang chen sogs//chung ma dang bcas phyag rgyar bcas/ /de dag thams cad 'gugs byed na/ /sdug bsngal can gzhan smos ci dgos/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par//rdo rje'i ligazugs brnyan 8snying gar yison/ /dbang po gnyis ni mnyam sbyor bas / /rdo rje can gyis hu sngon du bsgrubazhushe/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs byed pa//bcom ldan rdo rje can 'grub 'gyur/ /rgyal po thams cad sbyin gyur /khyen/ /dngos grub gzhan dag ru )smos ci dgos/ /sngags ni 'dir/ oṃ ṭakki rghaṃ dzaḥ/86—109

gsang sngags 'di yi sbyor ba yis①/ /dam pa'i don du bsgrub par bya/ /longs spyod ji snyed thams cad rnams/ /de snyed thams cad rnam par ster/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i zhusgrub pa'o// //dbang chen dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i/ /byams pa chen po'i bdag nyid sku/ /snying gar ③zla ba'i dugazugs brnyan 'od/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i phreng ba ldan//'jig rten khams ni 'byam ⑤klas pa/ /rang bzhin gcig tu byas nas ni/ /rdo rje yis ni spro ba yidang / /dbang bskur ⑦ba yi rang bzhin dge/ /gser gyi kha dog legs 'bar ba/ /ral pa'i thor tshugs 'dzin pa po/ /ral pa'i dbus su mchod rten che/ /dung dang kunda nizla 'od bzang / /bsgoms nas sems can thams cad la/ /brtan pa'i don du dbang bskur bya/ /yang na sems can thams cad la/ /bu gcig lta bur rnam par spro/ /bsgom nyapa'i sbyor bas bsgoms na ni/ /gnyis med ma rgyal ba las rgyal/ /spro ba dang ni bsdu ba dang / / thim sogs phyogs dbyes ⑩rnam par dbye/ /byams pas kun tu rnam par spro/ /chos dbyings mnyam dang mi mnyam pa/ /thams cad bdag dang bdag gi bar/ / 'das shing ⑩shin tu dri ma medatunye/ /ri rab lta bur brtan 8pa'i sems/ /'khrul pa med cing yi ge bral/ /de ltar sems ni brtan byas nas/ /mnyam med sems can kun dang mnyam/ /bdag nyid byams pa yin no zhes/ /dga' ldan gnas pa'i tshul 'dzin pa/ /cung zad li zhing 'khyil pa'i skra/ /padma rā ga mtshungs pa'i 'od/ /rin chen sems ni rnam dag pas/ / rang bdag nyid ⑫ni bsgom par bya/ / 'di ni 8gsang sngags rang bzhin gyis grub pa ni/ oṃ a dzi tañdza ya sabra satwa 7sa ma yonayā nu ga ta swā hā/ gsang sngags bdag nyid rgyal po 86—110

'di/ /byams pa zhes ni grags pa ste/ /chos kyi dbyings dang mtshungs par khyab/ /byams pa'i thugs ni yid du 'ong / /dang po'i nyusbyor ba'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /sgrub pa'i thabs mchog bsgom par bya/ /oṃ bee tre ya tril/ 'di ni bsgrubs ③pa tsam gyis kyang / /dga' ldan du ni gnas par 'gyur/ /sgrib pa kun dang bral ba'i bdag /rang nyid lha yi bu dang mtshungs/ /byams pa'i sbyor bas bsgoms dun ni/ /'di ni byams pa lta bur 'gyur/ /byams pa'i sangs rgyas zhing du ni/ /rang bzhin gyis ni skye bar 'gyur/ /de mdun chos ni legs mnyan ⑤nas/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa dang / /dbang dang ting 'dzin thob nas ni/ /de ni byang chub sems dpar 'gyur/ /mthar yang sangs rgyas thams cad ni/ /byams pa'i yid kyis thob par 'gyur/ /byams pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs so// //rang gi lus ni thams cad ni/ /nam mkha' mtshungs pa nyid du bsgomatshu/ /chos bdag med pa ⑦bskyed nas kyang / /rang nyid nam mkha'i snying por 'gyur/ /gsang sngags 'di yi sbyor ba yis/ /mkha' mtshungs dpe las rnam par 'das/ /nam mkha'i 'od zer gyur pa yis/ / sems can rang gi gsems las ⑨spro/ / thams cad ⑩sems las spros nas ni/ /slar yang rim gyis 7bsdu bar bya/ /nam mkhar mnyam par 'gro ba 8blta/ /rang gi de nyid kyis sbyar bya/ /rin chen dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /rin chen kha dog 'od po che/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis lus brgyan pa/ /lag na rin chen stobs po che/ /rin chen sbyor ba 8bsgoms pa yis/ /nam mkha'i dam pa 'grub pa yin/ / sngags ni/④oṃ ā kā sha gaṅgā 8ya swā hā/ nam mkha'i snying po stobs po che/ /bcom ldan rnal 86—111

'byor 'grub par 'gyur/ /rang gi dngos grub thams cad ni/ /ster bar 'gyur de 6)dpyad mi dgos/ /dpa' bo sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /dngos grub ji snyed bka' stsal pa/ /nam mkha'i snying po bsgrubs pa yisal/ /de dag thams cad myur du ster①/ /nam mkha'i snying po sgrub pa'i thabs so// //sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa yis/ /kun tu bzang po ④'od bzang ba/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /sngags pas rtag tu bsgom par bya/ /dngos grub mchog ni thob par 'gyur/ /rang gi lus ni ji snyed pa'i/ /rang gis phra ⑤rab rdul rnams kyis/ /de dag thams cad mtshungs par bya/ /sangs rgyas sku yi sku nyid du/ /yang na ba spu'i khung rnams su/ /rang gi 'khor los yongs bskor (nyanas/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mtshungs byas te/ /bdag ni kun tu bzang po zhes/ /yi ge lnga pa zhes su bshad/ /'di yi sngags chen bzlas par (bebya/ /yang na 'dir ni lha gzhan gyis / /rtag tu sngags su gyur pa'o/ /oṃ rsā trīḥ(kye'i ya swā hā/ gsang sngags rgyal po che gsang zhing / /gdod nas dag cing rang 'byung ba/ / 'di ni bsgrubs pa tsam gyis ni/ /shes rab dri ma med par 'gyur(she)/ /de yi ye shes ⑩dri med cing / /gzugs mdzes pa ni de dang mtshungs/ /bstan bcos thams cad rab smra ba/ /kun bzang mchog tu bdag 'gyur ro/ /kun tu bzang po'i sgrub pa'i thabs so// //zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /rgyan rnams kyis ni (/tebargyan pa yi / /sgrib pa thams cad rnam sel ba/ /dam pa'i don du bsgom (nyepar bya/ /gsang sngags 'di yi sbyor ba dang / /bcud kyis nyu2len gyis bde blag tu/ /86—112

ring po nyid du mi thogs par/ /sgrib pa rnam sel mtshungs par 'gyur/ / sngags 'byung ba ni①/ oṃ sarba ni wa ra ṇa biskam gi ni ②swā hā/ oṃ nī sa rā ya swā hā / gtso bo gsang sngags 'di 'dzin la/ /rnam par sel bar grags pa ste/ /thams cad bsgom ④pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /phyag rgya kun gyis ⑤thams cad du / /gdod nas skye med rang bzhin gyis/ /gdod nas dag cing 'gyur ba med / /de ltar chos 'di shes nas ni/ /lha nyid dang ni mnyam byas nas/ /rnyog pa med cing zag med pa'i/ /rjes su rnal 'byor gyis bsgrub bya/ /utpal sngon po'i 'dab ⑥ma ltar/ /gsal ba'i rnam par gnas pa'o/ / dbang chen dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa'i/ /④me yis yongs su bskor ba yil/ /phyag na ⑨ral gri gzi brjid che/ /yang nas yang du sems byed cing / /dngos grub 'di ni gzi brjid che/ /rnam sel mchog gi dbang phyug ni/ /mtha' las 'das pa'i dngos grub mchog /thams cad nas ni stsol ba nyid/ /rnam par sel ba sgrub pa'i thabs so// //dbang chen dkyil 'khor steng du ni/ /rdo rje yi ni dbus na bzhugs/ /gser gyi mdog can sku chen po/ /'bar ba lta 0bu'i gzi brjid can/ /snying gar rdo rje'i tu)phyag rgya gnas/ /sa hunyesnying zhes byar bdag nyid bsgoma'i/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lha sbyor bsa'/ /rang gi gsang sngags brjod par bya/ /sa 8snying zhes byar bdag bsgoms chanas/ /sngags kyi yi ge mchog bde 'di/ /oṃ kṣi haḥrā dza dhiswā hā/ bsam yas sngags mchog 'di yis ni/ /dngos grub thams cad rab stsol snyi/mdzad/ /sa yi snying po zhes grags pa/ /dam pa'i don tsunadu rnal 'byor pas/ /sa'i snying po'i sgrub pa'i thabs so// //86—113

zad pa med cing 'khrul pa med/ /zag ①med mchog gi shes rab can/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni②/ /shes rab rdo rje'i bdag nyid dge/ /blo gros mi zad rnyed dka' ba/ /'bad pa yis ni bsgom par bya/ / me yi dudakyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /gser gyi mdog dang ldan pa'i gzugs/ /rgyal po chen po zla ba'i 'od/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor rab tu gsal/ /sngags ni/ oṃ a kṣa rjoya ma ti swā hā/ sngags kyi yi ge gsang ba 'di/ /thams cad blo gros gsal bar byed / /ye shes mi zad 'dod pa yis/ /'bad pa yis ni bsgrub bya ste/ /dngos grub kun gyi mchog shes dubya/ /shes rab ye shes dri med mdzes/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyang thob gyur dun/ /dngos grub gzhan dag ci zhig smosaX/ /blo gros mi zad pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs so// //kun nas shes rab chen po can/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la brten par/ /gser gyi dukha dog gzi brjid che/ /rgyan rnams thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i/ /gzhon nu'i gzugs can rtag ⑨bsam bya0/ /re ba thams cad rdzogs par mdzad/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lha 7sbyor ba/ /nam mkha'i bdag po bdag yin zhes/ /lus ngag yid kyis 'thams cad du/ /thams cad rig pas brtan par bya/ /shin tu dri med byang chub sems/ /rang snying me long lta bur bsam/ /de nas yi ge ⑩tshig bkod de8/ /mkha' mdzod bdag ces bdag nyid kyis/ /bsgoms nas rdo rje rdo rje'i bdag /mkha' la rin chen 'byung gnas dang / /yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing / /de bzhin bum pa bzang po sogs/ /'jig rten kun gyi dbang phyug gisnyi/ /nye bar mkho ⑩ba thams cad 'bab/ /'jig rten kun gyi rdzas thams cad/ /ji snyed yod pa de dag kun/ /'dir ni 86—114

skad cig tsam nyid la/ /dngos grub dam pa stsol bar 'gyur/ /oṃ ga ga na gañdzi gi ①gu hā/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi dngos grub che/ /nor gyi rgyun gyi rab 'bebs pa/ /nam mkha'i ②mdzod ni stobs po che/ /skad cig tsam gyis ②byed par 'gyur/ /nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgrub pa'i thabs so// //rin chen dkyil 'khor las byung ba/ /rin chen phung po char rab 'bebasaX/ /rin chen gzi brjid mchog tu rol/ /lag na rin chen de bsgrub bya/ /lag na rin chen phyag rgya chekhru/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /rdo rje sbyor bas bsgom par bya/ /bdag nyid rin chen zhes bya dang / /rin chen thams cad stsol bar mdzadarjo/ /thams cad rdo rje bzhin bdag nyid/ /pri yang ku ⑦mdog sngo bsangs ni'od/ /dbang chen dang ni me las byung / /phyag na rin chen cher gsal ba/ /rab tu 'bad de bsgom par bya/ /oṃ ratna 0bā ṇi ra mu ⑩swā hā/ /gsang sngags 'di ni brtson 'grus che/ /rab tu 'bad de bsgrubs na ⑪ni / /'gro ba kun gyi lag tu ni/ /rin chen thams cad rab rtsol 0byed/ /lag na rin po che'i sgrub 8pa'i thabs so// //chos kyi dbyings dang mtshungs pa'i sems/ /bdud rtsi chu yis rab gang ba/ /stong gsum zhes ni bsam par bya/ /padma gcig gi steng na gnas/ /de yi steng du gzi brjid che/ /chu lha yi ni gzugs kyi mchog /de steng du yang gsang chen po/ / me yi tsodakyil 'khor dam pa yin/ /de yi steng du brtson 'grus che/ /rtse mo brgya pa'i rdo rje byung / /de yi steng du pad chen po/ /'dab tsom brgya pa tso'od gsal ba/ /de steng rtag tu bsam pa ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' stobs po che/ /rgya mtsho'i blo gros zhes grags pa/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i 86—115

'od / /dung dang kunda ①sgra ba'i 'od②/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan//de yi lag na phyag rgya che/ /rdo rje dung ①du rab tu grags/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lha sbyor bas/ /rang nyid rdo rje yin no zhes/ /rgya mtsho'i blo dugros shes rab che/ /slar yang gsang sngags bzla bar bya/ /sngags ni/ oṃ sā ga ra ma ti sa ra swā hā/ sngags 'di mchog dang gtso bo ste/ /shes rab ye shes dri med mdzes/ /rdo rje'i sbyor bas myangs na ⑤ni/ /shes rab rgya mtsho'i kyeblo gros mtshungs/ /rang nyid sangs rgyas 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ / thugs rje ⑦'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal/ /dngos grub gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ /rgya mcho1re blo gros kyi sgrub pa'i thabs so// //dbang chen dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i/ /utpal sngon po 'dab du'adra'i 'od / /rdo rje snying po brtson 'grus che/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /ji snyed sa steng stimatha' dag tu/ /khyab la sdug cing mtho ba yi7/ /sra zhing snying po rnam dag pa'i/ /mchog gi yi ge 'gyur med pa7/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug mgon po ni/ /chos kyi sprin la spyod mdzad pa/ /bsam yas sa ni yang dag brnyes/ /yin dra nī la mtshungs pa'i 'od/ /de yi sngags gyur mdzes pa ni/ /yi ge mchog ni steng du 'bar/ /thugs kur tsunardo rje cher gsal ba/ /rang nyid rnam par 'phro ba bzhin/ /sngags ni/ oṃ badzra garbha hūṃ/ 'di ni sngags mchog gtso bo ste/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab sgrub byed/ /ye shes yangs pa stsol mdzad cing / /rnam pa kun tu phun tshogs kun/ /sangs rgyas nyid kun pho stsol mdzad na/ /dngos grub gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ /dgug dang gzhug dang bcing ba dang / /dbang du bya ba sgrub par byed/ /bdag nyid rdo rje yin no zhes / /nga rgyal rab tu bskyed nas ni/ /rdo rje snying po bzhin du gzhan/ /86—116

bdag gi rnal 'byor bsgom par bya/ /thugs kyi rdo rje nyid gyur nas/ /chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa thob/ /des na rnam pa thams cad kyis/ /rdo rje snying po ①yang dag byung / /rdo rje snying po mkha' rdo rje/ /sbyin byed rtse mo drug pas zhusgrub/ /rdo rje snying po sgrub pa'i thabs so// //dbang chen me las yang dag byung / /nor bu rin chen 'dra ba'i lusal/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la duganas pa'i⑤/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mtshungs pa'i 'od//rin chen 'byung ba sems chen po/ /'gro ba snang bar byed de gnas/ /padma mkha' 'dra'i rnam pa can/ /phyag rgya de yi snying gar gnasadu/ /rin chen sbyor bas bsgom par bya/ /rin chen char ⑦pa 'bab par 'gyur/ /sngags ni/ oṃ ratna kā raḥhrīḥrasne nid da swā hā/ rin chen 'byung ⑨gnas rgyal po 'di/ /mchog rnams kyi ni sa'i dbang 0phyug /sbyor ba kun gyis bsgrub par bya/ /rgya che'i nor rnams stsol bar 'gyur/ /rin chen 'byung ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs so// //de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i 7snying po rgyan gyi rgyud chen po kṣ-i/gelas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sgrub pa'i thabs so// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad slar yang 'dus te gshegs nas bcom ldan 'das thog ma dang tha ma med pa dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba chen po la zhu gsol ba btab pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis khro bo bcom ldan 'das bskyed du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das khro bo 'khor los sgyur lib chen pos de skad ces gsol ba btab ma thag kho nar rdo rje 86—117

khro bo'i dkyil 'khor gsang ba las ches gsang ba bka' stsal pa/ de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /khro bo yi ni dkyil 'khor mchog /rlung khams rab tu gsal ba la/ /me ni dbus nas dbus su'o/ /de yi dbus su rdo rje che/ /'od zer lnga yi phreng bas mdzes/ /de yi mdun du bya ba yang / /mdung rtse 'bar ba chen po yi/ /de yi g.yas kyi cha ru ①ni/ /rdo rje chen po 'bar phreng can/ /g.yon nyid du ni be con chel/ /rig pa'i phreng bas rnam par spras/ /rgyab tu ral gri'i phyag rgya ni/ /rin chen 'bar bas rnam par brgyan / /phyi ngos rnams su rnam khros pa'i/ /khro bo thams cad dgod par bya/ /de yi sngags kyi yi ge gsang / /gsang chen mchog tu 'bar ba'o/ /gzhal rjodu med cing grangs med mchog /chos dbyings mnyam dang mi mnyam pa/ /yi ge gcig pa gsang chen po/ /rgyu yi don du rtogs par byed/ /dbyangs lnga ⑤dang ni yang dag ldan/ /thig le sgra yis rnam par brgyanadu/ /de nyid gsang ba'i mgon po ni/ /dbyangs bdun par ⑦ni bshad pa yin/ /he ⑤ru ka dpal rdo rje che/ /'jig ⑨pa'i thal ba mchog tu 'bar⑩/ /sems dpa' sngon po 'bar ba'i bdag /'bar ba'i me 7yi dkyil 'khor bzhin/ /'jig (nyapa chen po'i dus can gyi8/ /char sprin dang ni 'dra ba'i 'od/ /padma rā ga'i rnam pa 'dra/ /'bar ba kun gyis rnam par brgyan / /dur khrod me bzhin shin tu yang / /gsal ba'i skra tsoldan stobs po che/ /rno ba'i rdo rje cher 'bar ba/ /thod pa'i cod pan steng ⑩du 'bar/ /'jig ⑩pa chen po'i dus can gyi(ste/ /rgod ma kha yi me ltar gnas/ /smin yi'akhyog rnam par 'khrugs sno)pa can/ / g.yon brkyangs pa 0yi zhabs kyis bzhugs / /khro ba 3 la sogs nyams dang ldan/ /rnam pa sna tshogs 'khrugs du86—118

pa'i gdong / /gar dang sdud par yang dag ldan/ /'jig rten snang ba ①gar mdzad pa/ /phyag ni brgya phrag stong dang ldan/ /gcig tu 'gyur zhing ②rnam pa mang / /rnam mang zhal ldan de dag gi/ /sngo ser la sogs mtha' dudang ldan/ /zhabs kyang rnam pa du ma ldan/ /sna tshogs mdog ldan rnam par 'khrug /de nyid bcom ldan rnal 'byor te/ /khro bo'i durgyal po stobs po che/ /shin tu sdug ⑤cing drag rnams la/ /sgyu 'phrul dra rjob zhes byar gnas/ /phyag drug zhabs drug snang ba can/ /zhal drug pa ste gsus po che/ /char sprin mchog 'dra cher gnag ⑦pa/ /dus mtha'i me dang 'dra bar gnas/ /mdog chen rgyal po 'khyil pa 'dra/ /zar ma yi ni me tog mtshungs/ /khro bo thod pa'i phreng ba 'chang / /gshin rje ⑧mthar byed ⑨stobs po che/ /de la sngags kyang / oṃ āḥs phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma ma tha ⑩ na rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ trīḥjiḥbi kṛ ⑩tā na na hūṃ sasba sha thun nā sha ya st+waṃ bha ⑩ya hūm̐ phaṭa/sngags kyi rgyal po 0bdag nyid 'di/ /khyab bdag gdul dka' tso'adul ba po/ /gshin rje mthar mdzad khro bo che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid gtso/ /sangs rgyas thams cad spyan 'dren cing / /dbang du yang ni mdzad par gnas/ /rtag tu gdul dka' 8'dul mdzad cing / /rdo rje snang mdzad legs par 'dul/ /shin tu gdug pa drag rnams la/ /zhi ba 8nye bar mi sbyar te/ /shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid kyis/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams khro bor mdzad/ /thugs rje 0khro bo'i ngang tshul can/ /'jig rten gsum kyang (3nges sreg mdzad/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis3)/ /shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid sku/ /thugs rjes khro bo ma lus ri — stamachog /gdug pa 'dul bar mdzad pa bskyed/ /gshin rje mthar byed kyi sgrub pa'i thabs so// //86—119

de nyid bcom ldan rnal 'byor te/ /khro bo gzegs ma zhes su grags/ / dmar po ①'bar ba'i khro bo che/ /'jig ②pa chen po'i dus dang 'dra/ /utpal sngon po'i 'dab lam bzhin/ /de yi kha dog rnam par bsam④/ /drag po chen po'i zhal bzhi 0pa/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i 'od/ /spyan gsum pa la khro gnyer bsnyer/ /phyag drug pa la mchog tu 'bar/ /me yi khams dang 'dra ba'i mdog /li khri'i dumadog ltar shin tu 'bar/ /de yi gakhro gnyer bsnyer ba yis/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad 'byin par byed/ /khro bo'i rgyal po gnyis pa ni/ /yang dang yang du bsam par bya/ /ma lus sa nirnams thams cad du/ /son pa'i bdag nyid chen po des/ /'gugs pa dang ni dbang byed na / /skye bo gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ /sngags ni/ oṃ ka ṇi dhu stiṇi rgyu phaṭa/khro bo 'di yi sngags 'dzin pa/ /'jig rten gsum mchog stobs po che sa rnams thams cad sreg byed na/ /skye bo gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ /khro bo gzegs ⑩ma sgrub pa'i thabs so /de nyid bcom ldan rnal 'byor te/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /padma gar gyi dbang phyug gyur/ /rta mgrin zhes su bshad pa yin/ /rtag tu 'char ku'i mdog 'dra ba/ /rgya skyegs 0mdog ltar 'bar ba podhi/ /chu dang gzi brjid can reg pa/ /me yi dkyil 'khor dag dang ldan/ /'dod ldan rnams la 'dod tu pa 'byung / /gdug pa can rnams gdug pa 'byung / /zhi ba la yang 7zhi ba 'byung / /stobs ldan rnams la stobs kyis sbyor/ /zhal bzhi pa la zhabs bzhi pa/ /bsam gtan bzhi dang mnyam par ldan/ /phyag bzhi pa la brtson 'grus che/ /seng ge ltar gnas mche ba bzhi/ /rta mgrin rgyal po chen po 86—120

ni/ /dam pa'i dbang phyug bsgrub par bya/ /skad cig nyid la bslang ①nas ni/ /thams cad slong ②ba bsgrub par bya/ /sngags ni/ oṃ a mṛ gtoddha bortse pe hūṃ phaṭa④/ oṃ a mṛ ⑤rtong bha ba hūṃ phaṭa/ g.yas dang g.yon gyi sbyor ba yis/ /g.yon brkyang ba ni rab tu sbyar/ /khro bo'i skyil krung ⑥byas nas ni/ /'jig rten thams cad rab nyid byal/ /padma'i dbang phyug rgyal po 'di/ / kun mchog sa yi dbang phyug ste④/ /rta yi mgrin pa ⑨stobs po che/ /stobs kyi sbyor bas ⑩bsgrub par bya/ /dbang phyug chen po la sogs lha/ /tshogs kyi bdag po gzhan dag dang / /mi dang gdug pa'i bsam pa can/ /sa rnams thams cad dgug hunyepar bya/ /rta mgrin 0sgrub pa'i thabs so// //de nyid bcom ldan rnal 'byor de8/ /gcig pu nyid ni lhag pa'i lha/ /shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid gyur8/ /khro bo mchog tu mi 'gyur ba/ /kun sbyor bdag gi rnal 'byor gyis/ /thugs rjes khro ba'i tsodabang du song / /de nas sangs rgyas thams cad kyitso/ /sna yi rtse mor yid kyis ni/ /g.yo ba med par bsam par bya/ /slob dpon mi g.yo khro bo che/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad brtan/ /ral gri zhags pa 'dzin pa gsang ⑩/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /pri yang ku ltar ljang 8ba'i gzugs/ /'khrigs shing byis pa lta bur gnas/ /ma lus pa yi sa rnams kun/ /chos dbyings mnyam dang mi mnyam pa/ /khro bo mngag pa bran dang ni/ /pho nyas kyang ni rnam par brgyan/spu/ /skye bo kun gyis yongs su gang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi spyan snga na/ /bka' lung yang ni yongs su stsol/ / zad pa'i dus dang 'drar gnas so/ /ni )sngags ne/ na maḥsastes manta badzā tsā so tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa (zhu slo ṭa ya rghaṃ/ tra sa༄ka ṭwāṃ 'gyu snye/ khro 86—121

bo gzi brjid chen po 'di/ /gzugs mang mnga' ba stobs po che/ /'gro ba thams cad 'gugs par byed/ /dbang du yang ni mdzad par gnas/ /rlung dang me las yang dag byung / /'bar ba lta bu'i gzi brjid can/ /sngags dang phyag rgya sogs kun mchog /lus dang ngag yid de ①bzhin no/ /dgug dang gzhug dang bcing ba dang / /dbang du byas nas bsgrub par bya⑤/ /de la sogs pa mtha' yas mchog /nam mkha'i khams kyi dumatha' klas mchog /khro bo'i phyag rgya rang 'byung dub/ /drag po thog ma tha ma med/ /rnam par 'phro ba bzhin du gnas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las khro bo'i dkyil 'khor 'di yongs su rdzogs sol// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad slar yang 'dus te gshegs nas bcom ldan 'das la ⑥de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ⑦gzungs thams cad kyi dbang phyug gi rgyal po bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba btab pa/ bcom ldan 'das gzungs rnams nithams cad kyi dkyil 'khor bskyed par mdzad du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gzungs kyi dkyil 'khor bka' stsal pa/ de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /gzungs rnams kyi ni dkyil 'khor dge/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs kyis khyani rnam par mdzes / /thig bzhi dang ni yang dag ldan/ /dkyil 'khor dam par ⑩rab tu bshad/ /de yi dbus su pad chen po/ /lo ma kun gyis shin tu mdzes/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga'i 'dab ma ldan/ /rdo rje rin chen legs par brgyanatunye/ /de yi dbus su rtag bri ba/ /dpag med shes rab pha rol phyin/ /de yi nye 'khor thams cad 86—122

du/ /sna tshogs las ni 'bar rnams la/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga'i dbye ba yis/ /shes rab pha rol phyin ma bri/ /shar gyi 'dab ①ma nas brtsams te/ /thog mtha' nyid kyang brtag par bya/ /phyag rgya'i yi ge ci rigs par/ /go rims ②bzhin du rnam par dgod/ /phyogs cha'i dbye ba tha dad kyis/ /kha dog dbye ba thams cad du/ /rnam dbye mchog tu sna tshogs pa/ /chos dbyings ③mnyam dang mi mnyam pa/ /de las 'od zer bsam mi khyab/ /sngo ser la sogs dbye ba yis/ /shes rab snang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyis/ /'gro ba thams cad gsal bar bya/ /'dus par gyur nas de dag kun/ /lha nyid kyi ni gzugs ji bzhin/ /shes rab chen po gzugs chen po/ /'bar bcas mdzes pa'i gzi brjid can/ /de yi lte ba'i dkyil du ni/ /sngags kyi dkyil 'khor kun nas brten④/ /sku ni gser gyi mdog dang 'dra/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /rang gi ting nge 'dzin la zhugs/ /du ma'i gzugs kyi gzugs ldan ma/ /shes rab pha rol phyin ma ni/ /sems can khams ni rnam sbyong mdzad/ /kun nas sems can rnams kyi yum/ /sems can kun gyi thams cad du/ /thams cad lus la mnyam par khyab/ /sems kyi rgyun bzhin legs par zhugasal/ /zag pa med cing bsam mi khyab/ /dri ma med cing ngang yigis stong / /nam mkha' dang ni mtshungs 'dra ba/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam par spangs/ /thog ma tha ma med cing zhi/ /chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug sku/ /sdig pa kun las rnam par grol/ /bden pa gnyis la rnam par gnas/ / dam pa ⑦dang ni dam pa'i don//chos kyi sku ru de bshad do/ /dbang po kun kyang rnam par shes/ /sems dang thams cad thams ⑧cad du5she/ /yid kyi rnam shes zhes su bshad/ /shes rab blo 86—123

dang blo gros dran①/ /lhag mthong dang ni ye shes kun/ /kun nas nyon mongs rnam par byang ②/ /rtag dang chad pa'i mtha' dang ldan/ /mtha' gnyis po ni rnam par spangs/ /kun rdzob dang ni dam pa'i don/ /rnam pa gnyis su de rab brtags / /ji ltar bud shing la brten nas/ /me yi sa bon gnas pa dang / /til la til mar ji bzhin no/ /bur ②shing ro bzhin rab tu brtag /me tog dri ni ji bzhin nam/ /zho la mar gsar ⑤ji bzhin du/ /rnal 'byor pa yi ye shes bsrub⑤/ /bdud rtsi lta bu'i snying po 'byung / /gtsub shing dang ni gtsub stan las/ /ji bzhin gtsubs pas me 'byung ste/ /de bzhin ye shes rnal 'byor pas/ /bsrubs ⑥pas yongs su brtag par bya/ /shes bya'i dkyil 'khor thams cad la/ /yang nas yang du bsrub par bya/ /mun pa thams cad rnam sel ba'i/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer ji bzhin bdag /nam mkha' dri ma med brten nas/ /nyi ma zla ba ji bzhin gnas/ /'char ba yis ⑦ni gsal byed pa/ /'bar ba stong phrag gi ni snod/ /mun pa kun 'joms skar ma la/ /kun nas kyang ni mdzes pa yin/ /rnal 'byor pas ni ji ltar sems/ /mkha' bzhin shin tu dri ma med/ /gzung 'dzin las ni nges par grol/ /mnyam dang mi mnyam dngos po kun/ /de (kyeganas rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi6)/ /ye shes nyi zla mtshungs pa'i 'odabo/ /shes rab pha rol phyin bsgoms te/ /gsang sngags 'di ni bsam par bya/ /rang bzhin gyis ni dag pa'i dngos/ /rang bzhin med par rnam par gnas/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal kun/ /gdod nas ma skyes rnyog pa med/ /yi ge de nyid de lta bu/ /gnas dang mi gnas rnam par spangasanyam / /sde tshan zhu bzhi pa'i gnyis pa la/ /thig le sgra yis rnam par brgyanas //86—124

de nyid bcom ldan mgon po ste/ /shes rab ①pha rol phyin mar bshad/ /oṃ pra dzñā ②su hā/ ①/oṃ shu ti smṛ ④ti bi dza ye swā hā/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi shes rab 'disal/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs par byed/ / oṃ yo/⑤ 'di ni sangs rgyas kun gyi yum/ / 'di ni 'khor lo yirnam par bsgyur/ /'dis ni dngos grub thams cad dang / /grub pa nyid ni byed par gnas/ /bstan bcos ⑦rab tu 'chad byed dang / /shes bya thams cad khyad par du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos rnams kun/ /dbang phyug dam pas shes par 'gyur/ /shes rab kyi ⑧pha rol tu 7phyin ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs so// //shes rab pha rol phyin gnyis pa/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po mkha' dang mnyam/ /gser gyi mdog can 'bar ba can/ /zla ba'i gdan la legs par bzhugs/ /brtson 'grus chen mo ⑩bsam gtan bya/ /sngags kyi yi ge rnam par brgyan⑩/ /mchog tu rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis/ /sangs rgyas spyan zhes btags pa yis /de yi gsang sngags rab bshad bya/ /nyon cig sa rnams 'dod pa rnams/ / sngags ni/snyi/ oṃ ru ru sbu ru dzwa la tiṣṭha sidha 8lo tsa ni sarba atpa masā dha ni swā hā/'di de mchog tu gsang ba ni/ /rnal 'byor ma la mchog tu 8bshad/ /dbang chen yi ge'i mthar thug pa/ /bsgoms pas dge ba rab tu ster/ /chos kyi phyag rgya 'di shin tu/ /sems can thams cad dbang du byed/ /dpung dang bcas pa myur bkug ⑩ste/ /bran du gyur nas nye bar gnas/ /phyag rgya gcig pa'i lha mo che / /rol cing g.yo ba'i zhal mnga' ba/ /sgeg pa la sogs nyams dang ldan/ /rol cing snang ba'i gar mdzad panyurte/ /sangs rgyas (1)spyan ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /mig gi phyag rgya rab tu sbyar/ /mig gi phyag rgya 'di shin tu/ /'jig rten gsum 86—125

yang gar byed do/ /sangs rgyas spyan gyi phyag rgya'i sgrub pa'i thabs so// //chu yi dkyil 'khor dgyes ①pa na/ /bcud kyis len dang mtshungs pa'i mchog /mtha' yas rgyas shing yangs pa yi/ /dri ma med pa'i mkha' la gnas/ /dkyil 'khor de yi dbus su ni/ /lha mo mchog tu mdzes pa mo/ /'dam labu mda' ②rgyu'i mdog ltar dkar/ /grub ma ral pa'i cod pan 'chang / /'gro ba mtha' dag snang mdzad ma/ /rtag tu nam mkha' bzhin du gnas/ /sngags ni/oṃ ka ṭi bi ka ṭi ka ṭaṃ rjoka ṭi gā hā/ gos dkar mo yi phyag rgya che/ /dung dang kunda zla ba 'dra/ /sngags kyi yi ge'i 0phreng ba cheX/ /padma'i rgyal po rab tu gnas/ /'gro ba mtha' dag snang mdzad na/ /sgrub pa pos ni bsgrub ⑦par bya/ /dam pa'i lha mo 'grub par 'gyur/ /padma'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i thabs/ / zhi ba'i ro dang yang dag ldan/ /nizhi ba'i yi ge mnyam par ldan/ /zhi bar mdzad cing 'jig rten gyi/ /sa gsum sgrub par byed pa'i thabs/ /gos dkar mo'i sgrub pa'i thabs so// //sngo bsangs dkar mo sna tshogs gzugs/ /rnam pa sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas pa/ /sgeg pa'i nyams kyis yongs gang ba/ /'gro ba mtha' dag skyob mdzad ⑨ma/ /thugs rje'i thugs dang ldan pa can/ /rab tu 'bad de bsgrub par bya/ /rol pa yi ni yi gis mchod/ /sngags ni(3 /oṃ tā re tud tā 6nyare tu re swā hā/ chos kyi phyag rgya mtha' yas mchog /sgrol mas legs par rab tu 'o gnas/ /gsang chen bzhin du thams cad la/ /bcud kyis len dang 'dra ba'i mchog /kun du kun tshe lho thams cad du/ /dngos grub thams cad stsol bar mdzad/ /sgrol ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs so// //86—126

dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus su ni/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen mo mchog /phyag bzhi spyan ni gsum pa dang / /ral pa'i cod pan dag gis brgyan / /'dam bu mda' rgyu'i mdog ltar dkar/ /dpa' ba ①la sogs nyams kyis brgyan/ /brtson 'grus chen mo 'jigs sel ma/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /rab tu 'bar ba'i me bzhin du/ /shin tu gsal ba'i gzi brjid can/ /hūṃ gi yi ge zab mo'i sgra/ /sa gsum po ②ni 'khrug par mdzad/ /khro gnyer can zhes legs par grags/ /sngags kyi phreng bas rnam par brgyan②/ /sngags ni/ oṃ bha ya nā sa duni/ tā sa ni tā sel/ tā sa ya/ skṛ ku ṭi ta ṭī/ be tā ḍi gyebe ra ḍi gshe te shwe ta ⑧ dza ṭi 0ni/ oṃ ṭakki rgyu dzaḥ0swā hā/ gsang sngags 'di ni brtson 'grus che/ gsang sngags kun gyi bdag nyid mchog /'gro ba kun kyang 'gugs 0byed na/ /gdug pa'i sems ⑩lta smos 8ci dgos / /khro gnyer can gyi sgrub pa'i thabs so// //nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rdo rje ldan/ /rdo rje'i phreng bas yongs su bskor/ /gzi brjid dkyil 'khor kun nas dkris/ /der gnas rtag tu lha mo ni/ /stobs chen pri yang ku ④ltar ljang / /phyag bzhi par de8bsam par bya/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams cher zhi ba/ /dngos grub thams cad rab stsol ma/ /sngags kyi yi ge phreng ba che/ /rdo rje'i dbus song rab tu gnas/ /khro bo rtsu mdzad gang ba'i mtha'/ /dpa' ba'i 7nyams la sogs par ldan/ /lha mo 'jig rten gsum rmongs byed/ /dngos grub chen po rab stsol ma/ /skad cig tsam gyis 'gro ba kun/ /nges par dbang du byed par 'gyur/ /rdo rje sherlung gi phreng ba che/ /rdo 86—127

rje'i 'khor lo rab tu gnas/ /'jig ①pa chen po'i me ltar drag /snang ba chen ma ②stobs mo ①che/ /padma rā ga'i rnam pa 'dra/ /rdo rje 'bar bas rnam par brgyan④la/ /mtshan ni mā ma tī zhes bya/ /lha mo 'jig rten gsum gyis mchod/ /sngags ni/ oṃ ku dul dhā ṭī ye na maḥ/ shaṃ ka re/ shārnyi ༅ka re/ lhub kus ⑦kurtsi ni/ bhā ta la ku ṭi ni duswā hā/ oṃ ku lan dhā ri ban dha ban dha ⑨ phaṭa/gsang sngags 'di ni don gyi mchog / sangs rgyas tikun gyis gsungs pa yin/ /sa gsum po ni 'gugs byed cing / /tshangs pa la sogs lha rnams kun/ /'gro ba thams cad 'gugs byed la/ /rang gi dbang du gnas pa'ang yin/ /mā ma tī 0sgrub pa'i thabs so// //rlung gi dkyil 'khor drag 8po la/ /rdo rje lu gu rgyud kyis bskor/ /de yi dbus su snang ba che/ /zla ba'i gzugs kyis rnam par brgyan/ /des 0spros pa las bdag nyid ni/ /rdo rje lu gu rgyud kyi sku/ /phyag bzhi ma la lha mo de/ /rdo rje yi ni rgyan gyis brgyan/ /dmar po 'bar ba de yis ni/ /sa gsum po ni 'ching bar mdzad/ /tshangs pa khyab 'jug dbang phyug che/ /bkug nas dbang du mdzad par gnas/ /dngos grub thams cad 'dzin pa dang / /de yi thugs kur mirdo rje che/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i 'od/ /de yi 'bar ba lcags sgrog gi/ /rnam pa rdo rje'i mtshan mas mtshan/ /nges par phyung nas de dag kun/ /chos dbyings mnyam dang mi thamanyam pa'i/ /'jig rten khams ni mtha' dag tu/ /kun nas rnam par bkang nas kyang / /bsgom bya rdo rje thams cad du/ /khro bo dang ldan spro ba'i zhal/ /lto tsob 'phyang zhing sku che ba/ /mche ba bzhi yis rnam par brgyana'i/ /'bar ba yi ni phreng ba gsal/ /gzugs mdzes 86—128

drag pa'i ①gzugs dang ldan/ /sngags ni/ oṃ badzra shri ②kha lā yā dhi pa ta ye /ma hā ba lā ya/ ma hā bityā rā ④cho ya te pra dzwa ⑤li ta/ hastu duya na mo nī la gce ya ki rā ⑦ta rū pa lasbo da rā ya/ skṛ ⑧ku ṭī mu khā ⑨ya/ mā dzā 0ra mu khā ya0/tsa tu rda'i ka rā lā 8ya/ e gye nyi a su sha rī tsor/ ma nu pra bi ④shu/ shi raṃ groṇḍa/ spyi ba groṇḍasnyi/ hasta pā rda groṇḍi bi ṣa0/ ā be sha ⑩ya/ kai pa ya/ kai pa 8ya/ bhra ⑩ma yadu/ bhra ma ya/ 0 maṇḍa la ma sgye/ bi kurba/ bi kub/tsā tsā du/ kus kus/ sbo ṭa ya sgo ṭa ya/ marmā ṇi/ ni kṛnta duya/ hre ④da ya/ sminadu/ ba la ba la/ krirdzi durā ya si/ de ba/ nā ga /yakṣa/ rākṣa sa/ pi shā ston sā da 0ya/ sa ma ya ma nu sma ra/ dzā 6)ti ma nu sma ra⑥/hā hā/ ni dhi ni dhi/ ni ṣi ni 'i0 / badzra tho kha lā/ ādzñā pa ya (1ti gā hā/oṃ badzra ra sa'i hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badzi ṇi du)/ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kā chali rtsu phaṭa ṭwā hā/gsang sngags 'di yi sbyor ba yis/ /bcud kyis len ni bde ba dang / /'gro ba thams cad 'bebs pa dang / /gdug pa rnams ni 'ching ba dang / /tshangs pa la sogs ②lha rnams dang / /lha dang lha min 0sto 'phye che/ /'jig rten skyong dang klu rnams kyang / /rang gi gnas nas bskyod nas ni/ /grub pa kun gyi dngos grub ni/ /dngos grub 'gugs par 'dod pa yis/ /thams cad gus pas sbyin par byed/ /bud med gzugs kyis bsgrub par bya/ /rdo rje lu gu rgyud ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs so// //zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /padma dkar po sa rab tu gnas/ /phyag bzhi pa la du ma'i gzugs/ /dung dang kunda zla ba 'dra/ /thugs kyi rdo rje'i de nyid yin/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /zhi ba ru3la sogs nyams 86—129

dang ldan/ /chos rnams kun gyi ①bdag skyes mchog /rnal 'byor pas ni rtag tu bsgom⑤/ /sangs rgyas bye ba ⑧yang dag 'byung / /der④bdag yang dag bsgom ⑤pa ni/ /skul dubyed ma zhes yongs su grags/ /sngags kyi phreng ba'i yi ge ldan⑦ / /kun nas rnam par 'phro byed pani/ /nam mkha'i khams ni yongs gang ba / /ji srid de yi spyod yul yang / /de srid de yi 'od zer bsgomakhye/ /rnal 'byor ye shes kyis rab sprul/ /sngags ni/ oṃ tsa le tsu le tsunde swā hā/ 'di yi sngags kyi mchog gtso bo/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mchod pa po/ /mtshungs pa med pa'i dngos grub ster/ /lha dang lha min bcas pas mchod/ /'di yi ⑩sdig kun 'dzad 7byed cing / /phun sum tshogs kun rab stsol mdzad/ /padma'i phyag rgya yang dag ldan8/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyang ster byed pa'o8/ /skul 8byed ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs so// //gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na8/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs / /sangs rgyas kun bdag dgyes pa ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /'di ni rang byung bcom ldan 'das/ /gcig pu nyid ni lhag pa'i lha/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi dra ba sdom/ /'dod chags med cing chags bral med/ /dbu mar dmigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /bud med kun gyi sgyu ma'i rgyayi/ /'di ni gnyis med theg pa'i ⑩mchog /sgyu ma dag ni thams cad lasa'/ /bud med sgyu ma khyad par 'phags/ /yinas ( )pa yi 0ni rang bzhin gyis/ / rang bzhin nyid kyis de grub bo/ / 0'jig rten gsum gyi bud med 'dis/ /bkur so bar bya ba 'oste'os pa yin/ /ngan sbyong ⑤rnams kyis kyang 'grub ste/ /rnyed pa kun dang bde dang spro ⑩/ /thams cad bud med sgyu 86—130

mas 'grub/ /rang gi ngo bo ①yongs bsgyur ba/ /sna tshogs sgyu ma'i phyag rgya 'di//shes rab pha rol phyin mar bshad/ /kun la sna tshogs phyag rgya ni/ /kun la sna tshogs sdom pa yis/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam par sbyor/ /stong pa nyid kyis ②de nyid bskul/ /kun la kun nas thams cad du/ / rnam kun kun tshe ②rang nyid kyis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad brtan dang g.yo/ /thams cad dngos po rang nyid 'gyur/ /sems dang sems can ting 'dzin dang / /byang chub spyod pa sna tshogs nyid/ /sa dang pha rol phyin spyod pa/ /dbang nyid du yang de bshad do/ /bdud dang bdud las rgyal ba nyid/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje de bzhin gshegs/ /thog ma tha ma med zhi ba/ /byang chub sangs rgyas bcom ldan de'o/ /rdo rje rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid/ /padma de bzhin padma 'dzin/ /nor bu nor bu 'dzin pa nyid/ /sna tshogs de bzhin sna tshogs 'dzin/ /ral gri ral gri 'dzin rgyal po//'khor lo de bzhin 'khor lo 'dzin/ /'jig rten gsum rgyal nyid dang ni/ /'di rnams kyi yang 0rigs nyid 'gyur/ /de nyid chags dang chags bral ba/ /'dod dang thar pa ru yang phye'agyur/ /dus gsum dang ni srid gsum mchog /'jig rten gsum dang khams gsum pa/ /brtan pa thams cad de nyid de/ /rnam pa sna tshogs nyid du 'gyur/ /g.yo ba kun nas sna tshogs pa/ /thams cad du ni de 'gyur ro/ /de la sogs pa sna tshogs mchog /chos dbyings mnyam dang mi mnyam pa/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi (yematha' klas pa/ /dngos po kun du de 'gyur ro/ /de nyid bcom ldan rnal 'byor te/ /gcig pu nyid ni lhag pa'i lha/ /nam mkha' kun gyi skabs na dpal/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs / /dpal ldan sgyu ma chen mo (pe'achang / /rnam snang rtag pa thams cad 86—131

du/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug gtso chen khyab/ /sangs rgyas 'khor lo can mi bskyod/ /che dang rin chen 'byung stobs che/ /tshe dpag med pa kun nas mchog /don yod sna tshogs mdzad pa dang / /rdo rje sems dpa' blta ①na sdug /dgug pa mchog gi sbyor ba dang / /legs par mdzad pa de nyid yin/ /rin chen sgron ②ma de bzhin togadu /rdo rje bzhad ④pa snang ba che/ /rdo rje chos dang rno ba che/ /rgyu dang smra mchog bdud rtsi dang / /las dang go cha gnod sbyin che / /khu tshur de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /de nyid bcom ldan rnal 'byor 'di⑤ / /rdo rje sems dpa' stobs po che/ /rdo rje hūṃ mdzad rghaṃ mdzad dang / /rta mgrin zhes ni rnam par grags/ /he ru ka dpal rdo rje che/ /mchog gi dbang phyug zhugashin rje gshed/ /khro bo gzegs ma snang ⑦ba che/ /rdo rje me ni 'od chen po / /gzugs ⑧rnams kyi ni mchog gcig pusti/ /ting nge 'dzin las dbang sgyur ⑩ma/ /shes rab pha rol phyin mchog tunyegatso/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa ⑫stobs8 / /tshangs pa'i gnas pa chen po bzhi/ /dbang ni mchog tu 'bar ba dang ske/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi/ /dbang po rnams dang stobs rnams dang ske/ /rjes dran drug por gyur pa gang ④/ /bsgom par bya bar 8rab tu gnas/ /de nyid bcom ldan gcig pu ste/ /byang chub yan lag bdun btags tsopa / /mtha' gcig yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur/ /sum cu hu 7rtsa gnyis mchog gi mtshan/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i lam po che/ /'phags lam yan lag brgyad btags lho pa/ /stobs bcu yi ni bcu pa nyid/ /sangs rgyas chos kyi bdag nyid gnas/ /byang chub phyogs kyi chos chen po/ /rnam par dbye ba sum cu 6)bdun/ /mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms 'jug ni/byu /dgu la gnas par gyur pa ‘ kye dang / /86—132

bsdu ba'i dngos po chen po bzhis/ /sems can bsdu bas sdud ①pa dang / /so so yang dag rig pa bzhi/ /de bzhin bsrung ②ba mi mnga' ba/ /skal ba chen po'i mi 'jigs pa/ /mchog tu gyur pa nyid dang ni/ /bsam gtan gzugs med bzhi phrag gnyis/ /tshad med pa yang de bzhin no/ /byang chub sems ①kyi spyod pa dugatso/ /bden pa bzhi ni ston pa po/ / kun nas ⑤nyon mongs rnam par byangayi/ /zag bcas gzag pa med pa'i mchog /de nyid bcom ldan rnal 'byor te/ /dbang phyug mchog gi dbang phyug dang / /skye dgu'i ⑧bdag po skye dgu'i ⑨mgon/ /mchog gi bdag nyid ces su brjod⑩/ /kun rdzob brjod yipa thams cad dang / /sgra rnams kyi 8ni spyod yul 'gyur/ /brjod 8du med cing spros pa bral/ /stong pa mkha' mnyam mtshungs pa med/ /tshig mtha' sgra yis 8rnam dgod pa/ /'jig rten tha snyad tshul du rtogs8/ /de tshe lus sogs dbye ba yis/ /sa rnams kyis ⑩ni yongs su brtags/ /sku ni sprul pa nyid du 'gyur/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa yang dag brnyes/ /rdo rje'i sku dang de bzhin du/ /ye shes sku sogs yongs su brtags/ /mtha' yas sku dang sku chen po/ /rin chen sku ni 'od byed pa/ /padma'i sku ni snang ba che/ /thams cad sku ni las bzang byed/ /rtogs par bya ba las kyi sku/ /rnam pa gsum du'ang dbye bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan rnal 'byor te/ /byang chub sems ni 'od gsal ba/ /kun du 'od kyi sa chen po/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gzi brjid ldan/ /gnyis pa bdud rtsi'i /— 'od ces bya/ /zla ba'i 'od ni 'od gsal ba/ /gsum pa nam mkha'i 'od ces bya/ /mkha' bzhin legs par rab tu gnas/ /rdo rje /she'od mtha' gang zhig sa/ /bzhi pa de ni yid /ge'ong ba/ /bsam pa brtan pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje 86—133

zhes ni yongs su bsgrags/ /lnga pa rin chen 'od ces bya/ /dbang bskur bar ①ni rab tu gnas/ /drug pa padmo 'chang zhes bya/ /pad bzhin rab tu rnam par snang / /rang bzhin gyis ni chos nyid dag /bdag gi med cing yongs bzung med / /bdun pa las kyi 'od ces ②bya/ /sangs rgyas phrin ③las mdzad pa che/ /brgyad pa dpe med pa zhes bya/ /dpe ni de la yod ma yin/ /dgu pa dpe dang bral zhes bya/ /dpe rnams thams cad rab 'jug pa/ /bcu pa shes rab 'od ces bya/ /sangs rgyas sa ni bla na med/ /bcu gcig kun mkhyen nyid ces bya/ /sa chen po ni 'od gsal ba/ /bcu gnyis so sor bdag rig pa/ /rnal 'byor ye cashes yongs rdzogs nyid/ /sa chen po ni 'di rjodag rnams/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis don dam du/ /sangs rgyas dang ni sangs rgyas chos/ /rnal 'byor ye shes gang brjod pa/ /thams cad nyid ni mtha' yas mchog /chos dbyings mnyam dang mi mnyam pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud chen po las sngags kyi de kho na nyid do// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bcom ldan 'das thog ma dang tha ma med pa chos kyi 'khor lo chen po bskor ba rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po la gsol ba btab pa/ de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen pos de dag gis gsol ba btab pa'i tshig gi de ma thag nyid du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyam pa nyid du dmigs pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gzhag nas mnyam par (shegazhag 6)pa'i de ma thag tu yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje la rjes 86—134

su bcug ①nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi lus dang ngag dang yid mnyam pa nyid du byin gyis brlabs nas rnam ②par bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje ①rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi skur bdag nyid rtogs nas ting nge 'dzin las bzhengs ④te/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /'jam dpal de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi theg pa chen po mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po yod do zhes gsungs nas cang mi gsung bar bzhugs par gyur to/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs ⑤kyis stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs rdzite thal mo sbyar nas btud de 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bstan du gsol/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / thabs kyi theg pa chen po mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po gang du zhugs pas sems can rnams thabs chung ngus de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog gi dngos grub ⑦thob par 'gyur ba bka' stsal du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje ⑧rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen pos 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal legs so legs so/ /⑨'jam dpal khyod gang slar yang 'o )de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig la rjes su zhugs pa ni 'jam dpal khyod legs so legs so/ /de legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung 7shig dang theg pa chen po mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po bshad par bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi dbang 86—135

phyug chen po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rjes byin gyis rlob pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas dam tshig chen po rdo rjes byin gyis rlob pa theg pa chen po'i stimangon par rtogs pa zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di bka' stsal pa/ de nas dkyil 'khor chen po mchog /yang dag rab tu bshad bya ba/ /dam tshig chen po rdo rje mchog /snying po chen po'i rgyan ces bya/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis ni mdzes par byas②/ /thig bzhi dang ni mnyam par ldan/ /'od zer 'bar bas 'khrigs pa'i 'od/ /rdo rje snying po yongs bskor ba / /byang chub shing gis nye bar mdzes/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor grwa brnams dang / /sgo dang sgo khyud ⑤mtshams rnams su/ /rdo rje rin chen rnams kyis spras/ /rdo rje padma thams cad du/ /las kyi rdo rje thams cad du/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i 'od/ /dril bcas sna tshogs mchog dang ldan/ /rgyal mtshan bsgreng ⑥ba rlung bskyod pa'i/ /gos dang me tog chun pos spras/ /zla ba phyed pas nye bar mdzes/ /ral gri rdo rje la.utpa la/ /lcags kyu la sogs sna tshogs brgyan98)/ /chu yis 'o)dkyil 'khor yongs bskor ba/ / khor yug ⑩bzhin du rnam par gnas/ /de la'ang sgo dang sgo khyud 7sogs7/ /mkhas pa yis ni spro bar bya/ /de yi nang du bri bar byasanya/ /'khor lo chen po rab tu gnas/ /cha brgyad kyis 7ni yongs su bskorasnyi/ /dkyil 'khor legs par ⑩rnam par spras / /rdo rje'i thig gis lho tshoyongs su bskor(she/ /rdo rje'i 'khor lo cher 'bar ba//de yi dbus su snying po che/ /rdo rje'i snying po zhes su bshad/ /de yi steng du rdo rje che / /rdo rje padma rab tu gnas/ /padma'i steng du rdo rje che/ /'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor dag gis brgyan rte/ / gsangs che ba zla bas brgyan/ /'grel pa'i 86—136

bshad par 'di bzhin 'dug /①dung dang kunda zla ba dkar/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gdan du bshad/ /de yi steng du legs bzhugs pa/ /khyab bdag rnam par snang ②mdzad che/ /zla ba'i mdog ldan 'dzum ①bcas pa/ /ting 'dzin ldan gnas ④sdig pa bcom/ /rdo rje'i phreng bas rnam par spras/ /sna tshogs 'bar bas 'khrigs pa'i 'od/ /rin chen chen po'i phreng ba ches/ /spras ⑤pa rnam par dgod par bya/ /de sngags rtag tu shes bya ba/ /yi ge yi ni mchog gtso bo/ / sha sa'i sde ba gsal byed nisti/ /mchog gi dbang phyug rgyu gcig po/ /drug pa'i dbyangs ⑦kyis (nyelegs gsal ba/ /thig le nā das legs par brgyan⑨ / /rten cing 'brel 'byung 'khor lo yi0/ /don can rab tu bskyed par bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan rnal 'byor can/ /gcig pu nyid ni lhag pa'i lha//chos kyi sku ni ye shes che/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor dbang phyug bshad/ /de nas yang de bzhin gshegs pa mi bskyod pa dang ⑪/ ye shes kyi 'od zer dang / de bzhin gshegs pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rgyal po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje rnam par gnon pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje nyid du rang gi bdag nyid byin gyis brlabs te/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa'i phyogs thams cad mnyam pa nyid du dmigs nas phyogs bzhir 'khod do/ /dbang chen dkyil 'khor mi bskyod pa/ /me yi dkyil 'khor ye shes 'od/ /chu yi dkyil 'khor 'od dpag med/ /rdo rjes rnam gnon rlung dkyil 'khor/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po'i dam tshig las byung 7ba sems dpa' byin gyis rlob pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la 86—137

snyoms par zhugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi theg pa chen po mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i ①snying po'i rgyan gyi snying po 'di nyid kyi thugs ka ②nas phyung ba'o/ /oṃ badzra satwa/ de nas 'di rnam par phyung ba tsam gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka ninas rdo rje'i 'od zer rnams phyung ④ste/ rdo rje'i 'od zer ⑤de rnams kyis 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad snang bar byas te gsal bar gyur nas/ de nas rdo rje'i 'od zer de rnams kyis 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul phra ⑥rab dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi skus 'jig rten gyi khams rnams su gshegs nas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad snang bar mdzad de/sems can thams cad kyi don bya ba stimangon par rdzogs nas slar yang gcig tu 'dus te/ byang chub nisems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po'i skur gyur nas/bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po'i rdo rje snying po'i ⑨thugs kur chaganas te ched du brjod pa 'dis ched du brjod pa/ e ma ho rdo rje snying po bdag /sangs rgyas ye shes bla na med/ /snying po ye shes rnam dag pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nyid gyur nas/ /byang chub sems dpa' brtan bskyed yide/ /sangs rgyas ye shes bla na med/ /gang zhig brtan phyir lus min yang / /sangs rgyas sku nyid du gyur to/ /de nas rdo rje'i sku byang chub sems dpa' chen po bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka (nyanas 'thon 8nas bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod 8pa'i nye 'khor thams cad rnam pa bzhis phye meste/ dkar po ser po dmar po ljang gu'i tsomadog tu mngon par sprul nas rang gi sngags kyi yi ges zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la brten te gnas par gyur to/ /dgug pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ oṃ badzra rā dzaḥ(nye/86—138

rjes su chags pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ oṃ badzra rā ga /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la legs par mdzad pa'i ting nge ①'dzin ni/ oṃ badzra sā dhu/ de bzhin du rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dkyil 'khor la dbang bskur ba'i ②ting nge 'dzin ni/ oṃ badzra ratna / nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi ting nge du'adzin ni/ oṃ badzra te dza/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi nam mkha' mdzod kyi ting nge 'dzin ni/ oṃ badzra ke tu/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bzhad pa chen po'i ting nge ⑤'dzin ni/ oṃ badzra hā dus/ de bzhin du 'od dpag tu med pa'i dkyil 'khor yang thugs rje'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ oṃ badzra dharma/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ oṃ badzra tīkṣa/ dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ oṃ badzra he tu/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sems dpa' smra ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ oṃ badzra bhā ṣa/ de bzhin du rdo rje don yod pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ las sna tshogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ oṃ badzra ku ⑦/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ oṃ badzra rakṣa/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi khro bo'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ oṃ badzra yakṣa/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs khu tshur bcings pa'i niting nge 'dzin ni/ oṃ badzra sarnyi/ de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i dam tshig rdo rje spudabyings kyis byin gyis ⑩brlabs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ nyid kyi thugs ka hunyenas 'di phyung ngo / /oṃ badzra dhā 7tu rtsu/rang gi rig 8pa mchog ni/ oṃ badzra dhā tī shwa ri rghaṃ chabadzi ṇi/ de nas 8de bzhin gshegs pa mi bskyod pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje sems 86—139

dpa'i dam tshig ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlabs ①pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs ②te/ nyid kyi thugs ka ninas rang gi rig pa mchog 'di phyung ba/ oṃ a khyo bhya ma④/ oṃ tshwa na musbyi tsitta ⑤ badzre badzi ⑥ṇi hūm̐/ de nas ⑦de bzhin gshegs pa'i du'od zer gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje rin po che'i dam tshig gi ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlabs ⑨pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas nyid kyi thugs ka 7nas rang gi rig pa mchog 'di bka' stsal pa/ oṃ yiratna tunye bha ba ⑫ṭwāṃ/ oṃ badzra dzñā na gar bha ste 8rgyu/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag tu ⑫ med pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje chos kyi dam tshig gi ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor byin gyis rlob pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas nyid kyi thugs ka (nyanas rang gi rig pa mchog 'di bka' stsal pa/oṃ a mi tā bha trīḥ7/ oṃ badzra dhā 8ri ṇi ⑩ / de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par gnon pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje las kyi dam tshig gi ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor byin gyis rlob pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas rang gi rig pa mchog 'di bka' stsal pa/ oṃ ( )a mo gha sidhi i/ oṃ badzra ma hā ba le hūṃ/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ( steyul la rnam par gzigs shing / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyam pa nyid rnam par spros pa'i snying po 'di bka' stsal pa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa ( nyam tā zhunyadzñā na badzra hūm̐/de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po 'di dag bshad pa tsam gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil la'akhor thams cad mthong bar gyur to/ /86—140

de nas phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po'i bdag nyid rtogs nas/ rdo rje mnyam pa nyid spros pa'i snying po bka' stsal pa/ oṃ badzra sa ma tā tsā na buddha ①rgyu/ de nas 'di bshad pa tsam gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po rnams phyag na rdo rjer mthong bar gyur to②/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje'i thugs ka dunas chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid spros pa'i snying po 'di phyung ngo / /oṃ sarba dharma ④sa ma tā (shedzñā na badzra ⑥ / de nas 'di rnam par phyung ba tsam gyis kyang slar yang phyag na rdo rje'i thugs kur ⑦de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis (kyedakyil 'khor thams cad byin gyis brlabs pa ⑨mdzad nas/dkyil 'khor thams cad du 'khod par mthong ngo / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 0thams cad kyi thugs ka 3nyenas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyam pa nyid spros pa'i snying po 'di phyung ngo / /oṃ sarba satwa sa ma tā 8pra pañtsa buddha hūṃ/ de nas 'di phyung ba tsam gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka (/nyenas phyag na rdo rje rnam par phyung ste slar yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi spyan snga na gnas nas bka' nod cing 'khod do/ /bcom ldan 8de bzhin gshegs pa kunatso/ /bdag gis ji ltar bsgrub par bgyi/ / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bka' stsal pa/⑩ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor rnams la byin gyis brlab (/chepar byos shig /de de bzhin no zhes gsol nas/bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka zhunyenas dkyil 'khor thams cad byin gyis brlabs te brtan par gyur nas rdo rje sgeg mo la sogs pa'i lha rnams phyung ste/ lha mo de rnams dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi grwa rnams su de bzhin du rnam par gnas so/ /sgo rnams su sgo skyong ma 86—141

rnams dang / mtshams rnams su gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg bya rnams bshad do/ /de dag gi sngags su gyur pa ni/ oṃ brdza ①me ghi ṭwāṃ sa②/ 'khor lo'i mtshams su gzhag ③par bya'o/ / oṃ sne ha ④brdza ṇi rtabla / oṃ ⑥sha rad badzre ⑦ma i/ oṃ badzi ṇi ki li ki li ni// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dgyes pa chen po'i mchod pa phyi'i dkyil 'khor ⑨ga dang /mtshams rnams su dri rdo rje la sogs pa'i lha mo ⑩rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i nye bar gnas par dgod par bya'o/ /oṃ badzra ga rgyu/ oṃ ma dhu badzi ṇi0/ 'a st+waṃ/ oṃ ma nod bha ba tibadzi ṇi rgyu/ oṃ badzi she ④shi re ho ho/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rol pa chen po'i lha mo tisgo'i mtshams rnams su gzugs la sogs pa'i oṃ badzi rū tson/ oṃ brdza shasdi/ oṃ brdza garnye/ oṃ badzi char se/oṃ badzi sparshatso/ mnyes par byed pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi shin tu dga' ba rdo rje'i snying po ni/ oṃ sa ma ya hoḥsu ra :yi/ dga' bde chen po'i rdo rje'i snying po 'dis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kun nas mnyes pas dudakyil 'khor thams cad la brtan par gyur nas/ dngos grub thams cad stsol bar mdzod(nya/ /dgug dang legs par rab gnas dang / /ji bzhin gnas su sbyar ba nyid/ /kun nas dgyes mdzad sangs rgyas kun/ /dngos grub thams cad rab sbyin dge/ /sngags kyi tshig rnams kyang / oṃ e hye ⑤gyi bha ga wān ( sebadzra i ( steku sha dzaḥ/ oṃ pra be sha ya (ste// sab ta thā ga ta oṃ sa ma ye brnya tsotiṣṭha bha ga wān(nye/ oṃ tu gyi ho ( nyag ga wān badzra ā be 5)sha aḥ/ 'di dag ni dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi sgo'i phrin ( )las so/ /de lta bu'i dkyil 'khor 'dri ⑥ba la byams pa dang / 'jam dpal dang / kun tu bzang po dang / spyan 86—142

ras gzigs dbang phyug la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ①rnams dgod par bya'o/ /sngon du bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho gas slob ma bcug ste0/dbang bskur ba la sogs pa byas nas ③slob ma dang bcas pas thabs cig 0tu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la nye bar mkho ba thams cad kyis mchod par bya'o/ /de la dang po kho nar re zhig ⑤dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi slob dpon ni dam tshig thams cad shes pa/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen pos dngos grub thams cad kyis dubyin gyis brlabs pa/ dbang bskur ba thams cad thob pa/ rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug lta bu/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya la bslab par bya'o/ /de nas 'dir dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcing bar 'gyur ba ni skyil krung bcings nas dri ⑦la sogs pa rnams kyis lag pa gnyis byugs nas niphyag rgya bcing ba rab tu bsgrub par bya'o/ /lag pa gnyis rdo rje bsdams pa 0byas te sor mo phan tshun bcings nas skyil krung 0gi dbus su rdo rje bsdams par gzhag ⑪pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa ni gar gyi tshogs kyi 8sbyor bas so/ /rdo rje bsdams pa de nyid arked ④pa'i phyogs su gzung 8ba ni rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje bsdams pa las mdzub mo lcags 0gyu ltar gzung ⑩ba ni rdo rje 8rgyal po'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid mda' 'phen pa lta bu'i sbyor ba ni rdo rje mda'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las legs so ba ⑩sbyin pas rgyab tu 'jog pa ni rdo rje legs pa'i'o( )/ /byang chub kyi sems kyi tsophyag rgya rnams sos/ /rdo rje bsdams pa de nyid dpral bar 'jog pa ni rdo rje rin chen gyi phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje bsdams pa las ( nye'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sbyor ba ni rdo 86—143

rje nyi ma'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi ①phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje bsdams pa spyi bor sbyar ②ba ni tog gi phyag rgya'o/ /kha'i thad du bskor ba ni rdo rje bzhad pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje bsdams pa de nyid kha'i thad du bskor ba ni ①rdo rje chos kyi phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid snying gar ④byas pa ni rdo rje ral gri'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid 'khor lo ltar yongs su bskor ba ni rdo rje rgyu'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid snying gar ⑤bsgreng ⑥ba ni rdo rje smra ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /chos kyi phyag rgya rnams some/ /rdo rje bsdams pa de nyid gar nyid du ston pa ni ⑧las sna tshogs pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa gnyis spyi bo dang snying ga (skyedang mgrin par 'jog pa ni rdo rje bsrung ⑩ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje bsdams pa 'gram pa gnyis su 'jog pa ni rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje bsdams pa de nyid snying gar btsir ba 7ni rdo rje khu tshur gyi phyag rgya'o/ /de bzhin du sgeg mo dang bdug pa ma la sogs pa'i sbyor bas lha mo thams cad kyi phyag rgya thams cad la tshirab tu sbyar bar bya'o/ /na rol cing rnam 'khor chadagod pa dang //sgeg dang snying rje'i bdag nyid dang / /dpa' dang khro sogs chos bdag nyid/ /rang nyid zhi ba'i bdag nyid nyams/ /phyag rgya thams cad rab tshogs paske/ /gal te dngos grub mchog 'dod na/ /bdag nyid 7rdo rje'i gar byed dam/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /phyag rgya bcing ba rab tu sbyar/ /thams cad grub par 'dod sogs kyis/ / skyil krung yi snasangs rgyas thams cad kyi4)/ /de phyir gnyis med rdo rje can/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi drang po'i sku/ /sgeg pa'i sbyor bas 17rdo rje can/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi zhi ba'i spyan/ /snyems bcas rdo rje can gyir tsho 1dgongs/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang rdo rje spyanaX nya/ /ting 'dzin dbye ba las shes bya/ /'khrugs pa'i lta stangs khro rnams kyis snye/ /btsun mo 86—144

rnams kyi rol pa nyid/ /'jig rten pa yi lha rnams dang / /sdig ①spyod rnams kyi ②lta stangs stong ①/ /chos rnams kun gyi rjes 'jug pa'i/ /shugs kyis ④lta stangs phyag rgya'o/ /④tshogs dang pho nya pho nya yimo'i/ /lta stangs rnam pa sna tshogs nyid / /mchu yi phyag rgya yongs ldan pa/ /g.yo ba med cing mi 'gul ba/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi phyag rgya mchog /sangs rgyas byang chub rab sbyin byed/ /mtshams sbyor cung zad yang dag ldan/ /rnam 'gyur med cing mtshungs med gnas/ /rol pa'i yi ge yang dag ldan/ /mchu yi phyag rgya rdo rje can/ /rnam 'gyur can dang 'khor ba can/ /khro bas so ⑦ni yongs su bsdamadu/ /'di ni khro ba'i phyag rgyar bshad/ /mchu yi phyag rgya gzugs mdzes can/ /'jig rten pa rnams mchu'i phyag rgya/ /rnam 'gyur 'jig cing gzugs dang bral/ /shin tu brnag ⑨dka'i 'dod chags dang / /snang dang rmongs las thams cad du/ /rol cing rnam 'khor 0dang ldan pa/ /g.yo bcas rab tu 'phro ba yang / /mchu yi phyag rgyar shes par bya/ /lha mo pho nya tshogs kyi yang / /de la sogs pa mtha' yas mchog /lta stangs mchu la sogs pa'i ming / /phyag rgya thams cad mdor bsdu ba/ /skyob pa rnams kyis shestekun shes bya/ /ji srid sku yi dbye ba dang / /dbang po la sogs rab dbye dang / /de dag phyag rgya mtha' yas tsomachog /sangs rgyas kun gyis brtags 8pa nyid/ /sna tshogs sku ni gzi brjid che/ /tshad med yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi phyag rgya mchog /sangs rgyas byang chub rab sbyin byed/ /rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud chen po las dam tshig chen po'i de kho na nyid gsang ba zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po yongs su rdzogs storige// //86—145

gshegs pa thams cad ①mnyam pa nyid mngon par ②dbang bskur ba zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'di bka' stsal pa/ de nas dkyil 'khor chen po mchog /yang dag rab tu bshad ②bya ba/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo dubazhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis ni mdzes par byas⑤/ /sna tshogs khams ni bsam yas mchog /dar dang me tog chun pos brgyan⑥/ /rdo rje rin chen rnams kyis spras/ /sna tshogs padmo de bzhin gzhan/ /dkyil 'khor de yi dbus su ni/ /sangs rgyas sku gzugs yid 'ong ba/ /mgon po sum cu gtsa gnyis mtshan/ /'bar ba mchog gis brgyan ⑧pa po/ /de sngags rtags su shes bya ba/ /dang po'i dbyangs dang gnyis pa'o/ / de yi nye 'khor thams cad du/ /'khor lo can brgyad bri bar bya/ /⑨dkyil 'khor de yi dbus su ni/ /'khor lo kun tu 'bar ba gzhag⑩ /'khor lo'i lte ba'i dbus su ni/ /padma'i rgyal po rab tu gnas/ /sgeg sogs sangs rgyas thams cad ni/ /ji spre)ltar sngon bzhin bri bar bya/ /nye bar mkho ba'i mchod kun gyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mchod par bya/ /dgug sogs cho ga'i sbyor ba ni/ /dkyil 'khor snga ma ji bzhin no/ /dkyil 'khor nye bar spyod pa kun/ /cho ga 'di 7ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i rtog pa'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor chen po mchog /yang dag rab tu bshad bya ba/ /'jig rten gsum las rnam rgyal zhes/ /bya ba rdo rje hūṃ mdzad grags/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis ni mdzes par byas/ /de yi nang du 'khor lo ni/ /dkyil 'khor na brgyad pa lta bu'o0/ /de yi dbus su khro bo che/ /'jig rten 86—146

gsum las rnam rgyal yang / /khro gnyer ldan zhing smin ma 'khyog① /spyan gsal 'bar ba chen po ba/ /cung zad mche ba gtsigs pa'i zhal/ /rnam par dgod cing slar khro ba/ /g.yon ②brkyang ba yi gzhabs kyis ni/ / bka' zlog rjodabang phyug chen po gnon/ /sangs rgyas phreng ba sogs pas spras/ /ind+ra nī la mtshungs pa'i 'od/ /phyag bzhi pa la spyan gsum pa/ /zhal bzhi pa la thub par dka' / /be con dang ni zhags par brjod⑤/ /dang po na ni rdo rjer bshad/ /gnyis pa zhags pa sdigs ⑥mdzub can/ /phyag gnyis khu tshur dam pa mchog /khu tshur gnyis ni rab tu brtag /mthe chung gnyis cani mnyam sbyor bsti/ /lu gu rgyud kyis ⑧rnam par sbrel0/ /snying gar ⑩phyag rgya legs bzhag ⑩nas/ /sdigs ⑫mdzub gnyis kyis bsdigs par mdzad/ /'jig rten gsum rgyal zhes bya ba'i/ /phyag rgya mchog tu thub par dka'/ /sngags ni ming gi de nyid ldan/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba tsomanyam par 'khrigs/ /dkyil 'khor de yi 8gnas rnams su/ /cha rnams kun ni 8thams cad nas/ /phyag rgya thams cad mnyam par bri/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor mnyam gnas par/ /ral gri 'khor lo gzhu dang mda'/ /de bzhin du ni dgra sta nyid/ /de la sogs pa'i mtha' yas mchog /mdor bsdus nas ni phyag rgya dgod/ /de ltar khro bo'i dkyil 'khor thams cad rnam par bkod tsonas nye bar mkho ⑩ba'i mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod par bya'o/ /'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de nas dkyil 'khor chen po mchog /yang dag rab tu bshad bya ba/ /sangs rgyas dpa' bo thams cad kyis/ /'gro ba 'dul ba zhes su bshad/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /dar dang me tog chun pos brgyanatunye/ /de dbus dkyil 'khor chen po ni/ /chu 86—147

zhes bya ba'i ming can no/ /de yi dbus su pad chen po/ /'dab ①ma brgyad pa yid 'ong ba/ /de yi lte ba'i dbus su ni/ /'gro ba 'dul ba zhes bya ba/ /zla ba'i 'od can zla ba'i mdog /ral pa'i cod ②pan 'dzin pa can/ /phyag bzhi pa la zhal bzhi pa/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan ③pa po/ /sangs rgyas phreng ba sogs pas spras/ /sku rnams thams cad kun nas spro/ /mtha' yas rab 'byam ④rgya che ba'i/ /chos dbyings mnyam dang mi mnyam la/ /de yi sngags su yongs grags pa/ /sha ṣa'i sde yi mtha' dge ba/ /kṣa yig don ldan sngon byung ba/ /rgyu yi don du rab sgrub byed/ /bzhi pa'i dbyangs kyis spyi bor mnan/ /me yi sa bon gsal bar byed/ /thig le sgra ni mchog tu sbyin/ /'jig rten dbang phyug zhes ⑤bya'i mtshan/ /de yi phyag rgya yang dag bshad/ /padmo'i thal mo rab tu brkyang ske/ /bris pa'i phyag rgyar yang dag bshad/ /dbyug gu ⑥ril ba spyi blugs bri / /mdun du bgrang phreng padma yi/ /rgyal po zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gzhag /de la sogs pa mtha' yas mchog /phyag rgya mchog tu 'bar de dag /'gro ba 'dul ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /ji ltar rigs par ⑦dgod par bya/ /'gro ba 'dul ba zhes bya ba'i 3)dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal po'o9)// //de nas dkyil 'khor chen po mchog /gzhan ni rab tu bshad par bya/ /dpa' bo rin chen snying po yi/ /rdo rje rin chen zhes su bshad/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis ni mdzes par bya7/ /de yi dbus su rin chen che//yan lag brgyad pa mchog tu 'bar/ /de dbus rin chen padma ni/ /rin chen phreng bas rnam par mdzes/ /de dbus ma ra ka ta 'dra/ /rin chen rdo rje cher 'bar ba/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi cod phan can/ /rin chen phreng bas rnam par 86—148
