mdzes/ /mdun du kun gyi dbang bskur gtsol/ /rin chen de yi gtso bo mchog /g.yas su padma rā ga ste/ /rgyab tu ind+ra ②ni la'o/ /yid bzhin nor bu rin chen g.yon/ /phyag rgya rnam pa sna tshogs mchog /sna tshogs rin chen rnam par brgyan/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi grwa yi ②ni/ /gnas rnams su ni gzhag ④par bya/ /sangs rgyas dpa' bo thams cad kyis/ /de yi sngags su yongs grags pa/ /bzhi pa'i sde yi dang po gang / /me yi sa bon gyis gsal byas/ /dbyangs kyi ⑤gnyis pas kun nas mnan/ /dbang sgyur yib ni steng du gnas/ /de yi phyag rgya yang dag bshad/ /rin chen snyim pa rgyab bskums ⑦te/ /rin chen rnam pa legs byung dub/ /de ni rdo rje rin chen no/ /rdo rje rin po che'i dkyil 'khor ro// //de nas dkyil 'khor chen po mchog /yang dag rab tu bshad bya ba/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis ni mdzes par ⑨byas/ /thig bzhi dang ni yang dag ldan/ /rdo rje 0phreng bas rnam par mdzes/ /de yi dbus su zhal bzhi pa'i/ /'khor lo bzhin du rtsonyeyongs bskor ba'o/ /de yi dbus su pad chen po'o/ /kha dog sna tshogs yongs 'bar ba/ /de yi dbus su brtson chen po//rdo rje sna tshogs 7yongs su bri/ /rdo rje khu tshur 'dzin 'amadzes pa/ /rgyan tso rnams kun gyis brgyan pa po/ /kha dog sna tshogs gzi brjid che/ /sangs rgyas phreng bas rnam par mdzes/ /de yi sngags ni yang dag bshad/ /bcu gnyis pa yi 7dbyangs kyi mtha'/ /mya ngan 'das don legs gsal byasa'i/ /sgeg sogs rig ma thams cad kyis/ /de bzhin rang gi phyag rgya yis/ /rdo rje'i thig le yongs su ldan/ /sna tshogs bkra ba mchog tu 'bar/ /de yi dbang bskur phyag 86—149

rgya yis/ /mchod pa kun gyis ①thams cad ②nas/ /kun nas yongs su bskor ba yi③ / /las kyi dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /las kyi dkyil 'khor ro// //de nas dkyil 'khor chen po mchog /yang dag rab tu bshad bya ba/ /shes rab ye shes 'khor lo che/ /sngags kyi yi ges rnam par brgyanadu/ /de yi dbus su pad chen po/ /'dab ⑤ma brgyad pa shin tu mdzes/ /de yi lte ba'i dkyil du ni/ /gzhon nu sna tshogs gzugs ldan pa/ /sku mdog dmar zhing 'dzum bcas pa/ /sna tshogs gzugs can ral gri can/ /phyag bzhi pa la zhal bzhi pa/ /ral gri'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan⑥/ /gsang sngags chen po yi ge lnga/ /de yi drung du legs par gnas/ /dbyangs kyi bcu gnyis gsang sngags ni⑦ / /thugs ka duru ni yang dag gnas/ /phyi rol nyid ni gru bzhi mdzes/ /thig bzhi dang ni yang dag ldan/ /rta babs bzhi dang mnyam par sbyor/ /sgo bzhi ⑨yis ni shin tu mdzes/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa nyid/ /de la dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /gal te dngos grub mchog 'dod na/ /'bad pa yis ni bri bar bya/ /sngon du bshad pa'i cho ga yis/ /mchod sogs cho ga rgyas pa nyid/ /gzhug pa'i cho ga de bzhin du/ /ji ltar dkyil 'khor 'dir mthong bzhin/ /shes rab ye shes kyi ⑩dkyil 'khor ro// //de nas dkyil 'khor chen po mchog /yang dag rab tu bshad bya ba/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis ni mdzes par byas/ /thig bzhi dang ⑫ni yang dag ldan/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /de yi nang du bri bya ba/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bla na med/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung phreng ba ni/ /'bad pa yis ni bri bar bya/ /'khor lo'i dbus su brtson chen po/ /rdo rje'i rgyu ni stobs 86wa 150

po che/ /phyag bzhi pa la zhal bzhi pa/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa poyi/ /kha dog nag po gzi brjid che/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor mdzad/ /de yi sngags gyur mdzes pa ni/ /rgyu yi don du so sor bskyed/ /dbyangs drug dang ni yang dag ldan/ /thig le phyi mos rnam par brgyan/ /rang gi yi ge'i phreng ba chedu/ /'khor lo gnyis kyis rnam par brgyan / /de yi mdun du dung yin la/ /rgyab tu zhags par dubarjod par bya/ /rdo rje'i thal mo phyag rgya che/ /'khor lo bzhin du rab tu gnas/ /mchod pa thams cad rab tu brtag /ji ltar dkyil 'khor snga ma bzhin/ /de lta'i dkyil 'khor bris nas ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bla na med/ /thog mar chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /dngos grub thams cad yang dag 'bar/ /chos kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor ro// //de nas dkyil 'khor chen po mchog /yang dag rab tu bshad bya ba/ /thog ma'i dkyil 'khor sbyor ba yis/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi thig gdab bo/ /de yi dkyil du snang ba che/ /mkha' bzhin shin tu 'od gsal ba/ /sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i mdzod/ /padma'i rgyal po ⑤rab tu bzhugs/ /zla ba'i mdog can gzi brjid che/ /sna tshogs mtshon cha 'dzin pa'i mchog /gzhon nu rab tu brjid pa'i zhal/ /nam mkha'i mdzod ces rab tu grags/ /sangs rgyas phreng ba sogs pas spras/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor brgyan ⑥par mdzad/ /'di yi gsang sngags gzi brjid che/ /dbyangs dgu pa la thig wedang / /nā da yis ni rnam par brgyan(pe/ /sde tshan dang po'i gsum pa la/ /thig le nā das rnam par brgyan/ /de yang gtso bo'i gsang sngags 'gyural/ /nam mkha'i mdzod ni rab bskor ⑨mdzad/ /de lta'i dkyil 'khor bris nas ni/ /sngags kyi phreng ba mchog 86—151

ldan pa/ /ma lus pa yi sa rnams ①kun/ /thams cad nas ni nam mkha'i tshul/ /tog ni phyag rgyar ⑧gyur pa de'i/ /de bzhin du ni nges par bcing / /de lta'i dkyil 'khor bris nas ni/ /nam mkha' yi ni mdzod de la/ /gal te bdag ni grub 'dod na/ /mchod pa kun gyis rnam par mchod/ /nam mkha'i mdzod kyi dkyil 'khor ro// //de nas dkyil 'khor chen po mchog /yang dag rab tu bshad bya ba/ /dkyil 'khor snga ma'i sbyor ba yis/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad thig gdab bo/ /dkyil 'khor de yi dbus su ni/ /khro bo'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa/ /der yang rdo rje me ①yi mchog /dkyil 'khor gyi ni mchog tu 'dod/ /de yi dbus su gzi brjid che/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin bla na med/ /phyag bzhi pa la zhal bzhi pa/ /padma'i rgyal po la rab gnas/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa'i lus/ /bdud rnams thams cad rab 'joms mdzad/ /de sngags yi ger gyur pa nime/ /sha ṣa'i sde tshan mthar dge ba/ /rgyu yi don du legs gsal bya/ /khro bo'i dkyil 'khor chen po bskor/ /sngags kyi yi ge phreng ba che/ /'bad pa yis ni bri bar bya / /de lta'i dkyil 'khor bris nas ni/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin de yis ⑤ni/ /gal te dngos grub mchog 'dod na/ /sgyu ma thams cad gzhom par bya/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi dkyil 'khor chen po'o// //de nas dkyil 'khor chen po mchog /yang dag rab tu bshad bya ba/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis ni mdzes par byasardzi/ /de yi dbus su 'khor lo che/ /lcags kyu yis ni rnam pas (skyemadzes/ /dbus su bcom ldan rdo rje rgyal/ /lcags kyu la ni rab tu bzhugs/ /phyag bzhi pa la zhal bzhi pa/ /86—152

rgyan rnams thams cad rab tu 'bar/ /rdo rje lcags kyu khu tshur che/ /'bar ba 'phro bas rnam par brgyan①/ /'gro ba thams cad 'gugs par mdzad/ /sngags kyi yi ges legs par sbyar/ /sha ṣa'i sde yi drung gnas pa/ /byed pa'i rgyu ru legs par gnas/ /dbyangs drug pa yis legs par phye/ /zla phyed thig les legs par brgyan②/ /lcags kyu'i phyag rgya ①legs par sbyar/ /'gugs par byed la don yod pa'o/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor bris nas ni/ /rdo rje lcags kyu mchog tu dge/ /dgug pa la sogs thams cad la/ /'gro ba 'dul ba yongs su bsdu/ /don yod rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor ro// //de nas dkyil 'khor chen po mchog /yang dag rab tu bshad bya ba/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis ni mdzes par byasabya/ /thig bzhi dang ni yang dag ldan/ /dngos grub dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor de yi dbus su ni/ /dkyil 'khor lcags kyu'i rnam pa can/ /de yi dbus su gru gsum grags/ /lcags kyu mchog tu dge ba'o/ /de yi dbus su sems dpa' chel/ /rdo rje rgyal po stobs po che/ /phyag bzhi pa la zhal bzhi pa/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa po( ste/ /gzi brjid chen po dkar dang dmar/ /zhags pa lcags kyu 'dzin dge ba/ /de yi gsang sngags yang dag bshad/ /don yod 'bras bu stsol ba po/ /sde tshan gnyis pa'i gsum pa ni/ /gnyis 'gyur nyid du rnam par gnas/ /de yi thig le shu mya ngan 'das/ /sngags kyi phreng ba gzhan gyis bskor/ /sgeg mo la sogs mchod pa che/ /'bad pa yis ni bri bar bya/ /sgo skyong ba dang mchod pa yang / /sbyor ba ji bzhin rnam par dgod/ /de lta'i dkyil 'khor bris nas ni/ /mchod pa thams cad yongs su sgrub(khu/ /rdo rje rgyal 86—153

po'i dkyil 'khor ro// //de nas dkyil 'khor chen po mchog /yang dag rab tu bshad bya ba/ /sangs rgyas dpa' bo thams cad kyis/ /rdo rje chags pa zhes su bshad/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis ni mdzes par byas/ /thig bzhi dang ni yang dag ldan/ /chags pa'i dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /thams cad dmar pos rab dregs pa①/ /dbang du byed pa'i dam pa yin/ /de yi dbus su pad chen po/ /'dab ②ma brgyad pa ge sar bcas/ /de yi lte ba'i dbus su ni/ /rdo rje chags pa bri bar bya/ /padma rā ga ②mtshungs pa'i 'od/ /phyag bzhi pa la zhal bzhi pa/ /spyan gsum 'od kyi phreng ba can/ /de yi phyag rgya mchog tu ni/ /mdzes pa yi ④ni mda' gzhur 'gyur/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis mdzes pa'i lus/ /'gro ba kun la ches dumachog gyuraX/ /de yi gsang sngags mdzes gyur pa/ /rdo rje chags pa mchog tu bde/ /sha ṣa'i sde yi mthar gyur ⑦pa/ /kṣa yi yi ge'i sngon du gnas/ /dbyangs dgu pa dang yang dag ldan/ /sngags kyi ⑤phreng bas yang dag brgyan(1/ /me tog mda' ni yongs su 'phen/ /re ba thams cad yongs rdzogs mdzad/ /de lta'i dkyil 'khor bris ⑩nas ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rab mchod hu)byed/ /rdo rje chags pa'i dkyil 'khor ro// //de nas dkyil 'khor chen po mchog /yang dag rab tu bshad bya ba/ /rdo rje legs pa zhes grags pa/ /gnyis su med pa'i dga' ba'ang 'phel gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis ni mdzes par byas/ /de yi dbus su cher mdzes pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa gru 8bzhi pa/ /de yi dbus su pad chen po/ /ze 'bru yis ni nye bar mdzes/ /de yi lte ba'i dkyil du ni/ /zla 86—154

ba'i gzugs brnyan yang dag 'bar/ /der gnas dpa' bo bsam par bya/ /rdo rje legs pa stobs po che/ /dung dang kunda zla ba dkar/ /kha ba ba zho'i 'od ltar ①mdzes/ /legs so stsol ba tshim par mdzad/ /ting nge 'dzin dbang mang po 0sgyur/ /rdo rje sgeg mo sogs mchod pa/ /de bzhin me tog bdug pa sogs/ /sgo yi skyong ba nyid kyang ni/ /rab tu 'bad de bri bar bya/ /de yi sngags gyur mdzes pa ni/ /gsang ba chen po mchog tu 'bar/ / ha yi ②yi ge sngon gang de/ /sems can don ni rab sgrub byed/ /thig le gnyis dang yongs su ldan/ /legs stsol bas ni rnam par gnas/ /de lta'i dkyil 'khor bris nas ni/ /mchod pa thams cad rab tu bskor/ /bdag nyid dag pas gzhug ④pa sogs/ /thams cad yongs su spyad par bya/ /rdo rje legs pa'i dkyil 'khor ro// //de nas dkyil 'khor chen po mchog /yang dag rab tu bshad bya ba/ /rdo rje gzi brjid zhes ⑤su grags/ /rdo rje nyi ma ①blo gros ldan/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis ni mdzes par byasal/ /thig bzhi dang ni yang dag ldan/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bri bar bya/ /de yi nang du bri bya ba/ /rdo rje nyi ma 'od chen poni/ /rdo rje nyi ma'i steng du ni/ /gru gsum rnam pa las byung ba/ /de yi dbus su gzi brjid che/ /'bar ba yi ni me lta bu/ /padma chen po 'dab yosabargyad pa/ /ze 'bru yis ni shin tu mdzes/ /de yi lte ba'i dkyil du ni⑩/ /rdo rje gzi brjid stobs po che/ /bzang po'i mtshal yidang mtshungs pa'i 'od/ /rgya skyegs khu ba tsomatshungs pa'i mdog /phyag bzhi pa la zhal bzhi pa/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis 7brgyan pa'o/ /de yi sngags su yongs grags pa/ /kun nas sangs rgyas mtshungs pa ④nyid/ /dbyangs yig bcu gcig pa yi mtha'/ /nyi ma'i 86—155

dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /sngags kyi phreng bas yongs su bskor/ /rang gi phyag rgya'i mtshan ma ldan/ /de lta'i dkyil 'khor bris nas ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rab mchod bya/ /rdo rje gzi brjid kyi ①dkyil 'khor ro// //de nas dkyil 'khor chen po mchog /yang dag rab tu bshad bya ba/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyal mtshan ming / /bdag nyid chen po rdo rje'i snotog /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis ni mdzes par byas/ /thig bzhi dang ni yang dag ldan/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor de yi dbus su ni/ /mchog tu 'bar ba yi ni rlung / /zla ba phyed pa'i rnam pa 'dra/ /rin chen rgyal mtshan yongs bsgreng ③ba/ /de yi dbus su sems dpa' che/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa po/ /zhal bzhi pa la gzi brjid che/ /ind+ra ④gri la mtshungs pa'i 'od/ /rin chen char pa rab tu 'bebs/ /phyag bzhi pa la snang ba che/ /de yi gsang sngags gzi brjid che/ /sde tshan bzhi pa'i dang po la/ /me yis rab tu gsal byas pa/ /tog gi phyag rgyas yongs su bskor/ /sngags kyi phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /de lta'i dkyil 'khor bris nas ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rab mchod bya/ /rdo rje tog gi dkyil 'khor ro// //de nas dkyil 'khor chen po mchog /yang dag rab tu bshad bya ba/ /rdo rje bzhad pa zhes grags pa/ /rdo rje bzhad pa mtshungs pa'i 'od/ /gru ⑤bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis ni mdzes par byas/ /thig bzhi dang ni yang dag ldan/ /dkyil 'khor chen po bri bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor de dbus skum po ni / /ind+ra nī la mtshungs pa'i 'od/ /de bzhin chu ni gzi brjid can/ /phyag rgya 'khor los rnam par mdzes/ /dkyil 'khor de yi dbus su ni/ /ston ku'i 86—156

zla ba 'dra ba'i 'od/ /'gro ba mtha' dag snang mdzad pa/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa po/ /phyag bzhi pa la zhal bzhi pa/ /dbang phyug thams cad yang dag ldan/ /de yi gsang sngags gsang chen po/ /rgyu yi don du bsgrub par bya/ /stong pa mngon brjod bsam mi khyab/ /rang ming rtogs pas mtshan pa'o/ /de lta'i dkyil 'khor bris nas ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rab mchod bya/ /rdo rje bzhad pa'i dkyil 'khor ro// //de nas dkyil 'khor chen po mchog /yang dag rab tu bshad bya ba/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis ni mdzes par byas/ /thig bzhi dang ni yang dag ldan/ /dngos grub dkyil 'khor yang dag bri/ /de yi steng du'ang padma che/ /padma me las yang dag byung / /gru gsum mchog tu mdzes pa po/ / sum mdo ris kyis ①rnam par brgyan②/ /chos dbyings yi ge'i de kho na/ /thams cad gzi brjid bdag nyid dge/ /de yi bdag ③gi de nyid ni/ /'phro ba'i ma ra ka ta 'dra/ /phyag bzhi pa la zhal bzhi pa/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa po/ /gnyis pa'i mdog tu gyur pa ni/ /padma rā ga mtshungs pa'i 'od//ji srid ngag gi 'khor lo ni/ /smra ba'i dbye bas ④rab tu gnas/ /thams cad so sor gsal bar byed/ /sprin gyi dkyil 'khor mchog rmad byung / /de lta'i dkyil 'khor bris nas ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rab mchod bya/ /rdo rje smra ba'i dkyil 'khor ro// //de nas dkyil 'khor chen po mchog /yang dag rab tu bshad bya ba/ /dkyil 'khor snga ma'i sbyor ba yis/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad bri bar bya/ /de yi dbus su go cha che/ /rin chen kun gyis rnam par brgyan⑤/ /de yi dbus su 86—157

brtson chen po/ /rdo rje bsrung ba ①yang dag bri/ /phyag bzhi pa la zhal bzhi pa/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa po/ /kha dog sna tshogs gzi brjid che/ /thams cad bsrung ②ba mchog tu dge/ /phyag rgya sngags dang yang dag ldan/ /gsang ba chen po'i ②go 'phang mchog /de yi gsang sngags gzi brjid che/ /sha ṣa'i sde yi mthar gnas mchog /mgon po'i rgyur ni mngon par brjod/ /steng du nā das brgyan par byas④/ /kun nas kha dog du ma yis/ /yongs su bskor bar ⑤bsgom par bya/ /sngags kyi phreng ba yongs su ldan/ /glog gi phreng bas rnam par brgyan⑥ / /de lta'i dkyil 'khor bris nas ni/ /mchod pa thams cad rab bsgrub ⑦rgya/ /rdo rje bsrung duba'i dkyil 'khor ro// //de nas dkyil 'khor chen po mchog /yang dag rab tu bshad bya ba/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis ni mdzes par byadhi/ /thig bzhi dang ni yang dag ldan/ /khu tshur dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor de yi dbus su ni/ /rdo rje padma yid 'ong ba/ /gzi brjid chen po gser gyi mdog /'dab ⑩ma brgyad pa yid 'ong ba/ /de yi steng du gzi brjid che/ /rdo rje khu tshur stobs po che/ /phyag bzhi pa la zhal bzhi pa/ / sna tshogs rgyan (nyegyis brgyan pa po / /kunda dung dang zla ba dkar/ / khu 4nyatshur de bzhin gshegs kun gyi(/ste/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs khu tshur/ rdo rje nyid du mnyam nyid mchog /gnyis su med pa mchog gsang mib/ /khu tshur gyis ni sdud par bshad/ /de sngags mchog tu dga' ba ni/ /brjod midu med nyid stsol mdzad pa/ /sde tshan lnga pa'i gsum pa ni/ /'bar ba'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor can/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi rdo rje'i sku / /'di yi sngags la rnam par gnas/ /de lta'i dkyil 'khor bris nas ni/ /86—158

rdo rje khu tshur mchod par bya/ /rdo rje khu tshur gyi ①dkyil 'khor ro// //de la sogs pa ②mtha' yas mchog /dkyil 'khor mchog tu 'bar ba ni/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi mtha' ⑤klas pa'i/ /sangs rgyas byang chub stsol bar mdzad/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /'jig rten pa yi dkyil 'khor mchog /de bzhin gru bzhir ④gris nas ni/ /sgo khyud la sogs rnam par spangaphyi/ /rtse gsum partsi saXdang ni/ /dung dang padma sogs pas brgyan⑦/ /thog mar dbang phyug chen po dgod/ /rtse gsum pa yi phyag rgyar ldan/ /khyu mchog la zhon mig gsum pa/ /stag gi pags nirgyan phyag bzhi pa/ /thal bas byugs shing mgo bo la/ /ral pa'i tshogs ni rab 'phyang ba/ /chu yi dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la/ /phyag 'tshal ba ni 'di 'bri'o/ / de yi ⑩sngags ni/ oṃ tri shes sum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ gsang sngags 'di ni cher gsang ba/ /bdag nyid chen po dbang phyug che'i/ /dbang phyug chen po'i dkyil 'khor ratso/ /dkyil tu 'khor chen po de nyid la dbang phyug tsochen po'i gnas su nag po chen po gzhag par bya'o/ /lag pa stong gis tsogar byed pa dang ldan pa'i dga' byed dbang phyug dang lhan cig ⑩phyag bzhi pa spyan gsum pa'o⑩/ /lag pa stong gis gnas pa'o/ /rang gi sngags ni/ oṃ ma hā kā la rtsu bhyoḥyi/ oṃ nan di ke shwa ra /behūṃ bhyo/ 'di bzlas na dngos grub thams cad byed do/ /dga' byed dbang phyug dang / nag po chen po'i dkyil 'khor ronu )/ /de nyid kyi ni cho ga yis/ /dkyil 'khor gru bzhi thig gdab bya/ /der ni padma yang dag bri/ /padma'i dbus su sbrang rtsi byed/ /la sogs ming po gsum ( )bri'o/ /gzhu yi phyag rgya yongs su 'dzin/ /sbrang rtsi byed dang rgyal ba byed/ /de bzhin nyid du'ang sgrub 86—159

byed do①/ /me tog mda' dang yongs su ldan/ /rang gi ming rtogs mtshan ma can/ /sngags ni/ oṃ ma dhū kṛta sne/ oṃ sī/ oṃ dhwa na sul/ gsang sngags 'di ni 'dod gzugs can/ /dbang du byed pa thams cad sgrub/ /sbrang rtsi rdo rje la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor rodu/ /dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa bris nas dbus su thig bzhi gdab bo/ /dbus su tum bu ru'o/ /shar gyi 'dab dumar rgyal ba'o/ /lho ru rnam par rgyal ba'o/ /nub tu mi thub pa'o/ /byang du gzhan gyis mi thub pa'o/ /de lta bu'i dkyil 'khor bris nas go rims 0ji lta ba bzhin du gsang sngags dgod par bya'o/ /oṃ rtu bu ru rgyuX/ oṃ dza ye 'o⑦/ oṃ bi dza ye tsāni/ oṃ a dzi te tsā'-i/ oṃ a pa rā dzi te /⑩/ dga' ba 'di dag lag g.yon du/ /khu tshur g.yon pas rab grub ⑪stsol/ /'di yi phyag rgya nyid gyur pa//sangs rgyas kun gyis rab tu brtags/ /lag par dgod pa tsorab bshad bya/ /go rims 'ji lta ba bzhin du/ /tum ④bu ru ni mthe ⑩bor dgod/ /sdigs ⑩mdzub la ni rgyal ba gnas/ /rnam rgyal gung mo nyid la'o/ /mi thub de bzhin ming med la/ /gzhan gyis ⑩mi thub mthe'u 8chung la/ /lag pa'i dbus su yi ge oṃ/ /dgod bya de nyid lag pa'i rgyab/ /rdo rje phreng ba'i mthar thug tu/ /dgod par bya ba mchog tu bshad/ /sbyor dang rnam par dbye ba yang / /phyag rgya kun spyod yongs su bsdu/ /so sor brtan ⑩par bya ba nyid/ /sor mo rnams la khyad par du/ /dbang dang dgug dang rmongs la sogs/ /rengs byed la sogs go rims 8)bzhin/ /las rnams dag ni thams cad du/ /sngags pas mnyam par gzhag ste pyo nyebya/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad slar yang 'dus te gshegs nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi dbang 86—160

phyug chen po la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i mtshan rnams kyis ①legs par bstod pa ②mdzad de/ bcom ldan 'das mnyes par mdzad pa/byang chub sems ni rdo rje che/ /sangs rgyas de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /dgra bcom 'dod chags bral ba dang / /legs pa chos kyi du'abyung gnas mchog /blo gros dag pa ye shes che/ /thams cad mkhyen pa kun rig mchog /mchog gi dbang phyug dpa' ba 0che/ /thog ma tha ma med khyab bdag /dum 'dres ma 'dres pa yi don/ /shin tu phra ba mchog sbyin rgyal/ /rdo rje can chen rnal 'byor che/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor dbang phyug dumachog /mi bskyod pa dang mi zad mgon/ /chos dbyings gzhan dang gzhan min pa/ /rin chen 'byung gnas rdo rje mchog /dbang bskur kun gyi bla ma'i bla/ /theg chen che ba'i mchog gi mchog /dpa' bo mchog tu dpa' ba'i ⑦mchog /zab cing yang dul phra ba dang / /thams cad thams cad de bzhin gshegs/ /'khor los sgyur khyaba'i rgyal po che/ /tsha ⑩skyob dkar po stobs po che/ /gzi brjid phung po gzi brjid 7che/ /phul byung phul las phul du byung / /rgyu med mchog gi mchog dpa' mchog /gzi mchog gzi brjid byed mtshungs pa/ /rgyal ba rgyal ba mchog nyid dang / /legs pa'i rgyal po bdag nyid che/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sems 8chen po'/ /rdo rje rgyal po lcags kyu che/ /rdo rje chags pa mda' chen po/ /rdo je legs pa legs grub mdzad/ /rdo rje rin chen che mchog mchog /rdo rje gzi brjid legs brjid mdzad/ /rgyal mtshan chen po rin chen tog /rdo rje bzhad ④pa legs bzhad mdzad/ /'jig rten dbang phyug padma che/ /shes rab ye shes legs rno mdzad/ /chos kyi 'khor lo chos chen po/ /sems dpa' smra ba legs bzhad mdzad/ /sna tshogs las ni 86—161

rgyal po che/ /rdo rje bsrung ①ba legs bsrung ②mdzad/ /khro bo chen po gnod sbyin che/ /rdo rje mtshams sbyor mtshams sbyor sel/ /phyag 'tshal sangs rgyas kun khyod la / /dang po'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug mchog /legs so rdor can rnal 'byor che / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dge/ /snying po'i rgyan zhes mtshan gsol ba/ /'di dag thams cad legs par gsungs/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi byang chub sems/ /ye shes snying po shin tu mdzes/ /gsang ba chen po mchog tu gsang ②/ /sba bya shin tu rnyed dka' ba/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i mdo/ /brjod du med cing yi ge bral/ /rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud chen po las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i dkyil 'khor 'byung ba ④zhes bya ba'i rtog pa rgyas pa 'di yongs su rdzogs stol// // de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad slar yang 'dus te gshegs nas/ bcom ldan 'das thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po la gsol ba btab bo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rjo rje rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen pos de dag gis gsol ba btab pa'i tshig nye bar gsan nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yul la 'jug pa ye shes rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /de ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das ma yang snyoms par zhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po 'di skad cig 97nyid la 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi shes rab kyi ye shes rdo rje la zhugs par gyur to/ /zhugs nas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po (7shes rab ye shes kyi 86—162

ting nge 'dzin gsal bar mdzad cing brtan par gyur nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ①thugs de las 'thon ②te/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yul chos kyi dbyings kyi mtha' klas pa ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i sems can gyi khams thams cad snang bar mdzad nas/ sems can thams cad kyi'ang shes rab dang ye shes rnam par sbyangs te/ byang chub kyi sems bskyed nas bkug cing rjes su mnyes par byas nas legs par mdzad nas rnam par gnas te/ rdo rje sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin legs par yongs su rdzogs par mdzad nas mngon par dbang bskur te/ gzi brjid dang / tog dang / bzhad pa dang / de dag la nges par sbyar te mchog ①gi dbang phyug chen po las rdo rje sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis chos rtogs pa la yang rab tu gnas nas rnon po dang / rgyu dang / smra ba'i sems dpa' rnams la'ang thugs brtan par mdzad de/ yongs su dag nas yang padmo'i sems dpa'i ④ting nge 'dzin la rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i dbang phyug chos nyid gzhi med pa la sbyar nas sna tshogs pa'i las kyi bdag po dang ⑤/ sems can yongs su smin par byed pa bsrung ba dang / khro bo dang ⑥/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje mtshams sbyor ba rnams sems can gyi khams mtha' dag yongs su smin pa dang / byin gyis brlabs te slar log nas bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kur rtsirjes su zhugs te/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi shes rab kyi ye shes la bzhugs slonas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o ⑨zag med shes rab bdagatso /sangs rgyas skyob pa thams cad kyi/ /shes rab shin tu dri med sems/ /sems dpa'i lus su bdag gyur to/ /dri med sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /dngos 86—163

dang dngos med rnam dpyad na/ /e ma'o ①chos ni bsam med nyid/ /bdag gi dbang du rnam par gnas/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' ②chen po 'jam dpal bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka dunas 'thon dunas byang chub sems dpa' bcu drug gi lus su mngon par sprul te/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad la yongs su bskor ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi nye 'khor kun tu nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ⑤dang / 'od kyi dkyil 'khor dang / byin gyis brlabs pa zla ba'i rjodakyil 'khor la 'khod par gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyargyud las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mdor bstan pa'i chos kyi tshig bka' stsal du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la bka' stsal pa/'jam dpal khyod de bzhin gshegs pa la don de yongs su zhu bar sems pa ni legs so legs so/ /legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung ⑧shig dang ngas bshad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad du bdag nyid byin gyis brlabs nas sngags kyi tshig 'di dag bka' stsal pa/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi ni nang gi lus dang /phyi'i lus dang / phyi nang gi lus la lus kyi rjes su lta dhizhing brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ldan pa7/ dran pa dang ldan pas 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang yid mi bde ba rnam par bsal cing rnam par spyod do/ /lus la kun 'byung ba'i rjes su blta /1)zhing rnam par spyod do/ /lus la zad pa'i rjes su blta 8zhing rnam par spyod do/ /lus la mi gnas pa'i rnam par spyod cing 'jig rten du gang 86—164

yang nye bar len pa med do/ /nang gi tshor ba dang / phyi'i tshor ba dang / phyi nang gi tshor ba dang / nang gi sems dang / phyi'i sems dang / phyi nang gi sems dang / nang gi chos dang / phyi'i chos dang / phyi nang gi chos la chos kyi rjes su blta ①zhing brtson 'grus can ③shes bzhin dang ldan pa/ dran pa dang ldan pas 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang yid mi bde ba rnam par bsal ①cing rnam par spyod do/ /chos la kun 'byung ba'i rjes su blta 0zhing rnam par spyod do//chos la zad pa'i rjes su blta ⑤zhing rnam par spyod do/ /chos la mi gnas pa'i rnam par spyod cing 'jig rten du gang yang nye bar len pa med do/ /rtag tu shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lus dang / ngag dang / sems dang / chos mnyam pa nyid kyis duganas so/ /oṃ ṭwāṃ oṃ tsa tā ri smṛ khyu pasgralanā nā rtsu/ yang dag par spong ba bzhi ni sdig to mi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams mi bskyed ⑧pa'i phyir de ⑨mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis 'dun ⑩pa skyed 0cing rtsol 8lo/ /brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /sems rab tu 'dzin to0/ /smon lam yang dag par 'debs so/ /sdig to mi dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams spang ba'i phyir 'dun pa la sogs pa dang /dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams skyed ④pa'i phyir 'dun pa skyed 8do/ /'bad do/ /brtson 'grus rtsom mo8/ /sems rab tu 'dzin to/ /smon lam ⑩yang dag par 'debs so/ /dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams 'phel zhing 8rgyas par bya ba dang / yangs par bya ba'i phyir dang /yi bsgom 0pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir 'dun pa skyed 0do/ /'bad do/ /brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /sems rab tu 'dzin to/ /smon lam yang dag par 'debs so/ /chos rnams 'thams cad don dam par mi spong ba dang / mi spong ba ma yin pa'i ched du rtogs par bya'o zhes 4)bcom ldan 86—165

'das rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen pos 'di 6①bka' stsal to/ /oṃ samyaka pra hā ṇa sab ta thā ga ta dus ma tā a dhiṣṭha ③aḥraḥ// yang dag par spong ba rjod ④pa zhes bya ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo'o/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi ni 'dun ⑤pa'i ting nge 'dzin spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa sgom par byed doyi/ /⑦brtson 'grus dang / sems dang /⑧ spyod ⑨pa'i ting nge ⑩'dzin spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa sgom par byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa don dam pa dang / kun rdzob kyi sgo'i chos thams cad sgyu ma 7sgyu ma'i mtshan nyid du 'jug go 8zhes bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad kyi 'khor los sgyur phonyabs bka' stsal to/ /oṃ ṛ ④snyi pā da pā ra mi te la bā 8pa ra hūm̐ hūṃ/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes zhes bya ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /dbang po lnga ni dad pa'i dbang po dang / brtson 'grus kyi dbang po dang / dran pa'i dbang po dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po dang / shes rab kyi dbang po'o/ /bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid la dbang sgyur bas spros pa med pa'i dbang po 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /oṃ isgri tso'i ba bo tunyes pralha i sheñtsa snyinā ma n+ya nā ya 1rteg tā 3 )ya āḥ/tsho gle/ dbang po mnyam pa nyid ces bya ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin 32pa'o/ /stobs lnga ni dad pa'i stobs dang / brtson 'grus kyi stobs dang / dran pa'i stobs dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs dang / shes rab kyi stobs so zhes bka' stsal to/ /bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid la gnas pa/ stobs thams cad rtogs pa/ spros pa thams cad dang bral ba/ gdod ma nas dag pas 'di bka' stsal pa/ oṃ sasba ta thā ga tā ba la 86—166

aḥrgyu rtsu baḥl/ stobs 'phel ba zhes bya ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshangs pa'i gnas pa bzhi ni/ byams pa dang / snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyoms sol/ /oṃ brahma bi hā rā dhiṣṭha na gi ni rdu gho rghaṃ :du/chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid ces bya ba ⑤shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bka' stsal to/ /tshangs pa'i gnas pa byin gyis rlob pa'o/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi ni/ spobs pa so so ⑥yang dag par rig pa dang / nges pa'i tshig so so yang dag par rig pa dang / don so so yang dag par rig pa dang /chos so so yang dag par rig pa'o zhes bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad sgyu ma'i mtshan nyid du so so yang dag par rig pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o zhes bka' stsal to/ /oṃ pra ti sambi daḥrtsig rtsu/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam pa nyid do/ /rjes su dran pa drug gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa dang ske/ chos rjes su dran pa dang / dge 'dun rjes su dran pa dang / gtong ba rjes su dran pa dang / tshul khrims rjes su dran pa dang / lha rjes su dran pa'o⑧/ /chos thams cad gcig tu rjes su dran pa ni chos thams cad don dam pa stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /mtshan nyid dang mtshan nyid med pa rnam par spyod thoXpas mnyam pa nyid kyi sgo zhes bya ba 'di ting nge 'dzin la dbang sgyur bas bka' stsal to/ /oṃ sabra a nu smṛ ⑩ti bu: phonyasi pa dā di shi rghaṃ rdu hūṃ/ rjes su dran pa drug gi shes rab bo/ /byang chub kyi yan lag bdun gang zhe na/ dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / chos rnam par 'byed pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi 86—167

yan lag dang / ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ste/ byang chub kyi yan lag mnyam pa nyid skye ba med pa'i mtshan nyid ces bya ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bka' stsal to//oṃ sarba tā ①bo : ga sa ma 0tā su pra tikhri ③te sgru du / ⑤'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad dugang zhe na/ yang dag pa'i lta ba dang / yang dag pa'i rtog pa dang ske/ yang dag pa'i ngag dang / yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' dang / yang dag pa'i 'tsho ⑦ba dang / yang dag pa'i rtsol ⑧ba dang / yang dag pa'i dran pa dang ske/ yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /lam zad mi shes pa'i byang chub kyi sems chen po la 'jug pa legs par so sor rig pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes sol/ /oṃ ā cas ga mārga ma 0ṭa/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa mnyam pa 0nyid ces bya ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gsum ni stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa'o/ /de la stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ stong pa'i rnam pa dang / gsog dang gsob kyi 8rnam pa dang / rang bzhin med pa'i rnam pas chos 8thams cad mtshan nyid gcig tu rtogs pa tsosems rtse gcig pa ste/ 'di ni stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin ces brjod do/ /de la mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/gang la mtshan mar mi 8byed pa dang / 'dod pa med pa dang / shes pa med pa dang / zhi ba'i rnam pa dang / rnam par bral ba'i rnam par sems 0rtse gcig pa ste/ 'di ni mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin ces bya'o/ /de la smon pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ mi rtag pa'i rnam pa dang / sdug bsngal ba'i rnam pa sems rtse gcig pa ste/ de ni smon pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin ces bya'o/ /86—168

chos thams cad rtogs nas smon par mi byed do①/ /lha'am lha las gzhan gang yang rung ba don du mi gnyer zhing gsol ba 'debs ②par yang mi 'dod pa ste/dngos po thams cad la ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi sgo yis kyang ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid kyis ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo gsum nye bar rtogs par bya'o/ /oṃ kha sa maḥdusab dharmāḥbya / de la stobs bcu ni gnas dang ⑤gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / las kyi rnam par smin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs dang ske/ khams sna tshogs mkhyen pa'i stobs dang /⑥ dbang po mchog dang ⑦mchog ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / mos pa sna tshogs mkhyen pa'i stobs dang 9 sdug bsngal 'gog pa so sor mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa dang rnam par byang ba ⑨mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / mngon par shes pa lnga mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / zag pa kyizad dhi/pa mkhyen pa'i stobs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid so sor rtogs pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /oṃ da sha ba la sa ma tā bā8/ cistobs bcu mnyam pa nyid ces bya ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad gang zhe na/ gzugs can gyis ⑫gzugs rnams mthong ba 'di ni rnam par thar pa dang po'o/ /nang gzugs med pa'i 'du shes dang ldan pas phyi rol gyi gzugs rnams mthong ba 'di ni rnam par thar pa gnyis pa'o/ /bzang bar mos pa 'di ni rnam par thar pa gsum pa'o/ /gzugs kyi 'du shes las yang dag par 'das te thogs pa'i 'du shes rnams nub par gyur cing / sna tshogs kyi 'du shes rnams yid la mi byed pas nam mkha' mtha' yas so zhes teli/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar 86—169

bsgrubs te gnas pa 'di ni rnam par thar pa bzhi pa'o/ /de rnam pa thams cad du nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ rnam par shes pa mtha' yas so zhes rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas pa 'di ni rnam par thar pa lnga pa'o/ /de rnam pa thams cad du rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ cung zad ma yod do zhes cung zad med pa'i skye mched la ①nye bar bsgrubs te gnas pa 'di ni rnam par thar pa drug pa'o / /de ②rnam pa thams cad du cung zad med pa'i skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ 'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas pa 'di ni rnam par thar pa bdun pa'o/ /de rnam pa thams cad du 'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched las yang dag par 'das te 'du shes dang /tshor ba 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug ①pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas pa 'di ni rnam par thar pa brgyad pa'o/ /chos thams cad spros pa med pa'i mtshan nyid kun nas nyon mongs pa med cing rnam par byang ba med pa/ bsam gtan med cing ske/ bsam gtan med pa ma yin pa④/ snyoms par 'jug pa med cing ⑤ snyoms par 'jug pa ⑥ma yin pa 'di bka' stsal to/ /oṃ sa manta ༷bha dre sarba swa bhā ba 98)bi shurnye rghaṃ ṣi 'a⑨/ gnas dang gnas ma yin pa dang bral ba zhes bya ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /mi 'jigs pa bzhi gang zhe na/ bdag gis yang dag par rdzogs par 1gyesangs rgyas so zhes dam bcas na chos 'di rnams mngon par rdzogs par sangs ma rgyas so zhes bya bar bdag la dge sbyong ngam/bram ze'am/ lha'am/ bdud dam/ tshangs pa'am/ skye dgu'i yitshogs gzhan ci yang rung ste/ 'jig rten na chos dang ldan par rgol bar 'gyur ro 86—170

zhes bya ba'i rgyu yang dag par rjes su ma mthong ste/ rgyu yang dag par rjes su ma mthong bas de la bdag med pa ①thob pa dang / bag tsha ba med pa thob pa dang /mi 'jigs pa thob par ②rnam par spyod de/ khyu mchog rlabs po che'i gnas su dam bca'o①/ /'khor gyi nang du seng ge'i sgra bsgrag 0go/ /tshangs pa'i 'khor lo 'jig rten na ⑤dge sbyong ngam/ bram ze'am/ lha'am/ bdud dam/tshangs pa'am/ skye dgu'i tshogs yigazhan sus kyang rung ste/ chos dang ldan par bskor ⑦bar mi nus pa bdag gis rab tu bskor bar bya'o/ /bdag zag pa zad do zhes dam bcas nas de la zag pa 'di rnams yongs su zad par ma gyur to zhes bya bar bdag la dge sbyong ngam/ bram ze'amadu/ lha'am/ bdud dam / tshangs pa'am/ skye dgu'i 7tshogs gzhan su'ang 7rung ste/ 'jig rten na chos dang 'thun par 7zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /gang yang bdag gis bar chad kyi chos su bstan pa de dag la brten tunyen bar chad kyi chos su mi 'gyur ro zhes bya ba rgyas par sbyar ro/ /gang yang bdag gi zhu lam 'phags pa'i nges par 'byung ba'i lam du bshad pa de yis nges par 'byung bar mi 'gyur te/ yang dag par sdug bsngal zad pa dang / yang dag par sdug bsngal mthar bya bar ga la 'gyur 8zhes dge stong ngam/ bram ze'am/ lha'am/ bdud dam/ tshangs pa'am / skye dgu'i tsotshogs su yang tsorung ste/ 'jig rten na 0chos dang ldan par rgol bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i rgyu yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ba la sogs pa ji ltar gyur pa thams cad yongs su spros te brjod par bya'o/ /mi 'jigs pa ni /nyechos thams cad mnyam pa nyid sgyu ma'i mtshan nyid de ngar 'dzin pa dang nga yir 'dzin pa dang bral ba'i phyir ro/na/ /oṃ bee shā ra bya ri ris ma tā sapta 86—171

a a i aḥl/ mthar gyis gnas pa'i mnyam pa nyid kyi snyoms par 'jug pa dgu gang zhe na/ 'dod pas dben pa/ sdig to mi dge ba'i chos kyis dben pal/ rtog pa dang bcas pa/ dpyod pa dang bcas pa/ dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang bde ba can bsam gtan dang po la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas sol/ /de rnam par rtog pa dang / rnam par dpyod pa nye bar zhi nas nang yongs su dang ste/ sems kyi rgyud gcig tu gyur pas rtog pa med pa/ dpyod pa med pa / ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang bde ba can bsam gtan gnyis pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de dga' ba'i 'dod chags dang bral bas btang snyoms su gnas te/ dran pa dang ldan zhing shes bzhin can bde ba lus kyis myong la 'phags pa rnams kyis de la dran ②pa dang ldan pa'i bde ④ba la rnam par dpyod ⑤pa btang snyoms pa'o 6)zhes brjod pa ste/ dga' ba med pa'i bsam gtan gsum pa la nye bar bsgrubs ⑦te gnas sol/ /de bde ba yang spangs/ sdug bsngal ba yang spangs shing yid bde ba dang / yid mi bde ba snga nas kyang stinub pas bde ba yang med/ sdug bsngal ba yang med/ btang snyoms pa dang / dran pa yongs su dag pa/ bsam gtan bzhi pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du gzugs kyi 'du shes las yang dag par 'das te/ thogs pa'i 'du shes rnams nub par gyur cing sna tshogs kyi 'du shes yid la mi byed pas nam mkha' mtha' yas so zhes te nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched las 7yang dag par 'das te/ rnam 7par shes pa mtha' yas so zhes rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so//86—172

de rnam pa thams cad du rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ cung zad ma yod do zhes cung zad med pa'i skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du cung zad med pa'i skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ 'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du ①'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ 'du shes dang tshor ba 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug ②la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad po dang mnyam pa nyid rjes su thob nas dngos por rtog par mi byed/ dngos po med par rtog par ①mi byed/ chos thams cad gnyis su med par rtogs so/ /'di ni mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu mnyam pa nyid do/ /oṃ a nantaḥbi mokṣa ⑤mu khe (nye/ dngos po thams cad mthar gyis gnas ⑥pa'i rnam par thar pa mnyam pa nyid ces bya ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /de la pha rol tu phyin pa bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang /thabs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / spros pa med pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / yang dag pa'i don gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid kyi don gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / rdo rje'i pha rol tu phyin pa 86—173

dang ske/ rin po che'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / padma'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang /las kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ bstan ①pa'i rjes su rtogs pa'i sbyor bas so/ /oṃ sab pā ra mi ta arsha pa ri pū ②ra ṇi/ oṃ ṭwāṃ ni rta/ thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /de la sa bcu po gang zhe na/ rab tu dga' ba zhes bya ba'i sa dang / dri ma med pa zhes bya ba ④dang / 'od byed pa zhes bya ba dang / 'od 'phro ba zhes bya ba dang / sbyang dka' ba zhes bya ba dang /mngon du gyur pa zhes bya ba dang / ring du song ba zhes bya ba dang / mi g.yo ba zhes (7bya ba dang / legs pa'i blo gros zhes bya ba dang / chos kyi sprin zhes bya ba dang ske/ sa thams cad don gcig ste/ 'di ltar ye shes kyi don to/ /ye shes kyang ci yang med pa/ nyon mongs pa med pa/ yi ge med pa/ don yod pa/gdod ma nas dag pa/ dri ma med pa/ 'od gsal ba⑥/ brjod ⑦pa dang bral ba zhes bya ba'i don to(kye/ /oṃ khyu po)mi bi sho dha ni sa za pa 7ri pū ra ṇi baṃ :kyi//sa yongs su sbyong ba zhes bya ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i gnas pa bcu gang zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dang po bskyed 12pa dang / gzhon nur gyur pa dang / las dang po pa dang / rnal 'byor spyod pa dang / skye ba nas skye bar sbyor ba dang ldan pa dang / bsam pa dang ldan pa dang / phyir mi ldog pa dang / dbang bskur ba thob pa dang / skye ba gcig gis thogs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi /(nyarnam par gnas pa dang / mi gnas pa dor ba ste/ don dam par gnas pa gcig yin pa'i phyir te/ 'di ltar gnas pa medari pa'o/ /oṃ sasba bya thub sthā na bi ga te 'onye /86—174

rnam par gnas pa med pa zhes bya ①ba'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ②dbang bcu gang zhe na/ tshe la dbang ba dang /las la dbang ba dang / yo byad dul dbang ba dang / mos pa la dbang ba dang /smon lam la dbang ba dang / rdzu 'phrul la dbang ba dang / skye ba la dbang ba dang khu/ ye shes la dbang ba dang / chos la dbang ba dang / sems la dbang ba'o⑤la/ /dbang ba dang mi dbang ba yirang bzhin gyis rnam par grol ba thams cad la dbang ba/ dbang phyug thams cad la dbang rjes su thob pa/ chos thams cad ④legs par so sor rtogs pa nyid kyi ⑤phyir ro/ /oṃ sabra ba shi te ṭwāṃ rgyu rdul/ thams cad la dbang ba zhes bya ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /de la sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa ⑩brgyad gang zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa la 'khrul pa mi mnga'o/ /ca co mi mnga'o/ /dgongs pa nyams pa mi mnga'o/ /thugs mnyam par ma bzhag tu pa mi mnga'o/ /'du shes sna tshogs mi mnga'o / /ma brtags pa'i 8btang snyoms mi mnga'o/ /'dun yipa yongs su nyams pa mi mnga'o/ /brtson 'grus yongs su nyams pa mi mnga'o/ /dran ④pa yongs su nyams pa mi mnga'o/ /ting nge 'dzin yongs su nyams pa mi mnga'o/ /shes rab yongs su nyams pa mi mnga'o/ /rnam par grol ba yongs su nyams pa mi mnga'o / /rnam par grol ba'i ye shes gzigs pa yongs su nyams pa mi mnga'o/ /'das pa'i dus la ma thogs ma chags 7pa'i ye shes gzigs pa 'jug go/ /ma 'ongs pa'i dus la ma chags ma thogs pa'i ye shes gzigs pa 'jug go/ /da ltar byung ba'i dus la ma chags ma thogs pa'i ye shes gzigs pa 'jug go/ /sku'i phrin ⑩las thams cad ye shes sngon du 'gro ba ste ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ngo //86—175

gsung gi phrin ①las thams cad ye shes sngon du 'gro ba ste ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ngo / / zothugs kyi phrin las thams cad ye shes sngon du 'gro ba ste ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ngo / /'di chos rje sa skya pa'i bsgyur ②'phro lags/ rgya dpe dul gtugs shing slob dpon rab zhi bshes gnyen gyi 'grel pa dang yang bstun nas/ zhus dag byas shing / mi bcos su mi rung ba re re tsam 'grel pa dang bstun ④nas bcos shing zhu thug ⑤g.yar khral du blangs nas/ bu ston gyis bgyis pa'o// //dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de la sa bcu rnams ci zhe na/rab tu dga' ba zhes bya ba'i sa dang / dri ma med pa zhes bya ba dang / 'od byed pa zhes bya ba dang / 'od 'phro ba zhes bya ba dang / thub par dka' ba zhes bya ba dang / mngon zhudu gyur pa zhes bya ba dang / ring du song ba zhes bya ba dang / mi g.yo ba zhes bya ba dang / legs pa'i blo gros zhes ④bya ba dang /chos kyi sprin zhes bya ba'o/ /sa rnams thams cad don gcig pa ste/ 'di lta ste/ye shes kyi don no/ /ye shes kyang don dam par ci yang med pa/ nyon mongs pa med pa/ 'gyur ba med pa/ don yod pa/ gdod ma nas dag pa/ dri ma med pa/ 'od gsal ba/ brjod (nyedu med pa'o zhes pa'i don gang yin pa'o/ /oṃ khyu mi bi sho dha ni sablon ⑨pa ri gu lho )ra ṇi rba :7/ sa yongs su sbyong ba 8zhes bya ba'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rnam par gzhag pa bcu rnams ci zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dang po bskyed pa dang / byis par gyur pa dang / las dang po pa dang / rnal 'byor spyod pa dang / skye ba skyed pa dang / sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa dang / bsam pa phun 86—176

sum tshogs pa dang / phyir mi ldog pa dang / dbang bskur ba thob pa dang /skye ba gcig gis thogs pa ste/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rnam par gzhag pa ni don dam par na rnam par gzhag pa dang bral ba ste/ rnam par gzhag pa gcig nyid kyi phyir na 'di lta ste/ rnam par gzhag pa med pa'o/ /oṃ sarba bya bsgyu na bi ga te rgyu/ rnam par gzhag pa med pa zhes bya ba'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dbang bcu rnams ci zhe na/tshe la dbang ba dang / las la dbang ba dang / yo byad la dbang ba dang /mos pa la dbang ba dang / smon lam la dbang ba dang / rdzu 'phrul la dbang ba dang ske/ skye ba la dbang ba dang / stobs la dbang ba dang / chos la dbang ba dang / sems la dbang ba'o①/ /dbang rnams thams cad kyang don dam par dbang med pa rang bzhin rnam par dben pa/ kun rdzob tu dbang phyug thams cad la dbang rjes su thob pa ste/ chos legs par so sor rtogs pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /oṃ sarpā ba shi te ṭwāṃ : hūm̐/ dbang thams cad pa zhes bya ba'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /de la sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa ②brgyad rnams ci zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa la 'khrul pa med pa dang / ca co med pa dang /dran pa nyams pa med pa dang / thugs mnyam par ma bzhag ①pa med pa dang /tha dad pa nyid kyi 'du shes med pa dang / so sor ma brtags pa'i btang snyoms med pa dang / 'dun pa nyams pa med pa dang / brtson 'grus nyams pa med pa dang / dran pa nyams pa med pa dang / ting nge 'dzin nyams pa med pa dang / shes rab nyams pa med pa dang / rnam par grol ba nyams pa med cing rnam par grol ba'i ye shes gzigs pa nyams pa med pa dang / 'das pa'i dus 86—177

la ma chags ma thogs pa'i ye shes gzigs pa 'jug pa dang / ma 'ongs pa'i dus la ma chags ma thogs pa'i ye shes gzigs pa 'jug pa dang / da ltar gyi dus la ma chags ma thogs pa'i ye shes gzigs pa 'jug pa dang / sku'i phrin las thams cad ye shes sngon du 'gro zhing ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ①ba dang /gsung gi phrin las thams cad ye shes sngon du 'gro zhing ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang /ma(mi thugs kyi phrin dulas thams cad ye shes sngon du 'gro zhing ④ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba'o⑤/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ni yul thams cad du dus thams cad kyi tshe ⑥thams cad mnyam pa nyid la legs par rab tu gnas pa ste/ stong pa nyid la yang dag par rjes su rtogs pa nyid kyi phyir na shes rab yongs su dag pa'o/ /oṃ a we ༅ṇi ka buddha dharma 9kyes ma te āḥdhi'i ra hūṃ khaṃ/ ma 'dres pa mnyam pa nyid ces bya ba'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o// //de la skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu 7rtsa gnyis rnams ci zhe na/ phyag dang zhabs kyi mthil 'khor los mtshan pa nyid de/ 'di'i 'o)phyag dang zhabs kyi mthil 1snyedag la 'khor lo rtsibs stong can lte ba dang bcas pa mu khyud dang bcas pa rnam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /phyag dang zhabs kyi mthil legs par gnas pa ste/ zhabs kyi mthil thams cad kyis sa gzhi la reg cing de yang 'di'i mtho ba ni (snyedama' ba dang dma' ba ni mtho ba'o/ /phyag dang zhabs kyi sor mo ngang pa'i rgyal po lta bur midra bas 'brel 3)pa ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi phyag dag dang / zhabs de dag gser gyi mdog can gyi ri mo'i phreng ba rnams kyis rkang pa brgyad pa bzhin du mdzes pa'o/ /phyag dang zhabs 'jam zhing gzhon sha chags 7pa nyid denya tsho/ bcom ldan 'das 'di'i phyag dang zhabs dag 86—178

ras bal 'jam po bzhin dang / skyes nas zla ba lon pa'i byis pa bzhin du gzhon sha ①can dang / ka ⑤tsa lin da ltar 'jam pa reg na bde ba'o/ /bdun mtho bar gyur ③te phyag gnyis dag dang / zhabs gnyis dag dang / phrag gong dag dang / mgrin pa'i phyogs gcig byago/ /sor mo ring ba ste 'di'i duzhabs kyi sor mo rnams rim gyis ⑥ring ba nyid do/ /rting ⑦pa yangs pa ste 'di'i rting pa che zhing zhabs kyi rjes su 'tsham ⑧par yangs par 'gyur ro/ /sku che zhing drang ba nyid de 'phye bo ma yin zhing zhom pa ma yin/ ma tshang ba ma yin/ 'thas pa ma yin/ legs par skyes pa rnam pa thams cad pa bdun dang ldan pa'i sku ste/mtho ba 'di'i ⑨srid 0dang hunyerjes su 'tsham 8pa'i zheng 0du 'gyur ro/ /zhabs 'bur mi mngon pa nyid de 'di'i pus mo dang long bu ④mtho bar 'gyur ro/ /ba spu'i rtse mo gyen du phyogs pa ste/ 'di'i ba spu rnams rtse mo gyen du phyogs par 'gyur zhing ba spu rnams g.yas phyogs su tso'akhyil la 'khor ba mig sman gyi mdog can rnams te/ de rnams kyis gser gyi mdog can gyi sku mngon par gsal bar tsobyed do/ /byin pa ri dgas ⑩e ne ya'i nyunyelta bu ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi byin pa dag zlum pa ri dgas e ne ya 37rnams kyi lta bu'o/ /phyag ring zhing mdzes pa ste rgyas shing ma btud pa nyid du phyag mthil zhu )dag gis rang gi pus mo'i lha nga la reg pa'o/ /mdoms ri stekyi sba ba sbubs su nub pa ste/ sbubs kyis rab tu g.yogs pa glang po che'i gsang gnas lta 0bur 'gyur gyuro/ /sku mdog gser 'dra ba ste/ 'di'i ( stes dog gser lta bur 'gyur ro/ /pags ( nyepa srab pa ste shin tu 'jam pa gser shog ltar 'jam pa'i pags zhunyepa can du 'gyur zhing rdul med pa'i na bza' 'dzin pa'o/ /spu re re nas skyes pa ste/ 'di'i ba spu'i khung 86—179

bur spu rnams re rer 'gyur ro/ /smin ①ma'i dbus na mdzod spu ②can te 'di'i smin ma dag gi dbus na ras skud legs pa lta bu dung bcag pa'i kha dog ③can g.yas phyogs su 'khyil bar 'gyur te/ mdzod spu nyid kyis zhal gser gyi kha dog lta bu shin tu gsal bar byed do/ /sku stod seng ge lta bu ste/ 'di'i dusku stod rjodu yangs pa seng ge'i lta bur 'gyur ro/ /dpung mgo zlum pa ste yongs su skum pa'i mgrin pa can du 'gyur ro/ /thal gong rgyas pa ste/ 'di'i 0nye bar rgyas ⑦par 'gyur zhing gser shog bzhin du rnam par gsal ba'i mgrin pa can no/ /yan lag so so rnams su ro rnams myong bar byed do zhes ⑧pas na ⑨ri bro ba'i mchog dang ldan pa nyid de/ rtsa rnams yin la de rnams kyi mchog tu rlung dang /mkhris pa dang / bad 0kan la sogs pa rnams kyis ma dkrugs ⑩pa nyid kyi ⑫phyir yang dag par gsal tiba'o/ /shing n+ya gro dha ④ltar chu 8zheng gab pa ste④/skyes bu chen po'i chu ⑩dang zheng 8dag mnyam pa'o/ /dbu gtsug tor dang ldan pa ste/ dbu zlum par 'gyur zhing gtsug tor gdugs lta bus yas bkab yipa gtsug tor yang shin tu mtho ba'o/ /ljags ring ba ste nga )snyan gyi mtha'i bar du ljags kyi rtse mos reg par byed cing / dbu skra'i mthar thug par yang dpral ba'i mthar ljags kyis khebs pa'o/ /tshangs pa'i dbyangs te 0'khor stong phrag du mar dbyangs nang du ji lta ba de ltar ( nyephyi rol du'ang thos shing bya ka la ping ku'i bzhin du snyan pa nyid du 'gyur ro/ /'gram pa seng ge'i 9 nyelta bu ste/'gram pa dag seng ge'i bzhin du zlum por 'gyur ro/ /tshems dkar ba ste (stedung dang kunda dang / zla ba'i kha dog can gyi tshems rnams so/ /tshems mnyam pa ste ha cang dma' ba ma yin mtho ba ma yin mi mnyam pa ma yin pa'i rtse mo can 86—180

gyi tshems ①rnams su 'gyur ro/ /tshems thags bzang ba ste tshems rnams ②bar med pa'o/ /tshems bzhi bcu mnga' ba ste tshems 'og tu nyi shu dang / steng du tshems nyi shu'o/ /spyan mthon mthing ste spyan dag gi sngon po gang yin pa de shin tu rnam par dag par 'gyur te ri mo dmar po rnams dang / ma 'dres pa nyid kyi phyir la gang dkar po yin pa de dkar po kho na shin tu rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /rdzi ma ba'i lta bu ste/ spyan gyi rdzi ma rnams khyu mchog gi bzhin du gang zhu'og ma yin pa de rnams 'og kho na dang / gang steng ma yin pa de rnams steng 0kho nar gnas pa ma 'dzings pa legs par gzhol ba'o/ /sems can 'ga' zhig rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa gser gyi mdog can du mthong ba 'ga' zhig rnams kyis shel gyi mdog can du mthong ba ⑤'ga' zhig rnams kyis padma rā ga'i kha dog dang ⑥/ 'ga' zhig rnams kyis ind+ra nī rgyala'i kha dog can dang /'ga' zhig rnams kyis mu tig dmar po'i kha dog can dang / 'ga' zhig rnams kyis dung dang kunda dang zla ba ltar dkar ba dang / 'ga' zhig gis kha dog sna tshogs pa dang / 'ga' zhig gis nam mkha'i kha dog can dang / 'ga' zhig gis khru phyed dang bcu gsum pa'i tshad dang / ji srid du dpag tshad 'bum gyi tshad dmadu/ dpag tshad bye ba'i tshad dang / ji srid du 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam 0rgya mtsho'i sprin mtha' yas pa rnams su snang bar mdzad pa'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor can dang / stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams snang bas yongs su rgyas par mdzad pa dang / ji srid du me tog gi gzhi'i snying po'i rgyan bkod pa'i rgya mtsho rnams 0snang bar byed cing / chos kyi dbyings kyi mthar thug pa'i bar du ste/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yul gdul bya'i dbang las 86—181

thams cad snang bar byed cing 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad dbyangs kyis rnam par rig par mdzad pa dang / stong gnyis dang gsum dang / ji srid nam mkha'i mthar thug pa'i bar thams cad 'od dang / dbyangs kyis snang bar byas nas rnam par rig par mdzad pa dang / chos dang / zang zing dang /don mthun ①pa dang / don bya ba'i bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi rnams kyis sems can rnams la phan 'dogs shing / phan btags nas ②byang chub chen po la rab tu dgod par mdzad do/ /skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rgyartsa gnyis mnyam pa nyid kyis chos rnams thams cad mnyam zhing mnyam pa ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa mernams kyi mtshan mngon par 'grub par blta bar bya'i ⑤mtshan ma yin pa mngon par 'grub pa ni ma yin no/ /byang chub mtshan nyid med pa nyid kyi phyir chos rnams thams cad mtshan nyid med pa ste/ 'di lta ste/ stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid can no/ / de bzhin gshegs pa ⑥thams cad kyang stong pa nyid du mnyam pa'o/ / de bzhin gshegs pa gathams cad dang / byang chub dang /chos rnams thams cad kyang mtshan nyid gcig pa ste/ 'di lta ste/ nam mkha'i mtshan nyid can/ stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid can/ zhi ba'i mtshan nyid can rnams so zhes pa'o(8)/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ⑨ba ra lakṣa ṇa chas ma tā dharma te o1ho / mtshan thams cad mnyam pa nyid ces bya ba'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o// //dpe byad brgyad cu 3nyernams ci zhe na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sen mo zangs kyi mdog lta bur 'gyur te/ sen mo snum lhonyepa dang / sen mo mtho 〉ba dang / sen 3gemo rnams zlum pa ra gyur pa tshadang / sor mo rnams rim 86—182

gyis ༅phra ba dang / sor mo rnams rgyas pa dang / rtsa mi mngon pa dang / rtsa rnams mdud pa med pa dang / long ①bu mi mngon pa dang / zhabs mi mnyam pa med par mtshungs pa dang / glang po che'i stabs su gshegs pa dang / seng ge'i stabs su gshegs pa dang / g.yas phyogs su ldog cing gshegs pa dang /drang por gshegs pa dang / mdzes par gshegs pa dang / rim gyis gshegs pa dang / che zhing yangs la yongs su gyur pa'i pus mo'i lha nga can dang /mtshan yongs su rdzogs pa dang / gom (0pa snyoms pa dang / sku rnam par dag pa dang / sku 'jam pa dang / sku rnam par dang ba dang / sku zhum pa med pa dang ske/ sku sgu ④ba med pa dang / kun tu spyod pa gtsang ba dang / khyu mchog ltar kun nas rab tu dang ba (snyecan dang / gzigs pa yongs su dag cing mngon par 'dod pa la mnyam pa'i 'od can dang / dku yiskum pa dang / dku skabs 9)phyin pa dang / dku ma rnyongs (kyepa dang / sku rked spugazhu'i lag cangs ⑩lta bu dang / lte ba zab pa dang / lte ba mi yo ba dang /nyuste lte ba g.yas phyogs su 'khyil ba dang / lte ba thogs pa med pa dang / yan lag dang nying lag shin tu rnam par 'byes pa dang / pags 8pa skyon dang bral ba dang /gnag bag dang sme ba med pa dang / sku brtan pa dang / phyag shing bal lta bu dang ske/ phyag yangs pa dang / phyag gi ri mo snum pa dang / phyag gi ri mo mi yo ba dang / mchu bisba lta bu dang / zhal ha cang mi ring ba dang / mnyen zhing srab la dmar ba'i ljags dang / glang po che'i nga ro can dang / snyan cing mnyan 7pa'i dbyangs dang / sgra phun sum tshogs pa dang / dbyangs 'jam pa dang ske/ shangs mtho ba dang / mche ba skum pa dang / mche ba dkar ba dang /86—183

mche ba byin gyis phra ba dang / spyan gtsang ba dang / spyan yangs pa dang /spyan mthon mthing dang / rdzi ma gnag ①pa dang / smin ma stug ②pa dang /smin ma 'jam pa dang / spyan dkar nag ②'byis shing padma'i 'dab ④ma lta bu dang ske/ smin tshugs ring ba dang / smin ma'i spu nag pa dang / smin ma'i spu phra ba dang / smin ma rjes su mthun ⑤pa dang / kha dog ma dunyams pa dang /snyan mi mnyam pa med pa dang / snyan skyon dang bral ba dang / dbang po thams cad ma nyams shing gaskyon dang bral ba dang / sku niyongs su rdzogs shing mtho ⑨la mchog tu gnas pa'i zhal gdong dang / dpral ba can dang / dbu shin tu rgyas pa dang / dbu spa gnag ⑩pa dang / dbu skra stug pa dang / dbu 0spa 'jam pa dang / dbu skra dri zhim pa dang / dbu spa mnyam pa dang / dbu skra snum pa dang / dbu skra ma 'khums 8pa dang / dbu skra ma 'khrugs pa dang /⑫dpal be'u dang / bkra shis dang / g.yung drung 'khyil pas brgyan 8pa dang /rgyal mtshan yang dag par gnas pa dang / dpral ba dung lta bu dang / dbu mchog tu mtho ba dang / gtsug tor yar 'phags pa dang / dbu gdugs kyi rnam pa can dang / kun nas mdzes pa ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ni tshad med pa'i dpe byad can mnyam pa nyid la legs par rab tu gnas pa gsal byed dang / snyigasal byed ma yin pa ⑩mnyam pa nyid la legs par rab tu gnas pa/ chos thams cad gsal byed med par mnyam pa nyid la rab tu legs par gnas pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad thams cad sgyu ma'i 7chos dang ldan pa la legs par rab tu gnas pa/ dus gsum gyi dpe byad mnyam pa nyid/ rdo rje lta bu mnyam pa nyid thob pa/ stong pa nyid cinanyekyi chos thams cad dang / dpe byad 86—184

mnyam pa nyid thob pa/ gnyis su med pa'i don la legs par yang dag par zhugs pa rnams so zhes pa'o①/ kho a nu byardzo ②na sa ma tā su nipra tiṣṭha ta badzra tshwa dun rghaṃ lo ⑤ / dpe byad mnyam pa nyid ces bya ba'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad du'adus par gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje can ⑦rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po can la legs so zhes bya ba rnams kyis mnyes par mdzad do/ /oṃ byang chub sems ched ⑧khyod legs so/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid mchog /sangs rgyas chos ched ⑨khyod legs so/ / ting 'dzin dbang du 'jug pa yi/ /rdo rje ye shes khyod legs sol/ /rdo rje sems dpa' khyod legs so/ /0tshad med ched du khyod legs so/ /shes rab dam pa'i ched du yang / /mdo sde 'di ni legs par bshad/ /sangs rgyas snga mas ma gsungs pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das hunyerdo je rnal 'byor can gyi dbang phyug chen pos de bzhin gshegs pa ⑩/rnams thams cad la phyag 'tshal ba bzhi yis mngon par dgyes 4)par mdzad do④/ /sangs rgyas kun khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /chos kyi sku yi mchog gi mchog /gdod ma'i sngags kyi don nyid la/ /rdo rje ye shes stobs chen la/ /shin tu sgrib med zhi ba la/ /rdo je chos rnams legs gnas pa'i/ /theg pa chen po'i go 'phang thob/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid can gyi lha/ /gdod nas dag pa dpa' bo che/ /dbang phyug dam pa mchog gi mchog /dam chos mchog tu 'gyur ba med/ /bde gshegs de rnams la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes 7pa'o/ /na ma /bestu te/ oṃ 034 rghaṃ rdu hunyen mo stu te swā hā/ 'di ni brjod pa tsam zhig gis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rab mchod 86—185

pa'o / /zhes ①pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen pos de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bos nas 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnams thams cad dngos grub thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor bskyed ②par mdzad du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnams thams cad slar yang 'dus pa ②mdzad nas/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnal 'byor can gyi dbang phyug chen po la gsol ba btab pa/ bcom ldan 'das khyod nyid kyis ④rigs thams cad ⑤'khor lo bskyed ༅par mdzad du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen pos gsol ba btab pa'i gsung gis ⑦de ma thag kho nar 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la bos te bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal de bzhin gshegs pa rnams thams cad kyi byang chub kyi snying po nyon cig /ces te/ de nas 'di las yang dag bshad/ /byang chub (8)dkyil 'khor bla na med/ /rdo rje ye shes gsang ba mchog /sangs rgyas skyob pa thams cad kyi'o/ /dben pa'i sa gzhi 6)nyams dga' ba/ /me tog phreng bas rnam brgyan yipa/ /kun tu sna tshogs cha bzang ba/ /kun tu sna tshogs sdom par ni/ /kun nas sna tshogs bya ba rnams/ /dam pa'i don du bsgrub par bya/ /ri yi mchog gam grong khyer ni/ /me tog 'bras bus rnam brgyan 6nyapa/ /der gnas sngags pas dngos grub mchog /gal te 'dod na yang dag bri/ /gtsug lag khang dang dgon pa'i gnas/ /ri stengs yinyarnams su kun nas ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bya ba rnams/ /dam pa'i don du bsgrub par bya/ /ma mo'i gnas dang zhi ba'i gnas/ /dur khrod lha yi riganas su nyusteni/ /rdo rje 'dzin dpal bya ba 86—186

rnams / /don dam par ni bsgrub par bya/ /padma'i skyed mos tshal kun dang / /chu bo 'dus pa rnams su yang / /phyag na padma dpal bya ba/ /dam pa'i don ①du bsgrub par bya/ /rgyal po'i pho brang nyams dga' dang ②/ /rgyal po'i skyed tshal rnams su ni/ /rdo rje rin chen de yi ni/ /rin chen bya ba rnams bsgrub bya/ /rtags gcig pa dang ba glang laganas/ /chu klung 'dus pa rnams su yang / /sna tshogs bya ba thams cad rnams/ /dam pa'i don du bsgrub par bya/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /lha rnams gnas mchog kun tu'o/ /nam mkha' 'am ni phyogs gzhan du/ /gang du mnyam par gzhag ④pa der/ /rtag pa bsod nams mchog gyur pa/ /bya ba thams cad bsgrub par ⑤bya/ /phyogs kun mnyam nyid gnas dkyil 'khor/ /shes rab can gyis thig gdab bya/ /shar lho nub dang byang rnams kyi(ye/ /phyogs su dkyil 'khor thig brgyad pos/ /de yi phyi ru 'khor lo ni/ /kha dog lnga pa cher 'bar ba'o/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhi yis mdzes pa ste(8)/ /sna tshogs gos dang me tog phreng / /rnga yab sogs kyis rnam brgyan tsa)pa/ /dkyil 'khor kun la gnas pa yi / /sgo dang nyushesgo khyud mtshams rnams su9/rte/ /rdo rje rin chen rnams kyis spras/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad bri bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor de yi dbus nyunyes ni/ /gal te dngos grub mchog 'dod na/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pabla/ /sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan bri bar bya/ /shar du bcom ldan 'khor lo cana'i/ /rdo rje sems dpa' yang dag ldan/ /'khor los sgyur /zheb thams cad ni/ /sgeg par bcas pa kun bri bya/ /lho ru gtsug tor dkar po ni/ /rin chen 'bar ba yang dag ldan/ /gtsug tor dkar po'i ngos su ni/ /rdo rje gzi brjid la sogs bri/ /86—187

byang du brtson 'grus chen po ni/ /gzi ①brjid phung po stobs po che sna tshogs rdo rje sogs bcas pa/ /rim pa ②kun nas bri bar bya/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor can gyis ni/ /dbang phyug mgon po'i nub phyogs su/ /gtsug tor rgyal ba brtson 'grus che/ /rdo rje chos sogs dang bcas pa/ /thams cad sngags pas bri bar bya/ /gal te dngos grub mchog 'dod na'o①/ /dbang ldan phyogs su 'phags pa gnas/ /me mtshams su ni cher 'phags so/ /bden bral du ④ni rnam rgyal nyid/ /rlung du de bzhin rnam 'phro ba'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /sems dpa' kun gyi mdun du ni/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas pa/ /gsal zhing 'bar 'khrigs 'od zer can/ /mkhas pas dkyil 'khor rnams su ni/ /mchod pa rnams ni gzhag ⑤byas te/ /sgeg mo la sogs mchod pa che/ /de bzhin yigazugs sgra la sogs dang / /bdug pa la sogs gsang chen no⑦/ /sgo skyong ba ni bzhi yin te/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor gnas rnams su/ /kun tu bzang po sogs rnams bri/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor bri bya ste//mchod pa byas nas snga ma bzhin/ /de bzhin 'jug pa sogs byas la/ /sgrub pa'i thabs ni brtsam par bya/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor dbang phyug sogs/ /dkyil 'khor mngon sum mthong ba las/ /snga ma rtag ⑧pa ji bzhin du/ /phyi nas de bzhin bri bar bya/ /bsod nams ji bzhin dkyil 'khor rnams/ /thams cad mtshon gyis lhonyerab brtags ⑩pa/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lha ngo bos/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad bri byar 'gyur(spe/ /rang lha'i bdag nyid rnal 'byor gyis/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad rab tu grub/ /cho ga dman chadang lhag pas kyang / /'grub par 'gyur te skyon ma minatunye/ /kun tu sna tshogs skal 7bzang ba/ /kun nas sna 86—188

tshogs 'khor lo can/ /'khor los sgyur ①ba bdag nyid chel/ /rin chen bdun gyi mchod pa chedu/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i zla ba ltar/ /dkyil 'khor bdud rtsi 'byung shes dubya/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin sogs kyirgya/ /dkyil 'khor 'di ni bshad byas pa'o/ /phyag na padma bdag nyid che'idu/ /padma'i rnam par rtag gshes bya/ /rin po che yi rin chen rnams/ /dkyil 'khor sna tshogs rnam dupa'o/ /dkyil 'khor dman zhing dam tshig rnams/ /dor bar byas pa de nyid ni/ /gsang ba shes pa ma yin na/ /sgrub pa'i thabs ni 'grub mi 'gyur/ /de phyir 'bad pa ⑨thams cad kyis0/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad lta ba ni/ /gal te dngos grub mchog 'dod na/ /gdon mi za bar rtag tu bya/ /bla ma la ni yon phul nas/ /rjes su rim pas bsgrub par bya/ /brtan pa 'am ni g.yo ba yi / /rdzas rnams ji snyed thams cad deyi/ /rtsa ba me tog 'bras bu sogs/ /bu mo legs par brgyan 8byas dang / /'dod pa'i chung ma phul byas nas/ /slar yang rin gyis bslu 8bar bya/ /grong dang de bzhin gtsug lag khang / /kun dga' ra sogs rgyal srid mchog /gang la sbyin bya cung zad yod/ /'tsho ba de ni sbyin par bya/ /bdag gi dngos po yongs gtong ba/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rab mchod pa'o/ /bla ma la ni yon phul nas/ /gsang ba dam pa rmad byung ba/ /mngon par dbang bskur 8de nas bya/ /'dab tsom brgyad pa yid 'ong la/ /slob ma gzhag chanas yan lag kun/ /phyag rgya kun nas bcings byas nas/ /khams kun rang bzhin rtsa ba dang / /sa bon 'bras bus ⑩dud pa yi/ /bum pa rnams kyis ‘/shedabang bskur te/ /sangs rgyas phreng ba'i dbang bskur las/ /spyi bo dang ni dpral ba dang / /gzhogs /tsho)dang de bzhin rgyab tu 86—189

thug /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba rgyan gyi bkod pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/hu) ༄tshog /rgya gar skad du/ sarba ta thā ga (bta kā ya bārtsitta gu kyā lo (kye'i ra byu ha 47tant+ra rā dzā 45)nā ma/ bod skad du/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi (6)sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi 7)gsang ba rgyan gyi bkod pa zhes (0bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhabs kyi padmo (9)la gus pas ⑩phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig mi7na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje ye shes rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje ye shes phyag rgya chen po'i dam tshig gi byin gyis brlabs kyis 12rdo rje'i sku chen po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje ye shes rin po che chen po'i cod pan gyi rtse mo'i gtsug phud kyis dbang bskur ba brnyes pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 86wa 238

sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje ye shes kyi ting nge 'dzin chen po dang ldan pa dang ①/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje ye shes ②las sna tshogs pa chen po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje ye shes mchod pa chen po spro ba'i dam tshig gi gsang ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje ye shes dkyil 'khor chen po dam tshig gi de kho na nyid dang ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje ye shes gsang ba chen po'i snying po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje ye shes kyi ④mnga' bdag chen po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje ye shes kun tu bzang po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje ye shes dpe med cing mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa nam mkha' lta bu dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje rigs dang / snying po dang phyag rgya dang gsang sngags dang rig (depa gnyis su med par gyur pa (pedang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje ye shes pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po la dga' ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje ye shes ( lhag pa'i lha'i (8nasnying po mdzes pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje ye shes rgyan chen po bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i snying po la nam mkha'i khams thams cad kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul dang mnyam pa'i rdo rje ye shes chen po 'ba' zhig dang thabs cig rilatu bzhugs so/ /de'ang 'di lta ste/ sgo mtha' yas pa zhes bya ba'i rdo rje yum chen 86—239

mo dang / nam mkha'i sgo zhes bya ba'i rdo rje yum chen mo dang / a bo dza'i sgo zhes bya ba'i rdo rje yum chen mo dang / 'gyur ba med pa'i sgo zhes bya ba'i rdo rje yum chen mo dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma zhes bya ba'i rdo rje yum chen mo dang ske/ gzhan yang ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa'i brtson 'grus dang ldan pa'i rdo rje btsun ①mo stong phrag brgya ②la'ang 'di lta ste/ mda'i mtshon cha'i lag ces bya ba'i rdo rje btsun mo dang /dbang phyug la lta ba'i rim zhes bya ba'i ①rdo rje btsun mo dang / nye bar zhi ba'i ④bzhin ras zhes ⑤bya ba'i rdo rje btsun mo dang / gyen du blta duba'i bzhin ras zhes bya ba'i rdo rje btsun mo dang / 'dod pa'i ⑦sla mtshan rdo rje zhes bya ba'i rdo rje btsun mo dang / brda sprod pa ma 'a)zhes bya ba'i rdo rje btsun mo dang / 'bri ba'i sgo zhes bya ba'i rdo rje btsun mo dang / rol ⑨pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i rdo rje btsun mo dang / 'dod pa'i mchog ces bya ba'i rdo rje btsun mo dang /dbang phyug gi ⑩bde ba'i sgo zhes bya ba'i rdo rje btsun mo dang / dmigs pa'i sgo zhes bya ba'i rdo rje btsun mo dang / brang las skyes zhes bya ba'i rdo rje btsun mo ste7ske/ de dag la sogs pa rdo rje btsun mo rnams kyis yongs su bskor cing mdun du bdar 3)to/ /gzhan yang dpag tu med pa'i rdo rje pho nya mo chen po (sternams dang thabs cig tu bzhugs te/ de yang 'di lta ste/ snying skul chabar byed pa zhes bya ba'i rdo rje pho nya mo chen mo dang / gdug pa thams cad 'gugs ⑫pa zhes bya ba'i rdo rje pho nya mo chen mo dang / rjes su mnyes pa rdo rje ⑩zhes bya ba'i rdo rje pho nya mo chen mo dang / khrag 'gugs pa zhes bya ba'i rdo rje pho nya mo chen mo dang ske/ thams cad 'phrog pa lha 7zhes bya ba'i rdo rje pho nya mo chen mo la sogs pa'o/ /86—240

gzhan yang 'jig rten gyi khams rgyas pa'i rdo rje sgo srung ①ma chen mo rnams dang yang thabs cig ste/ de'ang 'di lta ste/ rdo rje 'bebs pa zhes bya ba'i rdo rje sgo srung ②ma chen mo dang / dam tshig gsum ldan zhes ①bya ba'i rdo rje sgo srung dum chen mo dang / 'jig pa'i yan lag can zhes ⑤bya ba'i rdo rje sgo srung dum chen mo dang / thog ma pa zhes bya ba'i rdo rje sgo srung ⑦ma chen mo dang / gdul dka' du'adul zhes ⑨bya ba'i rdo rje sgo srung byam chen mo la sogs pa'o/ /gzhan yang mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i rdo rje bran mo chen mo rnams dang yang thabs cig ste/de'ang 'di lta ste/ sku gsung thugs thams cad rdo rjes ⑩'ching ba ma zhes bya ba'i rdo rje bran mo chen mo dang / 'jigs pa'i me'i gdong zhes bya ba'i rdo rje bran mo chen mo dang / gtsigs shing rnam par 'gyur ba'i gdong zhes bya ba'i rdo rje bran mo chen mo dang / 'jig rten gsum 'ching ba zhes bya ba'i 8rdo rje bran mo chen mo dang / bskal par gnas pa zhes bya ba tshul sogs pa'i rdo rje bran mo chen mo'o / /gzhan yang dpe med pa'i rdo rje rol pa mo 8chen mo rnams dang yang thabs cig ste/ de'ang 'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje dgyes pa zhes bya ba'i rdo rje rol pa 8chen mo dang / kun nas 'bebs pa zhes bya ba'i rdo rje rol pa chen mo dang / 'jig rten gsum rab tu 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i rdo rje rol pa chen mo dang / rab tu ⑩dga' ba'i 0rjes su 'gro ba zhes bya ba'i rdo rje rol pa chen mo dang / thams cad dga' bar byed pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i the rdo rje rol pa chen mo hu)la sogs pa'o/ /gzhan yang nam mkha'i khams thams cad rgyas par gang ba'i rdo rje'i yab sgo )rnams dang yang thabs cig ste/ de'ang 'di lta ste/ 'dod pa'i dbang phyug ces bya ba'i du /rdo 86—241

rje'i ①yab chen po dang / mkha' 'gro'i ②rdo rje sridabang phyug dang / dri'i dudabang phyug dang / stug po bkod pa dang / zla ba'i 'od dang / 'dun pa srel dang / skye bo yongs su dor ba dang / legs par sbyangs pa dang /'dod pa'i rdo rje dang / gdung ba skyed ⑤pa dang / 'dul bar byed pa dang /gdug pa thams cad sel bar byed pa dang / de kho na nyid kyi mgon po dang /gnas pa po dang / brtse yib can dang / chos 'chang dang / bskyod pa ༷po dang ske/ sbo ⑧ba po dang / 'ching ba po dang / skor ba po dang / de dag la sogs pa rdo rje yab lhorarnams so/ /gzhan yang mtha' yas pa'i rdo rje pho nya mo 'phrog pa'i rdo rje bran pho rdo rje'i tshogs dang thabs cig ste/ de'ang 'di lta ste/rdo rje rlung zhes bya ba dang / rdo rje me dang /7 rtso rje mi 'khrugs pa dang / rdo rje chu dang / gzhan yang rdo rje rgyal po chen po bzhi la 'di lta ste/ zhi bar byed pa dang / rgyas par byed pa dang / dbang du byed pa dang / mi shes pa thams cad zad par byed pa ste/ de dag la sogs pa'o/ /gzhan yang mchog tu rgya chen po sangs rgyas kyi ye shes rab tu gnas pa'i mchod pa dang ldan pa bcom ldan 'das ston pa rtag 37pa mchog gi mnga' bdag ste/ kun tu bzang po'i sku yi ⑫ni / /'jig rten gsum gyi dkyil 'khor spros/ /bcom ldan rdor (/nya'adzin legs par mi/bzhugs ge/ /gsang ba rgyan 7gyi sbyor bas so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad skyed 1 tshopar byed pa'i yum gsang ba'i rdo rje 'dus pa thob (/sheste / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yab dang lhan cig tu dga' ba'i bde ba rjes su byung ste 'khor dang bcas pa rnams bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar lhags te/ rdo rje'i glu 'dis mngon par bstod nas zhu ba zhus pa/ sangs rgyas 86—242

kun don khyod phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje 'byung ba khyod la 'dud/ /thugs kyi rin chen mchog khyod 'dud①/ /chos kyi blo gros khyod la 'dud/ /chos rnams kun mchog khyod la 'dud/ /sna tshogs dgongs pa khyod la 'dud/ /dam tshig mchog gi mchog khyod ②'dud/ /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /grags pa chen po bdag cag ①ni/ /mgon po khyod la zhu ba zhu/ /sangs rgyas thams cad skyed ⑤byed yum/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni dkyil 'khor mchog /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' des de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i yum rnams la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yum rnams de skad ma smra zhigadu /'jig rten thams cad la khyab pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal po chen po 'di la ma 'ongs pa'i sems can rnams dad par mi 'gyur zhing rang gi sems yongs su sun 'byin la des ⑥ma mthong ba'i chos la ma dad pas rang gi sems yang dag par sun phyung steg/ mnar med pa rnams su skyes nas bskal pa stong phrag mang por mnar med pa'i sdug bsngal rjes su 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de brgya (snyulam na mnar med pa'i sdug bsngal las grol te/ mi rnams su skyes par gyur kyang rnam par 'gyur ba'i bzhin du 'gyur ro/ /brjed 6)ngas pa rnams dang / blo gros chung ba rnams dang / khyi dang / bya rog dang /byi la dang / phag dang / stag dang / glang po che dang / seng ge'i nga ro 'dra ba dag tu 'gyur ro/ /de dang 7'dre bar mi bya zhing blta bar mi bya'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bskyed (/nyepa'i yum de rnams kyis thabacom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ji ltar sems can de rnams kyi mnar med pa'i sdug bsngal zad par 'gyuranyuge/ bcom ldan 'das 86—243

kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang gis 'di'i ming gzung na ①yongs su zad par 'gyur ro / /bsod nams de'i rgyus de'i las kyi sgrib pa zad de bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi skal ba can du 'gyur ro/ /de nas de dag ②yid dga' ba skyes nas yang bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bstan du gsol/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs kyi rgyus dkyil 'khor chen po'i rgyal po sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir gang ma 'ongs pa'i sems can rnams kyis dran pa tsam gyis sangs rgyas kyi byang chub thob par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis kun tu bzang po chen po 'od 'phro ba gsal ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /rang gi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje rnams las ①de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku'i dam pa 'di bka' stsal pa/ dkyil 'khor kun gyi liyum gyur pa/ /stong nyid ye shes nyid du bshad/ /ci zhig nga yis bstan par bya/ /rtog ⑤pa thams cad rnam par spangs/ /sems can rnams la phan bzhed ⑥pa/ /gang zhig cung gzad bstan par bya/ /de kun sgyu mas sgyu ma'o/ /'gro ba sgyu ma lta bur shes/ /des na sgyu ma lta bu yis/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i dkyil 'khor bya/ /nam mkha'i khams kyis khyab pa yi(2)/ /thams cad yum gyis yang dag 'khrugs/ /phyi rol yang ni brtag par bya/ /gsang 79ba'i dkyil 'khor yum rnams kyis/ /dben zhing dga' ba'i gnas su ni/ /yid kyi 7legs par 'dus (3byas pa/ /nam mkha' la ni thig gis gdab/ /thog mar de yis bodam pas so/ /de nas rnal 'byor chen pos thig /gsang ba'i yum gyi dkyil 'khor ro/ /mu khyud dag gi rnam mdun 1stedu/ /kun nas yongs su cibaskor bar bya/ /dbus kyi 97cha ru dkyil 86—244

'khor ni/ /'khor lo lta bur ②bri bar bya/ /kun nas brgyad gnyis mdzes pa ni/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi yi dbus su'o②/ /'khor lo'i lte ba'i dbus su ni/ /padma ze'u ②'bru ldan pa bri/ /mtshams dudang mtshams ⑤su 'dab ma ni/ /ji lta skyob bzhin bsnyems ⑦bcas pas/ /srad bu lnga yis yang dag 'khrugs/ /srad bu bzhi yis ninye bar spras/ /sgo bzhi dang ni yang dag ldan/ /rta babs seng ge dag gis brgyan⑨/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan sogs/ /bla res ⑩steng du bres pa dang / /rin chen rdo rjes 0pad ldan sngon/ /dpag bsam shing gi lcug mas khyab/ /bum bzang rin chen ldan pa'i mchog /rgyan phreng glang po ldan pa 8ni/ /phyi rol gnas te legs par bris/ /rtog 8dang mi rtog rnam ④spangs te/ /dkyil 'khor rgyal 8po'i dbus su ni/ /gsang ba rgyan 0gyi rdo rje bya/ /mnyam par gzhag cing spro ba yis/ /sems kyis bri ba nyid du bya/ /de nas lha mo zhal bzhi ma/ /shes rab pha rol phyin dge ba/ /phyag bzhi pa la spyan yangs ma/ /phyag gnyis kyis ni chos 'chad cing / / bzhi pa'i ⑩g.yas par rdo rje ste/ /g.yon pa padmas rnam par brgyan/ /dkar dang dmar po cher sngo ba/ /sngo bsangs rin chen mchog mdzes 'od/ /gtsug na rin chen gtsug tor che/ /gtsug rgyan cod pan dam pa can/ /skal ba chen po 'od ldan ma/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par bklubs(she/ /gos kyis stod ⑩ni legs bsgribs pa/ /bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor 'dzum bcas shing / /sna tshogs gos ni sgo )legs gyon pa/ /dbu ma'i zhal ras gser gyi 'od/ /zhabs gnyis dbus su 'khor lo ste/ /mdun na rin chen bdun gnas pa/ /padma mchog ldan seng ge'i khri/ /zla ba rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gdanadun/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'phro ba/ /rgyab tu nyi ma'i 86—245

dkyil 'khor ni/ /dpa' bo de yis bri bar bya/ /'di yi mdun du bri bya ba/ /dpa' bo mtha' yas pa yi zhal/ /stong phrag du ma'i phyag ldan ma/ /mtshan nyid thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan①/ /phyag gis ②rdo rje padma 'chang / /sna tshogs phyag rgyas phyag gzhan dkrigs / /gtsug ldan dar gyi cod pan can/ /dbu rgyan ④padma'i bzhin ras ma/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dag la bzhugs/ /de 'od nyi ma lta bu'i 'od/ /dpa' bo'i rnal 'byor ldan pa yi/ /dpa' bo des ni bri bar bya/ /rdo rje sems dpar bdag bsgoms te⑤ / /der ni bsnyems 6)pas 'gro bar bya/ /dpa' bos lho ru bri bya ba/ / gshin rje'i 'dab ⑦ma mdzes pa la/ /mchog sbyin nam mkha' dge ma yang / /rin chen khri la legs par bzhugs/ /bzhin ras sngo la spyan dkar ba/ /'dzum bcas nor bu'i 'og pag can/ /mgul rgyan rin chen phreng ba mchog /rkang gdub gdu bu rin po che/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i lag pa can/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin dgongs mas)/ /de nas blo ldan rab song ste/ /nub tu yang ni de bzhin du/ /dpal dang ldan pas legs par bri/ /chu las skyes ma yid 'phrog ma/ /dmar po'i gos 'dzin dag pa ma/ /gtsug na cod pan gyis spras ma/ /sbrul rgyan sna tshogs lus can ma/ /dar dang rin chen gyis bklubago(7ma/ /padma 'byed pa'i sbyor ba yi7/ /phyag gi lo 'dab dang ldan pas/ /zla ba'i gdan la yang dag bzhugs/ /nyi ma du ma'i snang ba can/ /ji ltar rigs hu)pa bri bar bya//de nas byang du phyin nas su/ /song ste 12dpa' bos bri bya ba/ /mi g.yo bzhin ras grags chen ma/ /mar gad 'bar ba mtshungs pa mo/ /dkar po'i dar gyis yang dag bklubs12/ /gtsug na nor bu cod pan bzang / /gtsug rgyan sna 86—246
