tshogs dag gis spras/ /rdo rje dril bu'i lag bkra ma/ /sna tshogs rgyan dang gos ldan pas/ /zla ba'i gdan la yang dag bzhugs/ /'od kyis gtams ①pa'i dkyil 'khor mchog /de nas mtshams ②kyi 'dab ma la/ /me tog bdug ②pa dri ldan ma/ /rdo rje snang byed dag pa ma'i⑤/ /mchod pa sngags rig pa yis bristi//gzugs ⑤sgra dri ⑦dang ro dang reg /rang gi bdag po'i phyogs su'o/ /'dab ma 'dab mar thams cad du/ /bzhad (kyedang sgeg dang dbyangs chen mol/ /gar gyi phyag rgya grags chen po/ /sngags pas 'bad de bri bar bya/ /padma las ⑩skyes 'dab ma la/ /thams cad du ni 'grub pa bri/ /sgo rnams dag ni thams cad la/ /sgo skyong ba ni tu/rnam bzhi dang / /phyi rol du yang lha la sogs/ /ming ni yang dag bri bar bya/ /de nas khrus byas lus 8byugs la0/ /me tog bdug tsosogs kyis bdugs tem/ /sna tshogs gos ni rab gyon la/ /me tog phreng dang gos kyis brgyan / /gtsug phud hu)cod pan dang ldan zhing / /mdzes pa'i dar gyis yang dag bklubs/8/ /rdo rje dril bu lag par ldan/ /sbyor ba bzang po'i rnam gzhag /cagis/ /de nas thams cad dgug par bya/ /rdo rje ma mo dka' ( pe thub che/ /bzlog dang rnal tsho 1)ma'i phyag rgya yis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bzlas nas su/ /rdo rje'i sbyor bas gar bya zhing / /lan gsum du ni g.yas bskor bas/ /rdo rje ma mo'i gedakyil 'khor rnams/ /dam tshig ldan pa thams cad byon/ /glu shedabyangs kyi ri ni rgyal pos bskul/ /rang gi slob ma'i tshogs gar gyis/ /dregs pa yis ni g.yas dang g.yon/ /'gying ba dang ni 'dud par ri 5bya/ /'dir gshegs 'dir gshegs 9sems can don mdzad brtson pa po/ /ser sna mi mnga' sangs rgyas tshogs mchog mtha' dag dang / /86—247

bde gshegs dam pa'i yum gyur srid pa'i skyed pa ①po/ /pha rol don mdzad dus la de ring bab pa lags/ /zhes ②so/ /de nas de dag rang nyid kyisal/ /rdzu 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pas dubyon/ /mtshan ma dag ni bzang po rnams/ /dkyil 'khor dag tu blta dubar bya/ /rang ngam gzhan la 'bab ⑥sogs pa'i/ /mtshan ma ji ltar mthong ba na⑦/ /de tshe nges par ma mo ni/ /bde nigashegs thugs kyi dgongs par 'byon/ /de nas mchod yon zhabs bsil 0cho ga ji bzhin rab brtags teyi/ /de tshe babs pa'i sems can bsod nams ldan la dri ⑫bar bya/ /gal te de ni mi smra ba na rghaṃ gi yi ge dang / /ldan pa'i glu dbyangs can gyis 8yongs su bskul ba nyid du bya'o④/ /de nas shes rab ldan ma gzhugatso /slob ma'i gtso bo thal sbyar te/ /mig la mig dar gyis g.yogs la/ /rab dga' bdag yin yang dag dga'/ /ma mo thams cad la dmigs te/ /der 0ni me tog dor bar bya/ /me tog gang la lhung gyur pa/ /ma mo de ni de yis 'grub/ /de nas go rims ⑩ji bzhin du/ /sgo skyong ba nas brtsams nas su/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i bar/ /slob ma la ni bshad par bya/ /dam tshig thob par gyur nas su/ /sdom pa dag ni gzung (nyebar bya/ /ma mo'i sngags dang phyag rgya ni/ /mnyam par gzhag 7pas bstan par bya/ /gzhan du slob dpon blo ngan ni/ /nges par dmyal bar 'gro ri kye bar 'gyur/ /des kyang yang dag de 'grub cing / /myur du dmyal bar 'gro bar 'gyur/ /bgegs dang log par 'dren pa'am/ /rims dang gdon dang dug sogs kyis/ /gdungs te nad kyis 31rgyun du ni/ /'chi ba ru yang 'gyur ba yin/ /rdo rje slob dpon smad pa na/ /rtag tu dmyal ba nyid du ni/ /rab tu rmongs pa'i slob ma 'gro/ /86—248

mkha' las rdo rje ji bzhin no/ /des na bu kye ①dam tshig ni/ /khyod kyis rtag tu srung bar byos/ /ma mo kun gyi stisdom pa ni/ /theg pa chen po'i cho gas gnas/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs te/ rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad kyi ②yum rnams kyi dam tshig dubaka' stsal pa/ /rin chen sems kyi dam tshig gis/ /rnam pa gsum ni sbyang bar bya/ /thog mtha' bar gyi sbyor ba yis / /chung 'bring mchog gi dbye ba yis/ /de 'dra'i dam tshig yang dag pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis ⑤bka' stsal to/ /ji srid sems ni sbyangs kyi bar/ /'bad pa yis ni bsgom par bya/ /bud med thams cad mthong ba na⑥/ /lan gsum du ni bskor nas kyang / /spyi bor ②phyag ni byas nas su/ /lan gsum bar du gsol ba gdab(she/ /bdag ni ⑨ma khyod bu yin te/ /ji srid byang chub thob par 'gyur⑩/ /byang chub yan lag nu ma las(nye/ /byung ma rang gi 'o mas skyongs/ /de nas sbyor ldan rab dge ba'i/ /dbang bskur ba ni sbyin par bya/ /gser la sogs pa'i bum pa ru/ /dri yi chus ni ⑩yongs bkang la/ /dar dang ras sogs kyis hunyegayogs te/ /me tog chun pos mgul brgyan tsonas/ci /rin chen sman gyis skerab bkang ba'i/ /gcig lhag bcu drug bzang po la/ /ma mo'i snying po nyid kyis ni/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas pa yis/ /sngags shes pas ni dbang bskur ro/ /slob ma zhi ba bzang po yis/ /thog mar zhu ba byas nas kyang / /zhabs gnyis la ni mgos btud nas/ /bdag ni che ge mo rdo rje/ /byang chub sems ni rnam tu9bsgoms 51 pa'o/ /slob dpon zhabs kyi chu skyes la/ /dbang bskur phyir ni zhu ba bgyid/ / skal ba (shechen po bdag la stsol/ /slob dpon mchog tu rmad byung ba/ /dbang bskur rgyal ba thams cad kyis/7pe/ /86—249

sangs rgyas byang chub rab sgrub pa/ /des ni bdag gi ①sems can rnams/ /don gyi dam pa bdag gis bgyi②/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis ③don bgyid pa/ /brtul zhugs bzang po khyod kyi drin/ /de nas dbang bskur sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang gnas/ /slob mas duye shes rdo rje yi/ /go 'phang ⑤la ni bzhag dunas su/ /bum pa bzang po gcig gam ni/ /yang na bcu drug dag gam ni/ /lnga'am yang na bcu yis ni/ /dkyil 'khor du ni dbang bskur ro/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni mdun du ni/ /dkyil 'khor padma bri bar bya/ /padma ⑦'dab ma ⑧brgyad pa la/ /ge sar lte ba ldan par bri/ / de yi ⑨dbus su rdo rje bri/ /sna tshogs rdo rje 'od zer phreng ⑩/ /de yi mdun du 'khor lo bri/ /chen po rin chen bdun gyis bskor/ /lho yi phyogs su rin po che/ /nub tu padma nyid yin te / /byang du ral gri chen po'o/ /'bar ba'i phreng 'khrugs 'od zer can/ /grwa yi phyogs ni thams cad du/ /me tog bdug tunyepa dri zhim pa/ /'od ldan pa ni skal ba che/ /sgo dang sgo ru bzhi nyid do/ /phyi rol du yang 8mi 'chi kun/ /gcig nas gcig yi tu rgyal sgrogs pa/ /bde byed gcer bu'i cha lugs te/ /ming thos pa dang ldan pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor de yi dbus su ni/ /slob ma bsnyems dang bcas pa bzhagami /chos kyi rang bzhin gtam brjod de'i/ /de ring khyod ni rigs su skyes/ /'khor los sgyur 0ba'i rgyal po che/ /rtag pa dam pa'i dbang phyug pa/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan pa'i dpal/ /dag pa'i dbang phyug kun gyi bdag /rdo rje padma lag byin te/ /gnang ba bzang po rab tu sbyin//bu yis bya ba chen po gyis/ tsho/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi go 'phang /lteganas/ /der ni sbyor ba 'ongs nas su/ /gsang ba'i sdom pa sbyin par bya/ /'di ni 6)mchog tu 86—250

dga' ba ste/ /yum rnams rab tu rmad byung ba'o/ /dus su 'dod pa nyid du gyis/ /dam ༅tshig mchog tu gyur pa'o/ /brtul zhugs bzang pos ci 'byor pas / /de nas yon ni phul byas nas/ /slob dpon gyi ②ni zhabs la 'dud②/ /ma dang chung ma bu mo dang / /sring mo sring mo'i bu mo dang / /bu rnams dang ni bdag nyid dang / /rgyal po longs spyod gter dang ni/ /nor dang 'bru dang grong shing rta/ /glang po rta dang ba glang ④sogs/ /ma he dang ni ma he mo/ /gzhan dang gzhan yang ci 'dod pa/ /bla ma la ni chen pos dbul/ /bya dang mi bya rdzas kyi mchog /thams cad kyang ni dbul bar bya/ /de nas bcom ldan ma ④rnams la/ /rgyan phreng rnams dang bzhad ⑥gad dang / /sgeg dang rtse 'jo dga' ba dang / /rab tu dga' ba'i bde chen dang / /bza' btung bca' ba la sogs pa'ig/ /rnam pa du ma thams cad kyis/ /mchod nas gshegs su gsol bar bya/ /sems can kun gyi don dang ni/ /bdag gi yang ni ched (shecher mdzad / /bde gshegs gang du gshegs pa deratso)/ /ma mo thams cad gshegs su gsol/ /shes rab ldan pas yon phul te/ /slob ma'i mchog dang bcas pa yis / /gar byas lag pa mgor bzhag ste/ /rim gyis hu )'gyed dang 'dud par bya/ /de nas bzang mo rnams (17mnyes te/ /thams cad sgrub tshepar byed pa'i mchog /bdag gis 8skal bzang stsal nas kyang / /rang gi sras kyi gnas su gshegs/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje ye shes yum chen mo rnams kyi phyag rgya ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs sotso// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i yum bcom ldan 86—251

'das ma rnams kyis ①yang gsang ba 'dus pa las byung ba rang rang gi sgrub pa'i thabs rgyas pa bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces zhus so/ /shes rab ye shes mchog sgrub pa'i/ /sems dpa' chen pos gsung du gsol/ /thabs kyis sems can thams cad kun/ /sangs rgyas byang chub 'bras thob pa/ /rdo rje ye shes mchog gyur pa/ /rdo rje'i ②sku ste rdo rje mchog /dngos grub kun gyi bde ster ba/ /rdo rje chen pos chagasung du gsol/ /thugs kyi rin chen ldan pa'i mchog /gzi brjid rdo rje snang ba can/ /sems can rnams kyi rdzu 'phrul dang / /'grub pa'i yon tan 'byung gnas gsungs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rnal 'byor che//rnal 'byor chen po dbang phyug che/ /dpa' bo'i sbyor bas gar gnas pa'i/ /dpa' bo chen pos bshad du gsol/ /las likun gyi ⑤ni 'bras brnyes pas/ /sna tshogs mkhyen pa dbang phyug che/ /sems can rnams kyi yab chen po/ /sna tshogs dam pa bshad du gsol/ /zhes bya bas so/ /de nas bcom ldan rtag pa'i rgyal/ /dam pa'i dbang phyug kun mkhyen pas/ /gsung mchog nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa'i/ /zab mo yi ni chos bka' stsal/ /'di na sgrub 6)po gang yang med/ /dngos grub bam ni sgrub thabs kyang / /thams cad rnam par rtog las byung / /rnam rtog kyang ni dmigs ma yin/ /bdag med sangs rgyas rnams kyang med/ /chos rnams med cing chos nyid med/ /sbyor ba med cing sems can med/ /de bzhin pha dang ma yang med/ / byed pa (7med cing skyong ba (8pemed / /'bras bu med cing rgyu yod min/ /longs spyod med cing za 6)po med/ /shes med shes 7pa po yang minamed/ /rnam shes med cing shes bya med/ /rdzun ḍo/gyemin bden pa'ang ma yin pa/ /des na snang ba thams cad ni/ /sgyu ma lta bu 86—252

nyid las byung / /de ltar chos rnams rnam rig pa①/ /grol nas gos par mi 'gyur te/ /dngos grub chen po 'grub par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas byang chub bde chen po/ /zab mo'i chos ni thos pa na/ /mkhas pa gang zhig dad gyur na/ /snying po phyag rgya sngags rig ②rnams/ /gdon mi za bar 'grub par 'gyur/ /sbyor ba 'di ni bcom ldan gsungs/ /thams cad dag par byed pa'i mchog /gsang ba'i rgyan la legs bzhugs nasadu/ /sems can rnams la bstan pa po/ /de nas yum rnams tshim gyur ④te/ /rang byung ba la zhu ba zhus/ /grub pa'i sgrub thabs rab sbyor ba/ /mnga' bdag rnal 'byor rnams kyis gsungs/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ⑤yum las kyi dam tshig 'byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /de yi steng du ma nyams pa/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas khyab pa yi0/ /phyogs kun du ni rab 'phro ba'o/ /de yi steng du gzi brjid che/ /dus mtha'i me dang mtshungs 'dra ba//de yi steng du sa chen po/ /gser gyi ri bo dang mtshungs pa/ /de yi steng du chur shes bya/ /zla ba gang ba kha ba 'dra/ /sngags pas cho ga bzhin du bsam/ /rin chen bzhi yi rang bzhin bzang / /stong phrag brgyad cu gtsa bzhi yi/ /dpag tshad kyi ni tshad tsam pa/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhi yi rtse mo can / /ri bo chen po cog brgyad pa/ /dbus su rdo rje'i ri bo mchog /de yi steng du rdo rje che/ /kun tu phyogs pa yongs su bsgom(8)/ /sngo bsangs margad porata 'dra ba/ /sna tshogs 'od kyis yang dag 'khrugs/ /de yi steng du rdo rje che/ /rtse mo lnga pa rnam par bsam/ /dkar po shel dang 'dra ba'o(/— nee/ /'od zer lnga 86—253

yis rnam par spras/ /de yi steng du rin po che/ /chu skyes sngon po'i 'dab 'dra ba / /sna tshogs 'od zer stong gi ༅phreng / /phyogs bcu nam mkha' khyab pa'o/ /de yi gtsug tu padma che/ /nam mkha' khyab pa yi ni mchog /lo ma stong phrag du ma can/ /lte ba dang ni ze'u (ge'abrus dkrigs(kye/ /de yi mdun du nyi ma che/ /'od zer stong phrag du ma can/ /de yi steng du zla ba che/ /dkar po'i 'od zer 'bar bas dkrigs④/ /nam mkha'i khams ni gang ba yi/ /gzi ⑤brjid dkar po 'phro ba'o/ / de yi (yedabus su ma mo bri/ /dus gsum bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang / /yongs su dag pa mkha' 'dra ma/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'phro ba mo/ /phyag gnyis ma la thugs zhi bsti/ /bsam gtan spyan ldan bsam gtan yid/ /bsam gtan mchog gi phyag rgya yi/ /ser mo gzhon nu rab bzhag (8)pa/ /dkar po'i gos 'dzin mdzes pa mo/ /dkar po yi ni rgyan gyis brgyan / /ral pa'i thor tshugs cod pan bzang / /gtsug gi nor bu 'od ldan pa / /ye shes gdan la mnyam par bzhugasalho )/ /ba spu rnams kyi rtse bug ⑩gnas//rgyal ba rab tu khros nyi1pa ste/ /byang chub pha rol son par mdzad/ /de yi thugs kur rnam 32bsam pa/ /yi ge mchog tu mi 'gyur ba/ /yi ge rnams kyis yang dag dkrigs/ /thams cad du ni legs 'phro ba'o/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni mdun gnas pa/ /rab tu thal mo sbyor tsha/nyaba'o/ /de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /rig lisngags khro bo'i tshogs kyang boni/ /chos nyan pa yi tshul du yang / /dkyil 'khor du ni gzhag 7par bya/ / sgo yi /nga phyogs ni thams cad du//sgo skyong ba ni bzhi rnams so/ /sbyin pa la sogs ci rigs par/ /bcu drug po yang 1nyagazhag 19par bya/ /me tog bdug pa mar me che/ /ji lta ba bzhin gzhag shu 86—254

par bya/ /lha klu de bzhin gnod sbyin dang / /dri za lha min dmyal las ①byung / /'di rnams thams cad lhun po la/ /kun nas yongs su gzhag ②par bya/ /de nas me tog phreng ③ldan 'jug④ /dri dang me tog yang dag ldan/ /gos dkar 'dzin pa dpal dang ldan/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /shes rab 'phro dang lhan cig tu/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rjes dran pas0/ /bdag dag ⑥pas (peni dag par bya/ /shes rab sbyor bas gang gnas pas/ /sgo yi drung du legs 'khod la/ /glu ⑧'di yis ni spyan drang bya/ /thugs rje mnga' ba chos kyi dbang phyug sangs rgyas yum/ /rang gi yab kyi tshogs dang sras dang bcas te byon/ /spyon cig spyon cig lha dang srin por 0bcas mchod pa'i/ /'jig rten dbang phyug yang dag byang chub thugs mnga' ba/ /spyon cig spyon cig thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'jig rten gnyen/ /chos kyi yi ge bde bar gshegs pas rjes bskos pa/ /mkha' ltar yongs dag dri med dam bca' dran par mdzod/ /ma mo rnams ni mchog gi 7grus bskul 7byon par 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ma byon par mthong nas rang gi 8me tog gi snyim pa dang / mchod yon dang /zhabs bsil 8dbul bar bya'o/ /oṃ bdas gi mchod yon zhabs bsil 'di/ /ci bde bar yang babazhes su gsol/ /de nas de dang 7lhan cig tu/ /'dres pa ru ni gyur par bsam/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pra tso1 dzñā na sa ma ye rghaṃ sa ma ya st+waṃ/de nas 'di yis brtan mapar bya ste/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsa la sa ma ya tsom tsa la :yi/ de nas 'dis mnyes par bya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma na san tu ste sa ma ye rgyu/ e gye hi dzaḥ e hye hi ( )dzaḥ de nas dpag tu med pa'i ngo mtshar chen po lta ba'i phyir/ oṃ samāṅga puṇḍa ra rinam hā bha ga bān sa le sma ra sma ra spha ra 86—255

spha ra saṅgāṅgā ①ba yu brgyu ②ma hā buddha sa mu drun rgyu hūṃ i0/ 'di yis ma mo bskul nas su/ /sangs rgyas sprin ni 'od po che/ /dkyil 'khor ba la spro bar bya/ /de nas gsang sngags 'di yis ④ni/ /bsngags te me tog dor bar bya ma samāṅga puṇḍa rī ka pra tītstsha lha ku su mālja li hūṃ aḥtso/ de nas ji ltar bshad pa rjobazhin du dkyil 'khor gyi bum pa rnams la rig ⑦sngags 'dis ji ltar bshad pa ltar legs par byin gyis brlabs la rang gis dbang bskur rang gi snying po rang gis blang bar bya'o/ /de nas las thams cad kyi nus pa dang ldan pa dang /dngos grub thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas me tog la sogs dang / /bza' dang btung dang ro dag gis/ /mchod la sngon gyi rim pa bzhin/ /slob ma'i rgyal po gzhug ⑧par bya/ /'khor los sgyur ⑨ba'i rim pa yi/ /sbyor ba yis ni dbang bskur ro/ /rdo rje rin chen de bzhin pad⑩/ /las kyi rdo rje de bzhin no/ /zhags pa lcags kyu dril bu dang / /lcags sgrog rnga yab dang ni gdugs/ /ral gri mig sman thur ma gnyis/ /rgyal po'i nye bar spyod pa dang / /de la rgyan rnams bstan lha/nas su/ /dkyil 'khor der ni dbang bskur ro/ /rgyal ba'i yum gyi (snyedabang bskur ba/ /las kun byed par rab tu bshad/ /dam tshig gam ni sdom pa yang / /rang gi slob ma nyan 8du gzhug /zhi ba dang ni rgyas pa'i las/ /dbang dang drag shul spyod pa ni/ /legs par rnam par dag sems kyis/ /ci 'dod par ni bya ba byos/ /las rnams kun gyi 'bras bu yang ske/ /sbyor ba 'di yis 'grub par 'gyurasko/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' chen pos slar yang las dam pa rgyas par bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /ji lta'i 86—256

gzugs kyi snod byas la/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ①ni dbus su gzhag② /zho dang mar gsar ③'o ma ni/ /tsandan dmar po dang bsres te/ /ga pur dang ni ldan byas la/ /yid la byed pas bzlas te bsgrub④/ /zla ba nyi ma gzas bzung ⑤ma//sbyor ba bzang po'i rnam gzhag dubya/ /thog mar me ni sbar byas nas/ /'bad pa yis ni rlung gis busasti/ /gser gyi snod ⑧du bsdu bar bya/ /ba ru na yi 0khu bas sbyar/ /nyi ma dang ni zla ba la/ /slar yang rdzas de bskam par bya de nas de tiru lha mo yi/ /khrag dang sa bon blugs par bya/ /de yis myur du rdzas dag ni/ /'grub par 'gyur te the tshom 0med/ /grub nas thog mar lha mo la/ /cung zad tsam zhig 8dbul bar bya/ /de bzhin du ni slob dpon la/ /skal ba nyis 'gyur 8dbul bar bya/ /de nas grub pa gzhan rnams dang / /rang gi slob mar skal ba sbyin8/ /de nas byin brlabs 8sbyor ba yisatso/ /phyag rgya dang ni lhan cig tu/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /zas kyi chas bon dang ni bza'/ /skad cig de la gzugs brjes 8te/ /rdo rje sems dpa' lta bur 'gyurayi/ /gang dang gang gi pya gzugs rnams su/ / bsgrub 'dod pa yi ⑥sngags pa yis/ /de dang de yi bsam gtan gyis/ /blo gros brtan pas bza' bar bya/ /de dang de yi gzugs su ni/ /gdon mi za bar brje bar 'gyuras/ /gzhan pa yi ni rdzas zhu dag kyang / /'di nyid kyis ④ni bsgrub par bya/ /mig sman gyis ni mig byugs pas/ /khor ( nyeyug tu ni mi snang 'gro/ /snying la ldong ros kyis byugs na/ /yid kyi spyod yul nyid du 'gro/ / ba bla yis zhuni lus byugs na/ /mkha' la nye bar 'gro bar 'gyur/ /mig sman nag po blangs nas su/ /nag po'i phyogs la bza' ( bar bya/ /de yi bshang ba'i ri mar khu las/ /86—257

dud pa mkhas pas bsgrub ①par bya/ /de yis mig la byugs na ②ni/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi gzigs shing ①/ /stobs ni dpal ldan rdo rje'i mtshon/ /nyid 'gyur rga ④dang 'chi ba med/ /mig sman dang ni ba lang mar/ /ma he dang ni ra nyid dang / /mi yi mig sman nyid dag ni/ /mkhas pa yis ni blangs nas su/ /sngags pas bzung ste btso bar bya/ /mig sman chen po mchog tu bzang / /'di yis mig la byugs na ni/ /grub pa yid du 'ong bar 'gyur/ /mi snang 'grub pa thams cad kyis/ /blo gros chen po rgyal por 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sa chen po/ /nges par thob 'gyur gzhan du min⑤/ /rdzas kyi gnas skabs le'u 'di / /mtshungs med chen po nyer bshad do/ /gos dang gdugs ⑥sogs ral gri dang / /mtshon cha dam pa bsgrub par bya/ /snying po snying gar ④byas nas ni/ /bsgoms na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po ches/ /padma'i sems dpa' bzhin stiras mchog /de yi zhal du byas nas su/ /de dang ldan pas bsgom (9)par bya/ /mnga' bdag gang gis dbang phyug ltar/ /skad cig de la de 'gyur ro/ /de nyid kyi ni spyi bo'i char⑩/ /mchog gi dam pa bsam gtan bya/ /skad cig de la mchod pa che'i/ /sangs rgyas su ni de 'gyur ro//de yi spyi gtsug nyid du ni/ /sna tshogs rdo rje bsgom lhonyapar bya/ /de ni kun gyi rgyal dbang po/ /las kun byed pa'i don 'grub nyanya'agyur/ /rdo rje snying gar 'onyabasam par bya/ /de yi 7dbus su snying po blta/ /de nas rdo rje rig pa 'dzin/ /mnga' bdag rdo rje'i dbang po 'grub/ /rin chen chen po cha nyugebargyad pa/ /snying ga 7ru ni mkhas pas bsgomanya / /der ni snying po bsam nya pa yis/ /rin chen rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ /padma chen 4po 'dab brgyad 37pa/ /yid la bsgoms 86—258

pas skad cig la/ /padma che ldan mnga' bdag gis①/ /padma'i rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ /de la sogs pa mtha' yas pa/ /ji lta'i sbyor ba'i cho ga yis/ /mchog dang dman pa 'bring po yi/ /dngos grub dam pa bsgrub par bya/ /snying gar ⑤zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ /yi ge dam pa bsgom par bya/ /ji lta'i sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor gyis/ /thams cad bdag tu bsgom par bya/ /de las langs te bdag zhi bas6)/ /zla 'od kha ba ltar bsil ba'i/ /'od zer sprin gyis cher gtams ④pas/ /bsgrub bya'i spyi bor gzhag ⑤par bya/ /skad cig de la gdug ⑥pa dang / /gza' ⑦dang dug sogs rab 'phrog cing ⑧/ /nyi ma gcig gam bdun nam ni/ /bsgrub bya zhi ⑨'gyur gzhan du min/ /rin chen dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /snying po'i mchog ni bsgom par bya/ /'od zer ser po'i phreng mdzes pa/ /bsgoms pas de ni rgyas par byed/ /padma'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /mnyam par gzhag ⑩pas lha mo bsam/ /dmar po'i rang bzhin 'bar dag pa/ /bsgrub bya'i sems la 'phro bar bya/ /slar yang sdud /tshonyepa'i sbyor ba yis/ /rang gi lus la gzhug par bya/ /'khor los sgyur 8ba lta bu yang / /de ni ci nas dbang du 'gro/ /las kyi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /sna tshogs rdo rje bsgom par bya/ /de yi dbus su yi ge ni/ /margad 'od 'dra bsgom par bya/ /'od zer sprin gyis yang dag 'khrugs/ /mkhas pa yis ni snying gar / bsam/ /bsgrub bya la ni snying po'i 'od/ /bstims pa'i skad cig de la 'bab/ /rdo rje gar gyis cigar byed cing / /phyag rgya sbyor ba'i rnal 'byor dang / /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sbyor ba'i/ /phyag rgyas thams cad ston par 'gyur/ /'das dang ma 'ongs ci 'dod pa/ /lce brkyang 86—259

bas ni smra bar ①byed/ /'dod dang mi 'dod dge mi dge/ /rdo rje'i ngag gis smra bar 'gyur/ /yang na legs par sbyor ②ba'am/ /grong gi'am ③tha mal skad dag gis/ /'dod dang mi 'dod dge mi dge/ /'tsho ba 'am ni 'chi ④ba dang / /nyams dang mi nyams rang bzhin gyil/ /de dag thams cad de yis smraX/ /de las gzhan du de mi smra/ /'di ni bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /dbang bdag rdo rje'i dbyangs kyis gsungs/ /khros te lce rtser bsgoms nas su/ /lha mo yi ni snying po'i ⑦mchog /lcags kyu'i rnam pa ⑧spros nas su/ /phyag rgya dang ni phyag rgya'i lan / /rlung la bzhag ste khyaskad cig la/ /khrag rnams thams cad dgug par bya/ /char rgyun 'bab 0pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /rang gi kha ru dbab par bya de ni 'thungs pas sngags shes te/ /mnga' bdag rdo rje 'dzin par 'gyur/ /nam mkha' kun tu spyod dpal 0ldan/ /nyi ma'i snang ba lta bur 'gyur/ /'di nyid kyi ni rnal 'byor gyis/ /'o ma zho dang mar bzang po/ /mar khu chu dang me tog kun / /rlung gis dgug ‘/nyepa (nyanyid du bya/ /zhags pas mgrin pa bcings ④byas te/ /lcags kyu yis ni snying ga 7nas/ /rlung gis kun nas bteg nas su/ /lha mo de bzhin gnod sbyin mo/ /mi mo de bzhin lha min mo/ /brgyad brgya tsokho na bzlas pa yis/ /bud med tshul du dgug par bya/ /bsgrub bya thab 7byed ming spel nas/ /ka ba rtsig tsunyepa de bzhin khyim/ /dril bu rnams dang bum rnams la'ang / /lha mo yi ni snying po yi/ /brgya bzlas pas ni 'bebs par 'gyur/ /shes rab pha rol phyin ma mchog /khro ba dang ni yang dag ldan/ /gsal byed kyis 3)ni gsal byas rdzu )pas/ /las rnams dag ni thams cad bya/ /dur khrod ro ni ma nyams pa/ /mar ngo'i brgyad la ba sdus nas su/ /byang du phyogs te gzhag 6nye86—260

par bya/ /de yi khar ni mnyam gzhag pas/ /gsang sngags legs par bzlas nas su/ /rdzas kyi dam pa ci rigs pa①/ /ba bla mig sman rdo chu dang / /sdong ros dang yang yang na btsag /dkar rtsi ②sol ba nyid dang ni/ /gur gum ②dang ni rgya spos sam/ /ru ④rta shu dag ga pur ⑤dang / /tsandan de bzhin a ka ⑦ru / /sha dang khrag ni nyid dang yang / /de bzhin sor mo'i gdu ⑦bu ni/ /rnal 'byor ldan pas bzhag nas kyang / /de yi steng du bsdad la bzla/ /nyi ma shar nas de blangs pas/ /grub pa'i rig pa ⑧'dzin par 'gyur/ /dman pas dngos grub dman pa ste/ /rab kyis rab tu rnam par bstan/ /bar mas bar mar shes par bya/ /mtshan ma med na dbang du byed/ /ces so/ /skyes bu dag ni thams cad dang / /bud med dag ni thams cad la/ /reg pa tsam gyis dbang byed cing / /mig la byugs pa yis kyang ngo / /tsandan gyis ni yongs byugs te/ /gur gum gyis ni thig le'o/ /la gu yis ni bdug ⑨par bya/ /dkar rtsi sol ba ⑩btsag gis ni/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i ming dang ni/ /yongs su spel te tunyekhris pa yis8/ /dbang ma song ba dbang 'gro ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i bka' bzhin no/ /khams kyis 0ming ni bris pa nacha/ /dbang du byed pa'i mchog yin no/ /sol bas yongs su 'gugs par byed/ /dkar rtsi yis ni dug 'joms so/ /li khris skad cig de nyid la/ /smyo tsobar 'gyur bar the tshom 8med/ /ru rta a ga rus bdug hunyepas/ /dbang du byed pa'i mchog yin no/ /sol bas yongs su 'gugs par byed/ /gnod sbyin mo ni nges /shepar 'gugs/ /sha dang khrag gi bdug pa yisanyunye/ /srin mo 'gugs par byed pa'i mchog /tsandan sihla'i bdug ( — )pa yis/ /lha ni 'gugs par byed pa'i mchog /86—261

ga pur tsandan bdug pa yis/ /sangs rgyas mchog tu spyan 'dren pa'o/ /ga pur gang gis zos yo)pa yis/ /gzhan du'ang de yi dbang du 'gyur/ /rig pa chen mo yi ge bzhi/ /mnyam par gzhag (7pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /'khrugs pa dang ni spel ba'i dus/ /nges par shi ba bsgrub par bya/ /brtul zhugs can gyis gang bsgo ba'i/ /bka' lung de yis myur du byed/ /phrag ①par khur de ⑤bran mo 6)des / /lhun po'i steng du skyel bar 'gyur/ /grub pa yi ni mchog rab kyi/ /rdzas ni blangs nas 'ong bar yi'agyur/ /gtum po yi ⑦dgas ⑧nyi ma yi/ /rgyal gyi mtshan mo sol ba bzung 99ste/ /gtum mo'i me tog khu ba yis/ /brtul zhugs ⑩bzang pos brtags hunyenas su/ /padma'i nang du gzhag par bya/ /de nyid mtshan mo gcig gam gsum/ /de las blangs nyi te sbyor ba yis/ /mkhas pa 0yis ni mar zhu bya/ /de nas lha 'am grub pa'am/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang bsngags pa'am / /rig ④sngags grub pa'i grib 7ma 'am/ /gdon mi za bar mthong bar 'gyural/ /'gro dang mi 'gro'i skye bo rnams/ /dbang ma grub pa'ang dbang du byed / /rang gi khrag gis ⑩ming bris la/ /de nyid kyi ni phye mas dgang 3nye/ /ji srid bskams zhu par ma gyur par/ /de srid mi de 'ong bar tu)'gyur/ /gang dang gang gis na )lha dag gi lha/ /rim pa 'di yis ming bris te/ /khro bo ldan pas bzlas par bya/ /de 'dis 2skad cig de la 'grub/ /de yi bka' bzhin byed pa dang / /ngang gis de ni dbang du 'gyur/ /dkon mchog gsum la gnod byed pa/ /gsad rmo snyepa'i don du sngags rig pas/ /'bar ba'i phreng bas ( ste'akhrugs pa'i 'od/ /zhal bzhi pa la cher 'jigs pa/ /zhags pa lcags kyu thod pa can/ /bdag nyid myur du bsam par bya/ /gsang sngags dang ni sa spel 86wa 262

ba yis/ /ming ni sol bas bris nas su/ /gdug pa de ni mnan nas kyang / /rang gi gdug pa'i sems kyis bsnun/ /'di nyid kyi ni ting 'dzin gyis/ /nges pa ru yang ①res par byed/ /khams kyi sa bon dang spel ba'i/ /khams kyis ②ming ni bris nas su/ /khams de yang dag mnan nas ni/ /khang pa ru ni rgyun du bzhag /de ni myur du nges 'gyur te/ /de srid du ni mi g.yor gnas/ /rma bya'i sgro 'am gtsug phud kyis(kye/ /yongs su blangs la bsgrub par bya ma bya zhes bya'i ④tsa ba yi/ /mkhas pa yis ni yongs su gzung ⑤/ /dmag la sngags rig pas bskor bas/ /de nas dmag dpung 'jig ⑥pa dang / /rmongs pa 'am ⑦ ni rengs pa 'am/ /skad cig de la 'khor bar 'gyur/ /khyi dang phag dang bya rog gi/ /mig ni yongs su blangs nas su/ /mig sman dang ni mnyam por bya/ /lha mo'i sngags kyis bsngags pa yis(she/ /sgrub pa po yi gzugs rnams kun/ /'jig par 'gyur bar 51the tshom lngamed/ /tsaṇḍi'i me tog bcud nyid kyis/ /lcags kyis tunyegayogs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /de yi kha ru nges bcug pas/ /rga shi med par rnam par rgyu/ /rims gtong gzugs ni legs bris te/ /de yi kha ru gnod byed ni/ /sbyor ba yis ni bcug nas su/ /yongs su mnan la shin tu bzlas/ /rims gtong de yi gzugs kyis ni/ /rab tu 'dzin par gdon mi za / /gza' 'am yang dag yi dgas nyunyesam/ /gnod sbyin dang ni srin po dang / /gzhan pa yi ni nad rnams kyis/ /'dzin pa la ni dpyad /gemi dgos/ /gshin rje bris te bskrad par bya/ /de yi zhal du dgra bo ste/ /rmongs pa'i bdag nyid mi 'gro na/ /de ni myur du nges par 'chi/ /gsad yipa la yang 7'di nyid kyis//yongs su mnan nas nges par bzla/ /gang du gter ni yod snyam gyuradza/ /der 86—263

ni sngags rig ①pas song ste/ /lce yongs ②bzung la bzlas pa bya/ /de yis gsal po'i ③tshig gis smra/ /tshad dang yod dang med pa dang / /bgegs dang bgegs ni byaji ltar gnas/ /ji srid de ni dgyes smra ⑤na/ /de la gtor ma sbyin par bya/ /gal te bgegs ni mi smra na/ /der ni mchod yon rab tu brtag⑥ /pus mo gnyis btsugs gus ⑦pa yis/ /nor 'dzin sangs rgyas yum las so / /phyogs bzhi dag tu phur bus gdab/ /de nas gnas rnams bskrad par bya/ /de nas mtshams ni bcing bar ⑨bya/ /mnyam par bzhag ste ⑩bskor bar bya/ /sbyor ba shes pas 7sngags 'di yis/ /de nas rdzas ni gdon ⑩par bya/ /oṃ ba su de saṅgārga sā dha yā yu 0dha ra 8rakṣa rakṣa/ sargarba ni tsa yaṃ traṃ traṃ ⑫tsa tsa ṭa ṭa ha ha swā hā/ yang na rig pa 'di yis kyang / /las rnams dag ni thams cad bya/ /phyogs bcing ba dang 8de bzhin bsrung ⑩/ /phur bu bskrad ⑫pa de bzhin no/ /rin chen gsum ni thog mar sbyin/ /cha gcig dag 7ni nor 'dzin la'o/ /sdug bsngal can la cha gcig go/ /grogs po rnams la de dang mtshungs / /lhag ma rnams ni rig pas dpyad(3 / /dkon mchog gsum ni legs mchod bya/ /gzhan du sdug bsngal thob 'gyur te/ /rgyal po chom rkun 4nyesogs 'jigs lasal ge/ /gal te bla ma der bzhugs na/ /skal —9ba bzang po gnyis dbul lo/ /gzhan pa yi ni spyan ( —sternams la/ /rdo rje theg pa rtogs 'gyur ba'i —snye/ /skal 2nyab re ni sbyin par bya/ /gzhan du dam tshig gdung bar 'gyur / /'di ni bcom ldan rnal 'byor can/ /gsang ba rgyan gyi sonyerdo rjes gsungs / /de nas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi she/ /yum rnams kyis rdzu )ni der btud nas/ /dpa' bo che la zhu ba zhus/ /rgyas pa yi ni dkyil 'khor ni/ /86wa 264

gsungs shig ①gsungs shig ②dpa' bo che/ /yum rnams kun gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /rgyal po'i dbang phyug rab gsol pa/ /sems can thams cad 'dir 'byung ba'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po'i dbang phyug dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag ⑧nas nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /dkyil 'khor ji ltar sngar gsungs ④pa/ /'on kyang seng ge'i khri dang ldan/ /de yi steng du padma che/ /der ni ri bong can dkyil 'khor/ /de yi steng du nyi ma che/ /nyi ma der ni dkyil 'kher mchog /cha brgyad pa la dbus ⑤rin chen/ /de yi steng du rgyal ba'i 0yum/ /ser dang sngo ba'i 'od chen po/ /gser gyi ri bo dang mtshungs pasaX/ /phyag gnyis ④kyis ni chos 'chad cing / /g.yas pa yis ni mchog sbyin pa / /g.yon gyis ⑨rin chen lan bu mchod/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyanal/ /gos ni 'phyang ⑩zhing sna tshogs pa/ /gtsug 7tor mu tig thor tshugs can/ /de yi mdun du rin chen bri/ /g.yon du bum pa bzang po bzhagatuge /g.yas pa ru ni dpag bsam shing / /rgyab tu rin chen lan bu'o/ /mtshams tsornams su ni bum pa brgyad/ /gser gyi rang bzhin gzhag 8par bya/ /rin chen lnga yis 8yang dag 'khrugs/ /dri lnga dag dang ⑩yang dag ldan/ /bza' chal sogs pa'i ros tsogang ba'i/ /bum pa bcu drug phyi rol du/ /ser po'i gos kyis yongs su dkris/ /me tog ser po sogs kyis brgyan/ /de mdun blo ldan bri bar byam/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin dge ma/ /dmar dang ser dang ches ci nodakar ba/ /rin chen ldan pa'i phyag sbyin pa/ /ser po'i 'od ldan phreng ( 7mdzes ma / /rin chen bzang po kun gyi sras/ /mkha' zhi yi nyi zla skar ma yis/ /kun 86—265

nas yongs su bskor ba'o/ /gtsug phud ①rtsod pan gos la sogs/ /phreng ba dang ldan dgyes ②pa mo/ / dkyil 'khor ③de yi lhor bri ④ba/ /tshul khrims pha rol phyin dge ma/ /cung zad ser ba'i rin chen lus/ /sna dutshogs rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /sna tshogs gos ni yongs su gyon/ /mdzes shing ༅phreng ba'i chun po'i gtsug /gos ldan stigatsug na gtsug tor mchog /yid bzhin rin chen dam pa'i phyag /g.yon pa'i skyil krung nirin chen bzang / /cho ga ji bzhin rab tu bsam/ /rgyab tu bzod pa ma zhes bya/ /cung zad 'dzum zhing ⑨ser mdzes ma/ /dmar po'i gos ni legs par gyon/ /rin po che yi rgyan gyis brgyan / /thams cad rin chen mchog 'dri ⑩zhing / /dmar po'i gos ni 'phyang ba ma/ /gtsug na rin chen mchog dang ldan/ /seng ge mchog gi khri la bzhugs//byang du brtson 'grus chen mo ni/ /rdo rje go chas brgyan pa la/ /dpa' mo rin chen dbyug gu'i phyag /g.yas pa sbyin pa'i pha rol song / /pri yang ku la sngo bsangs dkar/ /rdo rje seng ge'i khri la bzhugs/ /lhag ma rnams ni gzhag zhunyebya ba / /dkyil 'khor byas te rin chen ldan/ /sgo dang sgo ru sgo ba ma/ /rin chen kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /de nas phyi yi phyi nyid du/ /rin chen snyim pa'i lag pa mchog /phyogs skyong ba phorteni thams cad ni/ /go rims 7bzhin du gzhag 8par bya/ /de yi phyi rol thams cad du/ /mkhas pas klu dang gnod sbyin bri'/ /rin chen bum pa bzang po dang / /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan lagan) /gtor ma rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /lha bshos rab tu bzang dge ba/ /bza' dang btung ba'i ro mchog dang / /mar dang ka ra nyid dang ni/ /zho dang bu ram hwags dang bcas/ /'o ma mar dang sbrang rtsi dang / /rgyal po'i hu bza' ba 86—266

dam pa'i mchog /bza' ba la sogs rab mchog go/ /de nas sngags pas 'jug par bya/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan nas su/ /ser po'i gos 'dzin dag pa dang / /phreng ldan dri zhim ldan pa'i las/ /sgo yi char ni zhugs nas su/ /thog mar lha ni spyan drang bya/— /phyag rgya bcings te dbyangs snyan pas①/ /rab tu dga' ba'i yid kyis su/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten dag la sman slad du/ /kun tu bzang po'i smon lam dran mdzod la/ /rin chen dam pa seng ge'i khrir bzhugs te/ /'khor bcas lha dang de bzhin gshegs pa spyon/ /de nas de dag legs byon te/ /sras bcas 'khor dang bcas rnams kyang / /sems can rnams la dngos grub ster/ /sgrub pa po la khyad par du/ /de nas thal mo legs sbyar la/ /rin chen gyis bkang (0me tog bcas/ /gsang sngags brjod de gtor bar bya/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /de nas rang gis (midabang bskur bya/ /de yi sngags dang phyag rgya yis/ /sa la lag pas reg nas su/ /bsnyems ④pa yis ni 'thon ⑤par bya/ /de nas slob ma gzhug ⑥par bya/ /me tog dris ni yang dag sdud/ /ser po'i gos bzang yang dag gyon/ /lago na rin chen dri bzang po/ /dga' rdzidang bcas te snyim pa (kyede/ /snga ma'i sngags kyis dor bar bya/ /gang gi tho)drung du lhung gyur pa/ /lha de de yis tso'agrub pa yin / /de nas g.yas nas rnam bskor te/ /slob ma de ni 'byung bar bya /bzang po'i seng ge'i khrir bzhag ste/ /dbang bskur ba yi sbyor ba bya/rje/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan dang / /mdzes pa'i rnga / yab g.yob pa yis/ /de bzhin du yang dbang bskur te/ /bum pa brgyad dam nyunyebacu drug la/ /de yi sngags dang phyag rgya yis/ /go rims blaji lta ba bzhin no/ /de nas sbyor ba der tshe86—267

'ongs te/ /'khor los sgyur ①ba'i rim pa yis/ /'khor lo rin chen bzang po'i lag /rgyal ba rgyal ba'i sgra dge bas/ /gsang ba'i sbyor ba'i rnal 'byor gyis / /lte ba ru ni dbang bskur ro/ /'di bdag gter ②can rin chen 'dzin / /rdo rje rin chen 'dzin par 'gyur/ /dam tshig gi ni dam pa yis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi don rgyas pa/ /'bad pas de ring blangs pa yis phongs ②pa'i dri ma 'phrog par byed/ /de nas dpa' bo 'chi med 'dzin/ /rin chen tshogs kyis mchod par ④bya/ /gzhan pa yi yang du ma ni/ /rgyal po dbang phyug dam pas so/ /de bzhin dbang bskur lnga po yis/ /skal med kyang ni bdag med 'gyur/ /gling bzhi'i phyidabang phyug dpal ldan yang / /gnod pa med par thob par 'gyur/ /gsang ba las kyang ches shin tu/ /gsang ba yi ni mna' bsgags te0/ /de yi bsgom ⑦dang sgrub pa'i thabs/ /slob ma la ni de nas bslab / /gur gum dang ni tsandan dang / /dri dang mar me bzang po la/ /dam tshig gis (8)ni gsal byas pa/ /lan gsum du ni 'thung du gzhug /bu kye 'thung ⑨shig gsang ba che/ /dam tshig shin tu ⑩'da' ba dka'/ /gal te 'di las 'das gyur na/ /myur ba nyid du 'chi bar 'gyur/ /shi nas kyang ni dmyal sdug bsngal / /rab mang ngu 'bod nyid du gnas/ /gal te mi ru skye 'dod pa'am/ /nam zhig dngos grub thob 'dod na/ /de bzhin phongs phonyapa'i sdug bsngal las/ /ring du nges par khyod kyis skyobs/ /'di dag legs thos 7slob ma la/ /gsang ba'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya/ /ji lta'i 0stergyal rigs bu mo ni/ /bzung nas gsal ba'i rnal 'byor bya/ /nyi ma bdun na nges par 'grub/ /rgyal po'i phun tshogs thob par 'gyurathu/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i mchog /dkyil 'khor 86—268

sbyor bas bsam gtan bya/ /rgyal mo cho ga bzhin bzung ste/ /sgrub pa pos ①ni myur du bsgrub②/ /nyi ma gsum gyis ②rgyal po mchog /gdon mi za bar thob par 'gyur/ /bram ze'i bu mo skal chen mo/ /nor chen la ni bsgrub par bya/ /rje rigs sna tshogs sbyor ba yis/ /mtshungs pa nyid du bsgrub par bya/ /de yis dngos grub mchog rnyed de/ /rgyal po 'jig rten gsum gyis brjed/ /dmangs ④mo dpa' bo'i sbyor ba yis/ /bsgrubs phyin sngags kyi dngos grub 'gyur/ /gnod sbyin rgyal mchog grub pa dang / /gnod sbyin rnams kyi dbang phyug mchog /dman pa'i sems su bshad pa dang / /mchog gis 6)mchog ni chen po dang / /bar mas bar ma'i dngos grub ni/ /skye ba 'di la thob par 'gyur/ /de nas las rnams bslab par bya/ /zhi ba dang ni rgyas pa'i las/ /de bzhin dbang dang mngon spyod dang / /gzhan pa yi yang ⑦sna tshogs ni/ /sems can rnams la dga' ba'o/ /shes rab pha rol phyin dge ma/ /dkyil 'khor sbyor bas bsgom par bya/ /kunda dkar po zla ba 'dra/ /'od zer dkar pos mdzes pa mo /skye ⑧bo nad pa 'chi ka ma/ /de yi lus la gzhug par bya/ /de nas de ni stobs ldan 'gyur/ /brgyad gnyis pa yi lang tshor ldan/ /nad rnams kun las rnam par grol/ /rga dang 'chi ba rnam par spangs/ /bstan bcos kun gyi don rig cing ske/ /shes rab dran pa mchog dang ldan/ /de bzhin rang 'gyur rnal 'byor pa / /nam mkha' la ni yang dag bsgomadzin/ /mdzes pa'i rin chen sna tshogs pa'i / /thams cad du ni char 'bab pa/ /'di yis phongs ⑩pa rnam par sel/ /phongs /dzo nyepa rnams la rab tu brtag /mthe bo tu yi ni tshad tsam pa'i/ /nor rgyun ma yi rnam pa bya/ /lha mo la ni mnyam par gzhaganyuge /de yi mdun du gsang 86—269

sngags bzlas/ /ji srid 'bum phrag kho na ste/ /de nas dngos grub bsgrub ①par bya / /zla ba gang ba'am bcu bzhi 'am/ /brgyad pa'am ②gzas gzung ②nyin par la/ /mchod pa chen po byas nas su/ /mkhas pas mtshan mo thog thag bzlas / /de nas dga' bas gzugs brnyan de⑥/ /gdon mi za bar 'bar bar 'gyur/ /de nas ⑤bzung ste mdor bsdu na/ /mi yi 'khor los sgyur skyobar 'gyur / /bzlas pas mtshan ma bzang byung na/ /rnal 'byor pa ⑦ni nor chen 'gyur / /bar mas gling ni thob par 'gyur/ /tha ma yis ni khor yug go/ /thams cad du ni bzlas tsam gyis/ /longs spyod zad par 'gyur ma yin/ /rgyal po thams cad dbang 'gyur zhing / /bud med thams cad dga' bar 'gyur / /snying gar 3)rnal 'byor byas nas su/ /nor bu lag par bcangs nas ni / /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas bsgom6)/ /myur du rin chen rgyal por 'gyur / /phyag rgya 'di ni byas gyur pas/ /rtag tu sgom pas bsgom ⑩par bya/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i grub rnyed de/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa ji bzhin no/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas bka' stsal to/ /de nas sbyor ba ji bzhin du/ /yum de rnams ni legs byon nas/ /las kyi dkyil 'khor legs gnas pa/ /ston pa la ni zhu ba zhus/ /gang du rgyal ba kun bzhugs nas/ tagu na med pa'i don mdzad pa/ /sems can kun la bde slad du/ /myur du las ni 'grub pa legs / /de nas bcom ldan 'das las thams cad kyi dam pa'i dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yum gyi nyastodam pa de rnams la las kyi dkyil 'khor bka' stsal pa/ rlung gi yigedakyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /de yi dbus su gru yi gsum pa/ /de yi steng du lha mo 86—270

bzhag /'bar ba'i me dang mtshungs pa la/ /zhal bzhi ma la cher 'jigs pa①//mche ba rab tu gtsigs pa mo/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i cod pan can/ /rdo rje lcags kyu thod ②pa dang / /zhags pa g.yas dang g.yon par 'dzin/ /pags ①pa chen po gos su gyon/ /khro mo mig 'bras rab phyung ba/ /mche bas mchu mnan zhal chen mo/ /de yi mdun du bri bya ba/ /mtha' ma'i zhal ni mdor bsdus ④pa//sna tshogs gtum dang drag po'i zhal/ /du ma'i phyag gis yang dag 'khrugs⑤/ /zhags pa lcags kyu thod sogs dang / /rdo rje can gyi sog le 'dzin/ /thod pas lus la bres gyur cing / /cod pan chen pos 'jigs byed mo/ /gshin rje dpa' bos bri bya ba/ /mtha' gdong dam pa yi ni mchog /sngon po 'bar ba'i rang bzhin khros/ /mgo bo'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i cod ⑥pan can/ /stag gi pags nyapa'i sham (8)thabs can/ /ral gri rin chen thod pa dang / /rin chen dbyug gu 'dzin pa'i mchog /de nas lha mo legs bri ba / /padma'i zhal ma 'jigs chen mo(7/ /dmar mo phyag na nyi zla 'dzin/ / bskal pa'i 7me dang mtshungs pa mo3na/ /g.yon pa ru ni khro mo che/ /ma bcom em ni ska 9/sherags mgulayi/ /las kyi rdo rje dril 8ldan mchog /mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa'i zhal/ /gtsug na thod pa 'jigs su rung / /rab gtum stobs dang gsal ba mo/ /sbyor ri ldan cho ga rig pas bri / /phyi rol du ni legs bri ba//khro bcas 'jigs pa dang bcas pa/ /ral pa'i thor tshugs chen po can/ /khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang / /phyag rgya bzang pos phyag mtshan pa'o/ /de yi phyi ru lha rnams ni/ /snyim pa rdzirab sbyar yi dam pa/ /thams cad du ni yongs su gzhagazhuge /'jig rten skyong ba gzhag sapar bya/ /sgo rnams dag ni thams cad 86—271

dul/ /sgo skyong ba yang ①de bzhin du/ /de nas gtor ma'i cho ga ni/ /sha bcas btung ba ro dang ldan/ /de nas go cha bcings gyur pas②/ /thod pa'i cod pan chen po dang / /khrag gam chang gis bkang ba'am/ /thod pa ldan pas 'jug par bya/ /thams cad 'grub pa'i ma mo rnams/ /'di yis spyan ni drang bar bya/ /dkon mchog gsum la gnod byed pa'i/ / gsad pa'i ③don du ma mo rnams/ /de ring nyid du dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /'jigs chen ma rnams thams cad gshegs/ /'jigs pa'i sgra dang cher gtum dang / /kha nas 'od zer stong phrag ni/ /mthong ba dang ni thos pa na/ /mtshan mar yang ni shes par bya / /de nas de yis argha ④spyin/ /ci bder bzhes shig ⑤'jigs mdzad ma/ /gdug pa chen po gsol bar mdzod(nya/ /gdug gtum 'jigs par byed pa yis//de nas bdag la dbang bskur te/ /thod par gnas pa'i ro yis ni/ /srang tsam gyis (meni sha zos nas(kye/ /ma mo thams cad bsgrub par bya/ /de nas mngon spyod las rnams kun/ /dam tshig bsrung ba yis ni bya/ /dkon mchog gsum la gnod byed dang / /bla ma rnams la 'khyal smra ba/ /rtag tu gsod par lha mo rnams/ /bgyid par bdag ni rjes su gzung (7/ /de nas cho ga de nyid kyis/ /slob ma'i dam pa gzhug 7par bya/ /khro bo'i lha la bskul nas su/ /me tog dmar po dor bar bya/ /bdag gi me tog dam pa 'di/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /bdug nyuhepa 'di ni bzung nas su/ /gsol byed 'di ni gsol bar mdzoda'i / /lha mo gang la lhung gyur pa/ /de yis de la mchog gsol lo/ /de nas dbang bskur byin nas su/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni mdun bzhag ste/ /thod pa ru ni gnas pa yi1ste/ /khrag gis dbang ni bskur bar bya/ /de nas sgo ru bos 86—272

nas su/ /dam tshig 'bad pas 'dzin du gzhug /rab tu gdug pa'i snying gi khrag /bzang po 'di ni 'thung zhig bu①/ /zo shig zo shig ②sha chen po/ /btung ba 'jigs pa chen po 'thung / /gzhan du na ni 'chi 'gyur te/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang gza' ②rnams dang / /gnod sbyin srin po gtum po yi/ /ring por mi thogs rab tu za/ /de nas mngon spyod las rnams ni/ /stong phrag dag ni bslab par bya/ /de yi sbyor ba'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /rang nyid khro bor bzung gyur pasaX/ /gnod byed thams cad gsad ⑤par bya/ /dgra durnams thams cad bza' bar bya/ /gdug ⑦pa thams cad bca' bar bya/ /srin po thams cad gzhom par bya/ /mtha' yas zhal ma'i sbyor ba yis/ /gsad nidang gzung skyub de yis bya/ /zhal bzhi ma yi 0sbyor ba yis/ /thams cad 'gugs pa'i dam pa'ang 7yin/ /mkha' gdong ma yis thams cad du/ /rin po che yi tshogs 'byung 8ngo / /padma'i zhal gyi sbyor ba yis/ /chang gi dam pa btung bar bya/ /ma bcom 8ma yi sbyor ba yis/ /sha ni 0'gugs pa'i mchog yin no/ /nam mkha' rengs 8pa chen po ste/ /dmag dpung 'byor pa'i dam pa'o/ /rmugs dang rmongs pa thams cad du/ /dpyad pa ru ni mi bya'o/ /sngar bshad pa yi las rnams dang / /ma bshad pa la ci 'dod pa/ /bzlas pa tsam gyis kun bya ste/ /thams cad du ni the tshom 7med/ /dur khrod kyi ni thal ba la/ /dgra bo'i ⑩gzugs ni 'bad pas bya/ /ming dang spel tunyebar byas nas su/ /ma mo'i ral gris gtub 7par bya/ /de nas nyi ma bdun na ni/ /brlag dzu )par 'gyur bar gdon mi za/ /gang lus ji ltar bcad gyur pa/ /de dang de yi yan lag 'chad/ /zhal bzhi ma yi du tesbyor ba yis/ /sngags pa mnyam par bzhag ri gyepas 86—273

bcad / /de yi mgrin par zhags pa ni/ /mkhas pas spros ①te bcing bar bya/ /lcags lakyus snying gar ①phug nas su/ /rlung gis bskyod de drang bar bya /de nas de yi ming bskul nas/ /de ni shes rab ldan pas dgug /dman dang mchog gi dbye ba yis/ /'di yi ④'bras bu nga yis bshad/ /mdor bsdus ⑤pas ni shes par bya/ /sngags (6)pa'i rgyal po'i sbyor ba yis/ /zhes ⑦so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ni/ de yis dngos grub gsol mi 'gyur/ /nye bar 'tshe ba 'jigs rnams dang / /gdon dang gnod sbyin srin por (nyebacas/ /mi bzad tsond kyis btab nas su/ /shi nas mnar med nyid du 'gyur/ /de nas de bzhin dbang bskur gyi0/ /dkyil 'khor la bzhag yum rnams kyis/ /dbang bskur gsang ba'i dam tshig sbyin/ /gsang ba'i sgrub thabs nyan tu du gzhug /rang yum ma mo'i sa bon gyis/ /rang gi rnam rtog bdag yum min/ /lta bus yab gyur bsgrubs hunyen ni/ /nyi ma bdun na rab tu 'grub/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi yab ston pa/ /kun mkhyen ye shes spyod yul te/ /drag po kun dang bde chen po/ /ye shes kun gyi mchog gi mchog /shes rab kyis ni thams cad bsgrubazhuste/ /las rgyas pa yi dam pa'i mchog /bye brag tu ni bskul nas skasu/ /byang chub kyi ni yon tan gyi/ /thams cad du ni 'od gsal ba'i/ /dngos grub thams cad bsgrub par bya/ /shes rab kyi lho ni las dbye bas/ /gzugs dang dbyibs nyid dag gis so/ /phyag rgya dang ni phyag rgya'i lan/ /de bzhin dkyil 'khor dam tshig dang / /bza' ba dang ni nyer spyod pa/ /gtor ma lha bshos nyid dang ni/ /shin tu bde ba'i stan nyid dang / /de dang de ni nges par sbyar/ /bzlas dang bsam gtan 86—274

sa bon ni/ /rang gi lus khyab pa nyid do/ /gsang sngags dag ni thams cad las / /gsang sngags 'di ni rab tu bsngags/ /tshe 'dir ①dam pa'i rjes grub ②cing ske/ /gdon mi za bar thob par 'gyur/ /'di ni bcom ldan kun rdo rje/ /ye shes 'byung gnas mnga' bdag gsungs / /las kun gyi ni sbyor ba yis/ /'di ni sgyu mas 'gro la bzhugs/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yum de rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /phyag rgya'i ye shes mchog tu dge/ /ye shes chen pos gsung du gsol/ /gang gis mngon par rgyas btab kun/ /mnga' bdag dus mi ring bar 'grub/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yang ting nge 'dzin rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /phyag rgya rtags su yang dag bshad/ /tha snyad tsam du rnam par btags④/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis ⑤kla klo'i skad/ /phyag rgya thams cad yang dag bshad/ /'on kyang mgon po mchog gis yibartags//lag pa'i rnam dgod mtshan ma nyid/ /gang gis ⑦yid ches legs skye rnams/ /dam tshig shes pa'i lha rnams ni/ /sgrub po rnams kyis rab bskul na/ /grub pa'i dam pa rab (shetu stsol/ /dus las thams cad byon nas su/ /slar yang gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur/ /lag pa zla ba nyi mar bya/ /shes rab thabs su rab tu brtag /de nas sngags pas yongs su sbyar/ /rang gi sa bon dag gis mtshan/ /oṃ prarnyo pā yinyeya sa mā yo ga /de nas thal mo nges par sbyar/ /phan tshun rjes su rtogs chen po/ /khu tshur shin tu gzhag 7par bya/ /khu tshur bsdams 3nyepa lta bur bcing / /so so ru ni sbyor bar bya/ /snying gi dbus su nges par bzung tshe/ /g.yon pa'i steng du lag pa g.yas/ / bzhag ste / sor mo so 86—275

sor bya/ /lag g.yas bsgreng ①nas phyogs kun tu/ /'khor lo'i sbyor bas spro bar bya/ /rdo rje sgo lcags lta bur bskum/ /sor mo thams cad rtsibs su bya/ /oṃ sarba dharma ⑤tsakra sa mā ye/ de bzhin g.yon pa niyongs su spro/ /sor mo rtsibs ④kyi sbyor ba yis/ /shes rab steng du bsgreng rjobar bya/ /g.yas pa yang ni de bzhin no/ /rtse mo cung zad sbyar bar bya/ /chos kyi las ni chen po byed/ /de nyid mnyam yidu bskums pa ni/ /las kyi phyag rgya zhes su grags/ /de bzhin ming med byas nas su/ /lhag ma ⑦rnams ni gdong du sbyar/ /phyag rgya chen po shin tu ni/ /dngos grub thams cad rab tu gsol/ /phyag rgya 'di rnams bsdams nas ⑧ni/ /rang nyid shes rab bdag por 'gyur/ /kun tu bzang po rgyal po che/ /lha dang lha min bcas pas mchod/ /ce'o/ /de nas ma mo de rnams kun/ /slar yang gtso bo la bstod nas/ /shes rab chen po rnam bzhi yi//phyag rgya zhu ba rnam par byas/ /phyag rgya bzhi yi rab kyi mchog /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsol cig /gsang ba'i phyag rgya'i yal ga mchog /shes rab thabs kyi (7lus bzang ba/ /gang zhig gsang ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ /gang gis ⑩rnal 'byor pa bde ba/ /rdzu 'phrul 'phel dang yang dag pa'i/ /rdzu 'phrul skye ba 'dir rnyed rtsonapa/ /bcom ldan ston pas bka' stsal pa/ /gsang ba'i phyag rgya rgyal ba'i gzhi/ /gang gis 12myur du sgrub nyunyepo kun/ /rab tu bde bar gnas pas 'grub/ /de nas bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /mnyes te gsang ba'i dam pa gsungs / /phyag rgya'i pha rol phyin pa rnams/ /bde ba chen po rab tu bsgrubasnyi/ /rdo rje thal mo dam par skobasdams/ /rdo rje dbus su gzhag ⑩par bya/ /gsang ba'i dam tshig ces 1 tshosu bsgrags/ /gsang ba'i rnal 'byor rab tu sgrubatunye/ /de 86—276

nyid rdo rje lta bur bya①/ /bskyod pas bde ba skyed ②par byed/ /'di ni chos 'dzin zhes bya ba'i/ /phyag rgya gsang ba sgrub ①pa'o/ /g.yon par thabs ni bskums nas su/ /bskyod pas bde ba 'gugs par byed/ /dag pa'i las zhes rab tu grags/ /bde ba thams cad rab stsol byed/ /de nyid kha dang rkan la ni / /sbyar ba chen mo zhes su bshad/ /rdo rje phan tshun yang dag sbyar/ /lcags kyu'i kha ni bskyod par bya/ /kha ni phan tshun yongs sbyar ba/ /gsang ba'i zhags pa zhes su grags/ /de bzhin bskum ④par byas nas su/ /dam du bsdams te bcing bar bya/ /'di ni gsang ba bsdams ⑤pa'i rgya/ /ye shes bsdams yipa rab tu 'grub/ /thams cad rdo rje ltar rdo rje/ /de bzhin bskyod cing bskor bar bya/ /de 'di gsang ba rab tshim pa/ /tshim pa'i don ni ster bar byed/ /lhag ma phyag rgya chen po ru/ /shes bya phyag rgya mdor bsdus pa'o/ /de nyid las kyi gaphyag rgya mchog /las kyi dbye bas sbyar bar bya/ /zhes so/ /de nas ma mo de rnams kun/ /yid ni tshim zhing mgu ba yis/ /rdo rje sems dpar nimatshan yangs pa'i/ /legs so ba ni nges par phul/ /legs so legs so gsang chen po/ /legs so legs so mchod chen po/ /legs so legs so rnal 'byor che/ /legs so legs so ⑨rab tshim mdzad/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ma rnams dang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje btsun mo rnams kyis bodagyes pa'i dkyil 'khor zhu ba bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ sangs rgyas rang bzhin khyod la 'dud/ /spyod pa'i tunyerin chen khyod la 'dud/ /dam pa'i rgyur gyur skokhyod la 'dud/ /sna tshogs mdzad pa khyod la 'dud/ /dpa' bo 'dul ba khyod la 'dud/ / gsang ba'i nyu chos ldan khyod la 'dud/ /zhi ba'i thugs la phyag 86—277

'tshal 'dud/ /mgon po khyod la bdag cag zhu/ /bdag gis ①dkyil 'khor zhu ba'i phyir/ /mnga' bdag rgyal dang sems can rnams/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis ②rdo rje btsun mo'i dkyil 'khor bka' stsal pa/ de lta'i dkyil 'khor bris nas su/ /dbus su pha rol phyin ma dgod / /rnyi zhes bya ba shes rab can/ /thabs ④dang ldan pas gsal byas pa//'di yis ⑤sngags pa 'jigs med par/ /zla ba phyed kyis nges par 'gyur/ /rig pa 'di yis de yi 6)ni/ /las rnams thams cad byed pa dang / /dbang dang dgug dang dbye ba dang / /tshim dang 'phrog dang 'bras chen po/ /zhi bas zhi ba zhes su bshad/ /brnyes ma zhes pas rgyas par bshad/ /dbang dang dgug dang dbye ba la/ /byed ma'o dbang la drag mo yin/ /sha yi mtha' ru bdud gsod ma/ /gsod pa dang ni spel bar bya/ /'gro ba dang ni yang dag ldan / /sor mo zhags pas dkri bar bya/ /thams cad du ni drag po dgug⑦ /drag po drag po'i go 'phang gnas/ /'di yi cho ga ldan pa yis/ /las kyi ⑧tshogs kyi mchog kun bya/ /sems la rnal 'byor legs bsams te(9)/ /brgyad brgya 7kho na bzlas pa yis/ /dbang bcas nyid dam dbang chen po/ /stobs kyis mgo bo mnan nas su/ /ma mo'i tshogs kun de yis bzla/ /dus mi ring bar 'grub par 'gyur/ /gzi brjid chen pos bka' bzhin du/ /mgo bos nye bar phyag 'tshal te/ /'di yi nyalham mo thams cad kun/ /gzi brjid kyi yonyani gzi ldan pa/ /sngags kyi rgyal po 'od ldan pas/ /go rims tunyeji lta ba bzhin du/ /dpe zla med pa'i dngos grub byed/ /grub pa'i lam la rab tu gnas/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin pa yi/ /'phrul dang rnam par 'phrul pa yisam/ /'di ni ston 86—278

pa chen pos gsungs/ /ma skyes skye ba med la bzhugs/ /rtag pa ston pa thams cad pa/ /nam mkha' nyi 7zla dri ma med/ /de dag thams cad rab dga' ste/ /dngos po spangs pa'i btsun mo yis/ /gar dang glu dang sil snyan mchog /bzhad ②dang sgeg pa'i sbyor ba yisal/ /bud med sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul dang / /gling bu pi bang rdza rnga ④sogs/ /ting ting shag dang dung sgra dang / /ro dang reg pa dri chen po/ /gzugs dang sgra sogs bde ldan ⑤pas/ /dpa' chen la ni mchod byas nas/ /snyems dang bcas pas phyag 'tshal te/ /slar yang mgon po la gsol btab/ /rdo rje btsun mo'i dkyil 'khor rnams/ /mgon po ci yi phyir mi gsung ⑥/ /yab rnams kyi ni thams cad dang / /yum rnams kyi ni mdor bsdus pa/ /mchod pa yang ni thams cad de/ /bran bcas pho nya pho nya mo/ /'jig rten pa ni mtha' dag gi/ /gtso bo chen pos gsung du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gnyis su med pa rnam par 'phrul ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de dag nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje la gzhug pa dang / dgug pa dang / bcing ba (3)dang / mnyes par bya stel/ nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang tsa/thugs rdo rje gnyis su med pa bsgyings pa dang ldan pa la mnyam par bzhag ste tsobazhugs so/ /de nas yang bde ba yongs su skyes pa rab tu dgyes pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad lhan cig bskyod /smyonapa dang bcas pa bran dang bcas pas de la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /mgon po dbang phyug rdo rje sems/ /rdo rje snang ba mdzes pa'i sku/ /gsang ba rgyan gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /dpa' bo chen pos gsung du gsol/ /gang gis tshe86—279

rgyal ba kun bskyed ①pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' ⑤grags chen po/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba rgyan gyi bkod ③pa dkyil 'khor chen po'i mchog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /e ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyis④/ /zhu ba rab tu zhus pa ni/ /gang phyir nga ⑤la dngos med kyang / /zhu ba zhus pa thams cad thos/ /gsang ba chen po'i smon lam dang / /de bzhin snying rje'i pha rol phyin / /dran pa med las dran pa yang / /dran 'gyur yidran po bzhin ⑦gnas pa / /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang chen po/ /shes rab pha rol phyin dge ba/ /chos dang chos min rnam par spangs/ /brjod du med pa bshad par bya/ /de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis nibadag nyid de rnams de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba rgyan gyi bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal po bka' stsal pa'i phyir slar yang glu'i dbyangs 'dis zhu ba zhus pa/ chos dbyings mi g.yo bde la legs bzhugs dam pa'i thugs/ /phyogs bcu mtha' yas sangs rgyas kyis yo)zhabs legs btud pa7/ /bde mchog lha yi lha ste sa dbang 'jig rten bla/ /dkyil 'khor bde ba mchog la bzhugs gsol bde chen gyi(/te/ /sa gnyis gtsug gis yiphyag byas bde ldan padma'i gtsug tor gyisatunye/ /rnam pa kun tu gar mdzad sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor dam pa gsungs shig ④kye/ /'gro kun phan dgongs rab tu bzhugs tshigasol mchod pa chen po kye/ /cha lugs rnam pa du mas 'gro kun 'dul 7mdzad kun gyi dam pa kye6me/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsol ba btab cing bskul ba'i tshig nyid kyi /nyethugs la bzhag nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa 4thams cad kyis tu)dkyil 'khor bsgyur du )ba 86—280

chen po rab tu tshim ①pa bde ba la ②longs spyod pa rnam par bsgyings pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad byin gyis brlabs te/ bde ba chen po 'khor los sgyur nib la rab tu gnas nas nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje rnams las ④rab tu phyung ngo / /dkyil 'khor snga ma bzhin bris la/ /de yi lte bar 'di dgod do/ /rdo rje chen po bsam gtan ⑤pa/ /'dod pa'i dbang phyug dag dang ldan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi yab/ /kun gyi thog mthar ⑥rab byung ba/ /de la sogs pa'i rim pa yis/ /thams cad kun tu brtag (7par bya/ /padma'i lo ma rtsibs ⑧la ni/ /rang gi chos dang rab tu spel/ /ma mo rnams ni thams cad kyitso/ /mchod pa la sogs rab tu brtag⑩ /sgo ru sgo ba yongs su brtag /sgo yi phyi ru sgo skyong ba/ /btsun mo lhan cig spyod bcas pa/ /kun nas lha rnams gzhag tunyepar bya/ /de nas rang gi sa bon gyis/ /klu dang gnod sbyin 'phar ma gzhan/ /dri za rnams dang mi 'am ci/ /lha min /tshosemakha' lding de bzhin no/nye/ /'jig rten skyong ba thams cad ni/ /sgo ru gnyis gnyis gzhag cipar bya/ /gdon dang dug dang rims dang nad/ /yi dgas 'isha za srin po dang / /dmyal ba brgyad po phyogs brgyad kyi/ /'khor lo'i phyi ru gzhag 7par bya/ /de nas 'khor lo'i mu khyud bri/ /chen po rin chen bdun rang bzhin/ /de yi sgo ru bri bya ba/ /shar du 'dod chags skye chaganas lag /zhe snang drag po lus gnag pa/ /byang du legs par bri bar bya/ /gti mug nub tu bri bar bya/ /lho ru nga rgyal nyid yin no/ /sog le dang ni gos nag po/ /de bzhin dbyug gu 'jigs chen po/ /'di rnams phyag rgyar brtags pa'o/ /de nas ji lta ba bzhin 'jug /de nas 86—281

gsang ba rdo rje'i phyag rgya nges par bcings pa'i lag par gyur pas ①rang gi dam tshig rjes su dran pas phyag rgya de nyid kyis 'gugs ②pa'i rnam pa dang rdo rje'i glu ①'dis bskul te dkyil 'khor thams cad spyan drang bar bya'o/ /'dir gshegs 'dir gshegs sangs rgyas zhal ras sangs rgyas dpal/ /bde bar gshegs pa yum dang bcas pa mtha' dag gis bskor te/ /'dir gshegs 'dir gshegs padma'i spyan ras pad las 'khrungs/ /dam tshig rnam dag rnams kyi dudapa' bo ⑤dam pa'i phyag(ye /glu ⑦dbyangs rgyal po 'di yis ni/ /rdo rje'i dublo gros nges par bskul/ /byon 'gyur 7song shig song shig ces/ /'khod cig 'khod cig 'khod par bya/ /tshim zhing tshim la rab tu tshim/ /zhugs shig zhugs shig 'jug par bya/ /kwa kye zhes brjod bskul ba yisatshu/ /sa la gnas kun rab tu 'bebs / /de nas me tog dor bar bya/ /bcom ldan bde bar bzhes su gsol / /lha dbang gang la lhung 'gyur bzung / /de yi sgrub thabs brtsam par bya / /yang na yid la gang 'dod pa'i/ /sgrub byed sgrub yipo dam pas byed/ /de nyid du ni dbang bskur ba/ /rnal 'byor pa ni mkhas pas blang / /de nas slob ma gzhug 1rtapar bya/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /dar la sogs pas gdong g.yogs te/ /phyag rgya bcings pa'i lag bzang pos de bzhin du ni me tog dor/ /sa ma ya st+waṃ bdag gis brjod/ /me tog gang la lhung gyur pa/ /de yi nyi sbyor bas dbang bskur bya/ /yang na gang 'dod rnal 'byor gyis/ /sbyor ba bsgoms te 0dbang bskur bya/ /yang na bdag po'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /gal te de ni sbyor ldan 'gyura'i/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan bla re yisogs / /blang lte 1ga ra yi bum pa dang / /rnga yab rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /seng 86—282

ge'i khri ni bzang po dang / /gser dang dngul gyi ①dbyug gu dang / /rin chen dbyug gu du ma ni/ /dgyes pa'i dkyil 'khor nyid du bzhag /dbang bskur spro ba chen po yis/ / de yi stan ②la bzhag nas sum̐/ /rnal 'byor ldan pas dbang bskur ro/ /dbang bskur ji ltar rigs pa yis②/ /gsang ba'i sbyor bas dbang bskur ro/ /thog mar sdom pa ldan pa yis/ /de ni dam tshig 'dzin du gzhug /'dir ni nga yi ④dam tshig zung ⑤/ /phyi dang gsang ba rnam pa bzhi/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi 0sdom pa ni/ /sangs rgyas ye shes rab gsal byed/ /gdug pa thams cad gsad par (lebya/ /'jungs pa rnams kyi nor dbrog (2)bya/ /lta ba ngan la brdzun du smra/ /srog chags gsod la smra bar bya/ /gzhan gyi bud med mngon bgrod ⑨par/ /ci bde bar ni phrogs shig bu/ /gzhan rdzas 'phrog par byed rnams dang / /dkon mchog gsum la 'gal byed pa/ /gsad dang gzhom par bya ba dang / /de bzhin khrag rnams btung ba ru/ /'bad pa yis ni thams cad byos/ /dam tshig rnam pa gsum po yis/ /de nas yon ni phul nas su/ /bla ma la ni gus pa yisa'i/ /zhabs la mgo bos nges gtugs te/ /rang lus rgyal po'i longs spyod dang / /chung ma'am yang na bu mo dang / /bu rnams dang ni bran nyid dang / /sring mo sring mo'i bu mo dang / /ma dang rang gi mna' ma dang ske/ /grong dang yul gyi longs spyod dang / /shing rta 'gro dang glang po dang / /rnam par bkra ba'i rta rnams dang / /nor gyis gang ba'i grong rnams dang / /ba lang /stom he ra rnams dang / /lug rgod rnams dang gzhan rnams dang / /rnga mo mdzes ma'i rnga nyu mo mo/ /gzhan yang gzhan yang gang 'dod pa/ /ji ltar rigs pas mchod par bya/ /rim bzhin rang gi slob ma'i tshogs/ /mgon po 86—283

mchod nas gshegs su gsol/ /gang gzhan rdo rje spun la yang / /de nas sgrub thabs dam pa bslab/ /srog dang thur sel sbyor ba yis/ /sems kyi brtan pa nyid du bya/ /zla ①ba nya ba ②lta bur dgang / /cha shas chadag ni bcu drug kyang / /de yi dbus su rnam bsam pa/ /gtso chen 'dod pa'i dbang phyug go/ /mdor bsdus nas ni spro bar bya/ /brtul zhugs ④can gyis rang lus bsam/ /bdag nyid 'dod pa'i dbang phyug rgyal/ /'dod pa'i zil gyis mnan nas su/ /rnal 'byor can bdag dpal ldan 'grub/ /lha dbang bcas pas phyag 'tshal zhing / /nad dang mya ngan 'jigs pa sel(pe/ /rga dang 'chi ba rnam par spangs/ /zla ba gcig tsam bzlas pa yis/ /dpa' bos tshulas kun byed par 'gyur/ /zhi dang rgyas dang de bzhin dbang / /drag shul spyod pa'i ④rim pa yis/ /dgug dang dbab pa'i las rnams ni/ /skad cig tsam zhig bskul ba yis/ /sngags pas ⑧thams cad byed par 'gyur/ /sngags kyi sbyor bas sngags zlos ⑨pas/ /'di ni bcom ldan rnal 'byor gsung ⑩/ /yan lag lnga las skyes pa gzung ⑩/ /'byung po'i nyi ma mtshan mo gung / /lcags gsum gyis ni dkris byas la/ /rang gi kha ru gzhug par bya/ /bdag nyid rnal 'byor ldan pas bzlas/ /de ni nang par mthong mi 'gyur/ /lhar bcas grub pa'i sems can gyis/ /thams cad rnam pa kun tu'o/ /bskal par gnas shing shes rab che/ /bstan bcos thams cad rab tu mkhas/ /gzugs dang lang tsho phun sum tshogs/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i mnga' bdag 'gyur/ /bcu bzhi'i nyin par shi ba yi/ /rdol pa'i g.yon gyi rtsib bologs ni/ /sbyor bas bzung ste 'phur 'gro mi/ /gzugs brnyan lag pa bzhi pa bya/ /zhags pa lcags kyu rtse gsum mtshan/ /g.yon par thod pa 'dzin 86—284

pa po/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ /spyan gsum rnam par gtsigs pa po / /thod pa'i phreng ba'i cod pan can/ /gtum ldan sta zur chen po pa/ /'jigs pa chen po'i dur khrod du/ /rnal 'byor ldan pas de bzhag ①ste/ /cho ga ji bzhin mchod par bya/ /gsang sngags rgyal po bzlas par bya/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i cod pan can/ /khrag dang sha dang mar khu yis/ /de nas lha mo de 'grub bo/ /mtshan ma yang ni blta ②bar bya/ /mtshan ma yis ni dngos grub che/ /dus mi ring bar bzang po 'thob/ /dman pas dman pa'i dngos grub ste/ /bar ma yis ni bar ma'o/ /mtshan ma med na chung ngu ni/ /rab tu 'grub par dpyad mi dgos/ /lha min bzang po dgug par bya/ /mi dang mda' ni bskul sneb yis/ /de yi skad cig nyid la byed/ /khrag nyid kyis ni bris pa yi/ /dbang du bya ba'ang 'di nyid kyis/ /de bzhin bud med thams cad dgug /'grub ④pa'i rdzas kyang ming nyid kyis/ /dgug pa'i sbyor bas dgug par bya/ /dmag dpung rnam par bzlog ⑤pa ni/ /rgyal mtshan rtse mor rnam gzhag yigo/ /rengs dang rmugs (pepar byed pa (nyedang / /rmongs dang 'ching ba ⑨de bzhin du/ / gyib dang gsad ⑩pa thams cad ni/ /cho ga dag dang ldan pas byed/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yum rnams dang yab rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsang ba rgyan gyi dkyil 'khor gyis dkyil 'khor gyi (/nyezhu ba chen po 'di zhus pa dang / gang la bzhugs nas rgyal ba kun/ /yum dang yab rnams de bzhin du/ /de yi 'isbyor bas sbyor bdag nyid/ /sems can rnams ni snod du mdzod / /gsang ba rgyan gyi dkyil 'khor gyi/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rnam dbye ba/ /gang gis ma 'ongs mi rnams ni/ /bde bas sangs rgyas nyid la 'jog /86—285

de nas bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /'dzum dang bcas pa'i spyan rgyas pa①/ /gsang ba rgyan gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /gsang ba chen po bka' stsal pa/ /gang phyir bdag nyid dkyil 'khor bshad/ /sems can dag pa'i rdo rje can/ /bdag nyid gsang ba'i rgyan ②zhes bya/ /snying po phyag rgya sngags nyid de/ /bdag nyid rig sngags dam tshig kyang / /gang phyir bdag nyid sdom pa ste/ /bdag nyid bshad dang 'chad pa'o/ /pha dang ma rnams de bzhin te/ /dngos grub sgrub po las kyi ③mchog /bde dang sdug bsngal khams gsum pa/ /zhes so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yum dang yab rnams kyis ④'di skad ces gsol to95)/ /de phyir gsungs shig 6)bcom ldan 'das/ /bde bar gshegs pas gsung du gsol/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems kun gyisal / /phan dang bde ba thob pa'i phyir/ /zhes so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi (kyiyum dang yab nye bar 0longs spyod pa rdo rje dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las 'di byung ngo / /sngon bshad cho ga'i rim pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor yang dag bris nas su/ /de yi dbus su bdag bsam bya/ /dkar dang dmar dang 'od chen po/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis lus la spras/ /dmar po'i phreng ba gtsug tor can/ /sna tshogs gos ni legs mnabs pa/ /dmar po'i 'od kyi bla 3 mogos can/ /phyag bzang g.yon na dril bu ste/ /bsnyems bcas 'dzum bag ldan pa'i zhal/ /phyag gzhan na ni rdo rje can/ /snying gar 11rab tu gsor mdzad pa/ /padma rgyas 'dra'i spyan nyusnyemanga' ba 'al gyi dkyil 'khor nyi shar mtshungs/ ci/rdo rje seng ge'i khri la bzhugs/ /dmar 86—286

po'i gos ni 'phyang ba po②/ /mdor bsdus chanas ni bri bar bya/ /g.yon du shes rab yongs su bri/ /sngon bshad pa yi gzugs can la/ /g.yas pa'i phyag ni 'phyang ba'o/ /lho ru sbyin pa chen mo ni/ /phyag rab rin chen stsol ba mo/ /byang du bzod pa chen mo ni/ /byams pa'i ya lad du'adzin pa mo/ /mdun ④du brtson 'grus chen mo ni/ /rdo rje'i lag pa cher bzang ba/ /shar dang lho yi mtshams su ni/ /bsam gtan pha rol phyin ma bri/ /bsam gtan phyag can spyan yangs ma/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'od bzang ba'o/ /bden bral du ni 'phel ma bri/ /rin po che yi rgyan ⑤gyis brgyan/ /nor gyi rgyan ni stong phrag gis/ /sems can mang po bde bar byed/ /smon lam bri bya rlung gi ni/ /mtshams su yang dag mtshon par bya/ /dbyangs snyan pa yi ngag brjod pas/ /sems can thams cad skul ⑥bar byed/ /blo gros ldan pas dbang ldan du/ /thabs kyi ye shes slob pa mo/ /lag pa gnyis kyis gar byed pa/ /sgeg dang dga' bas 'khrugs pa bri/ /dpa' bos shar sgor bri bya ba/ /shes rab pha rol phyin dge ma/ /ye shes lcags kyu mdzes pa'i phyag /dmar po'i dar gyis mngon par mdzes/ /dbang ni nub kyi sgo ru ni/ /'ching ba'i bdag nyid bri bar bya/ /shin tu byi (peru dang mtshungs pa/ /rdo rje lcags sgrog (de/'dzin pa mo/ /byang gi sgo ru bri bya ba/ /stobs kyi pha rol phyin ma mchog /rgyal ba thams cad mnyes byed pa / /dril bu bzang po 'khrol ba'i bdag /gshin rje cho 'phrul bri bar bya/ /'bar ba'i sprin gyis 59༄yang dag 'khrugs/ /phyag na rdo rje zhags bkra ba/ /rdo rje'i glog phreng tsodang mtshungs ma'onyunye/ /nga 51nyeyi mdun du zhu shes ldan gyis/ /'dod pa'i dbang phyug brgyan mupa bri/ /padma rā boga'i 'od gsal ba/ /mda' 86—287

dang gzhu ni 'dzin pa'i mchog /de yi mdun du dkar po bri/ /zla ba'i 'od 'dra grags chen po/ /zla ba shar ku'i 'od mdzes pa①/ /'dzum bag ②can la gzhon nu'i gzugs/ /rdo rje 'dun ②pa cher dmar ba/ /mda' lnga dang ni gzhu 'dzin pa/ /skye ba 'joms pa dpa' bo ni/ /lag na 'khor lo gzi brjid mchog /de yi g.yon du bri bya ba/ /dkar dang dmar ba'i 'od chen po/ /rdo rje dzang sgrogs rgyal po ni/ /dril bu 'khrol ba dang ldan pa/ /de yi rgyab tu bri bar bya/ /gser dang gur gum dang 'dra ba'o④/ /lho yi phyogs su bri bya ba/ /mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug dpal dang ldan/ /sngon po ⑤char sprin dang 'dra ba/ /lag na ral gri rin chen ldan/ /de mdun dpa' yichen 'dod pa yil/ /rgyal po bdag nyid chen po bri/ /'od zer dmar po lag na gzhu/ /rin chen 'bar bas rnam par brgyan/ /de yi lho ru bri bya ba/ /rdo rje rnam par smod pa mchog /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lag pa can/ /rab tu rno ba'i 'bar ba'i phreng / /rdo rje dam pa 'dul mdzad dpal/ /rdo rje rin chen mchog gi tog(kye /kha dog dkar po cher spro ba/ /gos sngon rnam par 'phyang ba po/ /rdo rje ḍā 6)ki'i dbang phyug rigs / /lag na rin chen shin tu mdzes/ /de yi rgyab tu bri bya ba/ /dgod ⑩dang bcas pa'i bzhin ras mchog /nga 'o)yi rgyab tu bri bya ba/ /dri yi dbang phyug dbang phyug che/ /lag na padma snying gar (nya'achang / /ban du'i zhunyame tog rnam pa 'dra/ /de la mngon par phyogs pa yi/ /rdo rje sgrol ba spyan mdzes bri/ /dkar ser bzang po sna tshogs pa/ /lag na utpal cisngon po bzang / /de yi g.yon du dag pa yisasnyi/ /lag na 'khor lo ches dkar bri/ /sngon pos legs pa'i gnas thob pa/ /mchog tu 'dzum pa'i bzhin ras can/ /lo ma'i rtse mo 86—288

rgyab tu bri/ /lag na yid bzhin nor bu mchog /kha dog sngo bsangs dpa' chen po/ /sems dpa' ldan pa'i thugs chen po/ /de yi lho yi cha ru ni/ /chos 'chad mchog ni bri bar bya/ /rgyu mtshan phyag ldan rab dkar ba/ /nyi ma shar ku'i ①snang ba 'dra/ /nga yi byang du bri bya ba/ / stug po bkod ②pa grags chen po / /shin tu ljang ba'i margad mtshungs/ /las kyi rdo rje mchog 'dzin pa'o/ /de yi mdun du bri bya ba/ /rdo rje skyong ba yid 'phrog bkra/ /bzhad bcas rdo rje'i lag pa can/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /de yi lho ru bri bya ba / /'gro ba'i rtse mo legs brgyan pa/ /lhang tsher nag po bung ba 'dra/ /rdo rje'i gsal shing 'dzin pa po/ /rgyab tu rdo rje 'ching ba bri/ /lag pa yang dag sbyar bsdams pa/ /rin chen kun gyi 'od dag cing ①/ /'dzum bcas mchog tu ngo mtshar ba/ /'khor byed g.yon du bri bar byabya/ /lag na mgal ⑤me'i 'khor lo can/ /legs sngo dar la bab pa poyi/ /rab rgyas padma lta bu'i zhal/ /de nas sgo yi cha dag ⑦tu/ /sgo ba rnam pa bzhi po bri/ /shar du rdo rje mi g.yo ba/ /lag na rdo rje lcags kyu che/ /lho yi sgo ru rdo rje me/ /lag na rdo rje zhags pa 'bar/ /nub tu rlung ni sngon po ste/ /rdo rje lcags sgrog 'dzin pa'o(kye/ /lus ngan du ni 7chu bri ste/ /zhags pa ldan pa'i dril bu 'dzin/ /de nas sbyor ldan 'ongs nas su/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni shar du bri/ /shar du mda' yi mtshon cha lag /rab 'bar 7padma ltar 'bar ba/ /lho ru chen po dbang phyug can/ /sngon mo /nyedabang phyug rdo rje ma/ /lag na rin chen snye ma can/ /rin po che yi rgyan gyis brgyan/ /rdo rje nyer zhi the dkar mdzes ma/ /rgyab tu rtag tu bri bar bya/ /lag na padma bzang po 'dzin ste/ /padma'i phreng rngubs rnam par brgyan/ /86—289

rdo rje steng zhal mdzes ma ni/ /sngo bsangs kun gyi yon tan ldan/ /lus ngan du ni shes ldan gyis①/ /g.yas su rdo rje rtse gcig bri/ /shar gyi mtshams ②su rdo rje ni / /dus tshigs zhes ①bya bzang mo bri/ /dbyar gyi sprin ltar mdzes pa mo/ /lag na bdug spos grags byachen mo/ /nub kyi mtshams ⑤su ri ri tasti/ /lag na me tog phreng ba 'bar/ /cung ⑨zad dmar la dkar ba mo/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /nub byang du ni bri bya ba/ /lag na yi ge sna tshogs bri/ /lag na sgron me rab dmar ba/ /cung zad sngo ba'i gos gyon pa/ /dri yi glang po ltar 'gying meba'i/ /rol pa ldan ma mkhas pas bri/ /sngo bsangs dmar po mthon mthing 6)'dra/ /rab tu dgod 7cing mig 0mdzes ma/ /rdo rje'i lag pa mig mdzes ma'o/ /de yi nya shar du bri bya ba/ /rdo rje mchog gi 'od ldan pa'i/ /rdo rje dbang phyug bde ba ma'o/ /de bzhin lho ru bri bya ba/ /gser sogs dang ni mthon mthing tso'adra/ /rin chen sgron ma rin chen lag /'od mchog ldan pa'i lha mo ni/ /nub kyi dkyil 'khor dag la bri/ /'od kyis misnang zhing mdzes pa la/ /lag na 'od zer legs mdzes pa'o/ /rdo rje brang skyes cher bkra ba/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /lag na sna tshogs gos ldan pa/ /byang du rtag tu bri bar bya/ /de bzhin sbyor bas bris nas su/ /pho nya mo yang (gelegs par bri/ /snying skul 7byed pa mdzes ma ni/ /shar du legs par bri bar bya/ /rdo rje myu gu mda' ldan dmar/ /mig gnyis dang ni gos sngon po'o/ /de dang nye bar dpa' mo ni/ /lag na lcags kyu zhags lho tshopa mchog /gdug pa 'gugs pa'i lha mo bri/ /sngo bsangs dmar la legs brjid nya pa'o/ /rjes su mnyes ma'i pho nya che/ /nub tu rtag nyi tu bri bar bya/ /rgyal ba thams cad mnyes byed ma/ /86—290

pags ①pa'i zhags pas lag pa mdzes/ /khrag 'gugs pa yi pho nya mo/ /byang du gnas pa bri bar bya/ /mdog gnag pa la cher za ba/ /lag na thod pa legs mdzad pa'o/ /thams cad 'phrog pa'i pho nya mo/ /me yi mtshams su bri bar bya/ /rdo rje lcags kyu zhags pa mchog /dmar gnag dka' thub chen po ma'o / /de yi byang du dpa' bo yis/ /sgo skyong stobs chen bri bar bya/ /rdo rje 'bebs ma legs dmar ba/ /lag mthil ②dril bu dang ldan pa'o/ /dam tshig gsum ldan spyan gsum ma/ /rtse gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa mo/ /'jigs pa'i lus can cher gsal ma/ /'od zer dmar po 'bar bas 'khrugs/ /'bar ba'i me lce'i lag pa can/ /me (kyeyi phyogs su yang dag brten④/ /lha mo chen mo thog ma ma / /lag na rdo rje'i gtsub shing can/ /dmar zhing sngo ba bri bya ste/ /ji lta ba yi rim pas so/ /gdul dka' 'a)'dul ba'i lha mo ni/ /sgo skyong ba yi gnas na gnas / /dpa' mo ⑥rdo rje dbyug gu'i ⑦lag /byin za 'bar ba dang mtshungs ma'o / /de nas bran mo bri bar bya/ /rang gi phyag rgyas lag pa mtshan/ /'jig rten gsum 'ching bran mo ni/ /nub tu yang dag bri bar bya/ /'ching ba chen po'i ⑧lag pa can/ /rab dmar gur gum 'od zer can/ /bran mo 'jigs pa'i me gdong ma/ /sgron bcas lag pa'i rtse mo mchog /rab gnag pa la lus chen mo/ /cho ga ji bzhin rtag tu bri/ /bran mo gtsigs shing rnam 'gyur gdong / /'khrug pa'i tshul la rab 'jigs dzitam/ /lag na thod pa rlon pa can/ /shin tu dmar zhing 'od chen mo/ /sku gsung thugs 'ching bran mo ni/ /shar du yang dag bri bar bya/ /dkar zhing dmar la lus che ba/ /zhags pa lcags kyu'i lag pa mchog /de nas rol pa mo bri bya/ /go rims tsheji lta ba bzhin no/ /de 86—291

bzhin gshegs pa dgyes ma ni/ /mdzes shing rin chen gyis nyer brgyan/ /mda' gzhu'i lag can dmar ba mo/ /gos dang phreng ba dmar po 'dzin/ /byang du sngags pas bri bya ba/ /kun nas 'bebs ma che ba'i mchog /mdzes pa'i lag pa 'dzin pa mo/ /bde ba 'bebs la legs par gnas/ /'jig rten gsum 'joms khro mo ni/ /rdo rje rol pa mo zhes bya/ /drag shul chen pos sdigs ①par byed/ /mnyam par bzhag ⑤pas shar du bri/ /rab tu dga' ba rjes rtog ma/ /sngags pa spro bas rgyab tu bri/ /'dod chags phyag rgya'i lag pa ma / /'gro ba'i gtso bo mnyes par mdzad/ /dga' byed ces ④bya bri bar bya⑤/ /thams cad rdo rje rol pa mo/ /dga' bo'i rtse 'jo'i lag can bkra/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa ni/ /sngags pa cho ga shes pas bri/ /rdo rje rtsu mdzad legs gnas pas/ /phyi rol rdo rje bri bar bya/ /rang gi rig ma g.yon du gnas/ /dbang por mig gsum bri bar bya/ /rdo rje can gyi rtse stigasum 'dzin/ /g.yas pa yis ni phyag 'tshal zhing / /rang gi chung ma sogs pas bskor/ /chu lhar tshangs pa chen po 97)ni/ /gdong pa bzhi pa bri bar bya/ /sgo ru sgo ba chen po ni / /rdo rje lcags kyu stobs po che(kye/ /kun nas dmar zhing cher gtum pa/ /sangs rgyas mchog tu spyan 'dren pa'o/ /lho ru legs par gnas pa'i mchog /lag na zhags pa dam pa bri/ /sems dpa' grags pa chen po dang / /sangs rgyas rnams ni 'jug par byed/ /'ching byed drag po chen po ni/ /brtan pa'i rdo rje yang dag bri/ /bal po se'u yi (9)me tog mtshungs/ / rags shing stan ⑩las mi g.yo ba'o/ /ne tso khug rta dang mtshungs pa'i/ /mnyes byed mchog ni bri bar bya/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes 37byed cing / /rig 7sngags pha rol 86—292

phyin rnams kyang / /rdo rje dbyug gu'i lag pa ①mdzes/ /zhi ba sogs kyis ②yongs su bskor/ /gshin rje 'khor lo'i lag pa ni/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i rdo rjes mtshan/ /ser po'i gos 'dzin gnag pa po/ /mtshon cha sogs pas yongs su bskor/ /lus ngan du ni dbang po bri/ /rdo rje'i lag pa rab tu mdzes/ /de nas mchod pa'i ①rnam pa ④byi/ /rdo rje me tog chen po'i gzugs⑤/ /lag na me tog snyim pa bumadzes/ /me tog phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /sngags pas rdo rje bdug ④pa bri/ /yid sim byed pa'i dam pa ni/ /lag na bdug 0pa mig yangs ma/ /'khur 7tshos cung zad dkar ba ma'o/ /lha mo rdo rje snang byed ma/ /gser bsregs pa yi mdog 'dra la/ /lag na sgron ma mkhas pas bri/ /rgyan ⑩rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /dri zhim lus la cha lugs bzang / /lag na dri yi snod mdzes ma/ /utpal sngon po'i lo ma mtshungs/ /mdzes pa'i gzugs la yid 'phrog ma'o/ /gzugs kyi rdo rje mdzes pa'i gzugs/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /lag na rdo rje me long 'dzin/ /'dzum bcas dgod ⑩pa'i dkyil 'khor can/ /sgra yi rdo rje sna tshogs lus/ /dkar dang sngo ba'i lus dang ldan/ /pi wang gling bu ting ting sogs/ /sgrogs pa shes rab can gyis brim/ /ro yi rdo rje skal chen mo/ /lag na ro yi snod 'dzin pa/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /mtshan nyid kun dang yang dag ldan/ /rdo rje reg bya sngo bsangs che/ /chu skyes sngon nyunyepo 'dab 'dra'i mig /rnam par gsal zhing cher dgod rdzipa/ /rang gi dpung pa bsdams pa mo/ /bzhad pa'i rdo rje bod libacas pa/ /rnal 'byor pas ni mdor bsdus te/ /bri bya sna tshogs gos 'dzin dkar/ /rgyan rnams thams cad 'dzin pa ma'os/ /rdo rje sgeg mamo 86—293

dkar mo che/ /sgeg ①dang bcas shing yid du 'ong / /rked par khu tshur gnyis bzhag cing / /mdzes pa'i phreng ba'i chun ②mo btsugasal/ /rdo rje glu mkhan legs dmar lus/ /glu len pa la rab tu brtson/ /chu skyes dmar po rgyas 'dra'i bzhin/ /glu len lag pa rab tu mdzes/ /rdo rje gar ma mkhas pas bri/ /gar dang bcas pa'i lag pa can/ /sngo bsangs dkar po cher dkar ba/ /mig che ba la 'dzum bcas mchog /rdo rje sil snyan drag mo che/ /dur du ra yi rnga mdzes rdung sti/ /rdo rje rnga chen lha mo che/ /rnga chen rdung ⑤ba bri bar bya/ /rdza rnga ma ni mkhas pas bri/ /rdza rnga rdung ⑥bar byed pa mo/ /lha mo mu kuṇḍa rdung ma/ /mu kuṇḍa ma bzhin mdzes ma'o/ /pa (peṭa ha ni rdung byed ma/ /rdo rje pa ṭa ha zhes bya / /rdza rnga ②chen po rdung byed ma(li/ /rdo rje rdza rnga mdzes ma bri/ /guñdza 0rdung byed dga' ba mo/ /dgod 7bcas padma'i mig can ma/ /rdo rje guñdza tsodapa' bos bri(nye/ /las 7kun gyi ni dam pa 'grub/ /lag na rdo rje ting ting shag /rdo rje ting ting shag bri bya/ /lag na rdo rje cang te ma/ /kha dog dkar mo 'od zer che/ /'khar sking rdung ba'i lag pa can/ /rdo rje 'khar snyirnga ma bri bya/ /rgyud gcig pi wang steng lho tshob bri/ /rdo rje pi wang steng ba mohurte/ /pi wang rgyud gsum sbreng 17ba'i rgya/ /pi wang rgyud gsum steng 9 )ba bri/ /rdo rje 'khar rdo 7khrol lha mo che/ /dmar po yi ni gos bgos 32pa'o/ /rdo rje gling bu rnal 'byor pas/ /gling bu 'bud pa ldan pa bri/ /rdo rje pi wang skal chen mtsho ge/ /pi wang steng 4gel rab spro ba'o/ /rdo rje 'bud dung sdo ge'abad pas bri/ /dung dkar 'bud pa'i rang bzhin can/ /dung ma 35lag na zangs dung 'dzin/ /'dod pa'i gzugs mchog 'dzin pa mo/ /rgyal ba'i dril bus lag pa mdzes/ /khrol ba yang dag bri 86wa 294

bar bya/ /legs spro ba la gzi brjid che/ /rnam par rgyal la ①spro byed ma'o/ /padma ②gar gyi dbang phyug dmar/ /padma dmar po kha 'byed ma/ /gar gyi sgyu ②mas rab gnas pa'i/ /lag pa stong ldan bri bar bya/ /rin chen gar ma lha mo che / /gar gyi bdag nyid legs par gri④/ /lag na rin chen snye ma ⑤can/ /lag pa du ma gdong brgya pa'o/ /rdo rje gar ma bsnyems bcas ma/ /lus mchu rjob dan dang ldan pa(pe/ /rnal 'byor pas ni cho ga bzhin/ /rdo rje sbyor bas rab gnas bri/ /sna tshogs gar ma skal chen mo/ /rdo rje thal mo spyi bor 'jog /'dzum bcas pa la mig mdzes ma'o/ /sna tshogs sgyu 3)ma legs sems ma/ /smin ma sgyur dzitaba'i mig mdzes ma/ /spros bcas gdong gi rnam 'gyur can/ /mthong na dga' ma ⑩'dzum pa'i bzhin/ /gdong gi dkyil 'khor sngo bsangs mchog /rdo rje mthong ma skal chen mo/ /rab tu dgod hu7cing mig rgyas ma'o/ /rnal 'byor chen pos bri bya ba/ /rnal 'byor mig gis lta ba mo/ /rab tu gsal bas 'khrugs pa can/ /'khor lo skor nyu2ba ltar byed ma/ / snying gar tsolag pa 'jog pa ni/ /sdig pa ma lus 'joms par byed/ /rdzi mar bcas pa'i mig gnyis ni/ /steng dang 'og tu 'phags pa yis/ /mthong ba 'gugs byed bde chen gyis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dbang du byed/ /sgo ru sgo ba chen po ④ni/ /rdo rje lcags kyu stobs po che/ /thams cad srung tshezhing cher gtum pa/ /sangs rgyas mchog tu spyan 'dren pa'o/ /sgo ru legs par gnas pa'i mchog /lag na zhags pa dam pa tshebyi/ /sems dpa' grags pa chen po dang / /sangs rgyas rnams ni 'jug par byed/ /'ching byed drag po chen po ni/ /brtan nyu tshopa'i rdo rje yang dag bri/ /bal po se'u yi nyunyeme tog mtshungs/ /rags shing rnam par 86—295

g.yo ba'i gdong / /ne tso nyukhug rta ②dang mtshungs pa'i/ /mnyes ②byed mchog ni bri bar bya/ /rig ༷sngags pha rol phyin rnams dang / /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par byed/ /dbang por rgyagazhon nu bri bar bya/ /gshin rjer gshin rje nyid yin no/ /chu lhar chu lha bri bar bya/ /lus ngan po ni byang phyogs su/ /'di dag bsdus te bri bar bya/ /'khor gyis mdun du bdar ba'o/ /phyi yiru dmyal ba brgyad po bri/ /yi dgas ④kyang ni thams cad du/ /rdo rje ཿ mdzad la gnas pa/ /sngags pas ducho ga bzhin bris te/ /phyi yi rdo rje bri bar bya/ /rang gi rig ma khyagayon du gnas/ /dang por mig gsum legs par bri/ /rdo rje can gyi 7rtse gsum 'dzin/ /g.yas pa yis ni phyag 'tshal zhing / /rang gi chung ma sogs pas bskor/ /chu lhar tshangs pa chen po ni/ /gdong pa bzhi pa bri bar bya / /rdo rje dbyug gu'i lag pa mchog /zhi ba la sogs rnams kyis bskor/ /gshin rjer 'khor lo'i lag pa can/ /rdo rjes 'onyamatshan cing rab tu mdzes/ /ser po'i gos 'dzin gnag pa po/ /dpal mo la sogs rnams kyis bskor/ /lus ngan du ni dbang po bri/ /rdo rje'i lag pa rab tu mdzes/ /mig stong pa ni che ba'i lus/ /bde sogs 3gyesogs kyis yinamadun du bdar8/ /dbang ldan du ni dbang ldan bri/ /me yi phyogs su me lha'o/ /bden bral du ni bden bral grags/ /rlung du rlung lha nyid yin no/ /shar gyi sgo ru dpung bzang bri/ /muṇḍa ⑫ṭa ni nub tu'o/ /lus ngan du ni grub pa bri/ /lho ru bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'o/ /cho ga 'dis ni sngags shes pas/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po bris nas su/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dgug par bya/ /yab yum gtso bo dam pa rnams/ /cho ga ji bzhin sngags pas gzhug /dkyil 'khor la 0ni dkyil 'khor bdag /rdo 86—296
