rje lcags kyu'i lag pa yis/ /cho ga ji bzhin bdag brgyan ①te/ /rdo rje sems dpar ②bsnyems byas nas/ /snyems dang bcas pas langs nas su/ /gsang ba'i sems dpa' dbang bskur ①te/ /'di yis spyan ni myur du drang / /yab dang yum bcas sangs rgyas sras ④bcas pa⑤/ /bran dang gnyen bcas nye du dang bcas dushing / /dpal mchog rdo rje sems dpa' yongs mnyes pa'i/ /lha dang lha mos ④legs bskor 'dir gshegs shig /glu 'di yis ni bskul ba yis//de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad byon/ /byon nas dngos grub chen po ni/ /sgrub ⑧pa po la stsol bar 'gyur/ /yang na ⑨mtshan ma gnang ⑩'gyur te/ /'bab pa'am snang ba blta bar byam/ /gal te bsod nams 8rab dman na/ /de yis ci yang mthong mi 'gyur/ / de nas hunyeslar yang gsol ba gdab/ /yang dang yang du bskul bar bya/ /lha yi rnal 'byor de nyid kyis/ /nga rgyal yang dang yang byas te/ /mchod pa shin tu chen po bya/ /de nas mchod yon zhabs bsil yang / /gsang ba'i de nyid kyis bskul te/ /sngags kyi 8de nyid rig pas dbul/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag phyag na rdo rje ni/ /mdzes pa'i shes rab kyis 'khyud sbyor ldan pas/ /yab yum sras bcas 'khor bcas pho nya sogs/ /bran bcas skye bo'i tshogs kyis bskor nas byon/ /sems can kun la phan dgyes pa/ /khyod la bdag nyid skezhu ba bgyid/ /'di ni khyod kyi dus lags pas/ /sems can don mchog mdzad du gsol/ /gsol ba 9btab cing bskul bas kyang / /gal te mtshan ma byung gyur na/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rnal 'byor ni/ /de tshe slob ma 'bad pas bsgom/ra/ /rdo rje padma'i yan lag bcing / /sbyor bas dkyil 'khor nyid du gzhug /de nas sgo ru /9nyemakhas pas bzhagatso /dam tshig dam pa 86—297

nyan ①du gzhug② /ma dang sring mo nyid dang yang / /de bzhin bu mo dag kyang ni / /som nyi ①rnam par bral sems kyis/ /khyod kyis rtag tu bsten ④par bya/ /sems can thams cad gsad dubya zhing / /brtul zhugs spyod pa bskyang dubar bya//'jungs pa rnams kyi gnor phrogs te/ /skye bo sdug bsngal can la sbyin/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor mi ⑧sbyor bas/ /yang na bdag nyid kyis kyang spyad/ /dkon mchog gsum la mchod bya zhing / /bla ma la ni gus par bya/ /brdzun gyi tshig kyang smra mi bya / /chang ni btung bar mi bya'o/ /dam tshig dus ni ma gtogs shing ⑨/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i dam tshig dang / /gzhan yang bde bar bya phyir dang / /slob dpon mnyes par bya don dang / /dkon mchog gsum la phan pa'i phyir/ /rdzun 8gyi tshig ni rtag tu smros/ /gzhan gyi bud med bgrod par bya/ /dam tshig don du sbyor ldan pas/ /gzhan pa 7yang ni thams cad kyang / /sems can don la brtson pas bya/ /gsang ba'i dam tshig 'di dag ni/ /blo gros ldan pas bsgrag hu mi bya/ /dam tshig ldan pa ma gtogs ka/pa/ /subla ma'i bka' gnang sngags pa yis6/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang chen po/ /lag na rdo rjes byin brlabs 7pa/ /gal te rmongs pa'i bdag nyid kyis/ /dam tshig dam pa 'di 'das tshan/ /rdo rje rdo rje'i mnga' bdag che/ /rgyal po 'dis ni nges par gsodakyi tsho / /kun nas 'bar ba'i 1snyerdo rje yisahuste/ /lus kyi spyi bo 'gems par 'gyur / /de nas 'di yis me tog gi/ /phreng ba bzang po dor bar bya ma sarba 3 )ta thā ga 21ta mā tā pi tram̐ pa tsho nati ma hā su kha sa manta bha dra pra tītstsha rda puṣṭhañtsa dzi mṛ du dzaḥs bo hoḥbha lhag wā 8sten ma hā na su kha sa manta bha dra sa ma ya st+waṃ sa ma yo3 ( lharta / 'di yis bzung ste myur ba ru/ ci /rdo rje sems dpa' ( )snying rje che/ /de ni 86wa 298

blangs te spyi gtsug tu/ /blo gros bzang pos ①bcing bar bya/ /sngags pa'i rgyal pos sngags 'di yis/ /de nas mig ni rab tu dbye/ /oṃ badzra dzñā na ma hā ne tra utta ṭa ②ya ti tsakṣa 'i / mgon po chen po ltos shig bu/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag po mchog /ye shes chen po kun gyi mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' bde chen po/ /rim pa ji bzhin legs bstan te/ /dbang bskur phyir ni gsol ba gdab④ / /dbang bskur ba ni yid 'ong brgya/ /skal ba chen po bdag la gsol / /gsang ba yi yini rgyan zhes par/ /rgyal bas gang sngon bka' stsal pa/ /gsang ba'i sbyor de bdag la ni/ /rgyal ba kun dngos stsal du gsol/ /de bzhin dkyil 'khor bum pa yis/ /de bzhin dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /slob ma chen po rnam pa lnga/ /der ni sbyor bas bos nas su/ /gsang ba'i rgyan zhes bya ba yisal/ /dngos grub shes pas dbang bskur ro/ /gsang ba'i sbyor ba'i rnam 'phrul gyis(she/ /der ni mchu (9)yis legs bzung ste/ /lce yi rtse mo mkhas pas sbyar/ /rdo rje'am yang na chu skyes kyis/ /phyag rgya dang ni phyag rgya'i lan/ /de nas 'dzin ma rnam par sbyin/ /de nyid la yang mkhas pas sbyin⑩/ /gsang ba rgyan gyi 9/3sbyor ba yis/ /gsang ba'i bde ba bsgrub par bya/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das kun tu bzang pos bka' stsal to/ /de nas yon ni dbul bar bya /bla mar phyag 'tshal mchod byas nas/ /ma dang bu mo nyid dang yang / /sring mo yi ni bu mo dang / /sring mo'am yang na chung ma dang / /rgyal po longs spyod skye bo'i tshogs/ /grong dang yul 'khor grong khyer dang / /nor dang rin chen la sogs dang / /gzhan yang ci dang ci 'dod pa/ /mkho ba'i longs spyod gus pa yis / /bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal te/ /dngos grub kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /86—299

dkyil 'khor pa yang ①legs par mchod/ /pha dang spun yang mchod par bya/ /de bzhin spun zla'i bu yang ②mchod/ /bza' ①btung yid du 'ong ba dang / /gos dang rgyan dang me tog dang / /de bzhin dri dang bdug ④pa sogs/ /ji ltar bdog pa thams cad kyis/ /mchod par ⑤byas te gtang yibar bya/ /lha rnams dag ni thams cad la/ /de bzhin du ni mchod par bya/ /gsang sngags rgyal po gshegs su gsol/ /badzra muḥ༅zhes brjod ⑧pas gshegs/ /de nas sngags pas 0slob ma'i mchog de la/ /gsang ba rnam par 'dzin la gsang ba yi/ /rgyal pos gsal mdzad rgyal ba'i gsang bdag gisaX/ /gsang ba mtha' dag ⑪legs par bslab par bya/ /gsang ba'i phyag rgya mig yangs ma/ /blo gros brtan ⑩pas bsgrub par bya/ /rang byin brlab 7pa'i rim pa yis/ /shes rab kyis ni byin gyis brlab/ /bdag nyid sems dpar legs bsgoms te/ /gsang ba rgyan gyi sbyor ba yis/ /nyi ma bdun gyis legs 'grub par8/ /'gyur ba 'di la the tsom 7med/ /lha mo shes rab che de yang / /rang nyid rdo rje 'chang gtso ⑩ste/ /nam mkha' kun gyi yimachog dpa' bo/ /rga dang 'chi ba med par 'gyur/ /'dod pa'i dbang phyug rnal 'byor che/ /bdag nyid 'dod par bsgom 1nyapa yis/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod 'grub par 'gyur/ /'dod pa'i dbang phyug gtso bo ste/ / de yang 4)'dod pa'i dbang lha mor/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /'dod pa'i khams kyi dbang phyug kun/ /bran dang 'dra bar 'khol bar ( )'gyur/ /nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor yid 'ong bar/ /mkha' 'gro'i sa bon bsgom par bya/ /de ni sbyor bas spros nas su/ /rang gi snying gar gzhug 27par bya/ /bcug nas rin chen chen po ni/ /srid pa 'joms par 86—300

bsgom par bya/ /yid bzhin rin chen rang bzhin ①mdzes/ /nyi ma bdun na de 'gyur ro/ /'dam skyes dmar po'i dbus su ni/ /'bad pas kun nas dri yis dgang / /dri yi dbang phyug rgyal po che/ /bdag nyid sems dpa' yid ches bsgomal/ /de nas myur du blo ldan te②/ /dri za'i bdag po'i bdag por 'gyur / /dri yis myur ba nyid du ni/ /brtan dang g.yo ba'i dug 'gugs byed/ /don yod kyi ni dkyil 'khor du/ /snying po snying gi sbyor ba bsam/ /yid la bsams ④pa'i dngos grub 'gyur/ /de yi phyag rgya'ang de dang mtshungs/ /rin chen gyi yang ⑤rin chen che/ /rin chen gyi ⑥ni mig 'od gsal/ /de bzhin dri dang ldan pa ni/ /sgrub pa po yis 'grub par 'gyur/ /de la sogs pa'i dbye ba yis / /lha gzhan dag kyang rig par bya/ /dkyil 'khor ram ni dam tshig kyang //bsgoms ⑦pas myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /snying po sngags dang phyag rgya dang / /rig nisngags kyi yang 6)sbyor ba yis/ /de rnams kyis ⑩ni de nyid ni/ /bsgoms na myur du nges par 'grub/ /'di ni bcom ldan rnal 'byor can/ /gsang ba rgyan bdag dam pas gsungs/ /phyag rgya bzhi yi mchog gi mchog /phyag rgya thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yab dang / yum de rnams kyis gsol pa/ myur du sbyor ba mchog bsgrubs pas/ /sgrub /lhapa pos ni ji ltar 'grub/ /de dag thams cad myur du gsungs / /bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang bdag gis/ / /snying po sngags dang phyag rgya dang / /rig hu sngags kyang ni legs par sgruba'i/ /btsun mo mchog gi gnas dbang phyug /dpa' bo chen pos gsung du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kun tu bzang po chen pos de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor 8rnam 86—301

par rgyal ba rnam par bsgyings ①pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yab dang yum rnams kyi ②zhu ba'i tshig rdo rje 'di nyid kyi ①sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje rnams las rnam par phyung ngo ske/ /lha rnams kyi ni snying po dang / /sngags dang phyag ④rgya de bzhin du/ /dkyil 'khor du ni legs par bshad/ /ji ltar sngon ⑤du kha dog sogs/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis slar yang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gsung du gsol/ /sems can rnams la phan bde'i phyir//rnal 'byor ma yi phyag rgya dang / /mtshan ma la sogs dam pa rnams/ /de nas bcom ldan kun tu bzang (67/ /rdo rje dam pa gsor mdzad nas/ /lag pa'i mtshan ma bka' stsal pa/ /gang gis (7lha rnams mtshon 'gyur ba'o(2)/ /lag pa zla ba nyi ma ru/ /mkhas pa yis ni bsam par bya/ /shes rab thabs kyi (9)sa bon ni / /rnal 'byor can gyis rtag tu spro/ /slar yang sdud pa'i sbyor ba yisakyi/ /rdo rje padmar rnam bsam bya/ /de nas shes rab pha rol phyin/ /sor mo'i rtse mor (stodagod par bya/ /de nyid sbyor bas bsdus rtsonyanas su/ /phan tshun nges par sbyar nyunyebar bya/ /rdo rje padma mnyam sbyar ba'i/ /bde ba myangs pas li'agrub par 'gyur / /'ching ba chen pos bcings nas su/ /lha mo'i sa bon gyis mtshan pa'i/ /gsang sngags rgyal po sngags rig pas/ /yang dang yang du byin gyis brlab / /bcangs 7te 'od ldan rnam pa gnyis/ /brkyangs nya)nas rtse mo sbyar bar bya/ /de 'di nya tshosnying po zhes bya ba'o/ /gnyis pa grags pa ldan pa yin/ /snying po yis ni mtshan byas nas/ /rim gyis snying gar 18bskor bar bya/ /rdo rje mnyam par sbyar byas te/ /der ni bcings pa gzhug par bya/ /'di ni dam 86wa 302

tshig nges ①bya ste/ /dam tshig ma lus sgrub ②par byed/ /'di yis lha mo mtha' yas zhal/ /thams cad du ni nges par 'grub/ /de nyid bsdigs ③pa lta bur sbyar / /las kun byed pa'i mchog tu 'gyur/ /rdo rje gnyis ni padma mi④/ /sbyor bar bstan ⑤pa mchog tu rmad/ /de las phyi rol bskums pa ni/ /gsum pa ru ni 'gyur ba yin⑥/ /snying ga ⑦ru ni snying po bsam/ /snying dga' byed pa zhes byar brjod/ /rdo rje gnyis po de bzhin sbyar/ /dam tshig bdag byed nyid ⑧du 'gyur/ /de nyid kun gyi ⑨'byung gnas gsal/ /chen po'i las ni byed par 'gyur / /de nyid mdzod spur sbyar ba'i brjid/ /phyag rgya bdag nyid chen por 'gyur/ /de nyid chu skyes rnam pa ru/ /snying gar ⑩bzhag pa snying po tsomachog /de bzhin rdo rje mnyam sbyar ba/ /dam tshig bdag nyid dag 8tu 'gyur/ /snying gar snyi/kun bsdigs sbyor ba yis/ /rab rgyas pa yi bzhin ras mchog /bsnyems pa byed pa thams cad kyang / /'dis ni las byed 'grub pa yin/ /de nyid kha ru sbyar bas ni/ /phyag rgya chen po rab tu 'grub/ /de nyid 'od ldan rtse mo ni/ /thur ④du bstan te snying gar gzhag(/nye /'di ni 'gyur ba med pa yi/ /snying po'i snying po'i 0chos sgrub byedang/ /de nyid snying gar (nyeyongs su bskor/ /snying gi dkyil 'khor nyid du bzung ⑪/ /'di ni dam tshig dngos grub che/ /bdag nyid chen pos bslab par 2 )bya/ /las kyi rdo rje mnyes pa yis/ /las rnams thams cad rab sgrub byed/ /dbab 'o:dang 'khor ba nyid dang ni/ /gar byed chen po de bzhin du/ /de bzhin thal mo sbyar nas su/ /snying gar ci bzhag du pa snying por bshad/ /spyi bor bskor bar ri stebyas pa ni/ /dam tshig ces ( rinabya bdag nyid che/ /steng du bsdigs pa las su 'gyur/ /mchod pa ma lus rab 86—303

sgrub ①byed/ /snying po la sogs 'og tu gzung ②/ /chos la sogs par yongs su brtag /de nyid brkyang ste snying gar ①bzhagadu /snying po zhes su legs par bshad / /bskor ba dam tshig zhes ⑤bya ste/ /las kyang (7thams cad ⑦de bzhin no/ /de las thal mo rdo rje gnyis/ /steng bsgreng ①snying po la sogs bzhin/ /sngon bshad lha mo thams cad kyi/ /gsang sngags rig par khyashes par bya/ /gnyis su byas la g.yas min pas/ /bsgrub bya'i mgrin pa bzung nas su/ /mngon par phyogs te gzhag ⑩par bya/ /gzugs kyi snying po ches yiche ba'o /de nyid kha yi phyogs bzhag pa'/ /sgra yi snying po yid 'phrog pa'o/ /de nyid cung zad bskums nas su/ /lce yi rnam pas kha ru gzhagatso /ro myang ba yi sbyor ba yis / /de nyid la yang rnam pa bzhi/ /phyag rgya sngags pas shes par bya ro 'phrog pa yi las rnams so/ /de ni gnyis su byas nas su/ /g.yas pa'am ni g.yon pa yis/ /snying gar ④legs sbyar sbyor bdag gis/ /reg pa'i phyag rgya ngo mtshar che/ /'di yis chos dang dam tshig dang / /las kyang rab tu skye ba yin/ /cho ga shes pas rnal 'byor sbyar/ /reg pas 'bebs pa'i mchog yin no/ /de bzhin sbyar ba 7so sor bya/ /g.yon pa rked par gzhag 7par bya/ /g.yas pa kha yi phyogs su bzung bi/ /khro bo'i tshul gyis de bzhin du/ /'di ni bzhad ldan zhes bya ba'i/ /phyag rgya mchog tu med byung 3steba'o/ /de'am bkrol yite snga ma bzhin/ /rked pa ru ni legs par gzhag riXgye /de las langs te slar yang khar/ /mkhas pas dal gyis bskyod par bya/ /de gnyis snying gar (steyongs su sbyar/ /bsnyems pas sdud dang 'gyed par bya/ /ji srid spyi bor gtugs pa yis/ /chos 8gyedang la sogs kun tu 'gyur/ ci/snying po la sogs sngags rig pas/ /phyag 86—304

rgya 'di yis rgyas btab na①/ /dngos grub thams cad thob 'gyur te/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i ②bka' bzhin no/ /thal mo mnyam por legs par sbyar/ /g.yon pa'i steng du de bzhin gzhan/ /de dag snying gar ③bsgreng bar bya/ /de ni phan tshun shes rab yin/ /sngags pa chen pos sbyar bar bya/ /gzhan ni sbyor bas rnam par spro/ /'di ni chos kyi pha rol tu/ /'gro ba'i chos kyi mchog tu bshad/ /de bzhin thal mo mnyam por sbyar/ /snying gar dugayon par gzhag ⑤par bya/ /'od 0ldan rdo rje'i gdong pa dang / /mdor bsdus nas ni sbyar nas su/ /g.yas pa thur ⑦du 'phyang dubar bya/ /de bzhin steng bstan mchog sbyin no//me tog snyim pa yang dag sbyar/ /rdo rje gnyis ni dbus su bzhag /bzod pa gnyis po de la sbyar/ /sbyin pa dag ni phyi ru bskum/ /de ni steng du legs par bzhag⑨ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /yid bzhin rgyal po'i 'bras bu ster/ /de ni sbyor bas so sor bya/ /g.yon pa snying gar ⑩yongs su bzhag /g.yas pa spro ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /yongs su bskor zhing bskor nas su/ /g.yas pa ru ni gzhag ⑩/par bya/ /rdo rje thal mo brkyang nas su/ /rdo rje'i steng du 'od mdzes ma/ /phyi rol bskul biba'i sbyor ba yis/ /de yi 8steng du gdong pa ⑩bzhag /phyag rgya 'di ni phyag rgya che/ /brtson 'grus pha rol phyin dge ma'o/ /de bzhin lag pa steng du sbyar/ /rtsibs mchog rin chen ma ru 'gyur/ /lhag ma'i bya ba de nyid kyis/ /de bzhin zhag gcig bsam par bya/ /sbyor ba de yis tsobacing ba ru/ /sngags shes gtso bo sngags pas bya/ /rdo rje thal mo mnyam par sbyar/ /khro mo 'irdo rje'i sbyor ba yis/ /snying gar zhu blo gros ldan pas bzung rtsonye/ /de ni lcags kyu'i rnam pa yis/ /bltas nas lus can 'gugs par byed/ /de 86—305

las sor mo'i rtse mo rnams/ /cung zad bsnol ①te brkyang ②bar bya/ /rdo rje mche ba lta bur bsgreng ②/ /kha sbyar sgrol byed ngo mtshar che/ /rgya 'di rnams kyis durgyas btab na/ /las rnams thams cad byed par 'gyur/ /de las thal mo sbyar nas su/ /gzi brjid rdo rje de bzhin no/ /de ltar lcags kyus dgug pa ste / /de yi mtha' gdong zhags pa'o/ /sog le'i thal mo nges par ni/ /'dir ni thod pa nyid du 'gyur/ /'di ni gnyis pa nyid yin te/ /las kun gyi (snyeni dam pa sgrub/ /de bzhin bcing ba legs bcings nas/ /rab tu sbyin pa brkyang bar bya/ /g.yas pa steng du byas nas su/ / bsad pa ⑥lta bur bcing bar bya/ /'di ni rdo rje mdung thung (7ste/ /srin po thams cad phye mar byed/ /'dir ni de bzhin thod pa dang / /zhags pa lcags kyu nyid dang yang / /sog le dang ni gri thung ni/ /rdo rje thal mo'i cho gas bya/ /rdo rje thal mo so sor ⑧bya/ /lag pa g.yas pa steng du ni/ /rin chen lta bur byas la gzung ⑨/ /sor mo thams cad spro bar bya/ /g.yon pa'ang de bzhin spro bar bya/ /de dag nyi zlar shes par bya/ /thal mo bsgreng ste 7shes rab dang / /las kyi rdo rje rtse mo sbyar/ /'dir ⑩ni las rnams thams cad kyi/ /sna tshogs las mchog sgrub par byed/ /de bzhin dgug dang zhags pa dang / /thod pa rdo rje nyid yin no/ /de las ⑪thal mo thod pa yi12/ /phyag rgya'i dbus su bu ga ni/ /sgron ma can zhes tsolegs bshad de/ /'di ni rdo rje ngo mtshar che/ /zhags pa lcags kyu de bzhin du/ /slob dpon blo gros ldan pas shes/ /gzungs rnams dang ni thams cad kyiske/ /sngar bshad pa yi phyag rgya nyid/ /thod pa rdo rje'ang shes par bya/ /phan tshun gcig la gcig tu ni/ /thams cad gzungs kyi phyag rgya ru/ /dkyil 'khor du 86—306

ni rab tu bsgrags/ /'di rnams sbyor ba ji lta bar/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi ni rtag pa ru/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyis bya ste/ /phyag na rdo rje'i bka' bzhin no/ /'di ni bcom ldan rnal 'byor gsung / /kun bzang ①bdag nyid chen po pa/ /sems can kun mchog las kyi mchog /sangs rgyas mchog gtso mnga' bdag che//zhes so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kun tu bzang po yang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ye shes rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas de dag thams cad la yang dang yang du gzigs te/ sems can ②thams cad brtson 'grus zhan ②pa spobs ④pa dman pa la mos par gzigs nas de rnams la bka' bsgo ba/ dbang po'i ⑤ma mo rnams kyis shod/ /rang rang gi ni sgrub sna tshogs/ /de nas de rnams legs (nyatshim nas/ /rdo rje can la gsol ba ni / /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya / /de yi steng du rdo rje che/ /rdo rje la ni dang po mchog /nyi ma gser mdog dang mtshungs par/ /gsang sngags shes pas de bsgom bya/ /rang gi lus las spros nas su/ /rang gi rnam par bsam par bya/ /de nas sngags bdag 'grub par 'gyur/ /sngags kyi de nyid bdag po cher/ /kun tu 'gro ba sna tshogs che/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'dra ba gzhan(le/ /gnyis pa'i de nyid bsgom ri8)pa ni/ /dkyil 'khor padma las byung ba/ /dpar po'i gos la gzi brjid che/ /'bar ba dag ni me dang mtshungs/ —/rang las spro bya thams cad du/ /'jig rten dbang phyug lta bur 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor dbang chen gzhag (7par bya/ /dkyil 'khor la ni cher dge ma/ /dang po'i lha mo drod dang ldan/ /rang gi lus la nges par khyab/ —/bsdus nas bdag dang 'dra ba'i bdag /yid bzhin nor 86—307

bu'i snang bar 'gyur/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor dbus son par/ /'gro ba'i sgo gtan lha mo ni/ /rang lus ①lus ldan thams cad du/ /ljang gu ②dang ni ljang ser ma/ /las kun sgrub pa'i dam pa yis/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa dpal ldan 'gyur//ma mo bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /shes rab ye shes dam pa gnas/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi dam pa ru/ /mkhas pa ①yis ni bsgom par bya/ /kun gyi bdag po dpal dang ldan/ /kun bzang mnga' bdag chen por 'gyur/ /bsam gtan dkyil 'khor sbyor ba yis/ /thams cad nyid ni bsgrub par bya/ /chos kyi yi ge yang dag sbyar/ /lha min bdag por bdag 'gyur ro/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das kun tu bzang pos bka' stsal to/ /gsang ba rgyan rjogyi bkod pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yum gyi phyag rgya'i ye shes mchog gi dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs so(snye// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yab 'khor dang bcas pa rnams slar yang 'dus par gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das kun tu bzang po chen po 6)la glu dbyangs kyi rgyal po 'dis gsol ba btab pa/ thams cad khyab pa'i ye shes che/ / mkha' la larlung ltar cher gshegs pa/ /yab kyi phyag rgya'i ye shes bzang / /kun mchog dam pas bshad du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kun tu bzang pos de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rgyal po mchog rdo rje dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas ye shes chen po'i phyag rgya dang dkyil 'khor 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje rgyas pa las nges par phyung ngo / /dbus su nyi ma chen po ni/ /86—308

hūṃ yig sbyor bas bsam par bya/ /sor mo kun gyi rtse gnas su/ /sa bon lnga yi yab dgod bya/ /tshigs kyi nang ni thams cad du/ /yi ge thams cad rnam par bsam/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dag la ni/ /bzang po thams cad rnam bsam bya/ /'khor lo chen po phyag rgya'i tshul/ /lag pa g.yon par bsam ①par bya/ /de yi dbus su shes rab che/ /de bzhin gzhan yang dgod par bya/ /de nas spro ba'i ②de nyid ni/ /gsang sngags 'di yis sbyar bar bya/ /oṃ pra rgyu zhu'i ya sa ma duyo ge ⑤rgyu a/ de nas phan tshun sbyar byas nas/ /rdo rje thal mor burab tu gnas/ /rdo rje bsdams par byas nas su/ /rdo rje bsdams par rnam par bsam / /de nas shes rab che bsgreng ④ste/ /rtse mo cung zad bskum par bya /'dod pa'i dbang phyug snying por 'gyur/ /snying gar ⑧bzhag na snying po 'grub/ /de nyid bsdigs ⑨pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /las kyi mchog tu 'gyur ba 8yin/ /de nyid snying gar hunyebasdams pa ni/ /phyag rgya chen po zhes 8su grags/ /thams cad kyis kyang mdor bsdus pa'i/ /las rnams thams cad rab sgrub byed/ /de bzhin legs par bcing bar bya/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin pa gnyis/ /phyi yi rgyab tu bskum par bya/ /mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug snying dga' ba'o/ /shes rab dag ni de bzhin sbyar/ /dam tshig ces tsu)par rab tu grags/ /lhag ma rnam par spro bar bya/ /las kyi gnas 'khod chen por grags/ /8shes rab dag ni zum tshul gyis/ /dri yi dbang phyug rab dgyes pa'o/ /bzod dang brtson 'grus gdong pa gnyis/ /lo ma'i tshul du brkyang bar bya/ /dam tshig sgrub pa ster bar libashad/ /'di las rtse mo rnam phye bskye/ /las kun byed pa zhes bshad de/ /re ba thams cad rdzogs par byed/ /de nyid rtse mor snying gar /)sbyar/ /bdag nyid 86—309

chen po'i phyag rgya mchog /rgyal po mchog lta'i rgyal po ru/ /'di yis myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /rdo rje bsdams ①pas shes rab mgo/ /dril bu'i chadam pa snying po mchog② /bzod dang brtson 'grus gdong sbyar ba/ /dam tshig mnyam pa nyid du gnas/ /cung zad gdong pa bskum par bya/ /las byed pa yi ④mchog tu 'gyur/ /gdong pa legs par brkyang nas su/ /steng du shes rab rtse mo gcig /'di ni chen por shes bya ste/ /dbang phyug thams cad byed pa'i mchog /sna tshogs byed pa mchog gi mchog /'di yis myur du 'grub par 'gyur / /rang gi ⑤bsdams las shes rab bsgreng ⑥/ /rdo rje sra ba'i chos dang ldan/ /gdong pa phye 9)ste rin po che/ /'di ni dam tshig ldan pa'i mchog /de gnyis de bzhin rnam par gzhag(8ri /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin dge dag /rab brkyang bzhi 0yi sems dpa' yi/ /las rnams thams cad byed par bshad/ /de bzhin tshul khrims pha rol phyin/ /'di ni chen po dam pa'o/ /bsdams las bzod dang brtson 'grus dag /legs par brkyang ste bstod pa ni/ /snying po'i zla ba ltar bcings pa/ /dam tshig 'od zer 'phro ba'o/ /phan tshun gyi ni gdong sbyar ba/ /'di ni 7las byed dam pa ste/ /lhag ma khu tshur ltar byas patunye/ /phyag rgya chen po zhes su 'grub/ /rdo rje bsdams pa legs par bcing rtse mo'i rnam par sbyar bar bya/ /shes rab 'ba' zhig rtse mor bya/ /lhag ma dag ni de bzhin no/ /lhag ma bsdams te gzhug par bya/ /snying po chos ni byed pa'i mchog /khu tshur g.yon pa g.yon du bzung / /rdo rje rdo rje can gyis 9/sebarkyang / /g.yas pa'i sbyin pa brkyang nas ni/ /rna ba'i rtsa bar dgug par bya/ /'di mi las byed shes lho bya ste/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab sgrub byed/ /rdo rje bsdams 86—310

pa brkyang ①nas su/ /snying gar ②'khor lo'i tshul du byadu/ /g.yas pa'i rtse mo lcags kyur bya/ /sbyin pa dusbyin pa'i pha rol son/ /de bzhin bcing ba legs bsdam bya/ / gnyis ka ⑤de bzhin lcags kyu ste/ /de ltar 'og ma bcug nas su/ /snying gar dubazhag pa las rjes 'brang / /de nyid dgug par sbyor ba ni/ /thams cad dgug pa rab tu 'grub/ /de bzhin sbyin pa bskums nas su/ /yang dang yang du brkyang bar bya/ /snying gar ⑦bskor ba zhes su bshad/ /de nyid 'og tu bstan pa ni/ /dam tshig can zhes rab tu grags/ /rdo rje chos su bshad pa ste/ /kha ru g.yo (gebar byed pa mchog /las las rnam par tshim zhes bya/ /las kun byed pa'i dam pa ster/ /lag pa bcings pa las bkrol 0te/ /shes rab mdzod du rab tu brtag /'di ni dam tshig cher mdzes pa/ /de phyir de ltar chos mdzad do/ /g.yas pas rab tu bsgrims pa ni/ /mi snang mdzod de des na tshulas/ /rin chen padma ldan pa'i gdong / /snying gar /lhabazhag 8pa snying por 'gyur/ /bsdams nas go char byas nas su/ /bskor ba dam tshig ces 7su 'dod/ /'khyud pa chos ldan zhes su grags/ /bsnun blapa las byed pa ru brjod/ /bsdams las nyi ma rnam par spro/ /bskor ba dam tshig mchog yin no/ /lag pa'i mtha' ma chos chen po/ /kun sdud /snyelas kun byed pa'o/ /bsdams las sbyin pa bsgreng bar bya/ /rtse mo gsum bya gnas mdzes pa'o/ /de nyid steng ga du bskor nas su/ /spros pas chos sgrub byed pa'o/ /rdo rje ba ru sbyar ba las/ /dbang bskur dam pa sgrub par byed/ /de nyid steng du spro ba ni/ /las kun byed pa'i mchog yin no/ /snying gar 7legs bzung snying po ste/ /mdzod spur bzhag pa dam tshig mchog /khar bzhag pa ni chos shes bya/ /las rnams thams cad 86—311

rab sgrub pa'o/ /'di ni bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /re ba kun rdzogs mdzad pas gsungs / /rdo rje bsdams pa rnam par bcings/ /padma'i rnam pa mchog tu bya/ /ster byed pa ni mig ltar bya/ /snying gar ①bzhag pa kun mchog 'grub/ /de nyid mig bzhag las yin no/ /bzhad ②pas chos de dam pa'i chos/ /dam tshig gsang ba'i mig yin te/ /padma'i mdzod la rab tu gnas/ /thal mo yang dag sbyar ba ni/ /snying po mchog tu rmad byung ba'o/ /kha ni cung zad phye ba ni/ /dam tshig mchog gi mchog yin no/ /snying gar ②shin tu gsal phye ba/ /ma lus las ni rab tu sgrub/ /rdo rje'i nang du padma ni/ /chos te stimachog tu rmad byung ba'o / /'di rnams kyis ni myur 'grub ste/ /sngags pas sngags kyis bskul bas sol/ /de bzhin 'ching ba legs bcings te/ /snying gar (nya'akhor lo nyid du bya/ /'khor lo gsum pa nyid du 'gyur(6)/ /rtsibs bzhis legs brgyan ༅chos su blta/ /bskor ba las kyi rdo rje'o/ /'di rnams ji lta bzhin sbyar na/ /grub pa'i dam pa 'grub par 'gyur/ /rdo rje bsdams pa legs bsgreng ⑤ste/ /shes rab myu gu dag tu bya/ /sbyin pa rin chen ltar byas pa/ /sems dpa'i gnas su nges par sbyar//'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /las rnams thams cad rab sgrub 6)pa'o/ /snying gar bochos kyi dam tshig dang / /snying po rig sngags legs par sbyar/ /de bzhin shes rab gnyis po sgreng 17/ /'og gi 'khrug pa de bzhin no/ /mthe chung bzang po'i kha sbyar ba/ /kun gong rdo rje ldan par bya/ /gnas ni bzhi yi sbyor ba yis/ /phyag rgya bzhi ni rab tu 'grub/ /spyi bor las su bshad pa ste/ /snying gar 7snying po brtag nyanyapar bya/ /bskor ba yis ni dam tshig ste/ /ngag gis kun bskul chos yin te/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /bcings nas shes 86—312

rab dag ni bsgreng ①/ /'od ldan dag ni rtsa bar sbyar/ /'di ni dang por shes par bya/ /thams cad nas ni thams cad 'gro/ /bcings las de bzhin shes rab cig /rtse mo mche ba gdug yid 'phrog /de bzhin du ni 'di sbyar bas/ /las rnams thams cad rab sgrub pa'o/ /gsang ba'i bcing ba legs bcings te//rdo rje nang du de bzhin no/ /snying gar ②rnal 'byor pa yis sbyar/ /ji snyed las kyi ming ①bzang po/ /rdo rje rab brkyang mgrin par gzung ④/ /kun tu bskor ba rab tu bya/ /'di yis las rnams thams cad ni/ /byed 'gyur bsrung ⑤sogs go 'phang bzang / /lhag ma cho ga bzhin rnal 'byor/ /rnal 'byor de nyid rab tu sbyar/ /phyag rgya rtags dang mi rnams ni/ /lha rnams kun la sbyar bar bya/ /'di ni bcom ldan rnal 'byor che'i/ /dbang phyug dpal rdor dusems dpas ⑦gsungasal/ /de nas de rnams legs tshim nas/ /phyag 'tshal nas ni thal sbyar te/ /zhu ba rdo rje bla na med/ /dpa' bo rjo rje can la zhus/ /yongs su rtog pa kun spangs pa'i〈pe/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni rang byung mal/ /yab dang yum ni bla na med/ /ci phyir 'di dag brtag pa lags/ ci/'khor ba las ni legs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas ji ltar 'byung ba lags/ /grong gi chos ni bsten ⑩pa las/ /ji ltar thar pa rab tu 'grub/ /gang du rnal 'byor pa grol 'gyur/ /gang na 'chi ba rab tu gnas/ /gang gis rnal 'byor pa rab 'grub/ /gang las rnal 'byor pa zhes bgyi/ /gsang sngags ji ltar gsang sngags lags/ /snying po zhes bya'i snying po gang / /phyag rgyas gang phyir phyag rgyar 'gyur/ /rig sngags rig pa ji ltar lags(12/ /ji ltar lha rnams dgug pa dang / /gzhug pa rnal 'byor pa yis bgyid/ /rnam par grol rnams bcing ba dang / /mnyes 86—313

dang bskul ba de bzhin du/ /ji ltar gnyis su med 'gyur zhing / /tsum pa 'khyud pa nyid dang yang / /mthong nas rjes su chags pa dang / /lag pa'i dgos pa ji snyed pas/ /phyag rgya ji ltar 'grub par 'gyur/ /gar dang glu dang cher dgod ①pa/ /sgeg dang smra ba ji ltar lags/ /gzugs dang sgra dang de bzhin dri/ /gtso bo ro dang reg par 'gyur/ /me tog bdug pa mchog dang dri//mar me gsal ba mchog gang lags/ /mchod pa thams cad ji ltar 'grub/ /ji ltar mchod pas 'grub par 'gyur/ /rgyal bas zhu ba 'di dag gis/ /phreng ba rdo rje ②can la zhus/ /zhes so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kun tu bzang po chen pos zhu ba thams cad rnam par dpyod pa longs spyod pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhu ba rgyas pa 'di dag phyung ngo / /shes rab yum du legs bshad de/ /yab ni thabs la snyimakhas pa'o/ /'di ni bsten pa nyid kyis ni/ /grong las thar pa rab tu 'grubarka/ /bag chags sbyor ba dang ldan pas/ /gnyi ga dag ni gdon yin te/ /grol dang ma grol zhes su bshad/ /de ni rnal 'byor pa ru brjod④/ /gsang sngags yid du bshad pa stengasnye/ /snying po yang ni de bzhin no/ /yid la rnam par gzhag 6zhin ni/ /gsang sngags mkhas pas 'grub par 'gyur/ /thar pa chos kyi rgya mtsho yin⑦/ /lha rnams gang la rgyas btab pa'i/ /phyag rgya 'di yis (kye'agrub 'gyur te/ /dngos grub bde ba bla na med/ /rig sngags ye shes ma lus te/ /rig sngags pha rol phyin par bshad/ /de shes pa 99)ni 'grub 'gyur te/ /grub nas bde ba rnam pa gsum/ /shes rab la ni shes rab ni/ /gzhug dang dgug pa de bzhin no/ /gshegs su gsol ba btang bar 3 )shes/ /bcings pa brtan 86—314

par byed pa'o/ /mnyes pa yis ni legs tshim yin/ /bskul ba 'phro ba nyid du bshad / /bsam pa gcig tu gyur pa ni/ /gnyis su med pa zhes su brtags/ /ro gcig de nyid bshad pa ni/ /'jig rten pa yi lha ru brjod/ /tsum pa rdo rje rnal 'byor te/ /rdo rje ye shes zhes su bshad/ /shes dang mi shes mnyam sbyor bas / /rdo rje'i ye shes zhes bshad do/ /shes dang mi shes mnyam sbyor bas/ /tsum pa na ①zhes nges par bshad/ /gnas pas rtags zhes bshad pa ste/ /rtags ni lus zhes brjod pa yin/ /de yi 'khyud pa reg par shes/ /chags pa mthong ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa'i 'od rnams lha mo ste/ /rdo rje padma mnyam bgrod pa'o/ /phyag rgya 'di las phyag rgya ste/ /lag pa'i dgod pa'i sbyor bas sol/ /gar dang glu sogs rnams kyis ni/ /lha rnams thams cad mnyes par 'gyural/ /'di rnams kyis ni sangs rgyas rnams/ /mchod na dngos grub thams cad ster/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das kun tu bzang pos bka' stsal to/ /gsang ba rgyan gyi bkod pa'i rgyud chen po las (gegasang ba rgyan gyi bkod pa zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal po yongs su rdzogs sori nee// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yum rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das kun tu bzang po chen po la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchod pa dang mchod pa'i lan dang / phyag rgya dang phyag rgya'i lan dang /ri da gar dang gar gyi lan dang / glu dang glu'i gshelan dang / sil snyan dang sil snyan gyi lan dang ske/ rnam 'gyur dang rnam 'gyur 55)gyi lan dang / dbrog pa dang dgug tsopa'i lan dang / brda dang brda'i (8)lan dang / bri (9dab dang bri tsheba'i lan 86wa 315

dang ske/ blta ba dang blta ba'i ①lan dang / dam tshig dang dam tshig gi lan dang / dkyil 'khor dang dkyil 'khor gyi lan dang / gsang ba dang gsang ba'i lan dang / gsang chen dang gsang chen gyi lan dang / de kho na nyid dang de ②kho na nyid kyi lan la sogs pa rnams dang / glu'i ③rgyal po 'dis gsol ba btab par gyur to/ /sangs rgyas sems can kun gyi don/ /ye shes kun don thams cad mdzad/ /thams cad khyab pa sems can don/ /gnyis dang gnyis med phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'di dag thams cad gsung du gsol/ /sgrub pa po la phan dgyes pas/ /sgrub pa dngos grub dag dga' ba/ /gang gis dngos grub 'grub 'gyur ba/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kun tu bzang pos thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la lta ④ba rnam par bsgyings pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge ⑤'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /me tog bdug pa dri zhim dang ske/ /gos bzang rgyan dang bza' ba dang / /btung dang ⑥ro dang sgron ma gsal / /mal khri stan dag yid 'ong ba/ /'di yis sangs rgyas thams cad mchod / /yid ni bde bar gnas par byed/ /slob dpon rdo rje can dang ni/ /khyad par du ni sgrub pos bya/ /dgod (7dang sgeg dang de bzhin glu/ /sil snyan gar ni rab dga' ba/ /mchod pa'i lan te shin tu ni/ /sangs rgyas niphyag rgyas 'grub par 'gyur/ /gzugs dang sgra dang de bzhin dri/ /ro dang reg pa yid 'ong ba/ /'di ni mchod pa'i lan du 'grub/ /sangs rgyas byang chub bde ba che/ /phyag rgya skyes bu'i rnam pa ste/ /phyag rgya'i lan ni rang gzugs te/ /gnyis pa phyag rgya chen po ste/ /phyag rgya'i lan ni las bzang can/ /phyag rgya rang gi bdag por shes/ /phyag rgya'i lan ni sgrub pa po/ /ji srid dbye ba stong phrag 86—316

ni / /dbye ba'i gzhi ru brtag par bya/ /zhes so/ /gar ni gar gyi ④sbyor ba yis/ /gar gyi lan ni gar mkhan ma'o/ /ji srid dbye ba stong phrag kyang / /dbye ba bzhi ⑤ru brtag par bya/ /kun tu bzang po la brten ninas/ /ji srid las kyi rjes 'brang ba'o/ /las kyi sbyor la yang dag bsten④/ /ji srid bzang po'i rjes 'brang ba'o/ /bla 'og yang dag bskyod pa yis/ /gar dang steng gi gar bskor ba/ /rtog pa'i sbyor bas brtag par bya/ /rtog pa yis ni rab tu gsung ⑤/ /ji lta'i sil snyan rdung spyad ni/ /rdung ba'i bdag nyid can gyis dkrol / /de las byung ba'i sil snyan lan/ /gsil ⑥bas sil snyan nyid du brjod/ /sngags kyi yi ge'i cho ga sbyar/ /ji srid las mchog spyod yul ba/ /de nas sbyor bas 'thon nas su/ /kun tu bzang por 'gro bar bya/ /sgrogs pas grub ces ⑦brjod pa ste/ /'dren pa gsum las legs par 'byung / /dbyangs rnams rnam drug shes par bya/ / glu yi (nyephyag rgya zhes su 'grub/ /de nas sbyor bas 'thon tsonas su/ /ji srid mgo dang snying gar 7son/ /mgrin pa sna yi sbyor ba dang / /mgul pa g.yo ba nyid kyis so/ /'gyur bas rnam par 'gyur ba ste/ /lan hu )dang gtong ba'i cho ga rim/ /chos rnams thams cad blang ba dang / /gdon gyi tshogs rnams zlog nyunyepa ste/ /rnam 'gyur las ni slar yang 'dir/ /sems kyi rnam par rtog pa'o/ /ji srid las ni rjes sbyor ba/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi rjes su 'brang / /sems dang lus kyi rnam pho bsgyings pas/ /gdug 8pa thams cad bzlog 8par bya/ /lag pa rkang pa'i rim pa kun/ /rnam 'gyur gyi ni lan yin no/ /dbrog pa dgug par shes bya ste/ /gtong 'ab dag ni dbrog mapa'i lan/ /dbrog pa mchog tu shes bya ba/ /bgegs kyi (/—nyeganas ni 86—317

rab gnon pa'o/ /dbrog pa'i lan ni rab bzlog ste/ /bsdigs pa'i rkang pa dgod ①par shes/ /brda ni dran pa'i don du ste/ /phan tshun yongs su brjod pa yis/ /'grub dang mi ②'grub sbyor ba rnams/ /slob dpon slob ma sogs pas bsgrub / /brda lan lha mo rnams kyis ni/ /bskul dang so sor bskul ba'o / /dri ba smra dang 'dri ba ste/ /mthong nas 'dri ba 'dri ba'i lan④/ /legs pa'i gzugs mthong blta ba ste/ /lha yi ye shes spyod yul lo/ / blta ba'i ⑤lan ni de las slar/ /sbyor ba mchog gis (7sbyor ba'o/ /lha dang lha mo rnams kyi ⑦ni / /g.yas g.yon blta ba blta ba ste/ /ji snyed blta ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /sgrub par byed pa'i (8)lan yin no/ /dam tshig sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /bka' rtags byas pa nyid du 'dod/ /gang phyir thos pa 'dzin pa yi/ /sgrub po lan du shes par bya/ /dkyil 'khor lus su bshad pa ste/ /ye shes lnga yis byin brlab 6)pa'o / /dkyil 'khor lan ni lha mo rnams/ /gcig tu byed pa'i dam pa'o/ /gsang ba sbas par bshad pa ste/ /gsang ba'i lan ⑩ni legs sbas pa'o/ /gsang chen sems kyi 'du shes te/ /bde ba'i rnam par rtog (/nyapa'o/ /so sor rtog pa lha mo dang / /lha yi bde ba bde chen po/ /sangs rgyas sras bcas thams cad kyis/nya/ /gsang chen lan du brjod 3nyapa'o/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das kun tu bzang pos bka' stsal to/ /de nas de rnams slar yang 'dus par gyur temi / yang bcom ldan 'das la legs par bskul ba/ rdo rje sems dpa' bde rab mchog /shes rab mchog rab grol ba'o/ /mchod pa'i ye shes legs 'grub pa'i/ /gsang ba chen po gsung du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kun tu bzang pos slar yang gsang ba chen po mchod pa cher gsang ba zhes bya ba'i 86—318

ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rtsu rghaṃ hūṃ rtsu hūṃ rtsu rgyu hūm̐ rgyu/ ga ga ri ga ga ri ga ga ga ga ri ga ril/ ra ra ra/ ga ri ga ga /te te te te/ he te te ②te te te/ na te te te ṇḍa ①te te/ na te te dzā tertadu / dzā te tattal/ dza te/ ri ti zhurā/ te ta te dzā te tī ri ra ⑦te/ ta rjori ta ⑨ri/ te ta 0ri rtsu/ ri 7ri rgyu/ te dzā 8te te 8rgyu/ zhes bcom ldan 'das kun tu bzang pos bka' stsal to/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag po mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' kun gyi rje/ /glu yi phyag rgya rab gsal ba'o/ /de nas rol mo'i phyag rgya yi/ /rnal 'byor chen po thugs rje'i bdag nyid can gyis gsungs pa / lha dang lha mo rgyal bdag dang / /gang gis myur du mtshungs 'gyur ba/ /oṃ rtsu bhyo ghi ṭa hūṃ/ oṃ rghaṃ bhyo ghi ṭa rtsu/ ghi ṭa rtsu/ ghi ṭa rtsu/ ru lu ru lu/ ghi ṭu ghi rgyu/ ghi ṭu ghi sum̐/ /ghi ṭa ghi ṭa/ hūm̐ ṭa nā ḍa 8yo/ rtsu ṭa nā ḍa yo/⑫rdu ṭa nā ḍa ⑩yonyunye/ ṭa ra tsā/ ṭa ra tsā/ ṭā ṇa ṭā ṇa ṭwāṃ ṭa/ ṭwāṃ ṭa/3/ ṭā ṇa ṭa ṇa ṭaṃ 18/ ṭā ṭwāṃ/ ṇas ṇa(/ ṇi/( kye / oṃ duḥduḥduḥduḥX nye/ oṃ 3duḥduḥ draḥdūḥdūḥdraḥdūḥduḥduḥduḥduḥshrī snyes ṭaṃ/ ḍa ( ste: ṭwāṃ/ dha dha dha :sa/ dha dha dha/dzha ṭwāṃ/ dzha sgro/ rnyi ṭwāṃ/ dzñā tsā 5 nyergya tsā ⑦/ rnyi dzha(nya/ rnyi/ sgro sgro sgro/ sgyu tso āoṃ sgro/ sna yi sbubs su dkrol tsu )ba dang / /lag pa'i mthil dang kha dag dunagis/ /sil snyan sbyor bas bsil du bar bya/ /nges par myur du rab tu 'grub/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi sbyor ba dang / /chang zung lta ༄steba'i rim pa yis/ /sgeg cing dpa' ba zhustemi sdug pa/ /dgod du dang drag shul 'jigs su rung / /snying rje rngam solhadang zhi sogs kyis rme/ /nyams kyi ngo bo legs bslabs du pa'i/ /gang gis rnal 'byor can 'grub 'gyur/ /gar gyi dbang 86wa 319

phyug gtso bo che/ /bcud ni zla ba sogs mdzes pa/ /sha sogs bza' ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / /tsandan la sogs byug ①pa dang / /me tog la sogs phreng mdzes dang ②/ /bud med bzang mo'i rigs rnams kyis/ /dam tshig byin brlabs ②sbyor ba las/ /rdzas rnams thams cad bsgrub par bya/ /phaṭa yig ④hūṃ dang bcas pa yis/ /zhes ⑤bcom ldan 'das kun tu bzang pos bka' stsal to / /sbyor ldan kun la gnas nas su/ /g.yas pa yi ⑥yang gar sbyor las/ /rdo rje bsdams pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /snying gar ⑦de bzhin bsgreng bar bya yang ni meganyis pa nyid kyang ste/ /shes rab gang yin rdo rjer bya/ /skar ma lcags kyu de bzhin 'dir/ /'dir ni bsnyems bcas rjes su chags/ /de las rdo rje'i sbyor ba sbyar/ /yang dang yang du dgrol bar bya/ /'di yis las rnams thams cad ni/ /byed 'gyur 'di la gdon mi za/ /de nyid snying gar 0khu tshur te/ /rdo rje gdong pa skar ma'i kha/ /rang gi gnas su bzhag pa de⑩/ /dbang bskur ba ni gnyis pa'o/ /de nyid bsnyems pas cher bstan te/ /yang dang yang du yongs su bskyod/ /de nyid 'od zer rnam pa ru/ /thams cad du ni spro bar bya/ /de nyid kha ru bstan pa ni/ /rdo rje bshad par rnam par bshad/ /'di rnams kyis ni don rnams kun/ /mkhas pa yis ni bsgrub par bya/ /de nyid padma'i sbyor ba dang / /mig gis zhustesbyor ba gnyis pa'o/ /shes rab skar ma de nas bsgreng 3ge/ /lte bar nyi byas pa 'khor lo can/ /rdo rje smra ba lce yi rtser/ /ro ⑫ rnams ma lus 'phrog par byed/ /'di dag gis ni rmogelas rnams kun/ /padma'i 'od kyis rab tu bya/ /de bzhin khu tshur legs par sbyar/ /shes rab kyis ni snying gar 7bsnun/ /de las gnyis pa sna tshogs che/ /snying gar yi yongs su 86—320

bskor bar bya/ /skar ma rdo rje'i rnam pa mchog /bzod ①dang gzi brjid mche ba mdzes②/ /de nyid dam du bsdams pa ni/ /'ching ba'i las ni byed pa'i mchog /'di rnams kyis ni thams cad sgrub/ /phyag rgya dang ni phyag rgya'i lan/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi sbyor ba yis/ /las kyi dam pa ma lus pa'o/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das kun tu bzang pos bka' stsal ②sto/ /de nas bcom ldan sna tshogs chel/ /padma rin chen rdor mchog 'dzin/ /gsang ba rgyan gyis ④dkyil 'khor gyi//dpal chen la ni zhu ba zhus/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor don phyir dang / /ma mo rnams kyi don dam ni/ /yongs su rtog ⑤pa thams cad spangs/ /sangs rgyas kun mchog dam pa'i gsang / /dkyil 'khor thams cad brgyan yipa yisaX/ /mdzes pas bcom ldan gsung du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kun tu bzang pos de dag gis gsol ba btab pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /dang po dang ni gnyis pa dang / /drug dang lnga dang de bzhin bcu/ /mdor bsdus nas ni bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje rin chen chu skyes las/ /rang gi dkyil 'khor go rims kyisal/ /gsang sngags 'dzin pas gnas lngar dgod/ /dkar dang ser po ches dmar ba/ /sngon po'i 'od zer glog (7las byung / /tha ma kun gyi thog ma ru/ /'od zer bzang po sbyar bar bya/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor cho ga la/ /gnas nas bsgom chadang bzlas pa sbyar/ /'di ni dkyil 'khor ming yin te/ /dkyil 'khor rgyal ba rnams kyi rten/ /brten pas sgrub zhustepo shin tu yang / /dus mi ring tsobar sa stengs 'grub/ /'di ni bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /kun sbyor dri ma med pa'i gtso/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rgyal po che/ /skye dang 'chi ba 'joms pas gsungs/ /de nas rgyal ba thams cad kyis/ / /sbyor ba'i ma dang 86—321

yum rnams ni/ /legs tshig rdo rje sems dpa' ni/ /bde ba che la legs zhes gsol / /rdo rje kun gyi bdag po gtso/ /sangs rgyas dbyangs kyis bstod par byas / /rdo rje glu sogs sbyar ba yis①/ /dbang bskur kun gyi mchog ldan gtso/ /dpal ldan sangs rgyas sangs rgyas bdag po tshul/ /sangs rgyas nas ②ni rgyal rnams chub mdzad rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas sras po nges par mtha' dag sangs rgyas kyis/ /sbyor bas blo gros sbyin ①rnams legs par tshim mdzad pa/ /dpal gyi rdo rje dri med rdo rje ④ye shes rdor/ /rdo rje'i snang bas 'jig rten rab tu gsal mdzad pa/ /bsdus pa'i rdo rje sbyor ba ldan pas legs bton te/ /rdo rje'i bdag nyid ngo bor mdzad pa'i mdzes rdo rje/ /dpal gyi rin chen rin chen 'byung gnas rin chen sprin/ /rin chen rnams la rin chen gyis dgyes rin chen mdzes / /mdzes pa'i brjid ldan rin chen rgyal mtshan gyi(snye/ /skye bo rnams kyi phongs yidang sdig pa rnams bcom nas/ /dpal gyi ⑦padma padma dam pa'i bla ma pad sems dpal(na/ /padmas rab dgyes padma las 'khrungs padma yi/ /dra bas padma mtha' dag nges par rgyal 99rinamadzad de/ /padma'i rigs la 'jog par mdzad pa'i pad bzang po/ /sna tshogs dpal ldan kun gyi bdag po sna tshogs mkhyen/ /sna tshogs dbang phyug sna tshogs yum gyis mi )ma gos pa/ /sems can rnams ni 'dul legs 'jog mdzad nya sna tshogs pa/ /ci dga' 'dod la rig pa dam pa gnang du gsol1snye/ /zhes so/ /de nas de rnams kyis slar yang sems can ma lus pa 'dul ba'i don du 'di skad ces bstod pa/ sangs rgyas tshul khyod 0phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas ye shes khyod phyag 'tshalabo/ /sangs rgyas gzi brjid phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sangs rgyas dpa' 86—322

bo khyod la 'dud/ /rdo rje khro bo'i yid las 'khrungs/ /sdig pa bcom pa khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sdig pa bsal la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /phyag na rin chen khyod phyag 'tshal/ /gtsug na rin chen gzi brjid can/ /sdug bsngal bcom pa khyod la 'dud/ /thams cad grub la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /chos kyi dag pa khyod spyil 'dud / /padma dag pa rtogs ②pa'i phyir/ /'dod chags chags pa khyod la 'dud / /'dod chags bral la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sna tshogs rdo rje khyod la 'dud / /sna tshogs sbyor ba khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sna tshogs tshul can khyod la 'dud / /sna tshogs bde ldan ②phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /bstod pa'i rgyal po 'di yis ni/ /chos dang ldan pa thams cad du/ /nyin re zhing ni stod byed na④/ /bsam ⑤pa'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kun tu bzang pos slar yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos shes rab dang ye shes rnam par bsgyings pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 6nardo rje chos kyi dbang phyug rgyal po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi (legasang / /gsang ba rgyan snices bya ba ni/ /sems dpa' chen po legs par zung hur/ /sems dpa' chen po ni dga' bas/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i dbang phyug rgyal pos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /dpa' bo chen po ci gsung ba(7/ /rang byung ye shes pha rol son/ /chos kun dbang phyug dpal dang ldan/ /'jig rten gsum gyi sdig 'joms pas ji skad gsungs bzhin snying la ni/ /legs gzung 7dri med hu ye shes bzang / /rdo rje sems dpas bka' stsal ca1 pa/ /bde ba chen po bdag gis bzung nyubyu/ /zhes 86—323

༄gi /'phags pa gsang ba nor bu thig le zhes bya ba'i mdo/①༄tshogi /rgya gar skad du/ ārya gu hya nasam ṇi ti la ka nā ma sru tra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa gsang ba nor bu thig le zhes bya ba'i mdo/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhabs kyi rdul rtog pa med pa la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i dam tshig gi ye shes rnam pa sna tshogs pa khyad par du 'phags pa dang ldan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rin po che'i cod pan khams gsum pa'i chos kyi rgyal por dbang bskur ba brnyes pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya (5thams cad legs par khong du chud pas las sna tshogs mdzad pa/ ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i sems can gyi khams kyi bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par mdzad pa/thugs rje chen po rnam par snang camadzad rtag pa dus gsum gyi dam tshig la rnam 86—342

par gnas pa'i sku/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis ①bsten cing bstod pa'i nor bu rin po che chen po'i rtse mo'i ②khang pa chabartsegs pa/ kha dog rnam par bkra ba'i dril bu dang ldan pa/ rlung gis bskyod pa'i dar gyi ba dan dang / me tog gi chun po dang / dra ba dang / dra ba phyed pa dang / zla bas nye bar mdzes pa'i 'og min gyi lha'i rgyal po'i khang bzangs ④na bzhugs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu dang thabs cig (kyepa la 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' lag 56)na rdo rje dang / spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / nam mkha'i snying po dang / rdo rje khu tshur dang / byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa dang ldan pas chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor ba dang / nam mkha' ⑦mdzod dang /bdud kyi stobs thams cad rab tu 'joms pa dang / 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po dang / de dag la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu dang / gang gā'i klung nigi bye ma snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa gzhal du med cing bgrang ba las 'das pa'i de bzhin gshe/sa pa rnams kyis 'di lta ste/ dper na til gyi gang bu ltar 'dzam bu'i ri9 gling yongs su gang bar mthong ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku re re las kyang gzhal du med cing grangs las 'das pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhing mthong bar gyur cing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing 57de dag thams cad na yang chos kyi tshul 'di nyid ston par mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad nam mkha'i khams thams cad la sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje rtag tu bzhugs lha pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis / yang dag par bgrod pa'i 86—343

rdo rje'i dbyings thams cad thugs su chud pa'i ye shes sems dpa' nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad kyi rdul rdo rjes byin gyis brlabs pa las byung ba'i ye shes kyi snying po nam mkha'i khams ①thams cad la 'phro ba'i rang bzhin gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes mngon par yongs su mkhyen pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag gi rang bzhin dag pas chos thams cad ngo bo nyid rnam par dag pa nam mkha' ②thams cad la khyab pa'i gzugs thams cad legs par gzigs pa'i ye shes kyis ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i sems can gyi khams 'dul ba'i spyod pa'i mchog tu gyur pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi don yod pa'i ye shes mdzad pa dang ldan pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byang chub ①chen po'i thugs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'gugs pa'i dam tshig de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rjes su chags pa'i ye shes kyi dbang phyug dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi legs pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rin po che chen pos dbang bskur ba'i rin po che dang /de bzhin gshegs ⑤pa thams cad kyi nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi dkyil 'khor ⑤dang /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yid bzhin gyi nor bu chen po'i rin po che'i tog dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bzhad gad chen po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dag pa 99)chen po'i chos dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi shes rab dang / ye shes chen po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor lo chen po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i gsung chen po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi (pelas sna tshogs pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bsrung (kyeb dang /86—344

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis ①yongs su skyong ba'i ②rdo rje gnod sbyin dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i dgongs pa phyag rgya thams cad kyi ye shes dang ldan pa ste/ kun tu bzang dang ③don yod pa/ /'chi med rab tu dga' ba'i gtso/ /nam mkha'i snying po gzi dubarjid che/ /rin chen tog ste cher 'dzum pa/ /spyan ras gzigs dang dbang phyug chel/ /'jam dpal kun gyi snying po dang / /brjod bral sna tshogs pa yi rjolas/ /dpa' bo gtum po dam por 'dzin/ /rdo rje lcags kyu mda' tshim pa /rin chen nyi ma rgyal mtshan 'dzum/ /chos mdzod mdzes pa'i 'khor lo gsung / /las dang chos dang 'jigs byed 'dzin/ /thog ma tha ma med zhi ba/ /ma rungs khro dang bzod pa che/ /gnod sbyin srin po dam pa brtan/ /gzi chen dpa' bo khyab bdag che/ /u ma'i bdag po skye dgu'i ⑦mgon/ /'jug sred ⑧rgyal 'dod thub pa che/ /'jig rten skyong dang mkha' dang sa/ /'jig rten gsum dang khams gsum pa/ /'byung chen ⑨sems can don rab mdzad/ /thams cad sems can pha chen po/ /'khor ba mya ngan 'das dang brtag /yang dag mtsho dang mchod chen po/ /sangs rgyas dag pa theg pa che/ /srid pa gsum po'ang de yin nos/ /de dag la sogs pa'i yon tan bye ba brgya stong du ma dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bye ba brgya stong phrag du mas yongs su bskor te dkyil 'khor chen po de la bzhugs nas chos ston par mdzad do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi spyan sngar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la brten hunyete 'khod nas thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i bcom ldan 'das la 86—345

gsol pa①/ bcom ldan 'das mchog tu gsang ba chen po'i thig le zhes bgyi ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par bka' stsal du gsol/ gang gis sems can rnams la gsang ba'i de kho na nyid kyi ②dam tshig de bdag gis bshad par bgyi ②lags so/ / de nas ④bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po rnam par snang mdzad chen pos gsang ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal pa/ lag na rdo rje gsang ba'i dam pa gang gis sems can thams cad nges par bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur ba de bshad par bya'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rjes yang bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po gang gis bdag gsang ba'i bdag por 'gyur ba bka' stsal du gsol/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs kur zhugs par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad mi phyed par mdzad de/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku de dag thams cad dang mi phyed par gyur nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' de nyid la ched du brjod pa 'dis ched du brjod pa/ e ma'o bdag ni thabs chen po/ /rab tu gsang ba thig le yi/ /ting 'dzin gang phyir grub pa yang —/ /gsang ba nyid ni zhu bar byed/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kun tu bzang tre chen po (5bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka nas 'thon (6)nas phyag tu 'khod par gyur pas yang bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rab tu gsang ba'i thig le zhes bgyi ba ci lags/ de nas bcom ldan 86—346

'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /lag na rdo rje rab tu gsang ba'i thig le 'di ni mchog tu gsang ba'o/ /ches shin tu gsang ba'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bskyed ①pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad nyid sbyin pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad brtan par byed pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bde ba dang / yid bde ba rjes su rig pa'i don du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs su byon pa'o/ / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yab bo/ /(gede bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yum mo / /'di ni gsang ba'i mdzod do/ /'di nyid du padma'o/ /'di nyid rdo rje'o/ /'di nyid dam tshig ste/ de nyid kyis na lag na rdo rje/ dam tshig mi shes pa'i mdun du ⑤smra bar mi bya'o/ /de'i phyir lag na rdo rje ngas 'ga' la yang ma bshad do / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rjes slar yang bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ci'i phyir gang 'ga' zhig la smra bar bgyi/ de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la legs so zhes bya ba gnang ste/ legs so rdo rje sems dpa' khyod/ /rdo rje rin chen khyod legs so/ /legs so rdo rje chos khyod kyis / /rdo rje las khyod rab legs so/ /mdo sde 'di ni legs bshad pa/ /rdo rje theg pa bla na med/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gsang / /theg pa chen po mdor bsdus pa/ /dag pas rnam par bsgrubs tsam gyis/ /bde blag tu ni sangs rgyas thob/ /bde ba zad med mi zad pa/ /skye ba 'di la 'grub par byed / /ces 5)so/ /lag na rdo rje des na 56)shin tu gsang ba'i thig le las kyang 86—347

mchog tu gsang ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo sde 'di legs par sba bar bya'o① / /sems can gang kha cig nye bar skrag ②pa dang bcas pa yod la/ gang kha cig dad pa dang ldan pas theg pa chen po glang po che'i phrag tu zhon pa dag yod do① / /de dag las dang po la ni gsang sngags dang phyag rgya dang gsang ba thams cad bshad par mi bya zhing / gsang ba thams cad bstan par mi bya'o/ /dad pa can dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur ba thob pa dag la de dag thams cad bshad par bya'o/ /legs par gsang ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi thig le 'di ni ches shin tu gsang ba rab tu gnas pa'i slob dpon la bshad par bya'o/ /gang zhig rgyud 'di bshad pa tsam na sems can dad pas rjes su 'brang ba dang / gang dag ches shin tu dga' ba skye ba de dag ni sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyis lung bstan par shes par bya'o/ /de dag la 'bad pas gdams pa dang bcas pa bstan par bya'o/ /sems can gang kha cig nyan thos kyi theg pa dang ldan pa de dag la lo rgyus tsam yang mi bya'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rjes yang bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to④/ /bcom ldan 'das ci'i phyir de dag la lo rgyus tsam yang mi bgyi/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /lag na rdo rje nyon cig /sems can de dag gis lha'i ris ma mthong zhing dam tshig la rab tu smod (51par byed pa de dag la gal te smras na/ lo rgyus tsam gyis kyang dmyal bar rab tu ltung bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la lag na rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang rdo rje kun nas 'bar rab tu 'bar zhing me lce gcig tu gyur pa 'dis 86—348

rigs thams cad sreg par byed do/ /bcom ldan 'das de dag ni tshul bzhin ma yin par 'chi ba'i dus bgyid par bgyi'o/ /zhes so/ /de nas yang byang chub sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to / /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis stinyan thos kyi theg pa pa ②de dag gi nang du bshad par mi bgyi lags na/ de'i ①phyir bcom ldan 'das kyis shin tu ches gsang ba'i thig le zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i snying po dkyil 'khor chen po 'di ④dam tshig ji srid bde ba dang / yid bde ba thams cad bskyed pa'i don du bka' stsal du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po rnam par snang mdzad chen pos spro ba'i sbyor ba'i dpa' bo'i ting ⑤nge 'dzin gyis de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad gcig tu mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi (bebadag pos ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan 'dren pa dam tshig rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par du ma la mnyam par bzhag ⑦nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan 'dren pa'i dam tshig ma lus shing lus pa med pa (kyesems can gyi khams thams cad 'gugs pa bde ba dang yid bde ba bskyed pa'i don du ji srid ting nge 5na'adzin dam pa 'grub pa'i don du byang chub sems dpa' 7chen po lag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/ so so'i sgrub pa'i thabs rgya che bas mdor bsdus te cho ga rgyas par gyur pa shelhani lag na rdo rje dang po re zhig 8sngags pas lag pa gnyis a'i rnam pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du bsam par bya'o/ /a'i rnam pa de dri ma med pa'i gzugs la dkar ba bdud rtsi'i kyi rang bzhin can te/ de nyid yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 86—349

rol/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje lho phyogs kyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la 'khod 0)par gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po la gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci'i phyir lag pa gnyis zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du blta bar bgyi/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam pa grub pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/ 'dir lag pa gnyis zla ba la rdo rje phra mo nas kyi tshad tsam dkar po 'od zer dang ldan pa sngags 'dis bsgom par bya ste / hūṃ/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rjes yang bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar 'tshal bar bgyi/ rdo rje des ci zhig bgyi/ de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen pos lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /lag na rdo rje nyon cig /rdo rje thal mo dam du bcings nas gsang sngags 'dis rang gi spyi bor dgrol bar bya'o/ /oṃ swa sgyu bhā ba bi tsha shud ṅgāḥ sarba dharmāḥ su bhā ba shurnyo3rta9ge/ de nas bdag nyid shel dag pa'i rang bzhin dri ma med cing gsal ba'i gzugs su 96)sngags pas bsgom (7par bya'o/ / de nas sdom pa gzung ste/(8 sangs rgyasi dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming che ge mo zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung 9)ste ji srid snying po byang chub la thug gi bar du/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag 1 cigis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi 11ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed 86—350

tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan par ①bdag gis gzung ②/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas brtan par gzung ②/ /rdo rje dril bu byaphyag rgya yang / /de nyid so sor gzung ⑤bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung zhu)bar bgyi/ /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po las/ /sbyin pa rnam ⑧bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /nyin re bzhin ni dus drug tu/ /rin chen rigs chen rnal 'byor gyi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba'o9)/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /padma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi nang hu stagasang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam chos so sor gzung ⑩bar bgyi/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /de nyid so sor gzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus pas/ /las kyi ri rigs mchog chen po yi/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa rab tu bskyed pa dang / /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom /nyepa ma lus gzung bla/ /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ / ma grol ba rnams bdag gis sgrol/ /rigedabugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod57/ /de nas yang 51 tshobacom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 512bdag pos byang chub sems dpa' chen po nyugelag na rjo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sdom pa bzung ste 2 skuphyag rgya chen po la gnas nas sngags pas chos thams cad bdag med par bsgom par bya'o/ /'di dag thams cad phyi /rol dang nang du rtog pas brtags ni pa las gzhan 'ga' yang mi gnas so ri 2zhes de ltar snying la bzhag shusteste 'di skad ces 'du byed thams cad ni mi rtag cing rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal la gdod ma 86—351

nas ma skyes pa nyid do zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nas yang byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das kyi mdun du lazla ba'i dkyil 'khor la 'khod de bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das sems rang bzhin gyis cha'od gsal ba ji ltar bsgom ②par bgyi ba ducung zad bka' stsal du gsol/ de nas yang ⑤bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po rnam par snang mdzad chen pos sems so sor rig pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /lag na rdo rje khyod kyis sems rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba de ni zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pa'i bdag nyid nam mkha'i dkyil ma lus pa khyab pa'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor stimadzes pa/ dpag tshad brgya stong las lhag pa/ a la sogs pa'i rnam pa'i yi ge/ a ā/ i khri/ u u/ ṛ 2me/ bla 'cha/ e mal/ o mcha/ i aḥzhes bya ba ⑩de dag yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pa bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rjes bdag nyid zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par bsgoms 7pas bdag nyid zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par mthong ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi g.yon gyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la 'khod de don yod grub pa'i gzugs su gnas so/ /yang bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs kur 3nya'akhod de ched du brjod pa 'dis ched du brjod pa/ e ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /thog med grub pa'i don yod bdag /ji ltar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor te/ /bdag nyid zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnas/ /de nas yang byang chub sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das kyi 8rgyab kyi zla ba'i 86—352

dkyil 'khor la 'khod de/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen po la gsol ba btab ①pa/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de ji ltar ②blta bar bgyi/ de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byang chub chen po'i zla ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams rab tu rgyas pa'i tshad kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad nyid kyi thugs kur ②zhugs par mdzad do/ /zhugs nas kyang gcig tu mi phyed par gyur te/nam mkha'i khams thams cad rab tu rgyas pa'i tshul du rnam par gnas so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje byang chub kyi zla ba de bshad par bya'o/ /zla ba de'i steng du bdag nyid byang chub kyi zla ba'i tshul du bsgom ④par bya ste/ shin tu dri ma med pa nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa'i gzugs rnam par rtog pa thams cad spangs pa'i mchog /gnas ngan len thams cad las rnam par grol ba/ bde ba dang yid bde ba thams cad myong ba'i don dang /ji srid nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i dri ma med pa sngon (gemathong ba'i zla ba lta bu ka la sogs pa'i gzugs kyis sangs rgyas kyi yon tan 'jug pa ste/ ka kha ga gha nga /tsa tsha dza dzha stinya/ ṭa ṭha rinaḍa nye ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha/ a lo kṣaḥ/ ka la sogs pa'i yi ge 'di dag skar ma la sogs pa'i gzugs su zhugs te/ gcig tu mi phyed rigepar gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid du bsam par bya'o/ /yang shenalag na rdo rje zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de la nam mkha'i khams thams cad rab tu rgyas pa'i tshad kyi rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa zhi ba 'od zer dang bcas pa bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas yang gsang ba'i 86—353

bdag po lag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje de ji ltar bsgom ①par bgyi/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po rnam par snang mdzad kyis ②de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sems dpa' ①rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang gcig tu mdzad ④nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/ lag na rdo rje rdo rje phyede sems dpa' rdo rje'i gzugs su bsgom par bya ste/ nam mkha'i ⑥khams thams cad rab tu rgyas pa'i tshad kyi (7rdo rje 'bar bas rnam par brgyan ⑧pa / rgyan thams cad kyis nywakernam par bklubs yi )pa/ lus thams cad sangs rgyas kyi gzugs brnyan gyi tshul gyis gang zhing dang ba/ lag pa g.yon pas dril bu 'dzin pa/ g.yas pa'i lag pas rdo rje snying gar de/brten pa/ zhal cung zad bzhad par sngags pas bsam par bya'o/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sngags ni 'di yin te/ oṃ badzra ādma ko3rta1ge/ de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de nas sems dpa' rdo rje'i gzugs de bzhin gshegs pa'i skur sngags 12pas sngags 'dis bsgom par bya ste/ oṃ ya thā sab bta thā ga tā sta 7shā 7a haṃ/ de nas sum̐ gyi yi ge 1 las sngags pas ri rab bsams lho la steng dang 'og gi sgor sum̐ 19dgod par bya'o/ /de nas rgyu gi yi ge las khang pa brtsegs pa bsam par bya ste/ gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rdo rje 'bar ba yang dag ldan/ /kha dog sna tshogs dag dang bcas/ /sna tshogs ka bas nye bar mdzes / /dra ba dra ba phyed pas spras/ /zla ba zla ba phyed pas spud/ /nor bu 86—354

dang mu tig gi phreng bas nye bar mdzes pa/ rin po che'i rgyan du ma dang / dar dang ske/ 'phan dang / me tog gi chun pos nye bar spud pa/ de dag la sogs pa'i yon tan gyis nyukhyad par du 'phags pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa sngags ②pas bsam par bya'o/ /de nas bdag nyid rnam par nisnang mdzad ④du byas tedu/slar yang bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i gzugs su gzugs brnyan gyi sbyor bas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba rdo rje'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan ⑥pa bsgoms te⑦/ de nas rtsu gi yi ge de nyid kyis rdo rje sems dpa'i lus kyi snying gar (nyezla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgoms la/ de nas rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge bkod de/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang yi ge de dag yongs su son pa las rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa zhi zhing dkar ba ⑨bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas yang byang chub sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rjes ⑩bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje de ji ltar bsgom rtsomapar bgyi/ de nas 8bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ‘/snyebadag pos lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal pa / rdo rje de yongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs rdo rje bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po lag na ④rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis (gesna tshogs 7rdo rje khums ⑩lags sol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bskyed ri shepa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas lag na rdo rje la 51)bka' stsal pa/ lag na rdo rje nyon cig /rdo rje de nyid 'od zer dang bcas snyems dpa dang bcas pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'i gzugs cung zad bzhad sa)pa'i zhal ras dang phyag gnyis rdo rje gsor bar byed pa/ sangs rgyas 86wa 355

lnga'i cod pan ①can/ steng na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po ②bzhugs ③pa/ dpral ba dang nye bar mi bskyod pa/ g.yas su rin chen 'byung ldan/ rgyab tu 'od dpag tu dumed pa/ g.yon pa'i drung du don yod grub pa can / de lta bu'i yon tan gyi zhukhyad par dang ldan pa rdo rje sems dpa'i gzugs su bsgom ⑥par bya'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rjes de lta bu'i rdo rje sems dpa'i gzugs su bskyed nas slar yang bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug ste/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces ⑦gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i gzugs su mthong lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje la legs so zhes gnang ba/legs so rdo rje sems dpa' po/ /rdo rje rin chen khyod legs so/ /legs so rdo rje chos khyod kyil/ /rdo rje las ni khyod legs so/ /mdo sde ⑨'di ni legs bshad pa/ /rdo rje theg pa bla na med/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyis yigasang //theg pa chen po mngon bsdus zhunyepa'o/ /zhes so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po rnam par snang mdzad chen pos lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /lag na rdo rje khyod la thams cad bshad par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje thal mo sbyar nas brkyang ste 7sngags 'dis lag na rdo rje dbab pa bskyed par bya'o/ /oṃ badzra ā yi be sha ā be sha aḥli/ de nas rdo rje dbab pa bskyed 9/snyenas sems dpa' rdo rje bcings la dam tshig bsgrag par bya ste/sa ma ya / de nas dam tshig byin la yi ge brgya pa brjod par bya ste/ oṃ tiṣṭha badzra dṛ ḍho me bha ba/ a nu rasto me bha ba3lha/ su to ṣyo me bha ba/9/haṃ shā shwa to me 86—356

bha ba/ skṛ ①da yaṃ me a dhi tiṣṭha/ sabra si smo lapra yatstsha/ sasba kum ①su tsa me tsisto the ④yaḥku ru rtsu/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ/ bha ⑤ga bān sarba 0ta thā ga to badzra mā me muñtsa brdzu bha ba badzra satwa āḥme/ de nas rdo rje khu tshur gyis rdo rje me tog spyi bor sngags 'dis gzhag ⑧par bya ste/ pra tī atstsha badzra hoḥ0/ sngags pas de me tog gi phreng bar ⑩bsam par byas la/ de nas phreng ba de blangs la sngags 'dis spyi bor bcing bar bya ste/ oṃ pra ti groṇḍa tt+waṃ 8mi mi satwa tsom hā ba la/ de nas phreng ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ngo bor blta bar bya'o/ /de nas sngags 'dis gdong dbye bar bya ste/ oṃ badzra satwa swa ④yan te ārya tsa da gha ṭa ṅge ta ta pa ra utta tunyes ya te sasba tsakṣa badzra tu)tsakṣa ()ra nutta tunyer he badzra pā ཿyi/de nas nam mkha'i dkyil na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mthong na de nas grub par shes par bya'o/ /gal te snang ba tsam mthong na yang des dngos grub la nye bar gyur pa 0yin no/ /de nas rdo rjes byin gyis brlabs pa'i dri'i chus sngags pas bdag la sngags 'dis dbang bskur bar bya ste/ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa/ de nas pheg ⑥rdob gsum dang se gol gdab par bya ste/ badzra tu ṣpe hoḥ/ de nas sngags 'dis rdo rje blang ste/ oṃ ārya a bhi ṣe ka tā sdidu rnye/ si burnye badzra a gi ṣe ka tā tsoyi rda te ④ sarba bu two groṇḍi ci geb su sinta tsunyeyi/ de nas rdo rje sems dpa' rang nyid dam de bzhin gshegs pa ston par mdzad do/ /gal te slob dpon du gyur na de nas dam tshig gi so phyag rgya dang sngags 'dis bdag nyid dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /oṃ badzra a dhi pa ti āoṃ sgo a bhi tso'iX so )mi tiṣṭha badzra sa ma ya sdi/ de nas bdag la phyag rgya 'di dang sngags 'dis dbang bskur te/ oṃ badzra satwa sdi nunyes rnyi ṣiñtsa dumi badzra 86—357

nā ma a bhi ṣe ①ka ta he badzra nā mame/ sems dpa' gang gi ming du gyur pa'i ③ming de la brjod par bya'o/ /de nas brtan par bya ba'i phyir brjod pa④/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ / khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zung / /rdo rje sems dpa'i brtul shugs brtan/ /⑤de nas dngos grub thams cad kyi de kho na nyid dbab pa bskyed par bya ste/ oṃ sab ⑥ta ⑦thā ga ta dusirnyi/ badzra e ṣa ṭwāṃ spuṅgā ra yā mi badzra satwa nyi hi nyi nyi ⑩ hoḥyi/ de nas bdag la rdo rje sems dpa'i dam tshig brjod par bya ste/ oṃ ma hā satwa sa ma ⑫ya st+waṃ tshirta/ de nas de ltar byin gyis brlabs te/ slar yang yi ge brgya pa brjod par bya ste/ oṃ tiṣṭha badzra sa ma ya st+waṃ/ tsos ma ya satā haṃ dṛ 8sto me bha ba/su po ṣyo 7me bha /rka tshob/ a nu rasto nya me bha ba/ shā shwa to (7me bha ba/ skṛ da yo me a rdu )dhi tiṣṭha sarba sirnyis ( )pra yatstsha/ sab ‘ shrīkarma snyesu tsa me tsirta the nunyeyaḥku ru rtsu/ha ha ha ha 2)hoḥ( nya/ bha ga bān 2zhesarba 8nyeta thā ga ta rdo )badzra mā me muñtsa bsgyu soste bha ba badzra satwa aḥ(nya/ de nas yang de bzhin du rdo rje sems dpa'i tshul du lag pa g.yon par dril bu/ lag pa g.yas par rdo rje snying gar bzhag sonyal/ thams cad sngon gyi ji lta ba bzhin bsgoms te/ bsgom na pa'i rim pa des rdo rje sems dpa' nyid dam de bzhin gshegs pa nyid thob par 'gyur ro/ / 'di yis ri risteting nge 'dzin thams cad dang dga' ba zlos pa thams cad la sngags pas thog ma kho nar 'di ltar bsgoms te bya'o/ /gsang ba chen po rtog pa'i rgyal po rdo rje thig le las sems so sor rig pa la sogs pa rgyas pa rdzogs stogi // //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos zla 86wa 358

ba'i dkyil 'khor de la bzhugs nas dpa' bo'i ting nge ①'dzin la zhugs ②te/de bzhin gshegs pa dang / rdo rje sems dpa' dang / lag na rdo rje la sogs pa de dag thams cad nyid kyi thugs ka zhunas phyung ④ste/ de nas de'i rjes su de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad kyis bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen po thog ma dang tha ma med pa la mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa 'dis gsol ba btab par gyur to/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /rdo rje dang po kun tu bzang / /phyag na rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod / /rdo rje rgyal po blo bzang mchog /rdo rje lcags kyu de bzhin gshegs/ /don yod rgyal po rdo rje mchog /rdo rje 'gugs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje chags pa bde ba che/ /rdo rje mda' ste dbang du byed/ /'dod pa chen po rdo rje che / /rdo rje gzhu la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' mchog /rdo rje tshim pa (decher dgyes pa/ /rab dgyes rgyal po rdo rje mchog /rdo rje dgyes par phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje rin chen don bzang mchog /rdo rje nam mkha' nor bu che/ /nam mkha'i snying po rdo rje phyug /rdo rje snying por phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje gzi brjid cher 'bar ba/ /rdo rje nyi ma rgyal ba'i 'od/ /rdo rje 'od zer gzi brjid che/ /rdo rje sgron mar phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sems can don rab rdo rje tog /rdo rje rgyal mtshan legs tshim pa/ /rdo rje tog ste rdo rje che/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje sku khyod la/ /rdo rje gad mo gad rgyangs che/ /rdo rje 'dzum pa ngo mtshar che/ /dga' zhing rab dgyes rdo rje mchog /phyag 'tshal rdo rje dgyes khyod la/ /sems can don rab rdo rje chos/ /rdo rje padma legs rinadag pa / /'jig rten dbang phyug rdo rje'i spyan/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje spyan khyod la/ /86—359

rdo rje rnon po theg pa che/ /rdo rje mdzod ste ①mtshon cha che/ /'jam dpal rdo rje zab mo ste/ /rdo rje blo gros khyod phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje rgyu ste snying po che/ /rdo rje 'khor lo tshul chen po/ /rab bskor rdo rje ②las skyes pa/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje rgyan khyod la/ /rdo rje smra ba rigs ①bzang mchog /rdo rje bzlas pa legs grub gsol / /mi smra rdo rje dngos grub mchog /phyag 'tshal rdo rje gsung khyod la/ /rdo rje las rab rdo rjes ④mtshan/ /las kyi rdo rje kun 'gro mdzes/ /rdo rje don yod cher yangs pa/ /sna tshogs rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje bsrung ⑤ba brtan pa che/ /rdo rje chos te yicher sra ba/ /'thab dka' shin tu dpa' ba'i ⑦mchog /rdo rje brtson 'grus khyod phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin thabs chen po/ /rdo rje mche ba cher 'jigs pa/ /bdud rab ni'ajoms pa'i rdo rje grag⑨ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje gtum khyod la/ /rdo rje mtshams te legs bsnyen ⑩pa/ /rdo rje 'ching ba yirab 'grol chab/ /rdo rje khu tshur dam tshig mchog /rdo rje khu 6)tshur khyod 8phyag 'tshal/ /khyod kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ /dge ba 'di ni gang 'dzin pa/ /rdo rje ming gi dbang la sogs/ /kun gyi dam pas tsodabang bskur ba'o/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po yi7/ /mtshan 'di rnams kyis yon tan tshogs/ /rtag tu dbyangs kyis stod 7byed na/ /de yang rdo rje 'dzin pa mtshungs/ /mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad 'di dag gis/ /bdag cag rnams kyis (nyamangon bstod pa'il/ste/ /theg pa chen po mngon rtogs pa'i/ /tshul chen po ni rnam par spros/ /mgon po khyod la zhu ba bgyid/ /cho ga dam pa gsung du gsol/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi 'khor lo che/ /dkyil 'khor chen po mchog gi ni/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa chen pos de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis sdo )gsol ba btab 86—360

pa'i tshig nye bar gsan nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig 'byung gnas rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas rdo rje dbyings zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i mchog 'di bka' stsal pa/ 'di dag thams cad rgyud gzhan las bshad pas na 'dir ①mdor bsdus pa'i cho ga rgyas pa ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po rnam par snang mdzad chen po/ rdo rje 'chang chen po②/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yab/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yum gyis de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' de rnams nyid kyi thugs kur ②bcug nas gcig btu mi phyed par gyur nas spro ba dang bsdu ba'i sbyor bas phyag na rdo rje'i ⑤mdun du gzhag yinas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dpa' bo'i ting nge 'dzin gyi tshul la bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal po chen po byang chub sems dpa' chen po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi char 'bebs par byed pas bcom ldan 'das thog ma dang tha ma med pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po rnam par snang mdzad chen po la gsol ba btab pa/ bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas nyid sgrub pa'i thabs bka' stsal du gsol/ gang gis sems can thams cad kyi sangs rgyas nyid bdag gis ⑦phyin par bgyi'o(kye/ /de nas ci tshul gzhan nam thoratheg pa chen po'i tshul gyis lags/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po rnam par snang mdzad chen pos lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /lag na rdo rje theg pa chen po'i tshul gyis 7sangs rgyas nyid sgrub nyu bo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rjes 86—361

bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /ci dkyil 'khor gyi tshul gyis sangs rgyas nyid sgrub 6)bam/ 'on te gsang ba'i tshul gyis lags/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po rnam par snang mdzad chen pos lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /lag na rdo rje gsang ba'i tshul gyis sangs rgyas nyid bsgrub ②par bya ste/ lag na rdo rje ngas kyang gsang ba'i tshul des dbang bskur nas lag na rdo rje gsang ba'i tshul des nga yang yang dag par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das khyod slob (dadapon gang gis dbang bskur ba lags/ de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang 9༄mdzad chen pos lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /lag na rdo rje gsang ba zhes bya ba'i slob dpon des dbang bskur ro/ /gang (5)gis gsang ba'i (6)de thob nas sangs rgyas nyid brnyes par gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gsang ba de'i rang bzhin gang lags/ des ( chos gang gsung bar 98)mdzad ci sbyor ba gzhan gsungs sam/ 'on te zab mo'i tshul khyod la bstan pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das gsang ba de'i rang bzhin ma 'tshal bas ci zhig lags/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po rnam par snang mdzad chen pos lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /lag na rdo rje 'dis chos ma bstan cing cung zad kyang ma bshad do/ /'on kyang lag na rdo rje rang gi shes rab kyi tshul dang 79tsho/ shes rab kyi khyad par gyis bdag nyid gsang ba bsnyen pa brtsam par bya'o/ /de nas gsang ba brten 7pa las gang dag 'o 86—362

ma'i thigs pa 'od zer dang bcas par gyur pa dang / de nas 'od zer gyi ①phreng ba las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku rnams rnam par phyung ②ste/de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku de rnams las 'od zer gyi phreng ba 'khrugs ①pa'i rdo rje'i gzugs dang / khro bo'i gzugs rnams dbyung bar bya'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de lta na'ang ④gsang ba de bsten ⑤pa nyid ji lta bu'i rnam pas 'grub pa lags/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po rnam par snang mdzad chen pos lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /lag na rdo rje dang po re zhig (yeji ltar bya ba ngas khyod la bshad par bya yis ④nyon cig /sngags pas re zhig ⑧bdag gi ting nge 'dzin sngon spus 'gro bar bya ste/ bdag nyid bskyed nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs kyi ⑩lha mo chen mo dang / rig pa'i rgyal mo thams cad bsgrub par bya'ol/ /de nas phyis gsang ba nyid bsten par bya'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das thog ma dang tha ma med pa la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /ji lta bu'i rnam pas lha mo de rnams bsgrub /tshepar bgyi/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sems can 'ga' zhig dad pa dang ldan pa yod pa de dag ni rtse gcig pa'i sems kyis bdag sgrub /gepar 'dod la/ de dag sbyor ba mi shes shing nus pa dang mi ldan pas de rnams kyi tshe zad par gyur kyang lha mo rnams kyi /nyethugs rje'i thugs skye bar mi 'gyur zhing sems kyi gsal ba yang mi byed pa des na lag na rdo rje byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos sbyor ba shes par bya'o/ /de nyid kyi phyir lag na rdo rje phyag rgya dang / sngags 86—363

thams cad dang legs par ldan pas ji tsam zhig gi ①nyi ma'i nges pas 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyir lag na rdo rje rgyud 'di ni lha thams cad dang / lha mo rnams dang / rig pa'i rgyal mo rnams kyi sbyor ba legs par ldan pas sgrub par byed pa'o/ / des na ②lag na rdo rje sngags pa gsang sngags kyi bdag po gsang ba'i bdag por bshad do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag sngags pa ma lags pa chagasang ba'i bdag po ma lags pas bcom ldan 'das ji ltar gsang ba dang lasngags rnams kyi bdag por 'gyur ba de ltar mdzad du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen pos lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /lag na rdo rje des na sngags pas re zhig ⑤dngos grub gzhan bsgrub par bya'o/ /de bsgrubs na las thams cad byed do / /bskrad pa dang / gsad 96 pa dang / dbang du bya ba dang / rengs pa dang ske/ dgug pa la sogs pa rnams bsgrub par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyi dngos grub la sogs pa rnams kyang 'grub na dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos / de nas byang chub sems dpa' lachen po lag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das thog mar bsgrub (kyepar bgyi ba gang lags/ ci rig pa'i rgyal mo bsgrub 99)par bgyi'am/ 'on te dbang du bya ba la sogs pa bsgrub par bgyi'am/ yang na ral gri la sogs pa bsgrub 7par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das de'i phyir thog mar dngos grub gang bsgrub 37pa bdag la bka' stsal du gsol/ cide nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po rnam par snang mdzad chen pos byang chub 86—364
