dbang phyug khri phrag phyed dang gsum dang thabs cig ①tu lho phyogs kyi rgyud ri bo ki kyirnya ②ri 'jug pa'i sgor gnas nas gang gi tshe phyag na rdo rje gsang ba'i chos ston pa de'i tshe rtag tu 'gro ba dang 'ong bar byed do/ /gzhan yang gser gyi mig can zhes bya ba'i rnal 'byor ma'i dbang phyug de yang kha dog dkar ①ba khri phrag gsum gyi 'khor dang lhan cig kā ma ru pa'i sgor gnas nas de bzhin du rgyun du ④'gro ba dang 'ong bar byed do/ /gzhan yang bde ba thams cad la dga' ba zhes bya ba'i rnal 'byor ma'i dbang phyug thams cad du gnas pa thams cad kyi gzugs can thams cad la byams pa'i tshul du gnas pa khri phrag brgya stong phrag du ma'i 'khor dang lhan cig gang gi tshe sngags pa gsang ba ston pa na de'i mdun du de gnas so/ /de'i phyir bde ba thams cad la dga' ma zhes bya'o/ /de nas gzhon nu ma ⑤ bzang po tsho zhes bya ba'i rnal 'byor ma'i dbang phyug de phyag na rdo rje'i tshul ji srid mngon sum du sangs rgyas nyid ster bar gyur pa de srid du ⑦ de yis (8)bsten par bya'o/ /de nas gsad par dzoḍa'adod na lha mo de nyid 'bar ba dang ldan pa mdog nag mo lag na mtshon cha thams cad 'dzin pa bsgoms na dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi dang bcas pa yang gsod par byed do/ /gal te bskrad par 'dod na de nyid cung zad dmar zhing sngo ba'i kha dog can rlung dang lhan cig ma sbyor ba de nyid kyis rlung gi dkyil 'khor la bokun tu bsten 1nyapar gyur pas skad cig de nyid la sgrod par byed do/ /gal te dbang du bya bar 'dod na de nas kha dog dmar por bsams la des bkug ste 12skad cig de la rkang pa'i drung du 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas rengs par bya bar 'dod na lha mo kha dog ser mor 3stebasams la de thubasgrub bya lcags kyi ris rdzis 7par bsams la/ dpung gi 86wa 414

tshogs yan lag bzhi yang rengs par hu)byed do/ /②'di dag thams cad yid kyis bsam par bya'o/ /lag na rdo rje gzhan yang bza' ba bshad par bya ste/gang zos pa tsam gyis skra dkar dang gnyer ma sel bar 'gyur zhing lo brgya phrag stong du 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /'di lta ste bya rog tshang bzang po snum pa bzung la pags ②pa dor te ④zhib tu byas la de'i sha lcags kyi snod du til mar dang btso ⑤bar bya'o/ /ka ra srang bcu dang 'o ma srang nyi shu dang lhan cig gcig tu byas la slar yang ji srid bya rog mi grag ༅pa de srid du btso bar bya'o/ /de nas mar dang ka ra ⑦dang lhan cig zhag bdun du bza' bar bya'o/ /lo brgya'i skra dkar dang ske/ lus kyang bung ba lta bu dang / stobs dang ldan zhing shin tu sra bar 'gyur ro/ /lo lnga brgyar 'tsho'o/ /slar yang bcud len gyi cho ga bshad par bya ste/ sngags pa mnyam par bzhag (kyepar gyur pas rdo rje sgeg mo'i 'o ma sbyor ba de nyid kyis bsams la/ bdag nyid tshim pa dang ldan par bsam yonyepar bya'o/ /de nas nyon mongs pa thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /'ga' zhig tu rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tu bsams la de'i zhu ba btung bar bya'o/ /'ga' zhig tu mngon sum du gyur pas bud med bsten te de 7nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin gyis de dang rang gi zhu ba lhan cig tu btung bar bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje'i lus dang mi phyed par 'gyur ro/ /bcud len gyi cho ga rgyas pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po dang / rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug de dag thams cad dang ske/ phyag na rdo rje'i sku dang gcig tu mdzad nas phyag na rdo rje'i skur gyur to/ /86—415

de nas rgyal po chen po phyag na rdo rjes lha mo de dag thams cad la dgyes pa dang bcas pa'i spyan gyis gzigs so/ /de nas rnal 'byor ma'i dbang phyug de dag thams cad kyis phyag na rdo rje la bltas 0)nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das sems can gang gsang ba'i tshul la zhugs na de dag gis ji ltar bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur ②lags/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes de dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal tol/ /sngon spyad 97pa'i gsang ba'i tshul gyis sangs rgyas nyid bsgrub par bya'o/ /de nas gzhon nu ma bzang mo zhes bya ba'i rnal 'byor ma'i dbang phyug gis thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i bcom ldan 'das la 4'di skad ces gsol to/ /sems can de dag gis bha ga bsten pa tsam gyis sangs rgyas nyid bgyid dam/ yang na de'i gsang ba bsgoms pas lags/ de nas (5)rgyal po chen po phyag na rdo rjes de dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /bsgom 76)pa'i rim pas bsgrubs te phyi ⑦nas rnam par rtog tsho87pa med pa'i sems kyis bstan (9)nas bdag nyid phyag na rdo rje'i sku'am/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku'am/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sku'am/rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi sku'am/ 'dod pa'i lha'i sku bsgrub par bya'o/ /rtsa de'i 'o ma las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pa 7)bsgoms la/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de las bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i sku'am/ rang gi lha'i skur bsgom par bya'o/ /rtsa de nyid kha dog nag por bsams nas de las bdag nyid rdo rje rghaṃ mdzad kyi skur bsgom par bya'o/ /rtsa de nyid dmar skya'i rnam pa'i rim pa de nyid kyis bsgoms 31nas bdag nyid 'jig rten dbang phyug gi skur las kyi dbye bas bsgom par bya'o/ /rtsa de nyid kha dog sngo bsangs nam mkha' 12lta bur bsgoms nas rdo rje rnon po'i 86—416

skur bsgoms na de nas las kyi dbye bas rtsa de dag gi sbyor bas bdag nyid bsgoms na de nas ①gdon mi za bar 'grub ②par 'gyur ro/ /de nas sngags pa des thun mtshams (kyebazhir sems gzhan du ma yengs par bsgoms pa nyid kyis zla ba drug nyid na 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas gzhon nu ma bzang mo zhes bya ba'i rnal 'byor ma'i dbang phyug des rgyal po chen po phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ji ltar sems can de rnams kyis dgug pa la sogs pa'i las bgyid pa lags/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gal te sngags pas skyes bu dgug par 'dod na de nas de'i bha ga'i dbus su ④bdag nyid cung zad dkar ba'i rnam pa khro ba dang bcas pa'i bzhin can phyag drug pa sbyor ba de nyid kyi phra mo'i sgras bsgoms na rdo rje des bsgrub bya'i snying gar du bsnun cing zhags pas mgrin pa bcings te lcags kyus bkug la bcug nas bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas rgyal po yang 'gugs par byed na skye dgu (phyinagrong gi mi la sogs pa lta ci smos/ rig pa 'dzin pa 'gugs na rgyal po lta ci smos/ de nas bud med dbang du bya bar 'dod na de nas bha ga'i dbus su /phra mo'i sgra'i sbyor me de 5genyid kyis bdag nyid rta mgrin gyi gzugs kha dog dmar por bsgoms te/ rdo rje des lha mo chen mo de'i kladasnying gar tshebasnun na de nas de rnam par myos pas dpag tshad brgya'i phyed na gnas pa rnams kyang 'ong bar 'gyur na grong gi mtha' dang khyim gyi mtha' na gnas pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de nyid kyis rig pa 'dzin pa'i chung ma'am/dri za'i chung ma'am/ gnod sbyin gyi chung ma'am/ 'jig rten gsum ri17gyi bdag po'i chung ma'am/ brgya byin gyi chung ma'ang 512'gugs par byed na rgyal po mche'i 86—417

lha mo chen mo'am/ gong gi bu mo lta smos kyang ci dgos/ mchog gi sbyor bas ①dman pa la mi bya zhing dman pa'i sbyor bas mchog la mi bya ste dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ro/ /dman pa'i sbyor bas mchog bsgrub ②par nus pa'ang ma yin te yan lag ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas phyogs 'ga' zhig tu gnas te nyin mtshan du gsang ba bsten sa)par byas na zla ba drug kho na ④la 'grub par 'gyur zhing bskal (nyepa'i dngos po dag kyang mthong zhing ring du gnas pa'i ngag dag kyang ⑥thos la ji srid sangs rgyas nyid kyang thob par 'gyur ba 'di la the tshom gamed doni//ji ltar rdo rje sgeg mo'i rigs kyi lha mo chen 7mo'i sgrub thabs ltar rdo rje sgeg mo'ang de bzhin du thams cad sngon gyi rim pas bsgrub par bya'o/ /sbyor ba 'di nyid kyis rnal 'byor ma'i dbang phyug de rnams kyang bkug la bsten par bya'o/ /de nas rnal 'byor ma'i dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas pa de dag phyag na rdo rje'i zhabs la gtugs te phyag na rdo rje la tshe'adi skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das tshul 'di nyid kyis bdag cag kyang 'grub par 'gyur lags so/ /de nas 'dod pas myos ma zhes bya ba'i rnal 'byor ma'i dbang phyug gis phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang gis bdag rdo rje'i zhu bas rtag tu bsten 'o1par bgyid na/ de'i sngon du mchis te sngags 7pa des bdag po bgyis te bdag nyastede'i rjes su mchi mibar bgyi'o/ /de nas gser gyi mig can lizhes bya ba'i rnal 'byor ma'i dbang phyug gis de la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang gis bdag bha ga'i dbus su bdag nyid zhugs nas rtag tu bsten 7par bgyid na bdag de'i bran mor gyur te/ rtag tu der gnas par bgyi zhing nam du yang 'ong ba dang 'gro bar mi bgyi lags so/ /de nas skye bo ⑪86—418

thams cad kyi yid du 'ong ba zhes bya ba'i rnal 'byor ma'i dbang phyug gis bcom ldan 'das thog ma dang tha ma med pa la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang gis bdag rtag tu gsang ba'i tshul gyis sems shing dran par 'gyur ba'am / dran par bgyid na de la bdag gdon mi za bar sangs rgyas nyid ①ster bar gyur cig /de nas phyag na rdo rjes rnal 'byor ma'i dbang phyug de rnams la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sems can gang theg pa chen po'i tshul 'di la zhugs par gyur pa de la bcud len gyi sbyor ba 'dis stobs dang ldan par bya'o/ /lcags kyi phye ma dang / a ti ba la ma hā ba la'i rtsa ba 'o ma dang lhan cig sbyar la ka ra dang ldan par byas te 'tsho ②bar bya'o/ /de nas cho gas rnal 'byor pas bza' bar bya'o/ /sha dang mar gyi bza' ba ①bya'o/ /de nas stobs chen po dang ldan par gyur nas sdig pas gos par mi 'gyur ro/ /da ④ni gzhan yang bshad par bya ste/ nam mkha'i yul lam yul gzhan du rdo rje'i 'khor lo rdo rje brgyad dang ldan pa bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin zla ba'i dkyil 'khor lta bur bdag nyid stobs dang ldan par bya ba'i don du bsgom par bya ste/ des stobs chen po ⑤dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /de nas gsad pa'i yidon du rdo rje'i 'khor lo de nyid 'bar zhing gsal ba'i rnam pa me stag (le'aphro ba can de'i khang pa'i (nyeyul lam grong khyer du bab par bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas de'i skad cig la rigs dang bcas pa brlag par 'gyur ro/ /de nas dbang du bya ba'i don du 'khor lo de nyid kha dog dmar po bca (1)ka'am/ dza ba'i me tog gi kha dog lta bu'i 0phyogs thams cad khyab pa po 'dis bsgrub bya bkug par bsgoms pas yedabang du 'gyur ro7/ /rdo rje 'khor lo'i sbyor ba 'di nyid kyis rgyal po dang / blon po dang /⑫86—419

mdun na 'don pa la sogs pa rnams kyang dbang du 'gyur ro/ /de nas rgyal po'i lha mo chen mo dgug par 'dod na rdo rje 'khor lo de nyid dmar por blta ①bar byas la/ de 'khor lo la ②gzhag 9kyeste rlung gis bsnun pas rang gi rkang pa'i drung du 4)sngas su gtugs par bsgom (5)par byas pas de nas nyin mtshan de na de 'gugs par 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po rgyal po phyag na rdo rjes slar yang 'dus par gyur 96)te/ rdo rje sgeg mo la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sngags pa gang la la rgyud 'di'i don mi bsgom (7)pa de lta na yang glegs bam du gyur pa'ang khyim du bcang bar bya'o/ /gang yang tshul 'di la gnas par shes par bya'o/ /gang zhig yang gus pa sngon du 'gro bas sgom /na)par byed na rdo rje sems dpa' ji lta ba bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /'di gang su la'ang bshad par mi bya ste/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ gdug pa can gyi sems can 'ga' zhig yod pas de'i mdun du bshad par mi bya ba yin no/ /slob dpon gyis rdo rje 'dzin pa lta bu la yang gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba sngon du song bas slob mar byas nas bshad par bya ste/ gzhan du ni ma yin no/ /slob ma des kyang tsandan la zla ba'i dkyis 'khor byasari te der slob dpon bzhugs su gsol la/ rgyan la sogs pa thams cad kyis brgyan par byas te bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad ji lta bu de ltar byas nas bstod pa la sogs pa dag bya'o/ / des na 997nyan thos kyi theg pa can la sogs pa rnams la nam du yang lo rgyus tsam yang mi bya zhing glegs bam tsam yang bstan par mi bya'o / /theg pa 'di pa dang lhan cig gcig tu longs spyod 7par bya zhing gcig tu gnas par bya ste/ rnam par rtog pa ci yang mi bya'o/ /'di ni bcom ldan 86—420

gag /rnam par snang mdzad chen po mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa rnam par sprul pa byin gyis tshab pa shin tu rgyas pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs/①༄7gi /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā bai ro tsa na a gi saṃ bo dhi bi kub ②ti a dhiṣṭha lan bee pulya sru tra ind+ra (pe'o dzā 95)nā ma dharma parsā (naya/ bod skad du/ rnam par snang mdzad chen po mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa rnam par sprul pa byin gyis rlob pa shin tu rgyas pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i 0)rgyal po zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs / bam po dang po/987 bcom ldan 'das ngag gi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis 9thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad byin gyis rlob pa/ rdo rje chen po rgya che ba/ tshes kyi dbyings kyi pho brang / rdo rje 'dzin thams cad 'du ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rmolhamos pas rnam par rol pa/ mtha' dang dbus med cing rtse mo mtho ba/rin po che'i rgyal pos shin tu legs par brgyan 17pa 'byung ba'i khang bzangs yi chen po rin po che'i rgyal po'i nang na/ byang chub sems dpa'i lus kyi seng ge'i 86wa 436

khri la bzhugs te/ 'di lta ste/ rdo rje 'dzin nam mkha' dri ma med pa dang /nam mkha' la rnam par 'gro ba dang / nam mkha' 'byung ba dang / gos sna tshogs gyon pa dang / sna tshogs su rgyu ba dang / chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid la gnas pa dang / sems can gyi ①khams mtha' yas pa yongs su skyob pa'i rdo rje dang / sred med kyi bu'i stobs can dang / sred med kyi bu chen po'i stobs can dang / rdo rje bzang dang / rdo rje mchog gi shugs 'chang ba ②dang / dri ma med pa'i rdo rje dang / rdo rje mchog 'chang ba chadang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i go cha dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i go 'phang du 'byung ba dang / spros pa med pa la gnas pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu las nges par skyes pa dang / dri ma med pa'i mig dang / gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje dang / de dag la sogs te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi rdo rje 'dzin rnams dang thabs cig byatu bzhugs so(ge/ /byang chub sems dpa' (nyachen po kun tu bzang po dang / byams pa dang / 'jam dpal dang /sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba la sogs pa dag gis kyang bskor cing mdun gyis bltas pa la 'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyi ma dus gsum las 'das par byin gyis brlabs nas/ sku dang / gsung dang / thugs mnyam pa nyid kyi gzhi zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sgo'i chos ston to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po la sogs pa de dag dang / gsang ba pa'i bdag po la stsogs (3)pa rdo rje 'dzin de dag bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi byin gyis brlabs 48)kyis sku mnyam pa nyid bkod pa mi zad pa'i mdzod rnam par bsgyings (9 pa la zhugs so/ /de bzhin du blagasung dang thugs mnyam pa nyid 86—437

bkod pa mi zad pa'i mdzod rnam par bsgyings pa la zhugs te/ 'on kyang ①bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku'am gsung ngam ②thugs la ni 'jug pa'am ldog pa mi dmigs so/ /thams cad du yang bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku'i phrin ( shelas thams cad dang / gsung gi phrin ④las thams cad dang / thugs kyi phrin (snyelas thams cad sems can gyi khams thams cad la kun tu gsang sngags kyi tshul gyi tshig 'di dag stigis chos ston par ⑦mthong ba ni 'di lta ste/ sems can las kyi tshe rnam par bskyed pa rnams sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar (debazung ste/ sa bcu'i tso)bar la gnas pa 'di nyid la yongs su rdzogs par bya ba dang / las kyi tshe bkag pa rnams kyang srid pa'i myu gu mngon par 'grub par bya ba'i phyir rdo rje 'dzin pa'i lus ⑩'dra ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po dang / phyag na padma'i lus 'dra ba phyogs bcu na gsang sngags kyi tshul gyi tshig rnam par dag pa'i tshig dag gis chos ston pa dag kyang mthong ngo / /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das la gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje 'khor 'dus pa de nyid na 'dug pa des 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ci 17ltar de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes brnyes nas thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes de sems can rnams la rnam par phye ste/ tshul sna tshogs dang / bsam pa sna tshogs dang / thabs nyi sna tshogs dag gis ston cing ske/ kha cig la ni nyan thos kyi theg pa'i tshul/ kha cig la ni rang 1 sangs rgyas kyi theg pa'i tshul/ kha cig la ni theg pa chen po'i tshul/ kha cig la ni mngon par shes pa lnga'i tshul/ kha cig la ni lhar skye bar bya ba dang / kha cig 86—438

la ni mir skye bar bya ba nas lto 'phye chen po dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang /dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am cir skye bar bya ba'i bar du chos ston pa ①lags/ de la sems can la la sangs rgyas kyis gdul ②bar bya ba dag gis ni dusangs rgyas kyi ④gzugs su mthong / la las ni nyan thos kyi gzugs su/ la las ni rang ⑤sangs rgyas kyi gzugs su/ la las ni byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs su/ la las ni dbang phyug chen po'i gzugs su / la las ni tshangs pa'i gzugs su/ la las ni sred med kyi bu'i gzugs su / la las ni rnam thos kyi bu'i gzugs su (6)nas/ la las ni lto 'phye chen po dang ske/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i bar du mthong ste/ rang rang gi tshig brjod pa'i tshul dag dang / spyod lam sna tshogs su mthong la/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes de yang 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par grol ba'i ror ro gcig pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste dper bgyi na nam mkha'i khams ni rtog pa dang / rnam par rtog pa thams cad dang 7)bral ba ste/ mi rtog ⑧rnam par mi rtog pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyang (9)rtog pa thams cad dang bral ba ste/ mi rtog rnam par mi rtog pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste dper tson/ sa chen po 'di ni sems can thams cad kyi gsos su gyur pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyang lha dang mi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi gsos su gyur pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste dper bgyi na/ me'i khams ni bud shing thams cad sreg 517pas nam yang yongs su bas par mi 'gyur lags so/ /de bzhin du thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes 86—439

kyang mi shes pa'i bud shing thams cad sreg ①pas nam yang yongs su bas par mi 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste dper bgyi na/ rlung gi khams ni rdul thams cad sel bar bgyid pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyang mi shes pa'i rdul thams cad sel bar mdzad ②pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste dper bgyi na/ chu'i khams ni sems can thams cad kyi lus sim par bgyid pa lags ①so/ /de bzhin du thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyang lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten rab tu sim par bgyid pa lags na/ bcom ldan 'das ye shes 'di'i rgyu ni gang lags / rtsa ba ni gang lags/ mthar thug pa ni gang lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /lag na rdo rje legs so legs so/ /lag na rdo rje gang khyod nga la don 'di 'dri ba ni yang legs so/ /de'i phyir nyon la legs par rab tu yid la zung 0)shig dang ngas khyod la bshad do/ /rgyu ni byang chub kyi sems so/ /rtsa ba ni snying rje chen po'o/ /mthar thug pa ni thabs so/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de la byang chub gang zhe na/ rang gi sems yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin yongs su shes pa ste/ de yang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub bo/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de la ni chos rdul tsam yang med cing mi dmigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub de ni nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/de la byang chub par byed pa yang med la/ byang chub par bya ba'ang (zhe'aga' yang med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub la mtshan nyid med pa'i phyir te/gsang ba pa'i bdag po chos thams cad kyang mtshan nyid med pa ci 'di lta ste/86—440

nam mkha'i mtshan nyid do/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das la phyag na rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni gang nas yongs su btsal bar bgyi/ gang gis ni byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po byang chub dang thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni rang gi sems las yongs su btsal bar bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sems de ni rang bzhin gyis yongs su dag pa yin te/ de ni nang na ①med/ phyi rol na yang med/ gnyis ma'i ②bar na yang mi dmigs so/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po sems de ②ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis ma gzigasabya / gzigs par mi 'gyur te/ sngon por ma yin/ ser por ma yin dmar por ma yin/ dkar por ma yin/ kha dog le brgan du ⑤ma yin/shel gyi kha dog tu ma yin/ thung ngur ma yin/ ring por ma yin/ snyam por ma yin/ gru bzhir ma yin/ snang bar ma yin/ mun par ma yin/ skyes par ma yin/ bud med du ma yin(be/ ma ning du ma yin no/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po sems de ④ni 'dod pa'i khams kyi rang bzhin ma yin/ gzugs kyi khams kyi rang bzhin ma yin(she/ gzugs med pa'i khams kyi rang bzhin ma yin no/ /lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang /nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang /mi ma yin pa'i 'gro ba sems can ris mthun ⑨pa'i rang bzhin ma yin no/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po sems de ni mig la mi gnas/ rna ba ma yinam/ sna la ma yin/ lce la ma yin/ lus la ma yin/ yid la mi gnas so/ /de ci'i 86—441

phyir zhe na/ sems de ni nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de①/ de'i phyir rtog pa dang /rnam par rtog pa thams cad dang bral ba'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ nam mkha'i rang bzhin gang yin pa de ni sems kyi rang bzhin no/ /sems kyi rang bzhin gang yin pa de ni byang chub kyi rang bzhin te/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po de ltar na sems dang / nam mkha'i dbyings dang / byang chub 'di ni gnyis su med de gnyis su byar med do/ /de yang snying rje'i rtsa ba can/ thabs kyi pha rol tu phyin pas yongs su gzung ②ba ste/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po de bas na rnam grangs 'dis kyang 'di ltar nga byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi nang du chos gang dang gang ston pa de thams cad ni/ byang chub kyi sems yongs su dag par bya ba dang /sems yongs su shes par bya ba'i phyir yin par rig par bya'o/ /gsang ba pa'i phunabadag po de lta bas na rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo byang chub yongs su shes par 'dod pas rang gi sems nyid yongs su shes par bya'o/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po ci ltar rang gi sems yongs su shes par bya zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ rnam par ram(4/ kha dog tu'am/ dbyibs su'am/ yul du'am/ gzugs su'am / tshor bar ram / 'du shes su'am/ 'du byed du'am/ rnam par shes par ram(6/ bdag tu'am/ bdag gir ramatsham/ gzung bar ram/'dzin par ramatshon/ dag par ram(9/ ma dag 7par ram/ khams su'am/skye mched du'am/ rnam pa thams cad kyi bar du yongs su btsal kyang mi dmigs pa yin te11/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i byang chub kyi 12sems rnam par dag pa'i sgo zhes bya ba chos snang ba'i sgo chos snang ba'i tshul dang po ste/ gang la gnas na byang chub sems dpa' rnams tshegs tsho stechung ngus 86wa 442

sgrib pa thams cad spong ba'i ting nge ①'dzin 'thob ②cing / de thob pas byang chub sems dpa' rnams sangs rgyas thams cad dang lhan cig 'grogs pa thob ③par 'gyur/ mngon par shes pa lnga dag kyang thob ④par 'gyur/ skad dang sgra dang dbyangs mtha' yas pa'i gzungs gakyang thob (7par 'gyur/ sems can gyi bsam pa rjes su shes pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis ⑦brlabs shing 'khor ba na yongs su mi nyams pa'i chos can du 'gyur/ sems can gyi don bya ba dag la yongs su mi skyo bar 'gyur/ 'dus ma byas kyi tshul khrims la rab tu gnas pa dang / log par lta ba rnam par spangs pa dang /yang dag par lta ba rtogs par khong du chud par 'gyur ba yin no/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po gzhan yang sgrib pa thams cad spong ba'i ting nge 'dzin 'di la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni/ mos pa'i stobs skyes (kyepas tshegs khachung ngus sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed de⑩/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po mdor na rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de ni yon tan dpag tu med pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das la phyag na rdo rjes yongs su zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar byang chub tu sems bskyed pa zhes bgyi ba lags/ byang chub 'byung ba'i sems skyes rtso1pa'i/ /mtshan nyid ji ltar 'tshal bar bgyi/ /sems mkhyen pa ni rnams kyi mchog /dpa' chen ye shes las byung ba/ /ji snyed cig las 'das nas ni/ /skye bar 'gyur ba bstan du gsol/ /mgon po sems kyi mtshan nyid dang / /dus kyang rgya cher bshad nyugedu gsol/ /de dag bsod nams ci 'dra dang / /spyod pa ci 'drar 'gyur ba dang / /sems la ri sems kyi khyad par yang / /thub pa chen pos bstan du 86—443

gsol / /de skad gsol nas de yi ①tshe/ /bcom ldan rnam par snang chen gyis②ske/ /phyag na rdo rje cher 'byung la/ /legs so bu zhes 'di skad gsungs/ /theg pa chen po'i go 'phang mchog /sems kyi rgyud kyi mtshan nyid ni/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gsang ba'i mchog /rtog ge kun gyis mi shes pa/ /thams cad khyod la bshad par bya/ /yid gcig bsdus la mnyan ②par gyisadu/ /sems ni brgya rtsa drug cu ⑤las/ /'das nas 4)byang chub nyid kyi phyir/ /bsod nams ches tsho 'byung snying po ste/ /byang chub 'byung ba skye bar 'gyur/ /nam mkha' lta bur dpag med cing / /gos pa med de ci bzhin gnas/ /chos kun gyis ni mi sgul gte/ /gzod (7)nas zhi zhing mtshan nyid med/ /dpag med ye shes kyis bsgrubs pa/ /yang dag 7rdzogs sangs rgyas ston pa/ /mchod dang spyod pas bsgrubs pa'i phyir/ /byang chub phyir ni dang por 'dod/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de la 'khor ba thog ma med pa na 7byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams ngar 'dzin pa dang nga yir 'dzin pa la mngon par zhen pas bdag gi khyad par grangs med pa (1rab tu brtags te/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po de la bdag gi ngo bo nyid la ma dpyad par bdag go zhes ngar 'dzin pa kun nas bslang 3stengo / /gzhan dag ni dus las pibyung ba dang / 'dzin pa pos sprul pa dang / nges par 'byung 8ba dang 'di lta ste/ dbang phyug dang / 'byin pa po dang ⑩/ dus dang / gtso bo dang / byed pa po dang / byed pa po ma yin pa dang / rnal 'byor dang /tshad ma dang / dag pa dang / ma dag pa dang / nang gi bdag dang / skyes bu dang / khyab bdag dang / srog dang / gang zag dang / rnam par shes pa dang ske/ kun gzhi dang / shes pa po dang / mthong ba po dang / gzung ba 86wa 444

dang ske/ 'dzin pa dang / shes pa dang / shes bya dang / khong du chud ①par bya ba dang / shed las skyes pa dang / shed bu dang / brjod par bya ba dang /brjod par bya ba ma yin par rtog ste/ gsang ba pa'i ②bdag po bdag gi khyad par de ①lta bu la sogs pa rnal 'byor 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pa ④dag gis thar par ⑤'dod pas sngon brtags pa yin no/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po gzhan yang byis pa so so'i skye bo phyugs dang mtshungs pa rnams las brgya lam na/ res du'aga' zhig chos kyi 'du shes 'byung ba ni 'di lta ste/ sgyung ⑦bar gnas pa la gnas par ⑧bya'o/ /zhes (7de tsam zhig sems la byas te/ mgu ba bskyed nas phyi phyir zhing de nyid la goms par byed de/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po de ni dge ba'i las skye ba'i sa bon lta bu ste sems dang po'o/ /de rgyu de nyid kyi ⑩mtshan ma dang bcas pa'i nyi ma de dang 7de dag la pha ma dang / bu dang / bu mo dang /mdza' bshes dang / nye du dag la sbyin pa sbyin par byed de/ 'di ni myu gu lta bu 8ste gnyis pa'o/ /gzhan yang sbyin pa de nyid mi shes pa dag la yang sbyin par byed de/ 'di ni sdong bu lta bu ste gsum pa'o/ /gzhan yang sbyin pa de nyid snod du rung ba yongs su tshol zhing sbyin par byed de/ 'di ni lo ma lta bu ste bzhi pa'o//gzhan yang sbyin pa de nyid bla ma'am rol mo mkhan skal dga' bzhin du sbyin par byed de/ 'di ni me tog lta bu ste lnga pa'o/ /gzhan yang sbyin pa de nyid yid dga' ba dag la sbyin par byed de/ 'di ni 'bras bu lta bu ste drug pa'o/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po gzhan yang mtho ris su skye bar bya ba'i phyir tshul khrims bsrung ciste/ 'di ni gsos su gyur pa maste bdun pa'o/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po gzhan yang sems de lta bu nyid kyis 'khor bar 7rgyu ba na / dge ba'i 86—445

bshes gnyen la la zhig las tshig 'di skad thos te/ lha 'di dag ni lha chen te/ /thams cad la ni bde ba ster/ /de la khyod kyis gus mchod dang / /thams cad 'byor pa nyid du 'gyur/ /de dag kyang ni 'di lta ste/ /dbang phyug dang ni tshangs pa dang / /de bzhin khyab 'jug bde byed dang / /drag po skem byed de bzhin du/ /nyi ma zla ba chu lha 6)nyid/ /lus ngan nor sbyin brgya byin dang / /mig mi bzang dang sna tshogs 'byung / /gshin rje dus mtshan mya ngan 'das/ /'jig rten gtso zhes bya ba dang / /me dang rnam par 'dud pa'i bu/ /de bzhin lha mo dka' thub zlog /padma smyo /dang ni 'jog po klu/ /nor ldan dang ni dung zhes bya/ /marko ṭa ka padma che/ /rigs can dang ni gdengs ka mang / /rtag tu mtha' yas thog ma'i lha/ /de bzhin lha dang drang srong mchog /rig byed rig byed skyes bu yin/ /mkhas pas mchod pa gyis shig ces/ /de las de 'dra'i tshig thos nas/ /yid ni yang dag mgu gyur te/ /de tshe rab tu gus ldan pas / /de dag la ni nan tan byed/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po 'di ni byis pa so so'i skye bo 'khor ba na kun tu 'khyam tsho pa rnams kyi dbugs 'byin pa'i mchog yin te/ 'di ni stobs su gyur 5pa ste/ sems brgyad par rgyal ba rnams kyis bshad do tshi/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po gzhan yang khyad par rtogs pa ci skad du yongs su bsgrags pa'i khyad par de dang de dag la khyad par du gnas pa rnams la 'ba' zhig 7pa nyid kyi don du blo skye zhing / de yang yod do yod do 98)zhes stong pa nyid kho na la dngos por sems te/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po de dag gis ni stong pa nyid rab tu mi shes so/ /stong pa nyid ni dngos po yang ma yin/ dngos po med pa yang ma yin/ yod pa yang ma yin/ med pa yang ma yin/91 gnyi 86wa 446

ga ①yang ma yin te/ de la rtog pa'am/ mi rtog pa yang med na/ de la ci ltar stong pa zhes brtag par bya/ gang dag stong nyid mi shes pa/ /de dag mya ngan 'das mi shes/ /de phyir dngos dang dngos med pas/ /'jig pas stong nyid shes par bya/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das la phyag na rdo rjes gsol ba btab pa/ bcom ldan 'das sems kyi khyad par de dag bshad du gsol/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po sems kyi khyad par gyi mtshan nyid nyon cig /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de la sems 'di ①ni 'dod chags kyi sems dang / 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sems dang / zhe snang gi sems dang / byams pa'i sems dang / gti mug gi sems dang /shes rab kyi sems dang / gtan la phab ④pa'i sems dang / the tsom ⑤gyi sems dang / mun par gyur pa'i sems dang / snang bar gyur pa'i sems dang / sdud pa'i sems dang / 'thab pa'i sems dang / rtsod pa'i sems dang / mi rtsod pa'i sems dang / lha'i sems dang / lha ma yin gyi sems dang / klu'i sems dang / mi'i sems dang / bud med kyi sems dang /dbang phyug gi sems dang / tshong pa'i (pesems dang / zhing pa'i sems dang /chu bo'i sems dang / lteng ga'i sems dang / khron pa'i sems dang / kun tu bsrung (7ba'i sems dang / ser sna'i sems dang / khyi'i sems dang / byi la'i sems dang / nam mkha' lding gi sems dang / byi ba'i sems dang /glu'i (8)sems dang / gar gyi sems dang / sil snyan (9)gyi sems dang / khyim gyi sems dang / seng ge'i sems dang / 'ug pa'i sems dang / bya rog gi 86—447

sems dang / srin po'i sems dang / tsher ma'i sems dang / sa 'og gi sems dang / rlung gi sems dang / chu'i sems dang / me'i sems dang /'dam gyi sems dang / rtog pa'i sems dang / tshon rtsi'i ①sems dang /shing leb kyi sems dang / 'khrul ②pa'i sems dang / dug gi sems dang /zhags pa'i sems dang / lcags sgrog gi sems dang / sprin gyi sems dang /zhing gi sems dang / lan tshwa'i sems dang / spu gri'i sems dang / ri rab lta bu'i sems dang / rgya mtsho lta bu'i sems dang / phug lta bu'i sems dang /skye bar gyur pa'i ①sems so/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de la 'dod chags kyi sems gang zhe na/ chags pa can chos kun tu sten (gepa'o/ /'dod chags dang bral ba'i sems gang zhe na/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i ⑤chos kun tu sten (9)pa'o/ /zhe snang gi sems gang zhe na/ snang bas chos kun tu sten (7pa'o/ /byams pa'i sems gang zhe na/ byams pa dang ldan pas chos (kyesten 6)pa'o/ /gti mug gi sems gang zhe na/ gang mi dpyod 7par chos sten 7pa'o/ /shes rab kyi sems gang zhe na/ khyad par las khyad par gzhan rtogs par bya ste (rtechos sten 1 pa'o/ /gtan la phab 7pa'i sems gang zhe na/ bka' dang bla ma'i tshig bzhin byed pa nyid don/ /the tshom gyi sems gang zhe na/ ci ltar yongs su gzung tsheb nges pa dag la som nyi sten nyu 7pa nyid do/ /mun par gyur pa'i sems gang zhe na/ som nyi med pa la som nyir 'du kyi shes pa'o/ /snang bar gyur pa'i sems gang zhe na/ som nyi med pa la som nyi med par sten 37pa'o/ /sdud pa'i sems gang zhe na/ du ma gcig tsho 7tu byed pa'o/ /'thab pa'i sems gang zhe na/phan tshun rtsod 1pa nyid do/ /rtsod 52pa'i sems gang zhe na/ gang gi bdag nyid 86wa 448

dang bdag nyid du rtsod ①pa'o/ /mi rtsod ②pa'i sems gang zhe na/ mnyam pas mtshungs par lta ba'o/ /lha'i sems gang zhe na/ yid kyis bdag nyid la rlom sems su byed pa'o/ /lha ma yin gyi sems gang zhe na/ gang 'khor ba nyid la smod pa'o/ /klu'i sems gang zhe na/ gang longs spyod chen po nyid du bya ba'i phyir sems pa'o/ /mi'i sems gang zhe na/ de nyid kyi don du sems pa'o/ /bud med kyi sems gang zhe na / 'dod pa kho na'i phyir chos sten ④pa'o/ /dbang phyug gi sems gang zhe na/ gang bdag gis thams cad bsams so 0snyam du rlom sems su byed pa'o/ /tshong pa'i sems gang zhe na/ gang bsdu ba byas te ⑥rnam par spel nas phyis sten ⑦pa'o/ /zhing pa'i sems gang zhe na/ gang thos pa rnam pa ⑧du ma tshol zhing phyis sten ⑨pa'o/ /chu bo'i sems gang ⑩zhe na/ gang mtha' gnyis la ltos shing sten nyunyepa'o/ /lteng tsoka'i sems gang zhe na/ gang sred pas sten 8pa'o/ /khron pa'i sems gang zhe na/ gang mi zab pa la zab par sems ④pa'o/ /kun tu bsrung 8ba'i sems gang zhe na/ 'di nyid bden gyi chagazhan ni 0gti mug go snyam du sems pa'o/ /ser sna'i sems gang zhe na/bdag nyid bsten (/nyecing gzhan la mi ster ba'o/ /byi la'i sems gang zhe na/gang (stemachod pa la 0ltos te sten zhu7pa'o/ /khyi'i sems gang zhe na/ gang chung so ngus kyang mgu bar 'gyur ba'o/ /nam mkha' lding gi sems gang zhe na/ gang phyogs 'dzin pas chos la sten ( nopa'o/ /byi ba'i sems gang zhe na/ 'ching ba sosnyethams cad gcad 'i pa'i phyir sems pa'o/ /glu'i sems gang zhe na/ bdag gis rinyadabyangs sgra sna tshogs kyi glus sems can rnams gzung bar bya'o snyam pa'o/ /gar gyi sems gang zhe na/ bdag gis rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs kyis gzhan dag yang 86wa 449

dag par 'dzin pa ①gzhug go snyam du sems pa'o/ /sil snyan gyi sems gang zhe na / bdag gis chos kyi rnga brdung ngo snyam pa'o/ /khyim gyi sems gang zhe na/bdag gi lus kun tu bsrung ②ba'i phyir sten ①pa'o/ /seng ge'i sems gang zhe na/gang thams cad zil gyis gnon pa sten ④pa'o/ /'ug pa'i sems gang zhe na/gang mtshan mo sems pa'o/ /bya rog gi sems gang zhe na/ gang ⑤thams cad du ⑥skrag pas ⑦sems pa'o/ /srin po'i sems gang zhe na/ dge bas mi dge ba rnams sgrub ⑧pa'o/ /tsher ma'i sems gang zhe na/ gang thams cad du 'gyod pa sems pa'o/ /sa 'og gi sems gang zhe na/ sa'i (pe'og gi don du sems pa'o /rlung gi sems gang zhe na/ gang thams cad du thams cad sgrub ⑩pa'o/ /chu'i sems gang zhe na/ gang mi dge ba thams cad bkru ba'i phyir sten ⑩pa'o/ /me'i sems gang zhe na/ gang dka' thub nyid kyis gdung bar byed pa'o/ /'dam gyi sems gang zhe na/ gang bdag gi nyes pas gzhan la skur ba'o8/ /rnyog pa'i sems gang zhe na/ gang (2pha rol gyi 7nyes pa 'dzin pas sems la rtog pa skyed ⑫ pa'o/ /tshon rtsi'i sems gang zhe na/ gang de la chags pa nyid du sten ⑩pa'o/ /shing leb kyi sems gang zhe na gang dge ba'i 3 tshogazhan spong bas sten yi pa'o/ /nor ba'i sems gang zhe na/ gzhan bzung nyartezhing gzhan kho nar sems pa'o/ /dug gi sems gang zhe na/ gang shin tu dngos po med pa ḍo )nyid sems pa'o/ /zhags pa'i sems gang zhe na/ gang thams cad du bdag nyid bcings shing 'dug pa'o//lcags sgrog gi sems gang zhe na/ gang rkang pa gnyis la 'dug ste sems pa'o/ /sprin gyi sems gang zhe na/ gang chu dag la sems pa'o/ /zhing gi sems gang zhi na/ rang gi lus nyid yongs su sbyong bar byed pa'o/ /lan tshwa'i sems gang zhe 86—450

na / gang zhig gang gis sems par byed pa de la yang sems pa'o/ /spu gri'i sems ①gang zhe na/ gang rab tu byung ba tsam la sten ②pa'o/ /ri rab lta bu'i sems gang zhe na/ gang mtho bar gyur nas sems pa'o/ /rgya mtsho lta bu'i sems gang zhe na/ gang rang gi lus nyid la mchog tu 'dzin cing 'dug pa'o/ /phug lta bu'i sems gang zhe na/ gang sngar nges par gyur la phyis de nyid kyis zhu'agyur bar sten ④pa'o/ /de la skye bar gyur pa'i ④sems gang zhe na/ gang gi sems 'du byed gang kho na dang skyes pa de kho na dang yilhan cig tu ⑦'gro ba'o/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de ltar na gcig gnyis gsum bzhi lnga gnyis su bsgyur ba byas pasal/ 'jig rten pa'i sems brgya drug cu ⑨bskal pa gsum gyis 'das nas / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sems skye ste/ 'di lta ste/ 'di ni phung po ⑩ tsam nyid de/ /bdag ni nam yang yod ma yin/ /dbang po'i bā/grong khyer khams rnams kyis/ /'jig rten don med rnam par nyams/ /yan lag bcu gnyis rten 'brel 'di/ /nyon mongs las kyis kun nas bslang / /ma rig sa bon las byung ba/ /byed po la sogs tshernam par spangs/ /de ltar zhi zhing shin tu zab / /rtog ge kun gyis shes par dka'/ /nyes pa thams cad rnam spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis sngon /3bstan pa'o/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de la 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sems la gnas pa rnams la yang phung po chosal yod do snyam pa'i blo nye bar skye'o/ /nam phung po dag la 'dod chags dang bral bar skyed 8pa de'i tshe lbu ba dang / chu'i chu bur dang / sgyu ma dang / smig rgyu dang mtshungs par 'jig 7pas rnam par grol bar 'gyur te/ 'di lta ste/ phung po dang khams dang skye mched dang gzung ba dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs pa/ chos nyid 86wa 451

kyi rang gi ngo bo ①zhi ba'i dbyings rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /gsang ba pa'i ②bdag po 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sems phyin ci log dang / phyin ci ma log pa'i sems kyi khyad par brgyad dang 'brel pa/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i dra ba dang bral ba 'di ni rnal 'byor pa dag bskal pa gcig gis 'da' bar byed do/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po gzhan yang theg pa chen pos bgrod ①pa gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa rnams la chos la bdag med pa'i sems skye'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/'di ltar de dag sngon spyad pa spyod cing phung po'i gnas rnam par 'jig pa na ngo bo nyid yongs su shes pa'i phyir sgyu ma dang / smig rgyu dang / gzugs brnyan dang ske/ brag ca byadang / mgal ⑤me'i 'khor lo dang / dri za'i grong khyer lta bu'i 'du shes skyes so/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de'i phyir de dag gi sems kyi dbang du byas pas chos la bdag med pa nyid kyang spang bar bya ste/ rang gi sems ni gzod ma nas ma skyes pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po ngo bo nyid yongs su shes pa'i phyir sems la sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha' 6)mi dmigs te/ rnal 'byor pa dag 'di yang bskal pa gnyis kyis 'da' bar byed do/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa/ bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong dpag tu med par bsod nams dang ye shes kyi rdo tshogs dpag tu med pa bsags tshan)pa rnams la shes rab dang thabs dpag tu med pas (9)yongs su bzung 7ba/ lha dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis phyag byas pa/nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sa las yang dag par 'das pa/ brgya byin dang / tshangs pa'i dbang po dang / nye dbang la sogs pas phyag 86—452

byas pa 'di lta ste/ stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid rdzas ①med pa/ mtshan nyid med pa / mtshan ma med pa/ spros pa thams cad las 'das pa/ nam mkha' ltar dpag tu med pa/ chos thams cad kyi go skabs su gyur pa/ 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas kyi khams dang bral ba/ las dang bya ba med pa/ mig dang /rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid dang bral ba shin tu ngo bo nyid med pa'i sems skye ste/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po 'di ni byang chub kyi sems dang po zhes rgyal ba rnams kyis gsungs ②so/ /de dag nyon mongs las las grol/ /las dang nyon mongs ldan pa'ang yin/ /de dag 'jig rten sbyin gnas te/ /de dag rtag mchod ri mor bya/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po gzhan yang /mos pa yis ni spyod pa'i sa/ /sems gsum rnam par sgom ③pa ste/ /pha rol phyin rnams spyod pa dang / /bsdu ba dag ni bzhi po yis/ /mos pa'i sa ④ni mtshungs pa med/ /dpag tu med cing bsam mi khyab/ /dpag med ye shes 'byung ba ni/ /sems bcu dag gis 'thob ⑧par 'gyur/ /ngas gang cung zad brjod pa ni/ /thams cad 'di yis 'thob ⑥par 'gyur/ /de phyir thams cad mkhyen pa yis(pe/ /mos pa zhes ni bya bar bshad/ /blo ldan bskal pa gcig gis ni/ /sa las yang dag 'da' bar 'gyur/ /'di yi yang ni bzhi cha yis/ /mos pa las kyang 'da' bar 'gyur/ /de nas yang (nyebacom ldan 'das la phyag na rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsol to/ /mgon po khyab bdag khyod kyis ni/ /sems kyi mtshan nyid bstan lags na/ /dbugs 'byin rnam pa du thob nas/ /mchog skyes de dag dbugs phyin 'gyur/ /de skad gsol nas bcom ldan 'das//rnam par snang mdzad chen po yis/ /de tshe phyag na rdo rje la/ /yid bsdus 'di 86wa 453

ni nyon ces ①gsungs/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de la nam byis pa so so'i skye bo dag mi dge ba'i las spangs te dge ba'i las byed pa de'i tshe dge bas dbugs phyin pa yin no/ /nam bdag gi de kho na nyid yang dag pa ci lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes pa de'i tshe bdag la brten nas dbugs phyin pa yin no/ /nam phung po yongs su gzung ②ba byas te rang gi ngo bo nyid ①la rnam par dpyad nas bdag la brten pa yongs su gtong ba de'i tshe bdag med pas dbugs phyin pa yin no/ /nam phung po rnams spangs nas chos kyi dmigs pa la gnas pa de'i tshe chos kyi ④dbugs phyin pa yin no/ /nam chos rnams spangs nas mi skye ba la gnas pa de'i tshe chos la bdag med pas dbugs phyin pa yin no/ /nam phung po dang /khams dang / skye mched thams cad dang / gzung ba dang / 'dzin pa dang /bdag dang srog la sogs pa dang / chos dang mi skye ba dag kyang stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid du yang ngo bo nyid med do zhes stong pa'i ye shes skyes pa de'i tshe chos thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid mnyam pa nyid kyis dbugs phyin pa yin no/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa bzhi bcus rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba rnams bsgoms te gsang sngags kyi tshul rtogs par khong du chud par 'gyur ro/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sgyu ma dang / smig rgyu (shedang / mi lam dang /gzugs brnyan dang / dri za'i grong khyer dang / brag ca 96)dang / chu zla dang /chu'i chu bur dang / 'khrul pa dang / mgal me'i 'khor lo lta bur rnam par bsgom 97mo/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de la byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pas 'di ltar so sor brtag par bya 86—454

ste/ de la sgyu ma gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sman dang sngags kyi sbyor ba byed pa dag gi sbyor ba las dngos po rnam pa tha dad pa sna tshogs mig dang yid 'phrog pa sngon ma mthong ba dag kyang ston te/ de dag ni phan tshun phyogs bcur 'gro ba dang 'ong ba med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sgyu ma ni rang bzhin gyis stong pa'i phyir te/ de bzhin du gsang sngags sbyor bar ༅byed pa dag gi sbyor ba las thams cad 'byung ngo / /gsang ba pa'i bdag po gzhan yang smig rgyu ni ②rang bzhin gyis stong pa ste/ de yang 'du shes kyi ②tha snyad du 'dogs shing tha snyad kyang sgrub par byed do/ /de bzhin du 'du shes 'di yang gsang sngags so zhes tha snyad du 'dogs shing tha snyad kyang sgrub par byed do/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po gzhan yang rmi lam na bdag nyid nyin gcig ④dang / zhuskad cig dang / yud tsam dang / lo la sogs par 'dug cing bde ba dang sdug bsngal rnam pa mang po myong bar mthong la/ sad na ci yang mi mthong ba de bzhin du gsang sngags kyi tshul 'di yang (6)mi lam lta bur khong du chud par bya'o/ /gsang ba pa'i ni bdag po gzhan yang gsang sngags kyi dngos grub 'byung ba ni gzugs brnyan (kyelta bur rig par bya ste/ dper na gdong dang me long la brten nas bzhin gyi gzugs brnyan 59)'byung ba ltar/ gsang sngags kyi dngos grub kyang de dang 'dra bar rig par bya'o/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po gzhan yang grub pa'i ⑩gnas ni/ dri za'i grong khyer lta bur blta'o31/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po gzhan yang gsang sngags kyi sgra ni brag ca 8lta bur rig par bya ste/ dper na sgra la brten nyushenas brag ca tso'abyung ba ltar gsang sngags kyi tshul 'di yang de dang 'dra bar rig par bya'o/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po gzhan yang zla ba shar tshen chu'i nang du gzugs brnyan 86—455

mthong nas chu zla zhes brjod pa de bzhin du sngags pa de nyid kyang ༅chu zla bzhin du rig sngags 'chang zhes brjod do/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po gzhan yang / ci ltar char pa bab pa na②/ / chu yi ③chu bur rnams 'byung ba/ /de bzhin dugasang sngags grub pa yig/ /sprul pa rnam pa sna tshogs 'dodabu/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po gzhan yang / /sems can med cing srog dang ni/ /byed pa po yang med pa ste/ /dngos po thams cad stong pa la/ /'khrul pa kho na snang bar zad/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po gzhan yang / ci ltar 'ga' zhig bdag nyid kyi/ /lag na mgal me thogs nas ni/ /bskor na 'khor lo ltar snang ba/ /de bzhin stong pa dag las 'byung ⑦/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po/ 'di ni theg pa chen po'i gzhi/ mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i gzhi/ nges pa'i gzhi/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i dusangs rgyas kyi ⑨gzhi/ mthar gyis theg pa chen po la 'jog ⑩pa'i gzhi ste/ ye shes sna tshogs cher 'byung ba/ /nor gyi dbyig 'di shes na ni//kun gyi sems kyi bye brag kyang / /ci bzhin yang dag rab tu shes/ /bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen po mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa rnam par sprul pa byin gyis rlob pa las/ sems kyi khyad par rim par phye ba'o// //de nas yang bcom ldan 'das la gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi dbyings bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ sems kyi phonyes las yang dag par 'das pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis thabs dang tshul sna tshogs dag gis bsam pa dang mos pa ci lta ba bzhin du sems can rnams la bstan pa de ni lho ngo 86—456

mtshar che ①lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das yang gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul snying rje chen po'i snying po 'byung ba dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal po chen po yongs su rdzogs par bgyi ba ②bshad du gsol/ de ni ma 'ongs pa'i dus na sems can mang po dag gi don dang phan pa dang bde bar 'gyur lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor la gzigs nas/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /lag na rdo rje dkyil 'khor spyod ③pa'i tshul bstan 0pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yongs su rdzogs par byed pa nyon cig /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad ⑤chos kyi dbyings kyi dgongs pa ma rdzogs shing / sems can gyi khams ma lus pa bsgral bar rjodam bca' ba ⑦mdzad pas/ de bzhin gshegs pas ④thams cad dang thabs cig ⑨yang dag par mol ⑩nas snying rje chen po'i snying po 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs yiso/ /bcom ldan 'das snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu sku'i yan lag thams cad nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i skus 8sems dang po bskyed pa nas bzung tu ste/ sa bcu pa'i chabar du sems can la phan pa'i don mdzad pa rnams byung 8ngo / /byung nas kyang phyogs bcu kun tu bskor te slar log nas bcom ldan 'das kyi sku'i nang rang gi gnas tsos zhugs so/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /lag na rdo rje dkyil 'khor rnam par dgod pa nyon cig /re zhig chadang por slob dpon yid byang chub kyi (/shesems la zhugs pa/ shes rab dang ldan pa/ brtan pa snying rje can/ sgyu rtsal dag la mkhas pa/ shes rab kyi 86—457

pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul la ①rtag tu mkhas pa/ theg ②pa gsum gyi khyad par shes pa/ gsang sngags kyi de kho na nyid kyi don la mkhas pa/ bsam pa shes pa/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la dad pa sridakyil 'khor bri ba'i las byed par gnang zhing dbang bskur ba/ rigs btsun ④gsang sngags spyod pa la/ /mngon par brtson zhing gtan la phab⑤/ /sbyor la mkhas shing zung ⑥thub la/ /byang chub sems la rnam par gnas/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po slob dpon de lta bu ni rgyal ba'i sras yin te/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis rab tu bsngags so/ /gsang ba pa'i ⑦bdag po de la slob dpon la gzhan gyis gsol ba btab kyang rung / yang na bdag gis sems can dag /snod du rung zhing nyes bral ba/ /mos mang brtan la dad pa can/ /gzhan la phan dga' mthong nas ni/ /de lta bu yi 9)slob ma de/ /shes nas slob dpon bdag nyid kyis/ /ma gsol bar ni de bos te/ /phan 'dod phyir ni 'di skad bya/ /khyod ni tshul chen snod yin gyis(9)/ /bu tshur theg 7pa chen po yi1lha / /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/ /khyod la yang dag bstan nyustepar bya/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang / /de bzhin gang tsha/nyadag ma byon dang /ri /da ltar byung ba'i mgon po rnams/ /'gro la phan phyir bzhugs 7pa dag /de dag kun gyis gsang sngags kyi/ /cho ga mchog bzang 'di mkhyen nasa'i/ /dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa mtshan med brnyes/ /gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med de/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /bdud sde shin tu mi bzad 7pa/ /dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /snying rje gyur pa'i nyan86—458

yid kyis ni/ /de ltar lan mang gzengs bstod de①/ /slob ma de brtan ⑤shes nas ni/ /sa gzhi legs par yongs brtag bya/ /me tog 'bras bu ②ldan pa'i ribya / /gtsang zhing yid 'ong chu yi gnas/ /de dag dkyil 'khor bri ba yi/ /las la sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags⑤/ /gang na du'abab chu ⑦mang po dag /ngang pa bzhad kyis brgyan yod pa/ /der ni sngags pa blo can gyis/ /snying rje 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor bri/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang rang mgon dang / /de bzhin rgyal ba'i nyan thos kyis/ /sa phyogs gang dag bsnyen pa ni/ /de dag thub pas ④rtag tu bsngags/ /phyogs gzhan rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /lha khang kun dga' bzang po dang / /khyim dang yang thog nyams dga' dang / /mtshe'u ⑨dang skyed mos tshal mdzes dang / /mchod rten gra gang ba lang lhas/ /'bab chu 'dus pa'i mdo dag dang / / lha yi 0gnas rnams thams cad dang / /de bzhin khang pa stong par /rjeyang / /slob ma dag la phan 'dod phyir/ /nan tan du ni dkyil 'khor bri/ /yang na yid du 'ong ba'i sa/ /gang yang rung bar bri ⑫bar bya/ /gsang ba pa'i nyunyebadag po de la sa skogazhi 8yongs su spyad par ⑩bya ba ni/ rdo dang / bong ba dang / gyo mo dang / gsog ma med cing spa dang /phub ma dang / sol ba dang / thal ba dang / tsher ma dang / rus 7pa dang /sdong dum dang / zug rngu bsal ba/ grog sbur dang / srin bu dang / srog chags med cing nyes pa thams cad spangs pa'i gnas ni lha rnams la rab tu shis sos la/ /de la tshes grangs dang / rgyu skar dang / gza' dang / byed pa dang /yud tsam bzang po'i /namatshan ma dang ldan pa'i nyi ma la snga dro'i dus kyi tshe ltas bzang pos mtshon pa la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag byas te/ sa'i 86—459

lha mo la 0sbran pa'i tshigs su bcad pa gnyis bsgrag ②par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas skyob pa thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul gyi khyad par gyi②/ /sa dang pha rol phyin dag la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang ④du gyur/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis ⑤bdud las ni/ /rgyal bar bya ste ⑥dkyil 'khor bri/ /sa la lag pas reg byas shing / /de ltar lan mang sbran nas ni/ /pus mo gnyis ni sar ⑦btsugs nas/ /me tog spos kyis nimachod pa bya / /mchod nas sngags pas de nas ni/ /de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal te/ /de nas cho ga 'di dag gis/ /mkhas pas sa gzhi sbyang bar bya/ /de nas phyag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la gtugs te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /sangs rgyas mtshan ma mi mnga' ste/ /chos kyi sku la rnam par bzhugs/ /mtshan med 'dus ma byas pa yi/ /mtshungs pa med pa'i chos ston lhonyen/ /dpa' bo chen po ci slad du/ /mtshan mar bcas pa'i cho ga 'di/ /gsang sngags spyad pa 7bstan par mdzad/ /'di ni chos nyid tshul ma lags/ /de skad gsol nas bcom ldan 'das/ /rnam par snang mdzad chen po yis/ /de tshe phyag na rdo rje la/ /chos kyi mtshan nyid 'di nyon gsungs/ /chos ni rtog dang bral ba ste/ /kun rtog thams cad spangs phohepa yin/ /de la sems dang sems byung 7gi/ /rtog pa rab tu spong 1 bar 'gyur/ /nga 7yis chos mngon sangs rgyas pa/ /de ni mkha' las byung ba ste/ /log par rtog pa'i spyod yul ba / /byis pa rnams kyis mi shes so/ /yul dus mtshan ma la sogs pa/ /mun gyis bsgribs pa rnams 'dod de/ /de dag gzung bar bya ba'i phyir/ /cho ga 'di yang brjod pa yin/ /yul med dus kyang med pa ste/ /bya ba med cing byed 86—460

pa yang / /chos rnams kun la yong ①med de/ /chos rnams nyi tshe 'ba' ②zhig ②go/ /gsang ba'i bdag po 'on kyang ni0/ /sems can dag ni blo zhan cing / /bya ba tsam gyis rmongs pa dag /dngos po'i don la chags pa rnams/ /ma 'ongs dus na 'byung bar 'gyur/ /'di lta'i tshul ni mi shes pas/ /yul dang dus dang bya ba las/ /dge dang mi dge'i mtshan ma yis/ /rmongs pa 'bras bu 'dod byed de/ /sems dpa' chen po de dag phyir/ /cho ga 'di ni brjod pa yin/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de la ci skad bstan pa'i gnas gang yang rung bar sa gzhi rab tu 'thas par bcags te/ ba'i lci ba sa la ma lhung ba dang ba'i gcin du bsres ⑤pas byug go/ /de nas sngags 'dis bsang gtor byas te bsngags ⑥so/ /na maḥ sa manta bus rname/ a pra ti sa me/ ga ga na/ sa ma tā nu ga te/ pra kṛ ②ti/ bi shurnye/ dharma dhā tu bi 0sho dha ni byas hā/ de yi ⑪'og tu sngags pa ni/ /langs nas de yi tsodabus su nga ⑫/ /padma dkar po'i gdanasal bzhugs/ /thor tshugs dang ni dbu rgyan 'chang / /'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pas/ /kun nas yongs su bskor bar bsam/ /de nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bzhi/ /blo dang ldan pas phyogs su bsam/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen tog /nyi ma 'char ka 8lta bur bsam/ /lho ru rgyal ba dpa' bo ni/ /me tog kun rgyas zhes bya ba/ /gser gyi kha dog 'bar bar chabacas/ /nyes pa bcom pa ting 'dzin gnas/ /byang phyogs su ni ⑩mi 'khrugs pa/ /nad dang bral ba ting 'dzin gnas(nya/ /nub phyogs 'od dpag med pa ste/ /rgyal ba lnga po 'di rnams ni/ /bsams (17te de nas sngags pa yis/ /rgyal ba'i gnas dbus 'dug nas su ༄/ /mi g.yo bdag nyid chen po'am/ /yang na 'jig rten 86—461

gsum rgyal gyi/ /gsang sngags don kun sgrub ①pa yis/ /sa ni yongs su gzung ②bar bya/ /dbus su sridakyil 'khor bzang po dag /tsandan dag gis bya ba ni/ /dang po ④gcig ni nga yi yin/ /gnyis pa skyob pa thams cad kyi'o/ /gsum pa de dang ⑤mnyam bya ba/ /the tsom ⑥med par yum gyi yin/ /bzhi pa lag na padma'i ④ste/ /lnga pa phyag ⑧na rdo rje'i phyir/ /drug pa mi g.yo mgon gyi ⑨ste/ /ma zad 'og tu legs par bya/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams rjes dran nas/ /me tog spos la sogs phul te/ /mnyam par bzhag tshunas gus pa ru/ /tshig tu 'di skad smra bar bya/ /mgon po thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /sras bcas sang gi gdugs 'das nas/ /sa gzhi (2yongs su gzung 3nyab mdzod/ /de skad kyi ni tshig smras nas/ /gsang sngags 'di ni brjod par bya/ /na maḥs manta bus 747/ sabra (nyata thā ga tā dhiṣṭha nā dhiṣṭha tshete/ a tsa le/ bi ma le sma ra ṇi/ pra kṛ ti 7pa ri shudhe swā hā/de nas sngags pa langs nas su/ /snying rjer gyur pa'i yid kyis ni/ /nub kyi phyogs su gnas 1nyanas su/ /nang gi bdag nyid rnam dag pas/ /byang chub sems ni sems byed cing / /de nyid du ni nyal bar bya(/(/ /de nas sngags parus rmi lam blta/ /byang chub sems dpa' grags chen nam/ /yang na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /sems can rnams la phan bya'i sa )phyir/ /dkyil 'khor bri ba'i las rnams la/ /bdag nyid kun sa1rtsol 'bad pa'am/ /bdag nyid la ni 'di skad du/ /sems can chen po bu khyod legs/ /dkyil 'khor myur du bris shig ces/ /spro ba bskyed dzo snyepa mthong yang ri rung / /de nas de yi phyi de nyin/ /slob ma dad cing rigs btsun pa/ /de bzhin dkon mchog gsum la dad/ /86—462

zab mo yi ni blo dang ldan/ /spro ba che zhing tshul khrims ldan/ /bzod dang ldan zhing ser sna med/ /dpa' la yi ①dam brtan pa ni/ /bcu'am brgyad dam bdun nam lnga/ /gcig gnyis bzhi las lhag kyang rung / /dpyad mi dgos par gzung ②bar bya/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das la phyag na rdo rjes zhus pa/bcom ldan 'das dkyil 'khor 'di'i ming ci lags/ ci'i slad du dkyil 'khor zhes bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po dkyil 'khor 'di ni sangs rgyas 'byung ba ste/ dkyil ③ni snying po zhes bya'o/ /'khor ni rdzogs pa ④ste/ de'i gong na snying por gyur pa gzhan med pas/ de bas ⑤na dkyil 'khor zhes bya'o/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po 'on kyang dkyil 'khor rgyas pa 'di ni/ sems can gyi khams ma nges pa yongs su bskyab pa'i phyir snying rje chen po'i snying yipo 'byung ba zhes bya ste/ de stini de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bskal pa grangs med par bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub yang dag par bsgrubs pa byin gyis brlabs so/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de lta bas na ⑧rnam grangs 'dis kyang khyod kyis 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ni sems can gcig gi poraphyir byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba ma yin/ gnyis kyi phyir ma yin/ gsum gyi phyir ma yin/ 'on kyang thugs rje chen po'i dbang du gyur pa dag sems can gyi khams ma lus pa yongs su bskyab pa'i phyir byang chub tu tsomangon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ste/ de dag gis sems can gyi khams rnam pa du ma la bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du/ sems can rnams la chos 'chad par rig par bya'o/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po theg pa chen po la goms par ma byas pa rnams ni gsang sngags spyod 17pa'i tshul mthong ngam thos na 86—463

sems la ①dga' ba'am/ dang ba ④cung zad kyang yang dag par mi skye yi③/gsang ba pa'i bdag po gang dag gis sngon theg pa chen po gsang sngags spyad pa'i dutshul sgo mtha' yas sgrub ⑤pa la goms par byas pa de dag ni rdo rje sems dpa' yin te/ de rnams nyid kyi don gyi phyir grangs kyi tshad ⑥'di byas so/ /'on kyang slob dpon snying rje chen po dang ldan pas sems can gyi khams ma lus pa bsgral bar yi dam bca' ba kho nar bya ste/ des byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyur 'gyur bar bya ba'i phyir sems can tshad med pa rnams yongs su gzung ⑦bar bya'o / /de nas de dag bos la gsum la skyabs su gtang ⑧bar yang bya'o/ /sdig pa mi bya ba ⑨rnams kyang bsgo bar bya'o/ /de nas de dag la spos dang me tog la sogs pa sbyin no/ /de dag dus gsum du sgrib pa med pa'i ye shes kyi sdom pa yang 'dzin du gzhug go/ /'dzin du bcug nas sngags pa yis de nas so shing dag kyang sbyin/ /rtse gcig mnyam par bzhag ⑩pa dag /shar ram byang du kha bstan 17te/ /u dum bā char a shwatthasanya/ /shin tu bzang po bsrung ⑫byas shing / /me tog dri la sogs bskus pa'i/ /so shing dag ni 'char gzhug go /sems can snod rung snod mi rung / /bor ba nyid las brtag par bya/ ju /de nas lag pa g.yon pa la/ /skud pa mdud pa gsum ldan pa/ /bdag nyid mnyam par bzhag 7pa yis/ /legs pa ru ni bcing bar bya/ /de ltar yongs su gzung 7ldan pa'i/ /slob ma nyes pa med rnams la/ /bsam pa brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ /'di ltar spro ba bskyed par bya/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyisal/ /rnyed pa mnyam med de 1 1ring rnyed/ /gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa/ /bdag nyid chen po kun gyis ni/ /bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun/ /yongs 86wa 464

su gzung ①ste skye bzhin pa/ /de phyir khyed rnams theg chen la/ /sang ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur/ /gal te rmi lam dag tu ni/ /gtsug lag khang dang kun dga' bzang ske/ /khang pa bzang po sna tshogs dang / /de bzhin du ni yang thog dang / /ral gri yid bzhin nor bu dang / /gdugs dang me tog sna tshogs dang / /bud med bzang mo gos dkar can/ /sdug pa'i gnyen dang bu dag dang / /glegs bam de bzhin bram ze dang / /sangs rgyas dang ni rang sangs rgyas/ /de bzhin rgyal ba'i nyan thos dang / /byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che/ /gal te 'bras bu thob pa dang / /mtsho dang rgya mtsho las rgal ②mthong / /de bzhin du ni nam mkha' las/ /bkra shis yid du 'ong ba'i tshig /'dod pa'i 'bras bu 'byung bar ①grag /de la sogs pa'i rmi lam ni/ /bzang po zhes ni bya bar brtag /mkhas pas de las bzlog pa yibya/ /mi lam ngan par shes par bya/ /brtul zhugs bzang po khyod ⑤rnams kyis/ /nang par thams cad nga yil zlos/ /slob ma de dag rnams la ni/ /de skad bsgo ⑦nas chos kyang bshad/ /theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ /khyed rnams der ni dong bas na/ /rang byung skal ba chen po pa/ /'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams su 'gyur/ /yod dang med las rnam par 'das/ /nam mkha' bzhin du dri ma med/ /zab mo rtog ge (7thams cad kyis/ /rab tu mi rtogs gnas med pa/ /spros pa kun dang bral ba ste/ /spros pa rnams kyis ⑨rnam par spros/ /las dang bya ba la sogs bral/ /bden pa gnyis la boganas pa yi/ste/ /theg pa rab kyi mchog 'di ni/ /tshul la gnas na thob par 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la rdo rje 'dzin spros pa med par ⑫86—465

gnas pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dus gsum du sgrib pa ma mchis pa'i ye shes kyi sdom pa gang la byang chub sems dpa' rnams gnas na sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams mnyes par 'gyur ba bshad du gsol / de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis rdo rje 'dzin spros pa med par gnas pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu lus dang /ngag dang / yid gcig tu 'jug cing chos thams cad la rtsom pa med cing bya ba med pa'i sdom pa gang yin pa de rigs kyi bu nyon cig /de yang gang zhe na/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la bdag gi lus yongs su gtong ba gang yin pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gang gis bdag gis lus yongs su gtong ①ba des ni dngos po gsum yongs su btang ba yin te/ dngos po gsum yongs su btang ②ba de yang gang ①zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ lus dang / ngag dang /yid do/ /rigs kyi bu de lta bas na byang chub sems dpas ④lus dang ngag dang yid gsum gyi sdom pas 97bsdam par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni lus dang ngag dang yid (6)yongs su ma btang ⑦bar bslab pa 'dzin par mi byed do/ /de nas phyi de nyin (2)bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad la phyag byas te/ bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpar byin gyis brlabs la bum pa spos chus bkang ba la 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal bas mngon par bsngags te sgo dang por bzhag 99)la mkhas pas skye bo kun la des bsang bogator bya'o / /de nas sems sbyang ba'i phyir spos chu gtsang ma blud do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la phyag na rdo 11rjes 'di skad ces gsol to/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni slob dpon dag /gsang sngags sgrub la 'bad pa na/ /gang gi nya dus su dkyil 86wa 466

'khor dul/ /sems dpa' chen po byin rlob pa'i/ /dus dang tshod ②ni kun mkhyen pa/ /smra ba'i mchog gis bka' 465 cig /de skad gsol nas bcom ldan ②gyis/ /rdo rje du'adzin la bka' stsal pa/ /dkyil 'khor don du ⑤gnyer ba la/ /rtag tu mtshan mo bre khyabar bya// // bam po gnyis pa/⑦ lag na rdo rje de ⑧slob dpon gyis 0sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag byas la tshon sna tshogs 7srad bu thogs te/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad du byin gyis brlabs la/ shar du srad bu bre ⑩ba ni/ /lte ba'i thad kur bzung nas su7/ /bar snang la ni gzung 8bar bya/ /de nas lho phyogs song nas su/ /byang phyogs su ni bre 8bar bya/ /de nas srad bu gnyis pa ni/ /rang gis blangs nas de nyid du/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rjes dran cing ⑫/ /shar phyogs bltas te bre ⑩bar bya/ /de nas lho phyogs song nas ni/ /byang phyogs su ni bre 0bar bya/ /blo can 8de nas slar yilog nas/ /bden bral phyogs su gnas nas ni/ /byang phyogs su ni bre zhu )bar bya/ /de nas g.yas su bsgyur bar bya/ /bsgyur te de ru 'dug nas ni tī/ /lho phyogs su ni bre ru bar bya//de nas gnas de 9 nyabatang nas su/ /me yi phyogs su gnas nas ni/ /sngags pas chagasang sngags cho gar gnas/ /shar du srad bu bre zhugebar bya/ /de nas de bzhin dbang ldan phyogs/ /song nas nub tu kha bltas te/ /rlung gi phyogs kyi bar du ni/ /byang phyogs su ni bre ( 9bar bya/ /sngags pa yis ni de lta bur/ /kun nas gru bzhi lham par bya/ /de nas dbus su zhugs nas su/ /de la cha ( sheni gsum du brtagaci /sa gernams zhu skuthams cad kun tu yang / /cha gsum dag tu brtags nas so ni/ /cha rnams kyang ni re re la/ /cha gsum du ni rab tu 86wa 467

brtag① /cha gcig cig ②ni bskor ba yi/ /'khor bar ③byas te lhag ma yi/ /cha gnyis po ni lha nyid kyi/ /gnas su nges par bya ba yin/ /blo dang ldan pas phyogs bzhi ru/ /so so'i phyogs char sgo khyud ni/ /sdom brtson can gyis dunan tan du/ /lha rnams gtso bo'i gnas su bya/ /de ltar rim pas ②legs phye ba/ /'di dag thams cad byas nas ni/ /dbus su padma dkar po mchog /de ni snying po zhes su bsgrags/ /dkyil 'khor snying po du'abyung ba kun/ /des ni snying po can du byas/ /de yi tshad kyang sor bcu drug /yan chad du ni bshad pa yin/ /'dab ma brgyad pa legs par rdzogs/ /ze bar ldan pa ༅shin tu bzang / /'dab ma'i bar ni ༷thams cad du/ /kun nas rdo rje bri bar bya/ /de yi snying po'i dbus su ni/ /rgyal mchog gtso bo gser gyi mdog /'bar bcas thor tshugs dbu rgyan can/ /'od zer dag gis kun nas bskor/ /mgon po nad dang bral ba ni/ /ting nge 'dzin du gnas par bri/ /de yi shar du blo ldan gyis/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi phyag rgya ni/ /gru gsum thams cad thal kur yi)nyid/ /padma'i steng na khor 7yug tu/ /'od zer dkar pos yongs bskor ba/ /rab tu bsgrims hunyete bri bar bya/ / de yi 8byang du mkhas rnams kyis/ /skyob pa dag ni kun gyi yum/ /gser gyi mdog can 'bar dang bcas/ /na bza' dag ni dkar po mnabs6nya/ /kun tu rnam par snang mdzad pa/ /ting nge 'dzin du gnas par bri/ /mgon po yi ni 8byang phyogs su/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang dpa' bo ni/ /padma dkar po'i stan la 'dug /dung dang kunda zla ba 'dra/ /dbu la 'od dpag med bzhugs pa/ci /bzhin ni bag tsam 'dzum pa 7bri/ /de yi g.yas su lha mo ni/ /sgrol ma grags pa chen mo de/ /dge zhing 86—468

'jigs pa sel ba ste/ /sngo bsangs mo la sna tshogs gzugs/ /bud med dar la bab pa'i tshad/ /thal sbyar me tog utpal thogs/ /'od zer dag gis ①kun bskor ②cing / /gos ni dkar po gyon par bri/ /g.yon du lha mo khro gnyer can//sngags de'i chaphreng ba lag na 'chang rjo/ /mig gsum pa la thor tshugs can/ /kha dog mdog ni dkar mo ⑤la/ /'od zer dkar po ser po dang / /dmar po rnams kyis bskor bar bri/ /khro gnyer can dang nye bar ni/ /mthu chen lag na padma thogs/ /brtse ba chen po gos dkar gyon/ /'od zer dag gis bskor ba yiyi / /dpa' bo yang dag bri bya stetshu/ /de yi padma kha ma byeni/ / de yi ⑨drung du blo can gyis/ /rig sngags lha mo grags ldan mtshu/ /gser gyi kha dog lta bu can/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa ste/ /lag pa g.yon pas pri yiyang ku'i8//snye ma yid 'ong 'dzin par bri/ /sgrol ma yi ni nye 'khor du/ /blo dang ldan pas gos dkar mo/ /thor tshugs can la gos dkar gyon/ /lag na padma thogs par bri/ / de yi ma'og tu sngags pa yis/ /rig 8sngags rgyal po stobs po che/ /kha dog nyi ma 'char ka bzhin/ /padma dkar pos 8rnam par brgyan0/ /'bar ba'i phreng can mi bzad cing / /spu dag seng ge ltar 'dug ⑩pa/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang blo ldan gyi/ /rta mgrin can zhes grags pa bri/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi lho phyogs su/ /byang chub sems dpa' skyob rnams kyi/ /phyag rgya yid bzhin nor bu zhes/ /grags pa skal ba chen po can/ /re ba thams cad rdzogs byed pa/ /padma dkar la 'dug par bri/ /mgon po rnam snang mdzad chen gyi/ /lho yi phyogs su rdo rje 'dzin/ /re ba thams cad skong byed pa/ /mdog ni pri yang ku 9/nyelta bu'o/smu/ /ljang ser ram ni margad ltar/ /sngo bsangs mgon po dbu 86wa 469

rgyan can/ /sems dpa' chen po rgyan kun gyis/ /rnam par brgyan 6)cing mtha' yas par/ /'jug pa rgya chen rdo rjer ②bcas/ /'od zer dag gis bskor bar bri/ /de yi g.yas su lha mo'i ming / /mā ma tī zhes bya ba de/ /rdo rje'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa ste/ /lag na rdo rje thogs pa ③bri/ /de yi 'og tu lha mo ni / /rdo rje ⑨rtse mo stobs chen dephyi/ /pho nya rnams kyis stimongs bskor cing / /bzhin ni bag tsam 'dzum par bri/ /g.yon rol du ni sngags pa yis/ /rdo rje lu gu rgyud ces pa/ /lag na rdo rje lu gu rgyud/ /rang gi pho nya rnams kyis bskor/ /pri yang ku ltar ljang ser mdog /rdo rje'i mtshan mas legs mtshan bri/ /lag na rdo rje'i 'og logs su/ /khro zla gtso bo zhes bya ba/ /bgegs chen dgra ni zhi byed pa/ /khro bo 'jig rten gsum du grags/ /mig gsum mche ba bzhi pa ste/ /kha dog dbyar gyi char sprin 'dra/ /rab tu rgod pa'i sgra yang 'byin/ /rdo rje'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /'khor ni mtha' yas khro bo yi(pe/ /dbang phyug rnams kyis yongs bskor ba/ /lag pa stong phrag brgya dag ni/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs shing gdengs6)/ /khro bo chen po 'di 'dra ba/ /padma'i steng na 'dug par bri/ / de yi ྅nub tu song nas ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa mang po dag⑩ci /lag na mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs/ /kha dog sna tshogs stobs po che/ /'od zer dag gis yongs bskor ba/ /sems can kun don byed par 3)bri/ /gsang sngags mgon po'i 'og logs rmo su/ /bden bral gyi ni phyogs kyi char/ /mi g.yo zhes bya lag na ni/ /ral gri zhags pa legs par thogs/ /zur phud spyi bo'i mispyogayon du 'phyang / /rab tu brgyan 7cing mig gcig yo/ /rang gi 'od kyi nang na gnas/ /khro dang bcas pas 7brag la 'dug /bzhin ni khro gnyer rab tu 86wa 470

bsnyer①/ /byis pa'i gzugs can mkhrang bag can②/ /bris nas blo ldan rlung phyogs su/ /song nas bcom ldan 'das kyi ni/ /khro bo 'jig rten gsum las rgyal / /'bar ba'i phreng can mi bzad ①pa/ /lag na rdo rje rtse bran rgyanadu/ /bka' lung nod pa ltar 'dug cing / /zad pa'i dus dang 'drar gnas pa/ /nan tan du ni ②bri bar bya/ /de ltar nang du bri ba ni/ /rgyas dudang bcas par bshad pa yin⑦/ /de nas sngags pa phyir byung nas/ /nges par gnyis pa'i cha dag la/ /shar gyi phyogs kyi nang du ni/ /cha ni gnyis su phye ba la/ /sgo khyud kyi ni nang rol du/ /sngags pas rgyal ba shākya thub/ /gser gyi kha dog 'bar dang bcas / /mtshan mchog sum cu durtsa gnyis ldan/ /mgon po na bza' ngur smrig mnabasasti/ /khyab bdag bstan pa'i don mdzad pa/ /padma dkar po'i stan la bzhugs / /chos 'chad tshul du bzhugs par bri/ /de yi g.yas su lha mo ni/ /sangs rgyas spyan zhes bya ba ste/ /lha mo cung zad 'dzum pa'i zhal/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor 'dom gang ba/ /mtshungs med sku ni rab tu dang yi / /de ni shākya thub pa'i yum/ /de yi g.yas su lha mo ni/ /rig (1sngags mdzod spu zhes grags pa / /padma'i steng na 'dug pa ste/ /dung zla kunda lta bu'i mdog /lag na yid bzhin nor bu thogs/ /re ba kun rdzogs byed pa bri/ /de nas sngags pas g.yon rol du/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yi/ /gtsug tor gzi can brtson 'grus che / /gdugs dkar po dang rgyal ba'i gtsug /gtsug tor rnam par rgyal enyid dang / /gzi brjid phung po skal chen dang / /rnam par 'thor hu zhes rnam grags pa/ /lnga po yang dag bri bar bya/ /shākya tog sani mthu chen gyi/ /gtsug tor lnga po 'di dag ni/ /gnas ni 'olnga rnams nyid du ni/ /rab tu bsgrims te 86wa 471

bri bar bya/ /de yi byang du song nas su/ /gnas gtsang rnams ni bri bar bya/ /dbang phyug kun tu me tog dang / /'od kyi phreng ba nyid dang ni/ /yid mgyogs dang ni rnam grags ①te/ /de dag thams cad legs par bri/ /mdzod spu yi ②ni g.yas logs su/ /gtsug tor chen po cher 'byung dang ni/ /de bzhin gyen rjodu 'byung nyid dang / /sgra dbyangs mtha' yas pa yang ste/ /gtsug tor gsum po kho na ni/ /bsgrims te yang dag bri bar bya/ /gtsug tor lnga po stobs chen ⑤rnams/ /dkar po ser skya ser por bya/rjo /gsum po gzhan ni medakar po dang ske/ /ser po dang ni dmar por nibya/ /kun kyang 'od zer mang po can/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa yikhya/ /de dag smon lam stobs chen de/ /re ba thams cad rdzogs byed pa'o/ /de nas sngags pas me phyogs su/ /me ni drang srong che rnams dang / /bcas shing me yi nang na 'dug /thal ba'i sor 7ris gsum gyis mtshan/ /dpa' bo thams cad rab tu dmar/ /snying ga 7sum mdo ris mtshan cing ⑫/ /me lce 'bar ba'i dbus na 'dug /bgrang phreng gunde ⑫thogs par bri/ /de nas lho yi 7phyogs kyi char/ /gshin rje'i chagatso bo lag pa na/ /dbyug pa thogs shing ma he zhon/ /kha dog dbyar gyi char sprin 'dra/ ci/ma mo rnams dang dus mtshan dang / /'chi bdag rnams kyis bskor bar bri/ /bden bral phyogs su bden bral ni/ /lag na ral gri 'jigs 7pa bri/ /de nas kyang ni blo ldan pa/ /myur du byang gi phyogs song ste/ / lha yi borgyal po ri rab la/ /'dug cing lha rnams kyis bskor ba/ /lag na rdo rje cod pan can/ /rgyan kun gyis ni lhonyebargyan par bri/ /de nas de yī shar du ni/ /chu lha lag na zhags thogs bri/ /de yi yang ni shar phyogs su/ /nyi ma shing rta'i steng 'dug 86—472

bri/ / de yi ①g.yas dang g.yon du ni/ /rgyal dang rnam par rgyal ba bri/ /de yi g.yas su tshangs pa ni/ /gdong bzhi pa la thor tshugs can/ /oṃ zhes bya ba lhur len pa/ / ngang pa ② padma'i steng du'adug bribya/ /de yi nub tu bri ba ni/ /sa yi lha dang dbyangs can dang / /khyab 'jug skem ⑤byed de bzhin rlung / /bde byed de bzhin zla ba ste/ /nub kyi ༅phyogs su ⑦gnas nas ni/ /rab tu nan tan byas te nizi/ /bris nas sngags pas de nas ni/ /yid la 'khrul pa med pa ru/ /gsang sngags mgon po'i 'og logs su/ /khro chen gzhan gyis mi thub ces/ /bya ba nyid dang lha mo ni/ /gzhan gyis mi thub ma dang ni/ /sa bdag lag na bum pa thogs/ /gus par yang dag gnas par bri/ /klu chen dga' bo bsnyen dga' dag /shākya seng ge skyob pa yi/ /sgo drung gnyis su mngon phyogs par/ /rab tu bsgrims te bri bar bya/ /gzhan yang shākya thub pa yil/ /rgyud rnams kun las dkyil 'khor du/ /sngags dang phyag rgya ⑩gang bshad pa/ /de dag kyang ni mkhas pas bri/ /sngags pa de nas phyir byung nas/ /cha gsum pa ni nges pa la/ /rdo rje dam pa sbyin pa ni/ /gur gum lta bu'i mdog can te7/ /spyi bo 8thur phud lnga dang ldan/ /byis pa gzhon nu'i gzugs can la/ /utpal sngon po rdo rje can/ /lag pa g.yon na thogs pa ste/ /padma dkar po'i stan la 'dug /rab tu 'dzum pa'i /༄bzhin du gnas/ /'od zer mtshan nyid bzang po yis/ /kun tu 'khor bar sngags pas bri/ /de yi byang du gzhon nu ni/ /dra ba'i 'od can lag pa na/ /rin chen dra ba thogs pa ste/ /sna tshogs pa yi rgyan gyis brgyan/ /padma dmar po'i stan spul 'dug /rgyal ba'i sras la blta ba 7bri/ /rdo rje dam pa sbyin pa yi/ /g.yon du pho nya mo lnga ②bri/ /86—473

spa can dang ni nye skra can/ /sna tshogs ma dang nor can ma/ /de bzhin 'gugs ①ma zhes bya ba/ /'di dag blo ldan pho nya mo'o②/ /de dag gi ni 'og ②zad du/ /phyag brnyan ma ni lnga rnams dang / /gzhon nu dra ba'i 'od can gyi/ /'khor gnyis po yang bri bar bya/ /de nas sngags pas lho phyogs su/ /byang chub sems dpa' grags chen po/ /sgrib pa thams cad rnam sel gtso/ /yid bzhin nor bu thogs pa (7bri/ /de yi cha gnyis bor nas ni/ /dpa' bo ngo mtshar can dang ni / /sems can kun la mi 'jigs sbyin/ /ngan song thams cad spong ba dang //de bzhin skyong sems blo gros dang / /blo can snying rjes gdungs pa dang / /byams pa mngon ⑤du 'byung ba dang / /gdung ba thams cad zhi byed dang / /de bzhin blo gros bsam yas te/ /mkhas pas (5)brgyad po bri bar bya/ /byang gi phyogs su song nas ni/ /sa yi snying po 'bar dang bcas/ /bzod dang des pa phun tshogs bri/ /de yi stan ni mkhas pa yis/ /'byung khungs ⑦kun dang ldan pa yis/ /rin chen kun gyis (lde)nyer brgyan po pa/ /de yi steng na rin chen bzhi'i / /padma yang dag gnas pa ni⑩/ /yid du 'ong ba bsam bya ste/ /byang chub sems dpa' grags chen po/ /de yi steng na 'dug par bri/ /de yi 'khor ni yon tan gtsonaste/ /mtha' yas shin tu grangs med den / /de yi nang na 3stebyang chub sems/ /rin chen 'byung gnas rin chen lag /sa 'dzin nyid dang lag na 0ni/ /rin chen phyag rgya can dang ni/ /lhag pa'i bsam pa brtan pa nyid/ /grags chen 'di dag bri bar bya/ /de bzhin sngags pas nub phyogs su/ /dpa' bo nam mkha'i snying po ni/ /gzi brjid chen po gos dkar gyon/ /lag na ral gri thogs bsam steng/ /rgyal sras padma'i stan steng na/ /legs par 86—474

'dug par ②bri bar ②bya/ /bdag nyid chen po de'i ②'khor du/ /grags pa dag kyang bri bar bya༅/ /de'i ⑤'khor dpa' bo chen po ni/ /nam mkha' dri med blo gros mkha'acha/ /blo gros rnam dag nyid dang ni/ /spyod pa yi ni blo gros dang / /blo brtan pa zhes bya ba ste/ /de dag rab tu ⑦bsgrim 2bri zhing / /rtag tu dpa' bo 'di rnams dang / /lhan cig go rims spubazhin du bsam/ /de nas gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag man rdo rjes thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor rnams la bltas nas/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad (/spel ring zhig tu tsomig mi 'dzums 8par bltas te④/ ched du gleng 8pa 'di gleng zhing tshig tu smras pa/'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams/ / u dum bā tsora'i me tog bzhin/ /brgya ⑩lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo / /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /bskal pa bye ba du ma tsoru/ /sdig pa bgyis nyu par gyur pa gang / /de kun dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra ba/ /mthong bas byang bar 'gyur lags na/ /grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod du )pa'i/ /tshul la gnas na smos ci 'tshal ma/ /skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni/ /go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur/ /gang dag spyod ru pa mchog 'di la/ /blo gros shin tu mi g.yo ba/ /de dag gis ni ngan 'gro'i rgyun/ /sdug bsngal kun 'byung rab tu bcad ge/ /de'i tshe thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dag dang / rdo rje 'dzin de dag gis mgrin gcig tu mthun par zhud tshig smras pa/gsang sngags spyod 2pa'i dbang gyur pa/ /dpa' bo chen po legs so legs/ /khyod kyi yid la gang bsam na pa/ /mnyam med thams cad mkhyen la zhus/ /sngags rgyud rtogs par shes pa yi / /byang chub sems dpa' gzhan rnams 86—475

dang ske/ /sngags ①sbyad 'bras bu la gnas pa/ /bdag cag thams cad dbang du gyur / /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das la phyag na rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsol to//tshon ②zhes bgyi ba de gang lags/ /ci slad 'di ③ni tshon zhes bgyi/ /tshon ni ji ltar dgye bar bgyi/ /gang zhig thog mar gtang ④bar bgyi/ /rta babs rnams dang de bzhin du/ /sgo khyud rnams kyi tshad dang ni/ /sgo yi tshad kyang ci 'drar bgyi/ /mgon po yis ni bshad du gsol/ /lha bshos me tog byug ⑤spros dang ske/ /bum pa rnams kyang rgyas par gsungs/ /slob ma ci ltar gzud pa ⑥dang / /de ni ci ltar dbang bskur dang / /bla ma la ni yon dbul ⑦dang / /sbyin sreg chaganas kyang bdag la gsungs/ /gsang sngags mtshan nyid ci 'dra lags/ /ting nge 'dzin du bzhed pa gang / /de skad gsol nas bcom ldan 'das/ /chos kun dbang phyug thub pa yis/ /rdo rje 'dzin la 'di skad gsungs / /yid gcig 7tu ni tshur nyon cig /theg chen 'bras bu 'byung ba yi//gsang sngags spyod 7pa'i tshul gyi mchog /sems dpa' chen po khyod kyis ni/ /gang dag dris pa bshad par bya/ /sems can khams ni zhen byed cing / /'di ni chos dbyings ro yin par/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis sngon gsungs te/ /de phyir 'di ni tshon zhes bya/ /tshon ni nang nas dgye bar bya/ /phyi rol nas ni tshon mi dgye/ /dkar po thog mar gtang phonyabar bya/ /de yi 'og tu dmar po ste//de nas ser po gtang 8bar bya/ /de yi 'og tu ljang gu gtang lhonya/ /kun gyi nang rol nag po ste/ /tshon gyi cho ga de ltar bshad/ /rta babs rnams kyi tshad kyang ni / /dkyil 'khor dbu ma dang mnyam mo/ /sgo khyud dag kyang de dang mnyam/ /padma sor ni labacu drug skabashad/ /dang po'i sgo ni snying po yi/ /dkyil 'khor 86—476

dang ni mnyam zhes bya/ /'jigs med dag gi ①rim gyis ni/ /bskyed de de las lhag ⑤shes bya/ /sgo rnams kyi ni bar bar du/ /sgo srung ②rnams ni gzhag dupar bya/ /ting nge 'dzin ni mdor na sems/ /yang dag mgu ba yin par bshad/ /sems dpa' chen po khyad par ni/ /yid gcig bsdus la mnyan par gyis⑤/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ting 'dzin ni/ /stong pa nyid ces rgyal bas gsungs/ /de ni ⑥sems yongs shes pa las༅/ /thob par 'gyur gyi gzhan las min/ /de dag nyid ni spangs pa ste/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi yin par 'dod/ /stong pa chen po zhes bya ste/ /kun mkhyen ye shes rdzogs byed pa'o/ /de bas rnam pa thams cad du/ /stong nyid rtag tu dran par bya'o(she/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad sangs rgyas thams cad dang thabs cig ⑨tu yang dag par mol tshunas/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas 4stedang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ting nge 8'dzin so so'i tshul du 8gsungs so/ /de'i tshe yang sangs rgyas thams cad dang rgyud gcig pa'i stobs kyi shugs zhes 8bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/ byang chub snying por 'dug nas su/ /bdud ni rnam pa bzhi bcom pas/ /de nas dpa' bo chen po zhes/ /tshangs tsol chasogs pa nyu lha tshogs rnams/ /'jigs pa thams cad med pa'i sgra/ /dga' bzhin du ni sgrogs rtso par byed/ /de phyin cad nyu)ni nga dpa' ( pe bo/ /dpa' bo chen po zhes su grags/ /skye ba med pa ( lhangs rtogs pa/ /tshig gi spyod yul rnams tsho )spangs shing / /nyes pa thams cad med pa ste/ /rgyu rdo chedang rkyen dang bral ba yin/ /stong pa'i ye shes mkha' 'dra ba/ /mun pa kun dang 86—477

bral gyur cing / /shin tu dri med de kho na/ /ci ltar 'byung ba nga ①las byung / /kun mkhyen tsam gyi tshul du gnas/ /kun mkhyen sangs rgyas mtshan nyid do/ /nga yi de nyid dam pa 'di/ /'jig rten snang bar ②byed pa ste/ /byin gyis brlabs (༷kyi stobs kyis ni/ /yig 'bru rnams su bstan nas su/ /sems can rnams la snying brtse'i phyir/ /ngas ni thams cad rab tu bshad/ /de nas dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ /ngo mtshar ④gyur nas mig gdangs te/ /thams cad mkhyen la mgo bo yis/ /phyag 'tshal nas ni tshig 'di smras/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thabs dang ni/ /shes rab bsam yas ngo mtshar che/ /spros pa kun dang bral ba yi75/ /chos rtogs nas ni rang byung rnams/ /'jig rten kun gyi re ba kun/ /yongs su rdzogs par byed pa ston76)/ /gsang sngags mtshan nyid de lta bu/ /bden pa gnyis la legs gnas pa/ /sems can kun gyis shes na (peni/ /'jig rten kun gyi 9shesamachod gnas 'gyur/ /de nas gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes tshigs su bcad pa de dag gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad la mig mi 'dzums 99)pa'i lta lho bas bltas nas cang mi smra bar 'dug go / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' skye ba gcig gis thogs pa 31sangs rgyas kyi sa la nyusnyeganas pa rnams kyi rtsonyeting nge 'dzin gyi tshul ni/ dogs sapa dang ni bral ba ru/ /'jig rten mtshan nyid shes nas ni/ /dgos pa'i sa la gnas de rnams/ /sangs rgyas sa la gnas pa yin / /gsang ba pa'i bdag po gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sa brgyad pa'i dbang phyug rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi tshul ni/ chos rnams thams cad mi 86—478
