dmigs ①shing / /srid dang skye ba rnam ②spangs pa'i/ /'jig rten sgyu ma ltar shes nas/ /'jig rten 'jig rten dbang du 'dod/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po gzhan yang nyan thos dmigs pa dang bcas pa'i sa la gnas pa rnams skye ba dang 'jig par rtogs nas/ mtha' gnyis bshig pas rgyu mi dmigs pa'i phyir shin tu dngos po ②med pa'i ye shes mi spyod de/ 'di ni nyan thos rnams kyi ting nge ④'dzin gyi tshul lo8/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po rang sangs rgyas rgyu dang 'bras bu rnam par bshig nas brjod du med pa'i chos kyi 0tshul la gnas pa rnams ni chos thams cad brjod du med do snyam pa'i ye shes 'jug ste/ ngag shin tu 'gog pa'i ting nge 'dzin la yang dag par rig (3)par byed pa 'di ni rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi tshul lo/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po gzhan yang 'jig rten pa ༅rnams rgyu las 'bras bu dang / las las 'byung ba'am ldog par rtog cing rigegazhan gyi dbang gis stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin kun tu skye bar 'gyur te/'di ni 'jig rten pa rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi tshul lo/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po / 'di ni ting nge 'dzin gyi tshul/ /yin te de la gnas pa yitshe/ /sangs rgyas dang ni rang sangs rgyas/ /byang chub sems dpa' skyob rnams dang / /nyan thos des pa sdig bcom par/ /grags pa gang dag yin pa dang / /'jig rten pa yi /1lha gang yin/ /gsang sngags spyad pa'i cho ga'i tshul/ /sems can rnams la phan 'dod pas/ /dpa' bo de tshe 'chad par 57byed/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/gsang ba pa'i bdag po gsang sngags rnams kyi gsang sngags kyi nyugematshan nyid nyon cig /bcom ldan 'das de ltar 'tshal lo zhes gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das 86—479

la nyan pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di skad ces bka' stsal to①/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de la/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gsang sngags ni/ /tshig dang ming dang brda ②yis mtshan/ /tshig de dbang du gyur pas na/ /gsang sngags don ②rnams thams cad sgrub/ /kha cig skul ④ba'i tshig dang ldan/ /kha cig rang ming thog mar smos/ /hūṃ dang phaṭa dang ldan pa ni/ /gtsug tor rnams kyi yin par bsgrags/ / zung zo choms 0shig ces pa dang / /snun ⑥sod drol cig ces pa ⑦ni/ /phyag brnyan ⑧rnams dang khro bo yi/ /gsang sngags yin par 'dren pas gsungs/ /na maḥswā hā la sogs ldan/ /ting nge 'dzin ni rtogs pas mtshan/ /zhi ba'i yi ge rnam par dag /re 6)ba thams cad rdzogs byed pa'i/ /gsang sngags sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /byang chub sems dpa' skyob pa'i yin/ /nyan thos rnams kyi gsang sngags ni/ /gcig po gzhi ⑩ni gcig la gnas/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi'ang de bzhin te/ /khyad par dag ni bshad bya na3lha/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par las/ /las 7tshe rnam par sbyang 'ostezhes bya/ /gsang ba pa'i 7bdag po gzhan yang gsang sngags rnams kyi mtshan nyid ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad 8kyis ma byas/ byed du ma bcug /rjes su yi rang ba ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ni chos rnams kyi chos nyid de/'di boltar de bzhin gshegs pa rnams byung yang rung / ma byung yang rung /chos rnams kyi chos nyid de ni ye nas gnas pa ste/ de yang 'di ltar gsang sngags rnams kyi gsang sngags kyi chos nyid do/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de la gang 7gi tshe yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad mkhyen pa/ thams cad gzigs pa 'jig rten du byung ba de'i tshe/ chos nyid de tshul sna tshogs dang 86—480

dgongs pa sna tshogs kyis/ sems can bsam pa sna tshogs pa rnams la tshig sna tshogs pa rnams ①yig 'bru sna tshogs dang / yul gyi nges pa'i tshig tu brjod pa sna tshogs dang / dbyangs sna tshogs su go ba rnams su byin gyis brlabs te/gsang sngags kyi ②tshul 'chad do/ /ci ltar na de bzhin gshegs pa rnams gsang sngags kyi tshul yig 'bru dag tu byin gyis rlob ce na/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po de la de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis ②bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mar yang dag par bsgrubs pa'i bden pa'i tshig gang yin pa dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag ④pa bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rin po che bdun dang / tshangs pa'i gnas pa ⑤bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa stibargyad gang dag yin pa dang / gsang ba pa'i bdag po mdor na de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes gang yin pa de thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa rnams nyid ⑦kyi bsod nams dang / ye shes kyi stobs dang / sngon gyi smon lam mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / chos kyi dbyings kyi byin gyi rlabs (shekyi stobs kyi ④byin gyis brlabs nas/ sems can rnams la skal ba ci lta ba rtsabazhin du gsang sngags kyi cho ga yang dag par rab tu ston to/ /gsang sngags kyi cho ga de yang gang zhe na/gzod 7nas ma skyes pa'i phyir a ni chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /dgongs pa dang bral ba'i phyir ka ni chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /nam mkha' dang 'dra bar dmigs su med pa'i phyir kha ni chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /'gro ba thams cad dmigs su med pa'i phyir ga ni chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /gcig tu 'phungs pa 86—481

dmigs su med pa'i phyir gha ni chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /'chi 'pho thams cad dang bral ba'i phyir tsa ni chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /grib ma thams cad dang mtshungs pa'i phyir tsha ni chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /skye ba dmigs su med pa'i phyir dza ni chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /dri ma dmigs su med pa'i phyir dzha ni chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /nga rgyal dmigs su med pa'i phyir ṭa ni chos thams cad kyi sgo'o / /bskyed pa dmigs su med pa'i phyir 0)ja ni chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /'khrug pa dmigs su med 5pa'i phyir ḍa (kyeni chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /bslu ④ba dang tshogeyongs su bral ba'i phyir rte ni chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /de bzhin nyid dmigs su med pa'i phyir (67ta ni chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /gnas dmigs su med pa'i phyir tha ni chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /'dul ba dmigs su med pa'i phyir da ni chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /khams dmigs su med pa'i phyir stidha ni chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /don dam pa'i bden pa dmigs su med pa'i phyir (kyepa ni chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ / lbu ba dang 99)'dra bar snying po med pa'i phyir pha ni chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /ngag gi lam dang bral ba'i phyir ba ni chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /srid pa thams cad dmigs su med pa'i phyir bha 7ni chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /'chi ba dmigs su med pa'i phyir ma ni chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /theg pa 11thams cad dmigs su med pa'i phyir ya ni chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /rdul thams cad dang bral ba'i phyir ra ni chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /mtshan nyid mi 12dmigs 1 pa'i phyir la ni chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /rang bzhin gyis zhi ba'i phyir sha ni chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /rang bzhin gyis blun pa nyid kyi thuphyir ṣa ni chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /bden pa thams cad dmigs su med pa'i phyir sa ni 86—482

chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /rgyu ①dmigs su med pa'i phyir ha ni chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po nga dang nya dang ṇa dang na dang ma ②ni ting nge 'dzin thams cad la dbang sgyur ba ste/ mthu thams cad dang ldan pa/ rab tu myur bar dgos pa'i don rab tu sgrub par byed pa yin no/ /gsang ba pa'i ②bdag po gsang sngags kyi tshul ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo 'di ni re ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ④rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu bsam gyis (nyemi khyab pa/ rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa/gsang sngags kyi de kho na nyid kyi don nges pa/ dus gsum las shin tu 'das pa/nam mkha' ltar dri ma med pa ste/ bsam yas sems kyi sa la gnas/ /las dang bya ba dag las byung / /spyad pa'i sa ni rjes thob nas/ /bsam yas 'bras bu sbyin (nyapar byed/ /'di ni de nyid dam pa ste/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rab tu bstan / /gsang sngags cho ga 'di shes nas(7ra/ /sngags pas 8)dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /sgra zhes bya ba de nyid mchog /gsang sngags rnams kyi gsang sngags mtshan/ /sngags pas yid la sems na ni/ /'chi 'pho med pa'i gnas 'thob bo/ /de nas 9)bcom ldan 'das la gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gsang sngags kyi mtshan nyid kyi tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs bstan pa/ bcom ldan 'das ngo mtshar lags so/ /de ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas mthams cad dang thun mong /lham lags te/ bcom ldan 'das gang dag gsang sngags kyi tshul 'di la dad pa'i sems can de dag kyang thun mong ma lags pa'i yon tan dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das gzhan yang dkyil 'khor gyi yo byad kyi 86—483

cho ga bshad du gsol/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje ①la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de nas sngags pa de yis su/ /me tog ser po dkar po dmar/ /yid du 'ong bas nan tan du/ /lha rnams la ni mchod pa bya⑤/ /padma'am ④yang na utpa la/ /nā ga ge sar pu na ga /tsam pa a sho 0ti la ka /pa ta la dang sa la'ang rung / /de la sogs pa'i me tog rnams/ /yid du 'ong zhing blta phyin sdug /bkra shis pa la sngags pa yis/ /mkhas pas nan tan mchod par ⑥bya/ / tsandan ta gar spre ⑦ka dang / /gur kum sridang ni ru rta'ang 0rung / /spos mchog rab tu bzang po ni⑩/ /sna tshogs yid du 'ong ba dbul/ /a ga ru'am sgron shing ngam/ /ga pur dang ni tsandan dang / / sā la'i thang 7chu bkra shis pa'am/ /shi 8ri ba tsos ka yang rung / /gzhan yang bdug spos sna tshogs pa/ /bkra shis 'jig rten rnam 〉grags pa'/ /yid 'ong sngags pas cho ga bzhin/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nas gzhan yang sems dpa' 7che/ /lha bshos las kyi cho ga nyonas / /'o thug 'bras chan zho sbyar nas/ /la phug lhonyedang ni khur poskya dang / /gor bod sbyo 7ka ra yid 'ong dang / /khaṇḍa'i zhunyabaca' ba bzang po dang / /pu rig ka dang ka ri ka /de bzhin ma thu shi ra dang / /phe na a shog bar ti dang / /par pa ta tsho 3yang dbul bar bya'otsho ste/ /de la sogs pa'i bza' ba dang / /shing tog ernams ni sna tshogs dang / /hwags dang li kha ra rnams dang / /bu ram sbrang rtsi mar dag tsho —1dang / /btung ba rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /zho dang 'o ma rgyas par dbul / /mar me rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /gtsang cizhing shin tu bzang po yi/ /'bru mar rab tu dri zhim pas/ /rab tu bkang ste dbul bar bya/ /phyogs su 86wa 484

gdugs dang ba dan rnams/ /kha dog sna tshogs rab tu bsgreng ①/ /rta babs bzang po rnams kyang ni/ /dril bu dang bcas rab tu dbul/ /yang na yid kyi mchod pa ni/ /thams cad nan tan bskyed de bya/ /de nas bum pa brgyad dam ni/ /bcu drug rgyas par blangs nas su/ /sman dang rin chen thams cad blugs/ /spos kyi chus ni rab tu bkang / /ldum bu dag gis kha brgyan ②te/ /de bzhin 'bras bus kha yang dgang / /me tog spos la sogs pas brgyan/ /shin tu bzang po bsrung ①ba byas/ /mgrin pa ras kyis bcings pa rnams/ /mkhas pas rnam par dgod par bya/ /lha yi gtso bo rnams la ni/ /ras ni zung re zung re dbul/ /sems dpa' chen po phal (ji)rnams la/ /ya re dbul bar rab tu bsgrags/ /mchod pa de ltar byas nas ni/ /slob ma dkyil 'khor drung bkug ste/ /sngags pas chu yis bsang gtor bya/ /dri dang me tog sbyin par bya//de bzhin gshegs pa dran byas nas/ /byang chub sems kyang 'dzin du gzhug / des na ⑧rgyal ba'i rigs dge la/ /thams cad rab tu skyes par yi'agyur/ /chos kyi dbyings las byung ba yi/ /phyag rgya de dag rnams la bcing chos kyi 'khor lo'ang bcings nas ni/ /rdo rje sems dpas (7byin gyis brlabs58da/ /de nas sangs rgyas kun gyi ni/ /dam tshig sdom brtson can gyis bcingasaphyin/ /de tshe sngags kyi cho ga bzhin/ /ras la lan gsum gdab par bya/ /snying rjer gyur pa'i yid kyis su/ /de dag gi ni gdong yang dgabam/ /dam tshig lan gsum bzlas nas ni/ /spyi bor yi ge ra zhes pa/ / klad kyi kor nyu7bcas brjid dang ldan/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba rnam par 'phro/ /zla ba 'char ka lta bu yi/ /kha dog dkar po gzhag 57par bya/ /skyob pa kun gyi spyan sngar ni/ /de nas me tog 86—485

'dor du gzhug /me tog gang la bab pa de①/ /sngags pas de la sbyin par bya//dkyil 'khor dang po'i sgo drung dul/ /sgo khyud kyi ni dbus kyi cha/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni sgo gnyis kyi/ /bar du slob ma gzung ②bar bya/ /der gnas pa la cho ga kun/ /rim pa bzhin du legs par bya/ /slob ma sdig dang bral ba kun/ /de ltar legs par btsud ④nas ni/ /de dag zhi bar bya ba'i phyir/ /sbyin sreg cho ga bzhin du bya/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor gyi ni mdun/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis pa'i rgyab rol gyi/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni dbus kyi char/ /ma yengs pa yi sems kyis bya/ /me thab khru gang tsam gyi ni/ /tshad du rab tu bsgrags pa yin/ /kha ran sor bzhi (57tshad du bya/ /dbus su rdo rje rab tu brtag /de nas sngags pa'i g.yas logs su/ /sbyin sreg gi ni yo byad gzhag(6) /g.yon gyi phyogs su slob ma rnams/ /tsog tsog por ni 'khod (7du gzhug /sdom brtson bdag nyid sa steng du/ /ku sha bting ba'i stan la 'dug /yang na tshon rtsi dmar ④po mchog /rab tu bzang po blangs nas su/ /de yis me (9)yi gnas rnams kun/ /sngags pas mdo ru bri bar bya/ /ku sha dag gis g.yas phyogs nas/ /thams cad khor yug dgram pa ni/ /mang pos bskor ba'i tshul du dgram/ /spos mi chu yis bsang gtor bya/ /de nas sems can phan byed pa'i/ /me ni thab khung nang bsams te / /brtul zhugs bzang pos dgang blugs 31mchog /gsang sngags 'di yis sbyin par bya/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ asna 'oye swā hā/ de nas slob ma re re nas/ /mkhas pas 12lag pa g.yon pa yis/ /g.yas pa'i mthe bong bzung thunas su/ /mnyam par bzhag thugs sbyin sreg 7bya/ /yid ni mnyam par bzhag 1 nas su/ / sreg blugs 18re re las kyang ni/ /gsang sngags 86—486

cho ga bzhin zlos shing / /nyi shu rtsa gcig sbyin sreg ①bya/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ oṃ ②ma hā shānta ga ta zhushārnyi ④ka ra pra sha ma dharma ni ra dzā ta0/ a bhā ba swa bhā ba dharma sa ma tā māste ⑥su hā/ sbyin sreg ④rjes la sngags pa yis/ /slob ma rnams la yon bslang ba/ /gser dang dngul dang rin chen dang / /rta dang de bzhin glang po dang / /rnga mo ba lang sadam he gos/ /gzhan yang dngos po ci yang rung ske/ /de tshe slob mas gus par ni/ /dad pa rab tu ldan pa yis/ /sems la dga' ba bskyed nas su/ /bla ma la ni yon dbul lo/ /yang na ci nas bla ma de / /rab tu mgu bar 'gyur bar bya/ /de ltar byas nas bdag bsrung stel/ /slob ma de bos chabasgo ba ni/ /'di ni bsod nams zhing yin zhes/ /sems can kun gyi hu)don gyi phyir/ /skyob pa rnams ni kun gyis gsungs/ /rnam dag yon tan rgyas pa yi/ /dge 'dun la ni kun gyis byin/ /dge 'dun la phul 'bras bu che/ /skyes bu mkhas pa gang dag gis/ /dge 'dun la ni yon phul na / /longs spyod chen po mi zad pa/ /'jig rten 'thad pa hu skye bar 'gyur/ /de bas thams cad mthun / par ni/ /sems la yidaga' ba bskyed nas su/ /sangs rgyas bsngags pa'i dge 'dun la/ /ci nus par ni mchod ston bya/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/ sems dpa' chen po dbang bskur ba/ /sngon gyi sangs rgyas kyis bshad pa/ /rgyas pa ru ni bshad par byas/ /yid gcig bsdus 47te legs par nyon/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de la slob dpon gyis rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du bar khru do bor nas phyi rol gyi sa la nyu dkyil 'khor gnyis pa gru bzhi pa 1 sgo gcig pa bri'og ge/ /grwa bzhir rdo rje 'dzin 86—487

pa bzhi dgod de/ bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ spros pa med par gnas pa dang ske/ nam mkha' dri ma med pa dang / dri ma med pa'i mig dang / gos sna tshogs gyon pa rnams so/ /dbus su padma chen po 'dab ma brgyad pa ze ba dang bcas pa gzhag ste/ 'dab ma bzhi la byang chub sems dpa' grogs su gyur pa sngon gyi smon lam gyi mthu can 1)bzhi bri bar bya ste/ 'di lta ste/ gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal po dang / dran pa dang shes bzhin can dang / phan pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa can dang / snying rje can no/ /'dab ma gzhan rnams la ni phyag brnyan bzhi bri ste/ bzhi chagang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sems kyi khyad par la spyod pa dang / 'dod pa yongs su rdzogs byed dang / ma chags pa dang / rnam par grol ba'o/ /dbus su ni chos kyi dbyings bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gzugs gzhag go /de nas rin po che'i bum pa bzhi rin po che dang / sman thams cad blugs 9 pa/ kun tu bzang po dang / /byams pa dang / sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba dang / ngan song thams cad spong 6)ba rnams kyis (7byin gyis brlabs pas spyi bo nas dbang bskur ro/ /padma 'dab ma de la ni/ /sngags pa bdag gis de bzhag rmo nas/ /spos dang me tog gis mchod de/ /mar me mchod yon sbyin par bya/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan dang / /rnga sgra yid du 'ong ba dang / /bkra shes rgya chen snyan pa yi(7)/ /tshig gis legs par mngon dga' (5)bya / /skyob pa rnams kyi spyan snga ru/ /de ni bsgrims te dbang bskur ro/ /spos dang me tog bzang po yis/ /de la yang ni mchod pa bya/ /de nas gser gyi thur ma ni/ /thogs te mdun du 'dug nas su/ 4 slob ma'i snying la 'bab 99)pa'i tshig /'di skad ces ni smra bar bya/ /sngon gyi mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /86wa 488

'jig rten ling tog ①bsal ba bzhin/ /bu khyod kyis ⑧ni mi shes pa'i/ /ling tog rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /de nas me long blangs nas su/ /chos kyi mtshan nyid bshad par bya/ /chos rnams gzugs ②brnyan lta bu ste/ / dang zhing ④dag la rtog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las byung ba ste/ /ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa/ / de ltar mtshan nyid bshad par bya/ /⑤de ltar chos 'di shes nas su/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang sangs rgyas sras su skye༅/ /de nas rkang pa'i bar 'og tu/ /chos kyi 'khor lo gzhag par bya/ /de nas lag pa g.yas par yang / /shin tu bzang po'i dung byin te/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /kun tu rgyas par bus nas su/ /de ring phan cad tso'ajig rten la/ /skyob pa rnams kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /som nyi ⑧yid gnyis mi bya zhing / /dogs pa med pa'i sems kyis khyod/ /gsang sngags spyad pa'i tshul gyi mchog /'jig rten 'di la rab tu shod/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la/ /phan 'dogs yo)byas pa gzo 0zhes bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun yang / /khyod la rnam pa kun tu srung 3nye/ /de nas slob ma de bslang mal/ /sngags pa snying rjer gyur pa yi/ge/ /yid kyis nang du bcug nas ni/ /de la dam tshig bstan par bya/ /de ring phan cad tsobu khyod kyis/ /dam pa'i chos dang byang chub sems/ /srog gi phyir yang da /nyephyin chad8/ /yongs su gtang 7bar mi bya'o/ /khyod kyis ser sna dang ni gang / /sems can gnod pa mi bya'o/ /dam tshig 'di dag sangs rgyas kyis/ /brtul zhugs bzang po khyod la bshad/ /ci ltar rang gi srog bsrung nyusnyeb/ /de ltar khyod kyis 'di dag srungs37/ /slob mas bla ma'i rkang pa la/ /dad cing gus pas ri )phyag byas 86wa 489

nas / /shin tu nges pa'i yid kyis ni/ /de dag thams cad khas blang ngo / /de nas yang 0)bcom ldan 'das la gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang snying rje chen po'i snying dzon po 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal po chen po 'di'i dam tshig la zhugs par gyur pa de'i chabasod nams ci tsam zhig mngon par 'dus bgyis par rig par bgyi/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis ④gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to⑤/ /sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ⑨ste de bzhin gshegs pa las byung ba'i bsod nams mngon par 'dus byas pa ci tsam pa nirigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de dag gi 3)bsod nams mngon par 'dus byas pa yang de tsam du rig par bya'o/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po rnam grangs 'dis kyang khyod kyis 'di ltar blta ⑨ste/rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhal dang thugs las skyes pa'i sras yin par rig par bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu 7mo de dag phyogs gang na gnas pa der de bzhin gshegs pa des nyamachen po dgongs mi dgos par 'gyur ro/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po nyu de lta bas na de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod par 'dod pa'i rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo rnams kyis de dag la mchod par bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa la blta bar 'dod pa rnams kyis de dag la blta bar bya'o/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa rdo rje 'dzin de dag dang / kun tu bzang po la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de rnams kyis mgrin 1nagacig tu tshig smras pā/ bcom ldan 'das deng slan cad 7rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de rnams la rim gror bgyi zhing mchod 86—490

par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de ci'i slad du zhe na/ rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag nyid sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams su ①blta bar bgyi ba lags so/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dag la gzigs nas/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje dang rdo rje 'dzin de rnams dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor rnams la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu dag de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi gsang sngags kyi tshig gsung gi ge'akhor lo'i dkyil 'khor mtha' yas par 'jug pa rgya chen po las byung ba sna tshogs kyi gzugs kyi nor bu dang 'dra ba/ re ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa/ bsod nams kyi tshogs dpag tu med pa bsags pa(ba/ thogs pa med pa'i rtog 0pa la gnas pa/ dus gsum du chags pa med pa'i stobs dang ldan pa (pedag yod do/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje dang / rdo rje 'dzin de rnams dang ske/ thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dag gis mgrin gcig tu tshig (7smras pal/ bcom ldan 'das de'i dus la bab bo/ /bde bar gshegs pa de'i tshod la bab bo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe ljags kyi dbang po 'dod pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par rnam par sprul pas thams cad dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing kun tu g.yogs nas/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi tog rgya chen po yongs su dag pa'i rtse mo la blta ri/ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu de nas 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis chos kyi dbyings khyab pa/ sems can gyi khams ma lus pa rnams yongs su bskyab nasapa'i sgra 'byin pa/ rig sngags kyi rgyal 86—491

mo stobs chen mo bsrung ①ba chen mo 'di gsungs so/ /na maḥsarba ②ta thā ga te bhyaḥsab (1bha ya bi ④ga te bhyo bi shwa mu khe abhyaḥsabra byathā stikhi rakṣa ma hā ba le sab duta ⑨thā ga ta 0pu rgya nir dzā 0te/ rtsu rgyu tra ta tra ta a pra ti ha te swā hā/ sangs rgyas mkhas pa thams cad kyis/ /rig sngags 'di gsungs med la ni/ /de tshe sangs rgyas zhing 'di dag /rnam pa drug tu g.yos par gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa' de kun gyis/ /ngo mtshar gyur pa'i mig gdangs nas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi spyan sngar ni/ /yid du 'ong ba'i tshig smras pa/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /bsrung 7ba rab tu stobs chen 'di/ /sems can thams cad bsrung rto ba dang / /bskyab cing sba ba'i phyir gsungs te/ /gang gi 8snying la bsrung miganas pa/ /de dag la ni 'jigs pa med/ /gsang sngags mthu chen dran byas na7/ /bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad dang / /srin po 'jigs pa'i gzugs can ni/ /de dag thams cad 'jig 7par 'gyur/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis chos nyunyekyi dbyings rgya chen por 3)byin gyis brlabs nas/de'i tshe chos kyi dbyings kyi ḍa gyemadzod kyi snying po can zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dul snyoms par zhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu dam tshig la 'jug pa'i rig sngags 'di tsha byung ngo / /na maḥs manta bud dhā 49 — / a sa me / tri sa me/ sa ma ye swā hā/ de nas de ma thag tu sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad dang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad du dam tshig la 'jug pa'i rig sngags kyi ‘ gesgra gang zhig thos nas rdzu stomakhas pa rnams chos thams cad las 'da' bar mi 'gyur ba grag 3 tshopar gyur to/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi dbyings kun tu 'byung ba'i gsang sngags 86—492

gsungs pa/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ dhasmra stis tu swa bhā ba ādma ko3rtal/chos kyi dbyings su ②byin gyis brlab ④pa'o/ /na maḥs manta badzā ṭwāṃ/ badzra ādma ko3rtadu/ rdo rje sems dpar byin gyis brlab ⑥pa'o/ /na maḥs manta badzā shāl / badzra ka ba tsa rtsu/ rdo rje go cha'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ ta thā ga ta tsakṣur bya ba lo kā (nyeya swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan 0no/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ⑩rna/ bi shu gastob ba ṭwā hā/ byug spos kyi sngags so/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ ma hā mi rgya rgyud ga ta spriswā hā/ me tog gi sngags so/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā 8rna/ dharma dhā twa na nu ga ta swā hā/ bdug spos kyi sngags so/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ sabra yin thā ga ta ra tsi spha ra ṇa a ba bhā mas ga ga notta re ⑩bhaḥ0swā hā/ mar me'i sngags so/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ ga ga na sa ma sa ma swā hā/ mchod yon gyi sngags so/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ ga ga na nān spha ra ṇa bi shu dha ri nyenir dza ta swā hā/ gtsug tor gyi sngags so/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ pra tsaṇḍa badzra dzwa la mabi sbu ri )ra hūm̐/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i go cha'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ dzā la mā :min ta thā ga ta ra tsi swā hā/kun tu 'bar ba'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ ma hā ta thā ga ta dzi hwa su dhasmra epra tikhyi ta swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ljags kyi'o/ /dkyil 'khor du dgod pa'i ( shesngags kyi mdzod do// // bam po gsum pa'/ de nas yang bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad la phyag na rdo rjes zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci ltar na/ dkyil 'khor bri ( geba'i tshe na ni/ /bgegs rnams zhi bar 'gyur ba lags/ /gsang sngags sgrub pa'i tshe na yang / /log 'dren rnams ni ma mchis 'gyur/ /gsang sngags 86—493

rnams kyang ci ltar bsgrubahunye/ /de yi 'bras bu ci 'drar 'gyur/ /de skad gsol nas de yi tshe/ /bcom ldan rnam snang mdzad chen gyis/ /'di skad ces ni bka' stsal to(mi/ /sems dpa' chen po legs so legs/ /khyod kyis yongs su dris pa gang tshokhu/ /thams cad khyod la bstan ④par bya/ /sngon cad ⑤sor sna bsten tshonapa'i phyir/ /bgegs ni rang gi ⑦sems las byung (she/ /de yi rgyu ni gzhig pa'i phyir/ /gang du sems dang sems byung ba'i/ /rtog pa thams cad spong ba dang / /rnam par rtog pa las byung ba'i/ /spros pa thams cad 'gag 'gyur ba'i/ /byang chub sems zhes ⑨bshad pa yin/ /sngags pas byang chub sems dran zhing / /mi g.yo ba ni yid la bzlas/ /de yi phyag rgya bcings na ⑩ni / /bgegs rnams thams cad 'jig par 'gyur/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de la rlung bcing ba 'di nyon cig /a zhes bya bar bdag bsgyur te/ /ha (stezhes bya bar mayid la bzlas/ /rlung gi phyogs su gnas nas ni/ /sa la spos kyi thig le dag /bdun nyid legs par byas nas su/ /kham phor gyis ni dgab par bya/ /kham phor ri rab chen po ru/ /yang dang yang du bsam par bya de yi steng du a zhes pa/ /klad kyi kor bcas pa rgyas par bsam/ /rlung bcing chen po de lta bu/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis 7bshad/ /sems dpa' chen po chu yi yang / /yid gcig bsdus te mnyan par gyis/ /sngags pas ra zhes bya ba ni / /thams cad dmar po stobs chen bsam/ /'bar ba'i phreng can mi bzad skapa / /khro bo lag na ral gri thogs/ /sa la sprin gyi gzugs bris nas/ /ral gri'i saphyag rgyas gdab 1 par bya/ /phyogs kun nas ni langs pa'i sprin/ /de ma thag tu 'jig par 'gyur/ /yang na sngags pa mi g.yeng bas/ /de dag phur 86—494

bus gdab bya ste/ /mkhas pa rdo rjer gyur nas su/ /thams cad rdo rje ①phur bus btab②/ /yang na bgegs rnams thams cad ni/ /zhi bar bya ba yang bshad de/ /sngags pa dkyil 'khor dbus gnas nas/ /mi g.yo stobs chen gsang sngags ni/ /shin tu mi bzad gsang sngags ①kyi/ /dkyil 'khor dag la gnas par bsam/ /de yi gzugs brnyan byas nas ni/ /rkang pa g.yon pas spyi bor gzer(ge/ /'on tang de ni zhir 'gyur ba'am/ /dogs pa med par 'chi bar 'gyur/ /de yi gzugs brnyan byas nas su/ /ske tse dug khrag (debasres pa yis / /byugs nas (7sngags pas bskams nas rtsonani/ /gdon de myur du 'tshig ⑧ par 'gyur/ /de ni me la bskams pa dang / /dug gis bskus na nges par ni/ /tshangs pa'am 'on te brgya byin yang / / de yi 594mod la myur du 'tshig /de nas rngu bcom ldan 'das la phyag na rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i don bdag gis 'tshal ba ltar na bdag gis 'di ltar mjal /lhato/ /bcom ldan 'das rang gi dkyil 'khor gyi gnas /gel gnas na lha rnams byin gyis rlob par byed /2do/ /de nyid du gnas na de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' las kyang 'gal bar mi bgyid do/ / de ci'i slad du zhe na/blabacom ldan 'das 'di ltar rang gi rigs la gnas pa de ni gsang sngags thams cad kyi dam tshig lags so/ /byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa rnams kyis kyang rang gi gnas la gnas nas kyang mdon thams cad bsgrub par bgyi'o519/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po de de bzhin te/ ci skad smras pa de 5nye bzhin no / /gsang ba pa'i bdag po/ gzhan yang gang gis ri kha dog gang 86wa 495

gsungs pa/ /de nyid de yi ①dkyil 'khor te/ / lha yi ②gzugs ni de lta bur / /sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyis bstan/ /de la gsang ba pa'i bdag po ma 'ongs pa'i dus na sems can blo zhan pa ma dad pa gang dag ②bstan pa 'di la dad par mi 'gyur zhing yid gnyis dang som nyi mang ba/ thos pa tsam snying por 'dzin pa/ sgrub pa la mi phyogs pa dag 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de dag ni bdag nyid kyang ma rung la gzhan yang phung bar byed pa yin no/ /'di skad du 'di ni phyi rol pa rnams la yod de/ sangs rgyas rnams ④kyis gsungs pa ni ma yin no zhes smra bar 'gyur gyi/ mi blun po de dag gis 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das thams cad mkhyen pa/ chos thams cad la mnga' brnyes pa/ sems can gyi don rtogs par thugs su chud pa des/ sngon sems can rnams la phan par bzhed nas/ 'di dag thams cad bshad do zhes bya bar ni ⑤mi shes so/ /chos rnams kyi ni chos kyi mtshan/ /blun po des ni de mi shes/ /chos rnams kun gyi mtshan nyid ni/ /stong pa nyid du yang dag gsungs/ /sngags pa rtag tu der gnas nas/ /rab tu nges par las bya'o/ /bgegs zhi bar bya ba'i (7rim par phye ba rgyas pa'o// // gude nas phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa rdo rje 'dzin 7de dag dang / kun tu bzang po la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' de rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad la phyag 'tshal nas/ snying rje chen po 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa'i sgo ci ltar rtogs pa rang rang gi tshig tu brjod pa'i tshig gis gsang sngags rnams smra bar 'dod nas 86—496

bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba btab bo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang / rdo rje 'dzin de dag la mi nyams pa'i chos nyid du byin gyis brlabs nas bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu dag chos kyi dbyings ci ltar rtogs pa bzhin sems can gyi ①khams rnam par sbyong ba'i ②gsang sngags kyi tshig rnams smos shig /de nas de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos sangs rgyas kyi rgyan gyi yul zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas stobs thogs pa med pa'i gsang sngags smras pa/ na maḥs manta ③bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ sa mas nu ga ti ba ra dza dharma (0nir dzā ta byam hā ma hā swā hā/kun tu bzang po'i 'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' byams pas byams pa chen po kun tu ⑥'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge (pe'adzin la snyoms par zhugs nas rang gi snying po smras pa/ na maḥnis manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ a dza 6)tan dza yā 8 sarba satwa ā 7sha yā nu ga ta swā 87/ byams pa'i 'o/ /de nas yang hūṃ 3byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po rnam par dag pa'i yul zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas gsang sngags smras pa/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ā kā 8sha sa ma tā nu ga ta bi tsi tram̐ tsob ra dha ra swā hā/ nam mkha'i snying po'i 'o /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba snying rje chen po'i snying listobs zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas gsang sngags smras pa/ na maḥs manta 'bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ ā sa tā bla ta a da nyusheg ta ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ rī rī 0swā hā/ sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba'i 'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug kun tu spyan ras gzigs zhes rdzu bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas rang gi snying po 'khor dang 86—497

bcas pa smras pa3)/ na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ sabra (bta thā ga ta a ba lo ki ta kā guru ṇa mā du yā ra ra ra hūṃ dzaḥ(snyeg hā/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi'o6)/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ rdza rdza sa swā hā/ mthu chen thob kyi'o⑦/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ kā (8ru ṇita be tsho'o)tā re tā ri ṇi yig hā/ lha mo sgrol ma'i 'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ sab 11bha ya tā hunyes ni rtsu sbo 8ṭa ya swā hā/ khro gnyer can ma'i 'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ ta thā ga ta bi sha tsoya saṃ bha be/padma mā li ni swā hā/ gos dkar can ma'i 'o8/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/hūṃ kha da brnya sbo ṭa ya tshag hā/ rta mgrin gyi'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying po rdo rje mi shigs pa rtog pa'i yul zhes bya ba'i ting nge ⑩'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas gsang sngags smras pa/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ ha ha ha su ta 18na swā hā/ sa'i snying po'i 'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs 37rnam par 'phrul pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas rang gi snying po smras pa/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ he he he/ ku mā snar ka /bi multi 1/ sa tha sbi ti / sma ra sma ra/pra ti ta lhan swā hā/ 'jam dpal gyi'o/ /de nas gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje mi pham pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas rang gi snying po 'khor dang bcas pa smras pa/ na maḥs manta badzā tsā/ tsaṇḍa tsho dzom hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ/ phyag na rdo rje'i 'o/ /na maḥs manta badzā tsā tsi/ tri ṭa tri ṭa/ dza yarnyi ( swā hā/ mā ma khri'i rna'o/ /na 29maḥs manta bud dhā dzā/ rghaṃ brnya ya brta ya/ mo ṭa ya mo ṭa ya/ badzob be sasba tra a pra ti ha te swā hā/ rdo rje lu gu rgyud kyi'o/ /na maḥs manta badzā ṇḍaṃ/ hrīḥ 14 phaṭa swā hā/ khro zla gtso bo'i 'o/ /na maḥs 86wa 498

manta badzā shāsti/ sarba (mi dhasmra nisgo da ②ni badzra su tsi ba ra de swā hā/ rdo rje rtse mo'i 'o/ /na maḥs manta badzā 〉bya/ rtsu hūm̐ rtsu phaṭa phaṭa/ rdza dze swā hā/ rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi'o/ /na maḥs manta badzā shāg/ ho he kyi: rā ya si groṇḍa groṇḍa (6)khā da khā da pa ri pu ra ya tshis pra ti dzñā (kyen swā hā/ phyag brnyan thams cad kyi'o/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa 〈perin po che'i ⑩'byung gnas zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas nyid kyi snying po 'khor dang bcas pa dag (2gsungs pa/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ sab nyugegle sha ni shud dhā na sarba tu dhasmra ④ba shi ta mā tshes ga ga na/ sa ma sa ma swā hā/ shākya thub pa'i 'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ ba ra de tshab ra māste hūm̐/ mdzod spu'i 'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ bam̐ rba hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa sā hā/ gtsug tor thams cad kyi'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ nni nni ri ri dzi dzi / swā hā/ khro bo gzhan gyis mi thub pa zhes /snyebya ba'i 'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ a pa rā dzi ta dzā nyushel na ti dzha ṭi ta 9 — swāswā hā / gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i ri du 'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ pri thi byi ri naswā hā/sa'i 'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ biṇḍa be snyeg hā/ khyab 'jug gi'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā āoṃ/ ru drwa ri buya swā hā/ drag po'i 'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā rnam/ bā ya be cu swā hā/ rlung lha'i 'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ sa ra swa st+ya lhag hā/ dbyangs can gyi'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ rākṣa ri sā dhi pa ta ye swā hā/ bden bral gyi'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā nī/ bai na ba satwa 29ya swā hā/gshin rje'i 'o'i )/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ mṛ ta ye 21swā hā/ 'chi bdag gi'o/ /na maḥs manta sa bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ kā la rā /tri ye swā hā/ dus mtshan gyi'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ ma tri bhyaḥswā hā/ ma mo rnams kyi'o/ /na maḥs 86wa 499

manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ sha krā ①ya swā hā/ brgya byin gyi'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/a rpā ②pa ta ye chaswā hā/ chu lha'i 'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ ā di tyā ④ya swā hā/ nyi ma'i 'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ pra dza ⑤pa ta ye swā hā/ tshangs pa'i 'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ tsand+ra duya swā hā/ zla ba'i 'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ me gha sha ni ye ⑦ga hā/ dga' bo dang bsnyen dga' po'i'o/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad bstan pa don yod ⑧par grub par bzhed nas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi 0yum rig sngags kyi rgyal mo gsungs pa/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ ga ga yin ba ra lakṣa ṇi hunyag ga na sa ma rtsonasasbod ga ta ti sa ra saṃ bha be dzwa thal na mo ④a mo ghā 0nān swā tshepho/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi yum nam mkha'i spyan gyi'obo/ /de nas yang 8bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad bgegs thams cad zhi bar bya ba'i phyir gzi brjid 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas bgegs chen po 'joms pa'i gsang sngags 'di gsungs so / /na maḥs manta badzā shā17/ tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa spro ṭa ya (2 rtsu/ trag ha mā/'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i 'o/ /na maḥs manta badzā shāng spe/ ha ha ha/ bisma 4ye/sarba gi ta thā ga na rte he'i ṣa ya dge bha ya tree tsho 9lokya bi dza ya hūm̐ dza sa swā hā/ khams gsum las tsho 2rnam par rgyal ba'i 'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā tsā shwe/ he tu pra tya ya bi ga te dhasmra ni rā dza 8 ta rghaṃ/ nyan thos rnams kyi'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ po / thar / rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā /snyi/ sab 82bu bo dhi satwa hre da yaṃ ni 5za sha ni na maḥsasba do biṅgā ci swā hā/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyi'i gi snying po'o/ /na maḥs manta 86wa 500

bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ lo ka lo ka ka spyirā yakhya/ sarba ②de ba/ nā ga /yakṣa/ gartar bā8 / a su ra/ ga ru ḍa/ kinda ra⑤/ ma ho ra ga skṛ da yanadu/ n+ya ka ri ṣa ya bi tsi ⑦dra ga ti swā hā/ lha la sogs pa spyi'i snying po'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ sarba dushā/ bī ma ti/ bi ⑨ka ra ṇa/ dharma byas tu nir dzā ⑩ta saṃ saṃ ha ṭwā hā/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/dunānta tsom hā ro ṣa ṇa khā ṭa ya sa na 8ta thā ga ta ā āoṃ 0ku ru swā hā/ sgo srung ⑫gdul ⑩dka' ba zhes bya ba'i 'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ he ma hā pra tsaṇḍa a bhi mu kha griṇḍa khā chad ya/ kyi skorā hu)ya si sa 0 ma 0ya ma nu sma ra swā hā/ sgo srung 3mngon du phyogs pa'i nya'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ sab ( batra a nu ga te / brnya sī 'du/ ma hā sa ma ya nir dzā cigate sma ra ṇi/ a pra ti ha te/ dha ka dha ka /tsa ra tsa ra/ bharnya bharnyas sgyu/ da sha di shan sarba ku nyeta thā ga ta/ a nu ga 0te/ pra ba ra dharma la du )bi dza ye bha ga ba saḥti bi ku ri bi ku le ༄ 3le lu bu pri swā hā/ mtshams (nyechen mo sastegacod pa'i 'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ a/byang chub kyi'o/ /ā nishespyod pa'i 'o/ /oṃ rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i 'o/ /a mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'o/ /na maḥs manta badzā ṇḍaṃ/ hāzhunya/ 'jig rten gsum las rnam par ri )rgyal ba'i'o/ /na maḥs manta badzā tsā/ tsā4she/ 'phags pa mi g.yo mgon gyi'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ a/ sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba'i 'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ sa/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ ba/ phyag na rdo rje'i'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ me'i / 'jam dpal gyi'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhwa ṭwāṃ/ga /nam mkha'i spyan gyi'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ raṃ/ chos kyi dbyings 86wa 501

kyi'o / /na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ /spyi/ dpa' bo chen po'i 'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ rdza/ chu'i dbang po'i 'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhwa ṭwāṃ/ rta/lha mo sgrol ma'i'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ hrīḥl/ khro gnyer ①can ma'i 'o / /na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ paṃ/ gos dkar can gyi'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ siX/ mthu chen thob kyi'o⑤/ /na maḥs manta bud dhwa ṭwāṃ/ rta0/rta mgrin gyi'o/ /na maḥs stimanta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ yaṃ/ grags 'dzin ma'i'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ saṃ/ phyag na rin chen gyi'o/ /na maḥs ⑧manta bud dhā shā / cho1// dra ba'i 'od kyi'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ bha/ shākya thub pa'i 'o/ /na tshamaḥs manta bud dhā tsā/ tsā tram̐ namathu/ gtsug tor gsum gyi'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ lo/ gdugs dkar po'i 'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā rnal/ shaṃ/ gtsug tor rgyal ba'i 'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ saṃ/ gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba'i 'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ tri( gye/ gzi brjid phung po'i 'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ hūṃ/ rnam par 'thor ba'i 'o na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ /nyanya/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i 'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ bīs/ sa'i 'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ ki li/ skra can ma'i 'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ di li/ nye skra can ma'i 'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/mi tshali/ sna tshogs ma'i 'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dmā ṭwāṃ/ hi li/ nor ldan ma'i 'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ ha 7sa ṭwāṃ/ ngo mtshar can gyi'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ ra sa māṃ/ sems can thams cad la mi 'jigs pa nyu sbyin pa'i 'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā dzā/ darsha 18rna/ ngan song thams cad sbyong ba'i 'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ bi ha sa māṃ/ yongs su skyong sems blo 86wa 502

gros kyi'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ shā/ byams pa chen po mngon par 'byung ba'i 'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ yaṃ/ snying rje ①gdungs pa'i 'o /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ i/ gdung ba ②thams cad zhi bar byed pa'i 'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ saṃ/ bsam gyis ④mi khyab pa'i blo gros can gyi'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ rta(pe/ rin chen 'byung gnas kyi'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ /⑤/ phyag na rin chen gyi'oyi/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ ṭaṃ/sa 'dzin gyi'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ i/ gzungs ⑦thob pa'i 'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ lha'uste/ phyag na rin chen phyag rgya'i 'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ rna/ bsam pa brtan pa'i 'onyunye/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ tsā / nam tshamakha' tunyedri med kyi'om/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ dzā/ nam mkha'i 7blo gros kyi'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā dzā/ ga haṃ/ blo gros rnam par dag pa'i 'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ jom/ spyod pa'i blo gros kyi'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ hūṃ/ brtan pa'i blo gros kyi'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā dzā / rmi shlau 48pre/ phyag brnyan rnams kyi'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ kṣa da ha tsher yaṃ kai/ byang chub sems dpa' ji skad gsungs pa zhu tshornams kyi'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ ma no mā ye dharma nyushesi bha be bi bha be ka ṭha ne 'o/se sa ne/gnas gtsang ma sa pa rnams kyi'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ kṛ ke ri/ srin po rnams kyi'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ hrīḥs nya/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ yakṣa bīrya nadha ri/ gnod sbyin rnams kyi'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ mi tsi mi tsi/ sha za mo 2rnams kyi'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ rgu rgu dzi dzi/ 'byung po rnams kyi'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ ra ṭaṃ 86wa 503

ra ṭaṃ/ phroṃ ṭaṃ phroṃ ṭaṃ/ lha ma yin rnams kyi'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ ga ra lo bi ra lo/ lto 'phye chen po rnams kyi'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ ha sa shāsti / bī a sa ṭwāṃ/ mi 'am ci rnams kyi'o/ /na maḥs manta bud ṅgā ṭwāṃ/ a ti tsa lā ra na ma no mi②/ mi rnams kyi'o/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po ngas ③de la sogs pa thams cad kyi gsang sngags ④bshad de'༄/ de la gsang sngags thams cad kyi/ /snying po des pas mnyan par gyis/ /a zhes bya ba (6)sngags kun gyi/ /snying po yin par yang dag bshad/ /de la gsang sngags kun gnas te/ /de ltar sngags rnams rnam par nges/ /rnam par snang mdzad chen po mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa rnam par sprul pa byin gyis rlob pa las/ spyi'i gsang sngags kyi mdzod rim par phye ba rgyas pa'o// //de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po gsang sngags ci ltar sgrub ⑦pa dang /bsgrubs 9 pa'i 'bras bu gang yin pa 'di (9)nyon cigatso /yi ge dang ni yi ger sbyar / /de bzhin gzhi las gzhir gyur pa me/ /shin tu bsdams pas yid la ni/ /bzlas brjod 'bum phrag gcig bya'o/ /yi ge byang chub sems yin te/ /gnyis pa sgra zhes bya ba yin/ /gzhi nyi ni rang gi lha 3lhagazhag pa/ /rang gi lus kyi gnas la bya/ /gzhi gnyis pa ni rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rkang gnyis mchog tu shes par bya / /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnam dag pa/ /sngags pas de la gnas par bsam/ /yi ge rnams ni go rims 1 bzhin/ /de yi dbus su legs par dgodam/ /slar sdud pa yi satshig gis non/ /srog dang rtsol ba rnam par sbyangs/ /srog ces bya 86wa 504

ba rlung du bshad/ /rtsol ba dran pa zhes bya ste/ /de gnyis bsdams pa byas nas su/ /sngon du bsnyen pa legs par bya/ /de nas sngags pas ⑤zla gcig tu/ /shin tu bsdams te bzlas brjod bya0/ /gsang sngags sngon du spyad pa ni/ /gzhi gcig nas ni gcig tu 'jug /grags chen sangs rgyas thams cad kyisal/ /sngar spyad pa zhes bshad pa yin/ /de phyin cad ④ni gang cung zad/ /me tog spos la sogs dbul zhing / /sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur bya'i phyir/ /de tshe byang chub tu yang bsngo/ /sngags pas 'jigs med de lta buX/ /zla gnyis pa la bzlas brjod bya/ /de nas zla ba nya ba'i tshe/ /mi de sgrub la 'jug par bya/ /ri rtse dang ni ba lang lhas/ /de bzhin 'bab chu'i mdo dag dang / /lam gyi bzhi ༅mdo mtshan gcig dang / /ma mo'i gnas sam zhi gnas su/ /dkyil 'khor nan tan bri bya ba47/ /thams cad rdo rje'i khang par byas/ /des ni der gnas bsrung ⑧byas nas/ /sgrub pa la ni nan tan bya/ /der ni mtshan mo nam phyed dam/ /yang na nyi ma 'char ba'i tshe/ /'di lta'i ltas tho)rnams 'byung 'gyur te/ /blo dang ldan pas de shes bya/ /rdu zhes pa dang rnga sgra dang / /de bzhin sa ni g.yo ba dang / /yid du 'ong ba'i tshig kyang rung / /de ni nam mkha' las grag na / /mtshan ma dag ni de rnams kyis/ /yid bzhin rjes grub shes bya ste/ /sangs rgyas rkang gnyis mchog rnams kyis/ /de yi 'bras bur yang dag bshad/ /de ltar sngags kyi tshul gnas pa/ /de ni nges par sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /de bas rnam pa thams cad du/ /sngags nyid rtag tu dran par bya/ /sngon gyi sangs rgyas mthu chen gyis31/ /de ni dran par bya ba'ang bshad/ /rnam par snang mdzad chen po mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa rnam par sprul pa byin gyis rlob pa las/86—505

'jig rten pa'i dngos grub bsgrub pa'i ①rim par phye ba'o// //de nas yang bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor 'dus pa la gzigs nas/ re ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa/ dus gsum mtha' yas pa'i sgo nges pa'i ye shes yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i chos kyi tshig rnams gsungs so/ /mkha' ltar dri med ngo bo nyid med pa/ /rnam mang ye shes sna tshogs sbyin par byed/ /ngo bo nyid kyis rtag tu stong pa nyid/ /rkyen la rag las zab cing blta bar dka'/ /khyad par 'gro ba rnams la rtag pa ru/ /rnam par bsams ②pa'i 'bras bu mchog sbyin byed/ /ji ltar nam mkha' chags med spyod yul can/ /'gro ba kun gyi gnas su gyur pa ltar / /de bzhin rnam par dag pa'i chos nyid 'di/ /srid gsum ma lus 'byor pa tshana'abyung bar byed/ /mchog skyes mkhas pa gang zhig 'dir spyod na/ /rgyal ba kun dang spyod yul gcig 4)par 'gyur(de)/ /rgyal bas ci skad gsungs pa'i chos nyid ni/ /shin tu rnam dag thams cad snang byed pa/ /de las go 'phang rnyed dka' gzhan med do/ /yangs pa'i chos ni zab la 'grib med cing //mnyam med 'jig rten phan byed de la ni/ /rnam rtog rnam par spangs te spyad par gyis/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen pos tshigs su bcad pa de dag gsungs nas/ thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor tshogs pa la gzigs nas phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa rdo rje 'dzin 96༄rnams la bka' stsal pa/rigs kyi bu dag gang gis na 7sems can rnams mthong ba'i chos kho na la dga' ba dang mgu ba thob nas bde ba la reg par 'gyur ba rang rang gi chos kyi 86wa 506

dbyings kyi mthu rlabs ①su gyur pal/ dngos grub sgrub ①pa'i tshig rnams ston cig /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / rdo rje 'dzin rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad la phyag 'tshal nas/ chos kyi rjes bka' ci skad stsal pa bzhin 'tshal lo zhes gsol to0/ /bcom ldan 'das nyid la gsol ba btab pa bdag cag la thugs brtse ba'i slad du dngos grub sgrub ⑤pa'i tshig rnams bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis bstan du gsol/ de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das gang bdag cag rang gis nyertogs pa bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar bshad pa de ni rab tu dka' tsolags so/ /de ltar (shelags pas ma 'ongs pa'i 'gro ba rnams kyi don dang / phan pa dang bde ba'i slad du bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis legs par rab tu bshad du gsol/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis rdo rje 'dzin de dag thams cad la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu dag legs so legs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pas bstan pa'i 59༄chos 'dul tsob 'di la phan yon che ba'i chos gcig yod pa ni 'di lta ste/ ngo tsha shes pa'o/ /ngo tsha shes pa dang ldan pa'i rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo ni mthong ba'i chos 'di hu la chos gnyis rab tu myur bar 'byung ste/gnyis gang zhe na/ mi bya ba'i las mi byed pa dang / dam pa rnams kyis bsngags pa'o/ /yang gnyis te/ khong du ma chud pa khong du chud pa rigedang /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang lhan cig 'grogs pa thob nyugepar 'gyur ba'o/ /yang gnyis te/ tshul khrims la rab tu gnas par 'gyur ba dang —/ lha dang mi rnams su skye ba 'thob gepar 'gyur ro51ge/ /de lta 51sgobs na legs par rab tu yid la zung 1 shig dang / 'di lta ste/ sgrub par sbyor ba'i 86—507

tshig gang rnams kyis ①byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa rnams gsang sngags rnams las myur du gsang sngags kyi dngos grub 'thob (kyepar 'gyur bzhu/ gsang sngags sgrub pa 'grub par sbyor ba'i tshig rnams bshad do/ /de la dang por re zhig ④dkyil 'khor mthong ba/bla mas gsang sngags bsgrub zhu)par gnang ⑥/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa/dad pa can ser sna med pa/ snying rje can dul ba rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba rnam par dbye ba la mkhas pa/ sdom pa bzung stib/ rang gi bslab pa la gnas pa / /thabs la mkhas shing rab tu brtan/ /dus dang dus ma yin pa'ang shes/ /'jigs pa med cing mkhas 'a la gtong / /bzod dang ldan zhing byams pa'i yid / /gsang sngags spyod la rab tu brtson/ /gsang sngags de nyid don la mkhas / /bsam gtan byed la dga' ba yin(94ri/ /sgrub pa po ni sgrub la shis/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de la 'dod pa'i khams kyi dbang phyug la 0myos par byed pa zhes bya ba'i rig casngags yod de7/ des 'dod pa na spyod pa'i lha'i bu thams cad myos pas brgyal bar 7byed cing / me tog mang po sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i sa phyogs nyams dga' ba rnams kyang ston la/ yongs su spyad pa dang nye bar spyad pa rnam pa tha dad pa sna tshogs rnams 7kyang mngon par sprul nas/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams la yang sbyin la/ bdag nyid kyang yongs su spyod do / /'di lta ste/ lha'i bu dbang phyug chen po la yid mgyogs zhes bya ba'i rig sngags yod des/ des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams su sems can gyi dgos pa byed cing / nye bar spyad cipa dang / yongs su spyad pa thams cad kyang mngon par sprul nas/ gnas gtsang ma'i ris 7kyi lha'i bu 86—508

rnams la yang sbyin la bdag nyid kyang kun tu spyod do/ /'di lta ste/ dper na ①mig 'phrul mkhan ni gsang sngags rnams kyis kun dga'i ra ba dang / mtsho dang / 'bab chu dang / mi la sogs pa rnam pa tha dad pa sna tshogs ston to/ /'di lta ste dper na/ lha ma yin rnams ni gsang sngags kyi ④sgyu ma rnams ston to//'di lta ste dper na/ gsang sngags dag gis ni dug dang rims la sogs pa med par 'gyur ro/ /'di lta ste ma mo zhes bya ba'i lha mo rnams ni gsang ③sngags kyis sems can rnams la nad 'go ba gtong ngo / /'di lta ste dper na/gsang sngags kyis ni me'i tsha ba med par byas nas grang bar ⑤byed par 'gyur ro//rigs kyi bu dag dpe'i tshig 'di (snyernams kyis gsang sngags kyi mthu la mngon par dad par bya'o/ /gsang sngags kyi mthu de yang gang zhe na(6)/ gsang sngags rnams las byung ba yang ma yin/ rdzas (malas 'jug pa yang ma yin/ sbyor ba pos (shelas dmigs pa yang ma yin mod kyi rten/ rigs kyi bu dag 'on kyang gsang sngags kyi byin gyi rlabs kyi mchos nyid 'byung ba las 'da' bar yang mi 'gyur te/dus gsum las 'das pa'i phyir dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba zab mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa las mngon par grub pa'i phyir ro/ /rigs kyi bu dag de lta bas na chos nyid kyis 31)bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo nyid rtogs par khong du chud pas rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par gsang sngags kyi tshul gyi / rjes su 'jug par bya'o//de nas yang bcom ldan 'das dus gsum du chags pa med pa'i stobs kyi ri gegazhi byin gyis rlob pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyan rnam thupar dag pa'i snying po can zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so / /bcom ldan 'das snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu de nas chos kyi dbyings ma 86—509

lus pa ci snyed yod pa ri3)rnam par rig par byed pa'i sgra rnams las chos kyi dbyings kyi gnas kyi ②stobs/ mi mnyam pa (kyedang mnyam pa'i stobs/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mos (gepa las byung ba/ gnas skabs bzhi dbyangs rmonacigacig las byung bas chos kyi dbyings thams cad khyab par byas khyate/nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur nas byung ba/ na maḥsab (7ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sab shā'atsho/ a 991ā i aḥ0/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi snying po de dag byung ma thag tu/ de nas yang chos kyi dbyings thams cad nges par sgrogs 17pa'i sgo dag nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi snying po'i ⑫ tshig gis mtshan pa 12rnam par rig pa'i dbyangs ④kyi sgra gcig 7nas gcig tu mngon par grag go/ /byang chub sems dpas de thos nas/ /ngo mtshar ⑩gyur pa'i mig phye 7ste/ /kun mkhyen bsnyan 12dang bral ba la/ /tshig snyan 'di skad ces gsol to/ /e ma'o gsang sngags spyad pa las/ /sangs rgyas rkang gnyis mchog rnams kyis/ /gang gis 'di kun khyab pa yi/ /ye shes yangs pa chen po byung 1rto/ /de bas rnam pa thams cad du/ /sangs rgyas bsngags pa'i snying po la/ /nang gi bdag nyid rnam dag pas/ /rtag tu mngon par brtson par bya/ /de nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi snying po ( )rnams 1sgrub pa byung 2nyaste/skyed lhamos tshal lam/ gtsug lag khang ngam tsho/ phug gam/ yid gang du dben pa der byang chub kyi sems bsgom 22zhing / nam mtshan ma ma byung gi bar de srid 2 du 'dug par bya'o/ /de nas snying po de dag las gang 8rung ba cig gzung ste 9/ the tsom med par gyur gyi bar du gzhi bsgrub par bya'o/ /de nas snying po :snying gar bzhag nas yid bsgrub par bya ste/ shin tu rnam 86—510

par dag pa/ dri ma med pa brtan (17pa rab tu mi g.yo ba/ rnam par mi rtog pa/me long lta bu/ rab tu phra ba la mngon par snyibalta zhing rtag tu goms pa'i sbyor bas rang gi lus rang gi lha'i lus su mthong gi bar du bya'o/ /gzhi gnyis pa ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas me long gi dkyil 'khor de nyid kyi nang na ④padma'i rgyal po chen po la bzhugs pa phug na bzhugs pa lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa/ thor tshugs dang dbu rgyan dang ④'od zer mtha' yas pas bskor ba/ rtog pa dang rnam par rtog pa thams cad dang bral ba/ nam mkha' bzhin gzod ma nas zhi ba ste/ de la sgra gnas par bsam zhing /mnyam par gzhag pas bzlas brjod bya/ /de nas sngon du bsnyen pa ni/ /'bum phrag gcig tu bya bar bshad/ /de nas zla ba gnyis pa la/ /me tog dri la sogs pa dbul/ /sems can rnams la rnam mang po'i/ /phan pa nye bar sgrub (ge byed cing / /rnyed dang ma rnyed rnam spangs te phyin/ /zla ba gzhan la rtsibazlas brjod bya/ /de la de ru sbyor ba 'di/ /mnyam par bzhag (85)pas bsam par bya/ /bdag gi ri9ribasod nams mthu yis ni/ /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /thams cad nad kyang med par shog /yang na de bzhin gshegs bsngags ri pa'i/ /'dod pa phun sum tshogs gyur cig /yang na sems can thams cad kyang / /re ba thams cad yongs rdzogs pa/ /sgrib pa med pa'i tshul gyis su/ /ma thogs par ni grub par shog /dud 'gro gcig la gcig za ba'i/ /sdug bsngal nam yang 'byung ma gyur/ /yi dgas 511rnams la zas skom sogs/ /thogs pa med par 'byung bar rigashog /sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal gang / /mi bzad rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /bdag gi bsod nams mthu yis ni/ /de dag myur du zhi 86—511

bar gyur/ /sems can sdug bsngal thams cad la①/ /snying rje chen po bskyed nas ni/ /bsgrub ②pa de dang gzhan dag kyang / /des ni yang dang yang du bsam / /ci ltar bsams ②pa 'grub bya'i phyir④/ /byin gyis brlabs kyi ⑤gnas gsum gyis/ /de dag thams cad byin brlab yicing / /yid la sngags kyang bzlas brjod bya/ /bdag gi ⑦bsod nams stobs dang ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin stobs dang / /chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs kyis su/ /sems can rnams la phan 'dogs 90pas/ /don rnams gang dag bsams ⑨pa kun/ /sems can khams ni ma lus 'dir/ /de dag thams cad ci rigs par/ /thogs pa med par 'byung gyur 7cig /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe rig sngags kyi nyarjergyal mo stobs nam mkha' dang 'dra ba nam mkha'i mdzod 'byung ba gsungs so/ /na maḥsasba 7ta thā ga te bhyo bi boshwa mu khe bhyaḥbisarba tad khaṃ utpa te spha ra ṇa i 8me ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ 'di 7lan gsum bzlas na ci ltar bsams ⑩pa'i don thams cad thogs pa med par 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas zla ba nya ba'i tshe/ /mi de sgrub nyunyal 'jug par bya/ /ri rtse dang ni ba lang lhas/ /chu mdo'am yang na dur 37khrod dam/ /lam gyi bzhi ḍa rtemado'am shing gcig drung / 5 /ma mo'i gnas sam zhi ‘ 7gnas su/ /bgegs rnams thams cad myos 'gyur ba'i//dkyil 'khor des pas mnyan par gyis/ /kun tu gru bzhi lham pa ste/ /sgo gcig pa la mu ran can/ /thams cad kha dog ser po yis/ /rdo rje'i (snyedakyil 'khor mchog bris nas/ /rdo rje sbrel ba'i tshul gyis su/ /rdo rje 3 phan tshun 'brel bar bya/ /sgor ni sgo srung gi 7gnyis bri ba/ ci /gdul dka' dang ni mngon phyogs gnyis/ /mig dmar khro dang bcas pa la/ /khros shing sdigs gi par byed 86—512

pa ②bri/ /mdung rtse gsum sa grwa ②rnams su/ /nan tan du ni bri bar bya/ /dbus su rdo rje'i gdan yid 'ong / /kha ni kun tu blta ba ②bri/ /de'i steng padma chen po ni/ /'dab ma brgyad pa ge sar ④bcas/ /rgyal ba kun la phyag byas nas/ /smon lam nye bar sgrub byed cing / /phyag na rdo rje blo can gyidu/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgya bcings nas su/ / der ni bsrung ⑥byas der 'dug ste/ /sbyangs ⑦pa'i rdzas ni blangs nas su/ /nang gi bdag nyid rnam dag pas/ /mtshan gcig thal byung bzlas brjod bya/ /der ni nam gyi phyed dus sam/ /yang na nyi ma 'char ba'i tshe/ /rdzas de yongs su 'gyur ba ni/ /'bar phreng can gyi ⑧gzi brjid bzhin/ /sngags pa rang gis de blangs na/ /nam mkha' la ni 'gro bar 'gyur / /bskal par gnas shing gzi brjid che/ /rgyal sras de ni 'dod na 'chil / /'jig rten khams ni gzhan du'ang 'gro/ /gtso bo sna tshogs gzugs 'chang ba/ /rdzas las byung ba'i sngags bsgrubs pas/ /dpal ldan mchod pa ⑩rab tu byed/ /'di ni nyams par mi 'gyur ba'i/ /rdzas kyi dngos grub yin par bshad/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de la brtag pa 'di rgyu mtshan du mdzad nas/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thabs ‘/3kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rtogs par thugs su chud pa rnams kyi brtag mapa de nyid rang bzhin gyis stong par mkhyen kyang thabs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i stobs kyis 'dus ma byas pa gdags par btags nyu te/ yongs su bsgyur ba'i tshul du mthong ba'i chos la bde bar gnas par bya ba'i phyir/ chos kyi dbyings kyi mthu rlabs po che sems can rnams la nges par ston te'i/ des de rnams yid rab tu dga' zhing mtshe 86—513

ring po yang rab tu thob nas/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dag gis ༅rtse dga' yongs su spyod pa(ge/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la mchod ④cing 'jig rten thams cad dang mi mthun pa'i lam 'di grub (gepar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 57dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis kyang don gyi dbang 'di gzigs nas/ gsang sngags spyad (7pa'i tshul gyi cho ga thugs dgyes bzhin du 'chad do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gang bskal pa du mar stsol 97zhing 'bad de bya dka' ba rnams brtsams kyang 'thob pon par mi 'gyur ba de byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa rnams kyi (she)tshe 'di gcig bekho na la 'thob 11par 'gyur ro/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i 32rgyal mtshan nam/ ral gri'am/ gdugs sam / mchil lham mamanyan/ yid bzhin gyi thunor bu'am/ lig bu mig gam/gi'u sa wang blangs te/ bzlas brjod sum 'bum byas la 7de ltar bsgrubs na de bzhin du 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po gzhan yang rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo thabs dang ldan pas yid la 'dod pa'i dngos po rnams bsgrubs 1 na/ de dag rang gi sems kyi dbang tsam kho nas yongs su 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po gang dag rgyu las 'bras bu mngon par 'dod pa'i mi blun po de dag ni/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po gsang sngags rnams kyi gsang sngags 1 mtshan nyid rab tu mi shes pa yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/rgyu ni byed par ma gsungs te/ /'bras bu'ang de la yod ma yin/ /rgyu ni rgyu yis stong pa 19na/ /de ni ci ltar rgyur yang 'gyur/ /de bas gsang sngags 86—514

'bras bu ni/ /rgyu dang las bral ①shes par bya/ /gang tshe mtshan ma med pa yi/ /ting 'dzin ci lta bzhin reg pa/ /de tshe sngags pas dngos grub ni/ /yid las yang dag byung ba 'thob②/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das la phyag na rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gzhi rnams dngos grub tu bsgrub (kyepa'i tshig gang gis rigs kyi bu dang ⑤rigs kyi bu mo rnams mthong ba'i chos nyid la rab tu dga' zhing bde ba la reg par gnas la/ chos kyi (pedabyings las /nesakyang 'gal bar mi 'gyur ba de yang bshad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das de ci'i slad du zhe na/ chos kyi dbyings ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings lags te/ de yang de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis bstan to/ /bcom ldan 'das de lta lags pas byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pas na rimachos kyi dbyings dbyer med pa (8)rtogs par khong du chud par bgyi 'tshal lo/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis phyag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po legs so legs so/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po gang khyod de bzhin gshegs pa la don 'di yongs su dri bar sems pa de 9༄ni yang legs so/ /de'i phyir nyon la legs par rab tu yid la zung shig ri dang ngas khyod la bshad do/ /bcom ldan 'das legs so zhes gsol nas/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje nyu bcom ldan 'das la ltar nyan 12pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de la a zhes bya ba'i sgrub pa 'byung 1 ste/gtsug lag khang ngam phug gam/ gnas gang choyang rung ste yan lag thams cad 86wa 515

du ①ma zhes bya ba gzhag la bzlas brjod sum ②'bum bya'o/ /de nas zla ba nya ba'i tshe ci 'byor pas mchod pa byas la ci nisrid du byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'am/ 'jam dpal lam/ rdo rje 'dzin chen po gang yang rung ba zhig 'ongs te④/ mgo la nyug gam legs so zhes zer gyi bar du bzlas brjod bya'i⑤/de nas phyag byas te mchod yon phul na ⑥byang chub kyi sems mi brjed pa'i ting nge 'dzin thob par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhine du sems yang ba dang / lus yang ba ⑦goms par bya zhing bzlas brjod byas na de'i lus rnam par dag pa dang /sems rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /a zhes bya ba rnam par ⑧bzhag ste/bzlas brjod byas na rna ba rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /'on te srog gzung bar 'dod na a zhes bya ba srog dang lhan cig tu byas la dus gsum du bsam ⑨pa byas na yun ring du gnas par 'gyur ro/ /de nyid kyi steng du klad 0kor gzhag na gnas pa dang 'gro ba'i dug thams cad 'byin (1to/ /de nas gzi can dbang du bya bar 'dod na/ a zhes byas pa 7bdag tu byas/ /pa las de bzhin mi dbang po/ /gcig 32la padma gzhag par bya/ /gzhan la yang ni dung bzhag ste/ / gcig la gcig 7ni gdong bltas na/ /de yi mod la dbangari du 'gyur / /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor 'dus pa la gzigs nas gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/ lag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs las byung ba zhes bya ba/ las dang 7bya bas rnam par rol pa 8spyod pa'i rol mo rim par phye ba rgyas pa khams bzhi yang dag par bsdu bar 3 tshobasdu sa pa/ sems kyi rgyal po la gnas pa/ nam mkha' ltar kun tu khyab 32pa/ mthong ba dang ma mthong ba'i 86—516

'bras bu mang ba/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi ①mngon sum pa/ gsang sngags kyi sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa rnams kyi re ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa②/las sna tshogs dang ldan pa/ sems can thams cad la phan 'dogs pa yod kyisani/ de nyon la legs par rab tu yid la zung shig (gedang / ngas khyod la bshad do/ /lag na rdo rje de la spyod pa'i rol mo las dang bya ba ⑤mngon par 'grub pa'i 'bras bu phal che ba/ lus can kun kyi mngon sum pa gang zhe na/cho ga shes pas thog mar ni/ /bdag gi de nyid rim (yibazhin bya/ /sngags pa snga ma bzhin 'dug la/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dran byas te/ /bdag nyid a zhes bya ba ni/ /klad kor bcas dang rgyas byas pa/ /thams cad shin tu ser zhing bzang ske/ /gru bzhi rdo rjes ⑦mtshan byas te/ /sngags pas der gnas rdzogs pa yisani/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gtso bo bsam/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /bdag gi de nyid yin par gsungs/ /nam zhig sngags pas bdag gi ⑨ni / /de nyid dogs pa med gyur pa57/ /de tshe 'jig rten thams cad la/ /phan pa byed pa nyid du 'gyur/ /ngo mtshar sna tshogs dag dang ldan/ /mig 'phrul can gyi gnas la 'dug /sngags pa nam zhig mnyam bzhag /ston/ /srid pa rab tu dog 8pa na/ /thog med dus nas mi shes pas/ /bsags pa'i las de kun zad 'gyur/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub sems/ /sems de nam zhig sgom byed pa/ /de /nyetshe'ang sngags pa rnal 'byor pa/ /chu yis 57padma lta bur ni/ /dge dang mi dge 'bras 'byung ba'i/ /las kyi rtog pas nyugemi gos na/ /'di bdag nyid ni rgyal mchog tu/ /bsgyur na smos kyang ci zhig dgos// //86—517

bam po bzhi pa/nyu) de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang ②mdzad bdud bzhi las rgyal ba rdo rje rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ②la snyoms par zhugs nas/ rdo rje'i yi ge'i tshig ④bdud bzhi las rgyal bar ⑤byed pa/ rgyud ⑥drug las rnam par grol bar byed pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yongs su rdzogs par byed pa 'di rnams gsungs so/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ a bī ⑦ra hūṃ khaṃ/ de nas yang gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje dang / rdo rje 'dzin de dag dang / byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po la sogs pa de dag dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor 'dus pa de dag thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur nas/ mig mi 'dzums (nyapar thams cad mkhyen pa la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ tshig 'di skad ces brjod do/ /byang chub sems dpa' skyob rnams dang ske/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi nor gyi dbyig /'dis ni gang dag sangs rgyas dang ske/ /byang chub sems dpa' skyob rnams dang / /rang sangs rgyas dang nyan thos pa/ /mkhas pas 99)de dag 'jig rten 'dir/ /sangs rgyas ye shes bla med pa / /dpe med ye shes thob nas su/ /rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs rnam 'phrul pas/ /sa steng 1 kun tu rnam par spyod/ /de bas 'di dag so so yi/ /cho ga rgyas pa dag dang las/ /sna tshogs dgod pa thams cad kyang / /bstan pa 'di la bshad du gsol/ /des ni gsang sngags spyod pa yi11/ /theg chen bla na med pa la / /sems can rnams ni dga' bzhin du/ /mthong ba'i chos la gnas par 'gyur / /de skad 12gsol nas bcom ldan gyis12/ /'jam pa'i gsung gis bka' stsal pa/ /khyed rnams mthun 1 tshopar rtse ga'ig 15tu/ /mnyam par zhog la 'di nyon cig /de'i tshe sa gzhi rdo rje chen por byin gyis brlabs te/ nyid kyi 86—518

sku las byang chub kyi snying po tu)nye bar bstan par bzhed nas gsungs pa/ a ni mchog tu shes bya ba/ /dbang chen dkyil 'khor ldan pa ste/ /phyi rol dang ni nang du yang / /rdo rje dkyil 'khor shes par bya/ /der 'dug nas ni thams cad bsam/ /rnal 'byor gnas zhes ②bshad pa yin/ /a ni srog gi dam pa ste / /'gugs ②par byed pa'i mchog tu bshad/ /nam zhig klad ④kar gyis mnan na/ /lus can kun gyi (shesel bar 'gyur/ /sngags pas nam yizhig zla gcig tu/ /rdo rje can gyis rgya bcings nas/ /dus gsum bzlas brjod byas na ni/ /mi shes grong khyer 'joms par 'gyur/ /lha dang lha min rnams kyis kyang —/ /mi phyed shin tu brtan par 'gyur/ /bdag nyid (bernyed pa grub bya'i phyir / /rgyas pa'i las nini gang cung zad/ /de kun rtag tu sngags pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni dbus su bya/ /gser gyi kha dog 'bar dang bcas/ /thor tshugs dbu rgyan 〈pe'achang ba yi/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ting 'dzin zhugs7/ /dbang chen gyi ni gzhi zhes bya/ /rdo rje padma ral gri dang / /de bzhin dang par bshad pa dang / /gser dag dang ni sa dag hu1dang / /yang na yid bzhin nor bu'ang rung / /de la sogs pa'i rdzas rnams ni/ /dbang chen du ni bsgoms te bsgrub/ /mnan nyugepa dag kyang bshad par bya51snye/ /'di ni khyod 8kyis mnyam bzhag mnyon/ /sngags pas mdor na ri rab ni/ /rtse mo brgyad pa bsam par bya / / de yi 7steng du padma gzhag /de yi rjes la rdo rje'o/ /de'i steng rnal 'byor pa yis ni/ /yi ge dam pa gtso bo ste/ /de yis spyi bor mnan na ni/ /de ni mi g.yo gnas par 'gyur/ /sman la yang ni lan brgya ru/ /bzlas brjod byas te mis 'thungs na/ /sngon gyi las las byung ba yi/ /de yi nad rnams 86—519

'byang ①bar 'gyur/ /de nas gzhan yang des pa yis/ /ba zhes bya ba dam pa nyon / /gangs dang 'o ma dung 'dra ba/ /lte ba'i dbus nas byung ba ste/ /padma dkar po 'dab ma ni②/ /de yi dbus na rab tu gnas/ /mgon po dam pa rab tu zhi/ /ston ku'i zla ba'i 'od dang 'dra/ /de yi dkyil 'khor ngo mtshar can / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis bshad/ /kun tu dkar po ①bsam par bya/ /khyud kor 'o/rim pa dgus kyang bskor/ / gdung ba ⑤thams cad zhi byed pa/ /smug zil 'dus pa'i nang na gnas/ /'o ma mu tig phreng yidakar dang ske/ /shel dang zla ba'i 'od 'dra ba'i/ /chu rgyun rnams kyis khor (7yug tu/ /kun nas rab tu 'bab pa (nyebazhin/ /sngags pas yid la bsams na ni/ /gdung ba kun las thar bar 'gyur/ /mnyam par gzhag pas dngos 'di rnams//dkyil 'khor 'dir ni bsgrub (9)par bya/ /mar sar 0'o ma mu tig phreng / /de bzhin khyu mchog shel kyang rung / /zho phonya'am yang na chu yang rung / /de la sogs pa'i rdzas rnams ni/ /dngos grub sna tshogs grub 1 phyir bsgrubatuste/ /tshe ni ring bar 'gyur ba dang / /gzugs ni ngo mtshar cher 'gyur dang / /nad rnams kun las thar ba dang / /skal ba bzang po mchog 'gyur dang / /yid rno 'dzin par nus pa dang / /shes rab shin tu dri med patsha/ /sgrub 7pa'i rdzas ni 'di rnams kyis/ /de dag thams cad myur du 'grub/ /dkyil 'khor dpal dang ldan pa 'di / /zhi bar byed par bshad pa yin/ / klad kyi kor yidang bcas byas na/ /sel bar byed pa'i mchog tu 'gyur/ /ra zhes bya ba yang dag mchog /'od can rnams kyi 'od ces bya/ /des ni las rnams gang cung zad/ /mtshams med lnga las byung ba yang / /rnal 'byor shin tu mnyam gzhag nas/ /86—520

bsams na de kun zad par 'gyur/ /yid 'ong ①thams cad rab tu dmar/ /gru gsum pa yi tshul du gnas/ /zhi ba 'bar ba'i phreng bas 'khrigs/ /sum mdo'i ris ②mtshan snying gar dugazhag /rnal 'byor pa ni der 'dug nas/ /ra ④ni klad kor bcas par bsam/ /mi 'jigs pas ni ci rigs par/ /dngos po de rgyadag des 0sgrub ⑦bo/ /nyi ma dang ni gza' kun dang / /de bzhin bsgrims te me dang ni/ /dbang du bya ba'i rdzas rnams dang / /yang na 'khon par du'agyur ba dang / /bskam ⑨pa dang ni gsad 57pa dang / /de bzhin dgar dang gnod pa dag /me dang lhan cig 'di sbyar na/ /de dag thams cad byed ⑩par 'gyur/ /ha zhes bya ba dam pa mchog /rlung ni thams cad yang dag 'byung / /rgyu dang las dang 'bras bu dang / /gang gis sa bon rnams skye btso/ /'di ni klad kor bcas sbyar na/ /de dag thams cad 'jig tu par byed/ /de yi gzugs kyang bshad pa ni④/ /kha dog nag mal 'od po che/ /mi bzad 'bar ba'i phreng bas 'khrigs/ /kun tu yang ni rnam par 'phrog⑩ /mkhas pas smin ma'i mtshams 7su ni/ /dkyil 'khor la ni gnas par bsam/ /de ni mthing ga /shezla gam 'dra/ /tog tsodang bcas par ba dan g.yo/ /yi ge rab tu mi 'gyur ba//sngags pas der gnas bsam par bya/ /dkyil 'khor de yi dbus su ni/ /gang gis mthong ba kho na la/ /sems can rnams kyi don byed pa'i/ /dngos po 4 starnams ni de tshe bsgrubaso1/ /mkha' la 'gro ba nyid dang ni/ /yang na rdzu 'phrul rkang pa dang / /lha yi mig dang rna ba dang / /sngags pas de bzhin 'thob pa dang / /mi snang ba la sogs kun dang / /dbye ba dag kyang gang gsungs pa/ /sngags pa rga mnyam par gzhag pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor gnas na de kun byed/ /86—521

'di ni snying po byang chub 'dir/ /byang chub sems dpa' grags chen rnams/ /rgyu kun dmigs su med sgo nas/ /bdud las rnam par rgyal bar byed/ /rgyu med pas na 'bras bu'ang med/ /las kyang yod pa ma yin te/ /dngos po de gsum med pas na/ /stong pa'i ye shes thob ①par 'gyur/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mthu chen gyis/ /de'i gzugs yang dag bshad pa ni/ /klad kor bcas par ldan pa ste/ /khaṃ ②ni stong pa'i mchog ces bya/ /ral gri phyag rgyar ldan pa yis / /bsgrub tsha par bya ba nges par bsgrub④/ /ral gri zhags pa 'khor lo dang ske/ /lcags mda' de bzhin tho ba ste/ /rdzas de rnams dang ldan na ni/ /go 'phang dam pa sgrub par byed/ /de nas yang 95)bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po nam byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pas bdag nyid a zhes bya ba'i rang gi ngo bor bsgyur nas / phyi dang nang du bcas pa'i dngos po thams cad la mi lta (6)bar gyur cing /bong ba dang rdo ba 7dang gser du mtshungs 98)la/ 'dod chags dang zhe sdang la sogs pa'i nyes pa rnams dang / sdig pa'i las rnam par spangs pa/ de tshe de ni dag 'gyur ba99/ /thub pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bzhin/ /des ni 7las rnams thams cad nus/ /nyes pa thams cad rnam par spangs/ /de nas gzhan sngags rnal 'byor la/ /gzhol zhing cho ga shes pa yis/ /sems can rnams la phan 'dod pas/ /ba zhes bya ba'i las bya'o/ /snying rje las byung sems kyis ni//'jig rten sdug bsngal la dmigs nas/ /mgon po de yis bdag nyid kyi/ /lus ni thams cad nyid du yang / /gangs dang ba yi 'o ma ltar/ /dkar ba'i 86—522

rgyun gyis yongs su dgang / /de tshe nges pa bskyed nas su/ /yan lag rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /ba spu'i ①bu ga kun nas kyang / /shin tu dri med chu rgyun dbyung ②/ /chu yis sa ni ma lus pa/ /'di dag yongs su dgang bar bya /gang gis chu 'di ②'thungs pa'am / /lag pas kyang ni reg kyang rung / /de kun nges par byang chub tu/ /'gyur te 'di la dogs pa med/ /yan lag kun tu ra zhes pa/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba zhi bas 'khrigs/ /kun tu rnam par 'phro ba ni / /shin tu mnyam par bzhag (gepas bsam(e/ /de tshe rnal 'byor pa yis phyir//'bar ba kun tu snang byed pa/ /btang lan ra yis rnam sprul pas/ /sngags pa 'dod pa bzhin du byed/ /ra zhes bya ba ro stod du/ /ba zhes bya ba lte ba khung kunas/ /'bar ba dang ni chu 'bab pa/ /de tshe cig char (spyodaston par 'gyur/ /dmyal ba grang ba'i sdug bsngal rnams/ /ras ni shin tu zhi bar byed/ /sngags pa sngags kyi tshul gnas pas/ /bas kyang tsha la sogs pa zhigs/ /ha zhes bya ba ba dan bcas/ /ra zhes bya ba'i 'og tu gzhag /sdig dang ldan pa'i mi rnams kyang ske/ /de yis shenalas rnams myur du bsgrubasna / /sngags pa dbang chen la 'dug nas / /chu yi las ni brtsam nyunyepar bya/ /sel ba la sogs thams cad kyang / /byed 'gyur 'di la the tsom 7med/ /rlung ni kun tu 'gro bar gsungs/ /thams cad 'jig dzapar byed pa'ang de/ /rnam pa sna tshogs tha dad pa'i/ /las rnams dbye ba las byung ba/ /gzugs kyi dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /cho ga 'di yis tsherab tu bya/ /yid yongs su sbyong zhing bzlas brjod byas na yid rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /lus yang bar goms par byed cing 'chag bzhin du bzlas brjod byas 7na rdzu 'phrul kyi rkang pa 'thob 51 par 'gyur ro/ /tsog pur 'dug la 86wa 523

a zhes bya ba rnam par bzhag ①ste/ zla ba gcig tu bzlas brjod byas ②na lha'i rna ba 'thob ②par 'gyur ro/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po dngos grub kyi go 'phang de lta bu la sogs pa dag ni yid las byung ba yin no/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po rnam par bsams ④pa tsam kho nas dngos po gzugs can ma yin pa rnams kyi 'du byed rnam pa tha dad pa sna tshogs rnams rgyalas thams cad kyi ⑥sa bon gyi bya ba tshig tu brjod pa tsam las 'byung ⑦ba la ltos/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po gzhan yang de bzhin gshegs pa duthams cad dang rjes su mthun ⑨pa sems can thams cad kyi bsam 7pa dang mthun ⑩pa sems can ⑩yang dag par mgu bar mdzad pa ste/ byang chub sems dpa' las thams cad dang gsang sngags spyad pa spyod pa rnams kyi mdun na gzugs brnyan lta bur bzhugs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de ni rnam par mi rtog cing yid kyi 7yul las yang dag par 'das pa/ dus dang yul dang bya ba dang las 3stedang chos dang chos ma yin pa rnams spangs kyang /gsang sngags spyod pa las bobyung ba'i/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang stsol/ /de bas kun mkhyen dngos grub dang / /go 'phang mchog kyang bsgrub par bya/ /de nas dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ /ngo mtshar gyur nas mig bgrad 8de/ /de tshe rdo rje 'od zer ni/ /me stag 'phro ba 'drar bogasor zhing / /sangs rgyas zhing ni 'di thams cad/ /kun tu snang bar byas nas su/ /chos kun dbang phyug thub pa la/ /tshig snyan 'di skad ces gsol to18/ /sngags kyi 'jug pa bshad lags na/ /'jug pa de yang ma rtogs na17/ /gsang sngags gang nas 'ong ba dang / /gang du 'gro ba gtso khyod kyis/ /de kun bdag la bshad du gsol/ /go 'phang dam pa khyod las med/ /khyod ni ci ltar chu rnams kyi sna/ /rgya mtsho bzhin du hūṃ sto86—524

chos kun ①gnas/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje la ②bka' stsal pa(kye/ sems dpa' chen po dkyil 'khor gyi/ /gnas ni yid ces ④bshad pa yin/ /snying ni gsang sngags gnas yin par/ /shes na 'bras bu thob ⑤par 'gyur/ /dkar po ser po dmar po gang / /yid kyis sems par byed pa ste/ /de la yongs su gcod pa gang / /de ni sems kyi yibyed pa yin/ /sems ni mgu nas nges gyur pa/ /de ni snying zhes bshad pa yin/ /der gnas pa yi gsang sngags rnams/ /'bras bu rgya cher ④ster bar 'gyur/ /de ru padma bsam pa ni/ /'dab ma brgyad pa ⑧ze bar bcas/ /a zhes bya ba 'bar phreng 'khrigasacad/ /bzang po de ru gnas pa ni/ /zhi ba kun tu rnam par g.yo/ /gtso bo sna tshogs gzugs mnga' ba/ /glog stong dag ni 'khyug pa bzhin/ /snang ba kun tu ston pa ni/ /me long phug na gnas pa ⑩bzhin/ /chu yi zla ba'i rnam pa bzhin/ /thams cad na yang mdun na gnas/ /sngags pa gsang sngags gnas 'dug pas/ /yid ni de ltar shes nas su/ /de nas sngags pas stong du yang / /klad /spepa'i rgyas kyi dbus su ni/ /klad kor bcas pa'i mtshan ma can/ /a 8zhes bya ba der bsams te/ /shel dang zla ba gangs 'dra ba/ /dri med dag pa mthong ba ni/ /zhi ba chos kyi rang bzhin sku/ /thams cad kyi ni gzhi zhes bya/ /de las gsang sngags dngos grub ni/ /sna tshogs gzugs can thob 51 par 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas mthong na/ /mtho ris dang ni byang grol 'thob57/ /ra mazhes bya ba mar me bzhin / /'bar ba mig tu bzhag tsonas su/ /mgrin pa cung zad dgu por nyu byas/ /lce yang dkan kyi la sbyar /khenas ni/ /snying ga'i dbus ri rī )su rnam blta 86—525

zhing ske/ /mnyam par bzhag ①ste yid la blta/ /dri med shin tu rnam dag pa/ /rtag tu me long bzhin du gnas/ /de nyid yid kyi yang dag par/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis gsungs/ /yid kyis snang byas lam la ni/ /rnam par shes pa snang bar 'gyur/ /de nas sngags pas rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rkang gnyis gtso bo mthong bar 'gyur/ /de mthong sngags pas dngos grub ni/ /rab tu rtag par ②thob par 'gyur/ /de nas gong du bsgyur nas su/ /yi ge yongs su bsam pa ni / /la zhes bya ba klad 9na kor bcas/ /mig gi gnas su bsam par bya/ /'di kun stong par mthong na ni/ /go 'phang mi nyams thob par 'gyur/ /ye shes rlabs po che 'am ni/ /yang na mngon shes lnga po dang / /rig sngags 'chang 'gyur dngos grub dang / /tshe ring gzhin nur 'gyur ba gang / /gal te thob par 'dod na ni/ /ci srid 'di ni ma bsnyen par/ /de srid thob par mi 'gyur rol/ /gsang sngags ye shes las byung ba/ /'di ni de nyid ye shes mchog /byang chub sems dpa' skyob pa dang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi nor gyi dbyig /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /nyan thos des pa dag dang ni / /sangs rgyas ye shes mchog gyur pa/ /ye shes dpe med thob nas su/ 5/de yis 74tshos steng 5thams cad na(6)/ /gnas shing de la (77gtam yang zer/ /rnam par snang mdzad chen po namangon par rdzogs par byang chub pa rnam par sprul pa byin gyis rlob pa las/ dngos grub bsgrub 9pa'i de kho na nyid rim par phye ba rgyas pa'o// // de nas yang bcom ldan 'das la gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes 'di 86—526

skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das lha'i gzugs gang gis byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa rnams lha'i gzugs la dmigs nas bdag nyid rang gi lha'i gzugs su bsgyur bas ②the tsom ②ma mchis par dngos grub thob par 'gyur ba'i lha'i gzugs byin gyis rlob pa ②bshad du gsol/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to / /gsang ba pa'i bdag po gang khyod nga la don 'di yongs su 'dri ba ni legs so legs so/ /de'i phyir golegs par rab tu (nyeyid la zung (6)shig dang / ngas khyod la bshad do/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar 'tshal lo zhes gsol nas/gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes (/bcom ldan 'das la nyan pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de la ⑧lha'i gzugs ni rnam pa gsum ste/ yi ge dang phyag rgya dang gzugs so/ /de la yi ge la 5)yang rnam pa gnyis te/ sgra dang byang chub kyi sems so/ /phyag rgya'i gzugs la yang tshernam pa gnyis te/ gzugs dang bcas pa dang gzugs dang bcas pa ma yin pa'o/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po lha'i gzugs kyang rnam pa gnyis te/ yongs su dag pa dang yongs su ma dag pa'o/ /de la yongs su dag pa ni mi rtog nyu )pa'i ngo bo ste/ mtshan ma thams cad dang bral ba'o/ /yongs su ma dag pa ni mtshan ma dang bcas pa'i gzugs te/ kha dog dang dbyibs so/ /de la lha'i gzugs rnam pa gnyis kyis dgos pa rnam pa gnyis 'grub par 'gyur te / mtshan ma dang bcas pas ni mtshan ma dang bcas pa'o/ /mtshan ma med pas ni mtshan ma dang bcas pa'i dngos grub kyang 'grub par 51 'gyur ro/ /86—527
