mtshan mar bcas pas mtshan bcas kyi/ /dngos grub rgyal ba dam pa bzhed/ /mtshan ma med la gnas pas ni/ /mtshan ma can yang bsgrub ①tu rung / /de bas rnam pa thams cad du/ /mtshan ma med pa bsten par bya/ /rnam par snang mdzad chen po mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa rnam par sprul pa byin gyis rlob pa las/ lha'i ting nge 'dzin gtan la dbab pa rim par phye ba'o// //de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po de la byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa/ mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin bsgrub 2par 'dod pas 'di ltar bsam par bya'o/ /mtshan ma rnams gang nas byung / ci bdag gi lus sam/ bdag gi sems sam bdag gi yid las byung / de la lus ni las las skyes pa ste/ rtswa dang shing dang bong ba lta bu ngo bo nyid kyis bya ba med pa/ blun pa'am phyi rol gyi rnam pa lta bu la bzos ( pebyas pa'i gzugs lta bur brtag snyipar bya'o/ / ci ltar bzos ⑤byas pa'i gzugs de 96)la mi zhig gis 77)khros te/ me'am/ dug gam/ mtshon tam/chu'am / rdo rjes bshig gam/ bsregs sam(8)/ bcad kyang mi dga' ba cung zad kyang med la/ bza' ba'am/ btung ba'am/ bkru ba'am/ byug pa'am3/ spos sam/ phreng ba'am/ gos sam/ tsandan nam/ ga bur ⑩la sogs pa lha 11dang mi'i yo byad rnam pa sna tshogs kyis mchod kyang mi de la dga' bar 'gyur ba dzimed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ ci gang ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i gzugs de la rang gi nga rgyal kun nas blang nya ba'i phyin ci log gis yang dag pa ma 86—528

yin pa'i rtog pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'am/ gnod par byed pa'i mi ①gang yin pa de ni byis pa'i rang bzhin can yin no/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de ltar lus la lus kyi ②rjes su song ba'i dran pa ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa bsgom par bya'o/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po gzhan yang sems ni ngo bo nyid med pa/ mtshan ma thams cad dang bral ba/ ngo bo nyid kyis stong par bsam par bya'o/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po sems la ni dus gsum med do/ /dus gsum dang bral ba gang yin pa de ni ngo bo nyid kyis mtshan ma dang bral ba'o snyam du bsam par bya'o/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po gzhan yang byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams yid mtshan ma dang bcas par rtog ste0/ 'di ni yang dag pa ma yin pa'i kun tu rtog ④pa'i tshig bla dgas ⑤so/ /yang dag pa ma yin pa gang yin pa de ni ma skyes pa'o zhes bya bar ni rab tu mi shes so/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pas de ltar bsams na mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin thob par 'gyur ro/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po nam mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas par gyur pa de'i tshe/ de la de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa'i gsang sngags rnams mngon du phyogs shing gzhol bar 'gyur ro/ /rnam par snang mdzad chen po mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa rnam par sprul pa byin gyis rlob pa las/ mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin rim par phye ba'o// //gsang ba pa'i bdag po gzhan yang bzlas brjod gsang ba bshad par bya'o/ /gcig pus gcig gam gcig gis gcig /yid kyis 6)bzlas brjod bya ba'am/ /86—529

yang na shub bu ①rnam gnyis pa(kye/ /rnal 'byor mchog gis brtag par bya/ /sngags pa yan lag nyams zhu) sbyar bar④/ /bzlas brjod gzhan du mi bya'o/ /phyi dang nang gi sbyor ba yis/ /yan lag bzhi pa ⑤ngas bshad pa/ /de yang 'jig rten pa yi ste/ /dmigs pa can ni bla med pa'oyi/ /slar sdud pa yi ⑦tshig gis non / /lha yi rjes su song ba'i yid/ /bshubs (8)te bzlas brjod byed pa'i ⑨mchog /dmigs pa can la bstan pa yin/ /yid kyi 'jig rten 'das shes bya / /slar sdud tshel sogs rnam par spangs/ /lha dang gcig tu byed pa dang / /tha dad ma yin 'dzin pa yi17/ /yid kyis 7rang bzhin dbyer med bya/ /gzhan du bya ba ma yin no/ /gsang sngags grangs ni sum 'bum du/ /phal cher ngas ni bshad pa dag /lus can sdig dang bral ba yi/ /sngags pa rnam par dag pa la//bzlas brjod grangs ni 12bstan pa ste/ /gzhan du bya ba ma yin no/ /rnam par snang mdzad chen po mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa rnam par sprul pa byin gyis rlob pa las/ 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bzlas brjod kyi de kho na nyid rim par phye ba'o// ///rdo/de ///do ///kyi ring nas yang ba ma ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad sa thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor 'dus pa la gzigs nas/ byams pa dang snying rje chen po'i spyan gnyis kyis kyang sems can gyi khams thams cad la gzigs te/ bdud rtsi 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu yan lag thamus cad nas dus gsum du ma chags pa'i stobs can zhes bya ba'i rig sasngags kyi rgyal mo 'byung 7ngo / /tabya 86—530

thā/ ga ga na sa me/ a pra ti sa me/ sarba ta thā ga ta sa ma tā nu lho rig ga te/ga ga na ba ra lakṣa ṇi ②swā hā/ rigs kyi bu rig (kyisngags kyi rgyal mo 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gnyis su med pa'i spyod yul can te/'di yis byin brlabs ④sangs rgyas dang / /byang chub sems dpa' grags chen rnams / /gang du sdug bsngal 'gag 'gyur ba'i/ /chos nyid chags med thob (gepar 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rjes su dgongs nas/ bdag nyid dang phyag na rdo rje gnyi ga ⑥gzod ma nas ma skyes pa nyid du byin gyis brlabs te/ phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa rdo rje 'dzin rnams la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu dag byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa rnams la sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pas rigaso sor nye bar gnas pa'i yi ge (8༄'khor lo bskor ba zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor spyad pa rim par phye ba rgyas par (7༄nyon cig /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad la phyag na rdo rjes phyag 'tshal te/ rdo rje'i 7padma'i stan de las rdo rje dbab 17pa'i tshul du babs 1genas bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod pa/ phyag 'tshal byang chub sems khyod nyunyel/ /phyag 'tshal byang chub 'byung khyod la/ /spyod gzugs khyod :chodang sa dang ni/ /pha rol phyin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag 'tshal thog mar byed khyod la/ /stong pa nyid la 'dud phyag 'tshal/ /bcom ldan 'das la gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes de skad du skemangon par bstod nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rje bdag cag la thugs brtse ba'i slad du/gang dag dang ldan na bdag cag rnams sems can gyi don bgyid 17par 'gyur ba 86—531

dang ske/ gsang sngags spyad pa ci skad gsungs pa bzhin yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba bshad du gsol/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /nga ni 'jig rten dang po yi/ /'jig rten mgon zhes bsgrags pa yin/ /bla med gzod nas zhi ba ni/ /mnyam pa med pa'i chos bshad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad pa de ①dag gsungs nas / byin gyi rlabs ②gang gis byin du ②brlabs na byang chub sems dpa' de rnams dang / rdo rje 'dzin de rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi snying po mchog dam pa la bzhugs pa nam mkha' bzhin du spros pa med pa/ spyod pa la gnyis su med pa'i rnal 'byor gyi mtshan nyid las kyi rnam par smin pa bzhin du mthong bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i byin gyis brlab pa stimadzad do/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi yan lag dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku thams cad nas 'a jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa rnams dang / nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang snyi/ bsam pa dang bsam gtan du bya ba dang / dngos grub bsgrub ⑥par mngon par brtson pa thams cad kyi (pesrog dang 'dra ba/ yi ge thams cad kyi 'tsho bar 781gyur pa/ srog tu gyur pa/7 skyabs su gyur pa/ dpung gnyen du gyur pa 'di byung bongo / /na maḥs manta bud dhā dzā/ a/ rigs kyi bu dag 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa/ byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa rnams la sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa nya so sor nye ba ra gnas pa yin te/ chos thams cad ni a zhes bya ba'i sgo nas 'jug go/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de lta 86—532

bas na byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa de bzhin gshegs pa rnams mthong bar 'dod pa dang / mchod par 'dod la ①byang chub kyi sems mngon sum ②bya bar 'dod pa/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang 'grogs par 'dod pa/ sems can rnams kyi don bya bar 'dod pa/ dngos grub mngon par 'dod pa/ rnam pa thams cad du rnam pa ③thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'dod pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi ④snying po 'di la brtson par bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis snying rje chen po'i snying po 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal po 'di'i cho ga dgod pa dang / lha'i gnas gtan la dbab pa dang / ting nge 'dzin rnam par sprul pa dang / gsang sngags spyad pa dang / bsam par bya ba gsungs pa de la ⑤slob dpon gyis thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sgo a zhes bya ba la gnas te srad bu blangs la/ sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag byas (6)nas srad bu shar phyogs logs gsu bres te g.yas su bskor la/ byang phyogs su kha bltas nas srad bu bres te④/ nub phyogs su kha bltas la bsgyur te thig gdab bo/ /de nas bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa' lag na rdo rjer de'i phyag rgya'am/ yi ge ba zhes bya bas byin gyis brlabs nyunyete/ nang du zhugs la snying po'i dkyil 'khor bri 7bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du dkyil 'khor gnyis pa la yung 'di ltar bdag nyid gzod hunyem nas zhi ba/ gnyis su med pa'i rnal 'byor gyi gzugs/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs snying po 7nyid kyi rang gi ngo bor byin gyis brlabs la/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas pa mngon du byed cing srad bu bres la/ phyi rol gyi dkyil 'khor de las sum nyu gnyis lha'i gnas su bzhag ste/ sum cha 'khor 886—533

sar bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor lhag ma gnyis kyang de bzhin du rnam par phye la lha'i gnas bsham ①par bya'o/ /de nas yang bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad du de'i phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs laphyi/ chos kyi dbyings rgya chen por byin gyis brlabs te/ thog mar tshon ②rtsi dkar po blangs la 'di ltar byin gyis brlab ④par bya'o/ /'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni rnam sbyong bal/ /'di 97ni bdag nyid de bzhin gshegs/ /nyes pa thams cad rnam par spangs/ /de ltar blo can gyis bsams na / /der ni ra zhes bya ba yang / /zhi ba 'bar ba'i gaphreng can mdog /dung zla kunda 'dra ba bsamakha/ /de nas tshon 7rtsi gnyis pa ni/ /dmar po blangs nas nan tan du/ /yi ge a zhes bya ba ni/ /'bar ba klad kor rka/skrebacas par bsam/ /rgyal ba thub dka' dam pa ste/ /nyi ma dang por 3gye'achar ba bzhin/ /de nas sngags pas tshon gsum pa/ /kha dog ser po blang bar bya/ /mkhas pas de nas ga zhes pa/ /de tshe cho ga bzhin du bsam/ /de bzhin gser 'od thub pa ni/ /gser gyi kha dog 'bar dang bcas/ /ting 'dzin gnas shing sdig bcom pa/ /kun tu rnam par snang ba yin/ /de nas 7mar gad 'dra ba yi/ /tshon rtsi 'khor ba las sgrol ga /ba zhes bya ba de ru gzhag /byang chub snying po'i thub chen temi/ / dpa' bo 7kha dog ljang tsha'adra ba/ /kun tu 'jigs pa med par byed/ /de nas tshon rtsi nag po de/ /mkhas pa yis 1 ni blangs nas su/ /der ni ha zhes bya ba kyi bsam/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba rnam par 'phro/ /dus mtha'i me ltar mi bzad 17pa/ /lag na rdo rje rtse bran rgyan / /bdud sde snang ba thams cad la/ /rnam pa kun tu sdigs tsho 1par byed/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad de'i tshe sa 86wa 534

ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs nas mtha' yas ①rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad ting nge 'dzin de la ②snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu thams cad du thogs pa med pa'i stobs zhes bya ba'i rig ②sngags kyi rgyal mo de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yul las byung ④ba 'di phyung ⑤ngo / /na maḥsarba ⑥ta thā ga te bhyaḥl/sab 6)mu khe dhibhyaḥ/ a sa me ba ra me/ a tsa le/ ga ga ne/ sma ra ṇi0/sarba ⑩tā nu ga te swā hā/ de nas tshon gyi cho ga byin gyis brlabs nas/ bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bklags /nyesam/ phyag byas te/rig 8sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di lan brgyad du bzlas brjod bya'o/ /de nas langs te dkyil 'khor bskor la nang du zhugs nas/ byams pa chen po dang snying rje chen po'i stobs kyis sgrub pa po la dmigs te/ bdag nyid ba zhes bya bas las kyi 8rdo rje sems dpar 8byin gyis brlabs la/ rdo rje dam pa sbyin pa dang lhan cig tu snying rje chen po'i snying po 'byung ba'i ri dkyil 'khor bri bar bya'o/ /de la nang gi dkyil 'khor gtan la dbab pa ni 'di yin te/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen po padma dkar po la bzhugs pa/ dbu thor tshugs dang dbu rgyan can/ dar ram 3 ras kyi nyu smad g.yogs dang / dar la'i stod g.yogs mnabs nyu7pa/ gser gyi kha dog lta bu 2 zhi'abar ba'i phreng bas 'khrigs pa/ phyag rgya'am gzugs sam yi ge'i 'brur bri'ori :/ /a/ shar phyogs su sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos sku'i ngo bo ri /a zhes bya ba klad sa kor dang bcas pa'o/ /iri sgo/ dbang ldan naphyogs su sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yum bcom ldan 'das ma nam mkha'i spyan bri'o/ /yang na yi ge ga zhes bya ba bri'o/ /86wa 535

ga /me'i phyogs su byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi phyag rgya yid ①bzhin gyi nor bu'am yi ge ka zhes bya ba bri'o/ /ga② /byang phyogs su lag na padma 'khor byang chub sems dpa' skye ba gcig ③gis thogs pa dag dang lhan cig tu padma'i phyag rgya'am/ yi ge sa zhes bya ba bri'o/ /sa/ lho phyogs su cha gsum bor te/gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje 'khor dang bcas pa ④rdo rje'i phyag rgya'am yi ge ba zhes bya ba bri'o/ /ba/ de'i cha gsum bor ⑤la rdo rje 'chang thams cad kyi phyag rgya'am yi ger bri'o/ / de la yi ge'i 'bru ni/⑥ // de nas bden bral gyi phyogs su stibacom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi 'og logs su mi g.yo ba pha bong gi steng na 'dug pa/ lag na ral gri (gyedang zhags pa thogs pa/ 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa/ bgegs thams cad la bsdigs ⑨pa de'i phyag rgya'am yi ger bri'o/ /de'i yi ge'i 'bru ni haṃ/ rlung gi phyogs su 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba bgegs chen po 'joms pa/ gyen du 'bar ba'i phreng ba can/ rab tu 'jig ⑩pa chen po'i dus kyi me'i gzugs 'dra ba/'jigs pa yang 'jigs par byed pa/ lag na rdo rje nyalha'od 'phro ba can thogs pa de'i phyag rgya'am yi ge 7bri'o/ /de la yi ge'i 'bru ni 'di'o/ /ha/ de nas phyogs bzhir srung ba chen mo 1nyabazhi dgod do/ /de la shar phyogs su mi 'jigs pa zhes bya ba'i srung nya ba chen mo 1snyegaser gyi kha dog 'dra ba gos dkar po gyon pa/yid tsam khro bo'i tshagadong lag na dbyug pa thogs pa de'i phyag rgya'am yi ger bri'o//de la yi ge'i 'bru ni 'di'o/ /tsa/ byang phyogs su ni bo'ajigs pa thams cad med par byed 18pa zhes bya ba'i srung ba kha dog dkar mo/ lag na ral gri thogs shing gos dkar po gyon pa/ 'bar ba dang bcas pa 'jigs pa thams cad med nyurte86—536

pa de'i phyag rgya'am yi ger 7bri'o/ /de la yi ge'i 'bru ②ni 'di'o/ /pani/nub phyogs su gdul dka' zhes bya ba'i srung ④ba/ a sho ka dmar po'i mdog 'dra ba/ gos dmar po gyon pa/ bzhin 'dzum pa/ thams cad dang ①ldan pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor la blta ⑥ba de'i phyag rgya'am yi ger bri'o/ /de la yi ge'i 'bru ⑦ni 'di'o/ /sa/ lho phyogs su ma thul ba rdo rjes 'dul ba zhes bya ba'i srung ba nichen mo kha dog nag mo/ bzhin khro gnyer bsnyer ba/ smad g.yogs nag po lagyon pa thor tshugs dang cod ⑩pan can 7thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams rang gi 'bar bas mngon par snang bar byed pa/ lag na dbyug pa thogs pa/ bgegs chen po med par byed pa'i ⑩phyag rgya'am/ yi ger bri'o/ /de la 8yi ge'i 'bru ni 'di'o/ /gtso/ de dag thams cad kyang 'khor dang bcas pa/ phyag brnyan dang bcas par padma dkar po la 'dug par bri'o/ /de ltar blo can gyis 8bkod nas/ /sngags pa sngags la gzhol ba yis/ /cho ga bzhin du phyir byung nas/ /gnyis pa'i cha ni nges pa la/ /shākya'i rigs ni dga' byed pa/ /thub pa'i rgyal po bri bar bya/ /mgon po na bza' ngur smrig ⑩mnabasam / /mtshan mchog sum cu 8rtsa gnyis ldan/ /bstan pa yi ni don mdzad lha/ /sems can kun la mi 'jigs sbyin/ /sngags pas phyag rgya dgod pa ni/ /lhung bzed 4)chos gos la sogs pa'am/ /yang na mkhas pas yi ger bzhag /de yi rmo rtecho ga dam pa 'di'o/ /bha/ de nas phyi rol gyi dkyil 'khor du bdag nyid chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid du byin gyis brlabs la/ byang chub kyi sems su gyur pa'i yid kyis cha gsum bor te/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad lan gsum rjes su dran par byas nas tshon de nyid blangs te/ shar phyogs 86—537

kyi cha gsum par rdo rje dam pa sbyin pa lagazhon nu'i gzugs can lag pa g.yon pa na utpal mthing ga'i nya steng na rdo rje can thogs pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa / dar ram ras kyi smad g.yogs gyon pa/ dar la'i stod dugayogs can/kha dog gur gum lta bu/ spyi bor 0zur phud lnga pa de'i phyag rgya 'am yi ger bri'o/ /de'i sngags ni 'di'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ mo(snye/ de'i g.yas phyogs stisu dra ba can gyi 'od gzhon nu'i gzugs can rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa/ lag na rin po che'i dra ba'am/ lcags kyu thogs pa phyag rgya'am yi ge'i 'brur bri'o/ /de la yi ge'i 'bru ni 'di'o/ /tsha/ de nas lho phyogs su byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba zhes bya ba ⑦gser gyi kha dog 'dra ba/ thor 8tshugs dang cod pan can/ lag na yid bzhin gyi nor bu thogs pa de'i phyag rgya'am yi ger bri'o(9na/ /de la yi ge'i 'bru lho ni 'di'o/ /u11la/ de nas 12byang phyogs su byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying po zhes bya ba sku mdog 1 ljang gus/ lag na padma 8thogs pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/de'i phyag rgya'am yi ger bri'o/ /de la yi ge ni 'di'o7/ /i/ nub phyogs su byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po zhes bya ba rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa/ gos dkar po gyon pa 'bar ba dang bcas pa/ lag na ral gri thogs pa de'i phyag rgya'am yi ger bri'o/ /de la yi ge'i 'bru ñtsa tshoni 'di'o/ /khri/chos kyi dbyings la gzhol ba yi/ /sngags pa de nas 'dug nas su/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin 18gyi/ /byang chub sems su gyur pa'i yid/ /shar phyogs kha bltas 19gnas nas ni/ /rdo rje can gyi rgya bcings nas/ /de nas las kyi rdo rjer gyur/ /nan tan du ni mchod pa bya/ /kun tu khyab pa'i yid kyis su/ /86—538

sangs rgyas skyob pa thams cad kyi/ /dam tshig ces ①bya'i rgya bstan nas/ /gsang sngags lan gsum bzlas par (kyebya/ /slob ma (cigatsang ma cho ga bzhin/ /bos te dkyil 'khor mdun du ni/ /de dag gsum la ༅skyabs su btang ⑤/ /de nas byang chub sems kyang bskyed/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin gyi/ /phyag rgya de dag kun la bcing / /de nas chos kyi 'khor lo'i bcing / /yid kyis de yi (yegazugs bsgyur te/ /ras kyis gegadong pa bkab nas su(8)/ /snying rjer gyur pa'i yid kyis su/ /byang chub tshogs ni rdzogs bya'i phyir/ /lag pa stong par mi bya'o/ /dam tshig gi ni dam pa riḍa'adi/ /de dag kun gyi rna bar bsgrags7ske/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi dam tshig ni/ /de nas de la bdag gis bcing ske/ /byang chub sems gyur yid kyis su/ /de nas me tog 'dor du gzhugam /me tog gang du bab gyur pa/ /de ni sngags pas de la sbyin/ /lus can kun la dam tshig phyir/ /cho ga de ltar rab tu bya/ /de nas dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ /gtso bo de la yang zhus pa/ /mgon po smra ba'i mchog gyur pas/ /dbang bskur ba yi / cho ga gsungs/ /de skad gsol nas bcom ldan 'das/ /chos kyi dbyings la gzhol ba yis/ /rdo rje 'dzin la 'di skad gsungs/ /chos rnams kun la dbang ba'i phyir/ /cho ga'i mchog ni ngas bshad kyis51snye/ /yid gcig bsdus te cho ga nyon/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de la slob dpon gyis ske bdag nyid de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs su de'i sngags sam/ phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas slob ma rnams bos la chos kyi dbyings kyi rimango bo nyid kyi padma'i rgyal po chen po la gzhag ste/ yan lag kun 'byung ba'i phyag rgya bcings la / byang chub sems dpa' chen po bzhis byin gyis brlabs pa/ rin po che sna 86—539

bzhi'i bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /a ni klad ༅kor bcas pa ru/ /mkhas pas spyi bor bzhag nas ni/ /a ②zhes bya ba snying gar ②gzhag /ra zhes bya ba brang du gzhag /yang na a ni kun tu gzhag /gser gyi kha dog 'bar dang bcas/ /thor tshugs dang ni dbu rgyan can/ /padma dkar po'i gdan la bzhugasabya/ /rgyal ba'i mchog ni ⑤ting 'dzin gnas/ /yi ge'i 'khor lo rim par phye ba rgyas pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor 'dus pa la gzigs nas/ byang chub sems dpa' gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i rgyan du gyur pa chos kyi dbyings rtogs pa'i mtshan mar gyur pa'i phyag rgya rim par phye ba rgyas pa gang gis brgyan 6tshon byang chub sems dpa' rnams 'khor ba na 'khor ba'i tshe/ 'gro ba thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byang chub chen po'i mtshan mas btab pas lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang / mi ma yin pa rnams 'byol 77bar 'gyur zhing / de rnams kyang de dag gi ngag nyan par 'gyur ba yod kyis( / de nyon la legs par rab tu yid la zung 9shig dang / ngas khyod la bshad do/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang /bcom ldan 'das la phyag na rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de'i dus la bab bo/ /bde bar gshegs pa de'i tshod la bab bo de 86—540

nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe stobs thogs pa med pa'i gnas byin gyis rlob ①pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu rig sngags kyi rgyal mo thams cad du thogs pa med pa'i stobs can/ mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i stobs can/ dam tshig la 'jug par byed pa/ stobs gsum dang ldan pa byung ngo / /na maḥs manta bud dhā dzā / a sa me chutri sa me/ sa ma ye swā hā/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po ②rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis yang dag par ston par byed pa/ chos gsum gyi lam gyi mtshams ④las mi 'da' bar byed pa/ sa dang pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa kunade yin te/ de'i phyag rgya ni 'di yin no/ /lag pa gnyis thal mo khong stong du sbyar la/ mthe bo gnyis bsgreng yingo / /rgya 'di phyag rgya chen po ste/ /sangs rgyas skyob ⑦pa kun gyi yin/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig ni/ /phyag rgya 'di la rab tu gnas/ /lag pa dag ni gnyis ka ⑧yang / /blo dang ldan pas khu tshur bcangasayin/ /mthe bo gnyis ni nang du gzhug /mdzub tshemo gnyis ni bsgreng bar bya/ /rgya 'di phyag rgya chen po ste/ /chos dbyings rnam par spyod pa'o/7/ /gsang sngags ni/ na maḥs manta bud dhā dzā/ dharma mas tu swa bhā ba ādma ko3rtanyusnye/ de bzhin du lag pa gnyis kyi sor mo thams cad bzlog ste skobasnol la mthe bo tsheganyis sprad ⑩do/ /phyag rgya dpal dang ldan pa 'di/ /chos kyi 'khor lo zhes su bsgrags/ /'jig rten mgon po skyob rnams kyi/ /'khor lo rab tu 'di bskor ro/ /gsang sngags ni/na maḥs manta bud dhā 〈sna / badzra ādma ko3rta/she/ de bzhin du lag pa gnyis phyag 'tshal ba'i thal mo sbyar la mdzub /mo gnyis mthe bo lke staganyis kyi steng du 86wa 541

gzhag ste/ ral gri lta bur bya'o/ /sangs rgyas skyob pa thams cad kyi/ /phyag rgya chen po ral gri'i rgya/ /'dis ni lhan cig skyes pa yi/ /'jig tshogs lta ba gcod par byed/ /gsang sngags ni/ na maḥs manta bud dhā dzā0)/ ma hā khan ②bi ra dza dhasmra sanda (misna ka sa ha dza sad kā ya dṛṣṭi (ma)myu da ka ta thā ga tā dhi musti nir dzā tshogata bi rā ga dharma (6)nir dzā ta ⑦// de bzhin du lag pa gnyis thal mo khong stong du sbyar te/ mdzub 98)mo gnyis kyis stimathe bo gnyis dkris pa 'idung lta bur bya'o / /phyag rgya dpal ldan dam pa 'di/ /chos kyi dung zhes rnam par bsgrags/ /'dis 37ni 'jig rten 'di dag na/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams//zhi ba mya ngan 'das 'gro ba/ /rdul dang bral ba'i chos 'chad do/ /gsang sngags ni/ na maḥs manta bud dhā 47/ sab nyu thā oṃ/ de bzhin du lag pa gnyis kyi sor mo kun thal mo sbyar ba las brgyang 17ste dril bu lta bur (snyebyas la/mthe bo tshaganyis dang mthe'u chung gnyis 7rtse gcig tu sprad de/ mdzub yonyemo gnyis dang gung mo 17sprad do/ /padma dam pa dpal ldan 'di/ /sangs rgyas skyob pa thams cad kyi/ /mi shigs rdo rje'i gdan yin te/ /der ni 'dren pa 'tshang rgya zhing ske/ /rgyal ba sras rnams 7thams cad ni/ /'di las skye na dang byang chub 'gyur / /gsang sngags ni/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ a/ de bzhin du lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcangs snyel/ gung mo gnyis gshibs te bsgreng nyal/ mdzub tsho mo gnyis bkug ste ngos gnyis su gzhag la rdo rje ltar bya/ mthe bo lhaganyis dang mthe'u chung gnyis bsgreng ste 2tshigazhag /srin lag gnyis lag pa'i nang du gzhug go/ /phyag rgya chen po rdo rje'i tsho 9rgya/ /mi shes grong khyer 'jig pa ste/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes 'di/ /nyid kyis byin gyis brlabs ri )te bstan/ /86—542

gsang sngags ni/ na maḥs manta badzā ṇḍaṃ/ :hu)/ de bzhin du lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcangs ②la gung mo gshibs te bsgreng la/ mdzub ④mo gnyis ngos nas bkug ste sbyar ro/ /gtsug tor phyag rgya rgya chen te/ /gtsug tor zhes ni bsgrags pa yin/ /'di ni bcings pa tsam gyis kyang / /rgyal ba mchog tu 'gyur ba yin/ /'di'i sngags ni/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ hūṃ rtsu/ lag pa g.yas pa tshikhu tshur bcangs la (gyerasmin mtshams gsu gzhag go/ /rgyal ba dam pas phyag rgya 'di/ /mdzod spu zhes ni rab tu bsgrags/ /'di ni bcings pa tsam gyis su/ /rgyal ba mchog tu 'gyur ba yin/ /'di'i sngags ni/ na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ a haṃ dzaḥrin/ blo ldan rnal 'byor tshul gnas te/ /lag gnyis lte ba'i thad kur ni/ /lhung bzed 'dzin pa'i tshul du bya/ /lhung bzed phyag rgya zhes su bsgrags(9༄/ /rgya 'di shākya thub pa'i 7ste/ /lhung bzed chen po zhes bya'o/ /'di'i gsang /)sngags ni/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ bha/ de bzhin du lag pa g.yas pa gyen du bsgreng /gel mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa lta bur bya'o/ /sems can kun la mi 'jigs pa/ /de yis rab tu sbyin par 'gyur/ /gang zhig 1 rgya chen de bcings na/ /mi 'jigs phyag rgya zhes bsgrags so/ /'di'i tso sngags ni/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ sarba dzamā dzi na dzi na bha tsoya nā sha ri chen swā hā / de bzhin du lag pa g.yas pa smad de dam pa sbyin pa ltar bya'o/ /'di ni dam pa sbyin rgya zhes/ /'jig rten mgon po rnams kyis bsgrags/ /'di ni bcings pa tsam gyis su/ /rgyal mchog dam pa stsol 51 bar 'gyur/ /'di'i gsang sngags ni/ na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ ba ra da 1 skabadzra ādma ko3rta 2 )swā hā/lag pa g.yas pa khu )tshur bcangs 5te mdzub samo brkyang jil dpral ba nakhro 86wa 543

gnyer lta bur bya'o/ /phyag rgya chen po rgya chen 'di/ /sangs rgyas skyob pa thams cad kyi/ /bdud ni rnam par bsdigs zhes ①bya/ /phung byed thams cad 'jig ②par byed/ /'di ni bcings pa tsam gyis su/ /bdud sde shin tu mi bzad ①dang / /bgegs dang log 'dren gzhan dag kyang / /the tshom ④med par rab tu 'byer/ /'di'i gsang sngags ni 'di'o⑤/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ ma hā ba la ba ti da sha ba la te (pedzo be ma hā mi rgya sgyu gad ga te swā hā/ de bzhin du lag pa g.yas pa khu tshur bcangs 98)la gung mo gnyis hu)dang srin lag gnyis brkyang ste7 / mthe bo de 7drung du gzhag go/ /'di ni sangs rgyas mgon rnams kyis/ /thugs rje las byung spyan yin te/ /mig gi steng du mkhas pas gzhag /de las sangs rgyas spyan du 'gyur/ /'di'i gsang sngags ni/ na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ga ga na ba ra lakṣa ṇa ka ru ṇa mā hu ya ta thā ga ta tsakṣuḥ8swā hā/ de bzhin du lag pa gnyis gcig tu sbyar la/ sor mo rnams phan tshun 7bsnol ba'i khu tshur bcings pate/ mdzub mo gnyis bsgreng tsol bkug ste 3 sprad la skum por bya/'di ni zhags pa mchog ces grags/ /snang ba thams cad 'jig 17par byed/ /sngags pas 'di phobacings de yi 21tshe/ /rtag tu snang ba bcings par 'gyur/sdu /'di'i lhagasang sngags ni 'di yin no nya/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ he te ma hā pā sha pra sa ro dā murya satwa dhā tu bi mo tsa ka /ta thā ga ta a dhi mutta 2nyeni ra dza ta ( nyeswā hā/ de bzhin du lag pa gnyis gcig tu sbyar te/ khu tshur bcangs ne la mdzub 8mo bsgreng ste rte/ tshigs gsum pa bkug la lhag ma rnams ni gdu bu'i gi )tshul du gnas par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas skyob pa thams cad kyi/ /lcags kyu zhes ni 'di bshad do ’/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che/ /sa bcu dag la 86—544

gnas pa dang ①/ /sdang bar sems pa ②gzhan dag kyang / /thams cad rab tu 'gugs ②par byed/ /'di'i gsang sngags ni/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ a sarba tra dus pra ti ha ta ta gathā ga ta/ i ku sha bo dhi tsārya ⑥pa ri pu ra ka swā hā/lcags kyu'i phyag rgya las gung mo gnyis bkug ste de nyid du sbyar ro/ /'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs kyi phyag rgya ste gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā rnal / tsā no ba swā hā/ phyag rgya de nyid las srin lag gnyis bsgreng shel lhag ma rnams de bzhin du gzhag go/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i lte ⑨ba'i phyag rgya ste/gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ a mṛ 0tonta ba swā hā/ phyag rgya de nyid las mthe'u chung bsgreng 7la lhag ma rnams de bzhin du gzhag go/ /rked ⑫pa'i phyag rgya ste/ gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ ta thā ga ta tsog ti saṃ bha ba swā hā/ de bzhin du lag pa gnyis khong stong du sbyar la/ mdzub ④mo gnyis bkug ste nang du gzhugam /srin lag gnyis kyang de bzhin du bya/ mthe bo lidang mthe'u 8chung gnyis cung zad dguganyushe /gung mo gnyis gshibs te bsgreng mngo / /'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdzod kyi phyag rgya ste/ 'di'i gsang sngags ni/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ ro ro ro swā hā/ phyag rgya de nyid las srin lag gnyis phyung la bsgreng ste tsho )gzhag go/ /mtshams 2stochen po gcad sartepa'i phyag rgya ste/ 'di'i gsang sngags ni 'di yin no ge/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā dzā/ be lu pu sa ri bi ku ri bi ku le swā hā/ mtshams ri shechen po gcad 89pa'o/ /de nyid las gung mo gnyis bkug la mthe bong gnyis bsgreng rimango / /srung du 3ba chen po'i yiphyag rgya ste/ gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā /ri sku/ ta thā ga te bhyaḥs sarba ri bha ye sa bi ga te bhyo bi ri4shwa mu khe bhyaḥ/ sarba ri thā haṃ khaṃ rakṣa ma hā ba 86—545

le sarba 1)ta thā ga ta pu 6 ②nir dzā te la/ rdu tra ṭa tra ṭa/ a pra ti byaha te swā hā/mi bzod pa zhes bya ba bsrung ⑤ba chen mo'o/ /de bzhin du mdzub 0mo gnyis brkyang la mthe bong gnyis ⑦nang du gzhug snigo/ /kun tu 'bar ba zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya ste/ gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ dzā ⑨la mā li ni ⑩ta thā ga ta artsi ṭwā hā/ kun tu 'bar ba'o/ /de bzhin du lag pa gnyis thal mo khong stong du sbyar la/ mdzub 17mo gnyis kyis ngos nas dkri'o/ /'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i go cha'i 8phyag rgya ste/ gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ pra tsaṇḍa badzra dza rmo ya bi spru ra rghaṃ/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i go cha'o0/ /phyag rgya de nyid las mdzub mo tshiganyis dang mthe bo miganyis gcig na)tu sbyar ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ljags kyi phyag rgya ste/ gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ ta thā ga ta dzi hwa sidhi dharma nyi pra tiṣṭha te 16ga hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ljags so/ /phyag rgya de nyid las mdzub ( — mo gnyis dang srin lag gnyis bkug la nang du sbyar/ mthe bo tsho 1gnyis bsgreng tsha rtel cung zad bkug ste/ rtse mo gung mo la phyogs par byarmo trī/ mthe'u chung gnyis ni brgyang la mthe bo gnyis bsnga ma bzhin no/ /'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhal chen po'i phyag rgya ste/gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ ta thā ga tsho 2ta ma hā bā gne ( —9bi dzñā na ma ho da ya swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhal lo/ /phyag rgya de nyid las mdzub py-i mo bkrol la/ nang du bcug ste dgu rtebor byas la bstod de gzung zhu)ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mche ba'i phyag rgya ste/ gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ ta thā ga ta ma hā 12 ṭī sa ra sa rā ri gra sa rim pra bhā gi ka sarba ri /ta thā ga ta bi ṣa 5ya saṃ bha ba swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mche ba'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid 86—546

las mdzub mo gnyis bsgreng ste gzung ①la tshigs gsum pa dgug go/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i so so yang dag par rig pa'i phyag rgya ste/ gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ a tsinta ā ta rū pa pā ba (geg saṃ pra ti bibyā bi shuddha swa ra swā duhā/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i so so yang dag par rig pa'o/ /de bzhin du lag pa gnyis gcig tu thal mo khong stong (dedu sbyar te mthe bo (snyeganyis dang mthe'u 4rachung gnyis nang du bcug ⑦la gcig tu sprad do/ /'di ni stobs bcu'i phyag rgya ste / gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ da (8)sha ba la ga dha ra rtsu si rdza swā hā/ stobs bcu'i phyag rgya dang gsang (7sngags so/ /phyag rgya de nyid las mthe bo ⑩gnyis kyi rtse mor mdzub mo gnyis bkug ste sbyar ro/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'i phyag rgya ste/ gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ ta thā ga ta smṛ ti satwa hi ta a rgyud ta rtsonag ga na sa ma sa ma swā hā/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'i phyag rgya dang gsang sngags so/ /phyag rgya de nyid las srin lag gnyis mthe bo'i steng du gzung 8ngo / /gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ sabra dharma (/nyes tsom tā māsta blata thā ga ta a nu ga 7ta swā hā/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du rtogs 0par byed pa'i phyag rgya dang gsang sngags so/ /de bzhin du lag pa gnyis gcig tu sbyar te/ mdzub 12mo gnyis kyis 51/gung mo gnyis 2 nodakris la lhag ma rnams ni de bzhin du gzhag go/ /kun tu bzang po'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i phyag rgya ste/ gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ sa mas rme glen ga ta bi rā dza gedha kto 2nir dzā 20ta ma hā ma hā swā hā/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i phyag rgya dang tsho gegasang sngags so/ /phyag rgya de nyid las mdzub 20mo gnyis gung mo gnyis kyi nang du bkug la gzhag /lhag ma rnams ni snga ma bzhin no/ /'di'i gsang 86—547

sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā dzā/ a tsi terdzo ①ya bza gisatā ①sha yā nu ga ta swā byahā/ byams pa'i phyag rgya dang gsang sngags so/ /phyag rgya de nyid las mthe bo ⑤gnyis nang du gzhug (7go/ /gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ā kā sha sa ma tā nu ga ta bi tsi traṃ ⑦ba ra dha ra swā hā/ nam mkha'i snying po'i phyag rgya dang gsang sngags so/ /phyag rgya de nyid las srin chalag gnyis dang mthe'u chung gnyis nang du bcug la/ mdzub ṇimo gnyis gung mo gnyis 0dang lhan cig tu sbyar ro/ /gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ a ta yisatwa nyi ta a rgyud mata traṃ traṃ tshir ro swā hā/ sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba'i phyag rgya dang gsang sngags so// // bam po lnga pa'i/ de bzhin du lag pa gnyis gcig tu sbyar 7la sor mo thams cad 7dril bu 'dra bar kha dbye/ mthe bo chaganyis dang mthe'u chung gnyis gcig tu sbyar ste/ lhag ma rnams ni padma lta bur bya'o/ /gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ sabra yota thā ga ta a ba lo ki ta ka ru ṇa mā 6)ya ra ra ra hūm̐ dzaḥ lhaswā hā/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi padma'i phyag rgya dang gsang sngags so/ /de bzhin du lag pa gnyis thal mo khong stong du sbyar la padma kha ma bye ༷ba lta bur bya'o/ /padma'i phyag rgya ste ge/ gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/rdza rdza sa 1swā hā/ mthu chen po gathob pa'i padma'i nyaphyag rgya dang gsang sngags so/ /de bzhin du lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcangs la mdzub shemo gnyis rtse mo can du bsgreng ste/ mthe bo ni tshoganyis kyang 9de'i drung du gzhag go/ /gsang sngags la/na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ tā re tā re ṇi gi ka ru kho be 1swā hā/ lha so mo sgrol ma'i 'o snye/ /phyag rgya de nyid las mdzub ri mo gnyis gcus te bsgreng ngo snye/ /86wa 548

lhag ma rnams ni snga ma bzhin no/ /gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ sasba bhā ①ba san tā sa ni hūṃ sbo ṭa ②ya swā hā/ khro gnyer can ①ma'i 'o/ /de bzhin du lag pa gnyis thal mo khong stong du sbyar dul/ srin ⑤lag gnyis dang mthe bo ⑥gnyis nang du gzhug go/ /gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ta thā ga ta ji ṣa rdziya sambha ba ⑧padma mā lī nī skyuswā hā/ gos dkar can gyi'o/ / phyag rgya de nyid las mthe bo /ḍa )gnyis gyen du bsgreng la mdzub (2mo gnyis kyi rtse mo de'i drung du bar nas gang tsam gyis chod par mgazhag go/ /gsang sngags la/na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ khā da bhañdza sbo nyunyes ya swā hā/ rta mgrin ④gyi phyag rgya dang gsang sngags so/ /phyag rgya de nyid las srin tsolag gnyis dang / mthe'u chung gnyis kyang gyen du bsgreng tsol lhag ma rnams ni ⑩de bzhin du khu tshur bcangs 9/—nyepa'i tshul du gzhag go/ /de'i gsang sngags lanyu)/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ ha ha ha su na ta nu 3 stag hā/ sa'i snying po'i phyag rgya dang gsang sngags sol/ /de bzhin du lag pa gnyis thal mo khong stong du sbyar la/ gung mo gnyis kyis srin ( spelag gnyis dkris te/ mdzub sdo 3mo gnyis kyang mthe bong gnyis kyi steng du bkug ste gzhag /lhag ma rnams ni snga ma bzhin no/ /gsang sngags la/na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ he he ku mā ra ka bi multi du gepa the sa0ste ṣṭha teri ge/ sma ra sma ra pra ti tsā ( riman swā sbyo tshohā/ 'jam dpal gyi phyag rgya dang gsang sngags so/ /lag pa g.yon pa khu tshur bcangs te mdzub ri 2mo dgug go/ /dra ba'i 'od kyi lcags kyu'i phyag rgya ste/ gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ he he ku mā ra ya ga ta swa bhā ba sbri ta swā hā/ dra ba'i 'od kyi phyag rgya dang gsang sngags so/ /phyag rgya de nyid las sor mo thams cad dgu ribor bya'o/ /gzhon nu dri ma med kyi ri ri'od 86wa 549

kyi utpa la'i phyag rgya ste/ gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ he he ku mā ra bi tsi 6)tra ga ti ku mā ra/ pra ti tshwa ②ma nu ②sma ra ṭwā hā/ dri ma med pa'i 'od kyi phyag rgya dang gsang sngags so/ /de bzhin du lag pa g.yas pa khu tshur bcangs la mdzub (shemo dang gung mo gnyis gshibs ⑤te gyen du bsgreng gyengo / /skra ⑦can gyi phyag rgya ste gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ he he ku mā ri kle sha myu sadad ya ā 64)tshwa nān sma ra pra ti dzñā yin swā hā/ skra can gyi lho)phyag rgya dang gsang sngags so/ /de bzhin du lag pa g.yas pa khu tshur bcangs bil gung mo gyen du bsgreng ste 32mdung rtse bolta bur bya1snye/ nye 7spa can gyi mdung rtse'i phyag rgya ste/gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ biddha ya 1 7adzñā he ku mā hunyeri ke swā hā / nye nya(spa can gyi mdung rtse'i phyag rgya dang gsang sngags so/ /lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcangs ( — )te/ gung mo gnyis brkyang la mdzub ( lhamo gnyis ngos su sbyar sna tshogs ma'i dbyug pa'i phyag rgya ste/ gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/he ku mā ri ke ā dzñā na 22gu ra bi rda rmo snyes ni swā hā/ de bzhin du lag pa g.yon pa khu tshur bcangs tshol srin lag dang mthe'u chung 3lhaganyis bsgreng tsha 5ngo / /nor can gyi rgyal mtshan gyi phyag rgya ste/ gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ he spru ra dzñā na ke tu swā hā/ nor can gyi rgyal mtshan gyi phyag rgya dang gsang sngags so//lag pa g.yas pa khu tshur bcangs la/ mdzub mo bsgreng 2 tshoste rtse mo dgug go/ /'gugs ma'i lcags kyu'i phyag rgya ste/ gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā rnal/ ā kunta ya sa ku ru ā dzñā na ku riktamā ra su swā hā/ 'gugs ri rima'i lcags kyo'i 1phyag rgya dang gsang sngags so/ /de bzhin du lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcangs la/ mdzub 2mo gnyis bsgreng ste sha tshigs gsum pa sa snadagug go/ /86wa 550

gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ a bi sma ya ni ye swā hā/ phyag brnyan ma rnams kyi phyag rgya dang gsang sngags so/ /de bzhin du lag pa g.yas pa khu tshur bcangs ①te/ gung mo bsgreng la tshigs ②gsum pa nidagug go/ /ngo mtshar can gyi rdo rje'i phyag rgya ste/ gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/bi ma ti myu da ka swā hā/ ngo mtshar gyi rdo rje ⑤phyag rgya dang gsang sngags so/ /de bzhin du lag pa g.yas pa'i dpung pa bstod (gyel/ lag pa mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa lta bur bya/ mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgya ste/ gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ a bha yas ta (6)swā hā/ mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgya dang gsang sngags so/ /(7)lag pa de nyid mas yar 2'dren pa'i tshul du bya'o/ /ngan song spong ba'i phyag rgya ste/ gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ a byung yisidha ra satwa dhā tu na ngos hā/ ngan song spong ba'i phyag rgya dang gsang sngags sol/ /lag pa de nyid brang du gzhag go/ /yongs su skyong sems blo gros kyi phyag rgya ste/ gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ he ma hā tunyem hā sma /ser pra ti dzñā nyu swā hā/ yongs su skyong sems blo gros kyi phyag rgya dang gsang sngags so/ /lag pa de nyid rngume tog 'dzin pa'i tshul du bya'o/ /gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ satwa rigebadzorsha ba swā hā/ byams pa 'byung ba'i phyag rgya dang gsang sngags so/ /lag pa de nyid snying gar 517gzhag la gung mo nang du dgug go//gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ ka ru ṇidha ba swā hā/ snying rjes brlan tsho pa'i phyag rgya dang gsang sngags so/ /de bzhin du lag pa g.yas pa ri snyemachog sbyin pa'i tshul du bya'o/ /gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/he he ba ra da ba ra nyu māsta swā hā/ gdung ba thams cad zhi bar byed pa'i'ori /86—551

lag pa de nyid yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'dzin pa'i tshul du'o①/ /gsang sngags la/na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ sab sha ④pa ri pu ra ka swā hā/ blo gros bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya dang gsang sngags so/ /de bzhin du lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcangs gel/ gung mo'i sor mo gnyis phyung ste brkyang ngo / /sa'i snying po'i me tog gi phyag rgya ste/ gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ ha ha ha bisma ye swā hā/ sa'i snying po'i phyag rgya dang gsang sngags so/ /lag pa g.yas pa khu tshur bcangs 9 la/ sor mo gsum brkyang ngo / /rin chen 'byung gnas kyi 7lde)phyag rgya ste/ gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ he ho ma hā ma hā swā hā/ rin chen 'byung gnas kyi (nyaphyag rgya dang gsang sngags so/ /lag pa de nyid las srin lag brkyang ste 'gyen du bsgreng 'a)ngo / /gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ rasnortse po)ba swā hā/ phyag na rin chen gyi phyag rgya dang gsang sngags so/ /de bzhin du lag pa gnyis bsnol te rgyab sbyar la/ g.yon pa'i mthe bos lkugayas pa'i mthe'u chung 'khyud de/ de bzhin du ḍo/rtsegayas pas kyang ⑫g.yon pa la 'khyud 3nyal lhag ma rnams rdo rje lta bur bya'o/ /sa 'dzin gyi phyag rgya ste / gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ dha mir tsā māsta (9swā hā/ sa 'dzin gyi phyag rgya dang gsang sngags so/ /phyag na rin chen ⑩phyag rgya lho 7ni rdo rje rtse lnga 1 riste snga ma bzhin no/ /gsang sngags la37/ na maḥs manta bud dhā dzā/ ratna ‘ )nir dzā rmo 1te swā hā/ phyag na rin chen gyi 2phyag rgya dang gsang sngags so/ phyag rgya de nyid las sor mo rnams dgod par bya'o/ /bsam pa brtan sa pa'i phyag rgya ste/gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ badzra saṃ bha ba swā hā/ bsam pa brtan pa'i phyag rgya dang gsang sngags so/ /lag pa gnyis de bzhin du bya ba ni 86wa 552

nam mkha'i ①snying po'i ral gri'i phyag rgya ste/ gsang sngags la/ na ②maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ ga ga na nānta tsa ra swā hā/ 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po'i phyag rgya dang gsang sngags so/ /'khor lo'i phyag rgya snga ma bzhin du byas pa ni nam mkha'i blo gros kyi phyag rgya ste/ gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ tsakra brti swā hā/ nam mkha'i blo gros kyi phyag rgya dang gsang sngags so/ /dung gi phyag rgya snga ma bzhin du byas pa ni rnam par dag pa'i blo gros kyi phyag rgya ste/ gsang sngags la/na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ dharma cha bha ba swā hā/ rnam par dag pa'i blo gros kyi phyag rgya dang gsang sngags so/ /padma'i phyag rgya snga ma bzhin du byas pa ni spyod pa'i blo gros kyi phyag rgya ste/ gsang sngags labu/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ padma mā lā ⑤ya swā hā/ spyod pa'i blo gros kyi phyag rgya dang gsang sngags so/ /utpa la'i phyag rgya snga ma ⑥bzhin las kha ma bye bar byas pa ni nam mkha' (7dri ma med ⑧pa'i phyag rgya ste/ gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ dzñā rnam ba swā khahā/nam mkha' dri ma med pa'i phyag rgya dang gsang sngags so/ /rdo rje snga ma bzhin du byas pa ni brtan pa'i blo gros kyi phyag rgya ste/ gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ badzra kā ra swā hā/ brtan pa'i blo gros kyi phyag rgya dang gsang sngags sol/ /de bzhin du lag pa gnyis gcig tu sbyar te/ srin lag gnyis nang du bcug la gung mo dang / mthe bong gnyis dang / mthe'u chung gnyis bsgreng 7ste mdzub zhunyamo gnyis gung mo'i ngos su bkug la bar nas gang tsam gyis ma reg par gzhag go/ /phyag na rdo rje'i phyag rgya ste tsherdo rje'o/ /gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta badzā 'on/ tsaṇḍa nyu ma hā ro ṣa ṇa mu / rdo rje 'dzin gyi'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid las mthe bo gnyis dang mthe'u chung gnyis nang du gzhug go/ /mā ma tī'i bla86wa 553

phyag rgya ste/ gsang sngags la①/ na maḥs manta badzā ṇḍaṃ/ tri ṭa tri ṭa dza ②yarnyi ③swā hā/ mā ma khri'i 'o 90/ /de bzhin du lag pa gnyis rgyab sprad la sor mo rnams phan tshun bsnol te gcus (snyel bsdams te/ g.yon pa'i mthe bos g.yas pa'i mthe bo 6mnan la bsdam mo/ /rdo rje lu gu rgyud kyi phyag rgya ste/ gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta badzā 〉〈pe/ hūṃ brnya brta/ mo ṭa ya mo ṭa ya/badzradha be/ sabra tra tshan)pra ti ha te (she)swā hā/ rdo rje lu gu rgyud kyi phyag rgya dang gsang sngags so/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgya de nyid las mthe bo 7gnyis cung zad bkug la mdzub (7mo gnyis kyang de la phyogs par bya'o/ /rdo rje khro zla gtso bo'i hunyephyag rgya ste / gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta badzā ṇḍaṃ/ hrīḥ1ste/ phaṭa swā hā/ khro zla gtso bo'i 'o/ /de bzhin du lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcangs ④mdzub mamo gnyis gshibs te 15bsgreng 1 ngo / /rdo rje rtse mo'i phyag rgya ste/ gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta badzā ṇḍaṃ/ sasba dharma ninde da na badzā sru tsi mi ba ra de swā hā/ rdo rje rtse mo'i 'o/ /de bzhin du lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcangs la snying gar 37gzhag go( )/ /rdo rje khu tshur gyi phyag rgya ste/ gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta badzā shā9 ste/ sbo ṭa ya badzra na bha be rirnyiswā hā/ rdo rje khu tshur gyi'o/ / rilag pa g.yon ( nyapa khu tshur bcangs pa'i mdzub 7mo gyen du bsgreng 2 ste khros pa bzhin du bsdigs gi par bya ba ni gdul dka'i phyag rgya 9ste/ gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta badzā shā )/dur dānta 1ma hā ro ṣa ṇa lā 2da ya saban ra ku ru ta thā ga ta ā gistesto na swā hā/gdul dka'i 'o/ /lag pa g.yas pa khu tshur bcangs la gdab sa pa'i thabs su bya'o / /mngon phyogs kyi tho ba'i rdo phyag rgya ste/ gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta badzā ṇḍaṃ / he a gi /mu kha ma hā tsaṇḍa groṇḍa khā med ya kyi: )ra ya si 1)sa ma 86wa 5 54

ya ma nu sma ra swā hā/ mngon phyogs kyi'o/ /snga ma bzhin ①lhung bzed 'dzin pa'i tshul du byas pa ni shākya thub pa'i lhung bzed kyi phyag rgya ste/ gsang sngags la/na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ sarba akle sha ni sru chad na sab dharma ④pa shī ta māsta ga ga na sa ma swā hā/ shākya thub pa'i 'o/ /mdzod spu'i phyag rgya ni snga ma bzhin rnargya/ /lag pa g.yas pa'i sor mo kun rtse mo sbyar te stispyi bo'i steng du gzhag go/ /gtsug tor thams cad kyi phyag rgya ste/ /gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/baṃ baṃ rdu rdu phaṭa swā hā/ gtsug tor thams cad kyi phyag rgya dang gsang sngags so/ /lag pa g.yon pa gakhu tshur bcangs (shel gung mo dang mdzub tsomo gnyis brkyang hukye ste/srin lag dang mthe'u chung gi rtse mor mthe bo gzhag la g.yas pa'i mdzub 7mo dang gung mo gnyis g.yon pa'i mthil du gzhug /mthe bo yang ⑩snga ma bzhin du bya'o/ /mi g.yo mgon gyi phyag rgya ral gri shubs su bcug hu pa'o/ /'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i ni rdo rje stemu/ snga ma bzhin no/ /de bzhin du lag pa gnyis gcig tu sbyar la srin lag dang mthe'u chung gnyis nang du bcug go'oge/ /gung mo gnyis gshibs te bsgreng ri la mdzub mamo gnyis bkug ste/ gung mo'i tshigs zhu gsum par gzhag /mthe bo nyukheganyis mig lta bur bya/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i yum gyi phyag rgya ru )ste gtsug tor ro/ /lag pa g.yon pa brkyang ste kha sbub rigeste/ lag pa g.yas pa khu tshur bcangs la mdzub ri ci mos gdugs lta bur gzung dzo gengo / /gdugs dkar po'i phyag rgya ste/ gdugs so/ /khosgro ste / gtsug tor rgyal ba'i ni smyo geral gri ru ste hūṃ snga ma bzhin no/ /sho/ rnam par rgyal ba'i 38'khor lo ste snga ma bzhin no/ /si spu/ rnam par 'thor ba'i ni skulcags kyu ste/ lag pa g.yas pa 1khu tshur bcangs la mdzub ri mo bkug ste gzhag go/ /86wa 555

rgyu / gzi brjid ①phung po'i ni gtsug tor te ②snga ma bzhin no/ / gsang sngags las tram̐/ cher 'byung ba'i ⑤phyag rgya ni/ /rdo rje'i ⑤phyag rgya zhes su grags/zhi / gyen du 'byung ba'i phyag rgya ni/ /padma bzang po'i ⑤snga ma bzhin/ //⑦/mtha' yas pa yi dbyangs dusgra ni/ /dung ni ⑨yin par ⑩ngas bshad do/ /sdu/lag pa g.yas pa khu tshur bcangs la smin mtshams 7su gzhag pa ⑩ni mdzod spu'i phyag rgya yid bzhin gyi nor bu'o/ /spyan gyi ni gtsug tor snga ma bzhin te⑩/ bye brag tu rdo rjes mtshan pa'o/ /ga④/ lag pa g.yas pa padma 'dzin pa'i thabs su snying gar 8gzhag la/ lag pa g.yon pa thal mo bsnun pa'i tshul du ⑩brkyang pa ni gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /gsang sngags ni/ dhi dhi ri ri dzi 8ri dzi ⑫ri / lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcangs ⑩la mthe bo 2)gnyis gyen du bsgreng rngo nyab las dgug go/ /gzhan gyis mi thub pa zhes bya ba'i kha'i phyag rgya'os/ /a pa ra dzi ta 2nyedza yarnyi ṭi 27te swā hā/ lag pa g.yas pa 'gram par bstan pa ni dbang phyug gi phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid las gung ( nyamo dang mdzub 0mo gnyis gcus 0pa lta bur gzung ri ngo / /kun tu me tog gi phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid las mthe bo 6)nang du gzhug go/ /'od kyi phreng ba can gyi phyag rgya'o/ /du )phyag rgya de nyid las mdzub do mo dang mthe'u chung tshoneganyis me tog 'dzin pa lta bur bya'o/ /yid mgyogs ra kyi phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa g.yas pa'i srin lag gi steng du mthe bo nunye gzhag la / mdzub dgemo dang gung mo dang mthe'u chung gsum brkyang ste rna ba'i steng du gzhag go/ /lag pa g.yon pa yang de bzhin du bya lha/ sgra rnam par sgrogs ri 7pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa gnyis gcig tu sbyar la/ mthe bo 'i gnyis rtse sprad de skum po bya rte/ sor mo lhag ma rnams kyi rtse mo dgug pa ni bum pa'i nyaphyag rgya'o/ /86—556 7

de bzhin du ①lag pa g.yas pa mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i tshul du byas la mthe bo ②nang du gzhag pa ni mi gnyer ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa de nyid mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa lta bur byas la mthe'u ③chung gi tshigs ④gnyis par gzhag go⑤/ /drang srong rnams kyi spyi'i phyag rgya ste/ go rims ni ci ⑥ltar rigs par bya'o/ /de bzhin du lag pa gnyis gcig tu sbyar la mdzub ⑦mo dang mthe'u chung gnyis nang du bcug ste/ lhag ma rnams gcig tu bsdus la bstod de gzung ⑧ba ni gshin rje'i be con gyi phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa g.yas pa kha bub stetshi/ dril bu 'dra bar byas pa ni 'chi ⑩bdag gi phyag rgya ste dril bu'o/ /de bzhin du lag pa g.yon ⑩khu tshur bcangs la/ mdzub 0mo dang gung mo gnyis bsgreng 8ba ni dus mtshan mo'i phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid las gung mo gyen du bsgreng cib ni drag mo'i phyag rgya ste tri shu sala'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid las padma 'dzin pa'i tshul du byas pa ni tshangs pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid las mdzub 8mo mgung mo'i rgyab kyi tshigs gsum por ⑫sprad pa ni gzhon 7nu ma'i mdung thung gi phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid las mdzub du kye mo mthe bo'i rtse mor gzhag go/ /khyab 'jug ma'i 'khor lo'i phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid las mthe bo gyen du bsgreng hūṃ gengo / /phag sdo — mo'i phyag rgya ste tho ba'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid las lag pa snod ( ri nyelta bur bya'o/ /tsa muṇḍi'i sanaphyag rgya ste thod pa'o//bden bral gyi phyag rgya ral gri ( —snyeni snga ma bzhin no/ /khyab 'jug gi phyag rgya 'khor lo yang snga ma bzhin no/ /de bzhin du lag pa gnyis g.yon phyogs nas bstod cigade bskor ba ni dga' bo dang bsnyen zu dga' bo'i sprin ri nagyi phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid las sor mo gsum gyen du bsgreng sa ba ni bde byed kyi mdung rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid las sor mo de dag drang por byas pa ni u ri skam pa ti 86—557

su'i (7phyag rgya'o/ /zla ba'i phyag rgya ni padma snga ma bzhin te/ khyad ②par du dkar po 9mibya'o/ /lag pa de nyid gnyis ka bugashibs te bkan la mdzub (shemo dang srin lag gnyis ngos su dgug go/ /nyi ma'i phyag rgya ste shing rta'o/ /lag pa de gnyis ka chagacig tu thal mo sbyar la gung mo dang / srin lag gnyis gzhu 'dra bar bya'o//rgyal ba dang rnam par rgyal ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /ba dan gyi phyag rgya ni snga ma bzhin te rlung gi'o/ /de bzhin du lag pa g.yon pa gnye ba'i phyogs su bkan la sor mo gnyis bsgreng 75)ste gzung tso ngo / /lag pa g.yas pa de la phyogs par byas te/ pi bang 7len pa lta bur byas pa ni dbyangs can gyi phyag rgya ste pi bang lhonyengo chu lha'i 'phyag rgya ni zhags pa ste snga ma bzhin no0/ /dbyangs can gyi phyag rgya ste ④de nyid las mdzub 8mo dgug go/ /lha ma yin rnams kyi phyag rgya ste/ gsang sngags la / na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ ga ra la yaṃ swā hā/ phyag rgya de nyid las srin lag brkyang ngo / /dri za'i phyag rgya ste gsang sngags la/ bi shu tshig ra ba nyi ne yinaswā hā/ phyag rgya de nyid las mdzub 1nyemo dgug go/ /gnod sbyin thams cad kyi phyag rgya ste/ gsang sngags la/ yakṣe lho)shwa ra swā hā/ phyag rgya de nyid las mthe bo dang mthe'u chung gnyis rtse mo dzo cisbyar ro/ /gnod sbyin ma tsho 1rnams kyi ( gephyag rgya ste/gsang sngags la/ yakṣa bityā /ṅgā rī dzo rig hā/ phyag rgya de nyid las gung mo brkyang ngo ske/ /sha za rnams kyi phyag rgya ste/ gsang sngags la/ pi shā tse ga ti tsho geswā hā/gung mo de nyid bkug la gzung tsho 7ngo / /sha za mo rnams kyi phyag rgya ste/ gsang sngags la/ mi tsi mi tsi swā hā/ de bzhin du lag pa gnyis gcig tu sbyar la mthe bo 2 gnyis gyen du bsgreng ste gzung ri ngo / /ga za' thams cad kyi phyag rgya ste/gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ gra ri 7he shārya māsta byo tir ma ya swā hā/86—558 44

phyag rgya de nyid las gung mo dang mthe bo tshiganyis bzlog ②ste sbyar ro(kye/ /rgyu skar thams cad kyi phyag rgya ste/ gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ nakṣa dra ni ra nā da nī ye stiswā hā/ phyag rgya de nyid las srin lag gnyis bkug ste lag gemathil du gzhag go/ /gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ rākta sā dhi ⑥pa ta ye swā hā/ srin po rnams kyi phyag rgya dang gsang sngags so/ /lag pa g.yas pa khar gzhag ste lce la reg par bya'o/ /mkha' 'gro ⑦ma rnams kyi phyag rgya ste/gsang sngags la/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ hrīḥ(nyehwa/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po de lta bu la sogs pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i mos pa las byung ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i mtshan mar gyur pa'i phyag rgya rab 'byam (spyodarnams te/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po 'on kyang ci tsam du yan lag bskyod pa de dag kun phyag rgya rgyas par rig par bya'o/ /ci tsam du lce bskyod pa tsode dag kun kyang gsang sngags bstan par rig par bya'o/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de lta bas na byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i /glespyad pa spyod pa rnams kyis byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa'i yid kyis shu de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa la gnas te dkyil 'khor bri bar bya'o/ /gzhan du byas na sangs rgyas lho dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / byang chub kyang bslus par 'gyur te/ dam tshig las 'das pas nges par ngan song du 'gro bar 'gyur rol/ /rnam par snang mdzad chen po mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa rnam par sprul pa byin gyis rlob pa las/ phyag rgya rim par phye ba rgyas pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje la bka' 86—559

stsal pa/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po thams cad du 'jug pa'i ༅sgo'i ②chos kyi rnam grangs nyon cig /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de la byang chub sems dpas a zhes bya ba la gnas te/ dgos pa thams cad bsgrub par bya'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā shā / a/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ sa/ na maḥs manta badzā shāsti/ ba/ka kha ga gha/ tsa tsha dza dzha/ ṭa ṭha ḍa nye/ ta tha da dha/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha/ nga nya ṇa na/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ sa⑤/ na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ sā/ na maḥs manta badzā ṇḍaṃ/ bā(nya/ kā khā sti'i sthā/ tsā tsā dzā tsā/ ṭā ṭhā ḍā rwa(nye/ tā thā dā dhā/ pā pā bā bhā mā/ yā rā lā wā/ shā ṣā sā hā / dā hā ṇa nā/ na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ i/ na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/so / na maḥs manta bsto shāsti/ paṃ/ kai khaṃ gi rghaṃ/ rtsa tshe rdza dzha/ ṭaṃ khri ḍi snyi//mi 15 :rdo /mi/ thomi thogyi thos /ste thos/ sku'i tsasdo shākhri 4khri/ ༷ni /( thos /mi/ sngosdo /mi /mi /rdo/ zug zugaḥs manta bud dhwa māṃ/ aḥ7/ na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ saḥrtsonya/ na maḥs manta badzā shābo/ baḥha / ka kha ga gha/ tsa tsha dza dzha/ ṭa ṭha ḍa 18/ ta tha da dha/pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha/ nga nya ṇa na/ i khri/ u snyi.u/e e/ o mtshe/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po de ltar na 'di ni yi ge'i tshul la mkhas pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs te/ gsang sngags kyi tshul la rnam par (1gnas pa'i cho ga /lha yongs su gzung 38ba'i cho ga /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyi rlabs 17kyis byin du brlabs pa/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi tshul tsho la mkhas pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa 27spyod pa'i rol mo ste/'das pa dang da ltar dang ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis kyang bshad 'chad 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po ngas ni 86—560 7

sangs rgyas kyi zhing rab 'byam hu)gang dag na/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnam pa ②thams cad du 'jug pa'i sgo chos kyi rnam grangs 'di mi 'chad pa ma mthong ngo ① /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de lta bas na byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pas/ gsang sngags kyi cho ga shes par 'dod na thams cad du 'jug pa'i sgo chos kyi rnam grangs la mngon par brtson par bya'o/ /ka dang tsa dang ṭa dang ta dang pa rnams thog ④ma dang tha ma dang /dbus ⑤dang ldan na ting nge 'dzin gyi tshogs la 'jug pas byang chub dang spyod pa dang ske/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ༅mya ngan las 'das pa dang bcas par ⑦thob par byed do/ /de bas na gsang sngags kyi cho ga la dang po la sogs pa'i tha snyad dang ldan par gyur pa nide dag nyid thog ma dang tha ma dang dbus dang lhan cig tu gyur par shes par bya ste/ gsang sngags kyi tshig re re la ci ltar 'dod par stinges par sbyar bar bya'o/ /blo yis rnam par rtogs na ni/ /de dag bla med gnas mchog ste7/ /de ltar 'di ni 'khor lo gcig (/nyeste 'khor lo bzhin du yongs su 'khor ba ni yi ge'i 'khor lo'o/ /sngags pas yi ge'i 'khor lo de shes na rtag tu ci ltar bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad 'khor lo bskor ba bzhin du rnam par mdzes par 'gyur ro/ / rnam pa / thams cad / du 'jug pa'i sgo chos kyi yi ge'i tshul rim par phye ba'o// //de nas yang cibacom ldan 'das kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan gyis sems can gyi khams thams cad la gzigs nas/ chos kyi dbyings mi zad pa chogebakod pa bstan pa dang gsang sngags kyi spyad /3pa mngon par bsgrub chi'o pa 'di nyid kyis 86—561

sems can rnams hu)ma lus pa gdon par thugs dam bcas pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir chos kyi dbyings kyi mdzod kyi mthu rlabs②/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mnyam pa nyid bkod pa'i snying po can zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu/ de nas de nyid kyi tshe sems can gyi khams ma lus pa nges par 'byung bar byed pa'i sgo ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin (kyilas dang tshe dang rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu za ba dang / zar 'jug pa'i gzugs dang / kha dog dang /dbyibs dang / nga khu/ro dang / 'gro ba dang / spyod pa dang / nges pa'i tshig brjod pa sems can thams cad so so so sor yang dag par mgu bar byed pa/chos kyi dbyings kyis rnam par bskyed pa'i sku rnams byung bar gyur to/ /byung nas kyang nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam ⑤rnams su sgra dbyangs gcig gis chos kyi dbyings khyab par rnam par rig par byed pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di sgrogs (7par gyur ton/ /chos kyi mtshan nyid gang las ni/ /chos rnams dag ni thams cad dang ske/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang nyan thos dang / /rang rgyal skyob pa rnams dang ni / /byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang / /de bzhin rgyal ba mchog rnams dang ske/ /sems can snod kyi 'jig rten dag /btags pa rim pa bzhin 'byung zhing rka/ /chos rnams skye dang gnas pa dag /gang las rtag tu 'byung 'gyur ba/ /shes rab thabs dang ldan 'gyur zhing dzo / /yid gnyis som nyi 79)dang bral ba/ /rdzogs lasangs rgyas kyis rab 11bshad pa'i/ /lam 'di khyed lokyis bsgom nya par gyis / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku chos kyi dbyings las byung 7ba de dag 86—562 4

gis chos kyi dbyings thams cad rang gi sku rnam par rig par byed pa/ sprul pa'i sprin gyis yongs su bkang nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs kyi ①dbang tsam gyis ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas sangs rgyas 'byung ba gcig nas gcig ②tu brgyud pa ①byin gyis brlabs te/ rang rang gi chos kyi dbyings kyi gnas su zhugs par gyur to/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor rnam par dgod pa lha rnams kyi gnas yang dag par gnas ④par bsam pa sa bon dang bcas pas mtshan pa yod kyis(zhin/ de nyon la legs par rab tu yid la zung ⑥shig dang / ngas khyod la bshad do/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje (lebacom ldan 'das la nyan to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal pa(kye/dang por sngags pas dkyil 'khor de/ /rang gi lus la dgod byas te⑨/ /rkang pa nas ni chu so la/ /thug gi bar du sa yir 7bsam/ /37de nas grong mdu snying ga'i hu bar/ /sdom brtson can gyis skochu yir nyunyebasam/ /chu yi yan cad 57me yi ste/ /me yi yan cad rtso rlung yin no/ /bsams spelanas de nas mkhas pa yis / /sa la gzugs brnyan gzhag par bya/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje ri gebacom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi sa la zhugs ri rinas chos mnyam pa nyid la bltas te/ ma 'ongs pa'i skye bo rnams la brtags nas rig sa sngags kyi rgyal po the tsom gethams cad gcod par byed pa 'di smras so/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ a sa ma pa ti dharma dhā tu kā gebya ga ti ga tā shāri ge/sarba gathā/ i khaṃ i a/ si sa haṃ ha/ raṃ ra bam̐ ba swā hā/ rghaṃ ma hā swā hā/ ro 86wa 563

ra swā hā/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes gsang sngags kyi rgyal po chen po 'di smras ma thag tu de nas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ①phyag g.yas pa brkyang ste phyag na rdo rje'i spyi bor bzhag ②nas legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /rigs kyi bu gang khyod kyis bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi sa la zhugs dunas/ thams cad du gsang sngags kyi tshul la mnyam pa nyid du gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la snang bar bya bar 'dod pa'i phyir / gsang sngags kyi rgyal po 'di smras pa legs so legs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub kyi snying po la bzhugs te/tshig bcu gnyis po 'di dag gis chos kyi dbyings rnam par dpyad ④cing bdud bzhi pham par byas nas chos kyi dbyings nas 'a)byung ba 'di dag gnas gsum nas byung ste/ bdud sdig can rnams btul ⑥bar gyur tome/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 78)sku dang gsung dang thugs mnyam pa nyid brnyes nas nam mkha' tshad med pa'i phyir sku tshad med pa brnyes par gyur/ de bzhin du gsung dang thugs tshad med pa yang brnyes par gyur to/ /de ltar ye shes tshad med pa dang ldan zhing ske/ chos thams cad la dbang thob pas 'di ltar gsang sngags kyi rgyal po tshig bcu gnyis po 'di dag nyid las brtsams te/ chos 'chad do/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyang bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs mnyam pa nyid la zhugs 99pas na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bzhin du snang ngo / /thams cad mkhyen pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad la/ /86—564 7

sngags spyad tshig mchog zhus shig dang / /cho ga rgyas pa ①bka' stsal to/ /nged kyang sngon ni ②'di rnams kyis/ /bla med byang chub rtogs nas su/ /mya ngan 'das lam 'gro ba yi/ /mnyam pa med pa'i chos bshad pa/ /'jig rten khams na bzhugs pa yi/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams dpang du gyur / /de nas dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ /bsam pa mchog rab mgu gyur pa/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis byin brlabs ④pas/ /'di skad ces ni tshig smras pa⑤/ /chos 'di rnams ni mtshan nyid med/ /ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa/ /las dang tshe las ⑥rnam par grol/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'dra bar 'dod/ /thugs rjes ⑦mnga' ni mdzad ⑧pa yi/ /mgon po rnams kyi thabs kyis ni/ /rnam par sprul ⑨nas chos rnams kyi0/ /mtshan nyid 'di dag rtogs par 'gyur/ /de nas gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes ched du brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa de smras nas/ ma 'ongs pa'i nyunya'agro ba rnams la bltas te/ge/ snying rje chen po'i snying po 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'di'i the tsom gcad nyugepa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad la zhus pa/ sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /kun mkhyen snyun chadang bral ba'osko/ /the tsom mthams cad gcod /namadzad pa/ /'dren pa khyed /7shel zhu ba ni/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni sngon rol du/ /ci zhig bgyi ba 'dren pas gsungs/9)/ /thub pa chen po slob dpon dang / /slob ma'ang rnam pa du ru bshad/ /sa gzhi ci 'drar 'tshal bar bgyi/ /de yang ci ltar sbyang bar bgyi / /ci ltar sa ni dag par 'gyur/ /ci ltar de ni brtan pa lags/ /slob ma'i dgos pa gang gis bgyi/ /sbyang ba'ang 'dren pas bka' stsol cig /dag pa'i mtshan ma ci 'dra dang / /gang gis de dag bsrung 2 ribar bgyi/ /sa ni gang 86—565

gis byin gyis brlab/ /der ni dang po ①gang gis brtag /sa yi cha las thig gdab pa'i/ /srad bu rnam pa ②du 'tshal ①bgyi/ /mchod pa rnam pa dur ④'tshal bgyi/ / me tog bdug spos ci 'drar dang / /me tog dang ni bdug spos dag /zhuci ltar dbul ba 'dren pas gsung ⑥/ /lha bshos sbyin sreg ⑦las rnams kyang / /gang dag las ⑧ni ji ltar bgyi/ /lha rnams kyi stini gdan dag kyang ske/ /gang la gang gis bgyi ba gsungs/ /kha dog dbyibs dang gzugs rnams kyang / /go rims ⑩bzhin du mgon pos gsungs/ /lha rnams dang ni phyag rgya dang / /gdan gyi tshad kyang bshad du gsol/ /phyag rgya rnams ni gang nas byung / /ci phyir phyag rgya zhes kyang bgyi/ /dbang bskur rnam pa du ⑩'tshal bgyi / /dam tshig rnam pa du zhig mchis/ /sngags 32spyad pa la brtson pa yi/ /sngags pa byang chub sems dpa' dang / /thams cad mkhyen par ci ltar 'gyur/ /ci ltar bden pa mthong bar 'gyur/ /dngos grub rnam pa du nyanya'atshal bgyi/ /grub pa'i dus kyang bka' stsal cig /grub nas nam mkhar 'gro ba dang / /ci ltar mi snang 'gyur ba dang / /gtso bo lus 'di ma bor bar/ /ci ltar lha yi yilus thob ske'agyur/ /sprul pa rnams ni sna tshogs pa / /de la gang nas 'byung bar 'gyur/ /nyi zla me dang phyogs rnams dang / /rgyu skar gza' dang skar ma dang —/ /yud tsam dang ni thang cig 1 tshodang / /rga dang 'chi dang rgud pa dang / /ltas ngan dag ni thams cad kyang / /de la ci ltar 'byung mi 'gyur/ /rkang gnyis gtso bo sangs rgyas dang / /sngags pa ci ltar 'bral mi 'gyur/ /sbyin sreg las dang me dag dang / /tshim par bgyi ba du 1 'tshal bgyi/ /lha rnams kyang ni so so yi/ /ngo bo nyid ni 'dren pas gsungs/ /'jig rten pa yi sngags 86—566 7

rnams dang / /de bzhin 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /tshad dang 'bras bu grangs rnams ①dang / /ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par dang / /las kyi rnam pa gang du smin / /ci ltar rnam par smin mi 'gyur/ /sngags pa rnams ni nam zhig na/ /las dang tshe las rnam grol 'gyur/ /de nas kun mkhyen rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bcom ldan snyun ②dang bral ba yis/ /rdo rje 'dzin la 'di skad gsungs/ /snying rje chen po'i rtsa las 'byung tshoṭa/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor rnam byadagod pa/ /lha rnams kyi ni rnam 3)nges pa/ /theg pa chen po'i go 'phang mchog /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi rab gsung (7ba/ /dpa' bo cher 'byung khyod kyis gang / /yongs su dris pa de legs so/ /lag na rdo rje stobs chen la/ /mdor ni bsdus (benas bshad par bya/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni sngon rol du/ /bya ba rnams ni des pas nyon/ /so so'i las rnams 'dod pa yis/ /tshul shes pas ni ci rigs par/ /rang gi ting (kye'adzin la gnas te/ /rig ri'isngags rgyal po stobs po che yan lag bcu gnyis tshig 'byung ba/ /go rims mabazhin du bzlas brjod bya/ /gsang sngags phyag rgya rtogs shes pa'i/ /slob dpon rnam pa gnyis shes nyunyebya/ /zab dang mi zab bye brag las/ /de yi mtshan nyid shes par bya/ /zab mo rgya cher shes par bya/ /lus can rnams ni yid mi rton/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi 5gesras mchog ste/ /mthong ba'i chos ni rnam par spangs/ /gnyis pa mthong ba'i chos rnams kyis/ /myos par gyur pa dmigs pa can/ /sangs rgyas rkang gnyis mchog rnams kyis/ /'jig rten pa yi ha dkyil 'khor kun/ /de yis bri bar bya ba'i phyir/ /rjes su gnang zhing dbang yang bskur/ /dus dang dus min bye brag las/ /slob ma rnam bzhir shes bya ste/ /gcig ni de yi mod las bsgrubacige//86—567

gnyis su bsgrub ①dang gnyi gar ②min/ /mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa yidu/ /slob ma de ni rgyal ba'i mchog /sa ni dang por shes bya brjo/ /sems kyi ⑤sar ni bshad par byayi/ /sbyang ba sngar ni bstan pa ste/ /de yis de ni yongs su sbyang ge/ /nam zhig nyes dang bral ba na/ /sems kyi las ni mi 'jigs ⑨pa/ /de tshe de ni dag pa ste/ /nyes pa thams cad rnam par spangs/ /mngon par byang chub ⑩mthong bas na/ /de ltar de ni brtan zhes bya/ /de las gzhan du sa sbyong ba/ /de ni dag par mi 'gyur ro/ /sngags pa rtog la gnas nas su/ /gang zhig sa sbyong 7byed pa ni/ /byang chub sems ni rnam spangs pas7/ /gsang ba'i bdag po de mi 'dag rte /de bas rtog pa rnam spangs nas/ /sa kun rnam par sbyang bar bobya/ /nga yis dkyil 'khor rnams kyi 7ni/ /cho ga rgyas pa ⑩gang bstan 7pa/ /de dag thog mar bstan pa ni/ /rmongs pa rnams kyis mi shes te/ /rtog pa sdug bsngal rgyur gyur patha/ /ci srid ma spangs bar du ni/ /'jig rten 'di nas na sangs rgyas min/ /kun mkhyen zhes ri kyang mi bya'o/ /slob ma rnams la nan tan du/ /byang chub sems kyis sbyang bar ( rjebya/ /bsrung ri ci ba mi g.yo mgon po'amatsho snye/ /khams gsum rnam par rgyal bas bya/ /slob ma nam zhig dmigs pa yis/ /nam yang g.yos par mi 'gyur ba/ /de tshe dri med nam mkha' bzhin/ /yang dag par ni dag par 'gyur/ /sa byin gyis brlab ( chedang po ni/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis bya bar bshad/ /gnyis pa sems kyi dbang gis te/ /'dir ni gzhan du mi bya'o/ /srad bu rnam pa ( 2bzhir bshad de/ /dkar po ser po dmar po dang / /nag po zhes ni bya bar brjod/ /lnga pa nam mkha' lta bur bshad/ /bar snang la ni bzung 35nas su/ /der ni dkyil 'khor 86—568 7

brtag ①par bya/ /srad ①bu dag ni gnyis pa yis/ /sa la dkyil 'khor dgod par bya/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad dang / /de chasras blo can rnams kyi gdan/ /padma yid las byung ba'i mchog /bkra shis 'jig rten rnams kyi sngags④/ /rang rgyal dang ni dgra bcom pa/ /phyogs gcig ⑤shes par gang grags pa/ /de dag stan du shes bya ba⑥/ /padma las byung 'dab ma'o/ /'jig rten gyi ni lha rnams gang / /tshangs la sogs pa 'jig rten gragasasti/ /de dag stan ni padma dmar/ /rgyal po rnams kyis bsngags 9kyepa'o/ /phal pa rnams kyi ⑨ci rigs par/ /sa yi bye brag dag las sama'i/ /mchod pa rnam bzhir shes bya ste / /phyag 'tshal thal mo sbyar ba dang / /de bzhin byams dang snying rje dang / /me tog bdug spos 'jig rten pa'i(spe/ /sor mo las byung me tog rnams/ /skyob pa kun la 8dbul bar bya/ /yan lag kun 'byung phyag rgya ni/ /bcings nas byang chub sems bsgoms te/ / so sor skomagon po thams cad dang / /de ④sras rnams la nan tan bya'o/ /'di ni skyon med me tog ste'i/ /rab tu bsung zhim 8rnam par mdzes/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi ljon shing rnams/ /rgyal ba mchod pa'i phyir byung ba/ /ting 'dzin dbang gis sgyur rngub yi/ /sngags kyis de dag byin gyis brlabs(nye/ /chos kyi dbyings las byung ba yi/ /sprin mang 4)rgya che 4 )dam pa rnams/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi spyan sngar ni/ /de tshe rtag tu char bzhin 'bab/ /lha rnams phal pa gzhan la ni/ /me tog 'di rnams bsgrags pa ste/ /rang gi sngags rgyud rgyas shes pas/ /ci ltar rigs pa spedabul bar bya/ /de bzhin me tog byug ( rtespos rnams/ /ci ltar rigs 2 par rnam par bsam /mthe stebo srin lag sbyar ba ni/ /bkra shis pa zhes bshad pa ste/ /de yis sogeme 86—569

tog de blangs nas/ /rang gi snying ga'i 7phyogs nas dbul/ /'jig rten pa yi lha rnams la/ /lte ba'i thad ka ②nas zhes ①bya/ /bdug spos rdo rje byakhu tshur ram / /yang na ⑤padma'i phreng yib yis/ /bar snang la ni bzung ⑦nas su/ /'jig rten mgon skyob rnams la dbul/ /de las ⑧gzhan pa ⑨'jig rten pa'i/ /lha rnams la ni go rims 7bzhin/ /phyi dang nang gi bye brag gis/ /sbyin sreg rnam pa gnyis shes nya)bya/ /las dang tshe las rnam par grol/ /slar yang sa bon 'byung ba ste/ /las 'dod pa yis sbyin sreg bya/ /nang gi sbyin sreg zhes zhu su bshad / /phyi rol gyi ni gsum ldan zhing / /gnas gsum dang ni gsum la gnas / /las gsum gyi ni las grub pa/ /'jig rten pa yi 0sbyin sreg mchog /sbyin sreg las ni mi shes pas/ /gang dag gzhan du byed pa ni/ /sngags kyi shes pa spangs pa ste/ /glen des 'bras bu mi thob bo/ /de bzhin gshegs pas gsang 7sngags dang / /de bzhin rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis gsungs/ /dkar dang ser du shes par bya/ /phyag na rdo rje 7thams cad pa/ /'jig rten dbang phyug gsang sngags ni/ /las kyi bye brag dag las dkar/ /kun tu gru bzhi lham pa dang / /go rims tshabazhin du zlum po dang / /gru gsum dang ni zla gam 'dra/ /dbyibs ni legs par bshad pa yin/ /gzugs ni gnyis su shes bya ste(/ne/ /bud med dang ni skyes pa nyid/ /yang na kun tu thams cad kyi/ /kha dog dbyibs dang gzugs rnams te/ /bsam yas ye shes las byung ba3she/ /de bas de rnams bsam yas te/ /ye shes mkhyen gyi ye shes ni/ /sems can don phyir tha dad gyur/ /yid kyi rgya ni ci tsam pa/ /stan 17dang phyag rgya dag dang ni/ /lha yi tshad kyang go rims bzhin/ /de tsam du ni shes par bya/ /sangs rgyas gang 86—570 7

nas ①byung ba nas/ /phyag rgya rnams kyang de nas byung / /chos las labyung ba'i slob ma rnams/ /chos kyi phyag rgyas gdab par bya/ /de bas ①mdor na chos kyi dbyings④ / /mtshan ma phyag rgya yin par bshad/ /dbang bskur ⑤gsum du shes bya ste/ /de bas nan tan mnyan ⑥par gyis/ /phyag rgyas ⑦gang zhig dbang bskur dub/ /las dang bya ba spangs pa ste/ /skyob pa rnams kyi dbang bskur ⑨ba / /de ni mchog ste dang po yin/ /gnyis pa las dang bya ba yis/ /kun nas bslang bar yang dag bshad/ /gsum pa yid kyir tsoshes bya ste/ /yul dang dus ni spangs pa'o/ /bla ma legs par mgu byas nas/ /phan par byed pa tsogang smras pa'i/ /dbang bskur 'di ni mchog yin par/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis bsgrags/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi thamador na ni/ /dam tshig can rnams lngar bshad de/ /dkyil 'khor 'di ni mthong ba las/ /dam tshig shes pa gcig na ces bya/ /de la phyag rgya mi bstan cing / /sngags kyang sbyin par mi bya'o/ /byang chub sems kyi bye brag las/ /sngags dang phyag rgya yongs su bzung ski/ /dkyil 'khor mthong zhes bya ba 'di/ /dam tshig can gnyis shes bya ste'i/ /dkyil 'khor dang ni phyag rgya mthong / /las dang bya ba la yang sbyar/ /bla mas lung ni ma byin pa/ /de yang dam tshig shes par bshad/ /phyag rgya dkyil 'khor bri ba rnams/ /de tshe cho ga bzhin du bstan/ /gsang ba'i ye shes 'byung ba yi/ /dbang bskur 57med pa'i sngags pa'ang 51 yin/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /sngags pa cho gas dbang bskur 51 ba/ /dam tshig shes pa lngar shes bya/ /dam tshig can zhes 1rdzigazhan mi bya/ /brtul nizhugs bzang po byang chub phyir/ /gang zhig sems ni bsgom 1pa na/ /sngags pa gnas gsum mi 86—571

dmigs ①pa/ /de ni byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /thabs kyi snying stobs bskyed nas su/ /sems can don la sbyor ba na②/ /dmigs su med pa'i spyod thob ①pa/ /rgyal ba'i mchog tu shes par bya/ /thog ma nas ni zhi ba'i chos/ / ngo bo nyid ni med pa la/ /④gang gis ④sems ni ri rab bzhin/ /gnas pa de ni bden pa mthong / /'di bden 'di ni yang dag pa/ /de bzhin du ni mi bslu ⑥ba/ /ci ltar sangs rgyas bden gzigs pa/ /de bzhin sngon ni ngas mthong ba'i/ /byang chub sems thob gang yin de/ /dngos grub de las gzhan ci dgos/ /de las gzhan du'ang dngos grub ni/ /rnam pa dag ni lngar ⑦'dod de / / spyod pa'i (2)rjes su 'jug pa dang / /de bzhin sa ni gnon pa dang / /'jig rten mngon shes lngar ⑨'dod dang / /sangs rgyas nyid dang gang gzhan no / /rgyud las rgyud du gyur pa yi/ /las ni ci srid ma nyams shing / /rnam smin rnam par mi smin pa/ /dngos 0grub dag gi 0dus su 'dod/ /mdor na gang tshe dus gcig tu/ /las 8dang skye ba 'phangs gyur pa/ /de tshe'ang sngags pas dngos grub ni/ /yid las yang dag byung 6nyab 'thob// // bam po drug pa/0 grub nas mkha' snyil 'gro ba ni/ /ci ltar sgyug ma 'jigs med bzhin/ /sngags kyi dra bas rmongs byed pa/ /ci ltar mig 'phrul chen po bzhin/ /gang la lus dang ngag 7med pa/ /dri za'i grong khyer ci bzhin te / /de bzhin mi snang 'gyur zhes lho 7bya/ /de ni de na gnas pa yin/ /ci ltar nyal ba'i rmi lam na/ /sum cu lha rtsa gsum gnas su phyin/ /lus kyang spangs pa ma yin la/ /de nyid kyis kyang de ma song / /de bzhin rnal 'byor nyid kyis kyang ske/ /sngags pa sngags la gnas pa dag /bsod nams bya ba'i (/stelas rnams 86—572 1

kyis / /'ja' 0byedang 'dra ba'i lus ④kyang 'thob/ /lus dang ngag yid las byung ba'i/ /gsang sngags yid bzhin nor bu 'dra/ /de las rnam par bsams pa'i don/ /ma brtags par yang 'byung bar 'gyur/ /ci ltar nam mkha' ②phyogs rnams su/ /'dus byas spyod yul thams cad kyis/ /mi gos de bzhin sngags pa yang / /rtog ④pa'i spyod yul kun gyis so/ /'di kun 'du shes tsam du ni/ /nam zhig de ltar bsgoms ⑤gyur cing / /rnam par bsgoms na sngags pa deyi/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang lhan cig dga'/ /sangs rgyas rkang gnyis gtso bo yis/ /sbyin sreg ⑦gnyis su bshad pa ni/ /phyi rol gyi dang nang gi ste/ /de yang tshim par bya dang bcas/ /lha rnams kyi ⑧ni so so yi/ /rang bzhin yongs su mkhyen nas su/ /'jig rten pa yi sngags rnams kyi(pe/ /tshad dag legs par gsungs tsos ni/ /dbang phyug la sogs mthu chen rnams/ /bkur ba'i lha rnams gang yin pa/ /de dag gis ni gang byas pa'i/ /sngags dang phyag rgya stobs chen rnams/ /'bras bu phal cher nyunye'aphral du ster/ /tshad ni bshad pa de yin no/ /'on kyang skye dang 8'jig 8pa yi/ /chos can de dag brtan pa med/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i sngags rnams kyisko/ /thog ma'i byed pa med pa'o//las dang skye ba kun bcad pa/ /nyes pa gsum bral rgyal ba dang / /rang rgyal bse ru lta bu dang / /de bzhin rgyal ba'i nyan thos dang / /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis kyang / /gsang sngags tshad ni sngon bshad pa/ /dus gsum las ni shin tu 'das/ /rten cing 'brel pa 'ilas byung ba/ /mthong dang ma mthong 'bras bu canas/ /ngag yid lus las byung hu tshoba'o/ /'jig rten pa yi 'bras bu'i tshad/ /bskal nga/ gcig ri shetu bshad pa yin/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i 86—573

sangs rgyas kyi/ /gsang sngags 'bras bu bskal pa 'das/ /sangs rgyas drang srong chen po dang / /rgyal sras rnams kyi ting 'dzin ni/ /mtshan ma med cing dag pa'o/ /'jig rten pa yi mtshan mar bcas/ /rnam par smin pa 'di nyid la / /las kyi 'bras bu smin 'gyur ①ba/ /nam zhig dngos grub thob pa na/ /de tshe las kyang ldog ②par 'gyur/ /sems ni ngo bo nyid med phyir/ /rgyu ②dang 'bras bu rnams ④spangs shing / /las ⑤dang tshe las rnam grol bskyo/ /nam mkha' lta bur 'gyur ba yin/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po gzhan yang phyag rgya'i gzugs su dgod pa rim par phye ba lha rnams gnas pa ④byin gyis rlob pa/ting nge 'dzin lnga rtogs pa byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa/ chos kyi dbyings rtogs pa (gye/ spyod yul du gyur pa/ sems can gyi khams ma lus pa ri9)bsgral bar yi ⑩dam bcas pa rnams kyi don dang phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyis mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa de nyon la legs par rab tu yid la zung 17shig dang ngas khyod la bshad do/ /bcom ldan 'das ji 'o ltar 'tshal lo zhes gsol nas / phyag na rdo rje nya bcom ldan 'das la nyan pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po dang por yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi dkyil 'khor dgod pa rim par phye ba gang lagasas/ 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor grangs med pa byung ba gsang ba tshabs kyang ches gsang ba/ snying rje chen po'i snying po 'byung ba zhes bya ba 7yod kyis1 / de bri ba'i cho ga nyon cig /kun tu gru bzhi lham pa la/ /sgo gcig 1 pa ni stegs bur bcas/ /bzang po rdo rje rnams kyis 86—574

mtshan / /dbus su rdo rje rtse brgyad pa/ /de'i ①steng padma bri ba ni/ /sa bon dang bcas rgyas par byas/ /de yi steng du ②padma che/ /phyag rgya klad ②kor gyis mdzes byas/ /'dab ma brgyad rnams legs par rdzogs/ / ze bar④bcas pa shin tu bzang / /'dab ma rnams ni thams cad la/ /yan lag bcu ⑤gnyis tshig bkod pa/ /de rnams dbus na mgon bzhugs pa/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rkang gnyis gtso/ /dkyil 'khor brgyad kyi 'khor rnams kyis/ /kho ra khor ⑥yug yongs stibaskor btso/ /snying rje las byung dkyil 'khor 'di'-i/ /mchog tu shes par bya ba ste/ /lung bzhin dkyil 'khor rnams dang ni/ /las dang lus dang dngos grub dang / /dgod pa rnams kyang des pa yis/ /'di las byung ba ⑩shes par bya/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po gzhan yang de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dra zhing mdog /dung lta bu yi ⑪dbus na skoni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gru gsum pa/ /padma dkar po'i steng na gnas / /klad /nyakor bcas pa'i mtshan gyis btab/ /rdo rje'i mtshan mas mtshan pa ste/ /dpyad mi dgos pas 57kun nas ni/ /'od zer dag ni gnyis bya bge/ /gsang sngags mgon las 57byung nas su/ /de ni phyogs bcu rnams su song / /gsang ba pa'i bdag po gzhan yang / /spyan ras gzigs dbang ⑪dkyil 'khor ni/ / nges pas 12nan tan mnyan par gyisanyuge/ /kun tu gru bzhi lham pa la/ /dbus su ༄dung 'dra gzhag par bya/ /de yi steng du so/padma ni/ /sa bon bcas byas rgyas par bri/ /de'i 3 cisteng du yang gerdo rje che/ /rdo rje las kyang padma che/ /thams cad sa bon rnams kyis mtshan/ /rang gi sa bon legs par 0sbyar/ /sgrol ma dang ni khro gnyer can/ /de bzhin gos dkar can dang 86—575
