gzigs dbang phyug gi g.yon logs su mthu chen 0)thob pa padma'i ②phyag rgya'am yi ge'i dzo —)'brur gzhag go/ /ma/ mthu chen 4thob kyi rgyadrung du khro gnyer can ril ba spyi blugs kyi (7phyag rgya'am yi ge'i 57)'brur gzhag go/ /bla(2)/ padma 'dzin pa'i g.yas rol du 7lha mo sgrol ma utpa la'i phyag rgya'am yi ge'i 7'brur gzhag go//rta/lha / de'i drung du gos dkar can padma'i 'phyag rgya'am yi ge'i rtsonya'abrur gzhag go / /paṃ/ bcom ldan 'das kyi g.yon logs su rdo rje 'dzin rdo rje'i phyag rgya'am yi ge'i 8'brur bogazhag go/ /rba/ de'i g.yas logs su mā ma tī 0rdo rje'i phyag rgya'am yi ge'i nyi tsho'abrur gzhag go/ /mā/ de'i drung du rig pa'i rgyal mo yonaganod mdzes rdo rje'i phyag rgya'am yi ge'i nya6'brur gzhag go/ /si/ rdo rje 'dzin gyi g.yon logs su bdud rtsi thab ri )sbyor rdo rje'i phyag rgya'am yi ge'i nga nya'abrur gzhag go / /29 2/ de'i drung du ri/rdo rje 'dzin thams cad rdo rje'i phyag rgya'am yi ge'i ( riste'abrur gzhag go/ /rtsu/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 'og logs su me yi phyogs tsunyesu mi g.yo ba ral gri'i ri phyag rgya'am yi ge'i 3 'brur gzhag go/ /tsā na/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 'og logs bden bral gyi phyogs su 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba rdo rje be con gyi phyag rgya'am yi ge'i rna 'brur gzhag go/ /hā/ sgo drung gnyis su klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang bsnyen dga' bo gnyis/ dga' bo dang bsnyen dga' bo zhes pa'i ming du gzhag go/ /sgo khyud rnams kyi nang du bsrung zhumab bzhi dgod de 2/ shar phyogs su ral gri da dang yi ge'i tsho'abru'o/ /tsa/ byang phyogs su ral gri gdang yi ge'i tsho'abru'o/ /ba/ nub phyogs su be con dang yi ge'i 'bru'o/ /sa/ lho phyogs su be con dang yi ge'i ra 'bru'o/ /kṣa/ de nas phyi rol gyi ri mo'i nang rol du 9gnas kyi dkyil 'khor chung ngu la gnas 86wa 626

gtsang ma lnga rnams bri ba ni/ dkyil 'khor dang po la si si swā hā/ zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa la ma no ma ya nyu)zhes bya'o/ /gsum pa la dharmā (kye bha ba zhes bya'o/ /bzhi pa la bi bha ba zhes bya ba'o(9/ /lnga pa la ka ta ④nan zhes bya ba'o(5) yang na gnas kyi dkyil 'khor chung nyangu la si si swā hā zhes bya ba yang (7)gzhag tu rung ngo ske/ /bdag gi lha'i 98)ni rigs gang du gtogs pa de'i rigs kyi bdag po'i gnas su rang nyagi phyag rgya'am yi ge'i dza'abrur gzhag par bya'o/ /de nas phyi rol gyi ri mo'i nang thog thag tu padma bri'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi sgo'i g.yas rol du yonye'akhor sa'i nang rol du/ me yi rtsonathab khung bya ba ni/ /kho ra khor yug zlum po la/ /khru gang tsam gyi mi tshad du bya/ /zabs su sor ni bcu gnyis tshad/ /de yi steng du kha ran ni/ /kun nas chosasor bzhi'i tshad skodu bya/ /de yi zhabs kyi dbus su ni/ /'khor lo'i 'phang 7du sor gcig 3 bya/ /de nas 'dug la/dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcings te/ dam tshig gi gsang sngags brjod la/she/ yi ge sa nyunyedang padma'i phyag rgyas bdag nyid )spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug tu byin gyis brlabs te/ yi ge a rang gi dkyil 'khor la 27gnas pa las rnam par snang mdzad chen po'i sku ci lta ba bzhin du gyur par ri nabasams la/ nyid kyi phyag rgya yang bstan par bya'o / /de nas ral gri'i phyag rgya bcings la/ yi ge a las bdag nyid 27rnam par snang mdzad chen po'i skur byin gyis brlabs te/ dkyil 'khor gyi yi ge thams cad so so'i 2lha'i gzugs su gyur par bsams la so so'i phyag rgya rnams kyang bstan to/ /de nas 'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i sngags zlos shing 20las kyi rdo rje bcings la lha rnams so so'i 2'khor na ci snyed bzhugs pa la byug spos dang / me tog la sogs pa dbul lo/ /yi ge ras kyang rdul dang 86wa 627

bral ba'o snyam pa'i ting nge 'dzin mngon du byas la/ byug spos dang me rtog la sogs pa so so'i gsang sngags rnams ①kyis mngon par bsngags ②te/ byug spos la sogs pa la so so'i snying po'i ②sngags kyis ④kyang mngon par bsngags ⑤la dbul lo/ /byug spos 'di bzhes te bdag la thugs dpag ⑥mdzod cig ces so sor bskul bar stiyang bya'o/ /de bzhin du thams cad la yang ⑤sbyar ro/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā tsā/ tra ṭa 0a mo gha tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa/ sbo ṭa ⑩ya rgyu tra ṭa haṃ ma/ 'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i gsang ⑩sngags so/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/bi shu gas 8ba swā hā/ byug spos kyi gsang sngags so/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā shārka/ ma hā mi rgya byusgo te phonyes hā/ me tog gi gsang sngags so/ /na maḥs manta ④bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ dharma dhā tā 8nu ga te swā hā/ bdug spos kyi gsang sngags so/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ ta thā ga brtsi spha ra ṇa a ba bhā yis ga ga no dbya ⑩ga hā/mar me'i gsang sngags so/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā māṃ/ tree ya rnyi kā dzā8/ a ra ra/ pa ra ra/ ba li depo/ ba dzi dha dā hi 2)swā hā/ lha 0bshos kyi gsang sngags so/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ ga ga na sa ma sa ma swā hā/ mchod yon gyi gsang sngags te'u/ thog ma dang tha mar yang sbyar ro/ /snying po'i gsang sngags brjod pa'i cho ga ni/ oṃ bha ga bān bee ḍa nyaro tsa na/ i rda gi dhi lipra ti gro hya i rda me kāru 9 ༄ku ru swā hā/ de bzhin du thams cad la sasbyar ro0/ /zhi ba'i cho ga la na ni tsandan na dkar po ga bur dang sbyar ba 6)dbul losate/ /ma 'byor na tsopu shel tse dbul 2)lo/ /de bzhin du me tog padma dkar po dang / sna ma'i me tog dang / me tog ma dngha li ka dang / me tog yug ༷ti ka la sogs pa me tog dkar po dri zhim pa/ bkra shis pa gang yin pa de dag dbul lo/ /zhi ba'i cho 86—628

ga la ①bdug spos ni/ ga bur dang / tsandan namal/ yang na shi chab sa ka dbul lo/ /lha ④bshos kyang zho dang 'bras chan la sogs pa dkar po dbul ⑤lo / /mar me yang mar gyi mar me snod dkar po'i nang du blugs te dbul lo/ /dung la sogs pa snod dkar po'i nang du tsandan dang / ga bur dang / me tog dkar po sbyar ba'i chu blugs pa'i mchod yon dbul lo/ /de ltar ci skad bshad pa'i mchod pa byas nas/ de nas phyir byung ste/ bdag nyid spyan ras gzigs ⑥ dbang phyug tu byin gyis brlabs la/ phyi rol du phyogs kyi gtor ma sbyin pa ni/'bras yos bcas shing gtil dang bcasal/ /chu dang bcas shing ⑨'bras chan bcas7ske/ /me tog dang bcas 7sran chan bcas/ /kri sar bcas shing snum bag mang / /gtor ma 'di 'dra slob dpon 8gyis/ /lag pas blangs nas ⑫dga' bzhin du/ /phyogs kun tu ni ligator bya hunyezhing / /bdug spos tsomachod yon dag kyang dbul0/ /thog mar dbang ldan phyogs su ni/ /gzhu can tshogs dang bcas la dbul/ /de nas dbang po'i phyogs su yang / /mkhas pas dbang po nyid la dbul/ /de nas sngags pa mi 'jigs pas/ /me yi phyogs su dbul bar bya/ /de nas sngags pa 'jigs med pasanyunye/ /gshin rje'i phyogs su /ngedabul bar bya/ /sngags rig bden bral phyogs su ni/ /bden bral tshogs dang bcas la dbul9 — )/ /chu lha'i phyogs su klu rnams la/ /'jigs med rdo nagasang sngags zlos shing dbul/ /bdag por ni bcas la gi phul nas su/ /rlung gi phyogs su 'gro bar bya/ /sngags shes pa ni ( peder song nas/ /rlung lha ri khutshogs dang bcas pa la/ /rang gi ming nas smos nas su/ /rang gi sngags kyis gtor ma dbul/ /byang gi phyogs su song nas ni ye/ /yid ni rab tu dang byas te/ /86—629

bdag gi dngos grub thob 'dod pas/ /gnod sbyin rnams la gtor ma dbul①//srin po rnams dang sha za dang / /'byung po sha rjen ②can rnams dang / /sems can rnam pa sna tshogs la/ /mkhas pas gtor ma phyogs su gtor/ /sa phyogs de yi sems can ni/ /shing dang gel pa la gnas pa/ /blo la gang dang gang dran pa/ /de dang de la gtor ma sbyin/ /phyogs kyi gtor ma'i sngags ②ni/dbang ldan gyi phyogs su/ ru dā (7ya swā hā/ dbang po'i phyogs su/ sha krā ya (gyeswā hā/ me'i 3)phyogs su/ asna tshaneye swā (8)hā/ gshin rje'i phyogs su/ bee ba ⑨swā hā/ bden bral gyi phyogs su/ rākṣa sā dhi pa ta ye swā ⑩tā/ chu lha'i phyogs su / me gha sha na 37ye swā hā/ rlung gi phyogs su/ bā ya tsobe swā hā/ ku be ra'i phyogs su/ yakta bityā 1 dha ri swā hā/ kre ki ri mig hā/ srin po rnams kyi'o/ /mi tsi mi tsi swā hā/ rtsorto za rnams kyi'o/ /gu i gu i swā hāsnyi/ 'byung po rnams kyi'o / /de ltar kun tu gtor ma gtor la/ lag pa bkrus te nye reg byas la/de nas nang du zhugs te sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal nas/ bsreg ⑩par bya ba'i rdzas 1 gang 1 cung zad ci yod pa de dag thams cad 'phags pa mi g.yo bas bsangs te g.yas rol du gzhag go/ /g.yon rol 37du ni mchod yon gyi snod gnyis rtswa ku sha dang / spos chur 2 〉sbyar ba blugs 21te gzhag la/ gcig ni 'phags pa mi g.yo bas bzlas ri so/ /gcig dzo steni rdo rje dam pas sbyin gyis ( stebazlas so/ /zhugs thab kyi lhakhor yug tu rtswa 7ku sha bskor tsha — tshoba'i thabs su dgram mo / /bdag rang gar 'dug pa'i gzhir yang rtswa nyaku sha bskor ba'i thabs su gding ngo / /shing u dum bā rnamur dang / a shwattha'i gi tshodagang gzar dang /blugs 1gzar dang / mar bzhus pa yang mdun du gzhag go/ /de nas me'i 86wa 630

thab khung tsandan gyis bskus lho)te me tog dkar po dri zhim po'i sil ma yang bkram la / bram ze'i khyim nas me blangs la(gyi/ khro bo'i rgyal pos bsang gtor byas te/shing blakṣa chadang / u dum bā stira'i bud (nyeshing la (7rlung yab ⑦kyis me spar ro/ /der kha byang phyogs su bltas te 'dug la/ lag pa gnyis byug spos kyis bskus te(kye / dam tshig gi phyag rgya la sogs pa bcings la/ bdag nyid rnam par snang mdzad chen po'i sku chu'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa ci lta ba bzhin du phyag rgya dang /gsang sngags kyis byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas me'i (9thab khung gi zhabs su chu'i dkyil 'khor bsams la/ chu'i ⑩dbus su sngar hu)bzhin du yi ge bla gzhag pa las/ me'i gzugs su gyur pa dung dang / me tog kunda dang / zla ba'i mdog dang 'dra ba/ thor tshugs can/ mig gsum pa/ lag pa bzhi pa/lag na bgrang phreng dang / ril ba spyi blugs cho1snyedang / be con thogs pa dang spu/mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa dang 'i/ gos dkar po bgos pa dang ⑩/ srad bu dkar po se ral khar thogs pa/ snying gi hu tshosum mdo'i ris mtshan nyu can/ yi ge ras mtshan pa/ me lce dkar po 'phro ba/ ye shes kyi rang bzhin can de lta bu'i me lha //bsams la/ 'phags pa mi g.yo bas bsngags pa'i chu sngar bshams pas/ me la bskor ba'i thab tu 2 )bsang gtor bya'o/ /rdo rje dam pa ri 1sbyin gyis kyang lan gsum du bya'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā dzā/ mi naswā hā/ rdo rje dam pa ri 2sbyin gyi'o / /de nas me la rang gi gsang sngags kyis 2gebyug spos dang / me tog la sogs pa dbul lo/ /de nas mngar gsum las sreg blugs sa gsum byinari 'u/dgang gzar tsho 3chang pas gzung 2shel/ mar gyi dgang blugs smugasum sbyin no/ /de nas shing u dum bā ri stara'am/ a shwattha'i 16 mo'i yam sreg shing geganyis 86—631

mar la sgyugs pa bdun bsreg ①go/ /de nas yang mar gyi dgang blugs ②gsum byin la/ bsang gtor ①snga ma bzhin du bya'o/ / na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/du.oṃ ba ra dā ga na meye shārnyi ku ru ṭwā hā/ de bzhin du lha thams cad la yang so sor sbyin sreg byas la/ bsang gtor bya'o/ /na maḥs manta bud dhā ṭwāṃ/ hūṃ a ma hā shārnyi ga ta shārnyi ⑨kastir/ pra sha 6)ma dhasmra 0nir dzā ⑩ta/ a bhā ⑩ba swa bhā ba dharma sa manta māstang/ a mu ka /tshonyesu swa sti/ shānti baṃ ku ru 8swā hā/ zhi ba'i gsang sngags so/ /de nas sangs rgyas thams cad bsams la/ nang gi bdag nyid ⑫rnam par dag pas ci lta ba bzhin du ⑩byang chub kyi sems bsgom bomo/ /de nas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la rang gi lhonyerig sngags bzhag ste/ rang gi lha'i phyag rgya bcings la/ 'o)rang gi lha'i gzugs su bsgom pya mo/ /de nas yang snga ma bzhin du dgang blugs gsum la sogs pa phul te/ bskor ba'i thab tu tshubasang gtor yang byas la/ bdag gi durgyud las byung ba'i rdzas rnams ci srid mi skyo ba'i bar du sbyin sreg bya'o/ /skyo bar gyur na/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi skur 0bltas te/yang byang chub kyi sems bsgom 9 3mo/ /de nas mchod yon phul lasanye/ lha rnams la phyag byas te/ slar snonyagashegs su gsol lo/ /lha thams cad bla slar gshegs su gsol nas/ phyag rgya'i tshogs rnams ( shegos sar ( rje)pas g.yogs la/ phyi de nyin tsho tshoyang snga ma bzhin du/ lha rnams so so'i dkyil 'khor la gnas par bsams te/ cho ga'i rim pa de nyid nam zhi bar gyur gyi bar du bya'o/ / cho ga shes pa'i sngags grub pa/ /gang zhig cho ga 'di yis su te/ /le lo med par zhi byas na/ /zhi ba nyid du 'thob gi par 'gyur/ /zla ba phyed kyi khams ris gcig /nges pa nyid du zhi bar 'gyur/ /rgyal po la ni zhag bcu gnyis/ /yul phyogs su 86—632

ni zhag bcus soyi/ /de la zhi ba'i cho ga'i las byed pas cho ga 'di ltar spyad par bya'o/ /gos dkar bgos shing gtsang la zhi/ /byang chub sems la ②rab tu gzhol / /ku sha bting ba'i stan la nyal/ /de las byas pa'i bsang ③byed thogs / /nas btsos pa'am ④'o ma 'thung ⑤/ /yid ni zhusbyin sreg byed la 'jug /dus gsum sbyin sreg bzlas brjod kyis/ /zhi ba'i cho ga spyad par bya'o / /zhabs stibasil rdo rje mchog sbyin gyis/ /bsang ⑧gtor mi g.yo mgon gyis sol/ / 'dir ni re zhig mdor bsdus na/ /sbyin sreg cho gar bsgrags pa yin⑩/ /rnam par snang mdzad chen po mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa rnam par sprul pa 0byin gyis rlob pa tsolas/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga rim par phye ba'o// // de nas gzhan yang 8skal 8chen po/ /8sngags la mkhas pa rnams kyis sngon⑩/ /sems can rnams la thugs brtse nas/ /sbyin sreg rgyas pa che byed pa/ /phan par bzhed nas bshad pa yang / /yid gcig bsdus te mnyan par gyisabo/ /de bas rnam pa thams cad du/ /rgyas pa'i cho ga spyad par bya(she/ /grong ngam yang na ljongs dag gi/ /shar gyi phyogs su gnas bcas nas/ /snga ma bzhin du nges pa yi/ /sa gzhi legs par brtag par bya/ /ri yi rtse 'am phyugs lhas samatsun / /mchod rten ring bsrel ri ze can dag tu/ /rgyas pa'i las ni sgrub ri —rjebyed pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor shes rab can gyis bri/ /mkhas pas las kyi cho ga yis/ /sa ni legs par brkos so nas su/ /dbus su rin chen 'bru dang so ni/ /sman dang bcas pa bsres gzhag sterdo rin/ /der yang sa ni ser po yis/ /sa ni ( gelegs 86—633

par dgang bar bya/ /mnyam zhing legs par bcags nas ni①/ /de yi 'og tu dkyil 'khor bris/ /'dir yang re zhig ②sngags pa cho ga la bumakhas pas bdag nyid 2rdo rje dam pa sbyin par bsgom zhing ⑥/ rang gi dkyil 'khor la gnas pas97ske/ de'i gsang sngags dang phyag rgyas dubyin gyis brlabs la/ 'phags pa mi g.yo bas mtshams gcad (7pa dang sa 0yongs su gzung ba ⑨/bya'o/ /zla ba yar gyi 32ngo'i tshes gsum mam lho lnga'am bdun nam yang na zla ba nya la yang rung ste/gza' 〉bzang po gza' lhag gam/ phur bu'am/ rgyu skar gro bzhin tsodang /mon gru dang / snron dang / snar ma la8/ bdag nyid rnam par snang mdzad chen por byin gyis brlabs te/ srad bu ser po blangs la grangs dang hu)tshad snga ma nya bzhin du dkyil 'khor gyi 37thig gdab bo/ /de nas dkyil 'khor bskor te nang du zhugs la/ bcom ldan 'das ma shu 7shes rab kyi pha rol tu ( nyephyin pa bklags 2la phyag kyangatsho rtebyas te/ yang bdag nyid rko snyernam par snang mdzad du 2gebyin gyis brlabs la 3 tshotshon rtsi ser po blangs te9 rmo/ der ni yi ge ka ( —snyebazhag pa/ /de tshe thub pa gser thub ni/ /gser gyi kha dog 'bar dang bcas/ /ting 'dzin gnas shing sdig bcom pa'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor 3)rta babs can bris du3 la nub phyogs kyi sgo rtag tu dbye'o/ /phyi rol 8)ri mo gru bzhi pa gsum gyis bskor la / dkyil 'khor du lha rnams dgod pa snga ma bzhin du bya'o/ /de la khyad par ni 'di yod de 2/ 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po'i gnas su kun du bzang po rin po che'i rgyal mtshan gyi phyag rgya yi ge sa dang bcas pa gegazhag go/ /sa/mdzod spu'i gnas su gi 'phags pa rmugs 'dzin gi shing tog sni dza pu ra'i rigaphyag rgya dang yi ge rdza bdud rtsi'i mtshan nyid can dang bcas par gzhag go/ /rdza/86wa 634

'phags ma khro gnyer can gyi gnas su grags ldan ma me tog pri yang ku'i phyag rgya yi ge ya ①dang bcas par gzhag go/ /ya/ 'phags ma gos dkar ②can gyi gnas su ni dpal chen mo 'phags ma dkar mo zhes bya ba padma'i phyag rgya dang yi ge'i du'abrur gzhag go/ /shrī/ 'phags pa gnod mdzes kyi gnas su ni dpung bzang rdo rje'i phyag rgya dang yi ge'i 9)'brur gzhag go/ /rtsu/ bdud rtsi thab ⑤sbyor gyi 6)gnas su ni rdo rje'i sde (7rdo rje'i phyag rgya dang yi ge'i ni'abrur gzhag go/ /sal/ gnas gtsang ma pa rnams kyi khaganas su ni brgya byin dang 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi dgod do/ /de nas phyi rol gyi ri tsomo gnyis kyi nang logs kho ra khor yug dang grwa thams cad du rdo rje bri'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi g.yas logs 'khor sa'i nang du me'i thab khung bya ba ni/ gru bzhi lham pa kha ran can/ /rgyar ni khru do'i tshad du bya/ /rdo rje yis ni 'khor bar 7bskor/ /zabs su khru gang tsam gyi tshad/ /kha ran mthe'u chung 7mtho gang tshada'oge/ /'jim pa ser po'i skyong nul bsku'i/ /padma'i phyag rgya mdzub tshigang tshad/ /'phang ⑩du sor bzhi'i tshad du bya/ /dus gsum du ba lang ’ tshogi rtsi ba sa la ma lhung bas bsku'o/ /de nas snga ma bzhin du dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po'i lha la sogs pa rnam pa dang /mtshan ma ci lta ba bzhin du bsams te/ byug spos dang me tog la sogs pas mchod par yi bya'o/ /de la khyad par ni //'di yod de gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad gnas su bzhugs su gsol ba dang / byug spos dang me tog la sogs pas mchod pa byed pa 2 node'i tshe/ bdag nyid shusterdo rje dam pa ri snyesbyin du byin gyis brlabs te bya'o/ /'dir byug spos dang / me tog la sogs pa'i khyad par bshad par bya ste/ gur gum ga bur bsres pas nyeni/ /rgyas pa 86—635

dag la byug spos mchog /dri zhim kha dog ser po yang / /de ma rnyed ①na sbyar bar bya/ /me tog tsam pa rab tu bzang / /yu ti ⑤sna ma ser po dang / /de las gzhan pa'ang dri zhim pa/ /ser po dag ni dbul bar bya/ /gur gum a ka ①ru dang sbyar/ /sha kha ra dang sbyar ba dag /rgyas pa'i las rnams 'grub bya'i duphyir/ /bdug spos mkhas pas dbul bar bya/ /gu gul dang ni tsandan yang ⑤/ /mar dang sbyar ba ⑥bdug spos mchog / sra rtsi pog ni ⑦kur gum bsresani/ /bdug spos sngags la mkhas pas dbul/ /mar me snod ni gser gyi bzang / /yang na kham pa'i ⑨ser po'ang rung / /mkhas pas ras ni ser po yi mar me'i 0snying po ser po dbul/ /spos kyi 'bru mar bzang po yis/ /de yi snum ni dri zhim bya'o0/ /yang na til gyi 'bru mar gyis/ /mar me gtsang ma dbul bar bya / /'bras chan tsoser po sran tshod can8/ /mar dang bcas pa shin tu bzang / /tshod ma rnams kyang ser por bya/ /shing tog bag cos 8de bzhin no//spos chus 8me tog ser po dang / /de bzhin 'bras dang drar ⑩ba'i rtswa/ /snod kyang ser por blugs pa dag /rgyas pa la ni mchod yon shis/ /de ltar mchod pa ci lta ba bzhin du byas te/ de nas bdag nyid 8rdo rje dam pa 4)sbyin du ⑩byin gyis brlabs la/ phyi rol du byung ste phyogs kyi gtor ma sbyin no/ /de nas nye reg byas te nang du zhugs la/ sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag byas te me'i thab khung gi drung du bsreg par bya ba la sogs pa sngags kyis bsang ba ( )rnams/ snga ma bzhin du gzhag la/ sa la rtswa ku sha bting ba'i steng du padma'i skyil mo krung (nyebacas te 'dug nas ge/ bdag nyid rnam par snang mdzad chen po'i skur bsams te khang pa'i nang 3stebyug spos ser pos zhugs thab dgebaskus la 9 steme tog 86wa 636

ser po chasil ma yang bkramacha/ rtswa ku sha yang ①bting ste/ rgyal rigs kyi khyim mam ④rgyal po'i pho brang nas me blangs te (gebasang gtor byas teyi/ shing blakṣa dhi dang u dum bā ⑧ras me spar la/ de nas me'i thab khung gi zhabs su dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor bsams te/ der 6)yi ge ya klad 0kor dang bcas pa 7padma la gnas pa bsam mo/ /yi/ yi ge ra bilas thab khung gi hunyenang nas me byung bar bsam ④pa ni/ gser gyi kha dog lta bu'i thor tshugs can/ mig gsum pa/gdong pa 8bzhi pa/ lag na bgrang phreng dang ril ba spyi blugs thogs pa dang dam pa ⑩sbyin pa/ gos ser po bgos pa/ srad bu ser po ⑩se ral khar thogs pa / sor ris gsum gyis byugs pa/ sum mdo'i ris mtshan can/ yi ge ras mtshan pa/ gser gyi kha dog 'dra ba/ me lce 'bar ba kun du 'phro ba/mthu chen po dang ldan pa/ gsang sngags kyi rgyal po'i 'od zer las byung ba'i me de lta bu (3bsams te/ de nas bsang gtor bya ba dang / kha bkru ba dang /mchod yon dbul bar 3)byas la/ byug spos dang me tog la sogs pa rang gi sngags kyis ( )sbyin no/ /na maḥs manta bus nān/ oṃ asna ( nyele swā hā/ de nas 'o thug sprang rtsi dang mar la sogs pa du rtesbyar ba'am/ til nag po mar zhu 3dang sbyar ba'i sreg ( ri)blugs gsum byin te/ de nas shing bil ba'i dgang gzar ku snyedang blugs gzar 9gyis mar gyi dgang ru blugs bdun sbyin no/ /de nas shing blakṣa'am( nyal/ u dum bā ( pera'i dbus kyi cha las byung ba'i yam zhu )sreg shing sboms su 31chang gang pa la srid du khru gang ba mar las sgyugs pa'i sreg blugs ji gegasum byin la yang dgang sasterlugs gsum sbyin no/ /de nas de dgesnga ma bzhin du lha'i gzugs rnams bsams te snying po de dang des sreg cigablugs gsum dbul lo/ /86wa 637

de nas sangs rgyas thams cad bsams te/ byang chub kyi sems bsgoms la bdag gi lha'i gzugs ①bsams te snga ma bzhin du sreg ②blugs gsum ①phul nas bdag gi dngos grub bsgrub ④pa las bshad pa'i rdzas las sbyin sreg bya'o/ /thog ⑤mar oṃ zhes brjod pa la mjug ⑥cu grags pa dang dpal dang longs spyod dang dge ba dang nor la swā hā/ zhes bya bar ①sbyar ro/ /yang na bdag gis ci ltar bsams ⑧pa'i dngos grub kyi rdzas la swā hā zhes bya zhing sreg ablugs dbul lo / /de 0ci lta ba bzhin du sbyin sreg byas nas byang chub kyi sems la sogs pa'i rim pa de nyid snga ma bzhin du bya'o/ /'dir yang sgrub 7pa pos cho ga spyad pa ni/gos ni ser po bgo 8bar bya/ /bsang lhonyebyed ser po gtsang ma thogs/ /sems ni brtan zhing mthu yang che/ /shin tu mi smra ser sna med/ /byang chub sems la rtag tu dga'/ /dus gsum cho ga thog mar byed/ /nas chan btsos pa'am tso'o ma 'thung snyi/ /rgyas pa'i las ni brtsam ⑩par bya/ /gang zhig 'di yis ⑩rgyas pa yi / /las ni legs par rtsom byed pa/ /de yi zhunyeyid la gang bsams pa'i/ /rgyas pa myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /ral gri 'khor lo rdo rje dang / /ldong ros mig bsku gi wang dang / /yid bzhin nor bu bum pa gos/ /nor gyi char 'bab mchil lham 17dang / /gdugs dang shing rta bzhin 3 )pa dang / /de bzhin khang pa brtsegs stopa dang / /padma bum pa mdung rtse gsum/ /bgrang phreng be con gun dhe 22dang / /pi bang ni mdung thung mda' yang rung / /lhung bzed dang ni 'khar gsil lam ri/ /yang na rdzas ni gang 'dod pa/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni bsgrub gapar bya/ /rnam par snang mdzad chen po mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa rnam par sprul pa rmo 5byin gyis rlob tsho 7pa las/ rgyas pa'i /sbyin sreg gi las 86wa 638

kyi ①cho ga rim par phye ba'o// //de nas gzhan yang sbyin sreg 'di/ /dbang ②gi las ni rab sgrub pa/ /'jig rten sgron (kyem mdzad pa yis/ /brtse bar gyur pa'i thugs kyis gsungs/ /de ni ma lus bshad par byas(ye/ /'byor pa ⑤'dod pas nga la nyon/ / thog mar (6nyes gzhi brtag pa ni/ /grong ngam yang na ljongs dag gi/ /me yi phyogs su gnas bcas te/ / skye bo limed pa'i khang stong ngam/ /shing gcig drung ngam dur khrod dam/ /yang na bde byed gnas su'am/ /ma mo'i gnas sam phug (8༄kyang rung / /sngags pas dkyil 'khor bri ba ni/ /mar gyi ngo yi (she)tshes dgu la/ /dbang gi las ni btsam ri7par bya/ /gza' ni 3nyenyi ma'am mig dmar la/ /rgyu 57skar rgyal dang smin drug dang / /mchu dang sa ga dag la ni/ /mkhas pas dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /de la dang por sngags pas bdag nyid nyunyephyag na rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs la/ sa rshakha dog dmar po la/ sa masbyang ba dang yongs su gzung chosab la sogs pa byas te/ de nas bdag nyid rnam par snang mdzad chen por byin gyis brlabs la 'phags pa mi g.yo bas bzlas pa'i srad bu le brgan nyu /du btses /ho pa blangs te/ dkyil 'khor 517thig gdab pa ni/ gru gsum pa la sgo shar phyogs su gtod rdo )pa/ sgo khyud dang rta babs dang mu ran gyi cha legs par byas teri rte/de nas tshon rtsi dmar po ni/ /shin tu bzang po blangs nas su( ge/ /yi ge 'bar ba bzhag gepa ni/ / ra yi noyi ge klad ni dang bcas/ /nyi ma 'char ba 'dra ba ste / /shin tu gdul dka' 9rgyal ba'i mchog /de ltar tshon rtsi byin brlabs la ske/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dran byas te/ /dkyil 'khor kun du bri ba ni/ /86wa 639

khru gsum ①yang na khru ②lnga'am/ / yang na bdun nam dgu yang rung / /dugasang sngags dngos grub rjes mthun 0par/ /rnam pa gsum du dbye bar bya/ /lha rnams dgod pa snga ma bzhin/ /mkhas pas rigs kyi bdag pos bya⑤/ /lhag ma rnams ni ci rigs par/ /mkhas pa yis ni dgod par bya/ /de la nam mkha'i snying po'i yiganas su skra can dang nye skra can gnyis be con dang zhags pa'i phyag rgyar gzhag go/ /gnod mdzes kyi gnas su ni rdo rje lcags kyu mda'i phyag rgyar gzhag go/ / gtsug spyod ④kyang mda'i phyag rgyar gzhag go/ /phyi rol du ni phyag brnyan bzhi gzhags pa'i phyag rgyar 7bri'o/ /de nas snga ma bzhin du cho ga thams cad bya'o/ /byug spos dang me tog la sogs pa yang dmar po dbul lo/ /me'i thab ⑩khung yang snga ma'i gnas su bya ste/ srid du sor nyi shu'i tshad la kha ran sor gnyis pa kha phar bltas par 7bya'o/ /zabs su mtho chung ngu gang la dbus su rdo rje sor brgyad pas tsodamar pos bskus pa 8bya'o/ /me'i thab khung de ni gru gsum la zur gsum du bya'o/ /de nas bdag nyid 8phyag na 8rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs la phyi rol tu gtor ma sbyin tsono/ /de nas btso blag ⑩mkhan gyi khyim nas me blangs la snga ma bzhin lha bsang gtor bya'o)/ seng ldeng gi du )shing ngam a sho ku'am shing ka ra bī ras me spar 9 — la/ de bzhin du bdag nyid pornam par snang mdzad du byin gyis brlabs te/ me'i thab khung gi zhabs su me'i dkyil 'khor bsams ⑤la yi ge ra gzhag go/ /yi ge ra de yang 'bar ba'i phreng ba la 'od na ste'aphro ba las me'i gzugs su gyur par bsam 8 pa ni/ nyi ma 'char ba 'dra ba gdul dka' ba mig gsum pa thor tshugs tsho hokham pa lag pa bzhi pa lag na be con dang zhags pa dang bgrang 7phreng dang ( nye gun dhe ( mthogs pa/ gos dmar po gyon zhing srad bu 86wa 640

dmar po se ral khar thogs pa yi ge ras mtshan pa/ me lce 'bar ba dmar po'i 'od 'phro ba de lta bu'i me bsams te bsang gtor byas la mchod yon phul te rang gi gsang sngags kyis byug spos dang me tog la stsogs zhi)pa byin la/ de nas shing ka ra bī phyira'i yam sreg shing yungs mar dang tsandan dmar po la sgyugs pa'i sreg blugs ③bdun sbyin ④no/ /de nas dkyil 'khor du bkod pa'i lha rnams la sreg ②blugs bdun phul te/ snga ma bzhin du bdag gi lha'i gzugs bsams la gzhag ste/ de bzhin du sreg 0blugs phul la cho ga las byung ba'i rdzas rnams sbyin sreg bya'o(pe/ / mjug tu yang (kyebyang chub kyi sems bsgom pa ⑨la sogs pa'i cho ga de bzhin du bya'o/ /cho ga 'di ⑩yang dkyil 'khor gyi yo byad thams cad yidamar por bya'o/ /me'i gnas kyang dus gsum du tsandan dmar pos byug cing me tog dmar po sil mas 8dgram mo/ /dpal ldan gos ni dmar po bgosatsho/༷ste / /byug spos phreng ba dmar pos brgyanacha/ /srad bu dmar po 8se ral thogs / /byang chub sems kyi bye brag shes/ /zas su sran chung ci tshe za sang na zas su shing tog za/ /dga' zhing 'dzum mul 7mi smra thub / /sems dang sems ni rjes su sbyor/ /rtag tu bzlas dang sbyin sreg byed/ /lha yi gzugs ni sems pa yi/ /mi yis dbang du bya ba yi/ /dngos grub ma lus brtsam par bya/ /gang zhig cho ga 'di yis su/ /cho ga shes pas las brtsams nanyushe/ /gzi brjid can nam de yi bu/ /zla ba gcig gis ri nadabang du 'gyur/ /sbyin sreg zla ba tsho )gnyis byas na/ /phyag brnyan pho mos gnod sbyin ma/ /de bzhin sa 'og bu mo dag /sngags pas myur du khugs par 'gyur/ /'di sa ni re zhig sa mdor bsdus te / /dbang gi sbyin sreg bsgrags da pa yin/ /rnam par snang mdzad chen po 86—641

mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa rnam par sprul pa ①byin gyis rlob pa ②lasani/dbang du bya ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga ④rim par phye ba'o// //da (geni drag shul spyod pa yi/ /cho ga ma lus bshad par bya/ /gnod sbyin lto 'phye yi dgas yigatum/ /lha min dri za mi 'am ci/ /sems can gnod dga' snang ba ⑦dang / /de bzhin bgegs dang log 'dren dang / /'byung po ma mo srin po dang / /mkha' 'gro dang ni lus srul dang / /mi yang rgyags dregs mthu ldan zhing / /drag po'i las byed snang ba'ang rung / /de dag 'dul 'u)phyir sngags shes pas/ /phyo)drag shul las ni brtsam par bya/ /nyes pa chung ngu dag la ni/ /drag po'i cho ga mi brtsam mo/ /grong gi lho yi phyogs su ni/ / sdom brtson ⑩sa gzhi nag po la/ /dur khrod dben pa'ang tunyedagon pa 'am/ /skyed 7mos tshal rnying zhi gnas su/ /mar gyi ngo yi tshes brgyad dam/ /yang na tshes ni bcu bzhi la / /gza' ni spen pa mig dmar dang / /rgyu skar rlung las byung ba dang / /me bzhi dang ni nag pa dang / /tha skar dang ni de bzhin dbo/ /nab so dang ni sa ri dang / /1stergyu skar de dag drag po ste/ /de dag gang yang rung ba la/ /sngags pa gshin rje bzhin khros pasarshasna/ /dgra yi srog ni gcod byed pa'i/ / dkyil 'khor 'jigs pa bri bar bya/ /7sngags pa bdag nyid rang gi rgyas/ /rdo rje sems dpar byin brlabs 7te/ /sngags la 'jigs pa med pa yis/ /sa gzhi snga ma bzhin du sbyang / /de nas mi g.yo mthu chen gyis/ /yongs su gzung tshel sogs byas nas/ /rang gi yi ge'i 1 phyag rgya yis/ ju /de nas rnam snang mdzad du bya/ /bu mo gzhon nus bkal ba yi/ /srad bu sngon po der blangs nas/ /86—642

dkyil 'khor nan tan thig gdab pa/ /gru gsum phyi rol zlum por bya/ /khru bzhi khru lnga khru brgyad dam/ /de bzhin bcu gnyis khru bcu drug① /ci ltar las kyi rjes mthun ( par/ /mkhas pas tshad ni brtag par bya/ /de nas dur khrod thal ba'am/ /mkhas pas tshon rtsi 55)nag po la/ /yi ge ha ④ni der bzhag pa⑤/ /me lce 'bar ba'i (6)phreng ba 'phro/ /dus mtha'i me la (7)'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /dbyar gyi char sprin 'dra ba'i mdog /kha ni mche ba gtsigs pa la/ /lag na rdo rje cod (kyepan can/ /bdud kyi sde ni thams cad dang / /snang ba thams cad sdigs 6)byed pa/ /tshon la tshemakhas pas tshon de dganyunye /de 'dra'i yi ge bzhag ⑫nas ni/ /shes rab can gyis dkyil 'khor bri/ /ba dan mang po (nyematshan mas mtshan / /rta babs dang ni sgo khyud bcas/ /sgo yi cha 51steni legs par phye/ /lha yi gtso bo gzhag pa ni/ /snga ma bzhin du brtag par bya/ /byang phyogs sgo ni phye nas su/ /lhag ma'i sgo rnams gcad mapar bya/ /de nas tso'aphags pa nam mkha'i snying po'i gnas su khro bo'i rgyal po gshin rje'i gshed gsal shing gi phyag hunyergyar bri'o/ /mdzod spu'i gnas su khro bo'i rgyal po 'phags pa gzhan gyis mi thub pa zhes bya ba rdo rje dang dgra sta'i phyag rgyar bri'o:she/ /mthu chen thob dang 'phags ma khro gnyer can dang 17'phags ma sgrol ma'i gnas rnams su/ don yod pa'i du — byezhags pa dang ral pa gcig ma dang / rta mgrin rnams zhags pa dang dgra sta dang rdo rje be con gyi phyag rgya rnams su go rims nabazhin du gzhag par bya'o/ /gnod mdzes kyi 2 gnas su khro zla gtso bo'i nu rdo rje'i phyag rgyar gzhag go/ /'phags pa mi g.yo ba yang be con gyi phyag rgyar gzhag go/ /sgo drung du ni gdul dka' 22dang mngon du phyogs tsiganyis be con gyi phyag rgyar gzhag go/ /gnas 86wa 643

gtsang ma pa rnams kyi gnas su/ gshin rje'i 'chi bdag dang dus mtshan mo dang lhan cig tu gzhag go/ /bden bral yang ral gri'i ①phyag rgyar gzhag go/ /'khor sa'i nang du ②me'i thab khung sgo la phyogs par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol kho ra khor yug tu ba dan rnams bri'o/ /me'i thab khung ni dbang gi las kyi me'i ②thab khung bzhin du byas te④/ bye brag tu ⑤phyi rol gyi mu ran zlum por byas la ba dan mang pos mtshan par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor kyi lha rnams snga ma bzhin du so so'i gzugs bsams te mchod pa'i cho ga bya'o/ /de nas lha rnams ci lta ba bzhin ⑥mchod nas ⑦bdag phyag na rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs la phyi rol du phyogs kyi gtor ma snga ma bzhin du sbyin no/ /de la byug spos la sogs pa'i khyad par ni tsandan dmar po dang du ru ska ⑧sol ba dang tho)bsres pa'i byug spos nag po chadabul lo/ /me tog utpa la mthing ga 7dang / a pa rā dzi ⑩ta mthing ga 7'am/ gzhan yang me tog sngon po rnams dbul lo/ /bdug spos ni sra rtsi pog bu ram dang sbyar ba dbul lo/ /mar me 0ni yungs 0mar 0tsha ba snying po sngon po bocan mar me'i snod zhunyanag po'i nang du dbul lo/ /bshos ni 6tethi sar dang gzhan yang tsha zhu)ba dang 9 me/ kha ba la sogs pa ( gyebaza' ba dang tshod ma kha dog nag po rnams dbul lo/ /sran chan po snyedang kri sa ra dang sha dang nya 8stebatsos pa dang rjen pa rnams phyogs kyi gtor mar sbyin no/ /gtor ma'i cho ga ci lta ba bzhin du byas nas gdol pa'i khyim mam midur khrod nas me blangs te khro bo'i rgyal pos bsang gtor byas la/ dur khrod kyi shing ngam/ shing ba la ta ku'am/ ba ru ra'i shing gis rmo 5me spar 2mel/ bdag nyid po nyernam par snang mdzad chen por ( —)byin gyis brlabs te me'i thab khung gi zhabs su rlung gi dkyil 'khor bsams la 86wa 644

der yi ge rtsu gzhag go/ /yi ge rtsu de las me'i gzugs su gyur par bsams pa ni kha dog nag po shin tu mi bzad pa/ mig gsum pa/ gdong bzhi pa mi g.yo ba dud kha'o①/ /blta dka' ba/ kham pa po②/ thor tshugs dud kha ③can/char sprin sngon po lta bu'i 'od zer ④can/ gsus po che gos sngon po gyon la ⑤srad bu sngon po ⑥se ral khar thogs pa/ kha nas mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa khro ba dang bcas shing kha gdangs pa/ lag na ral gri dang zhags pa dang be con dang ril ba spyi blugs ⑦thogs pa snying ga gsum mdo'i ris mtshan can/ yi ge ras mtshan pa/ gdong khro gnyer bsnyer ba/ ⑨ zhes bya ba ⑩dang bcas pa 'bar ba gnag tunyecing rtsub pa nyunyezangs lta bu'i 'od zer 〈nye'aphro ba'i phreng hunyeb can/'jig 7pa'i dus mngon du byung ba bzhin du 'dug pa de ⑩lta bu'i me bsams nas bsang gtor byas te/ byug spos la sogs pa charang gi rig sngags kyis sbyin nopo / /oṃ asna dzo/3ye dzā nyi trad ṭa ( pe hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas yungs mar tsha ba dang sbyar ba'i kri sa ra'i sreg 0blugs gsum sbyin ( snyel/ dug dang khrag dang ske 3che'i sreg phyiblugs bdun sbyin no/ /yang na shing bha dgel ta ( nyedang / ba ru ra'i shing gi yam sreg ( cheshing rtse mo rnon por gzhogs pa yungs mar tsha ba dang ske tsher sgyugs ru3pa sbyin no/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po la sogs pa'i lha rnams snga ma bzhin du bsams te rdzas de dag nyid las rang gi rig pas sreg ( )blugs dbul lo/ /de nas rang gi lha so )snga ma bzhin du bsams te bzhag la/ rang gi rig pa las byung ba'i rdzas ci lta ba bzhin du/ mdzub sno7mo dang mthe so bos gzung ste khro ba nunyedang bcas par gsang sngags zlos shing / phaṭa dang bcas par ci srid 'dod pa de srid du gi sreg ri blugs dbul lo/ /de nas snga ma bzhin du byang chub kyi sems 86wa 645

bsgom ①pa la sogs pas ngal bso ②bar bya'o/ /sngags pa gang zhig 'di lta bu'i / /rab tu drag po'i las byed pa/ /de ni sum cu durtsa gsum gyi/ /gnas kyang rtsa (gemachog bzhin du sreg(nye /'dir yang cho ga 'di ltar bya'o/ /dpal ldan gos ni sngon po bgos/ /byug spos phreng ba sngon pos brgyan/ /srad bu sngon po (6)se ral thogs/ /byang chub sems la rtag tu gzholasti/ /tsha dang kha dang bska khub dang / /kri sa ra yi 0kha zas bza'atshu/ /lha rnams dgod pa'i don la mkhas / /gtsang zhing mchog tu tshul khrims ldan/ /spro ba che zhing dpa' snying can/ /khros pa 'jig rten mthar byed bzhin/ /lho phyogs kha bltas mi smra zhing //'dug pa'i thabs ni tsog bur 'dug⑩ /sbyin sreg bzlas la rtag tu 'bad/ /bsrung bodang bskyab pa dag la mkhas/ /mtshan mo sbyin sreg byed pa yis/ /drag shul 7spyad pa brtsam ④par bya/ /rnam par snang mdzad chen po mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa rnam par sprul pa byin gyis rlob pa 7las/ drag shul spyad pa'i sbyin sreg 7gi cho ga rim par phye ba'o// //de nas yang bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyisazhu tsho/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa pa nya rnams la/ stong pa nyid gnyis su med pa'i spyod yul/ rten cing 'brel par 19'byung ba'i snying po rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes 'thob pa'i rgyu/ spros pa thams cad dang bral ba gsal zhing dag pa/ yid kyis bsgrubs pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ tsho yongs su rdzogs par byed pa/chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid kyi chos bshad do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po snying rje chen po spyan ras gzigs 1dbang phyug /de'i tshe 86wa 646

thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje la smras pa/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi spyod yul/ stong pa nyid kyi rjes su zhugs pa/gsang sngags thams cad kyi dngos grub stsol ba/ gnas med pa/ mtshan nyid med pa/ ngo bo nyid med pa/ mtshan ①gzhi dang mtshan nyid dang bral bzhu/theg pa chen po thob par byed pa/ bdud rtsi sbyin pa de sngags kyi tshul la rnam par gnas pa'i rjes su zhugs pa rnams kyis ci ltar 'thob 6)par 'gyur/ de skad ces smras pa dang / gsang ba pa'i bdag po/ /phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba ston pas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi zhal du bltas nas/ bcom ldan 'das la nasa'adi skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi 55nargyud la lta ba/ snying rje chen po byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs (cadabang phyug de bdag la 'dri zhing mchis na/ bcom ldan 'das 'gro ba la phan par byed pa/ theg pa chen po thob par byed pa/ mtshan nyid med cing gnyis su med pa'i spyod yul/ gsang sngags thams cad kyi tshul gyi dngos grub stsol ba/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i snying po'i ngo bo nyid/ chos kyi dbyings kyi rjes su zhugs pa/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'byung bar byed pa/ stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid kyi tsunospyod yul gyi chos bshad du gsol/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ theg pa gsum yongs su rdzogs par mdzad pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes thob par mdzad pa/ rnam par rtog pa thams cad kyi rgya 86—647

mtsho las sgrol ba/ sems can thams cad la dgongs pa/ gsang sngags thams cad kyi dngos grub stsol ba/ bgegs thams cad skrag par mdzad pa/ 'byung po thams cad 'gugs pa/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi snying po bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ gzugs med pa/ sgra med pa/ dri med pa/ ro med pa/ reg med pa/① gnas med pa/ yid med pa/ rnam par shes pa med pa/yi ge med pa/ spyod yul med pa/ brjod du med pa/ spros pa med pa/ ma 'dres pas gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /chos gang rgyus byung de'i rgyu dang / /de rnams kyi ni 'gog pa yang / /gang yin ②de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ /③de skad gsungs nas ④dge sbyong chekhru/ /gzhan dbang yod pa ma yin phyir/ /grub pa yang ni gzhan du gyur/ /gnyis po ⑥yod pa ma yin te/ /rnam shes brgyad po de gnyis ⑦mtshan/ /de nas 'khor mang po 'dus pa de rnams/ so so'i ye shes mngon par 'dus byas pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi mthus/ bsam pa tha dad pa dang / blo gros tha dad pas tshigs su bcad pa gnyis gsungs pa'i don ci ltar rjes su mthun rdo par khong du chud nas byang chub sems dpa' de rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la ponyelegs so legs so zhes gsol nas legs par 7phul lo/ /gsang sngags tshul la legs gnas gang 1sto/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis bsngags pa yi1ste/ /yang dag nyid 'di 8sgom 'gyur bske/ /de dag sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur/ /de nas de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 0spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi byin gyis brlabs kyis/chi bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ / zlos pa rnam rtog 7las 'das pa'i/ /ma 'dres 86—648

sems ni nyid kyis bu①/ /②dngos grub kyang ni 'thob ①'gyur na/ / 'dus byas chos lta smos ci 'tshal/ /gang gis rta dang 'dra ba'i semasaX/ /mnyam par gzhag pas btul ⑤nas su/ /byams dang snying rje brtan byas na/ /dngos grub brtan pa mod la ⑥'thob/ /lachos rnams rtag tu ⑧ma skyes pa/ /de yi sa bon a yi mchog /rgyal ba dam pa rnams kyis gsungs/ /a khyani stong pa nyid ces bgyi0/ /yi ge'i phyi mo phyi mo kun/ /de bzhin 'dren ldan gang gi phyir/ /mi 'gyur mi 'gyur dang ldan pa/ /de phyir bsam par bgyi ba lags7/ /a dang u zhes pa dang ni/ / ṛ dang bla dang e mchog snang / /a mchog snang ba'i dam pa stesnyi/ /'di las thar pa thob ༷/nyeces bshadam/ /ka yi ris dang tsa 8yi ris/ / de bzhin ṭa 7yi ris mchog dang tso/ /ta yi ris dang pa yi ris/ / mthun pa'i sgrar bcas lnga dang nin / /ya ra la ba tsosha la sogs/ /thams cad rgyal mchog yongs su rdzogs/ /'di ( byedag rgya chen don gyi mchog /rnam pa mang po'i don rnams bgyidaku nye/ /a zhes bgyi bas byang chub 'thobazhushe/ / 'de bzhin i ni 'gugs pa ste/ /u zhes bgyi bas gsod pa 'grub/ /ṛ ④ni dbang gi las la ste( ge/ /o ni srin po 'joms pa lags/ /i zhes bgyi ba 'ching bar bzhed/ /au rdzu nyeni klu yi snying po ste( / /kun kyang mchog dang dam pa lags/ /yi ge 'dren pa thams cad dang / /ra dang tsheg drag ldan pa ni( nye/ /chos kyi dbyings dang rtag ldan par/ /bsam gtan bzlas byas dngos grub 'thob/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ri naspyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la/ skus bcu rtogs par khong du chud/ / sems dpa' chen po legs so legs/ /so1bder ri gshegs yang dag mi zad pa'idu / /86wa 649

de nyid thams cad khyod kyis bshad/ /lag na rdo rjes smras pa yi/ /rab tu gsang ba khyod kyis rtogs/ /zhes ①legs so zhes bya ba byin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsol to / / dpa' bo rdo chos dbyings rang bzhin gyi②/ /'khor lo bskor ba rgyal ba'i (homachog / byang chub sems kyis legs bsdams te/ /(nye'ajig rten dpa' bo'i phyag rgya dang / /mi skye ba yi yi ge yis/ /de bzhin bdag nyid bsams nas su/ /charastong pa gnyis su med sbyor bas/ /las rnams thams cad bsgrub par bya/ /chos dbyings rnam par dag pa'i bdag /sa bon yi ge dang ldan par / / bsams nas mnyam gzhag dad pa yis/ /bzlas 9pen dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /khrus dang bshags 7shel sogs pa dang / /rab tu dben par lhur len 9dang / /phyag rgya yi ge phreng 97sems pa'i11/ /zlos pas 1snyedangos grub brtan pa 'thob/ /chos kyi dbyings dang ldan gyur pa1na/ /sngags 'di rnams kyis bsgrubs na ni/ /'gro dang mi 'gro'i khams gsum na/ /grub ④par mi 'gyur dngos de med/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de lta bas na bzlas brjod byed pas rang gi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i cho ga de la 'khor lo bskor bar gzhag par bya'os/ /rnam par snang mdzad chen po mngon par rdzogs par 7byang chub pa rnam par sprul pa nyu 7byin gyis rlob pa /snyelas bsgom 395pa'i yi ge dgod pa dang 2 / dbang bskur ba rnam 7par phye ba'o// //de nas 2bcom ldan 'das la/ phyag na rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das chos kyi dbyings bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ sems kyi sa las 86wa 650

yang dag par 1)'das pa nyid kyis mngon par rdzogs par ②sangs rgyas pa/②byang chub sems dpa' rnams la thabs sna tshogs kyis bsam pa dang mos pa ci lta ba bzhin du bshad du gsol/ bde bar gshegs pa ④bshad du gsol/ de la re zhig (pethog mar cho ga 'dis sdig pa so sor bshags par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad (gyerabadag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus 'di nas bzung ste nam snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar dul/ skye ba thog ma dang tha 9shem ma mchis pa'i yi)'khor ba na 'khor ba'i tshe / bdag gis 9 sdig pa mi dge ba'i las gang ⑩/bgyis pa dang / bgyid du stsal ba dang / rnya rjes su yi rang ba de dag thams cad sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan sngar so sor bshags so/ /de ltar lan gnyis de ltar 51snyelan gsum du bya'o/ /de nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan sngar gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba gzung cibar bya'o/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung geste/ nam byang chub kyi snying po la mchis kyi bar du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la skyabs su mchi'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi sku zhi ba/ bla na med pa so so chosarang gis rig pa la skyabs su mchi'o/ /phyogs bzhi'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /de ltar lan gnyis de ltar lan gsum du bya'o/ /de nas bdag ’ dbul ba ni/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung 1 riste nam byang chub kyi snying po la mchis kyi bar du/86—651

sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la bdag nyid dus thams cad du yong ye dbul gyis ①sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bdag la thugs brtse ba'i slad du bdag bzhes su gsol/ de ltar lan gnyis de ltar lan gsum du bya'o/ /de nas dam tshig gi phyag rgya ②bcings la gsang sngags brjod par bya'o/ /na maḥs manta bu nān/ a sa me tri sa me sa ma duye swā hā/ de nas chos kyi dbyings su byin gyis brlab bo/ /na maḥs manta bu nān / ④ dharma dhā tu swa bhā ba ādma ko3 ⑧lha/ de nas bdag nyid ⑥rdo rje sems dpar byin gyis brlab bo/ /na maḥs manta bu nān/ badzra ādma ko3 ⑦lha/ de nas byang chub tu dusems bskyed par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas dang byang 7chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas ⑩dus 'di nas bzung /91ste/ nam byang chub kyi snying po la mchis kyi bar du/dngos po thams cad dang bral ba/ phung po dang khams dang skye mched dang gzung ba dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs pa/ chos bdag med pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ⑫phyir rang gi sems gdod 1stem nas ma skyes pa/ stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid du yici ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang byang chub sems dpa' 8rnams — kyis byang chub tu sems bskyed pa de bzhin du bdag gis kyang ⑩bskyed do/ /de ltar lan gnyis 7lan gsum du bya'o/ /de nas gang 8ba'i phyag rgya spyi bor bcings la de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor thams cad du spos dang me tog la sogs pa'i sprin 37bsams te/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di lan gsum du ( )brjod par bya'o/ /na maḥs manta bu āoṃ/ a gis ( steye spha ra ṇa rmo nyanyi shrī( she/ ga ga na khaṃ dha dhā tā kā tsho )sha sa ma tā 9 snyeya sasba ( nyan thā ga ta pa ri ṣa dā sa)maṇḍa le/86wa 652

ma ①ma pra ṇi ②snyi purgya ②dzñā na ba le na sarba gta thā ga ta ⑤ba le na/ yidharma dhā twa dhijo na ba le ⑦na tsa snga hā/ gang ba'i phyag rgya ni spyi bor padma kha bye ba 'dra bar bya ba gang yin pa ste(nye/ de ni gang stiba'i phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid do0/ /bzlas brjod kyi cho ga rim par phye (/sdespeba'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis/ chos kyi dbyings bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnam par rol pa bstan nas / yang yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan par bzhed pas/ dbu'i gtsug tor hunyenas chos kyi mdzod ces bya ba sems can gyi khams mtha' yas pa'i sems kyi thibs po skosnang bar byed pa'i 'od zer gyi dra ba bibyung ngo / /de nas 'od zer chen po'i dra ba bkod pa de/de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyis brlabs pa rka/nyargya chen po rnam par rol pas mchos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nam mkha'i khams ltar rgya che ba nanyan bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la bskor ba byas nas/ sems can thams cad kyi 'khor kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad du snang bar byas te sems can gyi khams ma lus pa yongs su bskyab 7pa la sbyar nas sems can dmyal ba dang dud 'gro dang yi dgas 8 )kyi 'gro bar skyes pa rnams kyang tshim par byas te/ lha dang mi'i 'jig rten ( sternams kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po stug po bkod pa'i khongs su gtogs par byin gyis brlabs nas chos kyi dbyings bsam gyis mi khyab pa yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsod nams kyi stobs byin gyis brlabs 2rgyu mthun pa bsam gyis mi khyab gi pas byin du brlabs te 0chos kyi dbyings kyi dgos pa ma rdzogs pas tsho gesnying rje chen po'i snying po 'byung ba'i mdzod ces bya ba/ sems can 86—653

gyi khams ma nges pa yongs su skyob pa'i snying po dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal po chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs ①so/ /snyoms par zhugs nas kyang phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa ②rdo rje 'dzin sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa snyed la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu dag sems can gyi khams ma nges pa yongs su skyob pa'i snying po'i rgyal po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'byung ba zhes bya ba 9midakyil 'khor ④gang la rten (snyen ⑥byang chub sems dpa' rnams tshegs chung ngus de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa thob par 'gyur zhing lachos kyi dbyings bsam gyis mi khyab pa yang mngon sum du byed par 'gyur ba yang (kyeyod do/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa rdo rje 'dzin sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa de dag gis mgrin gcig tu (she)smras pa/bcom ldan 'das de'i dus la bab cing bde bar gshegs pa de'i tshod la bab ste bcom ldan 'das legs lags kyis7/ (stobacom ldan 'das kyis bdag cag la thugs brtse ba'i slad du/ dkyil 'khor chen po bkod pa mi byin gyis rlob pa gang lags pa de dag bshad du gsol/ chos rje chos kyi dbang phyug ste3nye/ /chos kyi dbang phyug mthar byed bralas/ /ye shes che mnga' 7ston pa stetshe/ /sa yi pho 3dbang phyug gcig pu lags3nya/ /don grub tshogs kyang nya'agrub pa ste/ /khur ( )las rgal zhing srid mthar phyin kā/ /sman pa'i rgyal chen de nyid mkhyen/ /'gag pa mi mnga' chad mi mnga'atsho mi/ /mtha' gnyis rnam par spangs pa lagasasoge/ /de bzhin nyid dang yang dag tsho mtha'/ /spros med rtogs par thugs su chud/ /skyabs dang gnas dang gling dang nidzo lta/ /mya ngan 'das dang zhi ba'ang lags/ /thar pa rims nad mi mnga' dag /rdul skyon dang ni bral ba lags/ /brjod 86wa 654

dang kun brjod bral ba de/ /dngos po thams cad rnam par 'jig /de ltar rdo rje 'dzin de kun/ /rtag tu yid rab dga' ba yis/ /mtshan ni yang dag bsgrags byas nas/ /rnam par 'dren la gsol ba 'debs/ /kun mkhyen dpa' chen snyun bral gyis/ /de dag gis gsol thugs chud nas/ /snying rje chen po'i snying po ni/ /'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor bshad ces gsungs①/ /de nas gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das kyi (snyezhabs dul phyag 'tshal nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dkyil 'khor 'di'i ming ci lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/lag na rdo rje dkyil 'khor 'di'i ming ni sangs rgyas med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnams (4)su sangs rgyas 'byung ba kun du (deston pa'o/ /de nas yang gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni nam mkha' lta bu'o zhes gsungs pa ma lags (nasam/nam mkha' la ni skye ba yang 3ma mchis 'gag pa yang (2)ma mchis so bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la yang skye ba yang ma mchis 'gag pa yang ma mchis na/ bcom ldan 'das de ci'i slad du 'di skad du thosa'adi ni sangs rgyas med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnams su sangs rgyas 'byung ba tsozhes gsungs11/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po gang gi tshe sprul pa'i sangs rgyas yongs su mya ngan las 'das par gyur 51 pa de'i tshe 'jig rten gyi khams de dag tu byang 1 chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgo 86wa 655

nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa rnams dkyil 'khor chen po bkod pa ①byin gyis rlob pas ②sems can rnams yongs su smin par byed do/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ngo mtshar lags te③/gang na sems can 'dod chags dang zhe snang dang gti mug dang g.yo dang sgyu dang the tsom ④gyi bsam pa can dad ⑤pa tha dad pa rnams kyi bsam pa ci lta ba bzhin ⑥yongs su rdzogs par bgyid pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag ni stishin tu dka' ba bgyid par rig par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lag na rdo rje rigs kyi bu de dag ni sangs rgyas gcig la bsnyen bkur byas pa ma yin gyis 2rigs kyi bu de dag gis ni sangs rgyas mang po la dge ba'i rtsa ba 73bskrun par rig par bya'o/ /chos snang ba'i sgo gsum gyis kyang nges par byung ba yin te lkugasum gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ snying rje chen po'i 0tshul gyi sgo snang ba'i tshul dang chos zab mo'i tshul gyi sgo 'o snang ba'i tshul dang de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa dang bkur ste byed pa'i tshul te rigs kyi bu de dag ni chos snang ba'i 8tshul gyi sgo 'di gsum dang ldan par rig par bya'o/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis byams pa tshedang thugs rje chen po'i spyan gnyis kyis chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang chen po na gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gzigs nas gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag lin rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/ lag na rdo rje slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid nyon cig /de la re zhig yislob dpon byang chub tu sems bskyed pa byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la spyod pa byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pas bsdams pa snying rje can dad pa che ba chos zab mo la gnas pa 86—656

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul la mkhas pa sgyu rtsal rnams la ①mkhas shing bzo ba ②gtsang zhing bag yod pa/ gsang sngags spyad pa dag dang ni/ /phyag rgya dkyil 'khor las la bslabs/ /dkyil 'khor bya ba'i las bya b.ral/ /bla ma las ni ④lung thob pa/ /sangs rgyas ⑤chos dang tshogs mchog gyel/ /gang zhig yid gnyis med gyur cing / /sems can khams ni ma lus pa/ /yongs su bskyab ⑦pa'i phyir brtson pa/ /mkhas pa des ni sangs rgyas kyi/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni bri bar 'os(kye/ /mtshan rnams thams cad yongs rdzogs brtan/ / yid gzhungs pa ⑨la dpa' snying can/ /bdag gang 0slob ma rnams kyi'ang rung / /bgegs ni zhi bar byed par nus/ /yang dag bden pa'i don rtogs la/ /gang gi 1nyemos pa rgya che zhing / /bzod rtsonadang ldan la nga rgyal med/ /rlabs po che yi las byed cing / /de ni rlabs po che la dad/ /byang chub sems dpa' skyob pa dang / /sangs rgyas rnams kyi 7smon lam dag /thos nas phyi phyir dga' ba dang | /rtag tu mgu bar 'gyur ba dang / /gsang sngags spyod la brtson pa dang | /bzlas brjod brjod tshel gang 'bad dang / /gcam 8sgyu thams cad mi sems la/ /'jig rten chos la mi lta zhing / /sngags la gzhol ba'i sngags pa ni / /yon tan de la sogs ldan na/ /slob dpon ston pas bkur ba yin/ /yang na chos rnams thams cad ni/ /rnam par dben la gang gnas pa/ /de (7yang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba ston par 'os yang na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /bsngags (1 pa'i dam tshig gsum shes sam/ / /nyes pa thams cad rnam sa/spangs pa/ /de la gnas pa'i sngags pa ni/ /yon tan kun dang mi ldan yang / /de yang nodakyil 'khor 'dri sonabar 'os/ /de lta'i dzwa86—657

yon tan kun ldan na/ / las kyi cho ga mthong ba yis/ /①'jig rten pa yi ②dkyil 'khor dang / /'jig rten 'das kun bya bar 'os / /de ⑤slob dpon la gzhan gyis bskul na slob ma don du gnyer zhing ⑤de la dad par shes na/ de ltar shes nas 6)slob dpon des/ /sa gzhi legs par brtag par bya/ /mtsho dang kun dga'i skyed ⑦mos tshal/ /rdzing bu rnams kyis kun brgyan cing ⑧/ /'bras bu me tog ②ldan pa yibo/ /ljon shing ⑩de bzhin ldum bu dang ⑫/ /gel pa dam pa nyams dga' ba/ /'bras bu me tog ldan pa dang / /ngang pa 'khrung khrung rma bya dang / / bzhad dang 8de tso sha ri rnams/ /gang gi yul na yod pa yi / /yul de 8nan tan bskyed de bstenatso/ /me tog 'bras bu ldan ri dang / / gtsang zhing 7yid 'ong rdzing bu dang lhonye/ /'bab chu (7chu ni zhim po dzña )dang / /chu klung ༷ rtegayas nas 'khor ba can/ /der ni sngags pa blo ldan gyis ⑤/ /dkyil 'khor longs spyod 'phel bar bri/ /yul ni shin tu snum pa dang / /gtsug lag khang dang khang pa dang / / lha yi 2nyaganas dang phyugs lhas dang / /shing gcig lam gyi bzhi mdor yang / /zhi ba'i las las 37zhi ba yi/ /dkyil 'khor shes tsho snyerab can gyis bri/ /khang pa stong pa'am dur khrod dmasnon/ /snum med drag po'i na las can dang / /ngan cing rtsub tsho tshal 'jigs pa can/ /de bzhin tshang tshing mi bzad tsho rto'ajigs rte/ /de la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su/ /drag po'i las kyi dkyil 'khor bri/ /drag por drag po'i ri1las rnams bya/ /zhi bar zhi ba'i las bya'o / /rgyas par rgyas pa nyid yin te/ / de ni rgyas pa'i cho ga'o/ /yang ni gi yid ni gang dag tu/ /nges par dga' ba skye gi 'gyur ba/ /yul der dkyil 'khor bri ba yi pa/ /las ni legs par sbyar bar bya ge/ /gang gi sems ni rnam 86wa 658

dag cing / /the tsom 0)la sogs rnams (mispangs pa/ /de las srilas rnams thams cad ni/ /'grub (nga)par 'gyur ba dogs pa med/ /rnam par rtog pa spangs pa yi/ /rnam par mi rtog byang chub yin/ /de yang rnam rtog spangs pa yis / /thob par 'gyur gyi snigazhan gyis min/ /de bas rnam pa thams cad du/ /blo ldan yid gnyis spangs nas su/ /'jig rten kun la phan 'dod pas/ /shes rab can gyis dkyil 'khor bri/ /yul med dus kyang yod ma yin/ /bya ba med cing byed pa'ang med/ /chos rnams dag ni thams cad la/ /chos nyid 'ba' zhig (6)yod pa (7yin/ /byis pa mi shes pas bsgribs pa/ /rgyu dang rkyen gyis brgyal bas na/ /stong pa'i chos ni ma rtogs rin pas/ /rtag tu bdud kyi dbang du gyur 9ri/ /de ltas ston 57pa ye shes mnga'/ /spros med rtog par mkhyen pa yis/lha/ /rnam rtog thams cad spangs pa nyu yi/ / chos ni gzhal du med par bshad51snye/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tshergyan bkod pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs boso/ /bcom ldan 'das snyoms par zhugs ri pa dang smin mtshams /9nyenas sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi 512rgyan zhes /9bya ba'i 'od zer byung ngo / /byung nas kyang kun tu snang bar gyur to/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di kun tu ru )snang bar byas nas kyang gang gi rnam pa 51dang yon tan gyi mtha' bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du yang rtogs par mi nus pa lha'i sgo khyud kyis rab tu brgyan ri be pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par smin pa las gyur pa/ me tog gi gzhi'i snying po bkod pa'i rgyan can na'adi dag thams cad lag mthil bzhin du mnyam par gyur to/ /de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa byin 86wa 659

gyis brlabs nas 'od zer de dag gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje'i spyi bor mi snang bar gyur to/ /'od zer de dag mi snang bar gyur ma thag tu phyag na rdo rjes ①bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs ②la phyag 'tshal nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dkyil 'khor chen po bkod pa ③byin gyis rlob pa bshad ④du gsol/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' rgyachen po phyag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/ lag na rdo rje dkyil 'khor chen po bkod ⑥pa ①byin gyis rlob pa ⑤nyon cig bcom ldan 'das de ltar 'tshal lo ⑨zhes gsol ⑩nas phyag na rdo rje bcom ldan 'das la nyan hu)pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /lag na rdo rje de la ci skad du bsgrags 8pa'i gnas rnams su ⑫dkyil 'khor kyi tshad khru gang pa ④yan cad chadapag tshad ⑩man chad kyi tshad ⑩du bya'o/ /dpag tshad gcig las 8lhag par ni mi bya'o/ /de la sa gzhi mnyam la 'jam / /byug spos dag gis legs par bskus/ /yang na 'jim pa gtsang ma yis / /sngags pas nan tan bsku bar bya/ /de nas phur bu sor brgyad pa la las thams cad lho)pa'i gsang sngags kyis brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te grwa dzña )bzhir mnyam par btab na dkyil 'khor kun tu cis kyang mi tshugs par byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur ro/ /na maḥs manta badzā 'on/ haṃ ko ṭa ( steya sa me ma hā tsaṇḍa li hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas ( stephyi de nyin ( snyedakyil 'khor gyi yo byad rnams bsags te sta gon byas lku sel las thams cad kyi ( nyagasang sngags sam 'phags pa mi g.yo bas bsrung ginyab byas te dkyil 'khor gyi byang phyogs su 'jog tu gzhug rko tshogo/ /yang na gi byin gyis brlabs la bdag nyid kyis tsho 7gzhag go/ /de nas phyi de nyin dugye86—660

slob ma rnams gzung bar bya ste ①dad pa che ba gtsang sbra che ba chos la 'bad pa cho rigs btsun pa/ mos pa rgya ②che ba gcig gam gnyis sam gsum mam ③ci snyed 'dod pa rnams gzung dungo / /las thams cad ⑤pa'am 'phags pa mi g.yo ba'am mi bzod pa'i gsang sngags kyis ①bu mos bkal ⑦ba'i skud pa'am/ skud pa ⑧gzhan nam ⑨yang na ⑩rna 7ku sha yang rung mdud pa gsum bor la8 de nas sngags kyis brgya 'am ni/ /yang na lhag par mngon bsngags te/ /slob ma'i las rnams 'grub pa'i phyiratso/ /dpung pa g.yon par 8bcing bar bya/ /u dum bā tsora'i so shing ni/ /me tog dri la sogs pas bskus/ /shin tu bzang po bsrung 0ba byasa'on/ /sor brgyad tshad /snyil rtse gcig pa/ /bzang po tsoyid du 'ong ba dag /de nas mkhas pas sbyin par bya/ /shar ram byang du kha bltas ⑥ te / /so shing dag ni bca' bar bya/ /de nas blo ldan mi bza' zhing ⑩/ /dpyad pa med par dor bar 'bya/ /gang du lhung 0bar gyur pa ni/ /de bzhin de las bugrub par 'gyur/ /shes rab pha rol phyin la sogs/ /mdo sde'i chos ni nyan byadu gzhug /slob ma skyo bar bya ba'i phyir/ /chos gtam shin tu tsobazang po bya/ /gal te mi lam bzang po'am/ /ngan pa dag ni mthong gyur na/ /bdag gi ( tshoskal ba brtag pa'i phyir/ /bla ma la ni de dag bsnyadas/ /mchod rten kun dga' gtsug lag khang / /glegs bam dang ni lha rnams dang / /yid bzhin nor bu rin chen gos/ /yang na me tog 'bras bu rnyedas/ /ral gri 'khor lo pi bang ri ri )dang / /grub pa'i rdzas ni sna tshogs rnams/ /gang gis rmi lam thob gyur mis/ /de yi ri medangos grub yid bzhin 'gyur/ /nyi zla me dang mtshon ri gedag gam/ /de bzhin rgya mtsho ri shergal ba dang / /glang po che dag zhon 86—661

mthong ba①/ /de ni dngos grub 'thob ②mi dka'/ /de la sogs pa'i mi lam ni / /bzang pos 'grub pa dudam pa brtag /mi lam bzlog ④pa mi bzad pa/ /'jigs pa mthong na mi 'grub po/ /bong bu rnga mong dukhyi dang ni/ /chu bya ①stag dang byi la wal/ /mi ni 'bru mar lus bskus dudang / /gcer bu rtsub la mi sdug pa / /de la sogs pa'i rmi ngan rnams/ /blo ldan mi yis ṇispang bar bya yang na dngos rnams mi lam dang / /dri za'i grong khyer bzhin shes nas/ /blo dang ldan pas rmi lam rnams/ /snying po med par bshad par bya/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la phyag na rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa rnams / 'di lta bu'i chos rnams la dang po nyid ⑩nas blo brtan par 'gyur ba de'i rgyu ni gang 0rkyen ni gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/'di ltar rigs kyi bu de dag ni snying rje chen po dang ldan zhing 8chos thams cad shin tu yongs su lho)mya ngan las 8'das par lta lam/ so so'i skye bo tsornams kyi mtshan nyid kyang phyin ci log cing tshimatshan nyid dang bral ba gcig zhu tu shes te des nyarten de dag thams cad la blo brtan zhing nges pa yin non )/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi dbyings bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgya chen po 0byin gyis brlabs nas/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/gsang ba pa'i bdag po dkyil 'khor chen po bkod pa sa byin gyis rlob rdo gepa nyon cig /de la dang por tsho 7slob dpon gyis gtsang spra byas te bden bral gyi phyogs su gnas la/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa la lke 2rnam par dbye spru byas te( ho/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag byas la ni chos kyi dbyings rnam par 86wa 662

dag pa yang dran par byas te stimatha' yas pa rgya che ba rab 'byam bkod pa ②byin gyis rlob pa ③la blta'o/ /bltas nas kyang bdag nyid ④rdo rje sems dpar byin gyis brlabs la tshon sna lnga'i po)srad bu'am/ yang na mkhas pas blos kyang rung / /lha yi gnas rnams nges pa ni/ /shes rab can gyis rnam par dbye/ /kun tu gru bzhi lham pa la/ /sgo bzhi rta babs dang yang bcas/ /sgo khyud rab 'byam durgya chen (peldan/ /rnam par dag pa sems kyis bris/ /rin chen lnga yi phye ma'am/ /yang na sā du lu'i phye ma'ang rung / /yang na spos sam thal bas kyang / /dkyil 'khor sngags pas bri bar bya/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /nub kyi sgo ni dbye bar bya/ /de nas rig 0sngags rgyal mo ni/ /mi bzad srung ba chen mo 'am/ /yang na mi g.yo dran par bya/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dran 7byas nas/ /bden bral gyi ni phyogs su 'gro/ /de nas srad bu bres nas su/ /bskor ba byas te slar log nasa'iste/ /de nas blo dang ldan pa ni/ / nub dang byang gi tu phyogs su 'gro / /der yang shar du kha bltas nas/she/ /shar gyi phyogs su srad bu bres/ /de ltar srad bu mtshul shes pas/ /rtag par thog pa 7nyid du bya/ /de nas dbus su 'dug nas ni/ /mgon po ngan song kun spong dang / /mi mchog 'od dpag med pa dang / /de bzhin sgrib pa kun sel dang / /thub pa me tog kun rgyas dang / /rgyal ba rnam par snang mdzad dang / /thub chen bdud las rgyal ba dang —/ /de bzhin mi 'khrugs ri zhes bya dang / /sangs rgyas rnga yi sgra dbyangs can / /de bzhin gshegs pa rjes dran nas/ /der 51 yang dka' /rjethub can gyis ni/ /nan tan bskyed de cha gsum brtag /de ltar las ri skul mkhas pa yis / /sa ni legs par brtags nas su/ /byang chub sems dpa' blo ldan ( 186wa 663

dang ske/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi yum yang bklag① /yang na zab mo'i mdo sde gzhan / /sa rnams gtan la 'bebs pa bklag② /bklags nas blo dang ldan pa yis/ /kun tu bdug duspos bskor dunas su/ /rgyal ba mchog gi sras rnams dang ske/ /sangs rgyas rnams la phyag byas nas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ②sku gzugs sam/ /phyag rgya mkhas pas bri bar bya/ /yang na gzhan ni gang yang rung ske/ /de dag thams cad bri ⑥bar bya/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/gsang ba pa'i bdag po sbyor ba gang dag ⑦dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa rnams tshegs chung ⑧ngus sems can gyi khams mtha' yas pa yang srid pa'i rgya mtsho las sgrol bar 'gyur ba chos kyi dbyings bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshul sgrub ⑨pa'i sbyor ba yod do//de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / phyag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sgrub pa'i gzhi tigang dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa rnams cho ga thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyid cing de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyang mnyes 37par bgyid pa'i sgrub pa'i gzhi hunyede dag bshad du gsol/de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis chos kyi 1snyedabyings kyi tshul rgya chen po byin gyis brlabs 8sgrub pa'i gzhi rgya chen pos byin du brlabs tshanas sbyor ba bzang po bshad do/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de las 7'khor los sgyur ba ni 1 tshodakyil 'khor gyi tshad dpag tshad gcig tsam bri bar bya ste gnas tsandan bzang po sbrul gyi snying po dam pa las byas pa'i khang pa dril bu 86—664

g.yer ka chen po ①dang rin po che'i bla re ②bris pa/ ②a ga ru bzang po'i rjobadug spos sna tshogs ⑤kyis bdugs pa 'dzam bu'i ⑥gser gyi srad bus bskor ba rin po che sna tshogs kyi dril bu g.yer ku'i ⑦dra bas steng brgyan ⑤pa rnga sgra snyan pa sna tshogs kyi sgra grag ⑨pa/ phyogs bzhi na rta babs sna tshogs byamu tig gi phreng bas yibatags pa tshon 8sna tshogs su btsos pa'i gos kyis bklubs pa 0bkod pa dang rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa rin po che'i sgron ma sna tshogs kyis kyang rnam par gsal bar bya'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'dus pa'i nang na 'dug bzhin du bdag nyid mchos kyi dbyings nyunyernam par dag pa'am de'i rnam pa la dmigs ⑩par byin gyis brlabs la mchos 'byung ba'i 8phyag rgya'am dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcings te/ stong pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi rjes su song ba rnams sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa dang byang chub kyi sems 'dzin du gzhug go/ /de nas bla na med pa'i ye shes kyi mig rnam par dag par bya ba'i phyir dam tshig bstan par bya'o/ /de la nang gi dkyil 'khor gyi phyag rgya ni 'di rnams yin no/ /shar phyogs su sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phyag rgya gru gsum pa padma'i steng na 'dug par bri'o / /de'i gsang sngags ni 'di'o/ /na maḥsabra 6)buddha bo dhi sa tā du )nān/ a sarba sa)tra ṇa ki 2 swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sagayas rol du rdzisangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi phyag rgya yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan bri'o/ /de'i gsang sngags ni/ na maḥs manta buddha bo dhi sa tā ( senān/ sa manta a mṛ te dzwa ri la swā hā/ de'i 'og tu kun du bzang po'i phyag rgya ral gri dang gnas kyi dkyil 'khor chung ngu bri'o/ /gsang sngags ni/ na maḥsab tshanabu bo dhi sa tā nān( ste/ badzra rā dza mā la swā hā/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phyag rgya'i 86—665

g.yon rol du ①chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya bri'o/ /de'i 'og tu bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i phyag rgya lhung bzed dang chos gos bri'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi g.yas logs su nam mkha'i spyan gyi phyag rgya can ②gtsug tor 'dra ba padma'i steng du ①'dug par bri'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ma'i 'og logs su rdo rje dam pa ④sbyin gyi ⑤phyag rgya utpa la'i steng du rdo rje gzhag pa bri'o/ /'phags pa kun du bzang po'i byang phyogs su byams pa'i phyag rgya ril ba spyi blugs 0bri'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi nub phyogs su spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi phyag rgya padma bri'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi byang phyogs su mtha' yas pa ⑦'phro ba rgya chen po mi g.yo ba rgyal po'i phyag rgya bri'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lho phyogs su rdo rje 'dzin thams cad kyi phyag rgya bri'o/ /de nas phyi rol gyi dkyil 'khor cha gsum du byas pa la 'khor sa'i snam bu bor te/ shar phyogs su pho nya'i tshogs thams cad kyi phyag rgya bri'o/ /de dag gi shar lho'i mtshams rno su pho nya mo thams cad kyi poraphyag rgya bri ste/ pho nya mo rnams kyi phyag rgya ni lcags 〉kyu'o/ /tshogs rnams kyi phyag rgya ni zhags pa'o/ /lho 17dang byang gi ngos 12su bran pho nya2bran mo rnams kyi phyag rgya bri ste de la bran pho rnams kyi phyag rgya ni ral gri'o/ /bran mo rnams kyi phyag rgya ni khad ga ri dang rdo rje'i khab bri'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bklag 7go/ /bklags bonas langs la dkyil 'khor bskor ba 7byas te sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la phyag kyang (1 tshobyas la slob ma byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dad pa can 1 /gtsang sbra che ba 717yi dam la brtan pa sdom pa bzung 3 )ba 'gro ba thams cad yongs su bskyab pa'i bsam pa can snying rje che ba gdong ras kyis stogayogs pa lag pa mi stong pa /de la sems rtse gcig tu dmigs pa rnams 86wa 666

dkyil 'khor bskor ba byas te ①dkyil 'khor gnyis pa'i sgo khar 'greng la gang zhu)ba'i phyag rgya'am chos 'byung ba'i phyag rgya'am dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcings te dam ③tshig brjod la dkyil 'khor du gzud ④do/ /de nas me tog 'dor du gzhug go/ /me tog gar bab pa der ⑤de'i lha yin no/ /de ltar dam tshig brtan pa can gyis (7slob dpon la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed do/ /slob dpon gyis kyang bu'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /de nas sems kyi rgyud rab dang 'bring dang tha ma la bltas nas gsang sngags spyad pa la 'jug pa'i rnal 'byor gyi cho ga sbyin no/ /de ltar byas na (pedakyil 'khor chen po bkod pa 'dir dam tshig mthong bar 'gyur rol/ /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor (kyedu zhugs kyang rung ma zhugs kyang rung tsodam tshig tu zhugs par 7'gyur ro/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor chen por byin gyis brlabs shing sdig pa thams cad dang bral ba de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs las byung ba/ sems can gyi khams mtha' yas pa yongs su bskyab pa yid la byed pa des gsang sngags spyad pa'i rnal 'byor gyi cho ga rjes su dran par bya'o/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis chos kyi dbyings kyi gnas na 'khod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la byams pa chen po dang thugs rje chen po'i spyan gnyis kyis gzigs nas/zhal cung zad 'dzum zhing de bzhin gshegs pa'i so so yang dag par rig pa la 'jug pa'i tshul gyis bla na med pa'i chos kyi dbyings shin tu rnam par dag par 3nabastan par bzhed de / lha srid pa'i rgya mtsho thams cad las bsgral bar yi dam bcas pa zhes bya ba'i bzhad 510pa chen po mdzad nas gtsug tor chen po'i dkyil 'khor nas 1 thams cad du ri de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yul 'byung ba 86—667

zhes bya ba'i 'od zer byung ngo / /'od zer de byung nas kyang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam ①nam mkha'i dbyings kyis klas pa na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ②kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor na 'khod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad ni snang bar byas chos kyi dbyings bsam gyis mi khyab pa la 'jug pa'i yul ni bstan/ sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi spyod pa rnams la ni bltas chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa mtha' yas pa ni dmigs par byas/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par rol pa dunam mkha' dang ④mnyam pa'i rjes su 'gro ba ⑤chos mnyam pa nyid ༅bstan pa ⑦rnam par rol pa'i sgo nas ni nirnam par rol nas/de bzhin gshegs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam par smin pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa las mngon par grub pa dang ⑨/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dgongs pa las mngon par ⑩ grub pa mos pa'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing bkod pa rnam pa bcus 1nyerab tu brgyan pa mdzad de(rte/ nam mkha'i ngos la bkod pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi byin gyis brlabs bsham pa byas te 'ganas par gyur to/ /'od zer chen po de dag ciganas par gyur ma thag tu gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje'i sems la sems kyi rtog pa 'di lta bu byung bar gyur to/ / ci tsam du 8de bzhin gshegs pa'i 7dgongs pa las byung ba'i 'od zer 7sngon ma mthong ba'i bkod pa bstan pa 'di dag rnam par bkod 3nyepa sna tshogs kyis 6)nam mkha'i ngos ni khebs par byas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par rol pa chen po rnams ni bstan nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhal du mi snang bar gyur pa ni 3)ngo mtshar to( nya/ /de bas na nges par deng bcom ldan 'das so so yang byudag par rig pa chen po mngon par sgrub ri pa'i tshul rnam par dag pas mnyam pa nyid la 'jug pa rnam 86—668

par dag pa'i gzhi de bzhin gshegs pa ①thams cad rnam par rol pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs bshad par chabazhed do/ /de'i phyir bdag labacom ldan 'das la ④zhu'o snyam mo/ /de nas phyag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs ⑤la phyag 'tshal nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bcom ldan 'das kyis dang po bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa nas/ bcom ldan 'das mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i ⑥bar du bdag rtag tu zham ring la (7mchis mchis na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ci ltar da laltar bzhad ⑨pa chen po sngar mdzad nas dbu'i gtsug tor gyi dkyil 'khor ⑩nas 'od zer stong phrag hunyesangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul tu snyed byung nas 'od zer de /nyernams kyis kyang 'jig rten nyunyekhams na hunyenam mkha'i dbyings kyi mthas hunyeklas pa snang bar bgyid pa'i nyunyengo mtshar 'di lta bu ni bdag gis sngon chad ma mthong lags so/she/ /de la bdag hunye'adi snyam du ri du )deng bcom ldan 'das bdag cag la so so ri nayang dag par rig pa chen po la 'jug pa'i tshul sgrub pa rnam par dag pa'i gzhi chos kyi rnam grangs de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa rnam par sprul pa bshad pa sa bzhed pa ni bdag cag gis 3nyernyed pa legs par rnyed do snyam bgyid dordo )/ /bcom ldan 'das de lta gebs na legs lags kyis( nye/ bdag cag ci la thugs brtse ba'i slad du so so yang dag par rig pa chen po la 'jug pa'i tshul sgrub pa snyernam par dag pa'i gzhi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa rnam par sprul pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs bshad du gsolatsho choge/de ni dus slad ma'i 'gro ba rnams la yang ri skusnang bar bgyid sa par 'gyur ba 86wa 669

lags sol/ /②de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis ③gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po legs so legs so/ /gang rgyakhyod don 'di 'dri ba ni ⑤yang legs so/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po/ /de'i phyir legs par nyon la 6)rab tu meyid la zung ⑧shig dang ngas khyod la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi so so yang dag par rig pa la 'jug pa sgrub 6)pa'i tshul rnam par dag par ⑩mnyam pa nyid la 'jug pa rnam par dag pa'i gzhi chos kyi rnam grangs de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa rnam par sprul pa nyunyebashad par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar 'tshal lo ⑩zhes gsol na)nas/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje bcom ldan 'das la nyan pa dang bcom ldan 'das kyis de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gsang 8ba pa'i bdag po stong pa nyid kyi gzhi ni mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i gzhi'o/ /nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i gzhi ni mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i gzhi'o/ /mtshan nyid med pa'i gzhi ni mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i gzhi'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzhi ni mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i gzhi'o/ /de ltar mngon par rdzogs par libyang chub pa'i gzhi 'di dag byang chub sems dpas bsgom par bya'o/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi so so yang dag par rig pa la 'jug pa sgrub pa'i tshul rnam par dag pas mnyam pa nyid la 'jug pa'i gzhi chos kyi rnam grangs yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis chos kyi dbyings rgya chen po rab 'byam tshamatha' yas pa byin gyis brlabs nas/nam mkha' dri ma med pa'i rgyal po rnam par smin pa nam mkha' ltar rgya che zhing 86—670

mtha' yas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu dbu'i gtsug nas 6)de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yul snang ba yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa rab 'byam ②ston pa zhes bya ba'i 'od zer rdo kyibyung ngo / /byung nas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rjes su mthun pa ④bstan te/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang ⑤mdzad la bskor ba lan brgya stong du ma byas te 6)'jig rten gyi khams rnam pa bcur snang ba chen pos gsal bar byas te steng gi nam mkha' la gnas nas/ gsang ba'i snying po'i dkyil 'khor chen po bsham pa byas te chadam tshig chen po gsum gyi (kyesnang bas/ 'jig rten gyi khams nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mthas klas pa snang bar byas nas sems can gyi khams rnams la dam tshig (khegasum gyi myu gu 7skye bar byin gyis brlabs te/ 'od zer /—nyedag nam mkha' las hu lhags nas phyag na rdo rje'i spyi bor babs sos / /'od zer skedag phyag na rdo rje'i spyi bor babs tsom thag tu de nas de'i mod la gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin chen po thob par gyur te/ de thob pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa la gnyis su med par gnas pa thob 97par gyur to/ /de nas gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi dga' bas yid mtshim par gyur nas/ mig gnyis mi 'dzums (1 par bcom ldan 'das tu rnam par snang mdzad la yud tsam zhig bltas te bzhin cung zad 'dzum zhing bcom ldan 'das la yid kyis zhus pa/ ci ltar de bzhin gshegs pa lags / /ci ltar rgyal ba dam pa lags/ /ci ltar byang chub sems dpa' lags / /ci ltar sangs rgyas zhes kyang bgyi/ /mgon po bdag gi the tsom ri )86—671

'di / /thub pa chen pos bsal du gsol/ /byang chub sems dpa' grags chen rnams / /the tsom ①yid gnyis spangs nas su/ /spyad ②pa'i rgyal po theg chen la//rgyal ba'i sras ni spyod par 'gyur/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po/ /khyod don 'di lta bu 'dri bar sems pa ni ①legs so legs so/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po chos kyi tshul sgrub ④pa'i gzhi 'di lta bu ⑤thos nas skrag par mi 'gyur/ shin 0tu skrag par mi 'gyur ba'i sems can de ⑦ni dkon ⑧rna/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po rigs kyi bu de dag ni sangs rgyas gcig la bsnyen bkur byas pa ma yin gyi/ sangs rgyas ⑨stong phrag du ma la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun ⑩pa yin par rig par (nyabya'o/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de lta bas na byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pas thog ma nyid du theg pa chen po rtogs par khong du chud par bya'o//de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po theg pa chen po rtogs par khong du chud pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni tshegs chung ngu kho nas 97gsang sngags kyi sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa sgrub na par 'gyur ro/ /'di ltar gsang sngags kyi sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa 'di ni mngon par shes skipa chen po yongs su sbyong ba 8yin no/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po de'i phyir nyon la legs par rab tu 7yid la zung 7shig dang ngas khyod la bshad par bya'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje bcom ldan 'das la nyan to/ /de la bcom ldan 86—672

'das kyis ①'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /chos rnams nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /gnyis su med cing mtshan nyid gcig / gzhi bcus rdzogs par sangs rgyas ②pa/ /de ni rdzogs sangs rgyas zhes bya/ /'du ①shes tsam yang spangs pa'i phyir/ /rang gi ngo bo bstan med cing ④/ /ye shes kyis ni rang rig pa/ /de ni de bzhin gshegs par bshadage/ /byang chub nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /rtog pa thams cad yispangs pa yiname/ /gang zhig de durtogs 'dod pa des7/ /byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya'o⑩/ /sa bcu po dag bsgrubs nas nihunye/ /dbang rnams rtogs par khong du chud/ /chos rnams stong pa sgyu ma bzhin/ /gang gis 'dir ni kun rtogs shing / /'jig rten kun gyi 8rgyud shes pa/ /sangs rgyas zhes ni bya ba yin0/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de ltar de dag ni 8byang chub sems dpa'i sems kyi gnas skabs rnam par gzhag pa skoyin no/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po rnam grangs des kyang 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ⑩rang gi sems rnam par gzhag pa sgrub ⑩pa ni med par rig par bya'o/ /de nas yang sa gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas abyang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la theg pa chen po mngon par rtogs pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs legs par bshad pa ni bcom ldan 'das ngo mtshar lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa shin tu ngo mtshar lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu de dag ni sa )'gro ba lnga'i 'khor ba na 'khor ba'i tshe ngan 'gro ngan song gi 'jigs pa'am bdud kyi las kyi 'jigs pa'am mi khom par skye ba'i 'jigs pa nanamachis par bdag mi kṣ-i gesmra'o/ /86—673

ci'i slad du ①zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po ②mngon par rtogs pa la gnas pa ni 'jig rten dang lhan cig tu gnas kyang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam mi gtong zhing sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir thabs kyis ⑧'jig rten gyi bya ba thams cad kyang ston to/ /theg pa chen po mngon par rtogs pa las yongs su nyams par yang mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas yang gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag ④na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba btab pa/ bcom ldan 'das gsang ba chen po'i ⑤nying po'i dkyil 'khor bshad du gsol/ de ni skye bo mang po la phan pa dang bde bar 'gyur lags so/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang ske/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de'i phyir nyon la (6)legs par rab tu ⑦yid la zung (2)shig dang ngas khyod la gsang ba'i snying po'i dkyil 'khor bsham pa 9)bshad par bya'o/ /de la 7re zhig 0slob dpon dam tshig gsum rnam par dbye ba la mkhas shing bdag kyang dam tshig gsum la gnas pa yin no/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po/ /de la dam tshig gsum po de gang zhe na chos kyi khyad par gsum ste chos kyi khyad par gang la 32dus gsum du gtogs pa'i dus na sgrib ri pa med pa'i tshul gyis 'jug pa de ni dam tshig gsum zhes bya'o/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po chos kyi khyad par de yang gang zhe na/ gsang lho ba pa'i bdag po sems ni chos bokyi khyad par temi/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po de la sems kyi rnam par rtog pa thams cad med pa yongs su shes pa'i lagang yin pa de ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mthong ba'o/ /'di'i lho chos kyi dbyings rtogs pa'i rang rig pa'i rnam pa gang yin pa de ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan nyid yin no/ /gang lus 86—674
