dang ngag dang yid 'jug pa de ni sprul ①pa'i mtshan nyid yin no/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de (༄ni dam tshig gsum yin te③/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kyang ma rtogs na mu stegs can gzhan dag gis lta ci smos/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsungs so/ /byis pa mi shes pas bsgribs pa/ /tshul 'di shes par lim gyur rnams/ /sangs rgyas gzhan du tshol bar byed/ /'di na gnas par yong (zhi)ma rtogs/ /'jig rten khams gzhan gang nas kyang / /sangs rgyas rnyed par nyayong mi 'gyur/ /sems nyid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas te/ /sangs rgyas gzhan du ⑦ma bstan to/ /de lta bas na rnal 'byor pas/ /rtag tu yid gnyis spangs nas ni/ /sems kyi khyad ⑧par rnam (9)gsum brtag /de nas dam tshig gsum shes 'gyur/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad pa de dag gsungs nas/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po de la (/rnyeslob dpon dam tshig gsum shes par bya ba la mkhas pas bdag nyid chos kyi dbyings su mos par byas la de la dmigs pa'i sbyor bas nyuges gzhi rnam par sbyang bar bya'ol/ /de ltar des sa gzhi rnam par 1 sbyangs nas nam mkha'i dbyings lta bu la yang dag par gzhol bas bdag ni chos kyi dbyings sgrib pa med pa'i ye shes kyi yul yin no snyam du bdag nyid rnam par snang mdzad du byin gyis brlab po/ /de ltar bdag nyid byin gyis brlabs la/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa'i phyir/gnyis su med pa'i sbyor bas bdag gi 10lus la 1gedakyil 'khor yin pa'am/dkyil 'khor bdag gi lus yin par byin gyis brlabs te/ rang gi sems kyis byas pa'i tshon sna lnga'i phye ma'am sagazhan yang rung ste cho ga snga mas rnam par dbye 86—675

bar bya'o/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po/ /de ni ①sems can sdug bsngal ba rnams yongs su bskyab ②pa'i phyir/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po nisnying po'i dam tshig la 'jug pa'i cho ga bya'o/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das durnam par snang mdzad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa gegang gis/ byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyang tshe 'di nyid gcig 0pus thob ⑦par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos kyi ⑧byin gyis brlab 0pa mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byams pa chen po dang thugs rje chen po'i spyan gnyis kyis sems can gyi khams la gzigs nas/gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po byin gyis brlabs sgrub hu )pa'i gzhi gang tunyegis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 6)thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes thob par snyi/dka' ba yang bsod nams ma byas pa'i sems can rnams kyi pha rol gyi rgyud la yang rab tu 'jog par 'gyur ba chos kyi dbyings kyi ④byin gyis brlabs kyi 8gzhi nyon cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / phyag na rdo rjes thal mo sbyar te bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das stobs bcu'i stobs dang ldan pa mi 'jigs pa bzhi'i khyu mchog seng ge'i sgra sgrogs 7pa rnams kyi (meye shes la mnga' ba ni 3 ngo mtshar to/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo mkhas pa'i rang bzhin can su zhig thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes 'di 'dra ba'i don du nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mthas klas pa'i bskal par yang sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal mi bzad pa yang bzod par mi bgyid/ bcom ldan 'das de lta bas na rigs kyi bu mkhas pa 'di la slob 86—676

par 'tshal bas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rjes su bslab ①par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de lta bas na legs lags kyis ②bdag cag la thugs brtse ba'i slad du chos kyi dbyings kyi ①byin gyis brlabs ④kyi gzhi de dag bshad du gsol/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang bcom ldan 'das kyis gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to⑤/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po nam mkha'i mtshan nyid dang mtshungs pa'i phyir chos thams cad ni mtshan nyid gcig pa'o/ /chos kyi dbyings dmigs su med pa'i phyir chos thams cad ni stong pa nyid kyi byin gyis brlabs kyi 6)mtshan nyid do/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po gang dag ngas sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa nas ④byang chub kyi snying po la 'dug gi bar du bsgoms shing lan mang du byas pa'i chos kyi nidabyings kyi byin gyis brlabs 0kyi gzhi yin te gsang ba pa'i bdag po de lta bas na de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub ni de yin no/ /rigs kyi bu nga byang chub kyi snying po na tso'adug pa na yang 'di dag sems sems pa las rnam par rtog pa thams cad spangs pa zhes bya ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo thob par gyur to/ /sgra dbyangs mtha' yas par sgrogs 7pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi sgo dang / bdud bzhi pham par byed pa'i dbyangs zhes bya ba'i rig sngags kyi rgyal mo gnas med pa/ nam mkha'i spyod yul mtshan nyid med pa 'gro ba po /gemed pa byed pa po dang tshor ba po med pa 'jig rten gyi 'gro ba thams cad las 'das pa yang thob par gyur to51 / /gsang ba pa'i bdag 7po de la rig lisngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo mtha' yas shing rab 'byam ⑩rgya che ba bstan par 51 bya ba de dag gang zhe na/ na ma gne ya rnyi kā māṃ buddha ga te pra tikhyi te bhyaḥ(1she/ a pra ti ha ta shā the ste86—677

sa ne dhibhyaḥ/ ma hā kṛ pe abhyaḥ/ ga ga na a ma la rū pa dhā ra tsā ta thā duru pa bi bha ④ba bi bha be na⑤/ pa ra rū pa dha re ma hā kṛ pe ⑥ba ma le/ sab ⑦ga te bi sho dha ni/ de la 'di ⑧ni rdo rje'i tshig mnyam pa med pa yin no/ /a ma hā bi sma ye hūṃ khaṃ/ phyag na rdo rje 'di ni nam mkha' ltar dri ma med pa zhes bya ba'i rig sngags kyi rgyal mo ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs ⑨kyis byin du brlabs ⑩pa/ sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi yum yin no/ /rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa rnams gang na rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di mi 'chad cing mi brjod pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing de ngas ma mthong ngo / /gsang ba pa'i bdag po rnam grangs des kyang 'di ltar gsang ba'i snying po'i dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya dang / dam tshig 'di la ⑩'jug par 'dod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pas/ gsang sngags kyi sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i borgyal po 'di la mngon par brtson par bya'o zhes bya bar rig par bya'o0/ /de nas chagasang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgo nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa rnams gsang sngags kyi rang bzhin ci boltar ston/ chos thams cad la dbang 7thob pa'i bar du ci ltar 'gyur / de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po 'di la byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgo nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pas slob dpon las 3 dbang nod par bya'o/ /'di snyam du slob 86—678

dpon 'di ni bdag gi ston pa ste bla na med pa 0)yang dag par rdzogs pa'i ②byang chub la bskul ba'o/ / snyam du yang sems bskyed par bya'o/ /de ①de nas thal mo sbyar te nye bar song la gsol ba gdab po/ /slob dpon gyis kyang de don du ④gnyer bar shes nas snying rje chen po mngon sum (snyedu byas te tshig 'di skad ces smra bar bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu longs de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan bla na med pa de khyod la bstan par bya'o/ /de nas sa gzhi yid du 'ong ba brtags la cho ga snga mas sa gzhi sbyangs te/ dkyil 'khor gru bzhi la ༅sgo gcig pa lha rnam par dbye ba'i gnas legs par brtags pa/ mchod pa'i gnas rnam pa sna tshogs bkod pa bsgrubs pa/ spos chu dzodadri zhim pos bkang ba'i bum pa dbus su bzhag pa bris la slob ma padma'i steng na 'dug pa/ rang gi lha'i gzugs bdag yin par dmigs pa la gnas pa yid byang chub kyi sems su gyur pa/ 'gro ba mtha' dag yongs su bskyab pa'i bsam pa can/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su 'gyur bar 'dod pa dag bum pa des spyi bo nas dbang bskur (8)ro/ /'di skad du rigs kyi bu khyod de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su skyes so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan phye'o zhes kyang 94)smra bar bya'o/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de la byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgo nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i yispyad pa spyod pa rnams kyis 17lha'i gzugs ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku ci snyed pa'am/ sems dpa' mtha' yas pa thams cad kyi cha lugs kyi 51 bye brag kyang rung ste/ gsang sngags dang / phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs pa ri snyelas 'gyur bar 〉rig par bya'o//gsang ba pa'i bdag po gsang sngags dang / phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab mapa yang ci lta bu yin zhe na/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po de la dbang bskur ba'i tshe/ slob 86—679

dpon gyis padma'i phyag rgyas gdan sra ①zhing brtan pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rdo rje ltar mi shigs pa yongs su brtag pa ni/ gser ram zangs sam 'jim pa las byas pa'am ri mor bris pa gzhag ste bya'o/ /de'i ②steng na ni'adug pa la chos thams cad la dbang thob par bya ba'i phyir/ spos chu dri zhim pos bkang ba'i bum pas spyi bo nas dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /slob dpon bdag nyid kyang ci ltar rjes su mthun ①par mos par bya ba'am de'i phyag rgyas rjes su mthun ⑤pa'i bya ba bya'o/ /chos kyi dung gi phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags kyis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung gi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /ral gri'i phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags kyi 0ni 'jig tshogs la lta ba mtha' dag gzhom par byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags kyis ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags kyis ni mi shes pa'i grong khyer gzhig par byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags kyis ni spyi gtsug ⑦bltar mi snang 6)ba byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /mdzod spu'i phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags kyis ni mdzod spu dang ldan par byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /yan lag thams cad byung 6)ba'i phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags kyis ni yan lag thams cad byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de bol padma'i phyag rgya 'byung ste/ lag pa gnyis gcig ⑪tu sbyar la mkhrig lhonyam nas bkyed de lhonyasor mo thams cad mgo cimanyam par brkyang ngo ske/ /phyag rgya 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cud kyi rdo rje gdan yin te dam pa mthu chen po'o/ /gsang sngags 'di 7ni ngo mtshar che ba thams cad kyi sgo 86—680

ste/ na maḥs manta bu nān/ ga ga nā ma ①la pra bhā badzā ste bya ②nā ma hā kṛ pādma maḥl/ de la 'di dag ni rdo rje'i tshig mnyam pa med pa'o/ /a ti bisma ④ya ma hā kṛ pādma ⑤dzaḥyi / lag pa gnyis bsnol ⑦te rgyab sbyar la sor mo rnams phan tshun slas ⑧pa'i tshul du bsnol te/ g.yon pa'i mthe bo 0rgyab tu bzlog tshul g.yas pa'i mthe bos sen mo la sbyar ro/ /rgya 'di phyag rgya chen po ste/ /chos kyi 'khor lo zhes su bsgrags7/ /'jig rten mgon po skyob rnams kyis/ /'khor lo dam pa 'di bskor ro/ /na maḥs manta 8bunta nān/ ta thā ga ta a mṛ 8te bi dza ya barṇa na 8sarba 8dza ya ga ta dharba ⑩tā ri ma hā kṛ pe rtsu ⑩lha tra hi tsom hād khyu ⑩te rtsu/ gsang ba'i phyag rgya las mthe bo du )gnyis lag mthil 0du bcug la/mdzub du mo gnyis kyis rtsa ba dkris te lhag ma rnams so na chagazhag la bsgreng ④ngo //'jig rten mgon po skyob rnams kyis/ /phyag rgya sems can thams cad kyi/ /don rnams rtag tu myur byed 'di/ /chos kyi dung zhes rnam par gragasadu/ /na maḥs manta bu ( nyenān/ tta da dhwa bha ga ba ti pra tiṣṭha te/ cas zhu nyenanta ru dus ra bi nir sto ṣi/ sarba ( —0ta thā ga ta 'i )bāka 5)pra sa ra zhu)bisma ya ka dha ra ma hā dha ra ma hā dha ra samaska cigesab (gyesatwa sarto sha nunyen rā ma hā ma hā hūṃ/ gang ba'i phyag rgya de nyid las mdzub so mo gnyis bkug ste nunyemathe bo'i sen gyumo'i steng du ral gri'i tshul du gzung 6 )ngo / /phyag rgya rab tu mthu chen 'di/ /ral gri'i (nyephyag rgyar rnam par grags/ /sems can kun gyi 'jigs zhe tshogs lta/ /lhan cig skyes pa'ang gcod pa yin/ /na maḥs manta bu nān/ a ma hā khan zhe pradzñā te dzi ta sata (steka ya dṛ zhe sbyi tshinda na kā ra/ ta thā ga tā dhi musti nir dzā ta bi dhu ta si kulpa snyim hā ma hā rtsu dzaḥzhen/ phyag rgya de nyid las mdzub ci mo gnyis phyi rol du brkyang ste/ gung 86—681

mo gnyis kyi tshigs gsum par nas gang tsam gyis ma reg par bzung la/ rdo rje lta bur byas te mthe bo ①dang srin lag dang mthe'u chung gnyis ②nang du gzhug go//sangs rgyas 'jig rten mgon po yi / /phyag rgya rab tu bsgrags ④pa 'di/ /mi shes grong khyer 'jig pa yi/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgyar rnam par grags/ /de'i ⑤gsang sngags ni/ na maḥs manta buddhā nān/ ma hā bisma ⑥ya te dzod bha ba ⑦ma hā tsaṇḍa dur dan tā tra bhañdza hārdoshe/ rdo rje'i phyag rgya de nyid las mdzub khyamo gnyis gung mo gnyis kyi ngos su gtsug tor lta bur gzung spe )ngo / /'di ni gtsug tor phyag rgya ste/ /'jig rten mgon po 17skyob pa yin(nye/ /gang gis phyag rgya 'di bcings pa//de la 'di ni gtsug tor 'gyur/ /de'i 7gsang sngags ni/ na maḥs manta bursā nān / sab tra ⑩a pra ti ha ta bha nyu5ba ti dharma tā ba li nānatshe/ sabra ⑩ta thā ga ta no du dharya ba 38sha ya/ ma hā buṅgā sab nya ta thā ga ta/ a dhiṣṭha na a dhiṣṭha te sbu zhu )ra ma hā ma ho: naḥṣa swā hā/ lag pa g.yas pa khu tshur bcangs 2nyal smin mtshams su gzung dzo nyengo / /rgya 'di rgyal ba mchog rnams kyi/ /mdzod spur rtag tu rnam par bsgrags/ /de'i 2 sngags ni/ na maḥs manta ri bunta nān/ a shi 8khen du ba ma pra bha sab tsho mosatwa kle sha santa pa pra sha ma nā nisnyeg ra ma hā ti dha gyur/ sarba sa )ta thā ga ristota a lo kā dalhar ma hā da pu ru ṣa rū pa dha ra ka ri gharko ti ga ta swā hā/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa rnams sangs rgyas kyi bya ba la nye bar gnas pa de gang yin pa de dag ni gsang sngags dang phyag rgya 'di dag yin no/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de lta bas na byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi byusgo nas/ byang chub sems dpa' gsang 5sngags dang phyag rgya 'di dag gis byin gyis brlabs pa 86wa 682

rnams ni yid bzhin gyi nor bu gzugs sna tshogs pa dang 'dra ba'i lus rnams kyis sems can gyi khams rnams su ①sems can gdul ba'i dbang gis ji ltar rjes su mthun ②pa'i lus rnams ston to/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/gsang ba pa'i bdag po gsang ba'i snying po'i dkyil 'khor la sdom pa gang dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa rnams lus dang ngag dang yid bsdams shing spyod par 'gyur ba'i sdom pa dang byang chub kyi sems yod do/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de la sdom pa gang zhe na/ bsdam pa ni sdom pa ste lus dang ngag dang yid rnams bsdus shing yongs su bsdus pa phyi dang nang gi sdug bsngal sel bar 'gyur ba de ni sdom pa yin no/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / phyag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgo nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pas ②sdom pa ci ltar gzung bar bgyi/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po 'di la slob dpon gyis lha spyan drang ba byas la bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bklags te/ dkyil 'khor la phyogs te lider 'dug la slob ma rnams la bos te 'di skad du bu (5)ses gsum du sgrib pa med par gnas pa(7/ dam tshig chen po la 'jug pa'i sdom pa nos shig ces bsgo bar bya'o/ /des kyang thal mo sbyar pus mo btsugs (lete 'di skad du slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba deng (8)gi dus 'di nas bzung (9)ste/ nam sko86—683

byang chub kyi snying po la mchis kyi bar du slob dpon gyis bdag la dam tshig chen po la 'jug pa'i sdom pa 7stsal du gsol/ ston pa'i bka' ②phyi bos nod par 'tshal lo zhes smra bar bya'o/ /de nas slob dpon gyis kyang 'di skad du ①rigs kyi bu dgongs shig /bla na med pa ④yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod pa khyod kyis byang chub kyi snying po la 'dug gi bar du lhag pa'i bsam pas ⑤sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams la bdag yidabul bar bya'o/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po 'di ni dam tshig chen po la 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i sdom pa yin te/ sdom pa 'di la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgo nas / byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa rnams ni tshul khrims shin tu bsdams shing / de bzhin gshegs pa'i (metshul khrims bla na med pa la rab tu gnas pa yin no/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de lta bas na gsang sngags kyi sgo nas/byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa'i sgo 'di la slob par 'dod pa'i byang chub sems dpas phyo)dam tshig chen po la 'jug pa 'di la mngon par brtson par bya'o/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po byang chub sems dpa' sems gang dang ldan na de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su skyes shing 99'das pa dang ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi ye shes rab tu gnas par 'gyur ba'i byang chub kyi sems de yang nyon cig /de nas bcom ldan 'das la phyag na rdo rjes 'di skad bogasol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag la thugs brtse ba'i slad du byang chub kyi sems de bshad du gsol/ de skad ces gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis nya7gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de la byang chub gang zhe na/ byang chub 86—684

ni nam mkha'i ngo bo ①nyid do/ /nam mkha' ②yang gzugs med bstan du med gzung du med pa'o/ /byang chub kyi mtshan nyid gang yin pa sems kyi mtshan nyid kyang de yin no/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de lta bas na sems dang nam mkha' dang byang chub 'di dag ni gnyis su med do/ /'di ①la chos rnams mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa chos kyi dbyings khong du chud pa gang yin pa de ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub yin no/ /de la mi 0skye ba'i tshul dang mi ⑤dmigs pa'i tshul gyis sems skye ba gang yin pa de ni/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po byang chub kyi sems zhes bya'o/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' gnas kyi gzhi lngas byang chub mngon par rtogs par 'gyur te/ lnga gang zhe na/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po 'di la byang chub sems dpa' rnams dngos po thams cad dang bral bar mngon par rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /kha cig ni phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched dang / gzung ba dang / 'dzin pa rnam par spangs pa stong pa sgyu ma lta bur (6)mngon par rtogs (7par 'gyur ro/ /kha cig ni chos la dmigs pas 58)so/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po 'on kyang byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgo nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pas/'di ltar dngos po thams cad dang bral ba phung po dang khams dang / skye mched dang ske/ gzung ba dang / 'dzin pa rnam par spangs pa chos bdag med pa mnyam pa nyid kyis (9ci rang gi sems thog ma nas ma skyes pa stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid du rtogs par bya'o/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de la dngos po thams cad dang bral ba zhes bya ba de / ni de bzhin gshegs pas 51)'di la bdag gam/sems can nam/ skye ba'amanyu / shed las skyes pa yod pa ma yin gyi phung po 86—685

dang ske/ khams dang / skye mched tsam du zad do zhes 'jig rten pa'i lam yongs su spang bar ①bstan pa yin no/ /phung po ②khams dang / skye mched dang ske/ gzung ba dang / 'dzin pa rnam par spangs pa zhes bya ba ni nyan thos kyi lam mngon par rtogs pa yongs su shes pa'i sgo nas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi theg pa chen po mngon par rtogs pa rnam par gzhag pa yin no/ /chos bdag med pa mnyam pa nyid kyis ni byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgo nas / byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa rnams rang gi sems thog ma nas ma skyes par mthong zhing stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid rdzas med pa mtshan nyid med par mngon par rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de ③lta bas na/byang chub sems dpas ④gnas med pa sgrib pa med pa spros pa thams cad dang dubral ba'i sems bskyed par bya'o/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po rnam grangs 'dis kyang 'di ltar theg pa chen po la yang dag par gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gsang sngags spyad (7pa'i tshul sgrub pa rnam par thar pa'i sgo ma gtogs par bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la phan 'dogs pa med par rig par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams bskal pa du mar 'bad cing btsal te/ gtang (7dka' ba rnams kyang byas pas byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba de 98)byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgo nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa rnams kyis 6)tshe 'di nyid la bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /de yang boci'i phyir zhe na/ci gsang ba pa'i bdag po tshe zhes bya ba de ni de bzhin gshegs pas skye ba la 'du shes su bya bar zad do/nya/ /86—686

byang chub sems dpa' de rnams kyi 0)'du shes de yang chos thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid khong du chud pa'i ting nge 'dzin thob pa'i sngon rol nyid du 'gags ②pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po gsang ba'i snying po'i ①dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya'i dam tshig 'di la 'jug par 'dod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chos lnga ④rgyang ring du spang bar bya'o/ /lnga gang zhe na/ ser sna dang sems can la gnod pa dang / the tsom ⑤dang le lo dang gsang sngags la sogs pa la ma gus pa ste/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po chos 'di lnga ni byang chub sems dpa' tshe 'di nyid la 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam du ⑥'jug par 'dod pa rnams kyis rgyang ring du spang ⑦bar bya'o/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po chos 'di rnams la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de la/ byang chub kyi spyad pa cung zad kyang yongs su rdzogs par nga mi smra'o/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos 'di rnams ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub kyi sems kyi (debar du gcod pa chen po'o/ /de nas gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang gsang ba'i snying po 'di'i dam tshig la gnas par gyur pa de'i bsod nams ci tsam po)zhig 'phel bar 'gyur/de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' 7stsal to/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mtha' 31)rtogs par nus sam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das nam mkha'i dbyings kyi tshad ma mchis pas de'i tshad gzung bar mi nus so/ /bcom 86—687

ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mtha' ni rtogs par nus kyang srid kyi ①gsang ba'i snying po'i dkyil 'khor du dam tshig mthong ba'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo'i ②bsod nams mngon par 'dus ③byas pa gang yin pa'i bsod nams de'i tshad ni rtogs par mi nus so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/gsang ba pa'i bdag po dkyil 'khor 'di ni sangs rgyas 'byung ba mthong ngo ④/ /gsang ba pa'i ⑤bdag po dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba ni/ snying po gtso bo snying po ⑥thams cad kyi mthar phyin pa ste de'i gong na de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor ⑦med do/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyi snying por gyur pa gnas su gyur pa skyabs su gyur pa'o/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de lta ⑧bas na rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo dkyil 'khor dang phyag rgya dang dam tshig 'di la 'jug par 'dod pas/dkyil 'khor dang phyag rgya dang dam tshig la 'jug pa thob par 'gyur ba ⑨gang na ba der ⑩'jig rten gyi khams me ma 0mur gyis yongs su gang ba la yang rkang pa gnyis kyis 8'bogs te 'gro bar bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgo nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa de rnams la yang rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag gis nyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi 'du shes dang / pha ma'i cha'adu shes dang mkhan po'i nyanya'adu shes bskyed par bya'o/ / de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag la ni bdag gi sha dang khrag gis mchod na yang lan lon par mi 'gyur na mchod pa gzhan gyis lta ga la nus/7 gsang ba pa'i bdag po gang la brten nyartenas sems can dmyal ba'i lha rgyun chad par 'gyur zhing dud 'gro'i skye gnas su 'gro ba dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten pa'i phung po med par 'gyur ba'i byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgo nas kyang nyustebyang 86—688

chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa de dag la ci ltar lan ldon ①par 'gyur/byang chub sems dpa' de dag ni ②mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa la gnas pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyi rlabs ①kyis byin du ④brlabs pa nam mkha' ltar gnas ⑤med pa'i spyod yul can yin par ⑥rig par bya'o/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po ngas khyod la bsgo bar bya'o/ /shes par bya'o/ /ma 'ongs pa'i dus na mi blun po dmigs pa can la lta ba 'jig tshogs la lta ba mngon par zhen pa blo phyin ci log tu gyur pa bdag gi sems kyi gnas gtan ⑦la ma phebs pa rnams rnam par 'khrul nas 'di skad du/ 'di ni sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa ma yin gyi (kye'adi dag ni rang bzo can gyis stirang bzor byas pa yin no zhes zer ba dag 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po mi blun po de dag ni 'gro ba gnyis su 'gro bar rig par bya ste/ gnyis gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ sems can dmyal ba dang dud 'gro'o/ /gsang ba pa'i bdag po de ⑨ dag la snyi/dge ba'i rtsa ba'i nyu)rgyu cung zad kyang yod par nga mi smra'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de dag ni rtsa ba chad par byed pa la zhugs pa ste/nye/ sangs rgyas kyi byang chub la bar du gcod par byed pa rtsibadud kyis zil gyis non pa shes rab 'chal pa'i rang bzhin can theg pa chen po la goms par ma byas pa nyan thos kyi theg pa la snying por 'du shes pa rnams 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la mngon par brtson par 'gyur ba 'ide dag la tshul khrims 'chal pa sdig pa'i chos spyod pa de dag la sangs rgyas kyi byang chub ga la yod ces mi snyan pa 7smra bar 'gyur te/ mi blun po de dag gis mi snyan pa de smras pas ngan 'gro gnyis su lhung ste/ gsang sngags kyi spyad pa spyod pa de ni (1 'di ltar 86wa 689

bcom ldan 'das thams cad mkhyen pa des/ sems can rnams la phan gdags ①pa'i phyir 'di dag thams cad gsungs so/ /de dag la snang ②ba'i sems bskyed pas sdug bsngal gyi skal ba can du 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba 'dzin pa lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis phyag bya bar 'os par yin par ③rig ④par bya'o/ de nas yang bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa rdo rje 'dzin sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul phra rab snyed ⑤la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu de rnams bsrung ⑥ba dang bskyab pa dang / sba ba'i phyir rigs kyi bu ༅khyod kyi lag tu gtad kyisani/ khyod kyis ⑨rigs kyi bu de rnams rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par bsrung ⑩bar gyis shig /yongs su bskyab par gyis 0gnod pa las kyang ⑩bzlog par gyis shig /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa rdo rje 'dzin sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul phra rab snyed po 8de dag gis mgrin gcig tu tshig 'di skad mismras so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa ⑫chos kyi rjes ci skad bka' stsal pa de bzhin du thams cad bgyi'o/ /rigs kyi bu de dag nam byang chub kyi snying po la mchis kyi bar du bsrung ⑩bar bgyi'o⑩/ /cibacom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu de phonyedag legs so legs sol/ /khyod lho)kyis ci nas kyang ston pa'i bstan pa 'jig par mi 'gyur ba de ltar gyis shig /de nas gsang ba pa'i bdag po 8nyaphyag na rdo rjes rdo rje 'dzin de dag thams cad la smras pa/ grogs po dag de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis sa)bya dka' ba brgya stong du mar 9 nyebasgrubs pa de ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs ṅge'i byang chub 'di yin te/86wa 690

de bas na khyed thams cad kyis ①nan tan bskyed de ②de dag bsrung bar ①gyis shig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'dis ni bdag cag de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' bzhin byed pa'o/ /zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa bsrung byaba'o/ /zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /stobs bcu 'dzin pa'o/ /zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /de bas na chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bsrung ⑤ba dang / bskyab pa dang / sba ba'i phyir bdag cag rnams kyis mertag tu brtson par bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu de dag kyang bsrung rgyab dang / bskyab pa ⑧dang sba ba'i phyir brtson par bya'o/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / rdo rje 'dzin ⑨de dag gis mgrin gcig tu smras pa/ bdag gis ci nas kyang ston pa'i bstan pa yun ring ( )du gnas par 'gyur ba dang /'jig par mi 'gyur bar 7bya ba 'di ni nges par bya dgos so zhes smras so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis ma 'ongs pa'i 'gro ba la gzigs nas chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yun ring du gnas par bya ba'i phyir/thugs rje chen po 8thog mar byas nas gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag gsungs so8/ /na ma ste ya snyi 8kā nān/ sarba ta thā ga tā nān/'oste sarba ⑩ta thā ga tā ⑩sa ma tā ga ti tshig te/ e ku smra sam bha sasba sa yir ṇi bi tsi ⑥ tra rū pa dhwa ri tsā spe/ sab (gyes ta du tra a gi thā ri steya ba ri pu ra ṇi/ sab zhunye bo dhi sa ta tra ga ta mā na se/ tra (nyenyi me bza 9 nyesnyam soshes ma/ ma hā ma tī ( ste bai snye )ro tsa na garbha saṃ bu /sab du ta thā ga ta/ a dhikhyi ri te so tra nyi te bha ga ba te duste / de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rjes su gnang ba/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis byin gyis brlabs sakyis snying rje chen po mngon du byas 86wa 691

te / 'di nyid kyi rgyud phyi ma smras pa/ dang por ①slob dpon gtsang sbra byas te/chos kyi dbyings su gyur pa'i yid kyis bdag rnam par snang mdzad du de'i ②phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags kyis bsgyur te dkyil 'khor bri'o/ /sngags pa gsang sngags cho ga la/ /rtag par cho ga snga ma yis/ /phye ma dkar po blangs nas su/ /snying rjer ①gyur pa'i yid kyis 0ni/ /rtag tu mi g.yo dran byas te/ /dang por tshon rtsi dgye bar bya/ /de nas tshon rtsi gnyis pa ni/ /dmar po ⑤blangs nas dgye bar bya/ /tshon rtsi gsum pa ser po yang / /shin tu nges par dgye bar bya/ /de nas margad 'dra ba ⑥dgye/ /de nas an da rnyil 'drar medagye/ /gang gi nikha dog ci 'drar ⑨gsungs/ /de yi dkyil 'khor de nyid do/ /lha yi kha dog de bzhin te/ /zhi dang rgyas dang drag spyod pa/ /de yi tshugasang sngags de nyid 'dod / /'di ⑩ni gsang ba bstan pa yin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang sngags 8gang / /de dag dbang chen yin par bsgrags8/ /phyag na padma'i chu yi yin/ /rdo rje can gyi rlung gi yin/ /pho nya la sogs bran rnams dang / /khro bo'i ming du gang gtogs ⑩pa/ /'ikun du thogs 7med spyod pa rnams/ /kun gyi dkyil 'khor me dang rlung / /yang na 'di dag thams cad kyang / /nus pa'i mthu ni kun dang ldan/ /stong pa nyid kyi bdud rtsis ngoms0/ /snying rje'i mig ni 12dri ma med/ /byams pa'i go cha legs par bgos/ /dga' ba dri 4)med rtsal dang ldanapo rte/ /srid pa'i rgya mtshor bying ba yi/ /sems can 'don par nisterab tu brtson/ /'khor ba na yang mi gnas shing / /mya ngan 'das la'ang gnas ma yin/ /yang dag mtha' la nges byas shing / /sems can rnams kyi don byed pa'o/ /de nas gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes thams cad dang 86—692

ldan pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor hu)la bltas nas tshig smras pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa sdig bral ba/ /ston pa bcom par ldan pa 'dis/ /bgegs rnams 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i gnas/ /gtan la bab par bshad 'gyur ba / /grogs po kun gyis mnyan par gyis/ /bgegs ni rnam pa du ma ste/ /lha dang lha min gnod sbyin mi / /de la bgegs ni rnam bganyis te/ /phyi dang nang gi spyod yul lo/ /glo lu 'dabugs brnangs ⑥rims dang skyugadu /skya rbab nad dang yi ga 'chu(kye/ /de la sogs pa'i rims rnams ni/ /rlung grang ④tsha ba la sogs las/ /mi bzad 7ngo bo can 'byung ba/ /nang gi yin par shes par bya/ /phyi rol gyi ni bgegs chen rnams/ /mi dang de bzhin mi min 7te/ /ye shes tsher ma de dag ni / /spyod pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /'jig rten gzhig 'o pa'i phyir 'byung ste0//dka' thub gnas na rmongs par byed/ /las kyi cho ga mthong ba yis/ /de rnams slar ni bzlog par bya/ /tsha bar gyur nas 'ongs pa'i 8bgegs/ /bsil bas nye bar zhi bar bya8/ /shes rab can gyis gnyen po yis/ /de dag so sor gso bar bya/ /yang na bgegs rnams thams cad la/ /sngags pas nges par mtshams bcad pa'i/ /bgegs rnams kun la ye shes ni/ /zhi bar byed pa'i mchog tu bshad/ /'phags pa rnam par snang mdzad chen po mngon par mardzogs par byang chub par sprul pa byin gyis rlob pa theg pa chen po'i ri gemado sde'i rgyal po gsang ba pa'i 3tshemachog ririm par phye ba las/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po byin gyis rlob pa rdzogs so 1// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī len dra na ribo rnyi dang / zhu chen gyi lotstsha ba ban de ( lhedapal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa ri// //86—693

༄gi /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi khro bo'i rgyal po 'phags pa mi g.yo ba de'i stobs dpag tu med pa rtul phod pa 'dul bar gsungs pa zhes bya ba'i rtog pa/3༄tshogi /rgya gar skad du/ ārya a tsa la ma hā kro sedha rā dza su busarba ta thā ga ta ta su (4)ba la a pa ri demi ta bī ra bi na ya swā byā (6)to nā ma kulpa/ bod skad du / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi khro bo'i rgyal po 'phags pa rdzimi g.yo ba de'i stobs dpag tu med pa rtul nadaphod pa 'dul bar gsungs pa zhes bya ba'i rtog pa/ rje btsun 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo /'di skad bdag gis thos pa 9༄dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rlung la bzhugs te/ rin po che sna tshogs bkod pa rin po che'i gzhal yas khang bye ba grangs med pa du mas bkod cing yongs su bskor ba/ bsam ri7gyis mi khyab cing grangs med pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsod nams las 'khrungs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i seng ge'i khri bshams pa rin po ches spras pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med pa rnam par : snang bar byed pa rin po che sna tshogs kyi lcags ris 86—757

yongs su bskor cing shin tu yid 'phrog pa/ steng du rin po che sna tshogs kyis spras pa'i rin po che'i bla bres nam mkha'i khams go 'byed par snang bar byed pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i padma'i rgyal po rin po che sna bdun gyi 0)rgyu las yang dag par byung ②ba/ sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa sna tshogs yongs su dga' bar byed pa/ 'od zer chen po phul du byung ba gsal bar byed cing mun nag thams cad rab tu dang bar byed pa/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi ye shes las 'khrungs pa'i seng ge'i khri bsam gyis mi khyab pa bye ba du mas yongs su bskor ba/ byang chub sems dpa' grangs med pas yongs su bskor ba/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po la sogs pa du mas yongs su bskor ba der bcom ldan 'das bzhugs nas chos ston to/ /'di lta ste/'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / 'jam dpal dang / kun du bzang po dang / byams pa dang / sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba dang /zhi ba'i blo gros dang / sna tshogs bkod pa dang / nam mkha' me tog 'chang dang ske/ nam mkha'i snying po dang / shin tu rnam dag dang / phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' chen pos yongs su bskor ba/ nyan thos bye ba phrag du ma 'di lta ste/ shā ri'i bu dang / mod gal chadang / rta thul dang /'od sung ( )la sogs pas yongs su bskor ba/ grags chen snyan pa chen po brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / lus ngan po la sogs pas yongs su bskor zhing / bcom ldan 'das thugs rje rjen po dang ldan pa'i thugs kyis 95)chos ston pa 'di lta ste/ gsang sngags kyi tshul la 'jug pa la sogs pa'i 86—758

chos kyi rnam grangs gang thos par byed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang /nyan thos de dag dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dag dang /bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sems can gyi khams kyi bsam pa sna tshogs yo)la dgos ②pa sna tshogs kyi spyod lam gyis zhugs shing gardzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul rnams mdzad do//bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sangs rgyas rnams bsnyen bkur dang / yongs su mnyes ④par mdzad do/ /sangs rgyas kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul du ma rnams kyang gzigs sol/ /sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa du ma yang mngon par sprul pa ⑤mdzad do/ /bkod pa chen po yang bskyed par mdzad do/ /mdor na thams cad 6)gang dang gang gis sems can gyi don du gzigs pa de dang de mdzad do/ /rtsibacom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa des 'khor chen po rnams la gzigs nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/ lag na rdo rje bdag gis sna tshogs du ma'i gsung gi 'khor lo'i (shedakyil 'khor rnam par 5)phyung ste tshig dang yi ge du ma bkod pa sems can sna tshogs mgu bar byed pa/ phyag rgya dang sngags sna tshogs kyis rnam par mtshan par gyur pa/ 'gro ba sna tshogs kyi khyad par brjod pa / sdug bsngal sna tshogs rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ dbang phyug du ma dang ldan zhing yid 'phrog pa'i yiyi ge gcig dang / 47stong phrag brgyad dang dzin/ grangs med pa tu dang / bye ba phrag tshugasum dang / rjes 'jug dang / ring po dang /thung ngu dang / nga ro dang / gsal byed kyi mtshan mas mtshan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi dbyings bcu la sogs pa'i tsho byang chub sems dpa'i dpe (zhedang ske/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / 'jig rten pa'i mngon par 86—759

shes pa lnga dang / lha'i gnas la sogs pa'i dbye ba dang / mi'i 'gro ba dang /yi dgas 1)dang / dud 'gro'i 'gro ba la thug ( par phye zhing bcad pa rnams gang bdag gis sems can rnams la phan pa'i lhag pa'i labasam pa bye ba phrag grangs med pa bdun cu (4)rtsa bdun gyi (snyesems can rnams kyi don du gsungs pa yin no/ /de yang gzhi dang me tog gi snying pos brgyan pa'i 'jig rten 6)khams 'dir dar bar 'gyur ro7)/ /gsang ba'i 98)bdag po bye ba phrag grangs med pa bdun cu kyi)rtsa bdun po de rnams kun gyi nang nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po 7'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang /medang / phyag na rdo rje dang / 'jam dpal la yo sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la bdag gis thabs sna tshogs kyi cho ga'i sgo bstan te1lha/ gsang ba'i tshabadag po de rnams la ni mngag gzhug dang /mngag gzhug ma dang / pho nya dang / pho nya mo tshul sogs pa de rnams kyi phyag rgya dang / sngags dang / rtog pa'i cho ga yang rgyas par bstan to/ /las sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs kyang bstan tetsha/ sgrub thabs sna tshogs yang dag ldan/ /ras ris cho ga rnam par bstan/ /yang na las kyi cho ga dbye/ /gang du stobs chen gsang ba'i las/ /sbyin sreg 1 dag ni bdag gis bstan/ /lhag ma de bzhin yul gnas gzhan/ /de nas ma lus me thab dang / /de bzhin zhi ba rgyas pa dang / /dbang du bya dang mngon spyod dang / /de nas dus kyi khyad par dang / /dkyil 'khor yang ni de bzhin bstan/ /phyag rgya dag kyang ma lus par / /sa bon dang ni mtshan ma dang / /gsang ba yi ni sngags nyid dang / /rigs kyi mtshan ma de bzhin sku/ /ma lus pa yi dbyibs 1nyadang yang / /de lta bu la sogs pa'i las/ /de dag thams cad bdag gi sa bstan/ /mi g.yo zhes 86wa 760

bya'i rtog pa ni/ /de ni slar yang bdag gis bshad/ /dag pa'i sems dpa' blo ldan gyis/ /sngags pas gang zhig bsgrub bya yi/ /bsam gyis mi khyab sna tshogs las/ /gsang sngags kyi ni sgrub thabs zhigatu) /rtog pa 'di ru mdor bsdus nas/ /de yi cho ga yang dag bshad/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas bsnyen cing / /sgrub (9pas go 'phang thob par 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sras kyi mchog /chos zhes bya bar (bskye bar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas zhing ni ma lus par/ /de ni kun du dag par 'gyur/ /rtag par rgyun du rnam rtog med/ /nam mkha' yi (0ni lam la gnas/ /gzugs can lus la brten (5)nas su/ /sems can bye brag thugs su chud/ /sems can zhi ba gdul dka' dang / /bgegs chen dang ni log par 'dren/ /de nas (5)gdul bar 7bya ba'i phyir/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis rtag tu sprul/ /mtshan ni mi g.yo ces 40bsgrags pa/ /khro bo 'phags pa stobs po che/ /dpal ldan gdul dka' 5)'dul mdzad pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sras kyi sras/ /de 'dir rgyal mchog rnams dang ni/ ci /de bzhin rgyal sras kyis rtag par/ /phyag 'tshal tshangs pa la sogs dang / /lus can thams cad kun tu mchod/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni byas pa gzo/ /de bzhin du ni sangs rgyas sras/ /'di kun smon lam yongs rdzogs shing / /bsam gyis mi khyab ye shes rdzogs/ /mi g.yo 7zhes bya'i sa thob pas41)/ /mi g.yo 'di yang de yi mtshan/ /bdud rnams kun gyis mi g.yo bas/ /rtag 1 pa'i ye shes dri med bzang / /rtog pa'i rgyal po rdzu 'phrul che/ /bshad kyis /nyebu khyod tshur nyon cig /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin gyis brlabs/ /chos nyu rikyi dbyings su rab gzhol bas/ /rtag tu tshe dang nad med mchog /dngos grub myur du 86—761

stsol ①mdzad pa/ /rtag tu bgegs rnams sel ②byed cing / /de bzhin bdud rnams rab tu 'joms/ /sems can rnams ni bde ba'i phyir/ / rtog pa ni'adi ni rab tu bshad/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dag mgrin gcig gi dungag gis gsol pa/ sems can thams cad kyi don dang bdag cag la thugs brtse ba bskyed de bcom ldan 'das bshad du gsol/ bde bar gshegs pa bshad du gsol / de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas gsol ba btab pa de mkhyen nas gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan pa'i du'ajig rten gyi ⑥khams ⑦'od zer chen pos snang bar byas nas/ dpal gyi be'u las byung ba zhes bya ba'i 'od zer byung ⑧ste/ 'od zer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma grangs med pas yongs su bskor ba byas nas gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan ⑨pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di nas bzung ste0/ ji srid brjod du 7med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams nas nam mkha'i khams kyi mtha' gtugs pa'i bar du de khyab nas g.yas phyogs nas bskor te/ de bzhin du byang phyogs dang / nub dang / lho dang /shar gyi phyogs dang / phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi bar du khebs par byas so/ /'jig rten gyi khams de rnams na bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de thams cad kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di smras so/ /shākya'i 7mgon po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /gzi brjid chen po gang bzhugs pa/ dku /chos kyi dbyings las byung ba yi/ /rgyal ba'i sras po thams cad gshegs/ /de ru dri med dam chos nyona'/ /86—762

gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul dge ba/ /gang thob ①'jig rten mgon pos ni/ /byang chub 'dus ma byas pa brnyes②/ /de nas 'od zer nides tshigs su bcad dhipa 'di thos nas slar log ste bcom ldan 'das kyi dpal be'u nyid du zhugs par gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po de rnams rang rang gi du'ajig rten gyi khams nas khro bo'i mthus/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa ga la ba der lhags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor rnams kyi dusems rtse gcig par mkhyen nas slar yang rdo rje bsgyings pa bsregs ⑦pa'i me lce kun du 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rnam pa drug tu g.yos so/ /rab tu g.yos so/ /kun tu rab tu g.yos so/ /'gul/ rab tu 'gul/ kun du rab tu 'gul/ ldeg rab tu ldeg /kun du rab tu ldeg /'khrugs/ rab tu 'khrugs / kun du rab tu 'khrugs/ 'ur 'ur/ rab tu 'ur 'ur/ kun du rab tu 'ur 'ur/ chem chem/ rab tu chem chemadu/ kun du rab tu chem chem/'jig rten du shin tu 6)snang ba dpag tu med par yibyung bar gyur 7to/ /gzhan yang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i cho 'phrul mthong ngo / /snyoms par zhugs pa 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa/bdud thams cad rab tu 'joms par byed pa/ sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa/ chos kyi dbyings grangs med par sems can gyi khams rnam par grol bar byed pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin gyi ting nge 'dzin rnam par rtog pa med pa'i ye shes kyi 86—763

me yang dag par byung ba/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byang chub kyi yo)snying po nye bar ston pa/ sna tshogs pa'i gsung gis ②'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor rab tu sgrub ①pa/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yab/ sems can nyon mongs pa'i mun nag tu lhung ④ba thams cad kyi snang bar gyur pa/ ngan song dang ske/ ngan 'gror ltung (snyeb thams cad kyi ded ⑥dpon/ sdug bsngal bas nyam (7thag pa rnams kyi (nyabade bar gyur pa6)/ mdor na sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal gang dang gang ldan pa de dang der rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gsang sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo chen po'i ⑩rgyal po'i snying po 'di sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir ro/ /na maḥsarsā (me sha pa ri pu (ster ke bhyaḥ/ sasba (nyeta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sab thā lha'i/ bcom ldan 'das kyis khro bo'i snyisnying po 'di gsungs ma thag tu gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan ⑩pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'i bdud kyi gnas thams cad dang / bdud kyi ris de dag dang /gang sems can 7thams cad mog mog por byas te/ sems can yo sdug bsngal ba rnams ni bde ba thams cad dang ldan par byed pa'i snang ba mdzad de/sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par byas nas ma lus pa'i srid pa'i bdag po'i sa gzhi rab tu 'gul bar gyur to/ /gzhan yang 'jig rten du bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo mtshar rab tu byung bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub 17pas gsang ba pa'i ( rtabadag po phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /lag na rdo rje (2nya'adi ni khro bo'i rgyal po de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po mchog gi de kho na nyid/ stong nyid 'di las gzhan dag byung / /chos kyi dbyings kyi bdag nyid de/ /'di las rgyal ba 'a byung ba mthong //86—764

'di ru rgyal ba thams cad bzhugs/ /srid pa'i khams ni 'di las 6)sprul/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /ma byon pa de de bzhin gzhan/ /thams cad 'di las yang dag byung / /nam mkha' lta bu ②dri ma med/ /spros pa thams cad rnam par bral/ /ngag gi spyod yul rnam par spangs/ /rtag par spros pa (0med pa nyid/ /nam mkha' lta bur gnas pa yin/ /tha snyad sngon ④du byas nas ni/ /gsang sngags rjes (5)su brjod pa yin/ /tha snyad kyang ni rtog pa ste / /de nyid ⑥nu ni brjod pa med/ /tha snyad la ni brten nas su/ /skyob pas de nyid gsungs pa yin/ /sems can med de sgyu ma bzhin/ /yid kyis bsgom par bya ba yin/ /la (3)lar sgyu ma ci (kyebazhin du/ /rang bzhin med par yang gyur 5)te/ /stong nyid de yi rang bzhin du/ /tha snyad rnams ni rtogs par bya /de ltar gsang sngags mgon po 'di/ /rang bzhin med par mnyam par mdzes /'dod pa'i don rnams stsol ba yang / /thams cad kyang ni rdzogs par byed/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun du bzang po la sogs pa thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor tsodang / tshangs pa dang / dbang po la sogs pa rnams shin tu ngo mtshar rmad du gyur cing snying po rnams spangs te/ de (nyuthams cad bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la bltas nas/ tshig 'di dag mgrin gcig gi ngag gis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis sngon chad ma thos pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo 'di bskor ba bcom ldan 'das ngo mtshar to/ /bde bar gshegs pa ngo mtshar to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag mchog tu bde ba dang ldan par 'gyur ro/rta/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di ni nyan thos thams cad dang / rang sangs 86wa 765

rgyas rnams kyi spyod yul ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das 6)bdud sdig to ②can rnams dang / bgegs kyi gzugs can thams cad kyis bgom ②par mi nus lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di ni sems can thams cad kyi don dam pa'i ④yid bzhin gyi nor bu lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di ni mngon par ⑤'dod pa'i don skong ba lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di ni de bzhin ⑥gshegs pa'i bstan pa dang / sems can rnams kyi ④sung (nyam lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di ni srin po dang grul bum yo)la sogs pa thams cad kyis 'da' bar mi nus pa tshulags so/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas byang chub sems dpa' chen po de dag dang / lha la sogs pa'i 'khor de rnams la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ gtsug lag legs so legs so/ /slar yang gtsug lag nges par legs so/ /de ltar gtsug lag 'di'i tshig brjod pa mdzes pa de ltar ji lta ba (1de bzhin du yin no/ /'on kyang gtsug lag gi bstan pa srung bar 7byed pa'i khro bo'i rgyal po chen po'i snying po'i 6)gzhung 'di bdag gis gti mug gi mun pas g.yogs pa'i sems can sdug bsngal ba rnams la bltas nas gsungs te/ 'di ni nyan par ma nus pa'i/ /go 'phang rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis gsungs/ /de rnams the tsom 7phyir bdag gis/ /ye shes sgron me yang dag sparaska / /byis pa 7sdug bsngal yang dag khengs(me/ /sa gzhi steng ni 'di na gnas / /tshul 'di rab tu mi shes pas/ /khyim gyi bcing ba ( dam pos bcings / /de nas bcom ldan 'das la gsang ba'i yi7bdag po lag 6nyan rdo rjes mig gnyis 'bru tshugs su bltas nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 86—766

'das ngo mtshar to/ /bde bar 1)gshegs pa ngo mtshar to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di ni mthu che lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das khro bo'i rgyal po de'i snying po'i gzi brjid dang mthu ni bdag gis mi bzod lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das khro bo'i rgyal po'i snying po 'di ni gdul dka' 'dul ba lags sol/ /bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas bka' stsal pa/ gsang ba'i bdag po 'di ni ci ③skad du smras pa ④de bzhin no/ /'on kyang gsang ba'i bdag po bdag ni gsang sngags kyi rgyal po 'di'i mthus nyon mongs pa thams cad dang bdud ci ⑤sted las rgyal lo/ /gsang ba'i 6)bdag po gang yang bdag gis 'jig rten gyi khams na 'dod pa tha dad pa sna tshogs kyis sems can rnams dga' bar byed pa'i gsung gi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor 'jig rten gyi khams sna tshogs pa'i bsam pa tha dad pa rnams la bstan pa de rnams ni 'di'i byin gyis brlabs ⑦kyis bdag gis bstan to/ /gang yang gsang ba'i bdag po byang chub sems dpa' chen po dbang thang thams cad thob pa'i ye shes kyi stobs rtul (8)phod pa brnyes po)pa 'di yang snying po'i 4 )byin gyis brlabs kyi (nyayin no/ /gcig tu sems can don rab brtson/ /sa gzhi la ni rnam par bzhugs/ /sems can rnams la phan 'dod pas/ /sprul pa rnams kyang 'gyed par mdzad/ /mchod cing mnyes par dzi)rtag tu ni/ /rgyal ba zhing na yi yang dag bzhugs/ /ji srid phyogs rnams gnas kyi bar/ /rtag par rgyun du mchod 'gyur ba'i/ /sangs rgyas kun ni mnyam pa ru/ /byang chub ces bya 'di la skibazhugs/ /rang bzhin med pa'i chos rnams ni/ /skye ba dang ni 'gags 7pa yin/ /tha snyad tsol ni brten gnas yinasu/ /gang zhig sgyu ma bzhin du gsungs/ /sgyu ma stong pa nyid yin ltar/ /chos rnams mtshan nyid de 86—767

bzhin no/ /'on kyang gsang ba'i bdag po bdag gis bskal pa grangs med pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag grangs med kyi bskal pa snyed du sems can sna tshogs kyi lus blangs nas sdug bsngal spyad de mgo dang / lag pa dang / rkang pa dang /mig dang / yan lag gi mchog dang / chung ma dang / bu dang / bu mo dang /glang po dang / glang 93)dang / shing rta la sogs pa dang / gzhan yang phyi rol gyi dngos po rnams yongs su btang ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs nas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams sna tshogs pa rnams kyi tshul gyis bsam pa sna tshogs dang / 'dod pa sna tshogs pa la sgra dbyangs dang / tshig dang —/ yi ge bstan cing spyod lam sna tshogs kyi mtshan ma'i cha byad (2)dang /dbyibs kyi khyad par can gyis 95)bdag gis sems can rnams kyi don byas shing gang byang chub kyi snying por bdud bzhi bcom pa de thams cad gsang sngags kyi rgyal po 'di'i mthus byas so/ /'di ni sangs rgyas rnams 'phel bar byed pa bdud las kyang rgyal bar byed pa bstan pa thams cad kyi don yod par byed pa/gzhan yang sna tshogs ma lus pa'i bgegs las kyang rgyal bar byed pa ste/ 'di las gnyis pa gzhan yod min/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis mi 'gyur sngags/ )/ /de bas snying gar gzhag 3nas kyang / /ci (6ltar bde bar rnam par gnas/ /sdang sgyubar byed pa'i bgegs kyang med/ /glags tshol gzhan yang yod ma yin/ /rtag tu dgra yi 'jigs pa'ang 987med/ /rkun la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa'ang med//'jigs pa kun las rnam par grol/ /de yi snying gar ri9gnas bsgoms (7pas/ /bdag ni yun rings 11bsgral ba ru/ /'khor ba'i rgya zimatsho 'jigs pa las/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis bsngags pa'i gtso/ /go 'phang bdag gis ji ltar 'thob//86—768

bdag gis ci yang thob med par/ /tshul 'di las ni rnam spyod nas/ /de 'dir mi 'gyur thob par bya/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyis rgyas pa thob/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis 3)gsungs pa yi/ /gsang sngags sgrub thabs bsten (9par bya/ /de nas ((yid bzhin nor bu'i 'od/ /sku ni 'di ru thob par 'gyur/ /gang zhig tshul 'dir gnas pa yi/ /de rnams kyi ni dngos grub phyir/ /gang tshe sngags pas mnyam gzhag (3)pas/ /de bas 6)ma brnyes pa yang (nya'athob/ /'dis ni mi phyed pa yang 'byed/ /mi rgyal ba las ma lus rgyal/ / stobs chen gsang sngags bzlas pa yis/ /rdzogs sangs go 'phang sbyin par byed/ /dran dang rtogs dang sems pa yi/ /sngags rig gang du song gyur pa/ /me ni 'bar ba ji lta bar/ /sngags pa gsal bar mthong bar 'gyur/ /6)gang tshe gsang sngags rgyal po bsten(8)/ / de las (nyuga'abras med ci yang med/ /gsang sngags stobs chen dran pa ni/ /las ni 'dod pa byed par 'gyur/ /sngags kyi mgon po ma lus pa/ /'di ni myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /gang tshe gsang sngags 'bras 'dod pas/ /'dir ni the tsom 7mi bya'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dag ngo mtshar ba'i snying po ma spangs par sgra skad gcig tu dungs pa'i /1 dbyangs kyis gsol pa/ e ma'o sangs rgyas bsam mi khyab/ /sems can don rnams thugs su chud/ /rtog pa med pa'i rang bzhin yang / /bsam mi tu khyab pa'i go 'phang shod/ /gang zhig 'chang bar yi byed pa'i mi/ /de yi mngan 'gro rnam par bcad/ /gang gis lag tu chud pa ltar/ /de yi tshedangos grub lag mthil gnas/ /'jig sa pa med cing nga yir med/ /dogs pa thams cad rnam par spangs/ /zad par sa la 86—769

bzhugs nas su/ /sems can la ni ma bsam byed/ /gsang sngags rgyal po skyob pa yis①/ /bdag cag thams cad skyob par byed/ /'dod pa'i don ni byed 'dod pas/ / gsungs pa ②yid kyis sgom par byed/ /de nas thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor 'di dag tshig 'di brjod nas de ma thag tu cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de nas thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur te spyan rgyas shing shākya'i rigs dga' ba la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshig gi nus pa med do/ /de nas nam mkhar gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpas ①ngo mtshar 'di thos nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la steng gi dunam mkha' la sna tshogs pa'i me tog gis ①snyim pa bkang ste bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pas mngon par bstod pa/ rtag tu dag cing dri med pa/ /rtag par rgyun du rtog pa med/ /rtag tu rtog pa ⑥med par bzhugs/ /dpa' bo chen po phyag 'tshal bstod/ /khyod kyi ④chos kun g.yo ba med/ /thams cad legs sbyar spyod yul bas/ /rtag tu g.yo ba med mkhyen pas6)la/ /spros dang bral la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sems can rnams la phan 'dod pas/ /spyod pa spyad pa gsungs pa ste/ /dag pa rnams ni yang dag 'byung 9)/ /dag pa'i sems dpa' phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ji ltar nam mkha' bzhin du dag /rdul phran thams cad rnam par spangs/ /de ltar byamagon khyod sku yang ni/ /kun du rtog pa thams cad spangs/ /shel sgong bzhin du shin tu dag /nam mkha' lta bur spros pa med/ /dngos po thams cad rnam dag pas/ /ye shes rgya mtsho phyag 'tshal bstodatunye/ /nam mkha' la ni 'ja' tshon ltar/ /gtso bo khyod ni rtag tu mthong / /de ltar dag pa'i sems can gyis/ /rtag tu gtso bo khyod mthong ngo / /ngan 'gro thams cad rnam par grol/ /dpa' bo chen po 86—770

khyod nyid 'khrungs/ /dbyings kyi snying po yang dag byung / / ye shes ①gcig tu gzi brjid che/ /sa gzhi thams cad nges pa ru/ /sems can sdug bsngal kun tu gzigs/ /sdug bsngal 'di ni zad byas nas/ /bla med go 'phang 'dra bar 'gyur / /gsang sngags rnams kyi gtso sngags 'di/ /chos rnams kyi ni blo 'phel bar②ske/ /rgyal ba'i sras po thams cad bskyedal/ /gtso bo khyod kyis gsungs pa yis / /dang ④po thams cad yang dag 'gyur/ /rgyal ba bdag nyid rgyu med 'khrungasaX / /las dang skye bas rnam par grol/ /rgyal mchog gtso bor 'khrungs par 'gyur/ /ye shes me lce rang bzhin med/ / 'dus byas duthams cad rnam par spangs/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin gcig /rgyal ba bla med phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /ces pas ⑦so/ /de nas gsang ba'i dubadag po lag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pas sngags kyi tshig gi don zhus pa/ bcom ldan gsang sngags ji ltar bsgrub6)/ /sgrub pa'i thabs ni ji ltar lags/ /sgrub thabs rtsa ba ci zhes bya/ /ji ltar yang ni de bstan lags/ /ji ltar sems ni dag pa'i phyir/ /gtso bo 'di ni ci zhig bsgom/ /ji ltar de ni 'bras bu med/ /sngags pa yis ni brten ⑩par bya/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /byang chub sems ni brtan (nyebyas nas/ /sngags kyi dngos grub brjod par bya/ /sngags 8kyi dngos grub bya'i cho gtunye /gzhan du thams cad 'bras bu med/ /ji ltar rtsa ba bskyed min na8/ /shing gi me tog 'bras bu med/ /de ltar 8gsang sngags 'bras bu shes/ / byang chub sems ni rtsa ba yin/ /⑩byang chub sems ni bskyed nas su/ /bla na med pa'i go 'phang 'thob/ /'di la gnas pa'i chos 86—771

kun ni/ /skye dang gnas pas 'byung ba ste0)/ /dngos po thams cad mdor bsdus nas/ /rang bzhin med cing bsam du med/ /byang chub sems ni nges par 'thob②/ /gzhan du 'ba' zhig par 'gyur ro/ /bu ni seng ge 'dra ⑧yin te / /stong nyid 'dus byas sgom par byed/ /srid pa thams cad sgyu ma yin/ /gang zhig bsam pa'i 'bras bur gnas/ /mu stegs rnams kyi 'dod bshad pa/ /bdag dang srog dang gang zag bcas/ /gtso bo skyes bur bshad pa dang / /gang du khyab par gnas pa dang / /de ltar 'khor ba ④rnams brtags nas/ /'khor ba'i dngos po 'ba' zhig ste/ /mngon pa'i nga rgyal gyis rmongs nas/ /byis pa sdug bsngal bden pa can/ /log pa'i zhags pas bcings pa yi(snye/ /sdug bsngal ba de rnams (6chibaltas nas/ /de rnams ri kun la (kyebarjod pa yin/ /'di skad gsung ni bka' stsal to/ /srog med sems can kyang yod min/ /byed pa po med gtso bo'ang medapo)/ /khyab pa med cing dngos po'ang med/ /rdzas la sogs pa'i rang bzhin med/ /log shes rang bzhin zhags pa ni/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba rnam par spangs/ /dngos po thams cad rnam par bral sna tshogs ji bzhin rnam bsgoms 7pas/ /dngos po kun las rnam par grol/ /stong pa nyid kyi go 'phang 1nya'athob/ /phyi rol nang gi khyad par gyis/ /de ltar thams cad rnam par bsgomanye / /dbu (12ba chu bur dang sgyu ma/ /stong nyid 'ba' zhig las ldang ste/ /de ltar thams cad rnam bsgoms nasayi/ /ye shes go 'phang ngo rnams khurtog /sdig pa'i cho ga tshulas grol nas/ /'chi med go 'phang du grol 'gyur/ /phung po khams dang skye mched dang / /gzhan yang gzung 'dzin rnams las 'das/ /kun mkhyen ye shes zhags pa ni/ /'chi (1 ba'i don 86—772

du rab tu brtag /gang du phung po khams med cing / /skye mched rnams ni 'byung ba med/ /dngos po kun las rnam grol bar0)/ /rgyal ba mchog gis rtag tu gsungs/ /gang du kun gzhi rnam shes (9med/ /bdag med gang zag kyang yod min/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sa steng la'adi/ /gang du thams cad sgyu mar gsungs/ /nga ni kun mkhyen mnga' brnyes pa/ /sems zhugacan don rnams thugs su chud/ /cho ga bya ba la zhugs phyir/ /bu la ma lus par bshad do/ /gang zhig kun gzhi yod pa dang / /gal te rnam shes kyang yod pa/ /de yi bdag nyid bdag gi bu/ /yod do zhes kyang bstan gyur pa/ /dngos po'i ⑤ gdon gyis brlams 6)pa yi/ /byis pas sdug bsngal rnams (7)mthong nas/ /bdag gis gzhug par bya phyir bu/ /cho ga rgyas pa gsungs pa yin/ /sems can med cing srog kyang med/ /gang zag med cing byed po'ang med/ /rnam shes med cing kun gzhi med/ /gang la bdag med dbang phyug med/ /skyes bu med cing khyab pa'ang med/ / dngos po na med cing sgyu 9༄yang med/ /dngos po kun las rnam par grola'o/ /dam chos dri ma med pa bshadatsho1)/ /de nyid mchog gi gtso bo ste/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang bstenadzige/ /rtag par rgyun du go 'phang bsten/ /rtag tu yinargyun du bsgom par bya/ /byang chub sems ni rnam par bsgom / /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam grol bar/ /dngos po thams cad rnam par sbyang pa/ /phung po khams dang skye mched dang ge/ /thams cad stong nyid sgyu ma ltar / /byang chub sems ni bsdus pa nyid/ /byang chub sems dpa' blo ldan gyis / /de ltar yid kyis bsgom par bya/ /phun sum tshogs pa thams cad nye/ /gang zhig sangs rgyas nyid kyi thugs/ /bag yod pas ni rtag bsten yin/ /byang 86—773

chub sems kyi myu gu 'char/ /bsnyen par 6)gyur na 'bras bu chung ②/ /gsang sngags spyod pas gang dag skye / /yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i sku/ /byang chub sems kyis 'thob par 'gyur/ /nam mkha' lta bur byagos med pa'i/ /sku ni kun du 'thob par 'gyur/ /byang chub sems ni bsgom pa yi/ /bsod phyinams bsam gyis mi khyab bshad/ /sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul che kun gyis/ /'bras bu'ang bsam gyis mi khyab gsungs/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rje stan las langs te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas/ rdo rje'i skabs su rtol ba blangs te bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /ye shes rgya mtsho las byung ba'i/ /khyod kyi sras po nga mnyes gshin / /'di dag shin tu som nyi za/ /bdag gis ji ltar rtogs par bgyi/ /gang yang byams pa la sogs gzhan/ /sa bcu ma lus pa thams cad/ /'di la the tshom 'tshal zhing mchis/ /thub pa chen po rtsibashad du gsol/ /gang zhig sems can don ma byas/ /bsod nams ye shes rnam par spangs/ /de rnams la ni thugs brtse'i (7)phyir/ /bcom ldan 'das la 'di gsol 'debs/ /de ring bdag la ma lus par(8)/ /sems can phan par brtson pas dzi)gsungs/ /'di yi mthu stobs kyang ni ci/ /'di yi pha rol gnon pa ci7/ /mi g.yo zhes bya'i gtso khyod kyis/ /'dir ni ji ltar yang dag gsungs/ /'di las gzhan pa'i go 'phang med/ /'di dag thams cad gsung du gsol/ /gang gi (1go 'phang de 'grub pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor yang ni bshad du gsol/ /gang gis sa stengs tsha'adi thob pa'i32/ /bsam mi khyab pa'i go 'phang gsungs/ /gsang sngags kyi ni tshad kyang gsungs/ /dkyil 'khor yang ni ji ltar lags/ /mgon 86—774

po 'di la the tshom za/ /gang 'dir 'gro ba la phan phyir/ /sngags kyi dngos grub de bzhin gsungs/ /de nyid las kyi dbye ba yang / /mngon spyod kyang ni rab tu bshad / /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dag gis/ /mgon pos ji ltar cher myur bar / /sngags 6)bzlas pa yi ⑧'bras bu mchis/ /mgon pos bzla ①ba'i mtshan nyid ni/ /sa stengs ④'dir ni de ji ltar/ / me thab kyi ni cho ga dang / /⑤de yang tshim dang bsang ⑥ gtor dgatso) /khro bo'i ⑧rgyal po dang ldan pa/ /mgon pos de dag thams cad gsungs/ /nyi ma gcig gi nyin phyed nas/ /zla ba brgyad pa'i skad cig tu/ /dngos grub dag ni yang dag gsungs/ /dug gi las kyi gso spyad dzi)dang / /rdzas kyis 7sbyor ba'i las sna tshogs/ /mngon par brjod pa yang dag 'byung / /ma lus pa ni bshad du gsol/ /gang gis dngos ⑩grub thob pa yi8/ /mgon po gzhan ni ma mchis te/ /gtso bo khyod spangs gzhan med do/ /byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo rnams/ /nyan thos rang rgyal rdzu (ge'aphrul che/ /gang yang 'jig rten par grags pa'i/ /tshangs sogs 7rdzu 'phrul cher bshad pa/ /de rnams kyi yang mgon skyabs ni/ /gtso bo khyod spangs gzhan ma mchis/ /de nas byams pa la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / phyag na rdo rje la sogs pas 8slar yang bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba btab pa/ chos kyi rgyal po sngags kyi sgo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad du gsol/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyad spyod pa'i/ /byang chub sems dpa'i don gyi phyir/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ /gang gis bcom ldan nyid kyis gzigs/ /chos kyi dga' bde thob pa ni/ /sa gzhi'i steng na rnam par gnas/ /gsang sngags mnyes yipar rab brtson zhing / /86—775

mthong ba'i chos la bde thob pa'i/ /sems can sa stengs 6)gnas pa yi/ /the tsom (mimed par 'byung bar 'gyur/ /thams cad dbang phyug (kyego 'phang 'thobargya//'jigs (7pa thams cad rnam par spangs/ /gsang sngags rgyal po rdzu 'phrul che/ /'jig rten 'di ru byung (6)bar 'gyur/ /sdang ba'i srin po (7thams cad dang / /'byung po (8rigadon dang sha za dang / /'jigs su rung dang drag shul las/ /sems can rnams la gnod bshad pa/ /gsang sngags stobs chen dran pa yis/ /de dag thams cad 'byung mi 'gyur/ /sa stengs (9)sems can ma rungs pa/ /rnam pa sna tshogs gzhan yang bshad/ /de rnams gdul kyibar bya ba'i phyir/ /rtog pa 'di ni rab tu gsungs/ /lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang / /grul bum yinadang ni lus srul 'apo/ /smyo byed rgyu skar thams cad dang / /ma rungs gza' sogs bshad pa dang / /sems can sdig can de rnams la/ /khro bo 'di ni rab tu gsungs/ /tshangs sogs gdon gyi tshogs kun dang / /de bzhin rgyal po nyan thos dang / /sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /gang zhig bshad par mi nus shing / /de dag thams cad thal bar rlog12 /gsang sngags bzlas pa rdzu 'phrul che/ /snying la gnas pa yang dag bsam/ /gsang sngags zhes bya mthong dka' zhing / /ma lus pa ru thal bar brlagasas / /tshangs pa la sogs dkyil 'khor dang / /byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che/ /dbang po'i tsoganas bcu bdag po yis/ /'di ni bzod par mi nus te/ /khro bo'i rgyal po rol pa ni/ /sdang ba'i sems can ci nas kyang / /ras bal 'da' ba mtshungs par brtag /ming nas smos lapa tsam gyis ni/ /phyogs bcu rnams su 'byer bar 1 'gyur/ /de bas rnam pa thams cad kyis/ /gsang sngags 'di ru bzlas 86—776

pa ni/ /rtag par rgyun du dran par bya/ /gsang sngags dngos grub 'dod pa yis / /thams cad du ni 'jigs med par/ /sngags gnas sa stengs yo)'di ru bya / /gsang sngags mgon po dran pa dang / /'chang ba dang ni rtag tu zlos②/ /me yi nang du gnas pa ni①/ /mche ba gtsigs pa yi ni skus/ /'byer te rtag tu 'jigs pa med/ /mtho ris them skas lta bur (snyadaga'/ /'jigs shing skrag pas 'khrigs pa na/ /rgyal po chen pos 'jigs (gepa sel/ /chom rkun gseb tu chud pa na/ /seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa'i sku/ /khro bo'i rgyal po rdzu 'phrul che/ /de yis rtag tu dran par byas/ /rims dang so mig gzer zug dang / /rked pa'i rtsib (5)logs lus las byung / /rnam pa sna tshogs kun 'byung ba'i/ /sa stengs (7)lus can nad rnams ni/ /gsang sngags dran pa tsam nyid kyis/ /de dag thams cad zad par 'gyur/ /khro rgyal bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /mthu dang stobs ni rtul (7phod pa'i/ /kun mkhyen las gzhan sa stengs 5)na/ /rtag tu bzod gnas su zhig yod/ /'khor los sgyur tshuba'i mthu stobs ni/ /ji ltar smra bar mi nus pa/ /de bzhin khro rgyal bsgyings pa yis/nya/ /brjod par yang ni mi nus so/ /ji ltar 'khor los sgyur ba yitshoste/ /yon tan mi g.yos (stebagrang mi nus / /de bzhin khro bo'i rgyal po yi/ /stobs ni brjod par mi nus so/ /rdo rje padma'i rigs zhes pa'i/ /khro bo'i rgyal po thams cad kyang / /khro bo'i mngag gzhug pho nya dang / /bka' mnyan pho nya rdzu 'phrul che/ /de rnams kyis ani khro bo 'di / /'khor los sgyur ba zhes su dzabarjod/ /khro bo'i rgyal po blo ldan gyis/na/ /mthu stobs ( gede ltar bshad pa ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dpal 519)gcig 'di/ /de yi dpa' bo zhes su bshad/ /gang gsungs bden pa'i tshig gyur pas/ /mi 86—777

slu ba ni nyid yin no/ /de phyir 'di ni mi g.yo bas/ /mi g.yo ba zhes mngon par brjod/ /mi g.yo ba yi sa thob pa/ /bsam gtan rtse gcig blo yis ①gnas / /nyan thos sa la ②sogs pa yi/ /bdud rnams kun gyis mi g.yo bdu/ / de nas ④mgon pos mtshan gsol to/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rkang gnyis mchog /byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo rnams/ /'di ni don kun 'grub par byed/ /gang yang 'das pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /gang yang de bzhin ma byon pa/ /mgon po da ltar bzhugs pa gang / /'gro la phan phyir cho ga ni/ /de dag kun gyis 'di gsungs pa/ /sangs rgyas spyan zhes bya bar bshad/ /sems can khams ni thams cad kyi/ /bstan pa gang yin bsrung ⑤bar mdzad/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sprul pa gang ⑥/ /byang chub sems dpa' mthu chen gyis/ /gang yang gsang sngags grangs med pa/ /sems can phan 'dogs bzhugs par gsungs / /lag na rdo rje blo ldan pa/ /'di dag thams cad yang dag bshad/ /mi gang sdig ⑦pas bsgribs med kyini/ /sems can snang ba skyed ⑨par byed/ /mi phyed pa yi kyizhags pas 7bcings/ /bla na med pa'i go 'phang 'gyur/ /khro bo'i rgyal po blo dang ldan/ /sngags pas ma bsgrubs pa ()yang 'grub/ /khro bo'i rgyal po'i byin rlabs 0kyis/ /'dod pa ma lus 'grub par 'gyur/ /de nas thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dag ngo mtshar te/ dga' zhing mig rgyas pas mgrin gcig dang ngag gcig tu tshig snyan pos gsol pa/ e ma'o sangs rgyas thams cad ni/ /thabs dang shes rab bsam du med/ /thugs rjer gyur pa'i thugs kyis ni/ /mtshungs med dam tshig bshad du gsol/ /gang yang sems can 'jigs pas 'khrigs/ /sa stengs mthams cad li'ajigs med cing / /86—778

gang gis gus chen rang bzhin gyis/ /de yi ngan 'gro stongs yo)par 'gyur/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das khro bo'i rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor 'dir zhugs pa tsam gyis sems can thams cad rgyal po'i dbang phyug gi go 'phang 'thob ②par 'gyur ba/ bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad kyis 'tshe bar mi nus pa/ dngos grub myur du 'thob par byed pa/ dbang phyug thams cad (5)yang dag par ldan par byed pa bshad rtsidu gsol/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/ lag na rdo rje legs so legs so/ /lag na rdo rje slar yang (45)shin tu legs so/ /khyod kyis kho bo la gsol ba btab pa'i don 'di rigs kyi bu nyon(5)/ khro bo'i rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor 'di gang gis thos pas sa stengs su (7thams cad ngo mtshar zhing mig rgyas 58)te nus pa med pas bzod par 5)mi nus te/ de nas sa stengs su tshe'agyel bar 'gyur te4nya/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe bdud thams cad sreg sna pa'i me lce yang dag par byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la tu snyoms par zhugs nas gsang sngags kyi rgyal po 'di sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par mdzad pa/ dus gsum kun gyi byang chub sems dpa' ma lus pa skyed (7par byed pa/ sems can thams cad kyi don gsal bar byed cing yod pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bsod nams bsam gyis mi khyab pa las ma'akhrungs pa/ sems can thams cad kyis shin tu mthong bar dka' ba/ mthong ba'i bgegs rnams rab tu 'joms pa / ngan 'gro thams cad rnam par sbyong tshabar byed pa/ nad thams cad rab 86—779

tu zhi bar byed pa/ bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa/ gdon ma rungs pa thams cad la gso sbyong mdzad pa/ bdud kyi dgra thams cad las ①rab tu zhi bar mdzad pa'i sngags bka' stsal pa/ na maḥsasba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/sagrwa sha ②pa ri pu ra ke bhyaḥ/ sab bdu/ tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa sbo ṭa ya hūm̐ traṭa tsā māsti / bcom ldan 'das kyis gsang sngags kyi rgyal po bka' stsal ma thag tu thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dag chu shing ⑤gi sdong bu lta bu byadang nags tshal chen po lta bur bab col du khas ⑦bub tu 'gyel bar gyur to/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i (nya'ajig rten gyi khams 'di 6)rnam pa ⑩drug tu g.yos par gyur pa dang —/ ldeg pa dang / 'gul ba dang / rab tu 'gul ba dang / g.yos pa dang ske/ rab tu g.yos pa dang / chem chem/ rab tu chem chem moyi/ / shar phyogs mtho na nub phyogs dma'/8 lho phyogs mtho na byang 'phyogs dma' bar gyur to8/ /gzhan yang ngo mtshar zhing med du 8byung ba mthong ste ngo mtshar che bar gyur pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnams su sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams sna tshogs pa yang mthong ngo / /gang yang gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'i ⑩bgegs sna tshogs dang / srin po dang bdud kyi rigs sna tshogs dang / gzhan yang gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa de dag thams cad thal bar brlags te/ kha cig kha sgrub tu ni yiganas/ /'jig 'o)pa'i bskal pa lta bur 17ni/ /dud pa 87dud skyar kun du gnas/ /nyi ma zla ba rdzu 'phrul che/ /'di yi snang ba'ang mun par 'gyur/ /mun nag smag ni shin tu 'jigs/ /glog 'gyu yul na 'jigs su rung / /phyogs kun du ni 'o dod 'bod/ /sa gzhi thams cad kun du 'khrug( sto /gza' dang rgyu 8steskar tshogs kun dang (nya/ /gang 86—780

yang lha yi gtso bo gzhan/ /de dag thams cad 'jigs dngangs nas①/ /sems med kha sbub tu ni 'gyel/ /lha min mi 'am ②ci dang klu/ /gnod sbyin srin ①po lus srul po/ /'di rnams lus kyis ma dubazod pas/ /dug gis btab bzhin gnyid yur te/ /'di dag thams cad gcig tu 'bar/ /bskal pa'i me las yang dag byung / /'di dag thams cad 'bar zhing mched/ /sangs rgyas zhing ni kun nas kyang / /byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che/ /sa bcu gnas kyi dbang phyug rnams/ /de yang gnyid bro yur bar 'gyur/ /kha sbub tu ni sa la 'gyel⑤/ /khro mo mngag gzhug bka' zhunyan pa/ /pho nya pho mo ⑦bran dang bcas/ /lus 'di'i tshugs ni mi thub par/ /sems stor kha sbub ⑧'gyel bar gyur⑨/ /gang yang nyan thos bse tsoru dang / /'jig rten rdzu 'phrul chen po gzhan/ /lcags ni shing phye ⑨thul ba ltar/ /de yang gnas su 'gyel bar 'gyur8/ /tshangs pa brgya byin la sogs lha/ /lha min gnod sbyin rdzu 'phrul che / /de dag thams cad thal bar 'gyuratunye/ /sdug bsngal 'khrigs par 'gyur na ni/ /chung 8zad slar yang phan tshun du/ /byed cing 'jigs pas tshig smras te / /bu gcig 'di ni ji ltar 'gyur/ /sa gzhi 'di dag shin tu 'jigs/ /bde gshegs go 'phang ma gtogs pa/ /zhi ba ci yang ma mthong ngo / /bdud dang bgegs kyi gzugs rnams kyang / /rnam pa sna tshogs yang dag gnas/ /lus ni 'gyur ba lta bu ru/ /sa stengs tson ni shing bzhin gnas/ /tshangs pa la sogs yul rnams ni/ /'di dag thams cad 'bar bar ⑩mthong / /mnar med gyur pa'i lus kyang ni/ /dud ka tu dud skyar kun tu gnas/ /sangs rgyas zhing ni ma lus pa/ /'di dag thams cad sreg 4)par byed/ /snying rje zhugs 86—781

shing yang dag ldan/ /phyag na rdo rjes 'di skad gsol/ /sems can don du ma bsams 0)pas/ /bcom ldan bkod pa bsdu ru gsol/ /byis pa sdug bsngal rten can gyis/ /'di ni bzod par (mimi nus so/ /'gro ba'i sems can kun gyi mgon/ /thugs rje rnams ni byung bar mdzad/ /thugs brtse (migacig pu'i stiri las 'khrungs/ /sems can sdug bsngal 'grol (nyamadzad pa'i/ /'gro ba'i mgon po khyod gcig pu/ /gnyen du gyur pa'ang 6)khyod kho na/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las sgrol 9)ba'i/ / mnyan pa yang (7ni khyod gcig pu/ /nad rnams thams cad gso mdzad pa'i/ /khyod nyid gcig pu sman par 'gyur/ /dam pa'i lam ston pa yang khyod/ /khyod ni 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor pha(9)/ /sa stengs 7nyid ni (tekhyod 'ba' zhig /mgon po thugs rje bskyed nas 7ni/ /sa gzhi thams cad yang dag 'phel/ /dpag bsam shing bzhin don gnyer ba'i/ /yang dag dpa' bo byang chub sems/ /sa bcu'i gnas kyi dbang phyug rnams/ /mgon po khyod nyid gcig pus 'phel/ /thugs rje padma 'dam skyes bzhin/ /sems ni ngan par 'gyur ba yi/ /'gro ba'i mgon 6)pos bsreg cipar mdzod/ /snying po med pa lta bur 'gyur/ /chu shing gi ni sdong po bzhin/ /phye (7ma leb bzhin skye bo rnams / /drag tu bod tshapa'i lung thob payi bhe/ /bsregs kyang zug 3nyardzu mi 'byung ste / /de bzhin 'dir ni byis pa rnams/ /bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad dang / /grangs med bcu yi yo6stobs kyi bdag /gsang sngags rgyal po brjod pa yis / /de dag thams cad thal bar brlag tsho /de bas rnam pa thams cad kyis//bcom ldan khyod la bdag gsol 'debs/ /khyod kyi sras po mnyabadag mnyes gshin na / /bdag gi de ni gsan pa'i rigs/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya 86—782

thub pa thugs rje dang ldan pa'i thugs mnga' bas phyag na rdo rje 6)sems can la phan pa'i phyir/ thub pa mchog gi gtso bo la/ /gsol ba btab pa'i tshig 'di ni / shin tu rgya che bu (snyelags so/ / de nas chabacom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe sems can thams cad kyi srog 'byung zhing ye shes 'khrung ba ④zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /snyoms par zhugs nas rig pa'i rgyal mo ⑤'di sems can thams cad la phan par byed pa/ 'dus byas thams cad rab tu 'gyur bar byed pa/ 'jigs pa thams cad rab tu 'jigs (7par byed pa/dgra thams cad dang me dang chu sel bar ⑦byed pa/ sems can thams cad kyi dpal phun sum tshogs shing skal ba bzang (she po thob par byed pa(9)/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / nyan thos dang / rang rgyal skyed tsopar byed pa/ 'jigs pa thams cad sreg (nyepar byed pa/ rnam par 'tshe ba thams cad 'joms par byed pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bzhed pa gsungs pa/ na maḥsasba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sa: sha 8pa ri pū ra ke bhyaḥ/ sasba thā/ oṃ sasba saṃ sku ra 4)pa ri ṅgā ra bi ski shud dha/ dharma tsote ma hā na ya 8pa ri bā re swā hā/ de nas 'di gsungs pa tsam gyis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i yi 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du bde ba thams cad gtad cing kun nas rgyal ba dang ldan pa/ dbang phyug go 'phang yi brnyes (7pa ni/ /rang gi lus la sems bcug pas/ /ngang tshul bzang por yang dag 'byung / /sdig pa thams cad rab tu zhi/ /bcom ldan 'das ni gzigs par 'gyur/ /rig ( )par gyur pa'i sems dang ldan/ /thams cad rang gi srog dang ldan/ /rdzu 'phrul rtul phod par ri gegyur pa/ /shin tu ngo mtshar go 'phang 'thob/ /de ni 86—783

rgyal mchog spyan sngar gnas/ /rang gzhan brtul zhugs brtan 'gyur ba/ /rig pa 'di yi mthu stobs kyis①/ /rang gi rdzu 'phrul g.yul las rgyal/ /sa stengs ②pha rol gnon ②pa 'byung / /thams cad dbang phyug go 'phang 'thob /bdud kun gyi ni gtsor gyur pa/ /sa stengs dugyur to cog kun ni/ /'jigs pa thams cad rnam par bral/ /ngan 'gro zhes ni gang bshad pa'i/ /shin tu sdug bsngal gting gnas te/ /ngan 'gro thams cad rnam dral nas/ /bde ba yi ni snod du 'gyur/ /dmyal ba'i me zhes bya ba yi/ /shin tu blta dka' 'jigs rung de(snye/ /de tshe lhag par bsil ⑥bar 'gyuraX/ /ston ku'i zla ba'i cha ltar gnas/ /gang yang dmyal ba zhes bshad pa/ /shin tu grang ba'i mun nag 'khrigs/ /drag shul me chen 'bar ba bzhin/ /de dag thams cad dro ⑧bar 'gyur/ /yi dgas 6)zhes bya'i sdug bsngal gang / /shin tu mi bzad 'jigs su 0rung / /rig pa 'di yi mthu stobs kyis/ /'di dag thams cad bral bar 'gyur/ /gang yang 'khor de thams cad ni/ /sdug bsngal 0gyis ni sems gdungs pa/ /bde ba thams cad yang dag gtad/ /phan tshun du ni dga' gtam smra/ /bgegs chen log par 'dren pa dang / /gzhan yang srog chags gyur pa gzhan/ /sa stengs 'byung tu po rang sems gnas/ /des par gyur nas 'di rnams ni/ /gcig la gcig ni blta 6)bar 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang / /tshangs pa la sogs rdzu 'phrul che/ /rang sems mdzes par rnal mar ni/ /de rnams thams cad bde ba 'thob/ /pho nya mngag gzhug bka' nyan rtsol8/ /'byung po gdon dang sha laza dang / /thams cad dbang phyug go 'phang 'thob/ /sa gzhi steng na rnam par gnas/ /gang yang 86—784

byang chub sems dpa' brtan/ /thams cad dang ni ldan pa yi/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po 'khor rnams kyis/ /'gro la phan phyir tshig gsol pa/ /e ma'o kun mkhyen mtshungs pa med/ /thabs kyi ye shes bsam mi lang ①/ /sa stengs 0khyod ma gtogs pa yi/ /'byung 'gyur gzhan ni su zhig yod/ /mtha' yas bde ba'i snod du ni/ /'di dag thams cad gang 'dzin mdzad/ /thams cad dbang phyug go 'phang brnyes③/ /sa yi steng ④na rnam par gnas/ /srid pa ⑤sdug bsngal sngar kyiyang med/ /de ltar shin tu mi bzad 'jigs/ /thams cad sangs rgyas sras su 'gyur/ /sems can kun la phan dga' bas/ /sems ni rtse gcig gyur pa yis/ /snyan pa yi ni tshig gis gsol/ /kun gyi gnyen du gyur pa ⑦nibya/ /sangs rgyas nyid las gzhan pa med/ /sems ni smad pa'i rgyu ⑨gyur pa'ang ⑩/ /so so nas ni bde bar mdzad/ /skyes pas yang dag bstan pa ni/ /ji srid mya ngan ma 'das pa/ /de srid bar du 'khor bar zhugs/ /sangs rgyas theg pa tshul gyi ⑩mchog /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / /tshangs pa la sogs 'khor rnams ni/ /thams cad stan tsolas langs gyur te/ /gtso bo gang na bzhugs pa der/ /byang chub sems dpa' (nyeyongs su bskor/ /tshangs sogs rdzu 'phrul che ba'i lha/ /lhan cig yang dag par lhags te/ /bla med go 'phang gsol ba 'debs/ /sems can kun la phan bzhed pa/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la bskor ba 8byas/ /'jig rten mgon la rab btud nas/ /'di skad kyi ni tshig gsol to/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas che ba'i bdag /sems can kun la sman skipar dgyes/ /'jig rten mgon po skyob pa yi/ /thabs ni mtshungs med bsam mi khyab/ /gang gis 'dir ⑩ni gnas par byas/ /sdug bsngal tu rgya mtsho 86—785

rnam par sbyong / /'gro la sman pa khyod mthong na/ /bde ba yang dag 'byung bar 'gyur / /de nas bcom ldan 'das hu)shākya thub pas thugs rje dang ldan pa'i thugs zab pas/ sgra dbyangs 'di skad kyis chatshig bka' stsal pa/ byang chub sems dpa' nirdzu 'phrul che/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan pa khyed ma li'ajigs/ /rdzogs sangs rkang gnyis mchog gi (snyeni/ /bsam gyis ⑥mi khyab 'di dag gsungs/ /de ⑦'dra'i chos ni brten (8)pa ni/ /sdug bsngal gang gis slar yang ni/ /'khor bar de ltar 'ching 'gyur ba/ /bsnyen par gyur pas 'byung mi 'gyur/ /rdzogs sangs rkang gnyis mchog gi 6)ni/ /theg pa chen po yang dag gsungs/ /lam ni yang dag bsdus nas ni/ /thams cad sdug bsngal las rab grol/ /de ni mchog gi de nyid zhi/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi theg par brjod( )/ /theg pa dam pa 'di bzung 17nas/ /sangs rgyas nges par gdon tu)mi za/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas kun dang ni/ /de bzhin gang yang ma byon pa/ /mgon po da ⑩ltar bzhugs pa rnams/ /'gro la phan pa'i tshul nyid las/ /de dag thams cad yang dag gzung ski/ /sdug bsngal zhi ba thob skipar 'gyur/ /de phyir rnam pa thams cad kyi/ /'di lta bu yi tsodam chos bsten/ /gtso bo 'di ni bsnyen gyur tu na / /sdug bsngal rnams ni sel bar byed/ /gang yang byang chub sems dpa' gzhan / /tshangs pa la sogs rdzu 'phrul che/ /sems can phan par zhugs pa yi12 / /spyan sngar snyan 17pa'i tshig 'di gsol/ /mgon po khyod kyis ci zhig gsungs / /bdag gi yid kyang rten ( )gzhan med/ /khyod nyid skyabs su gyur pa las / /mchog gzhan zhig ni yod ma yin/ /kun gyis 31dbang phyug go 'phang brnyes / /rang gi rdzu 'phrul snyems tshul gyuratsho snye/ /'jigs pa kun dang rnam par 86 —786

bral / /sdug bsngal 1)thams cad rnam par spangs/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po gus par ldan/ /theg pa chen por yang dag gnas / /byang chub mdzad pa la sogs 'thad/ /ces pa'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dag bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la gtugs nas gsol ba btab pa/ bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rgyal po bdag cag la thugs brtse ba bskyed de/ sems can thams cad dbang phyug gi (kyego 'phang thob par byed pa/ nad thams cad gso sbyong mdzad pa/ dpal thams cad dang ldan pa/ dus ma yin pa nidang /bgegs thams cad 'joms par byed pa dang (4ra/ dgra thams cad dang / nye bar 'tshe ba dang / chom rkun dang / mi rgod dang / rgyal po'i gnod pa dang /seng ge dang / stag la sogs pa dang / rims dang / skran dang (5)/ mtshan bar rdol ba dang / sdig sprul gyi gnod pa thams cad 'joms par byed pasti/gang gis khro bo'i rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor gyi chos nyid mthong bas sems can thams cad kyis rdo dbang phyug gi (8)go 'phang thob (9)par 'gyur ba bshad du gsol/de skad ces gsol bcom ldan 'das/ /shākya'i tshemagon po rdzu 'phrul che/ /rdo rje byung ba che ba'i bdag /snyan pa'i tshig gis bka' stsal pa/ /sa stengs kyi 67ni dkyil 'khor mchog /bshad par bya phyir bu khyod nyon/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i gsang ba ni/ /khyod la yang dag bshad par bya/ /phan pa'i sems kyis tshur la nyon/ /khro bo'i rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /'di dag thams cad ma gsungs pa/ /ngan (1 pas sems ni 'khrigs pa la/ /bu khyod kyis ni sbyin mi bya/ /re zhig nyu slob dpon rab tu 86—787
