nas kyang tshangs pa dang srin po grol bar byed do/ /sbrul nag pos zin pa zla ba ①drug nas mnan par 'dod na khros pas ral gri'i phyag rgya bris la lto 'phye chen po'i rigs ldan gyis bskor te/ de nas ral gri la stong phrag gcig mngon par bsngags nas dbus su de lta bur 'bar ba 'dra ba ②dgod par bya ste de nad pa la bstan na nges par la'ajug go/ /'phags pa mi g.yo ba spyan gcig pa'i snying po thun gsum du thergya rtsa brgyad bzlas na rtag tu 'brel par 'gyur ro/ /dben pa'i sa phyogs su zan gyi chang bu byin na mchog chen po stsol ④bar 'gyur te/ snying po'i phyag rgya bcings te khros pas/ yi ge hūm̐ bzlas na sprin dral ⑤bar byed do/ /tsher ma skye 6)tshes btags pa'i sbyin sreg byas na 6)rlung gi char pa gtun ⑧shing ltar 'jog go/ /sgrub pa yo)po la bsrung ⑩ba chen po byed do/ /mi rnams rkang pa g.yon pa mnan 3stobs bsgrubs na bka' nyan par 'gyur ro/ /lha dang mi rnams kyi rtegazugs brnyan byas nas gcad yosten 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /lha dang mi thams cad kyi gzugs brnyan byas nas de lcags kyi phur bus btab pas phur bu dang ldan pho 7par 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'ching bar 'dod par gyur na skud pa ser po la mngon par bsngags te gzugs dkris nas yi bcings par 'gyur ro/ /btsir bar 'dod na lha la sogs pa'i gzugs brnyan byas nas steng du spang leb kyis mnan na btsir bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas brdeg yipar 'dod na mi la sogs pa'i gzugs brnyan byas te re'u slud 11bus brabs na dgu tunyezhing 'ongs nas bka' bsgo 3)byed do/ /gnon par 'dod na lha dang mi thams cad kyi gzugs brnyan byas te spang leb la sogs pas mnan na gnon ( )par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar khro bo'i rgyal po rdzu 'phrul chen po 'di ji lta ji ltar sbyor ( nyab de lta de ltar 86—884

las gzhan ngo mtshar che ba yang stong phrag byed do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes khro bo'i rgyal po chen po'i sngags bka' stsal pa/ na maḥsasba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sarba bi shwa mu kha hutabhyaḥ/ /sasba thā/ oṃ tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ tāṭa ②ma hā tsaṇḍa ③a tsa la kā ṇa/ rtsu tt+waṃ rtsu/ a pra ti ha ta/ta thā ga tā ṭwāṃ sma ra byas phaṭa phaṭaswā hā/ de nas phyag na rdo rjes slar yang khro bo chen po thogs pa med pa'i cho ga'i 0snying po dpa' bo gcig pa bka' stsal pa/na maḥste ya dhī kā rnabya/ ta thā ga tā nī 'o⑦/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes bka' stsal ma thag tu de nas skad cig de la 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad snang ba chen pos snang bar byas nas de la 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi gang bdud dang bdud chen po 'jigs su rung ba'i gzugs ⑧can dang lha ⑨dang klu dang gnod sbyin la sogs pa de khro bo chen po'i gzi brjid kyis bsregs par gyur/ gang dang gang rang rang gi ⑩der song ste bcom ldan 'das bskyab tu gsol/ bde bar gshegs pa bsregs pa las bskyab tu gsol/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams kyis rang rang gi zhing rnams kyi hunyebagegs chen po de dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu dag khro bo chen po (nyemi g.yo ba zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bka' stsal pa mdzad pa/gdug pa thams cad rab tu ( 'joms par byed pa dran par gyis shig /gzhan du khyod yirnams kyi mgo bo phyag na rdo rje'i skerdo rjes tshal pa brgyar 'gas 7par 'gyur ro/ /gang zhig sgyu ma lta bur sems skyed tunyecig /sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i sems skyed yinyecig /sems can sdig pa thams cad dang bral ba dran par gyis shig /rigs kyi bu dag khro bo'i rgyal po chen po sdug bsngal 86—885

thams cad dang bral ba dran par gyis shig /de nas gdug pa de ①thams cad khro bo'i rgyal po chen po de nyid la skyabs su song ste bcom ldan 'das bdag ni sa'i phyogs su nye bar gnod par mi bgyid do②/ /gang na khro bo'i rgyal po chen po 'di nyid bzhugs pa de bsrung (7bar bgyi'o/ /nye bar dgos pa bskyed do/ /nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad kyang gzhom par bgyi'o/ /zhes ④dam tshig byas nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs kyi drung du lhags nas 'dug go/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rjes slar yang khro bo'i rgyal po chen po spyod pa'i cho ga yang sgrub (5)pa po rnams la bka' stsal pa/ khro bo'i rgyal po chen po 'di gang lkugs 96)pas mi bzlog par yal ga dang / rtsa ba dang / 'bras bu za ba 'am/ chu dang / rlung za bar gyur pa'i skye bos dben pa'i gnas su bzlas pa bya'o/ /khro bo'i rgyal po don yod cing (7thogs pa med pa 'di dkon mchog gsum la rgyab kyis phyogs pa'i sems dang ldan pa nga rgyal che ba mngon pa'i (ming rgyal can gyi gdug pa'i srin po la sogs pa sbyar bar bya'o6)/ /phan pa'i sems kyis byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par dad pas tsho stadakon mchog gsum la dang bar 11gyur par bsgrub par bya'o/ /rtog pa gzhan gyi cho gas 6)kyang dman pa'i sems can sdug bsngal ba rnams ni sbyar bar mi bya'o/ /dkon mchog gsum la mos shing dad pa 1 la khro bo'i rgyal po chen po sbyar bar bya'o/ /mtshams med pa lnga byed pas kyang gdon mi za bar 7cho ga ji ltar mngon par 'dod pa'i dngos grub thob po zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs so/ /de nas dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /thugs rje tshadang ni ldan pa'i thugs/ /sems can khams ni ma lus pa/ /'di kun rnam par gzigs nas su/ /'gro la yophan pa 86wa 886

mdzad pa can/ /snyan pa yi ni tshig gis gsol/ /bcom ldan chos rnams thams cad kyi/ /khyod nyid gcig pu dbang phyug gtso/ /khyod nyid gcig pu kun mkhyen de①/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i nam mkha' can/ /khyod ni skyob ②med sems can gyi/ /skyob pa dpung gnyen thams cad yin/ /sems can kun gyi khyod gcig pu/ /mchog tu mnyes gshin pa yi pha/ /nyon mongs nad rnams gso mdzad pa/ /sman pa'i rgyal po khyod gcig phul/ /khyod ni sems can thams cad kyisti/ /gtso bo mchog tu gzhol ba yin/ /bdag la 'dir ni khyod gcig pu / /gtso bo bdag la gzhan ma mchis/ /sems can rnams la phan 'dod pas / /gang zhig bdag nyid khyod la zhu/ /thugs rje dang ni ldan pa'i thugs/ /mgon po de ni bdag la gsungs/ /sems can ji ltar bde bar 'gyur/ /ji ltar sdug bsngal rten can du/ /gang gis 'dir ni gyur pa yin/ /de rnams bdag la gtso bos gsungs/ /rgyal po mi rgod chom rkun dang / /de bzhin du ni me dang chu/ /nad dang mu ge bdud rnams dang / /de bzhin dus min 'chi bas 'jigs / /char ches pa dang char mi 'bab/ /rtag tu yams kyis 'tshe bas te(nya / /mgon po 'di ru ji ltar yang / /brgya la mi 'gyur ba zhig yin/ /dpal gyis mdzes par brgyan pa yi4)/ /dbang du bya ba nyid dang ni/ /sems can thams cad brtse bar ni/ /thams cad ji ltar 'byung bar 'gyur/ /ngan dog ngan pa de (7ji ltar/ /ji ltar lus po dman par 'gyur/ /du ba'i mdog can hrud hrud (kyipo/ /de nas g.yeng ba nyid dag ni/ /sngags pa dag la 'byung mi 'gyur/ /nye bar 'tshe ba rnam par spangasadzin/ /'di kun ji ltar brtse ba legs7 / /longs spyod dang yang longs spyod 'phel/ /nyal ba dang ni 'dug pa 86—887

dang ske/ /'gro ba 'am ①ni 'dug pa na/ /sngags pa ji ltar bde ba ru/ /de ni rtag tu 'gyur ba yin/ /de la lha ni mngon ⑧spyod cing / /rjes su 'brel ba ji ltar 'gyur/ /las kyi dngos grub ji ltar ni/ /myur ba nyid du 'gyur ba yin/ /srin po lto 'phye ①gul bum dang / /yi dgas ④gcan gzan 0sbrul de bzhin/ /gang ⑥yang rtag tu 'tshe ⑦bas 'debs/ /ji ltar 'tshe bas (kyemi 'gyur lags/ /zhi ba dang ni rgyas pa 'am/ /de bzhin dbang dang mngon spyod kyi/ /las ni ji ltar myur grub nas/ /don yod par ni 'gyur ba lags/ /'di kun skal ba chen po ni/ /da 0ltar yang ni gsung bar rigs/ /chos kyi dbang phyug thub pa yis / /'di skad kyi ni tshig gsan nas/ /phyag na rdo rje des 0chen la/ /snyan pa'i gsung gis bka' stsal pa/ /legs so bu gcig dpa' bo che/ /phyag na rdo rje 0stobs po che/ /rdzu 'phrul che nyid slar yang legs/ / nga yi 8bstan la khyod nyid de/ /khyod nyid gcig pu bdag gi tsoms/ /rtag tu rjes su 'phel byed pa/ /nga yi bstan pa bsrung ④ba yang / /khyod nyid 8kyi yang tshulag na gnas/ /rgyal ba'i sras po khyod gcig pu/ /gtso bo dbang phyug kha lo sgyur⑩/ /khyod nyid gcig pu la rag yo las/ /byang chub thams cad lag mthil gnas/ /gang zhig khyod kyis zhus pa yis67/ /bu gcig 'di ni ngo mtshar to/ /gsang ba mchog gi rmad du byung / /ma lus par ( )ni bshad par 61bya/ /gang zhig bdag gi ()snying la gnas/ /de ni gzhan gyis ( nyebyin gyis brlabs/ /chos rnams kun gyi (nyegasang ba yang / /de nas gzhan du ma gsungs pa/ /dpa' bo khyod la ma lus par / /bshad par bya yis (nyatshur la nyon/ /gang gis dngos grub myur thob pa'i / /gsang ba gang zhig gnas pa yang / /mchog gi ( nyagazugs can lhan cig 86—888

tu / /sa stengs 'di 6)ni rnam par gnas/ /gtsug lag khang ni sna tshogs mdog /de bzhin sna tshogs gzugs 'chang ba/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po mthu che ba/ /de bzhin rgyal ba'i sras po 'chang / /rgyal ba'i chos rnams yang dag ldan/ /dkon mchog gsum la mchog tu gzhol/ /'di rnams mchod cing yang mchod la//gnod pa byed pa sreg par 'gyur/ /de ni rgyal ba'i bden pas bcing (gyi /sems can thams cad dbang du byed/ / 'khrig pa ①brten par gyur pa dang / /me 0ni gang zhig sdig byed pa/ /tshangs spyod dang ni de bzhin gzhan/ /sa stengs ⑤skye bo gang cung zadayi/ /'di kun 'dir ni rnam par 'tshe/ /lha rnams kyi yang de bzhin grong / /gdug ⑦cing mdog sdug pa yi lusadu/ /gnod sems bdag nyid rnam par 'tshe/ /brtan dang g.yo ba phyag 'tshal nas/ /'jig rten 'di ni rnam par spangs/ /sa stengs ⑨bstan pa ma gtogs par/ /de rnams bstan pa 0cung zad med/ /gang gis bde ba myong tunyebyed pa/ /khyod kyis kyang ni mnyan par rigs/ /sngags pas dang po kun byas nas/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas ni nyi ma'i 'od/ /kun mkhyen dbang phyug blo dang ldan/ /spros pa thams cad 'di las gzhan/ /shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos/ /gdod nas zhi ba chen po'i gnas / /skyon rnams thams cad rnam par grol/ /phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'byed/ /'di ni dkon mchog gsum gtso bo(snye/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs par byed/ /gza' rnams gzugs dang mtshan ma dang / /cha byad dang ni dbyibs nyid kyang / /brtan dang g.yo bas mi shes pas8/ /bshad par bya yis 7bu khyod nyon/ /bdag gis ye shes gnas pa 'di/ /mdzes pa'i tshul can skirmad du byung / / sa yi tshonadakyil 'khor kun du ni/ /bu gcig kho yi bos ma 86—889

gsungs so/ /gza' rnams kyi ni mchog gi 6)gzugs/ /mchog tu rmad 'byung ②bsam mi khyab/ /mchog tu mdzes par gyur pa ste/ /khros shing bzhin mi sdug pa yin / /mdzes pa'i gzugs can la brten stinas/ /rang nyid mdzes shing phan par gnas/ /gang tshe gzugs ni bsam mi khyab/ /mchog tu mdzes par gyur pa (geste/ /de tshe 'di ni bsam mi khyab/ /drang srong bsam gtan spyod yul min/ /zhi ba sems can la bya 4)zhing / /khros pa nyid ni khros pa nyid/ /sems can la 'di zhi ba ru/ /de yi tshe na kun du spyod/ /sangs rgyas chos dang de bzhin du/ /dge 'dun mkhas pas mchod byas na/ /de yi gzugs ni nyer mtshon te/ /de yi tshe na mchod par bya/ /zhi ba zhi ba shes par bya/ / rgyas pa stiyang ni rim ji bzhin / /mngon spyod zhes bya ba 'di dang / /dbang du bya ba'i gzugs mtshan nyid / /'di dag thams cad mdor bsdus (kyen/ /de ni rgyas par gsungs pa yin / /shin tu mnyam par gzhag po)mchod pas/ /zhi ba la 7sogs 'di yang min / /phun sum tshogs pa kun byed pa'i/ /dkon mchog gsum ni mngon tunyedu mchodarka/ /yid ni bsdams par gyur pa dang / /dbang po lnga ni bsdams pa yis//dri ma dkar chen zhag tu lon/ /lus la yi bsgos nas khrus kyis brgyanatunye/ /shin tu dben zhing phyugs med par/ /'di ni 'ong bar song nas ni/ /ba lci la dhisogs rtag tu byugs/ /dri yis nye bar byugs nas ni/ /kha dog ser dang dmar ba dang / /dkar po'am de bzhin ljang gu gludang / /nag po yang dag gsungs pa yin/ /kha dog 7yongs su bzung 1 byas nas ste/ /mkhas pas ji ltar rig 19pa nyid/ /yid du 'ong ba'i dkyil 'khor bya/ /sangs rgyas ser po bya ba ste/ /chos ni dkar po nyid du bya/ /dge 'dun ljang gur ne )bya ba ste/ /86—890

gsang ba 'di ni ①yang dag grags②/ /gza' rnams kha dog bye ba ①yis/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni nye bar mtshon/ /mkhas pas de yi 'og tu ni/ /sngags pa'i lus ni rtag tu bya/ /phyag rgya 'chang ba'i phyogs bris te/ /rang gi phyag rgya kha dog mtshan/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni tshad dag ni/ /sor mo bcu drug rab tu grags / /yang na gang ltar yid dga' ba/ /de ④ltar yang dag brtsam par bya /kha dog ji ltar nyer mtshon pa/ /dri dang me tog la ⑤sogs dbul/ /mnyam par gzhag ⑥pas so so ru/ /'di rnams kyi ni gsang sngags bzlasaX/ /sems ni rtse gcig gyur pa yis/ /bde gshegs bdag nyid bsgoms nas su/ /gza' rnams so sor mdun gnas nas/ /gsang sngags brjod par bya ba yin/ /de nas gsang sngags 'di yis ni/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs rdzogs byed/ /na maḥsasba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ/ sagrwa sā pa ri pū ra ke bhyaḥ/ sasba ta thā ga bhasti niswā hā/sarba tra yi/ āḥkhya ā di tya/ su bi shud rgyaḥkyi/ nyi ma dang / zla ba dang /gnon 0po dme / mig dmar gyi'o/ / bi budha pha tsoka /gza' lhag gi'o/ /oṃ bho ga spa da yaḥ(3/ phur bu'i 'o/ / oṃ a su ro dha ma 8hoḥtso/ pa sangs kyi'ol/ /oṃ kroṇḍa baṇḍi pha ka /spen 0pa'i 'o/ /o bi kṛ ⑩ta bklu (nyaru tsi swā hā/sgra gcan gyi'o/ /yang ni gsang sngags re re ni/ /bdun phrag brgya rtsa bdun du bzlas / /sna tshogs gzugs can gza' rnams ni/ /de ltar thams cad mchod par bya/ /skal bzangs 5)skye bar 'gyur ba dang / /longs spyod rgya chen stsol bar 'gyur/ /rgyal po mi rgod chom rkun sogs/ /srin po lto 'phye grul bum rnams / /de kun sum̐ ste'abyung bar mi 'gyur te/ / de yi ( nya'ajigs zhu)pa nam yang min / /nad so rnams kun las rnam par grol/ /sdug bsngal thams cad rnam 86—891

par spangs/ /thams cad dbang phyug go 'phang 'thob/ /the tshom ①med par 'byung bar 'gyur/ /gang yang gzir ②ba nyid 'gyur ba/ /gzir ①ba'i rang bzhin 'gyur dub gnas/ /cho ga bzhin du mchod pa yis/ /phan pa de la 'byung mi 'gyur/ /rtag tu bde bas gnas gyur cing / /brtser ldan sems can mnyes gshin ⑤pa/ /sems ni dang zhing mnyes ⑥pa ste/ /sems can kun la phan par dga'/ /dngos grub las ni phan yon nidhi/ /zhi ba'i sems ni mnyam par gzhag /de yi laphyi rol btsun par brten⑨/ /kun gyi tsogatso bo dbang phyug ste7/ /rgyal po sgyu tso'aphrul chen po dang / /gdug pa'i sems can 'dul 'byed par/ /the tshom 8med par 'byung 'gyur te/ /rgyal ba bden pa gsung bas 8gsungs/ /char ches pa dang char mi 'bab/ /mu ge byung dang rtsod par song / /dkyil 'khor mchod par gyur pa na/ /de la de ni 'byung mi 'gyur / /zhi ba dang ni rgyas pa dang / /gal te las 'di rtsom pa na/ /dri ni cho ga bzhin gsungs pas/ /dang por 'dir ni mchod par bya/ /'di ni sdig ⑩dang ldan pas kyang ⑩/ /de ni myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /nad rnams kun las rnam par grol/ / nyes pa thams cad rnam par spangs/ /sdig pa thams cad rnam par grol/ /6)rtsod pa thams cad rnam par spangs/ /thams cad rtag tu bde bar ni/ /the tshom ()med par 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de ltar mchod pa'i cho ga yis/ / gal te 6 7bsod nams byas mchod na( nya/ / lha yi tsotshogs rnams kun mnyes nas/ /dngos grub rgya chen stsol ( nyebar 'gyur/ /gdug pa'i log par 'dren pa kun/ /srin po 9 )'jigs pa'i gzugs can rnams/ /sngags pa bzlas par ( tsho brtson pa la/ /de ni de la 'tshe mi byed/ /rtag tu sna tshogs nad 86—892
